BLACK WALNUT

黑胡桃

Juglans nigra

黑核桃

Walnut Family

核桃家族

Appearance: A large tree that may grow to 120 feet, black walnut is characterized by its 6-inch- to 2-foot-long

leaves, which are each divided several times into twelve to twenty-four, lance-shaped and toothed leaflets. Fruits are

presented as green orbs with fleshy outer husks that later dry into very hard dark-brown nuts.

外观：黑胡桃树是一棵可长到 120 英尺的大树，其特征是叶子长 6 英寸到 2 英尺，每片叶子多次分成 12 到

24 个矛状齿状小叶。果实呈绿色球状，带有肉质外壳，随后干燥成非常坚硬的深棕色坚果。

Habitat and Range: Common throughout eastern North America; sporadically distributed throughout the Dakotas,

Nebraska, and Kansas; introduced as an ornamental tree in most other regions of the U.S. and southern Canada

栖息地和范围：常见于北美东部；零星分布于达科他州、内布拉斯加州和堪萨斯州；作为观赏树引入美国

和加拿大南部的大多数其他地区

Cycle and Bloom Season: Blooms in spring; bears fruit beginning in early summer

周期和开花季节：春季开花；初夏开始结果

Parts Used: Primarily the green (unripe) outer fruit hulls

使用部分：主要是绿色（未成熟）的外果壳

Primary Medicinal Activities: expels worms (anthelmintic), tightens skin and mucous membranes (astringent),

may induce vomiting (emetic), laxative

主要药用活性：驱虫（驱虫）、收紧皮肤和粘膜（收敛）、可能引起呕吐（催吐）、泻药

=== PAGE 99 ===
Juglans nigra

黑核桃

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract, skin

最强亲和力：消化道、皮肤

Preparation: Extract of the green, unripe hulls

制备：绿色未成熟外壳的提取物

Common Uses: Our purpose for including black walnut in this herbal repertory for animals is as much to discourage

its misuse as it is to express its medicinal attributes. Black walnut hull extract is unquestionably one of the best and

safest worming agents offered by the plant world. But like many substances that can actually make a tapeworm hate

life, it can be toxic to the host if not used with proper care, caution, and training. Black walnut offers symptomatic

worm intervention that is generally safer and kinder to the host animal than most other herbal wormers. The

holistically minded pet owner should also take into account that such intervention is actually contrary to the holistic

principles of using herbs in a natural context. Black walnut kills and expels tapeworms, but the underlying reasons

an animal is infested with an overpopulation of these opportunity-seeking parasites in the first place is not

addressed. For more on the principles we are referring to, and our recommended approaches to parasite control,

please read the section “Parasite-Related Problems” in chapter 3. For now, we must tell you that black walnut,

although safe and effective when used in the correct dose and where indicated by specific circumstances, is an herb

best reserved for use by experienced practitioners.

常见用途：我们将黑胡桃纳入动物草药库的目的既是为了防止其滥用，也是为了表达其药用属性。黑胡桃

壳提取物无疑是植物界提供的最好、最安全的驱虫剂之一。但就像许多实际上会使绦虫讨厌生命的物质一

样，如果使用时没有经过适当的护理、谨慎和培训，它可能会对宿主有毒。黑胡桃提供对症状的蠕虫干

预，通常比大多数其他草药驱虫剂对宿主动物更安全、更友善。具有整体意识的宠物主人还应该考虑到这

种干预实际上违背了在自然环境中使用草药的整体原则。黑胡桃可以杀死并驱除绦虫，但动物感染这些寻

=== PAGE 100 ===
求机会的寄生虫数量过多的根本原因并没有得到解决。有关我们所提到的原则以及我们推荐的寄生虫控制

方法的更多信息，请阅读第 3 章中的“寄生虫相关问题”部分。现在，我们必须告诉您，黑胡桃虽然在用于

正确的剂量和根据具体情况指示的草药最好保留给有经验的从业者使用。

Availability: Black walnut is available in the form of an alcohol tincture from several human-oriented herb product

companies. Black walnut is also used in several over-the-counter wormers, most of which we do not recommend by

virtue of holistic principles.

可用性：黑胡桃以酒精酊剂的形式从几家以人为本的草药产品公司提供。黑胡桃木也用于多种非处方驱虫

剂，但出于整体原则，我们不推荐其中大多数。

Propagation and Harvest: Black walnut is a beautiful, full-sized shade tree that can be purchased from many

landscape nurseries and fruit tree catalogs. The green, unripe fruit hulls are harvested while they remain fleshy, in

early to late spring.

繁殖和收获：黑胡桃是一种美丽的全尺寸遮荫树，可以从许多景观苗圃和果树目录中购买。早春至晚春，

绿色、未成熟的果壳在其肉质状态下被收获。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Garlic and raw pumpkin seeds, added to a good natural diet, are the better choices for

worm control in the majority of circumstances.

替代品和辅助剂：在大多数情况下，添加到良好的天然饮食中的大蒜和生南瓜子是控制蠕虫的更好选择。

Cautions and Comments: Black walnut can be toxic to horses and may cause laminitis, severe gastritis, and

breathing problems in these animals. These problems are believed to be caused not by the hulls themselves but by a

fungus that attacks the green fruit hulls shortly after they fall to the ground. While this suggests that the properly

harvested, fungus-free hulls may be safe for use in horses, we are often left with an unanswerable question of

whether or not the hulls we are using are in fact clean of this fungus. Problems have been recorded in cases where

horses had merely used black walnut shavings as part of their bedding! Concentrations of strong tannins, volatile

oils, and various alkaloid ingredients contained in the bark, leaves, stems, and hulls of black walnut may lead to

vomiting, diarrhea, and gastritis in dogs and cats if ingested in excessive quantities. Remember, anything that can

kill a tapeworm has the potential of being harmful to your animal.

注意事项和评论：黑胡桃可能对马有毒，并可能导致这些动物出现蹄叶炎、严重胃炎和呼吸问题。这些问

题被认为不是由果壳本身引起的，而是由一种真菌引起的，这种真菌在绿色果壳掉落到地面后不久就会攻

击它们。虽然这表明正确收获的无真菌的船体可能可以安全地用于马，但我们经常面临一个无法回答的问

题：我们使用的船体是否实际上没有这种真菌。据记录，马只使用黑胡桃木刨花作为垫料的一部分会出现

问题！黑核桃的树皮、叶子、茎和壳中含有大量的单宁、挥发油和各种生物碱成分，如果摄入过量，可能

会导致狗和猫呕吐、腹泻和胃炎。请记住，任何可以杀死绦虫的物质都可能对您的动物有害。

=== PAGE 101 ===
BORAGE

琉璃苣

Borago officinalis

琉璃苣

Borage Family

琉璃苣家族

Appearance: Borage looks similar to its relative comfrey except borage has a more unruly stature. Plants may grow

to 3 feet tall and quickly sprawl all over a flower bed shortly after rocketing skyward from their emergence as

flattened, well-mannered little rosettes of basal leaves. The unique, 2- to 6-inch-long broadly lance-shaped or

narrowly oval leaves have wrinkled, prickly haired surfaces that bring to mind two-day-old beard stubble. Flowers

are brilliant blue, with five petals and a black-tipped conelike structure at the center of each flower. Flowers are

borne in drooping clusters at the upper branches of the plant.

外观：琉璃苣看起来与其亲戚紫草相似，只是琉璃苣的身材更难以驾驭。植物可能会长到 3 英尺高，并在

从基生叶的扁平、整齐的小莲座丛中飞向天空后不久，迅速蔓延到整个花坛。这种独特的2至6英寸长的宽

矛形或窄椭圆形叶子具有皱纹、多刺的表面，让人想起两天前的胡茬。花朵呈亮蓝色，有五个花瓣，每朵

花的中心有一个黑色尖端的圆锥形结构。花朵以下垂的簇状生长在植物的上部枝条上。

Habitat and Range: Native to many parts of Europe and Asia, borage has been widely introduced as a garden plant

in North America. It grows just about anywhere that has a long enough bloom season to allow for seed development

—basically, from the midlatitudes of Canada southward.

栖息地和范围：琉璃苣原产于欧洲和亚洲的许多地区，已作为园林植物广泛引入北美。它几乎生长在任何

有足够长的花期以允许种子发育的地方——基本上是从加拿大中纬度地区向南。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Borage is a self-seeding annual that blooms from spring to midsummer in most areas.

周期和开花季节：琉璃苣是一种自花一年生植物，在大多数地区从春季到仲夏开花。

Parts Used: Leaves, flowers, and the oil extracted from seeds

使用部分：叶、花和从种子中提取的油

Primary Medicinal Activities: Stimulates milk production (galactagogue), stimulates mucous secretions in the

bronchi (expectorant), astringent, anti-inflammatory, diuretic, mildly calming to the nerves, adrenal stimulant

主要药用活性：刺激产奶（催乳）、刺激支气管粘液分泌（祛痰）、收敛、抗炎、利尿、轻度镇静神经、

肾上腺兴奋剂

Strongest Affinities: Adrenal glands

最强的亲和力：肾上腺

Preparation: The most common uses of this plant require extracting oil from the seed—a process that is impractical

for the do-it-yourself herbalist. The leaves can be dried and used within three months for infusions, in capsules, or in

=== PAGE 102 ===
bulk form powdered and added to your pet’s food. Dried leaves lose their medicinal qualities rather quickly, so use

this herb as early after drying as possible.

准备工作：这种植物最常见的用途是从种子中提取油，这一过程对于自己动手的草药师来说是不切实际

的。叶子可以干燥并在三个月内用于输液、胶囊或散装粉末并添加到宠物的食物中。干燥的叶子很快就会

失去其药用价值，因此干燥后尽早使用这种草药。

Fresh leaves can be scraped of their prickly hairs and made into a poultice or briefly steamed in their entire form

for use as a warm cover dressing for overexerted muscles and minor skin inflammations. Although fresh borage can

be fed to horses and other herbivores, most animals dislike the prickly texture of the foliage.

新鲜的叶子可以刮掉多刺的毛发，制成膏剂，或者将其整个形式短暂蒸熟，用作温暖的覆盖敷料，用于

过度劳累的肌肉和轻微的皮肤炎症。虽然新鲜的琉璃苣可以喂马和其他食草动物，但大多数动物不喜欢叶

子带刺的质地。

Common Uses: Borage is one of many herbs that have been in traditional use for many centuries but nonetheless

has not received the scientific attention it deserves. What we do know about borage is that its seeds contain

impressive amounts of EFAs, especially gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a compound that has proven to be extremely

useful in the treatment of various liver, cardiovascular, and metabolic disorders. In fact, borage seed oil may contain

twice the GLA offered by the oil of evening primrose (Oenothera biennis) seeds. The use of evening primrose

should be avoided in subjects with blood-clotting disorders. Some scientists claim that the GLA in evening primrose

oil can decrease blood cholesterol and blood pressure and cure rheumatoid arthritis.

常见用途：琉璃苣是许多世纪以来一直被传统使用的草药之一，但仍然没有得到应有的科学关注。我们对

琉璃苣的了解是，它的种子含有大量的必需脂肪酸，尤其是γ-亚麻酸（GLA），这种化合物已被证明在治

疗各种肝脏、心血管和代谢疾病方面非常有用。事实上，琉璃苣籽油的 GLA 含量可能是月见草 (Oenothera

biennis) 籽油的两倍。患有凝血障碍的受试者应避免使用月见草。一些科学家声称，月见草油中的GLA可以

降低血液胆固醇和血压，并治疗类风湿性关节炎。

=== PAGE 103 ===
Borago officinalis

琉璃苣

Recent studies suggest that EFA deficiencies may be strongly associated with many chronic diseases in both

people and animals, including atopic eczema, diabetes, and various inflammatory disorders. In dogs and cats, fatty

acid disorders are characterized in the early phases by a dull coat, itchy skin, and excessive shedding. Gamma-

linolenic acid is important in the production of prostaglandins, compounds that are critical to the healthy

performance of countless metabolic functions—from breakdown of carbohydrates, fats, and other essential nutrients

into usable forms, to maintenance of cellular integrity and proper functioning of smooth-muscle tissues (including

the heart, uterus, and vascular system) throughout the body. In other words, animals cannot survive without a proper

balance of fatty acids, including GLA, in their bodies.

最近的研究表明，全民教育缺乏可能与人和动物的许多慢性疾病密切相关，包括特应性湿疹、糖尿病和

各种炎症性疾病。在狗和猫中，脂肪酸紊乱的早期特征是皮毛暗淡、皮肤发痒和过度脱落。 γ-亚麻酸在前

列腺素的生产中非常重要，前列腺素是对无数代谢功能的健康发挥至关重要的化合物——从碳水化合物、

脂肪和其他必需营养素分解成可用形式，到维持细胞完整性和平滑肌细胞的正常功能。 -全身的肌肉组织

（包括心脏、子宫和血管系统）。换句话说，如果动物体内的脂肪酸（包括 GLA）没有达到适当的平衡，

就无法生存。

The body does not produce GLA, and therefore it must be received through dietary sources. The problem is that

GLA is relatively rare in nature—it occurs in only a few vegetable sources. Borage seed oil is one of the richest

GLA supplements available and can be easily administered by breaking a gel capsule onto your pet’s food each day.

Ask your holistic veterinarian for recommendations on how much of the oil your animal may need.

人体不会产生 GLA，因此必须通过饮食来源获取。问题是 GLA 在自然界中相对罕见——它只存在于少

数植物来源中。琉璃苣籽油是最丰富的 GLA 补充剂之一，每天只需将凝胶胶囊放入宠物的食物中即可轻松

服用。向您的整体兽医询问您的动物可能需要多少油的建议。

Borage leaf has also received attention from herbalists who believe that it may be useful for gently strengthening

adrenal function, particularly in subjects who have recently undergone extended steroid therapies. The adrenal

cortex (the outer tissues of the adrenal glands) is chiefly responsible for the body’s production of corticosteroids, the

hormones responsible for natural reduction of inflammation. When synthetic corticosteroids are introduced into the

body, natural adrenal functions are replaced and the adrenal cortex often begins to shut down its natural production.

As a result, many animals who are ending prednisolone or other steroid therapies have depressed adrenal function.

Fat metabolism and mineral balances may also be affected if this happens. While borage is by no means as powerful

as licorice (Glycyrrhiza spp.) in its adrenal-stimulatory actions, it is believed by many herbalists to gently stimulate

adrenal function that is slightly depressed, especially when used over an extended period. It may be particularly

useful in cases where water retention and high blood pressure are prevalent in an animal’s holistic condition. In

these situations, the stronger herb licorice may be contraindicated because of its potential side effects. While the use

of borage in this capacity lacks scientific validation, it has nonetheless been used safely and effectively for hundreds

of years. The dried leaves may be tinctured (12 drops per 20 pounds of body weight, twice daily) or fed in bulk form

(½ teaspoon sprinkled onto each pound of your animal’s food). Borage also has a folkloric reputation for increasing

milk production in nursing mothers (both human and otherwise)—an action that may be attributable to increased

hormone production by the adrenal gland.

琉璃苣叶也受到草药学家的关注，他们认为它可能有助于温和地增强肾上腺功能，特别是对于最近接受

过长期类固醇治疗的受试者。肾上腺皮质（肾上腺的外层组织）主要负责人体产生皮质类固醇，这种激素

负责自然减少炎症。当合成皮质类固醇被引入体内时，天然肾上腺功能被取代，肾上腺皮质通常开始停止

其自然生成。结果，许多停止泼尼松龙或其他类固醇治疗的动物的肾上腺功能受到抑制。如果发生这种情

况，脂肪代谢和矿物质平衡也可能受到影响。虽然琉璃苣的肾上腺刺激作用远不如甘草（Glycyrrhiza spp.）

那么强大，但许多草药学家认为它可以温和地刺激略微抑制的肾上腺功能，尤其是在长时间使用时。在动

物整体状况中普遍存在水潴留和高血压的情况下，它可能特别有用。在这些情况下，由于其潜在的副作

用，可能会禁忌使用较强的草药甘草。虽然琉璃苣的这种用途缺乏科学验证，但它已经安全有效地使用了

数百年。干燥的叶子可以酊剂（每 20 磅体重 12 滴，每天两次）或散装喂养（½ 茶匙撒在每磅动物食物

上）。琉璃苣在民间也享有盛誉，因为它可以增加哺乳母亲（人类和其他）的产奶量，这种作用可能归因

于肾上腺产生的激素增加。

Topically, borage leaves can be applied as a soothing poultice or compress for minor skin irritations. To sum up

=== PAGE 104 ===
its potential for topical use, consider borage as a limited alternative to comfrey.

局部使用琉璃苣叶作为舒缓膏剂或敷料，缓解轻微的皮肤刺激。总结其局部使用的潜力，可以将琉璃苣

视为紫草的有限替代品。

Availability: Virtually any nursery or seed catalog that sells herbs is likely to have borage.

可用性：几乎任何出售草药的苗圃或种子目录都可能有琉璃苣。

Propagation and Harvest: Borage prefers dry soil and full sun. Aside from these requirements, it is extremely easy

to grow from seed or nursery-raised transplants. If you choose to transplant borage from one part of a garden to

another, do it while the plants are young because the taproot grows straight down and is easily damaged when

removed from the soil.

繁殖和收获：琉璃苣喜欢干燥的土壤和充足的阳光。除了这些要求之外，它还非常容易通过种子或苗圃移

植进行生长。如果您选择将琉璃苣从花园的一个部分移植到另一个部分，请在植物还小的时候进行，因为

主根垂直向下生长，从土壤中取出后很容易损坏。

Borage is a successful self-seeding annual that drops thousands of tiny seeds almost immediately after blooming.

Give the plant plenty of room to sprawl, and consider planting it with other annuals because it may become a

nuisance when dozens of young plants emerge beneath your perennials during the second year.

琉璃苣是一种成功的自花一年生植物，在开花后几乎立即会掉落数千颗微小的种子。给植物足够的空间

来蔓延，并考虑将其与其他一年生植物一起种植，因为当第二年在你的多年生植物下面出现数十种幼苗

时，它可能会变得很麻烦。

Harvest the mature leaves while the plant is in full bloom. Borage leaves are especially susceptible to mold while

they are drying, so never harvest when the leaves are wet and never stack the leaves on top of each other. Dry them

in an area that is away from direct sunlight and has plenty of air circulation. Spread the leaves on clean newspapers

or a nonmetallic screen and turn them once or twice daily to assure quick, even drying. The dried leaves can then be

crumbled and stored in a glass jar for up to three months before they begin to lose their usefulness.

在植物盛开时收获成熟的叶子。琉璃苣叶子在干燥时特别容易发霉，因此切勿在叶子潮湿时收获，也不

要将叶子堆叠在一起。将它们放在远离阳光直射且空气流通的地方晾干。将叶子铺在干净的报纸或非金属

筛子上，每天转动一到两次，以确保快速、均匀的干燥。然后将干燥的叶子弄碎并存放在玻璃罐中长达三

个月，然后才开始失去其用处。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For similar topical applications, look toward comfrey, which is perhaps a more

effective alternative when indicated. For anti-inflammatory applications and situations involving depressed adrenal

function, such as with Addison’s disease, look toward licorice and astragalus as stronger alternatives.

替代品和辅助剂：对于类似的局部应用，请考虑紫草，当有需要时，这可能是更有效的替代品。对于抗炎

应用和涉及肾上腺功能低下的情况（例如艾迪生氏病），可以将甘草和黄芪视为更强的替代品。

Cautions and Comments: The leaves of this plant contain small amounts of PAs, a potentially toxic group of

compounds that may lead to liver damage. Although the presence of these alkaloids in borage is very low (much

lower than in comfrey) and require ingestion of large and sustained quantities to become harmful in most animals,

borage has nonetheless been banned from human use in Germany.

注意事项和评论：这种植物的叶子含有少量的 PA，这是一组潜在的有毒化合物，可能会导致肝损伤。尽管

琉璃苣中这些生物碱的含量非常低（远低于紫草），并且需要大量持续摄入才会对大多数动物有害，但琉

璃苣在德国仍被禁止人类使用。

BUGLEWEED

黄花草

Lycopus spp.

石蒜属

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: Bugleweed also goes by the name of water horehound. The deeply and irregularly lobed leaves of

Lycopus americanus differentiate it from other mints (and even other species of Lycopus). Other species of

bugleweed (such as the less common L. uniflorus and L. asper) have leaves that are not deeply lobed but are simple

and coarsely toothed, making them difficult to differentiate from other mints such as skullcap. The easily identified

L. americanus remains by far the most common and conspicuous variety in North America, making it the bugleweed

to remember. Bugleweed, unlike many other mints, does not have a minty odor. Small whitish to pink flowers are

whorled in the leaf axils (the point at which the leaf meets the stem). Stems may be lightly to moderately hairy,

especially toward the base of the plant.

外观： Bugleweed 也被称为水苦海草。美洲番茄的深裂且不规则的叶子将其与其他薄荷（甚至其他种类的

番茄）区分开来。其他种类的牛舌草（例如不太常见的 L. uniflorus 和 L. asper）的叶子不深裂，但叶子简单

且粗齿，使它们很难与其他薄荷（例如黄芩）区分开来。迄今为止，易于识别的美洲乳杆菌仍然是北美最

常见和最显眼的品种，使其成为值得记住的牛草。与许多其他薄荷不同，牛舌草没有薄荷味。白色到粉红

色的小花轮生在叶腋（叶子与茎的交汇处）。茎可能有轻微到中等的毛，特别是朝向植物的基部。

Lycopus americanus

=== PAGE 106 ===
美洲石蒜

Habitat and Range: An inhabitant of stream banks and marshes, bugleweed is typically found in the shade beneath

willows and other shrubs. Several species of Lycopus are widespread throughout most of North America.

栖息地和范围：牛杂草栖息在溪流岸边和沼泽地，通常出现在柳树和其他灌木下的阴凉处。几种石狼属植

物广泛分布于北美大部分地区。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Perennial, blooming from early to midsummer

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，从初夏到仲夏开花

Parts Used: Leaves, stems, flowers

使用部位：叶、茎、花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Slows thyroid function, mild cardiac sedative, calms nerves, diuretic, constricts

subcutaneous blood vessels, astringent, cough suppressant

主要药用活性：减缓甲状腺功能、轻度心脏镇静、镇静神经、利尿、收缩皮下血管、收敛、止咳

Strongest Affinities: Thyroid glands, heart, nervous system

最强的亲和力：甲状腺、心脏、神经系统

Preparation: Although this herb may be useful in dried bulk form or in capsules, it doesn’t taste very good, and it

may be difficult to administer to a dog or cat in an appreciable quantity that doesn’t just pass through the short

digestive tract. An alcohol or glycerin tincture is your best choice here.

制备方法：虽然这种草药以干燥散装形式或胶囊形式可能有用，但它的味道不太好，并且可能很难以可观

的量给狗或猫服用，以免仅通过短消化道。道。酒精或甘油酊剂是您的最佳选择。

Common Uses: Although relatively little research has been done to validate bugleweed’s usefulness in animal

subjects, it may prove useful in dogs and cats with hyperthyroid conditions. While bugleweed cannot physically

correct a diseased thyroid gland and does not work as quickly as synthetic drugs, human studies have confirmed that

bugleweed slows the release of the hormone thyroxine in the thyroid, making it useful in the treatment of mild forms

of hyperthyroidism. Specifically, it should help ease abnormal excitability, relieve acute hyperventilation, slow a

rapid heart rate, and relieve spastic coughing in dogs and cats who suffer from spontaneous hyperthyroidism. It

should be noted, though, that small, frequent doses of the herb extract must be given for a period of at least a few

days before results are seen. Giving 2–6 drops per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight three times daily is a good

starting point.

常见用途：虽然验证牛草对动物受试者有用性的研究相对较少，但它可能对患有甲状腺功能亢进症的狗和

猫有用。虽然虫草不能从物理上纠正患病的甲状腺，也不像合成药物那样起效快，但人类研究证实，虫草

可以减缓甲状腺中甲状腺素的释放，使其可用于治疗轻度甲状腺功能亢进症。具体来说，它应该有助于缓

解患有自发性甲状腺功能亢进症的狗和猫的异常兴奋性，缓解急性过度换气，减慢快速心率并缓解痉挛性

咳嗽。但值得注意的是，在看到结果之前，必须小而频繁地服用草药提取物至少几天。每天 3 次，每 20 磅

动物体重滴 2-6 滴是一个很好的起点。

Bugleweed is also useful in many heart and vascular system disorders. It is believed to work in the cardiovascular

system in a way that is similar to the drug digitalis—by strengthening the heartbeat while slowing a rapid pulse. But

unlike digitalis and other such drugs that are used primarily in humans, bugleweed is virtually free of dangerous side

effects.

牛舌草还可用于治疗许多心脏和血管系统疾病。据信，它在心血管系统中的作用方式与洋地黄药物类

似，即加强心跳，同时减慢快速脉搏。但与主要用于人类的洋地黄和其他此类药物不同，牛杂草几乎没有

=== PAGE 107 ===
危险的副作用。

Adding to bugleweed’s usefulness in cardiovascular disorders is its ability to help expel water from the body. This

makes it useful in animals with lung fluid associated with weak, rapid pulse and unproductive coughing. However,

some extra caution is advised here: bugleweed is believed to suppress the cough response even if such suppression is

not conducive to the healing process. In respiratory disorders such as Bordetella or pneumonia, cough suppression

may be contradictory to the holistic principles of using herbs in the first place and may even be dangerous to the

animal. Remember, the primary goal of herbal therapies is to assist the body in its capacity to heal itself, not to

interfere with its efforts to do so. If the animal is successful at expelling mucus as a result of persistent coughing, the

body is doing its job, and the use of bugleweed is probably contraindicated. See a holistic vet.

牛花草在心血管疾病中的作用还在于它能够帮助排出体内的水分。这使得它对于肺积液、脉搏微弱、快

速和咳嗽无效的动物很有用。然而，这里建议额外小心：牛角草被认为可以抑制咳嗽反应，即使这种抑制

不利于愈合过程。在博德特氏菌或肺炎等呼吸系统疾病中，抑制咳嗽可能与使用草药的整体原则相矛盾，

甚至可能对动物造成危险。请记住，草药疗法的主要目标是帮助身体发挥自我修复的能力，而不是干扰其

这样做的努力。如果动物因持续咳嗽而成功排出粘液，则表明身体正在发挥其作用，并且可能禁止使用牛

草。看一位全面的兽医。

The nerve-calming and vasoconstrictor actions of bugleweed make it useful for pain relief in situations that

involve irritability and tension. This is true especially when circumstances are compounded by injured nerves such

as in posttraumatic circumstances where an animal is in pain from a crushing injury, is jumpy and cannot get

comfortable, and just paces, whines, and pants. Bugleweed does not contain salicylates, so it can be used for

posttraumatic pain relief in cats. It is especially useful in cats with preexisting functional thyroid adenoma or other

forms of disease that may contribute to an overactive thyroid. In humans, bugleweed is often used by herbalists in

the treatment of migraine headaches.

牛舌草具有镇静神经和收缩血管的作用，有助于缓解烦躁和紧张的情况下的疼痛。尤其是当环境因神经

受伤而变得更加复杂时，例如在创伤后的情况下，动物因挤压伤而感到疼痛，神经兮兮，无法舒服，只有

踱步、哀鸣和喘气。牛舌草不含水杨酸盐，因此可用于缓解猫的创伤后疼痛。它对于预先存在功能性甲状

腺腺瘤或可能导致甲状腺过度活跃的其他形式疾病的猫特别有用。在人类中，草药师经常使用牛草来治疗

偏头痛。

Availability: Seeds are available from specialty seed catalogs. Bugleweed herb and herb tinctures are available

through natural products retailers.

可用性：种子可从专业种子目录中获得。牛舌草药草和药草酊剂可通过天然产品零售商购买。

Propagation and Harvest: This herb requires consistently moist soil and at least 50 percent shade cover. For the

best results, sow the seeds indoors in February or March then transplant them to an area that gets plenty of shade and

water throughout the summer. Plants are ready to harvest when the flowers are just beginning to bloom. The freshly

cut herb is the best choice for making your own medicine, but if this isn’t possible, cut the stems at about 3 inches

above ground level during a period when the foliage is completely dry. Hang them in small bunches of four to six

stems apiece in an airy location away from direct sunlight. When properly stored, the dried herb retains its medicinal

potency for at least six months.

繁殖和收获：这种草本植物需要持续湿润的土壤和至少 50% 的遮荫覆盖。为了获得最佳效果，请在二月或

三月在室内播种种子，然后将它们移植到整个夏季有充足阴凉和水的地方。当花朵刚刚开始绽放时，植物

就可以收获了。新鲜切下的药草是自己制作药物的最佳选择，但如果不可能，请在叶子完全干燥时将茎切

到距地面约 3 英寸的位置。将它们分成四到六茎的小束，悬挂在通风良好、避免阳光直射的地方。如果储

存得当，干燥的药草可以保留其药效至少六个月。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For use in hyperthyroidism, bugleweed combines especially well with lemon balm

(Melissa officinalis). For use in heart and vascular disorders associated with a rapid, erratic pulse, ginkgo and

mother-wort serve as substitutes in many cases, and skullcap, hawthorn, garlic, and astragalus should all be

investigated as adjuncts. For nervousness associated with abnormal irritability, pain, or rapid heartbeat, bugleweed

=== PAGE 108 ===
will combine nicely with valerian, skullcap, hop, or chamomile. When water retention is an associated factor in any

of the above conditions, try adding dandelion leaf to the formula as a diuretic aid.

替代品和辅助剂：对于治疗甲状腺功能亢进症，牛舌草与柠檬香脂（Melissa officinalis）的结合效果特别

好。对于与快速、不稳定的脉搏相关的心脏和血管疾病，银杏和益母草在许多情况下可以作为替代品，黄

芩、山楂、大蒜和黄芪都应该作为辅助药物进行研究。对于与异常烦躁、疼痛或心跳加快相关的紧张情

绪，牛舌草可以与缬草、黄芩、啤酒花或洋甘菊完美搭配。当水潴留是上述任何一种情况的相关因素时，

请尝试在配方奶粉中添加蒲公英叶作为利尿剂。

Cautions and Comments: Like all members of the mint family, bugleweed is a safe herb with no known toxicity

when used sensibly. However, since bugleweed constricts blood vessels and may have hormonal properties,

common sense dictates that it should not be used in pregnant or nursing animals. For obvious reasons, bugleweed

should not be used in animals with depressed thyroid function. Another point to consider before using bugleweed in

your pet is that very little research has been done into the attributes and side effects of bugleweed in some animals.

Although it can be safely used in most dogs, cats, and horses, its effects in birds, rodents, and other animals are

largely unknown. If in doubt, contact a professional who is familiar with the specific applications of this herb.

注意事项和评论：与薄荷家族的所有成员一样，牛舌草是一种安全的草药，在合理使用时没有已知的毒

性。然而，由于牛杂草会收缩血管并且可能具有激素特性，因此常识表明它不应该用于怀孕或哺乳的动

物。出于显而易见的原因，牛舌草不应用于甲状腺功能低下的动物。在您的宠物中使用牛草之前要考虑的

另一点是，对于某些动物中牛草的属性和副作用进行的研究很少。尽管它可以安全地用于大多数狗、猫和

马，但它对鸟类、啮齿动物和其他动物的影响很大程度上未知。如有疑问，请联系熟悉这种草药具体应用

的专业人士。

=== PAGE 109 ===
BURDOCK

牛蒡

Arctium lappa or A. minor

牛蒡子或小牛蒡子

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: In its first year of growth, burdock appears as a rosette of large heart-shaped leaves up to 12 inches

long. During the second year, the plant continues skyward, often reaching 6–8 feet, while branching out to produce

multitudes of thistlelike, light lavender to purple-flowered seed-bearing burrs at the upper reaches of the plant. Each

burr contains several small black seeds and is covered by reverse-hooked spines that enable them to stick to

anything that brushes by. The entire plant is covered with tiny hairs that give the leaves and the stems a tacky texture

similar to that of ultrafine grit sandpaper. The lightbrown taproot may weigh 2–3 pounds and extend 2 or more feet

below a second-year plant. This sturdy taproot, combined with the annoying and extremely efficient reproductive

qualities of the burrs, has earned burdock a hated reputation as a farm and garden enemy.

外观：在生长的第一年，牛蒡呈莲座状，由长达 12 英寸的大心形叶子组成。第二年，植物继续向天空生

长，通常达到 6-8 英尺，同时分支，在植物的上游产生大量蓟状、淡紫色到紫色花的带有种子的毛刺。每

个毛刺都含有一些黑色的小种子，并覆盖着反钩的刺，使它们能够粘在任何擦过的东西上。整个植物都覆

盖着细小的毛发，使叶子和茎具有类似于超细砂纸的粘性质地。浅棕色主根重 2-3 磅，在第二年植物下方

延伸 2 英尺或更多英尺。这种坚固的主根，加上毛刺令人讨厌且极其高效的繁殖特性，使牛蒡赢得了农场

和花园敌人的恶名。

Habitat and Range: Burdock is a Eurasian import that has made its home throughout most of North America. It

prefers rich, deep, consistently moist soil and is frequently found in profuse abundance along the edges of cultivated

fields and at roadsides (particularly where human or livestock traffic can cooperate with the hitchhiking burrs).

栖息地和分布范围：牛蒡是一种欧亚进口植物，分布在北美大部分地区。它喜欢肥沃、深厚、持续湿润的

土壤，经常在耕地边缘和路边大量发现（特别是在人类或牲畜交通可以与搭便车的毛刺配合的地方）。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A biennial that blooms in mid- to late summer

周期和开花季节：两年一度，在夏中至夏末开花

Parts Used: Root

使用部位：根

Primary Medicinal Activities: Blood cleansing, liver and gallbladder stimulant, diuretic, nutritive

主要药用活性：净化血液、肝胆兴奋剂、利尿剂、营养剂

Strongest Affinities: Liver, skin

亲和力最强：肝脏、皮肤

=== PAGE 110 ===
Preparation: Although all preparations of this herb are useful, the active constituents of this plant must be given in

relatively large doses to be of therapeutic advantage. Since most animals don’t like eating it, a strong tincture of

fresh or dried root is the most effective preparation. The medicinal ingredients of burdock root are extracted well in

a glycerin menstruum (solvent), and the flavor of the resulting liquid, or glycerite, is sweet and agreeable to most

animals. The fresh roots have a high water content, which is imparted to the finished tincture. A tincture that

contains more than 40 percent water spoils quickly. Therefore, it is best to use 100 percent undiluted vegetable

glycerin in your mixture. Fresh or dried burdock root can be decocted, as well, and poured over your animal’s food.

Be liberal with the quantity—burdock is a healthy food.

制剂：虽然这种草药的所有制剂都是有用的，但这种植物的活性成分必须以相对较大的剂量施用才能具有

治疗优势。由于大多数动物不喜欢吃它，因此新鲜或干燥的根的浓烈酊剂是最有效的制剂。牛蒡根的药用

成分在甘油溶剂（溶剂）中被很好地提取出来，所得液体或甘油的味道是甜的并且适合大多数动物。新鲜

的根具有很高的含水量，这些水分被赋予到成品酊剂中。含水量超过 40% 的酊剂很快就会变质。因此，最

好在混合物中使用 100% 未稀释的植物甘油。新鲜或干的牛蒡根也可以煎汤，然后倒在动物的食物上。数

量要宽松——牛蒡是一种健康食品。

Common Uses: We cannot emphasize the value of this herb enough in the long-term care of companion animals.

Burdock has an ancient and respected reputation as a nutritive liver tonic that helps to clean and build the blood. Just

2.5 ounces of fresh burdock root contains up to 61 milligrams of calcium, 77 milligrams of phosphorus, 1.4

milligrams of iron, 0.03 milligrams of thiamine, and 0.05 milligrams of riboflavin.

常见用途：这种草药在长期护理伴侣动物方面的价值再怎么强调也不为过。牛蒡作为一种营养肝脏补品而

享有古老而受人尊敬的声誉，有助于清洁和增强血液。仅2.5盎司的新鲜牛蒡根就含有高达61毫克的钙、77

毫克的磷、1.4毫克的铁、0.03毫克的硫胺素和0.05毫克的核黄素。

Burdock root is a specific treatment for chronic or acute psoriasis or eczema; it has a strong affinity toward the

treatment of flaky, oily, or inflammatory skin disorders that can be traced back to liver deficiencies or a general

overload of toxic substances in the body (usually the result of a poor diet). It is also useful in the holistic treatment

of arthritis, rheumatoid disorders, inflammatory kidney and bladder diseases, and virtually any other type of

metabolic disorder that may be the result of poor waste elimination. Adding to all of this is a diuretic action that

helps in the elimination of waste materials from the body. In simple terms, burdock helps clean the body from the

inside out.

牛蒡根是治疗慢性或急性牛皮癣或湿疹的特效药；它对治疗片状、油性或炎症性皮肤病有很强的亲和

力，这些皮肤病可以追溯到肝脏缺陷或体内有毒物质普遍超载（通常是不良饮食的结果）。它还可用于关

节炎、类风湿性疾病、炎症性肾病和膀胱疾病以及几乎任何其他类型的代谢紊乱（可能是由于废物排除不

良造成的）的整体治疗。除此之外，利尿作用有助于消除体内废物。简单来说，牛蒡有助于从内到外清洁

身体。

Burdock contains chemical elements that have been shown to be effective in preventing disease that may result

from environmental toxicity. Specifically, burdock helps to remove mutagenic substances such as pesticides and

airborne pollutants from the bloodstream before they cause harm to the body. Animal studies have indicated that

burdock extract has free-radical scavenging qualities in the liver, thus weeding out carcinogenic elements before

cellular damage can occur.

牛蒡含有的化学元素已被证明可以有效预防环境毒性引起的疾病。具体来说，牛蒡有助于在农药和空气

污染物等致突变物质对身体造成伤害之前从血液中清除它们。动物研究表明，牛蒡提取物具有清除肝脏自

由基的能力，从而在细胞损伤发生之前清除致癌元素。

Virtually every living creature is continually subjected to the harmful effects of human society—our companion

animals are no exception. The liver is the organ that begins the cleansing process. The liver not only filters the blood

but contributes bile and numerous enzymes to the digestive tract that are essential to the breakdown and absorption

of essential nutrients. By assisting liver function and prompting the efficient removal of systemic waste, absorbed or

ingested toxins, and allergens from the body, imbalances such as arthritis, kidney stones, bladder infections, and

eczema can be avoided. By helping the liver do its job, we are also relieving pressure from secondary immune

functions that need to remain unencumbered in their fight against viruses and other microbes that may have

bypassed the liver. Furthermore, if the liver can work at optimum efficiency, less solid or toxic waste will reach the

=== PAGE 111 ===
kidneys—a set of delicate organs that are vulnerable to the liver’s deficiencies.

事实上，每一种生物都不断受到人类社会的有害影响——我们的伴侣动物也不例外。肝脏是开始净化过

程的器官。肝脏不仅过滤血液，还向消化道提供胆汁和大量酶，这些酶对于必需营养素的分解和吸收至关

重要。通过协助肝功能并促进有效清除体内的全身废物、吸收或摄入的毒素和过敏原，可以避免关节炎、

肾结石、膀胱感染和湿疹等失衡。通过帮助肝脏完成其工作，我们还可以缓解次级免疫功能的压力，这些

功能需要在对抗可能绕过肝脏的病毒和其他微生物时保持不受阻碍。此外，如果肝脏能够以最佳效率工

作，到达肾脏的固体或有毒废物就会减少——肾脏是一组脆弱的器官，很容易受到肝脏缺陷的影响。

Burdock is an excellent long-term liver tonic, and it is gentle enough to use in cases of preexisting liver or kidney

disease. It is an excellent choice for animals suffering as a result of a poor diet. Just remember, diet is where the road

to a long, healthy life begins. Burdock will not replace a good natural diet, but it can help tremendously in allowing

the body to utilize the good nutrition it receives.

牛蒡是一种极好的长期肝脏补品，而且性质温和，适合用于已有肝脏或肾脏疾病的情况。对于因饮食不

良而遭受痛苦的动物来说，这是一个绝佳的选择。请记住，饮食是健康长寿之路的开始。牛蒡不会取代良

好的天然饮食，但它可以极大地帮助身体利用它所获得的良好营养。

Availability: Fresh organically grown burdock root is available at many health food stores. Dried burdock root and

root tincture are available through most herb retailers. Seeds are available through specialty seed catalogs.

供应情况：新鲜的有机种植的牛蒡根在许多保健食品商店都有售。大多数草药零售商都可以买到干牛蒡根

和根酊剂。种子可通过专业种子目录获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Provided you have deep, rich soil for taproots that can penetrate the earth 3 feet,

burdock is easy to grow. Burdock likes moist (but not wet) soil, and it prefers to have at least a couple of hours of

shade each day. Sow the seeds as you would carrots, in early spring. The roots are ready after the leaves die back in

the fall of the first year. Second-year roots can be used if dug in the spring, but remember that biennials die after

their second year of growth and the roots lose potency as they approach their demise.

繁殖和收获：如果你有深厚、肥沃的土壤，主根可以深入土壤3英尺，牛蒡很容易生长。牛蒡喜欢潮湿

（但不潮湿）的土壤，并且喜欢每天至少有几个小时的阴凉处。在早春，像播种胡萝卜一样播种种子。第

一年秋天叶子枯死后，根就准备好了。如果在春季挖出第二年的根，则可以使用，但请记住，二年生植物

在生长的第二年后就会死亡，并且当它们接近死亡时，根会失去效力。

=== PAGE 112 ===
Arctium minor

小牛蒡子

Burdock roots can be refrigerated for several weeks after harvest, or they can be chopped and dried, made into

tincture, or decocted for immediate use.

牛蒡根收获后可冷藏数周，也可切碎干燥，制成酊剂或煎汤立即使用。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Dandelion root serves well as an alternative to burdock. For treatment of flaky or itchy

skin problems, burdock can be supplemented with licorice, red clover, dandelion, or yellow dock. As a liver aid in

conditions associated with chronic constipation, burdock can be supplemented with dandelion, chicory, turkey

rhubarb, yellow dock, or Oregon grape. In cases of preexisting liver damage resulting from chemical toxicity or

vaccinosis, use the burdock with milk thistle or licorice. As an adjunct to an immune-support formula, combine

burdock with echinacea or astragalus.

替代品和辅助品：蒲公英根可以很好地替代牛蒡。为了治疗片状或瘙痒的皮肤问题，牛蒡可以补充甘草、

红三叶草、蒲公英或黄坞。作为慢性便秘相关疾病的肝脏辅助剂，牛蒡可以补充蒲公英、菊苣、火鸡大

黄、黄坞或俄勒冈葡萄。如果因化学毒性或疫苗接种而导致肝损伤，请将牛蒡与水飞蓟或甘草一起使用。

作为免疫支持配方的辅助剂，将牛蒡与紫锥菊或黄芪混合。

Cautions and Comments: This is one of the safest herbs available to humans and animals. In essence, burdock is a

nutraceutical, a food that also offers medicinal attributes. No toxicity has been noted with this herb.

注意事项和评论：这是对人类和动物最安全的草药之一。从本质上讲，牛蒡是一种营养保健品，也是一种

具有药用价值的食物。尚未发现这种草药有任何毒性。

CALENDULA

金盏花

Calendula officinalis

金盏花

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: This herb is also known as pot marigold. The bright yellow, orange, or red-orange flowers of

calendula are a familiar sight in gardens and landscape designs found everywhere. Calendula officinalis is a small

plant that seldom exceeds 18 inches in height. The lance-shaped or oblong alternate leaves have coarse surfaces and

are borne on sturdy branching stems. Calendula should not be confused with other marigolds, namely French

marigolds, and other members of the Tagetes genus of the sunflower family, which have a pungent odor and much

different leaf characteristics.

外观：这种草药也被称为万寿菊。金盏花的亮黄色、橙色或红橙色花朵是花园和景观设计中常见的景象。

金盏花是一种小型植物，高度很少超过 18 英寸。矛状或椭圆形的互生叶表面粗糙，长在坚固的分枝茎上。

金盏花不应与其他万寿菊（即法国万寿菊）和向日葵科万寿菊属的其他成员混淆，后者具有刺激性气味和

截然不同的叶子特征。

Habitat and Range: Originally a native of Europe and Africa, calendula is a cultivated plant throughout most of the

world.

栖息地和分布范围：金盏花原产于欧洲和非洲，是世界大部分地区的栽培植物。

Cycle and Bloom Season: The word calendula is derived from calends (the first day of the Roman month) because

the plant was thought to bloom on the new moon of each month. While calendula really doesn’t keep such an

accurate calendar, it does remain in a constant and generous state of bloom throughout most of its annual life span.

周期和开花季节：金盏花一词源自calenda（罗马月的第一天），因为人们认为这种植物在每个月的新月时

开花。虽然金盏花确实没有如此准确的日历，但它在其生命周期的大部分时间里确实保持着持续而慷慨的

绽放状态。

Parts Used: Flowers

使用部分：花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Anti-inflammatory, increases lymph circulation, heals wounds, astringent,

antibacterial, antifungal, anti-tumor, liver stimulant, promotes menstruation (emmenagogue)

主要药用活性：抗炎、增加淋巴循环、愈合伤口、收敛、抗菌、抗真菌、抗肿瘤、保肝、促进月经（调

经）

Strongest Affinities: Skin and mucous membranes

最强的亲和力：皮肤和粘膜

=== PAGE 114 ===
Preparation: Water or oil infusion, tincture, poultice, salve, ointment

制剂：水或油输液、酊剂、膏剂、药膏、软膏

Common Uses: Calendula is among the first herbs to consider in minor first aid situations. A broad array of

medicinal compounds in the flowers of the plant (various essential oils, flavonoids, saponins, triterpene alcohols,

carotenes, and others) combine to help speed cell reproduction and inhibit bacteria and fungi at the site of injury.

常见用途：金盏花是在轻微急救情况下首先考虑的草药之一。植物花中的多种药用化合物（各种精油、类

黄酮、皂苷、三萜醇、胡萝卜素等）结合在一起，有助于加速细胞繁殖并抑制受伤部位的细菌和真菌。

For minor cuts, insect bites, abrasions, and postsurgical incisions, a calendula salve applied externally brings

quick, soothing relief to pain and swelling, while lending wound-healing, antimicrobial properties to the body’s

healing effort. Infusions of the flowers are effective as a soothing and healing skin wash for various forms of

inflammatory dermatitis, such as those caused by fleabites, poison ivy, eczema, and sunburn. The infection-fighting,

skin-healing nature of this plant makes it useful for treating burns as well. A cooled water infusion may be used as

an eyewash for conjunctivitis, where the mild but predictable astringency of the plant combines with its bacteria-

fighting properties to reduce irritation and infection. To make an eyewash or skin rinse, refer to chapter 1.

对于轻微割伤、昆虫叮咬、擦伤和术后切口，外用金盏花药膏可以快速、舒缓地缓解疼痛和肿胀，同时

为身体的愈合提供伤口愈合和抗菌特性。花浸液可有效舒缓和治愈各种形式的炎症性皮炎，例如由跳蚤、

毒藤、湿疹和晒伤引起的皮炎。这种植物具有抗感染、治愈皮肤的特性，因此也可用于治疗烧伤。冷却水

输液可用作结膜炎的洗眼剂，植物温和但可预测的涩味与其抗菌特性相结合，可减少刺激和感染。要进行

洗眼或皮肤冲洗，请参阅第 1 章。

Internally, an infusion or tincture of the flower may be used in treating inflammation or ulceration of the digestive

or urinary tracts, where it serves in the drainage of lymph-engorged tissues and reduces inflammation. It may also

prove beneficial in the treatment of candidiasis, a fungal infection of the mucous membranes in the mouths and

digestive tracts of birds, cats, horses, and sometimes dogs. The antifungal qualities of this herb also make it a

possible option for topical treatment of chromomycosis, a fungal infection of the skin in cows, horses, dogs, cats,

and amphibians, or for the treatment of entomophthoromycosis, a fungal infection of the nostrils, mouth, or lips of

horses. While virtually no scientific data exist to validate the effectiveness of calendula against these three forms of

disease, calendula’s safety and reputed effectiveness as a broad-spectrum antifungal agent make it an option worth

trying.

在内部，花的浸液或酊剂可用于治疗消化道或泌尿道的炎症或溃疡，它有助于淋巴充血组织的引流并减

少炎症。它也可能有助于治疗念珠菌病，这是一种鸟类、猫、马，有时还有狗的口腔和消化道粘膜的真菌

感染。这种草药的抗真菌特性也使其成为局部治疗色霉菌病（牛、马、狗、猫和两栖动物皮肤真菌感染）

或治疗昆虫霉菌病（鼻孔真菌感染）的可能选择。嘴，或马的嘴唇。虽然几乎没有科学数据可以验证金盏

花对这三种疾病的有效性，但金盏花作为广谱抗真菌剂的安全性和公认的有效性使其成为值得尝试的选

择。

Preparations containing calendula have been shown to be effective in the treatment of chronic colitis. And animal

studies have shown that the saponin constituents in calendula may possess antitumor activities.

含有金盏花的制剂已被证明可有效治疗慢性结肠炎。动物研究表明，金盏花中的皂苷成分可能具有抗肿

瘤活性。

Availability: Over thirty varieties of calendula are available at nurseries everywhere.

供应情况：各地的苗圃里都有三十多种金盏花。

Propagation and Harvest: Sow seeds in early spring or transplant the starts after the danger of frost is past.

Calendula likes moderately rich soil and full sun. It is not picky about pH—as long as the soil is not excessively

alkaline or acidic, calendula will do just fine. Once established, plants self-sow from their prolific seed production.

Seedlings that emerge each spring should be thinned to about 6 inches apart, so you can have a continuous,

relatively carefree supply of calendula. Harvest the flowers whenever they are in full bloom. They can then be made

=== PAGE 115 ===
into an herbal preparation while they are fresh, or you can dry them indoors for use in the near future.

繁殖和收获：在早春播种或在霜冻危险过去后移植种子。金盏花喜欢适度肥沃的土壤和充足的阳光。金盏

花对pH值并不挑剔，只要土壤不过碱性或酸性，金盏花就可以生长。一旦建立，植物就会通过其多产的种

子自我播种。每年春天长出的幼苗应稀疏至间距约 6 英寸，这样您就可以连续、相对无忧无虑地供应金盏

花。每当花朵盛开时就将其采收。然后可以在新鲜时将它们制成草药制剂，或者您可以将它们在室内干燥

以供不久的将来使用。

Calendula officinalis

金盏花

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For use in first aid salves, calendula combines especially well with comfrey and Saint-

John’s-wort. To increase its effectiveness in antifungal uses (internally or externally), try adding bee balm, Oregon

grape, or licorice. For urinary or digestive tract inflammations, calendula can be coupled with corn silk,

marshmallow, or plantain.

替代品和辅助剂：用于急救药膏时，金盏花与紫草和圣约翰草的结合效果特别好。为了提高其抗真菌功效

（内用或外用），请尝试添加蜂膏、俄勒冈葡萄或甘草。对于泌尿道或消化道炎症，金盏花可以与玉米

须、棉花糖或车前草搭配使用。

Cautions and Comments: Although calendula is without question one of the safest herbs, it does have a reputation

for stimulating menstruation. In some studies it has been shown to possess abortifacient (abortion-causing) activities

in rodents, so it should be avoided during early pregnancy. Calendula may contain a very small measure of salicylic

acid, a constituent that is potentially toxic to cats. Although this compound is likely confined to the leaves and stems

of the plant and does not occur in quantities that are likely to be of immediate danger to cats, its presence should be

taken into account prior to long-term internal use.

注意事项和评论：虽然金盏花毫无疑问是最安全的草药之一，但它确实以刺激月经而闻名。一些研究表明

它对啮齿动物具有堕胎（导致流产）活性，因此在怀孕早期应避免使用。金盏花可能含有极少量的水杨

=== PAGE 116 ===
酸，这种成分对猫可能有毒。尽管这种化合物可能仅限于植物的叶子和茎中，并且其含量不会对猫造成直

接危险，但在长期内部使用之前应考虑到其存在。

=== PAGE 117 ===
CATNIP

Nepeta cataria

荆芥

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: Wild catnip is always a wonderful discovery. Its pungent tangymint aroma wafts to the nose with the

slightest disturbance of the plant. And the flavor and soothing effects of the tea are likely to please even the most

discriminating palate. Characteristically a mint, catnip has square stems and opposite leaves. Leaves are petiolate

(stemmed), coarsely but often bluntly toothed, and nearly heart shaped to broadly lance shaped. Once one has

become familiar with this plant, the aroma is a sure giveaway. The entire plant is distinctively fuzzy with an almost

flannel-like texture. Unlike most other mints, which bloom in whorls at the upper leaf axils or in terminate clusters

or spires, catnip blooms at both the upper leaf axils and in spikelike terminate clusters.

外观：野生猫薄荷总是一个奇妙的发现。只要对植物进行轻微的干扰，其刺鼻的丹香薄荷香气就会飘入鼻

子。即使是最挑剔的味觉，茶的风味和舒缓效果也可能会令您满意。猫薄荷是薄荷的典型特征，具有方形

茎和对生叶子。叶子有叶柄（有茎），粗糙但通常有钝齿，近心形至宽矛形。一旦人们熟悉了这种植物，

它的香气就很明显了。整个植物有明显的绒毛，具有几乎法兰绒般的纹理。与大多数其他薄荷在上部叶腋

以轮生或以末端簇或尖顶开花不同，猫薄荷在上部叶腋和穗状末端簇中开花。

Habitat and Range: Catnip is a Eurasian import that is now widespread in North America. It likes full sun and rich,

moist soil, and is most frequently found in disturbed areas such as along irrigation channels and at the edges of

cultivated fields. Unfortunately, this characteristic often makes it difficult for the herbalist or wild food forager to

find uncontaminated plants. Fortunately, catnip can be found at many nurseries.

栖息地和分布范围：猫薄荷是欧亚大陆进口的植物，目前广泛分布于北美。它喜欢充足的阳光和肥沃湿润

的土壤，最常见于受干扰的地区，例如灌溉渠道沿线和耕地边缘。不幸的是，这种特性常常使草药师或野

生食物采集者很难找到未受污染的植物。幸运的是，许多托儿所都可以找到猫薄荷。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms from late spring to midsummer

周期和开花季节：从春末到仲夏开花的多年生植物

=== PAGE 118 ===
Nepeta cataria

荆芥

Parts Used: Leaves, stems, and flowers are collected before seeds begin to develop.

使用的部分：在种子开始发育之前收集叶、茎和花。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expels intestinal gas, sedative, antispasmodic, helps alleviate vomiting (antiemetic),

feline-euphoric, diuretic

主要药用活性：排出肠道气体、镇静、解痉、帮助缓解呕吐（止吐）、猫欣快、利尿

Strongest Affinities: Digestive and nervous systems

最强的亲和力：消化系统和神经系统

Preparation: Fresh or dried chopped herb, water infusion, tincture, or, of course, stuffed in a catnip toy

准备工作：新鲜或干切碎的药草、水浸剂、酊剂，当然也可以塞进猫薄荷玩具中

Common Uses: Catnip is a gentle gas reliever and antispasmodic for easing flatulence and stomach upsets. It also

acts as a mild sedative to help calm the nerves and promote restful sleep in most animals. Due to an ingredient called

nepetalactone, cats become intoxicated when they sniff this plant. The effect of the herb when ingested is relaxing in

a different way, calming to the stomach and relaxing to the nerves but without feline-erotic visions of candy-coated

mice. Interestingly, about 20 percent of our feline friends do not experience a euphoric response to catnip. This is an

excellent herb to consider for a high-strung animal with a nervous stomach, especially if episodes of vomiting are

precipitated by stressful events such as running the vacuum cleaner, having the neighbors and their screaming child

over for dinner, or—worse yet—bringing another kitten into the “royal palace.” You can administer 12–20 drops

=== PAGE 119 ===
(0.25 to 0.5 milliliter) of a glycerin-based catnip tincture for every 20 pounds of an animal’s body weight, ten to

twenty minutes prior to being subjected to stressful circumstances. For travel or other prolonged periods of stress,

the tincture can be added to the animal’s drinking water—12 drops per 8 ounces of water is a good starting dose. If

the animal does not respond, try adding 6 drops at a time, until the desired calming effect is evident. Dropping a few

fresh leaves into the animal’s drinking water may work as well. You can also try feeding dried catnip to your pet by

putting it onto her food at a dose of ⅛ to ½ teaspoon per pound of food fed. Just remember that this might make kitty

roll around in her dinner!

常见用途：猫薄荷是一种温和的气体缓解剂和解痉剂，可缓解胀气和胃部不适。它还可以作为温和的镇静

剂，帮助镇静神经并促进大多数动物的安宁睡眠。由于含有一种叫做荆芥内酯的成分，猫在闻这种植物时

会中毒。摄入这种草药的效果是以不同的方式放松，使胃平静，放松神经，但不会出现糖果老鼠的猫科动

物色情幻觉。有趣的是，大约 20% 的猫科动物朋友并没有对猫薄荷产生欣快反应。对于胃部紧张的高度紧

张的动物来说，这是一种极好的草药，特别是如果呕吐是由压力事件引起的，例如运行吸尘器、让邻居和

他们尖叫的孩子过来吃晚饭，或者更糟糕的情况——把另一只小猫带进“皇宫”。您可以在遭受压力环境前

10 到 20 分钟，为每 20 磅体重的动物注射 12–20 滴（0.25 到 0.5 毫升）甘油猫薄荷酊剂。对于旅行或其他

长时间的压力，可以将酊剂添加到动物的饮用水中——每 8 盎司水 12 滴是一个很好的起始剂量。如果动物

没有反应，请尝试一次添加 6 滴，直到达到所需的镇静效果。将几片新鲜叶子放入动物的饮用水中也可能

有效。您还可以尝试将干猫薄荷喂给您的宠物，将其添加到她的食物中，剂量为每磅食物 ⅛ 至 ½ 茶匙。请

记住，这可能会让猫咪在晚餐中打滚！

Availability: Catnip has become a roadside weed in many areas. If you are not so fortunate, the plants or seeds are

available through many nurseries.

可用性：猫薄荷已成为许多地区的路边杂草。如果您没有那么幸运，可以通过许多苗圃获得植物或种子。

Propagation and Harvest: Gather the leaves, stems, and flowers before the plant goes to seed. The herb can then

be dried indoors. Spread the herb loosely on a clean sheet of paper, rearranging it frequently to prevent mold. The

herb is ready for storage when it is crispy dry.

繁殖和收获：在植物结籽之前收集叶子、茎和花。然后可以在室内干燥草药。将药草松散地铺在一张干净

的纸上，经常重新排列以防止发霉。当药草干脆时就可以储存了。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: To help settle an upset stomach and to prevent nervous vomiting, catnip combines well

with fennel. Chamomile serves as an effective adjunct or alternative in these circumstances. For motion sickness, a

pinch of ginger can be added to a teaspoon of dried, powdered catnip. The combination can then be given to a dog or

cat in a small gel capsule. One capsule should do for a cat; a dog may require two or three, depending on her size.

替代品和辅助品：为了帮助缓解胃部不适并防止神经性呕吐，猫薄荷与茴香可以很好地结合在一起。在这

些情况下，洋甘菊可以作为有效的辅助剂或替代品。对于晕车，可以在一茶匙干燥的猫薄荷粉中加入一小

撮生姜。然后可以将该组合装在小凝胶胶囊中给狗或猫服用。一只猫一粒胶囊就够了；狗可能需要两个或

三个，具体取决于她的体型。

Cautions and Comments: The herb is safe, but use it sparingly in pregnant animals, as it has been theorized that

the volatile oils it contains may be passed on to the fetus, the result of which is unknown.

注意事项和评论：这种草药是安全的，但在怀孕动物中应谨慎使用，因为理论上它所含的挥发油可能会遗

传给胎儿，其结果尚不清楚。

=== PAGE 120 ===
CAYENNE

辣椒

Capsicum spp.

辣椒属

Nightshade Family

茄科家族

Appearance: Like many common names, the words capsicum and cayenne are used as generic terms for a broad

range of small, very hot chili peppers. Most of these peppers are genetically engineered variations of two species of

the Capsicum genus: C. frutescens and C. annuum. There are dozens of varieties, but they all share a similar

appearance: shiny oval to lance-shaped, 1- to 5-inch-long leaves; small, white, star-shaped flowers; and sturdy,

sometimes vinelike stems that reach anywhere from 1 to 3 feet tall when mature.

外观：像许多常见名称一样，辣椒和卡宴这两个词被用作各种小辣椒的通用术语。这些辣椒大部分是辣椒

属两种辣椒的基因工程变种：C. frutescens 和 C. annuum。有几十个品种，但它们都有相似的外观：有光泽

的椭圆形到矛形，1到5英寸长的叶子；白色的星形小花；茎粗壮，有时呈藤蔓状，成熟时可达 1 至 3 英尺

高。

Habitat and Range: Originally a native of tropical regions of South and Central America, virtually all of the

capsicums are now cultivated in areas throughout the world with long growing seasons. In northern climes,

capsicum can be grown as an attractive houseplant.

栖息地和分布范围：原产于南美洲和中美洲的热带地区，现在几乎所有的辣椒都在世界各地生长季节较长

的地区种植。在北方气候下，辣椒可以作为一种有吸引力的室内植物种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Wild South American capsicums are perennial plants that can reach 7 feet in height, but

in North America most capsicums are cultivated as annuals. Most capsicums bloom in early summer and produce

ripe fruit by mid-August.

周期和开花季节：南美野生辣椒是多年生植物，高度可达 7 英尺，但在北美，大多数辣椒都是一年生植物

栽培。大多数辣椒在初夏开花，并在八月中旬结出成熟的果实。

Parts Used: Fruits

使用部位：水果

Primary Medicinal Activities: Warms and reddens the skin (rubefacient), dilates blood vessels (vasodilator), stops

bleeding (hemostatic), counterirritant, anti-inflammatory, analgesic, strengthens tissues (tonic)

主要药用活性：使皮肤变暖和变红（红化剂）、扩张血管（血管扩张剂）、止血（止血）、抗刺激、抗

炎、镇痛、增强组织（补品）

Strongest Affinities: Skin and circulatory system

最强的亲和力：皮肤和循环系统

=== PAGE 121 ===
Preparation: For internal uses, the dried and powdered fruits are most commonly contained in gel capsules. The

whole or powdered fruits may be used in oil infusions, salves, ointments, or tinctures. Various brands of capsaicin

creams and ointments are commercially available at drugstores for topical treatment of arthritis, muscle aches,

stiffness, and other conditions.

制备： 对于内部使用，干燥和粉末状的水果最常见于凝胶胶囊中。整个水果或粉末状的水果可用于油浸

剂、药膏、软膏或酊剂。药店出售各种品牌的辣椒素乳膏和软膏，用于局部治疗关节炎、肌肉疼痛、僵硬

和其他病症。

Common Uses: Capsicum is reliable in its activity as a peripheral vasodilator. Used internally, it acts to warm the

body by quickly dilating small capillaries and increasing circulation to the skin and extremities. (This is why

sweating and flushed skin is experienced when we eat foods containing cayenne.) Because of this activity, capsicum

is commonly used in the systemic treatment of impaired blood circulation, and because it triggers the outward

movement of blood throughout the body, it is often added as a “carrier” for the active components of other herbs. Its

effect in this capacity can be quite dramatic, especially when it is combined with herbs that have an affinity toward

the skin or extremities. By itself, capsicum is useful for opening capillary occlusions that are the by-product of a

crushing injury, and it is considered a specific remedy for chronically deficient peripheral circulation—situations

characterized by continuously cold paws, hands, or feet. Capsicum is also regarded as a circulatory stimulant for the

lungs and may be useful for improving pulmonary efficiency in animals with hypostatic pneumonia (a condition

arising from poor blood circulation through vascular structures of the lungs) or other conditions where edema or

other factors are interfering with proper blood circulation in pulmonary tissues.

常见用途：辣椒作为外周血管扩张剂具有可靠的活性。内部使用时，它可以通过快速扩张小毛细血管并增

加皮肤和四肢的循环来温暖身体。 （这就是为什么当我们吃含有辣椒的食物时会出汗和皮肤潮红。）由于

这种活性，辣椒通常用于血液循环受损的全身治疗，并且因为它会引发全身血液的向外流动，通常作为其

他草药活性成分的“载体”添加。它在这方面的效果非常显着，特别是当它与对皮肤或四肢有亲和力的草药

结合使用时。辣椒本身可用于打开毛细血管闭塞，毛细血管闭塞是挤压伤的副产品，并且它被认为是治疗

长期外周循环不足（以爪子、手或脚持续寒冷为特征的情况）的特殊疗法。辣椒也被认为是肺部循环兴奋

剂，可能有助于改善患有坠积性肺炎（一种因肺部血管结构血液循环不良而引起的疾病）或水肿或其他因

素干扰的其他疾病的动物的肺效率。肺组织的血液循环正常。

In most internal applications, capsicum is administered once per day in the form of a gel capsule. For a dog or a

cat, the capsule would contain a small pinch of the powder. For horses and other large animals, several full large

capsules may be needed to bring about desired results. Finding the correct dose is contingent upon the specifics of

the individual animal and the situation at hand.

在大多数内部应用中，辣椒以凝胶胶囊的形式每天施用一次。对于狗或猫来说，胶囊中会含有一小撮粉

末。对于马和其他大型动物，可能需要几个完整的大胶囊才能达到预期的效果。找到正确的剂量取决于个

体动物的具体情况和当前的情况。

Topically, capsicum works as a contact rubefacient, serving to quickly open subcutaneous capillaries while acting

as a nerve block and reducing pain at the site of application. These topical attributes make capsicum especially

useful for therapies that are to be confined to a specific portion of the body, such as those for stiff or arthritic knees

that may benefit from the herb’s instantaneous warming effect. The compound chiefly responsible for this activity is

called capsaicin, and in addition to its capacity to block pain and increase circulation, capsaicin has been shown to

activate the body’s own anti-inflammatory mediators at the site where it is applied. It not only helps to reduce pain

and congestion in arthritic joints but also acts as an assistant to the body’s internal anti-inflammatory mechanisms.

These combined actions make topical preparations of capsicum useful for safely relieving the symptoms of

rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis.

局部使用时，辣椒可作为接触性发红剂，快速打开皮下毛细血管，同时起到神经阻滞作用并减轻使用部

位的疼痛。这些局部特性使得辣椒对于仅限于身体特定部位的治疗特别有用，例如对于僵硬或关节炎的膝

盖的治疗，可能会受益于草药的瞬时升温作用。主要负责这种活性的化合物称为辣椒素，除了具有止痛和

促进血液循环的能力外，辣椒素还被证明可以在施用部位激活人体自身的抗炎介质。它不仅有助于减轻关

节炎关节的疼痛和充血，而且还可以作为身体内部抗炎机制的助手。这些综合作用使得辣椒外用制剂可有

效缓解类风湿性关节炎和骨关节炎的症状。

=== PAGE 122 ===
On the top of our list of uses for capsicum, though, is its effectiveness at stopping bleeding. It’s interesting to note

that while capsicum has such a profound ability to increase blood circulation when taken internally or applied onto

the skin, its effects are quite opposite when applied to the site of internal or external bleeding. To stop the bleeding

of a barbed wire cut, a claw that was clipped too short, or any other minor to moderate wound where profuse

bleeding does not coagulate readily on its own, capsicum powder, or ground cayenne from the kitchen cabinet, can

be liberally applied directly to the site of injury. Unless bleeding is emanating from a fairly large vessel, the result is

likely to be instantaneous, and believe it or not, capsicum really doesn’t hurt much when applied to an open wound.

然而，在我们的辣椒用途清单中，最重要的是它的止血功效。有趣的是，虽然辣椒在内服或涂抹在皮肤

上时具有促进血液循环的强大能力，但当应用于内出血或外出血部位时，其效果却完全相反。为了止血，

可以使用辣椒粉或厨房橱柜中的辣椒粉来止血，包括铁丝网割伤、剪得太短的爪子或任何其他严重出血且

不易自行凝固的轻微至中度伤口。直接涂在受伤部位。除非出血是从相当大的血管中流出，否则结果很可

能是瞬时的，不管你信不信，辣椒在开放性伤口上确实不会造成太大伤害。

Availability: Readily available wherever culinary spices are sold. Capsicum plants are available through virtually

any nursery that stocks vegetable plants.

可获得性：只要有销售烹饪香料的地方，就很容易买到。几乎所有种植蔬菜的苗圃都可以买到辣椒植物。

Propagation and Harvest: Capsicum is often slow to start from seed, so it is best to purchase young plants. Like

most peppers, capsicums that are planted outdoors require warm, sunny days and nighttime temperatures that seldom

fall below 55 degrees Fahrenheit (F) in order to produce fruit. Many varieties are quite suitable as houseplants.

繁殖和收获：辣椒从种子开始生长通常很慢，因此最好购买幼苗。与大多数辣椒一样，户外种植的辣椒需

要温暖、晴朗的白天和很少低于 55 华氏度 (F) 的夜间温度才能结出果实。许多品种非常适合作为室内植

物。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: To stop bleeding, capsicum combines well with yarrow. For circulatory problems,

hawthorn, ginkgo, ginger, and yarrow should all be considered as well.

替代品和辅助品：为了止血，辣椒与西洋蓍草可以很好地结合。对于循环系统问题，还应考虑山楂、银

杏、生姜和西洋蓍草。

=== PAGE 123 ===
Capsicum sp.

辣椒属。

Cautions and Comments: Contrary to what may seem obvious, capsicum does not cause irritation to the digestive

tract when consumed in moderate quantities, but the key word here is moderate. You should not feed capsicum to

animals who have a sensitive digestive tract or inflammatory digestive or urinary system disease unless you have a

full understanding of all underlying conditions. When used properly and in moderation, capsicum is a safe herb, but

extra care and attention are needed to assure that capsicum is truly indicated. No two animals are identical, and

where capsicum may serve to benefit one, it can cause painful irritation to another. In other words, it is best to have

your animal examined by a holistic veterinarian before proceeding with any internal therapy that includes capsicum.

Capsicum is a strong irritant to mucous membranes and should always be kept away from the eyes and nose. This is

the stuff that bear-defense pepper spray is made from. Its topical use should be avoided with animals who have

hypersensitive skin. Although capsicum is generally considered safe during pregnancy, we recommend that its use

be limited to topical applications. In our opinion, strong urinary tract irritants should not be used in pregnant or

lactating animals.

注意事项和评论：与看似显而易见的事实相反，适量食用辣椒不会对消化道造成刺激，但这里的关键词是

适量。除非您充分了解所有潜在状况，否则不应给患有敏感消化道或炎症性消化或泌尿系统疾病的动物喂

辣椒。如果使用得当且适量，辣椒是一种安全的草药，但需要格外小心和注意，以确保辣椒真正有效。没

有两只动物是完全相同的，辣椒可能对其中一种动物有益，却可能对另一种动物造成痛苦的刺激。换句话

说，在进行任何包括辣椒在内的内部治疗之前，最好先让兽医对您的动物进行全面检查。辣椒对粘膜有强

烈刺激性，应始终远离眼睛和鼻子。这就是防熊胡椒喷雾的原料。皮肤过敏的动物应避免局部使用。虽然

辣椒通常被认为在怀孕期间是安全的，但我们建议其使用仅限于局部应用。我们认为，强烈的尿路刺激物

不应该用于怀孕或哺乳期的动物。

Be sure to wash your hands with soap and water after handling any form of this herb, and don’t touch your eyes,

lips, or any other mucous membranes for about thirty minutes after.

处理任何形式的这种草药后，一定要用肥皂和水洗手，并且在大约三十分钟内不要触摸眼睛、嘴唇或任

何其他粘膜。

=== PAGE 124 ===
CHAMOMILE

洋甘菊

Matricaria recutita

母菊

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: German chamomile is characterized by its ½- to 1-inch flowers, each with a yellow disk surrounded

by ten to twenty white rays (petals). The common name chamomile is used in reference to dozens of related species,

but most of the medicinal uses are isolated to two genera, M. recutita (German chamomile) and Chamaemelum

nobile (Roman chamomile), and their respective subspecies. The differences between these two groups of

chamomile rest in their life cycles, the number of flowers they produce, and their overall size. German chamomile is

an annual plant that can grow to 2 feet tall, producing numerous flowers on each of its many stems. Roman

chamomile, on the other hand, is a creeping perennial that seldom exceeds 1 foot in height and produces fewer but

larger (1-inch-wide) flowers. Both German and Roman chamomiles share a nearly identical range of therapeutic

usefulness, but German chamomile is by far the more popular medicine because it has received much more research

attention and has long been regarded by herbalists as a more potent medicine than Roman chamomile. For the

purposes of this book, our primary focus is on German chamomile; there is, however, a generally overlooked wild

relative of cultivated varieties of chamomile that also deserves a place in the animal herbalist’s repertory: pineapple

weed (M. matricarioides).

外观：德国洋甘菊的特征是其 ½ 至 1 英寸的花朵，每朵都有一个黄色的圆盘，周围环绕着十到二十个白色

的射线（花瓣）。洋甘菊的通用名称用于指代数十种相关物种，但大多数药用用途仅限于两个属：M.

recutita（德国洋甘菊）和 Chamaemelum nobile（罗马洋甘菊）及其各自的亚种。这两类洋甘菊之间的差异

在于它们的生命周期、它们产生的花朵数量以及它们的整体大小。德国洋甘菊是一种一年生植物，可以长

到 2 英尺高，每根茎上都会开出无数的花朵。另一方面，罗马洋甘菊是一种多年生匍匐植物，高度很少超

过 1 英尺，花朵数量较少但较大（1 英寸宽）。德国洋甘菊和罗马洋甘菊的治疗功效几乎相同，但德国洋甘

菊是迄今为止更受欢迎的药物，因为它受到了更多的研究关注，并且长期以来被草药学家认为是比罗马洋

甘菊更有效的药物。就本书而言，我们的主要关注点是德国洋甘菊；然而，有一种普遍被忽视的洋甘菊栽

培品种野生近缘种，也值得在动物草药学家的宝库中占有一席之地：菠萝草（M. matricarioides）。

Pineapple weed looks, smells, and even tastes much like its cultivated cousins, but its flowers have no petals. This

small wayside weed is often found growing in inconspicuous ground-hugging mats in vacant lots, on road margins,

and sometimes right in the middle of a driveway!

菠萝草的外观、气味甚至味道都与其栽培的近亲很相似，但它的花没有花瓣。这种路边小杂草经常生长

在空地、道路边缘、有时甚至是车道中间不显眼的贴地垫上！

Habitat and Range: A Native of Europe and western Asia, chamomile is cultivated worldwide.

栖息地和范围：洋甘菊原产于欧洲和西亚，在世界各地都有种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Chamomile is notorious for its continuous bloom. In areas where the occurrence of frost

is rare, chamomile often produces flowers throughout the year.

周期和开花季节：洋甘菊因其连续开花而臭名昭著。在霜冻很少发生的地区，洋甘菊常年开花。

Parts Used: Flowers

=== PAGE 125 ===
使用部分：花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antispasmodic, expels intestinal gas, anti-inflammatory, sedative, antimicrobial,

stimulates digestion (bitter), heals wounds, expels worms

主要药用活性：解痉、排出肠道气体、抗炎、镇静、抗菌、刺激消化（苦味）、治愈伤口、驱虫

Strongest Affinities: Skin, digestive tract, liver, nervous system, mucous membranes, smooth-muscle tissues

亲和力最强：皮肤、消化道、肝脏、神经系统、粘膜、平滑肌组织

Preparation: Water or oil infusion, tincture, salve, ointment, fomentation

制剂：水或油输液、酊剂、药膏、软膏、热敷

Common Uses: Chamomile is a mild sedative, antispasmodic, and digestive tonic that is safe, gentle, and effective

in a broad spectrum of applications. The herb tea or tincture is helpful for indigestion, gas, and vomiting.

Chamomile is perhaps the first herb to reach for in cases of digestive upset that arises from nervousness and

hyperexcitability. The chemistry of chamomile is complex, and its medicinal activities are not attributable to any

single class of constituents but rather to a synergistic sum of all its parts. However, dozens of scientific studies

(using both animals and humans) have given us solid information about which of chamomile’s chemical compounds

contribute to its effectiveness as a holistic healing device. For example, apegenin, chamazulene (and its precursor,

matricin) and other volatile oil constituents of the flowers have been shown to be strong antispasmodic agents both

in and on the body, as have several of chamomile’s flavonoid constituents. In the digestive tract, chamomile serves

to ease nervous spasms, helps to expel gas, aids in the production of bile to improve digestion, and reduces

inflammation. All of these activities amount to an excellent remedy for chronic or acute gastric disorders, including

various forms of inflammatory bowel disease.

常见用途：洋甘菊是一种温和的镇静剂、解痉剂和消化补品，安全、温和、有效，用途广泛。花草茶或酊

剂有助于治疗消化不良、胀气和呕吐。洋甘菊可能是治疗因紧张和过度兴奋而引起消化不良的第一种草

药。洋甘菊的化学成分很复杂，其药用活性并不归因于任何单一类别的成分，而是归因于其所有成分的协

同作用。然而，数十项科学研究（使用动物和人类）为我们提供了有关洋甘菊的哪些化合物有助于其作为

整体治疗装置的有效性的可靠信息。例如，芹菜素、洋甘菊烯（及其前体母菊素）和花中的其他挥发油成

分已被证明在体内和体表上都是强效的解痉剂，洋甘菊的几种黄酮类成分也是如此。在消化道中，洋甘菊

可以缓解神经痉挛，帮助排出气体，帮助产生胆汁以改善消化，并减少炎症。所有这些活动都是治疗慢性

或急性胃病（包括各种形式的炎症性肠病）的绝佳疗法。

For inflammations of the skin, including those caused by fleabites, contact allergies, and various bacterial or

fungal infections, a cooled water infusion of the flowers can be used as a soothing, healing, antimicrobial rinse. For

conjunctivitis, whether it be from bacterial infection or the result of airborne irritants or allergies, the cooled infusion

can be carefully strained through a paper coffee filter, diluted with saline solution (the end product should be

transparent and light yellow), and used as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial eyewash that can be applied

liberally several times per day until the inflammation subsides.

对于皮肤炎症，包括由跳蚤、接触性过敏和各种细菌或真菌感染引起的皮肤炎症，可以使用花的冷却水

浸泡作为舒缓、愈合、抗菌的冲洗液。对于结膜炎，无论是细菌感染还是空气中的刺激物或过敏引起的，

都可以将冷却的输液通过咖啡纸过滤器仔细过滤，用盐水溶液稀释（最终产品应为透明和浅黄色），然后

用作一种抗炎和抗菌洗眼剂，每天可以多次使用，直到炎症消退。

=== PAGE 126 ===
Matricaria recutita

母菊

Chamomile has also been shown to have a tonic (constricting and strengthening) effect on smooth-muscle tissues

throughout the body, including the heart, bladder, and especially the uterus. While uterine tonics may be beneficial

before pregnancy and during late-term pregnancy, herbs that constrict uterine tissues are generally contraindicated

during early pregnancy.

洋甘菊还被证明对全身平滑肌组织（包括心脏、膀胱，尤其是子宫）具有滋补（收缩和强化）作用。虽

然子宫补品可能在怀孕前和妊娠晚期有益，但收缩子宫组织的草药通常在怀孕早期是禁忌的。

In our experiences chamomile serves as a general-purpose calming herb that can be fed to animals as a “first try”

remedy for any variety of spasmodic or anxiety-related problems. Because it tastes good, is soluble in water, and is

safe for most animals, its use should be considered before stronger, less-palatable antispasmodics or sedatives are

employed.

根据我们的经验，洋甘菊是一种通用的镇静药草，可以喂给动物作为治疗各种痉挛或焦虑相关问题的“首

次尝试”疗法。因为它味道好，易溶于水，并且对大多数动物来说是安全的，所以在使用更强的、不太适口

的解痉剂或镇静剂之前应考虑使用它。

Chamomile’s usefulness in expelling worms is often overlooked in favor of faster acting herbs (such as

wormwood, black walnut hulls, or garlic), but it should not be. Chamomile is relatively nontoxic when compared to

most other “herbal wormers.” While it doesn’t work as quickly as the other anthelmintics, it does work, especially

for roundworms and whipworms, and it offers anti-inflammatory activities that help counteract the effect parasites

often have on intestinal mucosa. Pineapple weed (M. matricarioides) is even more pronounced in its worm-expelling

activities.

洋甘菊在驱虫方面的作用经常被忽视，而人们却倾向于使用起效更快的草药（如苦艾、黑胡桃壳或大

蒜），但事实并非如此。与大多数其他“草药驱虫剂”相比，洋甘菊相对无毒。虽然它的作用不如其他驱虫

药那么快，但它确实有效，特别是对于蛔虫和鞭虫，并且它具有抗炎活性，有助于抵消寄生虫通常对肠粘

膜的影响。菠萝草（M. matricarioides）的驱虫活性更为明显。

=== PAGE 127 ===
For internal uses, we prefer a glycerin tincture of the herb because it can be administered in small, easy-to-feed

doses of 0.25–0.50 milliliter per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily as needed to suppress

symptoms. The sweet-tasting glycerin tincture can be administered directly into the animal’s mouth, or it can be

added to the animal’s drinking water. The glycerite is also useful in treating gingivitis, especially when small

proportions of stronger antimicrobial herb extracts (such as thyme, rosemary, bee balm, Oregon grape, or echinacea)

are added. To use chamomile in this capacity, the tincture can be applied directly to the gums of the animal with a

cotton swab.

对于内服，我们更喜欢这种草药的甘油酊剂，因为它可以按每 20 磅动物体重 0.25-0.50 毫升的小剂量施

用，易于喂养，每天两次，以抑制症状。甜味甘油酊剂可以直接注入动物的口腔中，也可以添加到动物的

饮用水中。甘油还可用于治疗牙龈炎，特别是当添加少量更强效抗菌草本提取物（如百里香、迷迭香、蜂

香膏、俄勒冈葡萄或紫锥菊）时。为了发挥洋甘菊的作用，可以用棉签将酊剂直接涂抹在动物的牙龈上。

Chamomile extract can also be used in a vaporizer or steamed from boiling water for inhalation treatment of

asthma, allergies, bronchitis, and the like. In homeopathic form, chamomile is used for teething puppies to keep

them from chewing everything in sight.

洋甘菊提取物还可以用蒸发器或沸水蒸出，用于吸入治疗哮喘、过敏、支气管炎等。在顺势疗法中，洋

甘菊用于出牙的小狗，以防止它们咀嚼看到的所有东西。

Availability: Chamomile can be purchased from any health food retailer and is available at most supermarkets. The

plants are available through most nurseries, as are the seeds.

可用性：洋甘菊可以从任何健康食品零售商处购买，并且在大多数超市都有售。这些植物和种子都可以通

过大多数苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Chamomile is easy to grow in all climates, and once established its promiscuous, free-

seeding character yields abundant growth year after year. If left to its unruly self, it is likely to find its way out of

flower beds and into pathways and beyond.

繁殖和收获：洋甘菊在所有气候下都很容易生长，一旦确立了其混杂、自由播种的特性，就会年复一年地

生长茂盛。如果任由它不守规矩，它很可能会离开花坛，进入小路甚至更远的地方。

Chamomile blooms continuously throughout the growing season. The flowers can be plucked off at any time and

dried indoors on a piece of clean paper or a nonmetallic screen. Fresh flowers are useful, too, and in fact are a

stronger option for use in skin rinses and against intestinal parasites, but the dried flowers have a much more

pleasant flavor.

洋甘菊在整个生长季节持续开花。可以随时将花朵摘下并在室内用一张干净的纸或非金属屏风干燥。鲜

花也很有用，事实上，它是用于皮肤冲洗和对抗肠道寄生虫的更强选择，但干花的味道更令人愉悦。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: In cases of nervous stomach problems and gas, look to catnip, fennel, and bee balm.

Chamomile combines well with calendula, juniper leaves, or uva ursi in anti-inflammatory skin rinses. For irritable

bowel, diarrhea, and other gastric disorders, consider plantain, slippery elm, and marshmallow. For inflammatory

urinary tract problems, chamomile combines with corn silk, plantain, uva ursi, white oak bark, couch grass, and

marshmallow. For use against worms, chamomile can be combined at a 4:1 ratio (four parts chamomile to one part

other herb) with garlic, Oregon grape, organically raised goldenseal, wormwood, or black walnut hulls.

替代品和辅助剂：如果出现神经性胃病和胀气，可以考虑使用猫薄荷、茴香和蜂香膏。洋甘菊与金盏花、

杜松叶或熊果在抗炎皮肤冲洗液中完美结合。对于肠易激、腹泻和其他胃部疾病，可以考虑车前草、滑榆

和棉花糖。对于炎症性尿路问题，洋甘菊可与玉米须、车前草、熊果、白橡树皮、沙发草和棉花糖结合使

用。为了对抗蠕虫，可以将洋甘菊以 4:1 的比例（四份洋甘菊与一份其他草药）与大蒜、俄勒冈葡萄、有机

饲养的毛茛、艾草或黑胡桃壳混合。

Cautions and Comments: Chamomile is, without doubt, one of the safest herbs in existence, but some animals (and

humans too) are extremely allergic to this plant and its relatives. Always check for sensitivity before feeding this

=== PAGE 128 ===
herb by applying a small amount of the preparation to an animal’s skin. Then if no reactions are observed, feed just a

drop or two and watch for any changes in your animal.

注意和评论：毫无疑问，洋甘菊是现有的最安全的草药之一，但一些动物（以及人类）对这种植物及其亲

戚极度过敏。在喂食这种草药之前，请务必将少量制剂涂在动物的皮肤上，检查其敏感性。然后，如果没

有观察到任何反应，则只喂一两滴，并观察动物的任何变化。

Studies suggest that excessive use of chamomile during pregnancy may increase fetus reabsorption and inhibit

fetus growth in some animals.

研究表明，怀孕期间过量使用洋甘菊可能会增加胎儿的重吸收并抑制某些动物的胎儿生长。

CHAPARRAL

丛林

Larrea tridentata

三齿斑鳢

Caltrop Family

菱角家族

Appearance: Chaparral (also commonly known as creosote bush) is the predominant low-desert shrub of the U.S.

Southwest. The abundance of this shrub almost makes a description of it unnecessary, as many who live or travel

between the Pacific Ocean and inland states of the Southwest invariably find themselves within what seems to be an

endless expanse of these ancient plants. But, for those who are unfamiliar with the plant, chaparral is the chest-high

to 10-feet-tall dark green bush with spindly wind-whipped branches, which contributes to the highway hypnosis we

all suffer while driving to and from Las Vegas. The leaves are tiny (⅛ inch long) and have a greasy-leathery texture.

The bark is reddish brown toward the base of the plant and progressively lighter (to almost white) on the smaller

limbs. Flowers are minute and yellow, developing into oddly fuzzy seed-bearing capsules. Chaparral is one of the

oldest living inhabitants of our planet, with some individual plants estimated to be over ten thousand years old!

外观：灌木丛（通常也称为杂酚油灌木）是美国西南部主要的低沙漠灌木。这种灌木的丰富性几乎使得对

它的描述变得不必要，因为许多在太平洋和西南部内陆州之间生活或旅行的人总是发现自己身处这些似乎

无边无际的古老植物之中。但是，对于那些不熟悉这种植物的人来说，灌木丛是一种齐胸高到 10 英尺高的

深绿色灌木，其细长的树枝被风吹得摇摇欲坠，它让我们在开车往返拉斯维加斯时在高速公路上感到催

眠。叶子很小（⅛英寸长），具有油腻的皮革质地。树皮向植物基部呈红棕色，在较小的枝干上逐渐变浅

（几乎白色）。花又小又黄，发育成奇怪的、毛茸茸的、含有种子的蒴果。灌木丛是我们星球上最古老的

居民之一，一些植物的历史估计已经超过一万年了！

Habitat and Range: Profusely abundant from the deserts of central Texas westward through the southern half of

New Mexico and Arizona to the deserts of southern California and Nevada.

栖息地和分布范围：从德克萨斯州中部的沙漠向西穿过新墨西哥州和亚利桑那州的南半部到加利福尼亚州

南部和内华达州的沙漠，资源丰富。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Chaparral often blooms according to precipitation. Generally, this occurs any time from

March through May.

周期和开花季节：灌木丛通常根据降水量开花。一般来说，这种情况发生在三月到五月的任何时间。

Parts Used: Leaves, flowers, fruits

使用部位：叶、花、果实

Primary Medicinal Activities: Inhibits bacterial reproduction (bacteriostatic), antifungal, kills certain types of

amoeba (amoebicidal), antioxidant, helps with blood cleansing

主要药用活性：抑制细菌繁殖（抑菌）、抗真菌、杀死某些类型的阿米巴原虫（杀阿米巴）、抗氧化剂、

有助于血液净化
