三齿斑鳢

Strongest Affinities: Skin, blood, liver

最强亲和力：皮肤、血液、肝脏

Preparation: A decoction is used externally as a skin and coat rinse or as an ingredient in salves and ointments. For

small animals, the fomentation method of application is strongly advised (see chapter 1) because this form of

preparation allows the active constituents of the herb to remain on the body longer and prohibits the animal from

licking off the decoction. Salves or ointments that contain a large percentage of chaparral should also be kept out of

the mouth of the animal. For horses or other large animals, this is less of an issue, especially if the decoction is

applied to portions of the body that are beyond reach of the animal’s mouth.

制备：煎剂外用，用作皮肤和外套冲洗剂或作为药膏和软膏的成分。对于小动物，强烈建议使用热敷方法

（参见第 1 章），因为这种制剂形式可以使草药的活性成分在体内保留更长时间，并防止动物舔掉汤剂。

含有大量灌木醛的药膏或软膏也应远离动物的口。对于马或其他大型动物来说，这不是一个问题，特别是

如果将汤剂涂抹到动物嘴巴够不到的身体部位时。

Because this plant is naturally designed to resist harsh desert elements, it is poorly soluble in water. Therefore,

decoctions and alcohol-based tinctures are the best methods of extraction for this plant.

由于这种植物天生就能抵抗严酷的沙漠元素，因此它难溶于水。因此，煎剂和酒精酊剂是提取这种植物

的最佳方法。

Common Uses: American Indians of the Southwest have used this plant for centuries—for everything from the

internal treatment of tumors and hepatic (liver) diseases to topical skin treatments, including sunscreen, for

themselves and their animals. Today, herbalists use the plant as a strong bacteriostatic and antioxidant agent in the

treatment of blood and liver disorders. However, recent scientific research and documented incidents have raised

=== PAGE 131 ===
both hope and concern.

常见用途：西南部的美洲印第安人几个世纪以来一直在使用这种植物，从肿瘤和肝病的内部治疗到局部皮

肤治疗，包括为自己和他们的动物涂抹防晒霜。如今，草药师使用这种植物作为强效抑菌剂和抗氧化剂来

治疗血液和肝脏疾病。然而，最近的科学研究和记录的事件既引起了希望，也引起了担忧。

Some studies have shown that chemical constituents in chaparral may inhibit the growth of cancerous cells, while

others have shown exactly the opposite. And recently, a few accounts of serious liver damage (in humans) have been

attributed to this herb. Many theories as to why this plant may suddenly be harming us after hundreds of years of

safe medicinal use. One theory is that perhaps humanity and chaparral are evolving away from one another.

Nevertheless, thousands of people still use chaparral on a daily basis, and it remains a popular herbal medicine in

natural products markets worldwide.

一些研究表明，丛林中的化学成分可能会抑制癌细胞的生长，而其他研究则表明恰恰相反。最近，一些

严重肝损伤（人类）的报道被归因于这种草药。许多理论解释了为什么这种植物在经过数百年的安全药用

后可能会突然伤害我们。一种理论认为，也许人类和丛林正在逐渐远离彼此。尽管如此，仍有成千上万的

人每天使用灌木丛，它仍然是全球天然产品市场上受欢迎的草药。

In animals, chaparral has been shown to have strong antifungal, antibacterial, and, remarkably, amoebicidal

properties. The constituent believed to be responsible for most of chaparral’s medicinal activity is a lignan

compound known as nordihydroguaiaretic acid (NDGA). Nordihydroguaiaretic acid may be effective in treating

various forms of amebiasis, including Entamoeba histolytica , an amoeba that can be passed from humans to the

digestive tracts of dogs (but rarely to other animals) and causes acute or chronic colitis characterized by persistent

diarrhea. It has also been proven effective against Salmonella, Streptococcus, Phylococcus aureus, Bacillus subtilis,

and various other pathogens and molds. Unfortunately, chaparral’s toxicity prohibits it from most internal uses. But

its remarkable antimicrobial properties make it an excellent broad-spectrum topical agent that is as useful for the

animal handler as it is for the animal receiving care.

在动物身上，灌木丛已被证明具有很强的抗真菌、抗菌作用，而且值得注意的是，它还具有杀阿米巴的

特性。据信，丛林树的大部分药用活性的成分是一种被称为去甲二氢愈创木酸（NDGA）的木酚素化合

物。去甲二氢愈创木酸可能有效治疗各种形式的阿米巴病，包括溶组织内阿米巴，一种可以从人类传播到

狗的消化道（但很少传播到其他动物）并导致以持续性腹泻为特征的急性或慢性结肠炎的阿米巴原虫。它

还被证明可以有效对抗沙门氏菌、链球菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、枯草芽孢杆菌以及各种其他病原体和霉菌。

不幸的是，灌木丛的毒性使其无法用于大多数内服。但其卓越的抗菌特性使其成为一种出色的广谱外用制

剂，对动物处理者和接受护理的动物都同样有用。

Used as a hand rinse before and after handling animals who may be carrying Salmonella or other transmittable

pathogens or as a rinse applied prior to handling animals who are prone to infection from human-carried pathogens,

a decoction of chaparral serves an effective two-way adjunct to soap and water. For external treatment of fungal

infections of the hooves, nails, or skins of various large and small animals, chaparral is among the first herbs to try.

Just remember, keep chaparral from going into the animal’s digestive tract.

灌木丛煎剂可用作处理可能携带沙门氏菌或其他传染性病原体的动物之前和之后的洗手液，或作为处理

容易受到人类携带病原体感染的动物之前的洗手液，灌木煎剂可作为有效的双向辅助剂肥皂和水。对于各

种大小动物的蹄、指甲或皮肤的真菌感染的外部治疗，灌木丛是首先尝试的草药之一。请记住，防止丛林

进入动物的消化道。

Availability: Available through herb retailers; profusely available in the low desert regions of the southwestern U.S.

and Mexico.

供货情况：可通过药草零售商购买；在美国西南部和墨西哥的低沙漠地区大量存在。

Propagation and Harvest: In arid regions, chaparral can be transplanted into the garden as a slow-growing

landscape shrub. The leaves, twigs, and flowers can be harvested any time.

繁殖和收获：在干旱地区，灌木丛可以作为生长缓慢的景观灌木移植到花园中。叶子、树枝和花朵可以随

时收获。

=== PAGE 132 ===
Alternatives and Adjuncts: For antibacterial skin rinses, bee balm, chamomile, sage, thyme, or rosemary can be

used. For treatment of psoriasis and other inflammatory skin disorders, chaparral combines well with calendula or

aloe.

替代品和辅助剂：对于抗菌皮肤冲洗液，可以使用蜂香膏、洋甘菊、鼠尾草、百里香或迷迭香。为了治疗

牛皮癣和其他炎症性皮肤病，灌木丛与金盏花或芦荟完美结合。

Cautions and Comments: Ingestion of any form of this plant in large enough quantities may lead to liver damage.

For this reason, it is a good idea to take extra measures to assure that your animal does not lick off external

applications of chaparral after they are applied. Therefore, we recommend that you wrap dogs, cats, and other small

animals in a towel after a skin rinse has been applied.

注意事项和评论：大量摄入任何形式的这种植物都可能导致肝损伤。因此，最好采取额外措施，以确保您

的动物在使用丛林树外用药后不会舔掉它们。因此，我们建议您在清洗皮肤后用毛巾包裹狗、猫和其他小

动物。

=== PAGE 133 ===
CHICKWEED

繁缕

Stellaria media

繁缕

Pink Family

粉红家族

Appearance: Common chickweed is a weak-stemmed sprawling annual that is commonly found in lush, low-

growing mats or entangled in other growth (oftentimes in rose beds). Chickweed exhibits a unique characteristic that

makes it easy to differentiate from all look-alikes: a line of minute hairs runs up only one side of the stem; switching

sides at each pair of leaves. Opposite leaves may grow to 1½ inches and range in shape from broadly lance shaped to

oval but always have distinct points at their tips. Flowers are small (¼ inch across) and white with five petals that

are clefted at their tips to give the false appearance of ten petals. Chickweed blooms continuously, each time

dropping its seeds as it continues its sprawl.

外观：普通繁缕是一种弱茎蔓生植物，常见于郁郁葱葱、低矮的垫子中或缠绕在其他植物中（通常在玫瑰

花坛中）。繁缕展现出一种独特的特征，可以很容易地将其与所有相似的植物区分开来：一排细毛仅在茎

的一侧延伸；在每对叶子处交换侧面。对生的叶子可以长到 1.5 英寸，形状从宽矛形到椭圆形不等，但在其

尖端总是有明显的点。花朵很小（直径 1/4 英寸），呈白色，有 5 个花瓣，尖端裂开，给人以 10 个花瓣的

假象。繁缕不断开花，每次在继续蔓延时都会掉落种子。

Habitat and Range: Chickweed inhabits moist meadows, ravines, and disturbed areas throughout all of North

America, from the Brooks Range of Alaska to all points southward.

栖息地和分布范围：繁缕栖息在整个北美洲的潮湿草地、峡谷和受干扰的地区，从阿拉斯加的布鲁克斯山

脉到以南的所有地方。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual that blooms and free-seeds itself continuously throughout growth

周期和开花季节：一年生植物在整个生长过程中不断开花和释放种子

Parts Used: Freshly harvested leaves, flowers, and stems

使用部分：新鲜收获的叶子、花和茎

=== PAGE 134 ===
Stellaria media

繁缕

Primary Medicinal Activities: Soothing to the skin; lubricates, soothes, and protects internal mucous membranes

(demulcent), diuretic, tonic

主要药用活性：舒缓皮肤；润滑、舒缓和保护内部粘膜（镇静剂）、利尿、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Skin and digestive tract

最强的亲和力：皮肤和消化道

Preparation: Fresh whole plant, fresh juice of the plant, water or oil infusion, salves, ointments. If you have access

to a juicer, try this: Juice enough of the fresh plants to fill an ice-cube tray (preferably a stainless steel one), then

freeze it. If the tray is stored in a resealable bag and kept in a freezer, the frozen juice cubes keeps for about three

months. Individual cubes can be thawed and the juice used as needed, internally or externally.

制剂：新鲜全草、新鲜植物汁、水或油浸剂、药膏、软膏。如果您有榨汁机，请尝试以下操作：将足够的

新鲜植物榨汁，装满冰块托盘（最好是不锈钢托盘），然后冷冻。如果将托盘存放在可重新密封的袋子中

并保存在冰箱中，则冷冻果汁块可以保存大约三个月。可以将单个立方体解冻，并根据需要使用果汁，内

部或外部使用。

Common Uses: Whether for human or animal purposes, chickweed is a safe, delicious resource for providing

soothing, cooling relief for virtually any form of minor irritation. Internally, chickweed acts to soothe, protect, and

mildly lubricate the upper digestive tract. Fed in its entire fresh form, it is useful for relieving minor esophageal

irritations, such as those caused by something Rover ate that had rough edges, or even a minor bite or sting that

Godzilla the iguana suffered from snapping at an insect with bad manners. Chickweed can also be fed to dogs or cats

as a source of lubrication and light roughage that may assist in the expulsion of hair balls. For mild cases of stomach

=== PAGE 135 ===
upset that are believed to be the result of an irritated stomach lining or for a mild case of colitis, fresh chickweed or

chickweed juice is indicated as a mild first aid tonic for dogs, cats, and horses or any other herbivore. If chickweed

is not astringent or mucilaginous enough to bring relief, the therapy can be progressively “upgraded” by using

stronger herbs. Chickweed is nutritious and an excellent nutritive and digestive tonic for birds. Chickweed poultices

are useful for cooling and soothing minor burns and skin irritations, particularly when associated with itching and

dryness.

常见用途：无论是用于人类还是动物用途，繁缕都是一种安全、美味的资源，可为几乎任何形式的轻微刺

激提供舒缓、清凉的缓解作用。在内部，繁缕可以舒缓、保护和轻度润滑上消化道。以新鲜形式喂食，可

有效缓解轻微的食道刺激，例如罗孚吃下的边缘粗糙的东西引起的食道刺激，甚至是鬣蜥哥斯拉因不礼貌

地咬昆虫而遭受的轻微咬伤或蜇伤。繁缕也可以作为润滑和轻粗饲料的来源喂给狗或猫，有助于排出毛

球。对于被认为是由胃壁受刺激引起的轻度胃部不适或轻度结肠炎，新鲜繁缕或繁缕汁可作为狗、猫、马

或任何其他食草动物的温和急救补品。如果繁缕的收敛性或粘液性不足以缓解症状，则可以通过使用更强

的草药来逐步“升级”治疗。繁缕营养丰富，是鸟类优良的营养和消化补品。繁缕膏剂可用于冷却和舒缓轻

微烧伤和皮肤刺激，特别是在伴有瘙痒和干燥时。

Availability: Chickweed grows just about everywhere in the world. If you cannot find a wild source, many specialty

seed catalogs now carry the seed. Don’t bother with the dried herb you are likely to find in the marketplace—it just

isn’t the same!

可用性：繁缕在世界各地几乎都有生长。如果您找不到野生来源，现在许多专业种子目录都带有这种种

子。不要为市场上可能找到的干药草烦恼——它们只是不一样！

Propagation and Harvest: Because chickweed is a vigorous free-seeder, transplanting it into the garden is as easy

as grabbing a handful of the plants and spreading them on a moist flower bed. Give your chickweed plenty of water,

rich soil, and at least four hours of shade each day, and it will likely be at your service forever. Although this plant

likes to sprawl, its delicate (and delicious) nature seldom poses a problem to the weed-weary gardener.

繁殖和收获：由于繁缕是一种生命力旺盛的自由播种植物，因此将其移植到花园中就像抓一把植物并将其

铺在潮湿的花床上一样容易。每天给你的繁缕充足的水、肥沃的土壤和至少四个小时的阴凉处，它可能会

永远为你服务。尽管这种植物喜欢蔓延，但其精致（且美味）的性质很少给厌倦杂草的园丁带来问题。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Aloe juice or gel is a better option for burns and irritations of the skin. In salves and

ointments, chickweed combines nicely with calendula or Saint-John’s-wort. For cases of gastrointestinal irritation

that will not respond to chickweed’s gentle nature, slippery elm, plantain, or marshmallow should be considered.

替代品和辅助剂：芦荟汁或凝胶是治疗皮肤烧伤和刺激的更好选择。在药膏和药膏中，繁缕与金盏花或圣

约翰草完美结合。对于胃肠道刺激的情况，如果繁缕的温和性质没有反应，则应考虑使用滑榆、车前草或

棉花糖。

Cautions and Comments: Generally, chickweed is considered to be a safe medicinal food plant—it can be fed to

most animals in whatever quantities they desire. Large quantities of chickweed, however, can have a laxative effect.

Always keep in mind that some animals may be allergic to chickweed. Perhaps the most important thing to consider

with the use of this plant is that it often lives among hated weeds that have been subjected to herbicides, and it is

frequently found in waste areas that are subject to various contaminants.

注意和评论：一般来说，繁缕被认为是一种安全的药用食品植物——大多数动物可以按照它们想要的数量

喂食它。然而，大量的繁缕可以起到通便作用。请始终记住，有些动物可能对繁缕过敏。也许使用这种植

物时需要考虑的最重要的事情是，它经常生活在经过除草剂处理的令人讨厌的杂草中，并且经常在受到各

种污染物影响的废物区域中发现它。

=== PAGE 136 ===
CLEAVERS

切肉刀

Galium aparine

肝素镓

Madder Family

茜草家族

Appearance: The Galium genus is large and widespread, with no fewer than thirteen species in the Pacific

Northwest alone. Species can be divided into two general groups: perennial and annual. In essence, the annual

varieties are sprawlers and climbers, often forming ground-covering mats with much weaker taproots and more

delicate stems and leaves than perennial species. All Galium plants have square stems and slender leaves that grow

in whorled clusters like bicycle spokes of two to eight leaves, depending on the species. Flowers are small and white

to greenish in color. Galium aparine (see photo) is a widely distributed annual variety that has earned most of the

attention of the herb market because of its delicate, aromatic, and readily water soluble nature. It has earned the

common names of “cleavers” and “tangleweed” because of the thousands of infinitesimal, reversed hooks on the

angles of its stems. These tiny hooks enable the plant to cling to just about anything in a fashion similar to the way

static-charged hair clings to clothing. This allows cleavers to reproduce effectively because the delicate seed-bearing

foliage is easily uprooted and carried away by passersby. Perennial varieties such as northern bedstraw (G. boreale)

do not share this unique characteristic.

外观：钆属庞大且分布广泛，仅在太平洋西北地区就有不少于 13 种。物种可分为两大类：多年生植物和一

年生植物。从本质上讲，一年生品种是蔓生植物和攀缘植物，通常形成地面覆盖垫，其主根比多年生品种

弱得多，茎和叶也更脆弱。所有的镓植物都有方形的茎和细长的叶子，叶子生长成轮状簇状，就像自行车

辐条一样，有两到八片叶子，具体取决于物种。花很小，颜色为白色到绿色。 Galium aparine（见照片）是

一种分布广泛的一年生品种，因其细腻、芳香和易溶于水的性质而赢得了草药市场的大部分关注。由于其

茎角上有数以千计的微小反向钩子，它获得了“菜刀”和“缠结草”的俗称。这些小钩使植物能够附着在几乎任

何东西上，就像带静电的头发附着在衣服上一样。这使得切肉刀能够有效地繁殖，因为带有种子的脆弱叶

子很容易被路人连根拔起并带走。多年生品种，如北方床草（G.boreale）不具有这种独特的特征。

Habitat and Range: Cleavers (G. aparine) and most other annual varieties prefer moist habitats and are commonly

found growing in shaded ravines and along streams. Northern bedstraw (G. boreale) and other perennial species can

tolerate a much wider diversity of habitats and are commonly found along road margins and in dry, sunny areas.

Both cleavers and northern bedstraw are common throughout North America and most of the Northern Hemisphere,

up to about 6,000 feet in elevation.

栖息地和分布范围：菜刀（G. aparine）和大多数其他一年生品种喜欢潮湿的栖息地，通常生长在阴凉的峡

谷和溪流沿岸。北方床秆（G. booleale）和其他多年生物种可以适应更广泛的栖息地多样性，并且常见于道

路边缘和干燥、阳光充足的地区。切肉刀和北床稻草在北美和北半球大部分地区（海拔约 6,000 英尺）都很

常见。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Annual or perennial (depending on species). Most Galium spp. bloom in early to

midsummer.

周期和开花季节：一年生或多年生（取决于物种）。大多数镓属。在初夏至仲夏开花。

Parts Used: Entire fresh plant

=== PAGE 137 ===
使用部分：整个新鲜植物

Primary Medicinal Activities: Tonic, helps with blood cleansing, diuretic, astringent, anti-inflammatory, heals

wounds

主要药用活性：滋补、帮助净化血液、利尿、收敛、抗炎、治愈伤口

Strongest Affinities: Lymph system, urinary tract, skin

最强的亲和力：淋巴系统、泌尿道、皮肤

Galium aparine

肝素镓

Preparation: Juice, tincture, or tea of the fresh plant

制备：新鲜植物的汁液、酊剂或茶

Common Uses: Herbalists have long regarded cleavers as a valuable lymphatic tonic. In essence, the lymph system

is responsible for “washing” body tissues. Throughout the body, lymph is passed across capillary barriers to remove

waste materials from healthy cell communities. The lymph is then returned to the bloodstream, where in a properly

functioning body it is cleaned of waste material by the liver and kidneys. The waste then (hopefully) leaves the body

via the usual urinary and digestive outlets.

常见用途：草药学家长期以来一直将切肉刀视为有价值的淋巴补品。本质上，淋巴系统负责“清洗”身体组

织。在整个身体中，淋巴液穿过毛细血管屏障，清除健康细胞群落中的废物。然后淋巴液返回血液，在正

常运作的身体中，肝脏和肾脏清除废物。然后废物（希望）通过通常的泌尿和消化出口排出体外。

Cleavers is used in virtually any condition that is characterized by general or localized swelling or in situations

=== PAGE 138 ===
where lymphatic circulation has been impaired by the formation of scar tissue, ulceration, or infection. Although the

activities of cleavers are subtle, the herb is believed to increase circulation of lymph in impaired areas of the body

through dilation of small, almost cellular-level capillaries. This would explain the remarkable ability of cleavers in

helping speed the healing of gastric ulcers and the herb’s long-standing reputation for aiding drainage of lymph-

engorged cysts, tumors, and inflamed tissues of the urinary tract. In addition to its lymphatic qualities, cleavers lends

mild astringent activities to its job of relieving inflammations of the upper digestive and urinary tracts. In cats, these

activities make cleavers a safe long-term aid in the treatment of feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD), also

known as feline urinary syndrome (FUS), and the herb may also be useful for chronic low-grade kidney

inflammation.

切割刀几乎适用于任何以全身或局部肿胀为特征的病症，或因疤痕组织、溃疡或感染的形成而损害淋巴

循环的情况。尽管切肉刀的活动很微妙，但这种草药被认为可以通过扩张几乎细胞水平的小毛细血管来增

加身体受损区域的淋巴循环。这可以解释切肉刀在帮助加速胃溃疡愈合方面的卓越能力，以及这种草药在

帮助淋巴充盈的囊肿、肿瘤和泌尿道发炎组织引流方面的长期声誉。除了其淋巴特性外，切肉刀还具有温

和的收敛作用，可以缓解上消化道和泌尿道的炎症。对于猫来说，这些活动使切肉刀成为治疗猫下尿路疾

病 (FLUTD)（也称为猫泌尿综合症 (FUS)）的安全长期辅助工具，并且这种草药也可能对慢性低度肾脏炎

症有用。

Because cleavers is thought to increase lymphatic flow throughout body tissues, it may be useful as an alterative

therapy in the treatment of various skin disorders. From a holistic perspective, skin problems such as psoriasis and

eczema are usually the result of poor elimination of systemic waste. Instead of being “washed” out by the lymph

system, “filtered” by the liver and kidneys, and eliminated from the body, the waste materials build up in the body,

resulting in diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and conditions such as flaky, oily, or itchy skin. By improving

lymphatic circulation, a critical level of systemic waste management is assisted.

由于切割刀被认为可以增加整个身体组织的淋巴流量，因此它可能可用作治疗各种皮肤疾病的替代疗

法。从整体角度来看，牛皮癣和湿疹等皮肤问题通常是由于全身废物排除不畅造成的。这些废物并没有被

淋巴系统“清洗”、被肝脏和肾脏“过滤”并排出体外，而是在体内积聚，导致类风湿性关节炎等疾病以及片

状、油腻等疾病。 ，或皮肤发痒。通过改善淋巴循环，有助于达到关键水平的系统废物管理。

Although relatively little scientific research has been done to validate these claims, its long history of use and safe

track record make cleavers a worthwhile tonic for those who are willing to accept natural healing based on anecdotal

evidence. A typical starting dose of the glycerin tincture for dogs, cats, birds, and other animals is 0.5–1.0 milliliter

per 50 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily. Horses, rabbits, and other herbivores can be fed the fresh

herb in their daily meals.

尽管验证这些说法的科学研究相对较少，但其悠久的使用历史和安全记录使得切肉刀对于那些愿意接受

基于轶事证据的自然疗法的人来说是一种值得的补品。对于狗、猫、鸟类和其他动物来说，甘油酊剂的典

型起始剂量为每 50 磅动物体重 0.5-1.0 毫升，每天两次。马、兔子和其他食草动物可以在日常膳食中喂食

新鲜药草。

Availability: Cleavers is a common wild plant throughout most of the Northern Hemisphere. It is available in

various forms at local herb retailers, but remember that the dried herb (or any preparation of the dried herb) is

inferior medicine compared to the fresh plant. If you plan to purchase a commercial preparation of cleavers, check

the label to make sure that it was produced from the fresh plant—otherwise, you might be buying an expensive but

powerless herb. Fresh plant tinctures, in our opinion, is the best choice.

可用性：切肉刀是北半球大部分地区常见的野生植物。当地草药零售商有多种形式出售，但请记住，与新

鲜植物相比，干草药（或干草药的任何制剂）是劣质药物。如果您打算购买商用切肉刀制剂，请检查标签

以确保它是由新鲜植物生产的 - 否则，您可能会购买一种昂贵但无作用的草药。我们认为，新鲜植物酊剂

是最好的选择。

Propagation and Harvest: A few specialty seed catalogs offer cleavers (G. aparine) seed, and many nurseries sell

starts of “sweet woodruff,” a generic term for any variety of perennial Galium spp. sold as bedding plants. While

these cultivars likely possess medicinal attributes, exactly how they measure up to the “herbalist-approved” G.

aparine is unknown.

=== PAGE 139 ===
繁殖和收获：一些专业种子目录提供切刀（G. aparine）种子，许多苗圃出售“甜木叶”的种子，这是任何一

种多年生草本植物的通用术语。作为花坛植物出售。虽然这些品种可能具有药用特性，但它们究竟如何达

到“草药师批准的”G. aparine 的水平尚不清楚。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For problems involving the lymphatic system, cleavers combines with calendula,

echinacea, or astragalus. For skin and liver problems, cleavers is best if combined with alterative, diuretic, and liver-

strengthening and stimulating herbs—dandelion, burdock, Oregon grape, milk thistle, and yellow dock should be

considered. For treatment of tumors, cleavers is traditionally combined with red clover, licorice, violet, or aloe. For

urinary tract problems, check out corn silk, marshmallow, and couch grass as alternatives or adjuncts.

替代品和辅助剂：对于涉及淋巴系统的问题，切肉刀与金盏花、紫锥菊或黄芪结合使用。对于皮肤和肝脏

问题，切肉刀最好与替代、利尿、强化肝脏和刺激的草药结合使用——应考虑蒲公英、牛蒡、俄勒冈葡

萄、水飞蓟和黄坞。为了治疗肿瘤，切肉刀传统上与红三叶草、甘草、紫罗兰或芦荟结合使用。对于泌尿

道问题，可以使用玉米须、棉花糖和沙发草作为替代品或辅助品。

Cautions and Comments: Cleavers is a safe herb. No contraindications have been noted with animal or human use,

although allergic reaction is a possibility to consider before feeding.

注意事项和评论：切肉刀是一种安全的草药。尽管在喂养前可能要考虑过敏反应，但尚未发现动物或人类

使用有禁忌症。

COLTSFOOT

款冬

Petasites and

百叶石和

Tussilago species

杜鹃花属

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: The common name of coltsfoot is shared by two distinctly different genera, Tussilago and Petasites.

The classic Old World coltsfoot is T. farfara , a European native that produces light yellow, dandelion-like flowers

and leaves proportionately large and heart shaped. The Petasites genus, on the other hand, produces its flowers on a

leafless stem before the leaves fully develop. Five species of Petasites inhabit North America, while T. farfara is

strictly a naturalized import here. Both genera of coltsfoot are equally valuable as medicines. For the purposes of

identifying varieties native to North America, we focus on the Petasites clan of coltsfoot.

外观：款冬属的俗名是两个截然不同的属：款冬属（Tussilago）和款冬属（Petasites）。经典的东半球款冬

是 T.farfara，原产于欧洲，能开出淡黄色、蒲公英状的花朵，叶子比例较大，呈心形。另一方面，瓣花属在

叶子完全发育之前在无叶的茎上开花。北美洲栖息着五种 Petasite，而 T. farfara 是这里严格意义上的归化进

口。这两个属的款冬都具有同等的药用价值。为了识别原产于北美的品种，我们重点关注款冬的 Petasites

家族。

The flowers of Petasites are generally drab and featherlike, ranging in color from white to light purple, and are

presented in a cluster at the top of the plant. Leaves vary in shape according to species, from triangular (P. frigidus

and P. nivalis) or narrowly arrow shaped (P. sagitatta ), to broadly oval shaped with deep palmate (resembling a

hand with the fingers spread) lobes (P. palmatus). The 3-to 10-inch-wide leaves are presented on long leaf stems

that extend directly from thick, creeping rootstocks and are dark green on their upper surfaces and lighter green and

feltlike on their undersides.

瓣叶植物的花通常是土褐色和羽毛状的，颜色从白色到浅紫色，并在植物的顶部成簇出现。叶子的形状

因物种而异，从三角形（P. frigidus 和 P. nivalis）或窄箭形（P. sagitatta），到宽椭圆形、深掌状（类似于手

指张开的手）裂片（P. palmatus） ）。 3至10英寸宽的叶子长在长叶茎上，叶茎直接从厚实的匍匐砧木延伸

出来，上表面呈深绿色，下表面呈浅绿色，呈毡状。

Habitat and Range: Coltsfoot requires consistent moisture at its feet and is usually found along streams, in wet

meadows, and on shaded road margins, particularly where water seepage is continuous. Several species of Petasites

range in forested areas from Alaska southward to California and eastward across the northern half of North America.

The European variety of coltsfoot (T. farfara) has escaped cultivation in the northeastern portions of the U.S., where

it enjoys similar habitat characteristics.

栖息地和分布范围：款冬的脚部需要持续的湿度，通常出现在溪流沿岸、潮湿的草地和阴凉的道路边缘，

特别是在持续渗水的地方。数种 Petasite 分布在从阿拉斯加向南到加利福尼亚州以及向东穿越北美洲北半部

的森林地区。欧洲品种的款冬 (T.farfara) 在美国东北部地区已不再种植，在那里它具有类似的栖息地特征。

=== PAGE 141 ===
Petasites palmatus

掌叶蜂

Cycle and Bloom Season: Late March to early June

周期和开花季节：3月下旬至6月上旬

Parts Used: Leaves and stems of the mature plant

使用部位：成熟植物的叶和茎

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expectorant, eases cough spasms (antispasmodic), anti-inflammatory, antibacterial

主要药用活性：祛痰、缓解咳嗽痉挛（解痉）、抗炎、抗菌

Strongest Affinities: Lungs and upper respiratory tract

最强的亲和力：肺和上呼吸道

Preparation: Water infusion (tea), tincture, or syrup

制剂：水浸剂（茶）、酊剂或糖浆

Common Uses: People have been using coltsfoot for hundreds of years in the treatment of respiratory ailments

ranging from chest colds to whooping cough, asthma, and viral pneumonia. Coltsfoot has long been regarded as a

first choice for relieving the rawness and pain of unproductive spasmodic coughs. It is soothing because of its

mucilage, and the ingredient petasin acts as an antispasmodic and nerve sedative for the bronchial rings and

pulmonary receptors in the lungs.

=== PAGE 142 ===
常见用途：数百年来，人们一直使用款冬来治疗呼吸道疾病，包括感冒、百日咳、哮喘和病毒性肺炎。款

冬长期以来一直被认为是缓解痉挛性咳嗽的疼痛和疼痛的首选。它因其粘液而具有舒缓作用，其成分

petasin 对肺部的支气管环和肺受体具有解痉和神经镇静作用。

Coltsfoot is useful in easing the discomforts of respiratory infections that are characterized by dry cough or

seemingly immobile accumulations of thick phlegm in the bronchi. We find it particularly useful for

tracheobronchitis in dogs (specifically kennel cough), especially when combined with anti-viral herbs such as

licorice. Preparations of T. farfara have been shown to inhibit Bordetella pertussis, a bacterial component of the

kennel cough malady, as well as various other strains of gram-negative bacteria such as Staphylococcus aureus,

Proteus hauseri, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Proteus vulgaris. All of this makes coltsfoot useful as a respiratory

disinfectant, expectorant, and cough suppressant in a wide variety of different animals—plus it acts in a holistic

manner.

款冬可有效缓解呼吸道感染带来的不适，其特征是干咳或支气管中看似不动的浓痰积聚。我们发现它对

狗的气管支气管炎（特别是犬舍咳嗽）特别有用，特别是与甘草等抗病毒草药结合使用时。 T. Farfara 制剂

已被证明可以抑制百日咳博德特氏菌（狗窝咳病的一种细菌成分）以及各种其他革兰氏阴性菌菌株，例如

金黄色葡萄球菌、豪氏变形杆菌、铜绿假单胞菌和普通变形杆菌。所有这些使得款冬在多种不同的动物中

可用作呼吸道消毒剂、祛痰剂和止咳剂，而且它具有整体作用。

Many forms of cough suppressants (including wild cherry bark) simply suppress the body’s efforts to heal itself

by acting upon the brain to block the body’s cough response mechanisms. Coltsfoot, on the other hand, gently assists

the body in its efforts to clear invading microbes out of the upper respiratory tract.

许多形式的止咳药（包括野樱桃树皮）只是通过作用于大脑来阻止身体的咳嗽反应机制，从而抑制身体

的自我修复能力。另一方面，款冬会温和地帮助身体清除上呼吸道入侵的微生物。

Glycerin tinctures are the ideal form of administration of this herb. A good starting dosage for most animals is

0.5–1.5 milliliters (or about ⅓ teaspoon) per 20 pounds of an animal’s body weight, two to three times a day.

甘油酊剂是这种草药的理想给药方式。对于大多数动物来说，合适的起始剂量是每 20 磅动物体重 0.5–1.5

毫升（或约 ⅓ 茶匙），每天 2 到 3 次。

Availability: Although coltsfoot is currently under FDA scrutiny and will likely be labeled as “unsafe for internal

use,” the tincture or dried herb remains widely available through herb retailers.

可用性：虽然款冬目前正在接受 FDA 的审查，并且可能会被贴上“内部使用不安全”的标签，但酊剂或干药

草仍然可以通过药草零售商广泛购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Coltsfoot (both Tussilago and Petasites) can be propagated in a garden if given ample

shade and rich, consistently moist, slightly acidic soil. This winter-hardy plant does best in a cool climate.

繁殖和收获：如果提供充足的遮荫和肥沃、持续湿润的微酸性土壤，款冬（Tussilago 和 Petasites）可以在

花园中繁殖。这种耐寒植物在凉爽的气候下生长得最好。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For deep coughs and bronchial congestion, coltsfoot may be combined with mullein,

horehound, licorice, or elecampane. For respiratory infections that are believed to be bacterial or fungal in origin,

coltsfoot can be boosted with echinacea, Oregon grape, bee balm, or thyme. For respiratory viruses, licorice and

echinacea are good adjuncts.

替代品和辅助药物：对于深度咳嗽和支气管充血，款冬可与毛蕊花、苦海草、甘草或土木香结合使用。对

于被认为是细菌或真菌引起的呼吸道感染，可以用紫锥菊、俄勒冈葡萄、蜂香膏或百里香增强款冬的效

果。对于呼吸道病毒，甘草和紫锥菊是很好的辅助剂。

Cautions and Comments: Coltsfoot contains PAs. The PA content of coltsfoot is about one-third of that contained

in comfrey (Symphytum spp.), and most of this compound is contained in the plant’s flowers, not the leaves and

stems. What this means is that the PA content of coltsfoot is really quite low. Nevertheless, it can cause harm if it is

used in absence of common sense. For more on pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs), see “Comfrey.”

=== PAGE 143 ===
注意事项和评论：款冬含有 PA。款冬的 PA 含量约为紫草 (Symphytum spp.) 的三分之一，而且这种化合物

大部分存在于植物的花中，而不是叶和茎中。这说明款冬的PA含量确实很低。然而，如果在缺乏常识的情

况下使用，它可能会造成伤害。有关吡咯里西啶生物碱 (PA) 的更多信息，请参阅“紫草”。

COMFREY

紫草

Symphytum officinale

聚合草

Borage Family

琉璃苣家族

Appearance: Comfrey is a robust plant with coarsely textured, broadly lance-shaped leaves that may exceed a foot

in length at the base of the plant and become progressively smaller toward the top of the plant. The leaves and

hollow stalk of the plant are covered with bristly hairs that tend to irritate human skin. The downy tubular flowers

are presented among the small upper leaves in drooping clusters and are usually a shade of pink or purple but are

sometimes white or pale yellow. Large plants may reach 3 or more feet in height and multiply vigorously by

continuous root division, sometimes forming their own sort of hedgelike clump. Symphytum uplandicum (Russian

comfrey) may grow in excess of 6 feet tall.

外观：紫草是一种健壮的植物，叶子质地粗糙，呈宽矛状，植物基部的长度可能超过一英尺，向植物顶部

逐渐变小。该植物的叶子和空心茎上覆盖着刚毛，会刺激人体皮肤。绒毛管状花以下垂的簇状出现在上部

小叶子中，通常呈粉红色或紫色，但有时呈白色或淡黄色。大型植物的高度可能达到 3 英尺或更高，并通

过连续的根分裂而旺盛地繁殖，有时形成自己的树篱状丛。 Symphytum uplandicum（俄罗斯紫草）可长到

超过 6 英尺高。

Habitat and Range: Over thirty-five species of Symphytum are in cultivation worldwide, most having originated

from Europe and western Asia. In North America, common comfrey (S. officinale) and Russian comfrey (S.

uplandicum) are the most common garden varieties.

栖息地和分布范围：全世界有超过 35 种 Symphytum 品种，其中大多数起源于欧洲和西亚。在北美，普通

紫草（S. officinale）和俄罗斯紫草（S. uplandicum）是最常见的花园品种。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms from early spring to late fall

周期和开花季节：从早春到晚秋开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: All aboveground parts

使用的部件：所有地上部件

Primary Medicinal Activities: Heals wounds; anti-inflammatory; astringent; lubricates, soothes, and protects

internal mucous membranes; expectorant

主要药用活性：治愈伤口；消炎（药;涩;润滑、舒缓和保护内部粘膜；祛痰剂

Strongest Affinities: Skin, digestive tract, respiratory tract

亲和力最强：皮肤、消化道、呼吸道

Preparation: Water or oil infusion, poultice, salve, fomentation

=== PAGE 145 ===
制剂：水或油输液、膏剂、药膏、热敷

Common Uses: Where does one start with an herb that has had such a rich history as a healing device? Comfrey

traditionally has been used for everything from mastitis in goats to cancer in humans. Virtual libraries of scientific

research and anecdotal records have been compiled over the centuries to substantiate, deny, or otherwise argue

comfrey’s value and safety as an herbal medicine. Most of what you may have heard about this plant extends to

animals (especially mammals), including toxicity issues, and almost everyone who has lived around horses, goats,

sheep, llamas, and a comfrey patch knows how valuable this plant is.

常见用途：人们从哪里开始使用一种作为治疗手段有着丰富历史的草药呢？紫草传统上被用于治疗从山羊

乳腺炎到人类癌症的各种疾病。几个世纪以来，科学研究和轶事记录的虚拟图书馆已经被编译出来，以证

实、否认或以其他方式论证紫草作为草药的价值和安全性。您可能听说过的关于这种植物的大部分信息都

适用于动物（尤其是哺乳动物），包括毒性问题，几乎所有生活在马、山羊、绵羊、美洲驼和紫草丛周围

的人都知道这种植物的价值。

Symphytum officinale

聚合草

Comfrey is among the first herbs to consider in the topical treatment of burns, skin ulcerations, abrasions,

lacerations, flea and other insect bites, or just about any other irritation. Likewise, a poultice, salve, or infusion of

the leaves can be applied directly to bruises, fractures, sprains, and other closed-tissue injuries. Most of the healing

effects are attributable to allantoin, a compound that has been shown in several studies to speed cell reproduction,

both inside and outside of the body. In fact, many herbalists have found that comfrey works so well at speed-healing

injuries that it can actually seal bacteria into the site of an open wound. To prevent this from happening, a strong

antibacterial herb such as Oregon grape, thyme, usnea, or Saint-John’s-wort should be added to any comfrey

preparation that is intended for open wounds, especially burns. In addition to its cell-proliferation activity, comfrey’s

mucilaginous nature provides a soothing, lubricating, and protective barrier to the skin and inflammations of the

digestive tract. Comfrey also contains rosmarinic acid and several other compounds that have been shown to

=== PAGE 146 ===
contribute anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and astringent qualities to its list of healing attributes.

紫草是局部治疗烧伤、皮肤溃疡、擦伤、撕裂伤、跳蚤和其他昆虫叮咬或任何其他刺激时首先考虑的草

药之一。同样，药膏、药膏或叶子浸液可以直接应用于瘀伤、骨折、扭伤和其他闭合组织损伤。大部分的

治疗效果都归功于尿囊素，多项研究表明这种化合物可以加速体内和体外的细胞繁殖。事实上，许多草药

医生发现紫草在加速伤口愈合方面效果非常好，甚至可以将细菌密封在开放性伤口的部位。为了防止这种

情况发生，应在任何用于治疗开放性伤口（尤其是烧伤）的紫草制剂中添加强效抗菌草药，例如俄勒冈葡

萄、百里香、松萝或圣约翰草。除了其细胞增殖活性外，紫草的粘液性质还为皮肤和消化道炎症提供了舒

缓、润滑和保护屏障。紫草还含有迷迭香酸和其他几种化合物，这些化合物已被证明具有抗炎、镇痛和收

敛作用，具有治疗功效。

For external treatment of closed injuries, skin ulcers, or mastitis, you can make a poultice or fomentation from the

fresh or dried leaves and apply to the affected area. If you have access to fresh comfrey leaves, wrap a handful in a

clean towel, then place the towel into a bowl of boiling water. Allow it to soak until the water just begins to turn

green, then remove the towel and leaves and squeeze the excess water from the towel back into the bowl. After

allowing the fomentation to cool slightly, apply the warm compress to the affected area. With horses and other large

animals, this might require you to secure the compress onto a swollen limb with a strip of gauze or a clean piece of

fabric torn from some old clothing. Leave the compress on for as long as possible—preferably eight hours or more.

The extra “comfrey tea” that you squeezed back into the bowl can be applied to the compress from time to time and

allowed to soak through to where it is needed. In cases of mastitis or other ailments where a fixed compress is not

practical, an ointment or salve is a better option. If neither of these preparations is available, try making a strong tea

of the leaves (fresh leaves are always superior to dried) and rinsing the entire area with the lukewarm liquid several

times per day.

对于闭合性损伤、皮肤溃疡或乳腺炎的外用治疗，可以用新鲜或干燥的叶子制成膏剂或热敷剂，涂在患

处。如果您有新鲜的紫草叶，请用干净的毛巾包裹一把，然后将毛巾放入一碗沸水中。让它浸泡，直到水

开始变绿，然后取出毛巾和叶子，将毛巾上多余的水挤回碗中。待热敷稍微冷却后，对患处进行热敷。对

于马和其他大型动物，这可能需要您用一条纱布或从旧衣服上撕下的一块干净的织物将敷布固定在肿胀的

四肢上。尽可能长时间地敷布——最好是八小时或更长时间。您可以不时地将多余的“紫草茶”挤回碗中涂

抹到敷料上，并让其渗透到需要的地方。如果出现乳腺炎或其他疾病而无法进行固定敷贴，则软膏或药膏

是更好的选择。如果这些准备工作都没有，请尝试用叶子泡浓茶（新鲜叶子总是优于干叶子），并每天用

微温的液体冲洗整个区域几次。

Internal use of comfrey has become a controversial issue and is strongly discouraged by the FDA, though millions

of people have been using this herb safely and effectively in their animals (and themselves) for centuries. As is true

for many other herbs, the safe use of comfrey is measured by moderation and common sense.

紫草的内部使用已成为一个有争议的问题，并受到 FDA 的强烈反对，尽管数百年来数百万人一直在他们

的动物（和他们自己）中安全有效地使用这种草药。与许多其他草药一样，紫草的安全使用是通过适度和

常识来衡量的。

For treatment of colitis, stomach ulcers, or just about any other inflammation of the digestive tract, a handful of

the fresh leaves or 2–3 ounces of the dried leaves can be fed directly to horses and other large herbivores on a daily

basis for up to two weeks. For dogs and cats, ½–1 teaspoon of the dried herb for each pound of food fed should be of

therapeutic benefit.

为了治疗结肠炎、胃溃疡或任何其他消化道炎症，每天可以将一把新鲜叶子或 2-3 盎司干叶子直接喂给

马和其他大型食草动物，以达到治疗效果。至两周。对于狗和猫来说，每磅食物喂 ½–1 茶匙干草药应该具

有治疗作用。

Comfrey is traditionally used for bronchitis and other respiratory ailments that are relieved by its soothing anti-

inflammatory nature. A cooled tea serves this purpose well. Administer 1 tablespoon per 20 pounds of the animal’s

body weight, twice daily. In all cases of internal use, feeding of comfrey should be limited to occasional short-term

therapies. By no means should comfrey be fed to an animal as a daily food supplement because the plant contains

small cumulative amounts of potentially toxic PAs. For the same reason, highly concentrated preparations such as

tinctures or strong decoctions should not be employed internally.

紫草传统上用于治疗支气管炎和其他呼吸道疾病，其舒缓的抗炎作用可以缓解这些疾病。冷茶可以很好

地达到这个目的。每 20 磅动物体重服用 1 汤匙，每天两次。在所有内部使用的情况下，紫草的喂养应仅限

于偶尔的短期治疗。紫草绝对不应该作为每日食品补充剂饲喂给动物，因为该植物含有少量累积的潜在有

=== PAGE 147 ===
毒 PA。出于同样的原因，不应内服高浓度制剂，例如酊剂或浓汤剂。

Availability: Any nursery that carries herb plants has access to comfrey. The dried herb and various salves,

ointments, and other preparations containing comfrey are available through health food retailers and herb stores.

可用性：任何种植草本植物的苗圃都可以使用紫草。干草药和各种药膏、软膏和其他含有紫草的制剂可通

过保健食品零售商和草药商店购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Comfrey can be easily started from root cuttings. It grows in just about any soil and is

hardy as far north as central Canada. The biggest plants, though, are found in rich, deep, moist soil with a pH level

in the range of 6 to 7.5. Once established, comfrey needs little attention. In fact, its rambunctious growth will amaze

you. We live in an area of Montana that has a scant one hundred-day growing season and winter temperatures that

may plunge to–40°F, yet our comfrey (which grows from beneath the foundation of the house) can be divided into

multiple new starts at least twice per year!

繁殖和收获：紫草可以很容易地从根插条开始。它几乎可以在任何土壤中生长，并且可以耐寒，远至加拿

大中部。然而，最大的植物生长在肥沃、深厚、潮湿、pH 值在 6 至 7.5 之间的土壤中。一旦建立，紫草就

不需要太多关注。事实上，它的狂暴增长会让你大吃一惊。我们生活在蒙大拿州的一个地区，该地区的生

长季节只有短短一百天，冬季气温可能会骤降至零下 40°F，但我们的紫草（从房屋地基下生长）可以分为

多个新的开始每年至少两次！

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For external applications, comfrey combines especially well with calendula,

chamomile, aloe, Saint-John’s-wort, or bee balm. For gastric disorders, comfrey combines with cleavers, calendula,

catnip, or chamomile.

替代品和辅助剂：对于外用，紫草与金盏花、洋甘菊、芦荟、圣约翰草或蜂香膏结合得特别好。对于胃

病，紫草可与菜刀、金盏花、猫薄荷或洋甘菊结合使用。

Cautions and Comments: The issues of toxicity that have haunted comfrey in recent years have become a major

subject of frustration for herbalists, a source of apprehension and political ammunition for opponents of herbal

medicine, and a wealth of misinformation, confusion, and fear for the casual herb user. While the FDA and other

protective agencies are doing their jobs as best they can during a major health care revolution—and it is not our

intent to criticize them—most herbalists agree that comfrey has received an undeserved bad reputation. The FDA

has banned the sale of comfrey for internal use, but in thousands of years of use by millions of people, only two

reports of hepatotoxicity have been documented in humans.

注意和评论：近年来困扰紫草的毒性问题已成为草药学家沮丧的一个主要问题，成为草药反对者的忧虑和

政治弹药的来源，并为人们带来了大量的错误信息、困惑和恐惧。休闲草药使用者。虽然 FDA 和其他保护

机构在一场重大的医疗保健革命中尽了最大努力，我们无意批评他们，但大多数草药医生都认为紫草科植

物受到了不应有的坏名声。 FDA 已禁止销售紫草供内服使用，但在数百万人使用的数千年中，只有两份有

关人类肝毒性的报告记录在案。

Indeed, comfrey contains PAs, which are known to cause liver damage or cancer if ingested in large enough

quantities. Most of the concern surrounding these alkaloids, however, comes from studies or cases where the

alkaloids were isolated from the rest of the plant’s chemistry and then fed or injected into test animals in quantities

or concentrations hundreds of times greater than those that would occur in nature. Common sense dictates that

anything ingested in overabundance is potentially toxic, but given the fact that the PA content in a fresh comfrey

leaf amounts to only about 0.3 percent of its total chemistry, the average horse would need to eat several hundred

pounds of the leaves each day before any toxic effects would be observed! Coffee contains over one dozen

potentially toxic alkaloids—so does chocolate. However, the real threat from PAs comes from the fact that these

alkaloids may accumulate in the body, perhaps to toxic levels, if used continually over a long period. Therefore, if

you plan to use comfrey or any other herb that contains PAs in an internal application, do so with moderation and

only for short periods. Don’t use comfrey in pregnant or lactating animals or in animals with preexisting liver

disease. Also, keep in mind that the PA content of the root is ten times greater than that of the fresh leaves;

=== PAGE 148 ===
therefore, the root shouldn’t be used internally. On the other hand, the PA content of the dried leaves, the form in

which comfrey is most readily available in the marketplace, is practically nil.

事实上，紫草含有 PA，如果摄入足够多，会导致肝损伤或癌症。然而，围绕这些生物碱的大部分担忧来

自于研究或案例，其中生物碱从植物的其余化学成分中分离出来，然后喂食或注射到测试动物体内，其数

量或浓度比自然界中存在的数量或浓度高数百倍。常识表明，任何过量摄入的东西都可能有毒，但考虑到

新鲜紫草叶中的 PA 含量仅占其总化学成分的 0.3% 左右，平均每匹马需要吃掉数百磅的叶子观察到任何毒

性作用的前一天！咖啡含有十多种潜在有毒的生物碱，巧克力也是如此。然而，PA 的真正威胁来自于这样

一个事实：如果长期持续使用，这些生物碱可能会在体内积累，甚至可能达到有毒水平。因此，如果您打

算在内服中使用紫草或任何其他含有 PA 的草药，请适量使用，并且只能短期使用。不要在怀孕或哺乳期动

物或患有肝病的动物中使用紫草。另外，请记住，根部的 PA 含量是新鲜叶子的十倍；因此，根不应该在内

部使用。另一方面，紫草干叶（紫草在市场上最容易买到的形式）的 PA 含量几乎为零。

CORN SILK

玉米须

Zea mays

玉米

Grass Family

草家族

Appearance: We’re sorry if you were expecting something other than the obvious here, but the corn silk we’re

referring to is simply the hairlike pollen-receiving portion of a corn stalk, the part most of us throw away first when

we peel an ear of corn.

外观：如果您期待的不是这里显而易见的东西，我们很抱歉，但我们指的玉米丝只是玉米秆上毛状花粉接

收部分，我们大多数人在剥皮时首先扔掉的部分玉米穗

Habitat and Range: Farms and gardens throughout the world

栖息地和范围：世界各地的农场和花园

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual that blooms in early summer. The “silk” develops just as the plant is

beginning to form cobs.

周期和开花季节：一年生植物，在初夏开花。当植物开始形成穗轴时，“丝”就会发育。

Parts Used: Silk

使用部件：丝绸

Primary Medicinal Activities: Diuretic; lubricates, soothes, and protects internal mucous membranes; anti-

inflammatory, stimulates the liver (cholagogue), astringent

主要药用活性：利尿剂；润滑、舒缓和保护内部粘膜；抗炎、刺激肝脏（利胆）、收敛

Strongest Affinities: Genitourinary tract, including the kidneys

最强的亲和力：泌尿生殖道，包括肾脏

Preparation: A low-alcohol (less than 25 percent alcohol) tincture or an infusion (tea) of the fresh silk is preferable.

The dried silk may be used if it is fresh, but it is not as potent as silk that has been recently pulled from the plant.

制备方法：最好是低度酒精（酒精含量低于25%）酊剂或鲜丝浸剂（茶）。如果干燥的丝是新鲜的，则可

以使用，但它不如最近从植物中拔出的丝有效。

Common Uses: First and foremost, corn silk is indicated wherever chronic inflammation exists in any portion of the

urinary tract or kidneys. It is specifically indicated in FLUTD, where it serves to reduce inflammation without

causing added irritation to the kidneys. Unlike many other diuretic and astringent herbs used to increase urine output

by means of kidney irritation, corn silk does not contain harsh volatile oils that may compound the problems of

=== PAGE 150 ===
inflammatory kidney disease. Therefore, it is useful for improving kidney function during early onset kidney failure

or for helping with the reduction of pain and inflammation in the passing of kidney or bladder stones (especially

when combined with marshmallow). The astringency factor of corn silk is enough to tighten and strengthen the

lining of the bladder and the smooth-muscle tissues of the urinary tract, making the herb useful in some cases of

chronic urinary incontinence, but it is not strong enough to effectively stop acute cases of bleeding or inflammation.

So, corn silk is best remembered as a long-term medicine for chronic urinary problems. Corn silk has been shown to

lower blood pressure and blood sugar levels and to possess cholagogue and diuretic activities in laboratory animals.

All of these activities serve as clues as to why corn silk is especially effective as a general kidney tonic.

常见用途：首先，玉米须适用于泌尿道或肾脏任何部位存在慢性炎症的地方。它特别适用于 FLUTD，它可

以减少炎症而不会对肾脏造成额外的刺激。与许多其他通过刺激肾脏来增加尿量的利尿和收敛草药不同，

玉米须不含可能加剧炎症性肾病问题的刺激性挥发油。因此，它有助于改善早期肾衰竭期间的肾功能，或

有助于减轻肾脏或膀胱结石排出时的疼痛和炎症（特别是与棉花糖结合使用时）。玉米须的收敛因子足以

收紧和强化膀胱内壁和泌尿道的平滑肌组织，使该草药对某些慢性尿失禁病例有用，但其强度不足以有效

阻止急性尿失禁。出血或炎症的情况。因此，玉米须最好作为治疗慢性泌尿问题的长期药物。玉米须已被

证明可以降低实验动物的血压和血糖水平，并具有利胆和利尿活性。所有这些活动都为解释为什么玉米须

作为一般补肾药特别有效提供了线索。

The effectiveness of fresh silk over dried cannot be overstated, and the best methods of administration involve the

direct feeding of the herb in a low-alcohol liquid base (a strong tea is ideal). Dosage is difficult to generalize because

of the variable nature of genitourinary diseases. But a safe starting point is to use 1 milliliter (about 30 drops or so,

or ¼ teaspoon) of the low-alcohol tincture per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily. If the tincture is

alcohol-free, it can be administered directly into the mouth. If not, it should be no more than 25 percent alcohol and

should then be further diluted with at least an equal amount of water.

新鲜蚕丝干燥后的功效怎么强调都不为过，最好的给药方法是直接将草药放入低酒精液体基质中（浓茶

是理想的选择）。由于泌尿生殖系统疾病的性质不同，剂量很难一概而论。但安全的起点是每 20 磅动物体

重使用 1 毫升（约 30 滴左右，或 1/4 茶匙）低酒精酊剂，每天两次。如果酊剂不含酒精，可以直接送入口

中。如果不是，酒精浓度不应超过 25%，然后至少用等量的水进一步稀释。

To make a tea of the fresh silk, chop it as finely as possible, then steep a heaping tablespoon of the herb in near-

boiling water until the mixture cools. After the tea is strained, it can be fed to the animal—¼ cup (if possible) per 20

pounds of body weight, twice daily. Many herbivores enjoy eating corn silk. This is fine, but remember that if you

want to get an optimum amount of the herb into your animal’s urinary tract, it really needs to be administered as a

liquid.

要用新鲜的丝绸泡茶，请将其尽可能切碎，然后将一大汤匙草药浸泡在接近沸水中，直到混合物冷却。

过滤茶后，可以将其喂给动物——每 20 磅体重 1/4 杯（如果可能），每天两次。许多食草动物喜欢吃玉米

须。这很好，但请记住，如果您想让最佳量的草药进入动物的尿道，那么它确实需要以液体形式施用。

Availability: Finding dried corn silk is easy and several manufacturer’s provide extracts of this herb, but if you want

fresh corn silk, you might have to plant some corn in your herb garden. If you have access to organically raised fresh

corn at your local health food store, you can use the silk from this. However, nonorganic sources of corn silk should

be avoided because the silk has likely been sprayed with a pesticide. Corn silk should look fresh, juicy, and colorful.

If it has turned brown, much of its medicinal activity has diminished.

可用性：找到干燥的玉米须很容易，一些制造商提供这种草药的提取物，但如果您想要新鲜的玉米须，您

可能需要在您的药草园里种植一些玉米。如果您可以在当地的健康食品商店买到有机种植的新鲜玉米，则

可以使用其中的玉米丝。然而，应避免使用非有机来源的玉米丝，因为玉米丝可能喷洒了杀虫剂。玉米须

看起来新鲜、多汁、色彩鲜艳。如果它变成棕色，它的大部分药用活性就会减弱。

Propagation and Harvest: Corn is easy to grow, and dozens of varieties are available to suit virtually any set of

growing conditions. (We live at an elevation of 5,500 feet in Montana, and even we can grow corn.) Harvest your

corn before the silk turns brown—usually in early summer. If you want to eat the corn, make sure that it has an

opportunity to receive pollen from the tassels of the plants for at least a week before you harvest, otherwise your

cobs will have no kernels. Plan to use your fresh silk immediately. Cooled corn silk tea can be stored in the

=== PAGE 151 ===
refrigerator for about a week—a glycerin tincture keeps for at least a year if kept refrigerated.

繁殖和收获：玉米很容易种植，有数十种品种可供选择，几乎可以适应任何生长条件。 （我们生活在蒙大

拿州海拔 5,500 英尺的地方，甚至我们也可以种植玉米。）在玉米丝变成棕色之前收获玉米——通常是在初

夏。如果你想吃玉米，请确保在收获前至少一周，它有机会从植物的雄穗中接收花粉，否则你的玉米棒子

将没有玉米粒。计划立即使用你的新鲜丝绸。冷却的玉米须茶可以在冰箱中保存大约一周，而甘油酊剂如

果冷藏则可以保存至少一年。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For chronic urinary tract inflammation, corn silk combines well with couch grass,

calendula, or cleavers. If infection is evident, add echinacea, Oregon grape, yarrow, or thyme. For urinary

incontinence, read about Saint-John’s-wort, ginkgo, and uva ursi. To help pass kidney stones, try a half-and-half

combination of corn silk and marshmallow. For use as a kidney tonic, corn silk combines with marshmallow,

hawthorn, ginkgo, or goldenrod. For use in FLUTD, corn silk combines with couch grass, echinacea, marshmallow,

and horsetail.

替代品和辅助品：对于慢性尿路炎症，玉米须与沙发草、金盏花或切肉刀完美结合。如果感染明显，添加

紫锥花、俄勒冈葡萄、西洋蓍草或百里香。对于尿失禁，请阅读有关圣约翰草、银杏和熊果的信息。为了

帮助排出肾结石，可以尝试将玉米丝和棉花糖混合在一起。作为补肾药，玉米须与棉花糖、山楂、银杏或

黄花结合使用。用于 FLUTD 时，玉米须与茅草、紫锥菊、棉花糖和木贼结合。

Zea mays

玉米

Cautions and Comments: Corn silk is known to be safe, but this herb is actually the pollen-receiving part of the

plant. It stands to reason that animals with pollen allergies may have adverse reactions to corn silk. Corn silk has

been shown to stimulate uterine contractions in rabbits and therefore should be used with caution (if at all) in

pregnant animals.

注意事项和评论：众所周知，玉米须是安全的，但这种草本植物实际上是植物接受花粉的部分。按理说，

=== PAGE 152 ===
花粉过敏的动物可能会对玉米须产生不良反应。玉米须已被证明可以刺激兔子的子宫收缩，因此在怀孕的

动物中应谨慎使用（如果有的话）。

COUCH GRASS

沙发草

Agropyron repens

白草

Grass Family

草家族

Appearance: If you are a gardener, you probably already know, and hate, this plant by the name quack grass. Couch

grass (pronounced “cooch grass” in much of Europe, its native birthplace and medicinal origin) is a profusely

common weed in North America. To the untrained eye, Agropyron repens looks like every other waist-high wild

grass—with perhaps the most distinctive exception displayed by its leaves. Each leaf, or blade, of couch grass looks

as though somebody pinched a crimp in it 1 or 2 inches away from the tip. While this does not serve as a definitive

means of identification, it provides a good point from which you can begin the process of ruling out look-alike

grasses in your area, one species at a time. If you wish to gather this plant for medicinal use, find some samples of

what you think might be couch grass, and then take them to your county extension agent, a botanist, or somebody

else who can identify grasses. Unless you are experienced at using a botanical key (a scientific reference used to

identify plants through recognition of their taxonomic features), identifying couch grass is hit or miss. Fortunately,

the look-alike grasses are not toxic—but they’re probably not medicinal.

外观：如果您是一名园丁，您可能已经知道并且讨厌这种名为嘎嘎草的植物。沙发草（在欧洲大部分地区

发音为“coochgras”，是其诞生地和药用来源）是北美一种非常常见的杂草。对于未经训练的人来说，白草

看起来就像其他齐腰高的野草一样——也许最独特的例外是它的叶子。沙发草的每一片叶子看起来都好像

有人在距尖端一两英寸的地方捏了一个卷曲。虽然这并不是一种确定的识别方法，但它提供了一个很好的

起点，您可以从这里开始排除您所在地区的相似草，一次一个物种。如果您希望采集这种植物用于药用，

请找到一些您认为可能是沙发草的样本，然后将它们带到您所在县的推广代理、植物学家或其他可以识别

草的人处。除非您有使用植物学钥匙（用于通过识别植物的分类特征来识别植物的科学参考）的经验，否

则识别沙发草的成功与失败。幸运的是，这些看起来很像的草没有毒，但它们可能没有药用价值。

Habitat and Range: Couch grass is native to the Mediterranean area. It now makes itself at home virtually

everywhere on earth. In North America, expect to find it in areas where livestock grazing, farming, or other human-

related activities have delivered the seeds.

栖息地和范围：沙发草原产于地中海地区。现在，它几乎在地球上的任何地方都安家落户。在北美，预计

会在牲畜放牧、农业或其他人类相关活动提供种子的地区找到它。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An aggressive perennial that reproduces by seed or spreading rhizomes (horizontally

creeping roots)

周期和开花季节：一种侵略性多年生植物，通过种子或传播根茎（水平匍匐根）繁殖

Parts Used: Rhizomes

使用部位：根茎

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antimicrobial, astringent, anti-inflammatory, mild diuretic

主要药用活性：抗菌、收敛、抗炎、轻度利尿

=== PAGE 154 ===
Strongest Affinities: Urinary tract

最强的亲和力：泌尿道

Preparation: Tincture or decoction of the fresh or freshly dried rhizomes. Use fresh leaves as a dietary supplement.

制备：新鲜或新鲜干燥根茎的酊剂或煎剂。使用新鲜叶子作为膳食补充剂。

Common Uses: Historically, many animal lovers have come to know A. repens as dog grass because dogs, cats, and

other animals love eating the fresh spring leaves of the plant. Our dogs are no exception—we have clumps of dog

grass growing in front of our house, and whenever an opportunity arises (one that doesn’t interfere with a game of

Frisbee), our dogs both actively graze on the plants. It’s interesting to watch how they actually differentiate the

couch grass from other grasses in their intuitive drive to eat the plants. But even more interesting is the way our dogs

instinctively use this plant to fulfill special health care needs. Specifically, they eat couch grass to the point of

vomiting, and while humans may find this somewhat disgusting, an inquisitive herbalist with a holistically oriented

mind can clearly see what the animals are doing. They are either using the grass as a digestive cleansing agent or

they are vomiting so they can reingest their stomach contents. The latter may be indicative of poor nutrient

absorption—eating food twice, in effect, allows for more complete absorption of certain nutrients.

常见用途：历史上，许多动物爱好者都知道白茅草是狗草，因为狗、猫和其他动物喜欢吃这种植物在春天

新鲜的叶子。我们的狗也不例外——我们家门前长着一丛狗草，只要有机会（不妨碍玩飞盘游戏），我们

的狗都会积极地吃这些植物。有趣的是，观察它们如何通过直觉来吃植物，从而将沙发草与其他草区分开

来。但更有趣的是我们的狗本能地使用这种植物来满足特殊的医疗保健需求。具体来说，它们吃沙发草直

到呕吐，虽然人类可能会觉得这有点恶心，但具有整体导向思维的好奇草药师可以清楚地看到动物在做什

么。他们要么使用草作为消化清洁剂，要么通过呕吐来重新摄入胃内容物。后者可能表明营养吸收不良

——实际上，吃两次食物可以更完全地吸收某些营养。

The point is this: if your animal eats grass, the grass is likely to fill a nutritional or medicinal need, and such

activities should not be overlooked when assessing your animal’s holistic health—even if you do wish to look away

and forget about it.

要点是：如果您的动物吃草，草很可能会满足营养或药用需求，并且在评估动物的整体健康状况时不应

忽视此类活动 - 即使您确实希望移开视线并忘记它。

As a food, a patch of couch grass provides grazing animals with a rich source of vitamins A and B, iron, rough

fiber, and silica (for healthy bones, hooves, nails, and coat). But most of the medicinal value of couch grass is

contained within the rhizomes of the plant.

作为一种食物，一片茅草可为放牧动物提供丰富的维生素 A 和 B、铁、粗纤维和二氧化硅（用于健康的

骨骼、蹄子、指甲和皮毛）。但茅草的大部分药用价值都包含在植物的根茎中。

Couch grass serves as an excellent tonic and disinfectant for the urinary tract. It is a soothing, anti-inflammatory

demulcent and saponin-based diuretic with mild antimicrobial activity. Couch grass is considered a specific remedy

for chronic or acute cases of cystitis and urethritis, where the root tea or tincture helps to reduce inflammation,

inhibit bacterial reproduction, and lessen pain during urination. It should be noted that although couch grass has

been shown to possess broad antibiotic activity, it may be too weak to be effective against infections that are already

well established. In such cases, couch grass should be combined with stronger antimicrobial herbs such as

echinacea, thyme, or Oregon grape (or certified organic goldenseal—don’t buy wildcrafted goldenseal because the

plant is at risk of becoming extinct).

沙发草是一种极好的泌尿道滋补剂和消毒剂。它是一种舒缓、抗炎镇静剂和皂苷利尿剂，具有温和的抗

菌活性。沙发草被认为是治疗慢性或急性膀胱炎和尿道炎的特效药，其根茶或酊剂有助于减轻炎症、抑制

细菌繁殖并减轻排尿时的疼痛。应该指出的是，尽管沙发草已被证明具有广泛的抗生素活性，但它可能太

弱而无法有效对抗已经确定的感染。在这种情况下，沙发草应与更强的抗菌草本植物结合使用，如紫锥

菊、百里香或俄勒冈葡萄（或经过认证的有机金毛莲——不要购买野生的金毛莲，因为这种植物有灭绝的

危险）。

=== PAGE 155 ===
As a diuretic, couch grass increases the volume of urine by stimulating sodium excretion, helping to wash away

waste materials from the body via the kidneys. This makes couch grass an effective adjunct to a variety of liver-

supporting, alterative herbs (such as dandelion or burdock), especially in the treatment of rheumatism or chronic

skin problems.

作为一种利尿剂，茅草通过刺激钠排泄来增加尿液量，有助于通过肾脏清除体内的废物。这使得沙发草

成为各种护肝替代草药（例如蒲公英或牛蒡）的有效辅助剂，特别是在治疗风湿病或慢性皮肤问题方面。

The demulcent properties of couch grass soothe inflammation, so it can also be used for kidney stones and gravel.

And because couch grass is gentle on the kidneys and seldom irritates the bladder or urethra during long-term use, it

is a primary herb to consider when treating the symptoms of FLUTD in cats, a condition that is usually due to

factors other than infection.

茅草的镇痛特性可以缓解炎症，因此它也可用于治疗肾结石和碎石。由于沙发草对肾脏温和，长期使用

时很少刺激膀胱或尿道，因此它是治疗猫 FLUTD 症状时要考虑的主要草药，这种疾病通常是由感染以外的

因素引起的。

For use in urinary problems, the best way to administer this herb is in the form of a cooled decoction. Make the

decoction by gently simmering a heaping teaspoon of the chopped dried root, or 2 heaping teaspoons of the chopped

fresh root (rhizomes), in 8 ounces of water for about twenty minutes. The decoction can be squirted directly into the

animal’s mouth. A safe starting dose is about a ½ teaspoon (2–3 milliliters) per 20 pounds of the animal’s body

weight, two to three times daily. If direct administration is too difficult, the dose can be added to the animal’s

drinking water. Try to figure out how much your animal drinks, then add enough couch grass to meet dosing

requirements. Glycerin or alcohol tinctures can be used at half the above dosage and are best if diluted into water.

Keep in mind that this is a subtle herbal medicine—the needs and systemic requirements of the animal you are

helping may require several increases in dosage over several days or weeks of administration.

对于泌尿系统问题，服用这种草药的最佳方法是以冷却汤剂的形式。将一茶匙切碎的干根或两茶匙切碎

的新鲜根（根茎）放入 8 盎司水中，轻轻煮约二十分钟，制成汤剂。汤剂可以直接喷入动物的嘴里。安全

的起始剂量约为每 20 磅动物体重 1/2 茶匙（2-3 毫升），每天 2-3 次。如果直接给药太困难，可以将剂量添

加到动物的饮用水中。尝试计算出您的动物喝了多少水，然后添加足够的沙发草以满足剂量要求。甘油或

酒精酊剂的用量可以是上述剂量的一半，最好用水稀释。请记住，这是一种微妙的草药 - 您正在帮助的动

物的需求和系统要求可能需要在几天或几周的给药时间内多次增加剂量。

Agropyron repens

白草

Availability: Couch grass is not a popular herb in the U.S. (although it is popular in Europe), and some of the dried

rhizomes that you find in herb stores are on the verge of becoming useless dust. Fortunately, it grows everywhere.

The only problem is identifying it among other weeds and finding the physical stamina to dig up the stubborn

rhizomes. If you meet these criteria, you can easily become a garden hero in your neighborhood. (On the other hand,

everyone may think you’re nuts for actually wanting the weed.) The golden rule: Beware of pesticides. Finding

“clean” couch grass is often difficult.

可用性：沙发草在美国并不是一种受欢迎的药草（尽管它在欧洲很受欢迎），并且您在药草商店中找到的

一些干燥根茎即将成为无用的灰尘。幸运的是，它到处都有生长。唯一的问题是如何将其与其他杂草区分

开来，并找到足够的体力来挖出顽固的根茎。如果您满足这些标准，您就可以轻松成为附近的花园英雄。

（另一方面，每个人都可能认为你真的想要大麻而疯了。）黄金法则：小心杀虫剂。找到“干净”的沙发草

通常很困难。

Propagation and Harvest: As far as propagating couch grass is concerned, go ahead if you don’t mind sacrificing

the engine on your tiller and if you don’t care if the plant strangles the rest of your garden. The rhizomes can be

harvested anytime throughout the growth season but are usually strongest when dug up in the fall. The best

medicines are made from the fresh rhizomes, but dried roots are useful, too, if used within a year of digging.

繁殖和收获：就繁殖沙发草而言，如果您不介意牺牲耕耘机上的发动机并且不关心植物是否会扼杀花园的

其他部分，请继续。根茎可以在整个生长季节的任何时候收获，但通常在秋季挖出时最强。最好的药物是

用新鲜的根茎制成的，但如果在挖掘后一年内使用，干燥的根也很有用。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For urinary inflammations that are secondary to infection, combine with Oregon grape,

organically raised goldenseal, thyme, or echinacea. For stones or any other cause of urinary tract inflammation,

marshmallow, corn silk, and plantain are valuable adjuncts. If blood is present in the urine, see your holistic

=== PAGE 157 ===
veterinarian—your pet needs stronger measures than couch grass.

替代品和辅助剂：对于感染继发的泌尿道炎症，可与俄勒冈葡萄、有机饲养的白毛茛、百里香或紫锥菊结

合使用。对于结石或任何其他引起尿路炎症的原因，棉花糖、玉米须和车前草都是有价值的辅助剂。如果

尿液中出现血液，请咨询您的整体兽医——您的宠物需要采取比沙发草更强有力的措施。

Cautions and Comments: No toxicity has been noted for couch grass, although excessive amounts may lead to

vomiting or diarrhea. Always be careful about verifying the cleanliness of the sources of this herb—it is on just

about everybody’s “noxious weed” list, and pesticide residues can remain with the plant for several years.

注意事项和评论：尽管过量可能会导致呕吐或腹泻，但尚未发现沙发草具有毒性。一定要小心验证这种草

药来源的清洁度——它几乎被列在每个人的“有毒杂草”名单上，而且农药残留可能会在植物中残留数年。

DANDELION

蒲公英

Taraxacum officinale

蒲公英

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: It’s time for all good herbalists to put their egos aside. Dandelion is actually confused with several

other species of the sunflower family, and although we may hate to admit it, many of us have been fooled into using

one of the look-alikes. The primary consideration to bear in mind when identifying Taraxacum officinale or any of

its hundreds of variations is this: Dandelion has no branching characteristics but instead grows in a rosette fashion

directly off of its taproot. And dandelion never has spines on its midrib as does Lactuca serriola (prickly lettuce),

which otherwise looks similar to dandelion when young. Although dandelion impostors likely won’t harm you, they

won’t offer you dandelion’s benefits, either.

外观：现在是所有优秀草药师放下自负的时候了。蒲公英实际上与向日葵家族的其他几种物种混淆了，尽

管我们可能不愿意承认这一点，但我们中的许多人都被愚弄了，使用了其中一种看起来很相似的植物。在

识别蒲公英或其数百种变种时要记住的主要考虑因素是：蒲公英没有分枝特征，而是直接从主根上以莲座

状生长。蒲公英的中脉上从来没有像生菜（Lactuca serriola）那样的刺，它在其他方面与蒲公英年轻时看起

来很相似。尽管蒲公英冒名顶替者可能不会伤害您，但他们也不会为您提供蒲公英的好处。

Habitat and Range: A native of Europe and Asia, dandelion has found its way onto every continent—except

maybe Antarctica.

栖息地和分布范围：蒲公英原产于欧洲和亚洲，现已遍布各大洲——也许除了南极洲。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Dandelion is a perennial that may bloom several times throughout the year. In areas

where there is severe winter climate, dandelion may appear only as a free-seeding annual.

周期和开花季节：蒲公英是多年生植物，一年中可能多次开花。在冬季气候严酷的地区，蒲公英可能只能

作为一年生植物自由播种。

Parts Used: All parts of the plant are useful for various applications.

使用的部件：设备的所有部件都可用于各种应用。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Diuretic, stimulates the liver, stimulates salivation and improves digestion (bitter),

nutritive, laxative, anti-inflammatory, tonic

主要药用活性： 利尿、刺激肝脏、刺激唾液分泌和改善消化（苦味）、营养、通便、抗炎、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Liver, gallbladder, gastrointestinal tract

亲和力最强：肝脏、胆囊、胃肠道

Preparation: Water infusion, decoction, tincture, fresh or dried leaves and flowers

制剂：水浸剂、汤剂、酊剂、新鲜或干燥的叶和花

=== PAGE 159 ===
Common Uses: To begin an accurate assessment of dandelion’s deep-reaching medicinal attributes, we must first

put healing into a whole-body perspective. All higher organisms (including dogs, cats, birds, mice, lizards, goats,

and humans) maintain vital body functions within tightly knit parameters of systemic cooperation. A precise and

balanced relationship between nutrition and elimination of waste is a critical part of this cooperation. If a systemic

excess or deficiency occurs that the body cannot correct through elimination, supplementation, or immune system

intervention, it will try to compensate by shutting down a system or storing waste materials wherever it can. In other

words, a state of “dis-ease” results. Enter the dandelion.

常见用途：要开始准确评估蒲公英的深远药用价值，我们必须首先从全身的角度来看待治疗。所有高等生

物（包括狗、猫、鸟类、小鼠、蜥蜴、山羊和人类）都在紧密结合的系统合作参数下维持重要的身体功

能。营养与消除废物之间精确平衡的关系是这种合作的关键部分。如果发生系统性过剩或缺乏，身体无法

通过消除、补充或免疫系统干预来纠正，它会尝试通过关闭系统或尽可能储存废物来进行补偿。换句话

说，结果就是一种“不安”的状态。输入蒲公英。

Dandelion is one of the most complete plant foods on earth. A 1-cup serving of fresh dandelion greens provides as

much as 2,000 international units (IU) of vitamin A (one and a half times the recommended daily allowance [RDA]

for an adult human); 20 percent protein (by content, that’s double what spinach provides); vitamins C, K, D, and B

complex; iron, manganese, phosphorus, and many other trace minerals; and an especially rich supply of potassium.

All of these vital nutrients are conveniently contained within a single source in quantities that the body can fully

absorb. This means that dandelion can gently supplement a diet without overworking the liver and kidneys with

excess vitamins and minerals (which is often signified by dark urine).

蒲公英是地球上最完整的植物性食品之一。 1 杯新鲜蒲公英绿叶蔬菜可提供多达 2,000 国际单位 (IU) 的

维生素 A（成人建议每日摄入量 [RDA] 的一倍半）； 20% 蛋白质（按含量计算，是菠菜的两倍）；复合维

生素 C、K、D 和 B；铁、锰、磷和许多其他微量矿物质；以及特别丰富的钾供应。所有这些重要的营养素

都方便地包含在单一来源中，其数量可以被人体充分吸收。这意味着蒲公英可以温和地补充饮食，而不会

因为过量的维生素和矿物质（这通常以深色尿液为标志）而使肝脏和肾脏过度劳累。

Supplementing your companion animal’s diet with dandelion leaf is as simple as drying the greens and crumbling

them onto her food. If your animal doesn’t like eating dandelion or if you need to get nutrients into her more

quickly, try making a leaf tea using organic unsalted vegetable or meat broth in place of plain water. Plan on feeding

about 1 teaspoon of the dried herb for each 20 pounds of body weight daily. Horses, llamas, sheep, goats, mules, and

other large animals often eat the greens directly out of their pastures. If they don’t, try hand feeding the greens to

them or adding a little molasses. If your animal is sensitive to changes in diet, then start her off with a small amount

of dandelion at a time.

用蒲公英叶补充伴侣动物的饮食非常简单，只需将绿色蔬菜晒干并将其粉碎到她的食物上即可。如果您

的动物不喜欢吃蒲公英，或者您需要更快地为她提供营养，请尝试使用有机无盐蔬菜或肉汤代替白开水制

作叶茶。计划每天每 20 磅体重喂食约 1 茶匙干草药。马、美洲驼、绵羊、山羊、骡子和其他大型动物经常

直接吃牧场上的蔬菜。如果他们不这样做，请尝试用手喂他们蔬菜或添加一点糖蜜。如果您的动物对饮食

变化很敏感，那么开始时一次给她少量的蒲公英。

Taraxacum officinale

蒲公英

In addition to providing your animal with many of the nutrients she needs, the leaves have what herbalists call a

bitter tonic effect: the body’s metabolism is “warmed up” before the digestive system is forced to go to work. When

a small amount of a bitter herb is taken into the mouth, the recipient immediately experiences a sudden increase in

salivation. As the bitter herb reaches the stomach, bile and other digestive agents are then triggered into production.

The result is more efficient digestion, reduced indigestion, better absorption of nutrients, and increased appetite.

Dandelion leaf is particularly useful in animals who have a chronic problem with indigestion. If your animal has

frequent gas or passes food that does not appear digested, get her to chew a fresh dandelion leaf while you

reconsider her diet, or apply a few drops of dandelion tincture (an herbal glycerite is most palatable) onto her

tongue. It does not matter if the animal doesn’t appear to swallow it; the bitter tonic action is triggered in the mouth.

除了为动物提供所需的许多营养之外，叶子还具有草药学家所说的苦味滋补作用：在消化系统被迫开始

工作之前，身体的新陈代谢会“预热”。当少量苦味药草放入口中时，接受者立即会感到唾液突然增加。当

苦味药草到达胃部时，胆汁和其他消化剂就会被触发产生。其结果是更有效的消化，减少消化不良，更好

地吸收营养，并增加食欲。蒲公英叶对于患有慢性消化不良问题的动物特别有用。如果您的动物经常放屁

或排出未消化的食物，请在您重新考虑她的饮食的同时让她咀嚼新鲜的蒲公英叶，或者在她的舌头上滴几

滴蒲公英酊剂（一种草药甘油是最美味的）。即使动物看起来没有吞下它也没关系；苦味的滋补作用在口

腔中触发。

Dandelion is well known among herbalists as a safe but powerful diuretic and liver stimulant. Congestive heart

failure, pulmonary edema, arthritis, gallbladder disease, and kidney stones are all imbalances resulting from the

body’s inability to eliminate water or accumulated excesses. In mainstream practices, drugs such as furosemide are

often used to drain off excess fluid from the body and thus promote the elimination of accumulated waste materials.

Pharmaceutical diuretics are fast acting, easy to administer, and effective, but while they do a great job at expelling

fluid, they tend not to discriminate between what the body needs to keep and what it needs to lose. As a result, the

body often loses too much potassium, a crucial heart and brain nutrient, through urination. In this event, potassium

must be supplemented throughout the therapy. Dandelion leaf, on the other hand, contains its own rich source of

fully assimilable potassium, an attribute that helps to replace what would otherwise be lost through urination.

=== PAGE 161 ===
蒲公英在草药学家中被认为是一种安全而强大的利尿剂和肝脏兴奋剂。充血性心力衰竭、肺水肿、关节

炎、胆囊疾病和肾结石都是由于身体无法排除水分或积聚过量水分而导致的失衡。在主流实践中，经常使

用速尿等药物排出体内多余的液体，从而促进消除累积的废物。药物利尿剂起效快、易于给药且有效，但

虽然它们在排出液体方面做得很好，但它们往往无法区分身体需要保留的东西和需要失去的东西。结果，

身体经常通过排尿失去过多的钾，钾是心脏和大脑的重要营养素。在这种情况下，必须在整个治疗过程中

补充钾。另一方面，蒲公英叶含有丰富的完全可同化钾，这种特性有助于补充通过排尿流失的钾。

How effective is dandelion as a diuretic? Many contemporary herbalists claim that dandelion may be as effective

as the aforementioned furosemide. The big trade-offs, though, are ease of administration, getting enough of the tea

into the animal to bring about desired effects, and the time that it may take for dandelion to start working. While

furosemide can be administered in a little pill, a dandelion therapy involves getting your animal to drink warm tea or

take a tincture extract (the broth method works nicely). None of this is meant to encourage you to stop the diuretic

therapy prescribed by your veterinarian. If you wish to seek the dandelion alternative, see a holistic veterinarian first.

蒲公英作为利尿剂有多有效？许多当代草药学家声称蒲公英可能与前面提到的呋塞米一样有效。然而，

最大的代价是易于管理、让足够的茶进入动物体内以产生预期的效果，以及蒲公英开始发挥作用所需的时

间。虽然速尿可以以小药丸的形式服用，但蒲公英疗法需要让你的动物喝温茶或服用酊剂提取物（肉汤法

效果很好）。这些都不是为了鼓励您停止兽医开出的利尿疗法。如果您想寻求蒲公英的替代品，请先去看

整体兽医。

While dandelion leaves are nutritive and diuretic, the root possesses its own usefulness as a safe, reliable liver

tonic. The liver is the primary filtering organ of the body; it is responsible for removing toxins and excesses from the

blood for elimination via the kidneys. The liver also plays critical roles in digestion through its production of bile,

bilirubin, and various enzymes. If bile ducts in the liver or gallbladder become congested, blocked, or otherwise

diseased to the point of dysfunction, the body invariably suffers one or more toxicity-related imbalances. Such

imbalances may be characterized by symptoms such as jaundice, rheumatoid conditions, eczema, dandruff, or

chronic constipation. And while dandelion leaf tea or tincture may do much toward relieving the symptoms of such

conditions through a nutritive and diuretic action, the root will have more effect on the underlying causes.

蒲公英叶具有营养和利尿作用，而其根也具有作为安全、可靠的肝脏滋补品的用途。肝脏是身体的主要

过滤器官；它负责清除血液中的毒素和多余物质，并通过肾脏消除。肝脏还通过产生胆汁、胆红素和各种

酶在消化中发挥关键作用。如果肝脏或胆囊中的胆管充血、阻塞或以其他方式患病达到功能障碍的程度，

身体总是会遭受一种或多种与毒性相关的失衡。这种失衡的特征可能是黄疸、类风湿病、湿疹、头皮屑或

慢性便秘等症状。虽然蒲公英叶茶或酊剂可能通过营养和利尿作用在缓解此类疾病的症状方面发挥很大作

用，但其根部对根本原因的作用更大。

Dandelion root has a well-validated ability to stimulate bile production and circulation throughout the liver. In one

study involving dogs, researchers observed a three to four times increase in bile production after administration of

dandelion root. The gallbladder, which stores bile from the liver, is also stimulated, causing this small, hollow organ

to contract and release bile into the digestive tract, thus aiding in digestion and acting as a gentle laxative to promote

the elimination of solid waste.

蒲公英根具有经过充分验证的刺激胆汁产生和整个肝脏循环的能力。在一项涉及狗的研究中，研究人员

观察到服用蒲公英根后胆汁分泌量增加了三到四倍。储存来自肝脏的胆汁的胆囊也会受到刺激，导致这个

小的中空器官收缩并将胆汁释放到消化道中，从而帮助消化并充当温和的泻药以促进固体废物的消除。

One of the best features about dandelion root as a liver and gallbladder stimulant is its gentle nature. Unlike many

cholagogue herbs, dandelion does not further irritate an already inflamed condition. In fact, in clinical studies using

an over-the-counter preparation of the root, dandelion was shown to be effective in treating inflammatory diseases of

the liver and gallbladder, including gallstones.

蒲公英根作为肝脏和胆囊兴奋剂的最佳特点之一是其温和的性质。与许多利胆草药不同，蒲公英不会进

一步刺激已经发炎的部位。事实上，在使用蒲公英根的非处方制剂进行的临床研究中，蒲公英被证明可以

有效治疗肝脏和胆囊的炎症性疾病，包括胆结石。

The flowers of dandelion are known by herbalists to be high in lecithin and to have weak but useful analgesic

qualities. Their usefulness as a pain reliever stems from the fact that they don’t contain any salicylates, the alkaloid

compounds found in aspirin that are toxic to cats and may be irritating to the stomach lining. To use the flowers,

infuse a generous handful in a cup of near-boiling water. When the water has darkened as much as possible, it can be

cooled and administered with a dropper: 30–40 drops per 20 pounds of body weight. If this proves to be too difficult

=== PAGE 162 ===
for you and your animal, try drying the flowers and sprinkling them on her food. You shouldn’t expect aspirin-like

effectiveness, but this is a mild painkilling option worth considering.

草药学家知道蒲公英花的卵磷脂含量很高，并且具有微弱但有用的镇痛功效。它们作为止痛药的用途源

于它们不含任何水杨酸盐，这是阿司匹林中发现的生物碱化合物，对猫有毒，可能会刺激胃壁。要使用这

些花，请将大量的花朵注入一杯近沸水中。当水颜色尽可能变深时，可以将其冷却并用滴管给药：每 20 磅

体重 30-40 滴。如果这对您和您的动物来说太困难，请尝试将花晒干并将其撒在她的食物上。你不应该期

望它有像阿司匹林一样的功效，但这是一种值得考虑的温和止痛选择。

Dandelion is perhaps the first herb to consider when optimized digestion and waste elimination is a necessary part

of an herbal therapy. In holistic healing, the body, whether it be human or another kind of animal, should not be

viewed as a collection of individual body systems but as an intricately balanced cooperation of relative components.

From this perspective, it is easy to see how dandelion can serve a positive role in its effort to help the body at what it

is designed to do—stay healthy. The body cannot achieve this goal unless it is able to effectively utilize nutrients

and eliminate waste—and dandelion is here to help.

当优化消化和消除废物是草药疗法的必要组成部分时，蒲公英可能是第一个考虑的草药。在整体治疗

中，身体，无论是人类还是其他动物，不应被视为个体身体系统的集合，而应被视为相关组成部分错综复

杂的平衡合作。从这个角度来看，很容易看出蒲公英如何发挥积极作用，帮助身体实现其应有的目标——

保持健康。除非身体能够有效利用营养并消除废物，否则无法实现这一目标，而蒲公英可以提供帮助。

Availability: Everywhere!

可用性：无处不在！

Propagation and Harvest: If you wish to propagate dandelion (no, we’re not insane), give the plants deep humus-

rich soil and full sun. Gather dandelion greens for use in salads in early spring—they get bitter with age. Leaves

intended for herbal teas and medicines can be gathered anytime in dry weather. Wet dandelion leaves tend to

develop mold while they are drying, so don’t wash them after picking. Shake them off and dry them on newspapers

in a well-ventilated area, away from light. Then stir them often to prevent molding and store them in plastic bags

only after they are completely crispy dry. Gather the roots as late in fall as possible; this is when they contain the

greatest concentration of beneficial constituents. Chop them up (we use a food processor), then spread them onto

newspaper and dry with the same consideration you gave to the leaves.

繁殖和收获：如果您想繁殖蒲公英（不，我们没有疯），请为植物提供深厚的富含腐殖质的土壤和充足的

阳光。在早春收集蒲公英叶用于沙拉——随着时间的推移它们会变得苦涩。用于花草茶和药物的叶子可以

在干燥的天气里随时采集。湿的蒲公英叶子在干燥时容易发霉，所以采摘后不要清洗。将它们抖落并放在

报纸上晾干，放在通风良好、避光的地方。然后经常搅拌以防止发霉，待完全酥脆干燥后才将其存放在塑

料袋中。秋天尽可能晚地收集根部；这是它们含有最大浓度的有益成分的时候。将它们切碎（我们使用食

品加工机），然后将它们铺在报纸上并以与叶子相同的方式干燥。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For liver and digestive problems, consider milk thistle, burdock, yellow dock,

marshmallow, chickweed, and Oregon grape as possible adjuncts or alternatives.

替代品和辅助品：对于肝脏和消化问题，可以考虑将奶蓟草、牛蒡、黄坞、棉花糖、繁缕和俄勒冈葡萄作

为可能的辅助品或替代品。

Cautions and Comments: The first and foremost consideration in using dandelion as food or medicine is the

cleanliness of the plants you are using. Always make sure that the greens you are feeding have never been sprayed

with herbicide. If they ever have, don’t try washing them. Move on to another patch. You won’t have trouble finding

more.

注意事项和评论：使用蒲公英作为食品或药物时首要考虑的是您所使用的植物的清洁度。始终确保您喂的

蔬菜从未喷洒过除草剂。如果有的话，不要尝试清洗它们。转到另一个补丁。您不会有困难找到更多。

DILL

莳萝

Anethum graveolens

香叶草

Parsley Family

欧芹家族

Appearance: A healthy dill plant is an attractive addition to any herb garden. Plants may reach 6 feet in height. The

dark green finely divided leaves have a delicate feathery appearance, and the yellow umbel (umbrella-like) flowers

are attractive to bees. The entire plant is distinctively aromatic and delicious—just brushing past one can make your

mouth water!

外观：健康的莳萝植物对于任何药草园来说都是有吸引力的补充。植物高度可达 6 英尺。深绿色的细裂叶

子具有精致的羽毛状外观，黄色的伞状花对蜜蜂有吸引力。整株植物香气独特，味道鲜美，一粒擦过就让

人垂涎欲滴！

Habitat and Range: Originally a native of southeast Europe and southwest Asia, dill is a common resident in herb

gardens worldwide.

栖息地和分布范围：莳萝原产于东南欧和西南亚，是世界各地药草园的常见居民。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual that blooms in early to midsummer, dill is successful at reproducing from the

copious quantities of viable seed it produces shortly after blooming.

周期和开花季节：莳萝是一种在初夏至仲夏开花的一年生植物，开花后不久就会产生大量有活力的种子，

能够成功地进行繁殖。

Parts Used: Foliage, flowers, and seeds

使用部分：叶子、花和种子

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expels intestinal gas, soothes the stomach (stomachic), stimulates milk production,

antibacterial, diuretic

主要药用活性： 排出肠道气体，舒缓胃（胃），刺激产奶，抗菌，利尿

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract

最强的亲和力：消化道

Preparation: Feeding of the fresh or dried herb, tea, tincture, poultice

准备：喂食新鲜或干燥的药草、茶、酊剂、膏剂

Common Uses: Dill is good for relieving nausea and flatulence, especially when these maladies are secondary to a

sudden change in diet—such as when your puppy decides to steal a tamale from your foolishly unattended dinner

=== PAGE 164 ===
plate. The effectiveness of dill in this capacity is largely attributable to the plant’s numerous volatile oil constituents,

which combine to cause an antifoaming action in the stomach, like many over-the-counter antigas remedies. The

highest concentrations of these oils are held within the seeds of the plant, but the dried leaves and stems (the herb

you likely have in the kitchen) can be used too. If your dog is belching something that is suspiciously reminiscent of

what was supposed to be your dinner and the problem appears to be getting progressively worse, try direct-feeding

2–8 ounces of cooled dill seed tea (1 teaspoon of dill seed to 8 ounces of water) to the animal. If your animal doesn’t

like the flavor, try adding the tea to her drinking water—or, if need be, disguise it as “yummy people food” by

making the tea with some clear, unsalted broth instead of water. If belching, bloating, or other forms of indigestion

are a problem after every feeding, call a holistic veterinarian and reassess your animal’s diet. Think holistically—a

sprinkling of ground dill seed on your pet’s food may bring about symptomatic relief, but if the condition is

ongoing, a deeper problem needs to be addressed.

常见用途：莳萝有助于缓解恶心和胀气，尤其是当这些疾病是由于饮食突然改变而继发时，例如当您的小

狗决定从您愚蠢的无人看管的餐盘中偷走玉米粉蒸肉时。莳萝的这种功效很大程度上归功于该植物中的大

量挥发油成分，这些成分结合在一起会在胃中产生消泡作用，就像许多非处方抗胃气药物一样。这些油的

最高浓度存在于植物的种子中，但也可以使用干燥的叶子和茎（厨房里可能有的药草）。如果您的狗打嗝

的东西可疑地让人想起您应该吃的晚餐，并且问题似乎越来越严重，请尝试直接喂食 2-8 盎司冷却的莳萝

籽茶（1 茶匙莳萝籽到 8 盎司）水）给动物。如果你的动物不喜欢这种味道，可以尝试将茶添加到她的饮用

水中，或者，如果需要的话，用一些清澈的、无盐的肉汤代替水来泡茶，将其伪装成“美味的人类食物”。

如果每次喂食后出现打嗝、腹胀或其他形式的消化不良问题，请致电整体兽医并重新评估您的动物的饮

食。从整体上考虑——在宠物的食物上撒上磨碎的莳萝籽可能会缓解症状，但如果这种情况持续存在，则

需要解决更深层次的问题。

In addition to providing relief from excess gas, dill also possesses antibacterial qualities that are strong enough to

inhibit bacterial reproduction in the mouth but too weak to compromise beneficial microbes deeper in the digestive

tract. This makes dill useful for treating halitosis and the early onset of gingivitis in dogs and cats. The herb or seeds

can be infused and added to drinking water, or a poultice or glycerin tincture can be swabbed on the animal’s gum

line two or three times daily.

除了缓解多余气体外，莳萝还具有抗菌特性，其强度足以抑制口腔中的细菌繁殖，但又不足以损害消化

道深处的有益微生物。这使得莳萝可用于治疗狗和猫的口臭和早期牙龈炎。可以将草药或种子浸泡并添加

到饮用水中，或者可以将药膏或甘油酊剂擦拭在动物的牙龈线上，每天两到三次。

Dill is useful for treating mild to moderate cases of colic. If they will take it, horses and other large herbivores can

be fed the seeds or even the entire fresh plant—as much as they need.

莳萝可用于治疗轻度至中度绞痛。如果他们愿意的话，马和其他大型食草动物就可以根据需要喂食种子

甚至整个新鲜植物。

Dill seed contains carvone, anethofuran, and limonene, volatile oils that have been shown to increase the

production of cancer-fighting enzymes (namely, glutathione s-transferase, or GST) in the body. These enzymes react

with certain types of carcinogenic chemicals, eliminating them from the system. While this in itself represents only a

small measure of cancer prevention, it makes dill another medicinal food to consider when custom-tailoring your

animal’s diet plan. While dill contains limonene, a substance known to repel fleas, its presence is not large enough

to be of use by itself.

莳萝籽含有香芹酮、茴香呋喃和柠檬烯，这些挥发油已被证明可以增加体内抗癌酶（即谷胱甘肽 s-转移

酶，或 GST）的产生。这些酶与某些类型的致癌化学物质发生反应，将其从系统中消除。虽然这本身只代

表了预防癌症的一小部分，但它使莳萝成为在定制动物饮食计划时值得考虑的另一种药用食品。虽然莳萝

含有柠檬烯，一种已知可以驱除跳蚤的物质，但它的存在量不足以单独使用。

The carvone that dill contains, however, is believed to increase the effectiveness of various other natural

insecticides (such as those contained in feverfew or oxeye daisy), making dill a useful adjunct in the never-ending

battle against fleas. Dill has a folkloric reputation as a substance that stimulates the production of milk in nursing

mothers.

然而，莳萝所含的香芹酮被认为可以提高各种其他天然杀虫剂（例如小白菊或牛眼菊中所含的杀虫剂）

的效力，使莳萝成为与跳蚤永无休止的战斗中的有用辅助剂。莳萝在民间享有盛誉，因为它是一种刺激哺

乳母亲产奶的物质。

=== PAGE 165 ===
Availability: The grocery store or your favorite nursery

可用性：杂货店或您最喜欢的托儿所

Propagation and Harvest: Dill is easy to grow from seed or starts and can be seeded in fall for an early spring

harvest in areas where winters are harsh. In areas where the growing season is long but not too hot, a continuous

self-seeding crop of dill is not only possible but perhaps inevitable. Harvest the leaves and flowers when they are

lush and aromatic, the seeds shortly after they have turned brown, before they begin to fall to the ground. This is

best accomplished by clipping off the entire umbel, then shaking the seeds into a paper bag.

繁殖和收获：莳萝很容易从种子或开始生长，可以在秋季播种，以便在冬季严酷的地区早春收获。在生长

季节长但不太热的地区，莳萝连续自播种不仅是可能的，而且可能是不可避免的。当叶子和花朵茂盛且芳

香四溢时收获，种子在它们变成棕色后不久、在开始掉落地面之前收获。最好的方法是剪掉整个伞形花

序，然后将种子摇晃到纸袋中。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For gas and other digestive problems, dill combines with fennel, parsley seed, or

catnip. For infections of the mouth, Oregon grape, sage, and thyme are stronger options. For bad breath, a

combination of parsley, dill, and peppermint makes an excellent formula. For fleas, try making a skin and coat rinse

by combining dill, feverfew flowers, and yarrow into a tea.

替代品和辅助剂：对于胀气和其他消化问题，莳萝与茴香、欧芹籽或猫薄荷结合使用。对于口腔感染，俄

勒冈葡萄、鼠尾草和百里香是更好的选择。对于口臭，欧芹、莳萝和薄荷的组合是一个很好的配方。对于

跳蚤，可以尝试将莳萝、小白菊花和西洋蓍草混合到茶中来冲洗皮肤和皮毛。

Anethum graveolens

香叶草

=== PAGE 166 ===
Cautions and Comments: Dill is safe but because of its volatile oil constituents, dill should be used conservatively

in pregnant or lactating animals.

注意事项和评论：莳萝是安全的，但由于其挥发油成分，莳萝在怀孕或哺乳期动物中应保守使用。
