ECHINACEA

紫锥菊

Echinacea spp.

紫锥菊属

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Echinacea, also known as purple, pink, or white coneflower, is a taprooted perennial that may grow as

high as 40 inches. Nine species of Echinacea are native to North America; all have flowers with distinctive conelike

central disks, with the most common species ranging in color from pale to dark purple. The rays of most species

droop away from the disk when mature. Echinacea purpurea (see photo) is by far the most widely distributed

species in North America. For several decades, this species has been popular as a medicinal herb and garden flower.

Dozens of varieties of E. purpurea have been developed, and it is estimated that the entire world market supply of

this species comes from cultivated plants. Several other species, however, such as E. angustifolia and E. pallida are

quickly succumbing to commercial and environmental pressures.

外观：紫锥菊，也称为紫色、粉色或白色金光菊，是一种直根多年生植物，可长至 40 英寸高。九种紫锥菊

原产于北美；它们的花都有独特的圆锥形中央花盘，最常见的品种颜色从浅紫色到深紫色不等。大多数物

种的射线在成熟时会从圆盘下垂。紫锥菊（见照片）是迄今为止北美分布最广泛的物种。几十年来，该物

种一直作为药草和园林花卉而广受欢迎。已开发出数十个 E. purpurea 品种，估计该品种的整个世界市场供

应均来自栽培植物。然而，其他几种物种，例如 E. angustifolia 和 E. pallida，很快就屈服于商业和环境压

力。

Habitat and Range: In the West, echinacea is largely an introduced plant. Partial to open plains and woodlands, its

natural range once extended from eastern Canada southward into the Ozarks and westward throughout the corn belt

states to the east slopes of the Rockies. Market pressures and continuing loss of habitat have eliminated most of the

wild stands of echinacea. Its range continues to shrink, and today only small isolated populations of wild echinacea

survive west of the Missouri River.

栖息地和分布范围：在西方，紫锥菊主要是引进植物。其自然范围部分为开阔的平原和林地，曾从加拿大

东部向南延伸至奥沙克山脉，向西穿过玉米种植带各州直至落基山脉东坡。市场压力和栖息地的持续丧失

已经消灭了大部分野生紫锥菊。它的分布范围持续缩小，如今只有少量孤立的野生紫锥菊种群在密苏里河

以西生存。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in early to late summer, depending on climate

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，根据气候在初夏至夏末开花

Parts Used: Most often the root is used. The leaves, stems, and flowers are useful too, although they are much

weaker medicine.

使用的部分：最常用的是根。叶子、茎和花也很有用，尽管它们的药力要弱得多。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Immunostimulant, antimicrobial

主要药用活性：免疫增强剂、抗菌剂

=== PAGE 168 ===
Strongest Affinities: Immune system, lymph system, urinary tract

最强的亲和力：免疫系统、淋巴系统、泌尿道

Preparation: Tincture, decoction, dried and powdered root, or direct feeding of the fresh leaves, stems, and flowers

制备方法：酊剂、煎剂、根干研粉，或鲜叶、茎、花直接饲喂

Common Uses: First and foremost, echinacea is an immune-supporting herb—it serves to support intact immune

functions through stimulatory and strengthening actions at various levels within the body. No single constituent

contained in the root or flowering upper parts of echinacea can be attributed to the immune-tonifying functions of

this plant. Instead, most herbalists agree that the complex structure of this plant should be viewed as a therapeutic

synergy of dozens of biochemical influences. However, a few key elements stand out as strong clues to exactly how

echinacea works.

常见用途：首先，紫锥菊是一种免疫支持草药——它通过刺激和加强体内各个层面的作用来支持完整的免

疫功能。紫锥花的根部或开花上部所含的任何单一成分都不能归因于该植物的免疫增强功能。相反，大多

数草药学家都认为这种植物的复杂结构应被视为数十种生化影响的治疗协同作用。然而，有几个关键元素

脱颖而出，成为了解紫锥花到底如何发挥作用的有力线索。

A great deal of scientific research has identified echinacea’s most influential immunostimulatory components as

an extensive array of caffeic acids, volatile oils, polysaccharides, polyenes, polyines, and isobutylamides. In simpler

terms, echinacea’s immunostimulatory qualities are derived from a wide array of chemical compounds that allow the

plant to be used in a variety of forms without sacrificing its effectiveness. For instance, while many of the acid

constituents in echinacea are poorly water soluble and require a strong alcohol base to extract them into a tincture

form, the plant’s polysaccharide constituents are exactly the opposite—they are easily extracted into water—and, in

fact, they are largely destroyed by alcohol. Since both of these chemical groups have been shown to possess very

strong immunostimulatory qualities, it would appear that the plant is naturally designed to accommodate a wide

variety of metabolic needs.

大量科学研究已确定紫锥菊最有影响力的免疫刺激成分是多种咖啡酸、挥发油、多糖、多烯、多胺和异

丁酰胺。简而言之，紫锥菊的免疫刺激特性源自多种化合物，这些化合物使该植物能够以多种形式使用，

而不会牺牲其有效性。例如，虽然紫锥菊中的许多酸性成分水溶性差，需要强醇碱才能将它们提取成酊剂

形式，但该植物的多糖成分却恰恰相反，它们很容易提取到水中，而且事实上，它们大部分被酒精破坏。

由于这两个化学基团已被证明具有非常强的免疫刺激特性，因此该植物似乎天生就可以满足多种代谢需

求。

Echinacea serves to support disease resistance in several ways. At the blood level, it accelerates phagocytosis, the

means by which macrophages and other antibodies attack and remove bacteria. At cellular levels, echinacea helps to

reduce the production of an enzyme that breaks down hyaluronic acid, the compound that occurs between cells to

bind them together. Eliminating this enzyme at the onset of an infection is believed to make body tissues less

pervious to invading microbes and, in turn, the invaders more vulnerable to scavenging antibodies that have already

been stimulated into action. Echinacea has also been shown to stimulate the lymph system, thus helping the body to

eliminate waste materials from the tissues. And it possesses measurable antimicrobial qualities that assist the body’s

fight against infection by intervening with bacteria at the point of invasion.

紫锥菊以多种方式支持疾病抵抗力。在血液水平上，它加速吞噬作用，巨噬细胞和其他抗体通过吞噬作

用攻击和清除细菌。在细胞水平上，紫锥菊有助于减少分解透明质酸的酶的产生，透明质酸是细胞之间产

生的将细胞结合在一起的化合物。据信，在感染开始时消除这种酶可以使身体组织对入侵微生物的渗透性

降低，反过来，入侵者更容易受到已经被刺激发挥作用的抗体的清除作用。紫锥菊还被证明可以刺激淋巴

系统，从而帮助身体清除组织中的废物。它具有可测量的抗菌特性，可以通过在细菌入侵时进行干预来帮

助人体抵抗感染。

Echinacea’s multidirectional means of immune system support, its primary usefulness, depends on a healthy

immune system. Without a healthy population of unencumbered antibodies to work with, echinacea’s capacity to

fight infection is limited to its simple, and less-than-impressive, antiseptic actions. This means that timing is critical

=== PAGE 169 ===
to echinacea’s effectiveness—this herb should be taken at the first onset of infectious symptoms, otherwise its

activity will amount to a losing battle fought against microbial opponents that have already fortified their positions

within the animal’s body.

紫锥菊对免疫系统的多向支持及其主要用途取决于健康的免疫系统。如果没有健康的不受阻碍的抗体群

体，紫锥花抵抗感染的能力就仅限于其简单且不那么令人印象深刻的抗菌作用。这意味着时机对于紫锥菊

的有效性至关重要——这种草药应该在感染症状第一次出现时服用，否则它的活性将等于与已经在动物体

内巩固地位的微生物对手进行一场失败的战斗。

Learn to recognize minute variances in your animal’s behavior and feeding habits. Take extra time to give your

pet a cursory examination during your daily grooming session or playtimes, and look for anything that may point to

the introduction of an infection—an inflamed gum, a swollen fleabite, or a slightly runny nose may be indicators for

the proactive use of echinacea. If you are too late and an infection has set in, it’s time to consider calling in some

other troops from the herbal army. Don’t despair. Try boosting echinacea with a small percentage of an antiseptic

herb such as Oregon grape, usnea, or organically grown goldenseal. By combining echinacea with about 10 percent

by weight or volume of one of these other herbs, you will be offering a small measure of direct antiseptic

intervention without compromising populations of the beneficial microbes the body needs in its fight. Applying

antiseptics topically, directly onto the point of infection, also aids in the healing effort.

学会识别动物行为和饮食习惯的微小差异。在日常梳理或玩耍时，花额外的时间对你的宠物进行一次粗

略的检查，并寻找任何可能表明感染的迹象——牙龈发炎、跳蚤肿胀或轻微流鼻涕可能是感染的迹象。积

极使用紫锥菊。如果你来得太晚并且感染已经开始，那么是时候考虑从草药大军中召集其他一些部队了。

不要绝望。尝试用少量的防腐药草（如俄勒冈葡萄、松萝或有机种植的毛茛）来增强紫锥花的效果。通过

将紫锥菊与按重量或体积计约 10% 的其他草药之一结合起来，您将提供少量的直接防腐干预，而不会损害

身体在战斗中所需的有益微生物群。直接在感染点局部涂抹抗菌剂也有助于治愈。

So how much echinacea should you give, for how long, and in what form? Many people think that the potency of

an echinacea preparation can be determined by the intensity of the tingling sensation it causes when placed on the

tongue. If this is your current method of judging echinacea preparations, please abandon it. A great deal of recent

and continuing research has shown that the isobutylamides responsible for this sensation represent only a fragment

of echinacea’s active constituents and that their absence may not affect the overall effectiveness of echinacea. The

more we learn about echinacea, the more complex and diverse its medicinal actions seem to be.

那么，您应该给予多少紫锥菊、给予多长时间以及以什么形式呢？许多人认为紫锥菊制剂的效力可以通

过其放在舌头上时引起的刺痛感的强度来确定。如果这是您目前判断紫锥菊制剂的方法，请放弃它。最近

和持续进行的大量研究表明，产生这种感觉的异丁基酰胺仅代表紫锥菊活性成分的一小部分，它们的缺失

可能不会影响紫锥菊的整体功效。我们对紫锥菊了解得越多，它的药用作用似乎就越复杂和多样。

There is no best kind of echinacea preparation per se. As long as care and quality have gone into its propagation,

its harvest, and the manufacture of the end product, all echinacea preparations contain adequate medicinal

constituents. The question of what preparation to use internally in your animal hinges on how easy or difficult it is to

get a therapeutic quantity into the animal. Echinacea is by no means a good-tasting herb, and its administration is

complicated by the fact that dogs and cats have short digestive tracks and fast metabolic rates. In these animals, the

problem isn’t finding a preparation that contains high enough concentrations of active constituents but finding one

that is both palatable and fully assimilable by their short digestive tracts. Cats in particular don’t like alcohol and the

sour tingle that alcohol extracts impart on the tongue. (They typically foam at the mouth and sometimes act as if you

are force-feeding them a vile, poisonous fluid.) Dogs typically drink from toilets without complaint and are

somewhat less picky, and since gel capsules often pass directly through them undigested, we prefer to use low-

alcohol glycerin extracts for our carnivores. Glycerin-based preparations are low in tongue-tingling isobutylamides

but rich in readily available polysaccharide constituents, and the sweet taste of the vegetable glycerin helps mask the

unpleasant flavor of the herb.

本身没有最好的紫锥菊制剂。只要在其繁殖、收获和最终产品的制造过程中都经过精心呵护和质量保

证，所有紫锥菊制剂都含有足够的药用成分。在动物体内使用什么制剂的问题取决于将治疗剂量输入动物

体内的难易程度。紫锥菊绝不是一种味道好的草药，而且由于狗和猫的消化道短、新陈代谢速度快，因此

其给药也很复杂。对于这些动物来说，问题不在于找到一种含有足够高浓度活性成分的制剂，而在于找到

一种既可口又可被其短消化道完全吸收的制剂。猫尤其不喜欢酒精和酒精提取物给舌头带来的酸刺痛感。

（它们通常会口吐白沫，有时表现得就像你在强行给它们喂食一种肮脏的有毒液体一样。）狗通常毫无怨

=== PAGE 170 ===
言地从厕所里喝水，而且不太挑剔，而且由于凝胶胶囊通常未经消化就直接通过它们，我们我们的肉食动

物更喜欢使用低醇甘油提取物。以甘油为基础的制剂中令人舌头刺痛的异丁基酰胺含量较低，但富含容易

获得的多糖成分，植物甘油的甜味有助于掩盖草药的难闻味道。

Herbivores are naturally designed to efficiently metabolize plant materials; horses, goats, llamas, and other large

animals can be fed the flowering plants, or dried root can be added to their feed.

食草动物天生就能够有效地代谢植物物质；马、山羊、美洲驼和其他大型动物可以用开花植物喂养，或

者可以将干根添加到饲料中。

Dosage and duration of use vary based upon the needs and individual nuances of the animal, but a conservative

rule for dogs and cats is to give 12–25 drops of the tincture three times daily. Horses, cattle, sheep, and other large

animals can be fed a couple of handfuls of the dried whole flowering herb per day. Several high-quality powdered

echinacea preparations are now available for equines and other large animals as well. Use them as directed by your

veterinarian or as suggested on the label.

剂量和使用时间根据动物的需要和个体差异而有所不同，但对于狗和猫来说，保守的规则是每天 3 次，

每次 12-25 滴酊剂。马、牛、羊和其他大型动物每天可以喂几把干燥的全花草本植物。现在有几种高质量

的紫锥菊粉制剂也可用于马和其他大型动物。按照兽医的指示或标签上的建议使用它们。

In recent years, a rather heated controversy has arisen within the herbalist community concerning how long

echinacea can be used before the body builds a tolerance to its immune-stimulating actions. In a German study

conducted in 1989, a diminished response to echinacea was recorded in human subjects after five to ten days of

normal dose administration. This result raised questions of whether echinacea is effective when used over the long

term. Closer scrutiny of this study, however, has since led to the conclusion that while echinacea’s activity does fall

off sharply after about five days of use, its long-term use still maintains a level of immune system activity higher

than that observed prior to its initial administration. Many herbalists believe that breaking the continuity of

echinacea use every five to ten days allows for a greater immune boost each time the therapy is reestablished after a

two- or three-day respite. We agree and believe that a break is necessary, in any case, to monitor the unassisted

recovery of the animal. Five days on, two or three days off is a good guideline to follow.

近年来，草药界内部出现了一场相当激烈的争论，即在身体对其免疫刺激作用产生耐受性之前，紫锥菊

可以使用多长时间。 1989 年德国进行的一项研究显示，人类受试者在服用正常剂量五到十天后，对紫锥菊

的反应减弱。这一结果引发了紫锥菊长期使用是否有效的问题。然而，对这项研究的更仔细的审查得出的

结论是，虽然紫锥菊的活性在使用大约五天后确实急剧下降，但长期使用它仍然保持了高于首次使用之前

观察到的免疫系统活性水平。行政。许多草药医生认为，每五到十天中断一次紫锥菊的使用，每次在两三

天的休息后重新开始治疗时，都可以增强免疫能力。我们同意并相信，无论如何，休息是必要的，以监测

动物的独立康复情况。工作五天，休息两三天是一个很好的遵循准则。

Aside from its immune-stimulating qualities, echinacea is a good antimicrobial for the mouth and urinary tract. It

is useful for treating bacterial or fungal infections of the bladder and urethra, especially when added to a demulcent

and anti-inflammatory combination of herbs. Echinacea also has a long-standing reputation as a snakebite remedy.

Used internally and externally simultaneously, the herb is said to antidote the venom. Although little scientific

evidence exists to support such claims, hundreds of years’ worth of use amounts to more than folkloric trivia.

Knowing that about 85 percent of rattlesnake bites involve only a partial injection of venom (or no injection at all), it

is likely that echinacea serves more to ward off infection and prevent tissue damage than to actually nullify the

venom. Echinacea relieves the pain and swelling of most insect bites and stings, especially when applied as a clay

poultice.

除了其免疫刺激特性外，紫锥菊还是口腔和泌尿道的良好抗菌剂。它可用于治疗膀胱和尿道的细菌或真

菌感染，特别是当添加到缓和和抗炎草药组合中时。紫锥菊作为治疗蛇咬伤的药物也享有盛誉。据说这种

草药可以同时内服和外用，可以解毒。尽管几乎没有科学证据支持这种说法，但数百年的使用价值不仅仅

是民俗琐事。据了解，大约 85% 的响尾蛇咬伤只涉及部分毒液注射（或根本不注射），紫锥菊很可能更多

地用于抵御感染和防止组织损伤，而不是真正消除毒液。紫锥菊可以缓解大多数昆虫叮咬和蜇伤的疼痛和

肿胀，尤其是作为粘土膏剂使用时。

Echinacea is also used with some success for colic in horses, with free-feeding of the fresh leaves, stems, and

flowers being the most popular method of administration.

紫锥菊在治疗马绞痛方面也取得了一些成功，自由喂养新鲜的叶子、茎和花是最流行的给药方法。

=== PAGE 171 ===
Availability: Various preparations of echinacea are widely available through health product retailers. The seeds and

plants are available through most nurseries. Because of continuing overharvest, wild stands of this plant are at risk

of disappearing forever. Please make sure that the echinacea you are using is from cultivated sources.

可获得性：各种紫锥菊制剂可通过保健品零售商广泛购买。大多数苗圃都可以提供种子和植物。由于持续

的过度采伐，这种植物的野生种群面临着永远消失的危险。请确保您使用的紫锥菊来自栽培来源。

Propagation and Harvest: Echinacea purpurea, the primary echinacea of commerce, is easy to grow and requires

little care once the plants are established. Seeds require cold, damp stratification and light to break their dormancy.

This means that the seeds must be sown on top of the soil or covered with just a trace of soil in order to germinate.

Roots must be at least three years old to be of medicinal value. The plants are hardy and drought tolerant when

mature. A well-established stand of echinacea reseeds itself, and mature plants can bear roots of up to 3 pounds

each.

繁殖和收获：紫锥菊是主要的商业紫锥菊，很容易生长，一旦植物定植后几乎不需要照顾。种子需要寒

冷、潮湿的层积和光照来打破休眠。这意味着种子必须播种在土壤顶部或仅覆盖少量土壤才能发芽。根必

须至少三年才能具有药用价值。这些植物成熟时耐寒、耐旱。成熟的紫锥菊可以自行重新播种，成熟的植

物每根可生出重达 3 磅的根。

Varieties such as E. pallida and E. angustifolia are much more finicky. Before you choose to grow them, bear in

mind that despite what herbalists once thought, the gardener-friendly E. purpurea provides medicine that is as potent

as these other species.

E. pallida 和 E. angustifolia 等品种更加挑剔。在您选择种植它们之前，请记住，尽管草药学家曾经认为如

此，但对园丁友好的紫紫桉提供的药物与其他物种一样有效。

Dig mature echinacea roots from the garden after the plant has gone dormant for the winter, following its third

year of growth. The roots can be chopped and tinctured while fresh or dried and ground for use in teas. The dried

roots can be tinctured as well.

在植物生长第三年后进入冬季休眠状态后，从花园中挖出成熟的紫锥菊根。根可以在新鲜时切碎和酊

剂，也可以干燥并磨碎用于泡茶。干燥的根也可以酊剂。

Leaves, stems, and flowers can be selectively harvested when they are in full bloom in midsummer. If you opt to

do this, bear in mind that a preponderance of leaves and flowers must remain on the plants to provide life support for

the roots and to produce viable seeds.

叶、茎、花盛夏盛开时可选择性采收。如果您选择这样做，请记住，植物上必须保留大量的叶子和花

朵，以便为根部提供生命支持并产生有活力的种子。

Echinacea purpurea

紫松果菊

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Virtually any of the alterative, diuretic, cholagogue, or expectorant herbs combine well

with echinacea to support the body during microbial infections. To help fight infections of the mouth, digestive tract,

or urinary tract, echinacea serves as an excellent adjunct to Oregon grape or couch grass. As a lymphatic, echinacea

combines well with cleavers.

替代品和辅助品：实际上，任何替代药、利尿药、利胆药或祛痰药草都可以与紫锥菊很好地结合起来，在

微生物感染期间为身体提供支持。为了帮助对抗口腔、消化道或泌尿道感染，紫锥菊是俄勒冈葡萄或茅草

的绝佳辅助品。作为一种淋巴管，紫锥菊与切肉刀结合得很好。

Cautions and Comments: Echinacea is a very safe herb. But remember, echinacea can only be expected to support

a healthy immune system. If the animal is malnourished or immune-compromised by preexisting disease or by other

factors, you should consider dietary changes and/or other measures that feed and support the immune system before

jumping into Echinacea therapy. Before using echinacea, it is a good idea to consult a holistic veterinarian—

especially if you are uncertain of your animal’s level of disease resistance.

注意事项和评论：紫锥菊是一种非常安全的草药。但请记住，紫锥菊只能支持健康的免疫系统。如果动物

因先前存在的疾病或其他因素而营养不良或免疫受损，您应该在开始紫锥菊治疗之前考虑改变饮食和/或其

他喂养和支持免疫系统的措施。在使用紫锥菊之前，最好咨询整体兽医，尤其是当您不确定动物的抗病能

力时。

Appearance: Elecampane is a stout, impressive plant. Healthy specimens may grow in excess of 6 feet high. We

have seen these plants in tightly clustered hedgelike stands so thick that one cannot see daylight through them. The

narrowly lance-shaped leaves may exceed 16 inches in length and 4 inches in width. The daisylike flowers may

reach 4 inches in diameter, are burnt orange, and have narrow rays that contrast with the robust overall appearance

of the plant—a splendid addition to any herb or flower garden!

外观：土木香是一种粗壮、令人印象深刻的植物。健康的标本可能会长到超过 6 英尺高。我们已经看到这

鲜明对比，是任何药草或花园的绝妙补充！

栖息地和分布范围：土木香可能原产于欧洲东南部，现已在欧洲大部分地区和美国东部地区归化。世界各

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，通常在初夏至仲夏开花

Common Uses: Elecampane has long been regarded as a valuable medicine for a wide variety of lung disorders.

Among herbalists, it is regarded as an expectorant that also lends antibacterial support, mild cough-suppressive

qualities, and relief to mucous membranes by virtue of its slippery, oily, soothing mucilage. In other words,

elecampane helps make coughing more productive by stimulating excretion of mucus, acts to protect and lubricate

inflamed mucous membranes in the respiratory tract while inhibiting bacterial infection, and serves to suppress the

cough response just enough so that the body is relieved of unnecessary stress. Unfortunately, relatively little

scientific study has been performed to support all of these claims. Science has uncovered evidence to suggest that

elecampane may have sedative qualities in mice, and we know that it contains a volatile oil constituent called

alantolactone, which is active against roundworms, whipworms, threadworms, and hookworms in humans.

Regardless of a lack of scientific study, this plant has been used for thousands of years as a treatment for bronchitis,

pneumonia, and tuberculosis—and it is regarded by herbalists as safe enough for use in children with a dry, irritating

cough. In animals, we find it useful for soothing a raspy hack that is the result of too much trail dust or perhaps even

for kennel cough. Proper dose and duration of therapy must be determined through recognition of specific symptoms

and should be based on the special needs of the individual animal. Most of what we know about this herb is centered

on the hands-on experience of those who are familiar with it. Therefore, if elecampane seems to be a viable option

for your animal, seek the advice of a holistic practitioner before you proceed with its use.

常见用途：土木香长期以来被认为是治疗多种肺部疾病的宝贵药物。在草药学家中，它被认为是一种祛痰

剂，还具有抗菌支持、温和的止咳功效，并因其滑滑、油腻、舒缓的粘液而缓解粘膜症状。换句话说，土

木香通过刺激粘液排泄来帮助提高咳嗽效率，保护和润滑呼吸道发炎的粘膜，同时抑制细菌感染，并起到

抑制咳嗽反应的作用，从而使身体摆脱不必要的有害物质。压力。不幸的是，支持所有这些说法的科学研

究相对较少。科学发现的证据表明，土木香可能对小鼠具有镇静作用，而且我们知道它含有一种名为土木

香内酯的挥发性油成分，对人类的蛔虫、鞭虫、线虫和钩虫具有活性。尽管缺乏科学研究，这种植物数千

年来一直被用来治疗支气管炎、肺炎和肺结核，草药学家认为它足够安全，可以安全地用于治疗患有干

咳、刺激性咳嗽的儿童。在动物身上，我们发现它可以缓解因灰尘过多而引起的刺耳咳嗽，甚至可以缓解

犬舍咳嗽。适当的剂量和治疗持续时间必须通过识别具体症状来确定，并应基于个体动物的特殊需要。我

=== PAGE 175 ===
们对这种草药的了解大多来自熟悉它的人的实践经验。因此，如果土木香似乎对您的动物来说是一个可行

的选择，请在继续使用之前寻求整体医生的建议。

Availability: The dried rhizome or tincture is available through herb retailers. Plants, root cuttings, and seeds are

available through specialty nurseries.

可用性：干燥的根茎或酊剂可通过草药零售商购买。植物、根插条和种子可通过专业苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Elecampane likes full sun and a moist clay loam with an acid pH of 4.5 to 6. Aside from

these requirements, you can grow it just about anywhere. Roots are dug in the fall of their second year. They can

then be processed into tincture while fresh or dried in a warm location for future use.

繁殖和收获：土木香喜欢充足的阳光和湿润的粘土，pH 值为 4.5 至 6。除了这些要求之外，您几乎可以在

任何地方种植它。第二年秋天挖根。然后可以将它们加工成新鲜的酊剂或在温暖的地方干燥以备将来使

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For respiratory disorders associated with heavy congestion, elecampane combines well

with mullein or grindelia. For kennel cough, it can be combined with coltsfoot.

替代品和辅助药物：对于与严重充血相关的呼吸系统疾病，土木香与毛蕊花或银杏可以很好地结合使用。

对于犬窝咳，可与款冬合用。

Cautions and Comments: Elecampane has been shown to be highly allergenic in animals and humans with

注意事项和评论：土木香已被证明对对向日葵（菊科）科植物敏感的动物和人类具有高度过敏性。

FENNEL

茴香

Foeniculum vulgare

小茴香

Parsley Family

欧芹家族

Appearance: Fennel looks very much like dill—delicate finely divided leaves, yellow umbel flowers, and hollow

stems. The most obvious difference between fennel and dill is the aromatic nature of the plants—fennel smells

somewhat like anise (or licorice), whereas dill smells like, well, dill pickles. Fennel also has sturdier stems and a

proportionately large bulb, which is considered a gourmet delicacy by salad and sautéed vegetable connoisseurs. The

entire plant may grow in excess of 6 feet tall.

外观：茴香看起来非常像莳萝——精致的细裂叶子、黄色的伞形花序花和空心的茎。茴香和莳萝之间最明

显的区别是植物的芳香性质——茴香闻起来有点像茴香（或甘草），而莳萝闻起来像莳萝泡菜。茴香还具

有更坚固的茎和比例较大的球茎，被沙拉和炒蔬菜鉴赏家视为美味佳肴。整株植物可能长到超过 6 英尺

高。

Habitat and Range: Native to Eurasia, fennel has become a full-time, naturalized resident in the southern half of

California, where it is frequently found on the edges of waste areas.

栖息地和分布范围：茴香原产于欧亚大陆，现已成为加利福尼亚州南半部的全职归化居民，经常在荒地边

缘发现它。

Cycle and Bloom Season: There are many subspecies of Foeniculum vulgare—many are perennials, others are

annuals or biennials. In northern climes, fennel usually grows as an annual.

周期和开花季节：茴香有许多亚种，许多是多年生植物，其他是一年生或二年生植物。在北方地区，茴香

通常是一年生植物。

Parts Used: Seeds, leaves, roots

使用部位：种子、叶子、根

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expels intestinal gas, relieves stomach cramps, stimulates milk production,

stimulates digestion, nutritive, and antibacterial

主要药用活性：排出肠道气体，缓解胃痉挛，刺激产奶，促进消化，营养和抗菌

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract

最强的亲和力：消化道

Preparation: Fresh or dried leaves, seeds, or roots; or a tincture of the seeds or roots

制备方法：新鲜或干燥的叶子、种子或根；或种子或根的酊剂

Common Uses: Fennel seed is among the first herbs to reach for in cases of flatulence or colic. Its activity in the

digestive tract is similar to that of catnip. Fennel tastes different from any mint, however, and its flavor is often

favored by dogs and cats who dislike “minty” herbs. About 20 percent of cats won’t go near a flake of catnip,

making fennel the herb of choice for gastric upset and irritability. In chronic cases, it serves as a gentle antigas and

antispasmodic agent that can be added directly to the animal’s food to bring symptomatic relief while the caretaker

looks for the deeper cause of the problem. In acute cases, such as when your horse finds an open bag of molasses

and oats that you forgot to put away (or when she grazes on too much fresh alfalfa because you left a gate open),

fennel may help to reduce the subsequent bloating that is caused by intestinal gas buildup. For flatulence or colic,

horses can be free-fed fresh fennel greens—as much as they want—until they find relief. For dogs and cats, fennel

seed works to relieve gastric discomfort from the “no-no’s” that are inevitably consumed as a result of human

weakness such as tidbits fed from the Thanksgiving dinner table or from the dishes that “can wait until morning.” A

cooled tea works well for this purpose—1 teaspoon of the fresh or dried seeds (fresh are better) in 8 ounces of

boiling water, steeped until cool. The tea can be fed at a rate of 2–4 tablespoons for each 20 pounds of the animal’s

body weight, or it can be added to drinking water as generously as the animal will allow. A glycerin tincture also

works well, especially for finicky animals, because it allows for the convenience of a small dosage of 10–20 drops

(or more precisely, up to 0.75 milliliters) per 20 pounds of the animal’s weight, as needed. Fennel is high in vitamin

C, vitamin A, calcium, iron, and potassium and has varying amounts of linoleic acid. It is an especially good

nutritional adjunct for dogs and cats with chronic indigestion that cannot be attributed to a specific disease entity.

Fennel also helps increase appetite and reduce bad breath by minimizing belching and by acting as an antibacterial

in the mouth. The leaf tea is said to be an effective skin and coat rinse for repelling fleas. Traditionally, fennel is fed

to increase milk flow in nursing mothers.

常见用途：茴香籽是治疗肠胃胀气或绞痛时最先使用的草药之一。它在消化道中的活性与猫薄荷相似。然

而，茴香的味道与任何薄荷都不同，它的味道往往受到不喜欢“薄荷味”香草的狗和猫的青睐。大约 20% 的

猫不会靠近猫薄荷片，因此茴香成为治疗胃部不适和烦躁的首选药草。在慢性病例中，它可以作为一种温

和的抗气剂和解痉剂，可以直接添加到动物的食物中，以缓解症状，同时饲养员寻找问题的更深层次原

因。在严重的情况下，例如当你的马发现一袋打开的糖蜜和燕麦而你忘记收起来时（或者当她因为你没关

门而吃到太多新鲜的苜蓿时），茴香可能有助于减少随后的腹胀。是由肠道气体积聚引起的。对于胀气或

绞痛，马可以自由喂食新鲜茴香叶——想吃多少就吃多少——直到它们得到缓解。对于狗和猫来说，茴香

籽可以缓解因人类弱点而不可避免地食用的“禁忌”引起的胃部不适，例如感恩节餐桌上的小吃或“可以等到

中，浸泡直至冷却。可以按照每 20 磅动物体重 2-4 汤匙的比例喂茶，也可以在动物允许的范围内将茶添加

叶茶是一种有效的皮肤和皮毛冲洗剂，可以驱除跳蚤。传统上，喂茴香可以增加哺乳期母亲的乳汁流量。

Availability: Fennel seed, root, and sometimes the greens can be found in food stores that stock specialty

vegetables. Fennel tinctures are available through herb retailers.

可获得性：茴香籽、茴香根，有时还可以在出售特色蔬菜的食品店找到茴香蔬菜。茴香酊剂可通过草药零

售商购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Fennel is easy to grow from seed or nursery starts. It does best in areas with a cool

climate and likes light, dry, slightly alkaline soil. The seeds should be harvested in the fall, just as they begin to dry

and turn to a light brown color. The leaves and flowers can be harvested and used anytime. For food use, the 1-inch-

wide bulbs are “blanched” throughout the remainder of their growth by covering them with hills of soil. This makes

the bulbs white and tender with a mild flavor.

繁殖和收获：茴香很容易从种子或苗圃开始生长。它在气候凉爽的地区生长得最好，喜欢轻质、干燥、微

碱性的土壤。种子应该在秋天收获，当它们开始干燥并变成浅棕色时。叶子和花可以随时采收和使用。为

了供食用，这些 1 英寸宽的球茎在其生长的剩余过程中会通过用土丘覆盖它们来“漂白”。这使得球茎又白

又嫩，味道温和。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Catnip serves as an excellent alternative, as does anise seed, celery seed, or dill seed.

For chronic flatulence, try using a bitter herb such as dandelion leaf or Oregon grape a few minutes before each

feeding. Fennel can then be used after meals if flatulence persists.

替代品和辅助品：猫薄荷、茴香籽、芹菜籽或莳萝籽都是很好的替代品。对于慢性胀气，尝试在每次喂食

前几分钟使用苦味药草，例如蒲公英叶或俄勒冈葡萄。如果肠胃气胀持续，可以在饭后使用茴香。

Cautions and Comments: The volatile oils in fennel are thought to cause or contribute to photosensitive dermatitis

in some animals, but such occurrences are rare. In general, this herb is safe.

注意事项和评论：茴香中的挥发油被认为会导致或促成某些动物的光敏性皮炎，但这种情况很少见。一般

来说，这种草药是安全的。

FEVERFEW

发烧

Tanacetum parthenium

菊科植物

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Feverfew is a stout, fast-growing plant with sturdy ridged stems, deeply divided alternate leaves, and

yellow-centered white flowers that look like miniature (1-inch-wide) white daisies. The entire plant is aromatic.

外观：小白菊是一种粗壮、快速生长的植物，具有坚固的脊状茎、深裂的互生叶和黄色中心的白色花朵，

看起来像微型（1英寸宽）白色雏菊。整个植物都是芳香的。

Habitat and Range: Feverfew is native to the Balkan region of Europe and has since been naturalized throughout

North America.

栖息地和分布范围：小白菊原产于欧洲巴尔干地区，现已在整个北美归化。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial or biennial that usually blooms from June through August

周期和开花季节：多年生或二年生植物，通常从六月到八月开花

=== PAGE 180 ===
Tanacetum parthenium

菊科植物

Parts Used: All aerial parts

使用零件：所有空中零件

Primary Medicinal Activities: Anti-inflammatory, helps reduce arthritic inflammation (antirheumatic), dilates

blood vessels, insecticidal, promotes menstruation

主要药用活性：抗炎、帮助减少关节炎炎症（抗风湿）、扩张血管、杀虫、促进月经

Strongest Affinities: Vascular, gastrointestinal, and reproductive systems

最强的亲和力：血管、胃肠道和生殖系统

Preparation: Dried herb, tincture, and tea

准备：干草药、酊剂和茶

Common Uses: Feverfew has become a well-known remedy for migraine sufferers. Several studies have shown that

part of its effectiveness in treating migraines is attributable to a group of chemicals known as sesquiterpene lactones

(especially parthenolide) that are contained in the plants’ leaves and flowers. These compounds act to inhibit platelet

aggregation in the bloodstream, thus preventing blockage of small capillaries and helping to relieve the pounding,

high-pressure pain of a migraine headache. In animals, this activity helps relieve posttrauma or postsurgical

discomfort, especially where capillary circulation is diminished or impaired. Feverfew has been shown to block or

inhibit the release of histamine, serotonin, thromboxane, and prostaglandins, while inhibiting proliferation of certain

types of mononuclear cells in the synovia of injured or arthritic joints. This means that feverfew might be useful in

the proactive reduction of inflammation associated with arthritis, joint injuries, and various other diseases.

常见用途：小白菊已成为治疗偏头痛患者的众所周知的药物。多项研究表明，其治疗偏头痛的部分功效归

因于植物叶子和花中含有的一组称为倍半萜内酯（尤其是小白菊内酯）的化学物质。这些化合物可以抑制

血液中的血小板聚集，从而防止小毛细血管堵塞，并有助于缓解偏头痛带来的剧烈高压疼痛。在动物中，

这种活动有助于缓解创伤后或手术后的不适，特别是在毛细血管循环减少或受损的情况下。小白菊已被证

明可以阻断或抑制组胺、血清素、血栓素和前列腺素的释放，同时抑制受伤或关节炎关节滑液中某些类型

单核细胞的增殖。这意味着小白菊可能有助于主动减少与关节炎、关节损伤和各种其他疾病相关的炎症。

Feverfew is especially useful in cats as an alternative to aspirin, which can be toxic to felines. And many of the

classic anti-inflammatory herbs, including willow, poplar, and meadowsweet, contain salicylic acids, the natural

precursors to aspirin. Feverfew may not address pain as directly as aspirin, but it does not contain any salicylate

compounds and can therefore be used with a greater margin of safety. A glycerin-based tincture works well for this

purpose, as does a cooled tea. A safe starting dosage is 12–20 drops of the tincture or ½ teaspoon of a strong tea for

each 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily.

小白菊作为阿司匹林的替代品对猫特别有用，因为阿司匹林可能对猫有毒。许多经典的抗炎草药，包括

柳树、杨树和绣线菊，都含有水杨酸，这是阿司匹林的天然前体。小白菊可能无法像阿司匹林那样直接缓

解疼痛，但它不含任何水杨酸盐化合物，因此使用时具有更大的安全性。甘油酊剂和冷茶都可以很好地达

到此目的。安全的起始剂量是每 20 磅动物体重 12-20 滴酊剂或 ½ 茶匙浓茶，每天两次。

The upper parts of feverfew (especially the flowers) contain pyrethrins, compounds that are known to paralyze

fleas. To make a flea rinse for your pet, pour boiling water over some fresh herbs. Cover the container, and let the

mixture stand until it is completely cooled. Strain the herb from the liquid, and pour the liquid onto your animal’s

coat, making sure that it soaks down to the skin. Do not towel dry your pet. Let the rinse dry naturally and be sure to

use all of the rinse as the pyrethrin will not remain active for more than a few hours.

小白菊的上部（尤其是花朵）含有除虫菊酯，这种化合物可以麻痹跳蚤。要为您的宠物制作跳蚤冲洗

剂，请将沸水倒在一些新鲜香草上。盖上容器，让混合物静置直至完全冷却。将药草从液体中滤出，然后

=== PAGE 181 ===
将液体倒在动物的皮毛上，确保它浸透到皮肤上。不要用毛巾擦干你的宠物。让冲洗液自然干燥，并确保

用完所有冲洗液，因为除虫菊酯的活性不会持续超过几个小时。

Availability: Feverfew is readily available wherever herbal remedies are sold. The plants are available through most

nurseries. For use against fleas, however, you really need a fresh plant—so plant one in your garden.

可获得性：只要有草药出售，小白菊就很容易买到。大多数苗圃都可以买到这些植物。然而，为了对抗跳

蚤，你确实需要一株新鲜的植物——所以在你的花园里种植一株。

Propagation and Harvest: Feverfew is easy to grow from seed or nursery starts. The plants are extremely winter

hardy, drought resistant, and tolerant of poor soil. Tuck a plant into the corner of your garden, give it a little water,

and watch it grow. (In fact, it will reseed its way right out of the garden!) Harvest the leaves and flowers as you need

them.

繁殖和收获：小白菊很容易从种子或苗圃开始生长。这些植物非常耐寒，抗旱，能耐受贫瘠的土壤。将植

物塞到花园的角落里，给它一点水，然后观察它的生长。 （事实上，它会直接从花园里重新播种！）根据

需要收获叶子和花朵。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For relief from pain and inflammation, feverfew combines well with skullcap, valerian,

and licorice. For fighting fleas, combine with yarrow and celery or dill seed.

替代品和辅助剂：为了缓解疼痛和炎症，小白菊与黄芩、缬草和甘草完美结合。要对抗跳蚤，请与西洋蓍

草、芹菜或莳萝籽混合使用。

Cautions and Comments: I (Greg) have heard that feverfew should never be fed fresh, because it may cause mouth

ulcers. But throughout two decades of using and recommending this herb, I have yet to witness an adverse side

effect. Nevertheless, caution dictates that we should take care in assuring that the herb is entirely dried first.

注意事项和评论：我（格雷格）听说小白菊不应该新鲜喂养，因为它可能会导致口腔溃疡。但在使用和推

荐这种草药的二十年中，我尚未目睹任何不良副作用。尽管如此，谨慎要求我们应该小心确保草药首先完

全干燥。

FLAX

亚麻

Linum spp.

亚麻属

Flax Family

亚麻家族

Appearance: Almost three hundred species of flax are distributed worldwide. The most common species have

bright blue, five-petaled, ½- to 1-inch-wide flowers, narrow single-veined leaves, small five-chambered fruits, and

wirelike stems that sway in the slightest breeze and seem to have a hard time supporting their own weight. Plants

range in height from 6 to 32 inches.

外观：世界各地分布着近三百种亚麻。最常见的品种有明亮的蓝色、五瓣、1/2 至 1 英寸宽的花朵、狭窄的

单脉叶子、小五室的果实和在微风中摇曳的线状茎，看起来很难受。支撑自己的重量。植物的高度范围为 6

至 32 英寸。

Habitat and Range: Common blue flax (Linum perenne) and several other blue-flowered species are found in

prairies, in open meadows, and along roadways throughout North America.

栖息地和分布范围：常见的蓝色亚麻（Linum perenne）和其他几种蓝色花的物种分布在整个北美的大草

原、开阔的草地和道路沿线。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual or perennial (depending on species) that blooms from June to August and

reseeds itself readily

周期和开花季节：一年生或多年生植物（取决于物种），从六月到八月开花，并且很容易重新播种

Parts Used: Seeds (called flaxseed)

使用部分：种子（称为亚麻籽）

Primary Medicinal Activities: Nutritive, soothes the digestive tract, laxative, antioxidant, tonic

主要药用活性： 营养、舒缓消化道、泻药、抗氧化剂、滋补品

Strongest Affinities: Skin, nervous system, digestive system

最强亲和力：皮肤、神经系统、消化系统

Preparation: Ground seeds, seed oil, stabilized seeds

准备工作：磨碎的种子、种子油、稳定的种子

Common Uses: Flaxseed contains alpha-linolenic acid and linoleic acid, as well as omega-3 fatty acids. Essential

fatty acids are important in the development and maintenance of a healthy brain, liver, heart, and immune system—

in fact, these acids are so important, animals cannot survive without them. Several studies have confirmed that

=== PAGE 183 ===
omega-3 fatty acids are essential factors in the brain development of young animals and may even help protect the

brain against certain types of neurotoxins. Numerous studies also have shown that daily supplementation with EFAs

may dramatically improve the skin, coat, and nails in animals who receive it as a supplement to a good diet.

Essential fatty acids have been linked to retinal development and antioxidant activities. The point is this: All animals

require EFAs in order to enjoy healthy lives. The problem is that many animals do not receive enough to adequately

support their bodies’ needs and, as a result, suffer from chronic diseases that could have been easily prevented.

Flaxseed oil is one of the richest plant source of omega-3 fatty acids known to humanity—but it is not the “totally

complete,” stand-alone source of omega-3 fatty acids we once thought. A piece of the complex puzzle is missing,

namely, gamma linolenic acid (GLA)—a fatty acid that is needed to support the body’s inflammatory responses to

allergens and other inflammatory stimuli. The problem is due to the lack of a critical enzyme, called delta-6

desaturase (or D6D), that is needed to convert the linoleic acid constituents in flax into GLA. Although most

mammals, including humans, should be able to produce D6D, most cannot. This is due to environmental factors,

such as various pollutants, and perhaps even emotional stress factors, which have been shown to inhibit the body’s

production of this important enzyme. So if you are searching for a more complete omega-3 supplement, you should

turn to fish oil, borage seed oil, or chia seed. All of these sources already contain gamma linoleic acids, and no

metabolic conversion (or D6D) is required for the body fully utilize it.

常见用途：亚麻籽含有 α-亚麻酸和亚油酸，以及 omega-3 脂肪酸。必需脂肪酸对于健康的大脑、肝脏、心

脏和免疫系统的发育和维持非常重要——事实上，这些酸是如此重要，动物没有它们就无法生存。多项研

究证实，omega-3 脂肪酸是幼年动物大脑发育的重要因素，甚至可能有助于保护大脑免受某些类型的神经毒

素的侵害。大量研究还表明，每天补充必需脂肪酸可以显着改善动物的皮肤、毛发和指甲，这些动物将其

作为良好饮食的补充。必需脂肪酸与视网膜发育和抗氧化活性有关。要点是：所有动物都需要必需脂肪酸

才能享受健康的生活。问题在于，许多动物没有获得足够的营养来充分支持其身体的需求，因此患上了本

可以轻松预防的慢性疾病。亚麻籽油是人类已知的最丰富的 omega-3 脂肪酸植物来源之一，但它并不是我

们曾经认为的“完全”、独立的 omega-3 脂肪酸来源。这个复杂难题中缺少了一块，即γ亚麻酸（GLA）——

一种支持人体对过敏原和其他炎症刺激的炎症反应所需的脂肪酸。问题是由于缺乏一种称为 delta-6 去饱和

酶（或 D6D）的关键酶，这种酶是将亚麻中的亚油酸成分转化为 GLA 所需的。尽管大多数哺乳动物（包括

人类）应该能够产生 D6D，但大多数却不能。 这是由于环境因素，例如各种污染物，甚至可能是情绪压力

因素，这些因素已被证明会抑制人体产生这种重要的酶。因此，如果您正在寻找更全面的 omega-3 补充

剂，您应该转向鱼油、琉璃苣籽油或奇亚籽。所有这些来源都已含有 γ 亚油酸，身体无需代谢转化（或

D6D）即可充分利用它。

=== PAGE 184 ===
Linum sp.

亚麻属sp。

There are various ways to feed flaxseed to an animal. One option is to buy a nutritional supplement that includes

flaxseed as part of a balanced herbal formula. Other options are to buy the seeds in their whole form and grind them

immediately before adding them to your companion’s food. You can also use flaxseed oil. When deciding which

form of flaxseed is best for you and your companion, you should consider several factors. First, it’s important to

know that flaxseed oil (the fraction of the plant that contains the highest concentration of EFAs) becomes rancid

very quickly. While flaxseed oil offers omega-3 EFAs in a form that can be fed in relatively small quantities and that

is quickly and completely absorbed into the body, it requires constant refrigeration and its shelf life is variable and

unpredictable. On the other hand, its flavor is relatively easy to mask in an animal’s food. If you wish to use flax for

digestive problems, you will need the seeds. Whole seeds keep for several months if refrigerated but must be ground

into powder each time they are used. If you grind them ahead of time, they will quickly spoil. The freshly ground

seeds can be used as an EFA supplement, but it’s difficult to gauge the amount of EFAs your animal receives with

each feeding because as the seeds age, their EFA content deteriorates. Another problem with the seed option is

palatability—many animals don’t like the flavor of ground flaxseeds, and getting an appreciable amount of the

powder into a finicky animal can be challenging. The solution: buy a natural pet product that contains stabilized

flaxseed.

有多种方法可以给动物喂食亚麻籽。一种选择是购买一种营养补充剂，其中含有亚麻籽作为平衡草药配

方的一部分。其他选择是购买完整的种子并立即将其磨碎，然后将其添加到同伴的食物中。您也可以使用

亚麻籽油。在决定哪种亚麻籽最适合您和您的伴侣时，您应该考虑几个因素。首先，重要的是要知道亚麻

籽油（植物中含有最高浓度 EFA 的部分）很快就会酸败。虽然亚麻籽油以相对少量的形式提供 omega-3

EFA，并且可以快速、完全地被人体吸收，但它需要持续冷藏，并且其保质期是可变且不可预测的。另一

方面，它的味道相对容易被动物食物掩盖。如果您想使用亚麻来治疗消化问题，则需要亚麻籽。如果冷藏

的话，整个种子可以保存几个月，但每次使用时都必须磨成粉末。如果你提前磨碎它们，它们很快就会变

质。新鲜磨碎的种子可以用作必需脂肪酸补充剂，但很难测量动物每次喂食时摄入的必需脂肪酸含量，因

为随着种子老化，它们的必需脂肪酸含量会下降。种子选择的另一个问题是适口性——许多动物不喜欢磨

碎的亚麻籽的味道，而给挑剔的动物喂大量的亚麻籽粉可能是一项挑战。解决方案：购买含有稳定亚麻籽

=== PAGE 185 ===
的天然宠物产品。

Stabilized flaxseed is treated with zinc and vitamin B6, which makes the seed taste better and helps to prevent the

EFA-containing oil from becoming rancid. If you buy a stabilized flaxseed product that is designed especially for

animals, follow the manufacturer’s feeding instructions. You can also buy stabilized flaxseed that is intended for

humans and prorate the recommended dose up or down to your animal’s body weight. Human doses are generally

based on the needs of a 150-pound person; therefore, if you have a 50-pound dog, you need to feed the dog one-third

of the recommended dose for humans. It’s also a good idea to consult your veterinarian for the correct dosage for

your pet’s weight.

稳定的亚麻籽经过锌和维生素 B6 处理，使种子味道更好，并有助于防止含有 EFA 的油酸败。如果您购

买专为动物设计的稳定亚麻籽产品，请遵循制造商的喂养说明。您还可以购买供人类使用的稳定亚麻籽，

并根据动物的体重按比例增加或减少推荐剂量。人体剂量一般根据150磅重的人的需要而定；因此，如果你

有一只50磅重的狗，你需要给狗喂食人类推荐剂量的三分之一。咨询您的兽医以了解适合您宠物体重的正

确剂量也是一个好主意。

If you don’t wish to use a stabilized flaxseed product and have access to a source of fresh flaxseed, buy weekly

supplies and grind a ½ teaspoon of the seed into a fine powder for each 20 pounds of your animal’s body weight.

Sprinkle the powder onto your companion’s food each day, and be sure that she has plenty of water to drink with her

meal because flaxseed absorbs water and gains mass while in the stomach. This swelling action is due to the

combined fiber, mucilage, and oil content of the seed, which make flaxseed an excellent herb for colic, constipation,

and other digestive problems. The oily mucilage of the seed helps lubricate the digestive tract while the swollen

fibers serve as a safe but efficient intestinal cleanser (it works the same way as psyllium husks do). For cases of

constipation, 1 teaspoon of ground flaxseed can be thoroughly mixed with 4 ounces of cool water. Allow the

mixture to stand for an hour, or until it thickens—you should be able to rub a drop between your thumb and

forefinger and feel its oily nature. If the mixture doesn’t feel slippery, add more powder and let it stand again. The

idea is to activate the flaxseed before putting it into your companion’s body and thus alleviate any possibility of

expansion-related discomfort. Once you get a slippery consistency, 2 teaspoons of the mixture can be fed for each

30 pounds of the animal’s body weight (start with ½ teaspoon in cats). If possible, the slurry should be fed on an

empty stomach so the mixture can work its way throughout the digestive tract.

如果您不想使用稳定的亚麻籽产品，但有新鲜亚麻籽来源，请每周购买供应品，并按照每 20 磅动物体重

将 1/2 茶匙亚麻籽研磨成细粉。每天将粉末撒在同伴的食物上，并确保她在用餐时喝足够的水，因为亚麻籽

在胃中会吸收水分并增加质量。这种膨胀作用是由于种子中的纤维、粘液和油脂含量所致，这使得亚麻籽

成为治疗绞痛、便秘和其他消化问题的极佳草药。种子的油性粘液有助于润滑消化道，而膨胀的纤维则可

作为安全而有效的肠道清洁剂（其作用方式与车前草壳相同）。对于便秘情况，可将 1 茶匙磨碎的亚麻籽

与 4 盎司冷水充分混合。让混合物静置一个小时，或者直到它变稠——你应该能够在拇指和食指之间擦一

滴，感觉到它的油性。如果混合物感觉不滑，请添加更多粉末并再次静置。这个想法是在将亚麻籽放入同

伴的身体之前激活它，从而减轻任何与扩张相关的不适的可能性。一旦达到光滑的稠度，每 30 磅体重的动

物可以喂 2 茶匙混合物（从猫的 1/2 茶匙开始）。如果可能的话，应空腹喂食浆液，以便混合物可以在整个

消化道中发挥作用。

Propagation and Harvest: Flax is easy to grow from seed. Simply scatter the seeds as thinly as possible, rake them

into the top ⅛ inch of soil, and water thoroughly. Sprouts will usually emerge within seven days. Flax is a pretty

border plant, but it really isn’t a practical herb to grow for medicinal purposes. It takes several plants to yield a

useful quantity of seed, which must be thrashed and separated from the stems, leaves, and seed capsules. Without

special equipment, this is a tedious task that yields only a handful of seeds that could have been purchased for a few

cents at a health food store.

繁殖和收获：亚麻很容易从种子开始生长。只需将种子撒得尽可能薄，将它们耙入顶部 ⅛ 英寸的土壤中，

然后彻底浇水。一般7天内就会发芽。亚麻是一种漂亮的边境植物，但它确实不是一种用于药用目的的实用

草药。需要几株植物才能产生有用数量的种子，必须将种子与茎、叶和种皮分离。如果没有特殊设备，这

是一项乏味的任务，只能产出少量种子，而这些种子本来可以在保健食品商店花几美分买到。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Borage seed oil, evening primrose oil, and black currant seed oil are also excellent

=== PAGE 186 ===
sources of EFAs. Flaxseed oil can be combined with cod liver oil or other fish oils to make a rounded supplement of

omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids. For digestive problems, psyllium husks, plantain, and marshmallow serve as good

alternatives.

替代品和添加剂：琉璃苣籽油、月见草油和黑醋栗籽油也是 EFA 的极好来源。亚麻籽油可与鱼肝油或其他

鱼油混合，制成全面的 omega-3 和 omega-6 脂肪酸补充剂。对于消化问题，车前子壳、车前草和棉花糖都

是很好的替代品。

Cautions and Comments: Dry flaxseeds should be fed with plenty of water, otherwise digestive upset and

discomfort may result from rapid expansion of the seed fibers in the digestive tract. The best way to avoid this

possibility is to premix flaxseed with water prior to feeding or to use a balanced flaxseed formula that is specially

designed to be used in powder form.

注意事项和评论：干亚麻籽应喂大量的水，否则种子纤维在消化道中快速膨胀可能会导致消化不良和不

适。避免这种可能性的最佳方法是在喂食前将亚麻籽与水预混合，或使用专为粉末形式使用而设计的平衡

亚麻籽配方。

GARLIC

蒜

Allium sativum

大蒜

Lily Family

百合家族

Appearance: Need we describe garlic? It’s what makes Italian dishes worthwhile. It is the aromatic bulb that repels

vampires yet attracts hungry people with its nose-tantalizing, mouthwatering scent. While most of us can readily

identify a head of garlic in the supermarket, relatively few of us are familiar with the living green plant. Garlic is a

member of the Allium genus, a branch of the lily family that also includes hundreds of varieties of onions, leeks,

chives, and shallots. In terms of appearance, the numerous varieties of garlic are differentiated from what we know

as onions by the nature of their bulbs (commonly known as heads) and their leaves. Commercial varieties of garlic

produce heads that are divided into segments (cloves), whereas onion bulbs are comprised of singular, multilayered

globes. Garlic leaves are characteristically flat and almost grasslike, whereas most onions’ leaves tend to be hollow

and erect. Shallot leaves fall somewhere in between. For the purposes of holistic healing, it’s important to know that

all of the Allium species come from the same source—nature. All of the various colors and shapes of onions, garlic,

and their relatives have originated from wild Allium species that range throughout the world. On the slopes

surrounding our Montana home, several species of wild Allium are among the first greens to emerge from the

receding snows of early spring. With their emergence come winter-weary bears, grouse, deer, elk, and moose, all of

whom wish to indulge, if only briefly, in a snack of garliclike wild onions. As one watches these animals while they

browse, it soon becomes apparent that they eat wild onions and garlic to fill some instinctive need other than hunger

—they pick and choose only a few select plants, then move on to others. Could it be they know something we don’t?

Certainly! It is obvious that nature put the Allium genus here for reasons far deeper than epicurean delight.

Fortunately for those who cannot forage the wilds of North America on behalf of their pets, the “supermarket

varieties” of garlic are of optimum medicinal potency.

外观：我们需要描述大蒜吗？这就是意大利菜物有所值的原因。它是一种芳香的球茎，可以驱除吸血鬼，

但又以其诱人的鼻子、令人垂涎欲滴的气味吸引饥饿的人。虽然我们大多数人都能轻易地在超市里辨认出

一头大蒜，但我们很少有人熟悉这种活生生的绿色植物。大蒜是葱属的一种，是百合科的一个分支，还包

括数百种洋葱、韭菜、细香葱和青葱。就外观而言，众多大蒜品种与我们所知的洋葱的区别在于其球茎

（通常称为头）和叶子的性质。商业品种的大蒜产生的头被分成多个部分（丁香），而洋葱球茎则由单个

多层球体组成。大蒜的叶子通常是扁平的，几乎像草一样，而大多数洋葱的叶子往往是中空的且直立的。

青葱叶介于两者之间。为了整体治疗的目的，重要的是要知道所有葱属植物都来自同一个来源——大自

然。所有各种颜色和形状的洋葱、大蒜及其近缘种都起源于遍布世界各地的野生葱属物种。在我们蒙大拿

州家园周围的山坡上，几种野生葱属植物是早春消融的积雪中最早长出的绿色植物之一。随着它们的出

现，厌冬的熊、松鸡、鹿、麋鹿和驼鹿也随之出现，所有这些动物都想吃点像大蒜一样的野洋葱零食，哪

怕只是短暂的。当人们在这些动物浏览时观察它们，很快就会发现它们吃野洋葱和大蒜是为了满足除饥饿

之外的一些本能需求——它们只采摘和选择几种精选植物，然后转向其他植物。 难道他们知道一些我们不

知道的事情吗？当然！显然，大自然将葱属植物放在这里的原因远比享乐主义的快乐更深层次。幸运的

是，对于那些无法代表宠物在北美野外觅食的人来说，“超市品种”的大蒜具有最佳的药用功效。

Habitat and Range: It has been theorized that garlic’s wild ancestors originated from west-central Asia. Garlic’s

use as a medicine dates back at least five thousand years, and since then hundreds of cultivars have been propagated

worldwide. In North America, dozens of varieties can be found in open forest clearings and grasslands at foothill to

subalpine elevations. Most are montane residents.

=== PAGE 188 ===
栖息地和分布范围：据推测，大蒜的野生祖先起源于亚洲中西部。大蒜作为药物的使用至少可以追溯到五

千年前，从那时起，数百个品种已在世界范围内传播。在北美，在山麓至亚高山海拔的开阔森林空地和草

原上可以找到数十种品种。大多数是山区居民。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Although commercial varieties are typically harvested during their first year of growth

when the bulbs are prime, most Allium species are self-seeding perennials that bloom in midsummer.

周期和开花季节：虽然商业品种通常是在球茎生长的第一年收获的，但大多数葱属物种都是自花多年生植

物，在仲夏开花。

Parts Used: Bulb (the segments of which are called cloves)

使用的部分：球茎（其部分称为丁香）

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antibacterial, stimulates the immune system, anticancer, nutritive, antioxidant,

expectorant, lowers blood pressure, antitumor, antiviral, antifungal, tonic

主要药用活性：抗菌、刺激免疫系统、抗癌、营养、抗氧化、祛痰、降低血压、抗肿瘤、抗病毒、抗真

菌、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Liver, blood, cardiovascular system, immune system

最强的亲和力：肝脏、血液、心血管系统、免疫系统

Preparation: Fresh, dried, tincture, or oil infusion

制剂：新鲜、干燥、酊剂或油浸剂

Common Uses: Garlic contains considerable amounts of protein, fiber, potassium, phosphorus, calcium, sodium,

vitamin A, thiamine, niacin, taurine, zinc, riboflavin, and dozens of other nutritive compounds. A single clove of

fresh garlic may contain as much as one hundred sulfur compounds, all of which have been shown to possess

medicinal qualities.

常见用途：大蒜含有大量的蛋白质、纤维、钾、磷、钙、钠、维生素 A、硫胺素、烟酸、牛磺酸、锌、核

黄素和数十种其他营养化合物。一瓣新鲜大蒜可能含有多达一百种硫化合物，所有这些化合物都已被证明

具有药用价值。

Most of us who read the ads and labels for garlic preparations or supplements at health food stores are continually

reminded of allicin—a volatile oil constituent of garlic. Once believed to be the definitive factor in garlic’s healing

abilities, allicin represents only a segment of garlic’s complex, medicinally versatile chemistry. This is not to say

that allicin is not useful; actually it is one of the most impressive broad-spectrum antimicrobial substances available

in nature, with dozens of scientific studies to back up this claim. Researchers have found that allicin may be more

effective against harmful microbes than tetracycline, a frequently prescribed antibiotic drug. And unlike

conventional antibiotics, garlic works against many forms of virus and won’t compromise populations of beneficial

flora in the digestive tract when ingested in the appropriate amounts.

我们大多数人在保健食品商店看到大蒜制剂或补充剂的广告和标签时，都会不断地想起大蒜素——大蒜

的一种挥发油成分。大蒜素一度被认为是大蒜治愈能力的决定性因素，但它仅代表大蒜复杂的、具有药用

价值的化学成分的一部分。这并不是说大蒜素没有用；而是说大蒜素没有用处。事实上，它是自然界中最

令人印象深刻的广谱抗菌物质之一，有数十项科学研究支持这一说法。研究人员发现，大蒜素可能比常用

抗生素药物四环素更有效地对抗有害微生物。与传统抗生素不同的是，大蒜可以对抗多种病毒，并且在摄

入适量时不会损害消化道中的有益菌群。

Despite its clear value as a healing agent, allicin is not the only healing agent in garlic worth considering. In fact,

the presence of allicin in garlic preparations is not required at all in many situations where garlic may prove

=== PAGE 189 ===
beneficial. At least thirty other compounds that are contained in garlic have been shown to be useful for conditions

that range from skin disorders to cancer.

尽管大蒜素作为治疗剂具有明显的价值，但它并不是大蒜中唯一值得考虑的治疗剂。事实上，在大蒜可

能有益的许多情况下，根本不需要大蒜制剂中含有大蒜素。大蒜中含有的至少三十种其他化合物已被证明

可用于治疗从皮肤病到癌症的各种疾病。

Allicin is an unstable compound that dissipates quickly when exposed to air, moisture, or heat. Unless special

measures are taken to preserve it, the allicin content in many garlic preparations are nil by the time they reach

someone who needs them. To confront this dilemma, several garlic preparations that have been “standardized to

allicin” are available on the market. These extracts, powders, capsules, and tablets have had a certain percentage of

allicin added in the laboratory to “guarantee their potency.” Such formulas are safe and effective when used properly

for specific antimicrobial purposes but are generally unnecessary and expensive for use in most other instances

where garlic is indicated. And, despite the claims of many manufacturers, consumers can’t tell if the allicin content

in a standardized preparation still exists at the time of use. Unless a laboratory analysis is performed after the

product has reached store shelves, there’s no way of knowing whether the allicin’s potency has vanished from the

formula.

大蒜素是一种不稳定的化合物，当暴露于空气、湿气或热量时会迅速消散。除非采取特殊措施来保存，

否则许多大蒜制品中的大蒜素含量在到达需要它们的人手中时已经为零。为了解决这一难题，市场上出现

了几种“大蒜素标准化”的大蒜制剂。这些提取物、粉末、胶囊和片剂在实验室中添加了一定比例的大蒜

素，以“保证其效力”。当正确用于特定抗菌目的时，此类配方是安全有效的，但在需要使用大蒜的大多数

其他情况下通常没有必要且昂贵。而且，尽管许多制造商声称，消费者在使用时无法判断标准化制剂中的

大蒜素含量是否仍然存在。除非在产品上架后进行实验室分析，否则无法知道大蒜素的效力是否已从配方

中消失。

Before you use a standardized formula, try to find out how the manufacturer can guarantee the allicin content in

the product after it leaves the lab. If the company’s answer is satisfactory, then bear in mind that many of garlic’s

other medicinal constituents may be absent or overpowered by an unnatural abundance of allicin and that you will

be using garlic in a manner beyond nature’s design. Regardless of what the manufacturer might say, nature endows

garlic with a specific amount of allicin as well as hundreds of other compounds that serve unified purposes.

在使用标准化配方之前，请尝试了解制造商如何保证产品出厂后的大蒜素含量。如果该公司的答案令人

满意，那么请记住，大蒜的许多其他药用成分可能不存在或被非自然丰富的大蒜素所压倒，并且您将以超

出自然设计的方式使用大蒜。不管制造商怎么说，大自然赋予大蒜特定数量的大蒜素以及数百种其他具有

统一用途的化合物。

When we isolate a single constituent from the whole plant, we are no longer working within a natural context, and

we limit the healing potential of that plant to the confines of what we know, as opposed to what might be possible.

While scientists are beginning to understand how single chemical elements and compounds work in or on the body,

we still know very little about how they work in a synergistic capacity. In this realm, just beyond our understanding,

a great many healing secrets are waiting to be discovered. Any good herbalist will tell you that the whole is always

greater than the sum of its parts.

当我们从整个植物中分离出单一成分时，我们就不再在自然环境中工作，并且我们将该植物的治疗潜力

限制在我们所知道的范围内，而不是可能的范围。虽然科学家们开始了解单一化学元素和化合物如何在体

内或体内发挥作用，但我们对它们如何协同发挥作用仍然知之甚少。在这个超出我们理解的领域，有许多

治愈的秘密等待着我们去发现。任何优秀的草药医生都会告诉你，整体总是大于部分之和。

=== PAGE 190 ===
Allium sativum

大蒜

The chemical complexity of garlic is good news for the self-reliant herbalist because in addition to allicin, garlic

contains a multitude of compounds that are stable and easy to use. Despite its widespread recognition as a healthy

food for humans, garlic demands some added respect, caution, and therapeutic consideration if it is to be used

effectively in the care of animals. Here are three general rules of proper use:

大蒜的化学复杂性对于自力更生的草药师来说是个好消息，因为除了大蒜素之外，大蒜还含有多种稳定

且易于使用的化合物。尽管大蒜被广泛认为是人类的健康食品，但如果要将其有效地用于动物护理，则需

要更多的尊重、谨慎和治疗考虑。以下是正确使用的三个一般规则：

• Allicin is essential in applications where garlic is to be used as a natural form of antibiotic but may not be

necessary if you are using garlic for general health maintenance or other purposes.

• 大蒜素在将大蒜用作天然形式抗生素的应用中是必不可少的，但如果您将大蒜用于一般健康维护或其

他目的，则可能没有必要。

• If you wish to employ garlic as an antibiotic, you need to use raw garlic or raw garlic juice within three hours

of chopping or pressing the fresh cloves, or you need a good garlic extract from a reputable source. A

properly dried garlic powder may be useful for internal antibiotic applications as well, though only a residual

trace of allicin remains in the powder until it is used. In this case, two compounds, alliin and allinase, meet

with enzymes to form allicin as they enter the mouth. The allicin then does its work within the body—from

the inside out.

• 如果您希望使用大蒜作为抗生素，您需要在切碎或压榨新鲜丁香后的三个小时内使用生大蒜或生蒜

汁，或者您需要来自信誉良好的来源的优质大蒜提取物。适当干燥的大蒜粉也可用于内部抗生素应

用，尽管在使用之前粉末中仅残留微量大蒜素。在这种情况下，两种化合物，蒜氨酸和蒜酶，在进

入口腔时与酶相遇形成大蒜素。然后大蒜素在体内从内到外发挥作用。

If you use garlic as a topical antibiotic, bear in mind that raw garlic juice is strong and may cause acute reddening

and irritation of skin and mucous membranes if applied undiluted. Cut the juice with olive oil, vegetable glycerin, or

=== PAGE 191 ===
water at a starting rate of one part pure garlic juice to two parts inert liquid (oil, water, etc.). If irritation persists,

further dilute the juice. Such problems can be avoided by infusing fresh cloves of garlic directly into olive oil.

如果您使用大蒜作为局部抗生素，请记住，生蒜汁的味道很浓，如果未稀释就使用，可能会导致皮肤和粘

膜急性发红和刺激。用橄榄油、植物甘油或水切汁，起始比例为一份纯大蒜汁与两份惰性液体（油、水

等）。如果刺激持续存在，请进一步稀释果汁。通过将新鲜大蒜直接注入橄榄油中可以避免此类问题。

• If you wish to use garlic as a cancer-inhibiting antioxidant agent, immunesystem enhancer, blood-thinning

agent, cardiovascular tonic, or nutritional supplement, any form of garlic will probably have the desired

results. Perhaps the only exceptions are preparations of garlic that have been subjected to heat such as

pickled, sautéed, boiled, roasted, or otherwise hyperheated cloves that have likely been depleted of their

medicinal potential and a considerable percentage of their nutrients.

• 如果您希望使用大蒜作为抗癌抗氧化剂、免疫系统增强剂、血液稀释剂、心血管补品或营养补充剂，

任何形式的大蒜都可能达到预期效果。也许唯一的例外是经过加热（例如腌制、炒、煮、烤）的大

蒜制品，或其他过热的丁香，这些大蒜的药用潜力和相当大比例的营养成分可能已经耗尽。

Used properly and in the correct form, garlic is valuable for treatment of virtually any form of internal or external

bacterial, viral, or fungal infection, including parasites (such as tapeworms) and protozoan organisms (such as

Giardia). Fresh garlic or properly dried powder (from a reputable market source) can be fed as part of your animal’s

diet to fight infections of the mouth, throat, respiratory tract, stomach, or intestines. In sheep, goats, and cows, it is

said to help alleviate mastitis. Freshly crushed garlic or fresh garlic juice can be infused or diluted into olive oil for

use as a topical antiseptic for minor injuries, ear infections, or mites. The rule here is to be sure the garlic is diluted

sufficiently—the volatile oils are strong and can cause burning irritation if applied to the skin in concentrated form.

Never apply essential oil of garlic to any part of the body; it’s too concentrated. And never use garlic preparations in

the eyes.

如果使用得当且形式正确，大蒜对于治疗几乎任何形式的内部或外部细菌、病毒或真菌感染都很有价值，

包括寄生虫（如绦虫）和原生动物（如贾第鞭毛虫）。新鲜大蒜或适当干燥的粉末（来自信誉良好的市场

来源）可以作为动物饮食的一部分，以对抗口腔、喉咙、呼吸道、胃或肠道的感染。据说它有助于缓解绵

羊、山羊和牛的乳腺炎。新鲜压碎的大蒜或新鲜大蒜汁可以注入或稀释到橄榄油中，用作轻伤、耳部感染

或螨虫的局部防腐剂。这里的规则是确保大蒜被充分稀释——挥发油很强，如果以浓缩形式涂在皮肤上会

引起灼烧刺激。切勿将大蒜精油涂抹在身体的任何部位；太集中了。切勿在眼睛中使用大蒜制剂。

To use in topical applications, you don’t need much garlic—just enough to impart a mild garlic odor to the oil. To

make a garlic oil, crush two or three cloves of garlic, wet them with vodka to help release the oils, and cover them

with 4 ounces of olive oil. Shake the mixture vigorously and let it stand in the refrigerator for an hour before using.

The oil should have an obvious, but not overpowering, garlic odor. Within three to twenty-four hours, the allicin will

begin dissipating from your oil, and its usefulness for killing microbes will be diminished. But don’t discard it. It

still possesses immune-supporting and disease-preventing qualities, and it can be added to your pet’s meals. Use ½

to 1 level teaspoon per pound of food per feeding, depending on the oil’s strength. Keep your garlic oil in the

refrigerator in a glass jar with a tight-fitting lid. Expect it to keep for no more than a month. Contrary to what many

believe, garlic will not act as its own preservative, and old garlic oil may develop botulism—a bacteria that can be

deadly to animals and people. The added alcohol (vodka) is not enough to prevent botulism either, but adding ¼

teaspoon of vitamin E oil to the garlic oil before it goes into the refrigerator will help extend its shelf life while

adding a new element of nutritional support. As you can see, this justifies the task of making your own oil. Many

commercially prepared oils produced from raw garlic offer no information on how long they will remain fresh and

effective.

要用于局部应用，不需要太多大蒜，只要足以赋予油温和的大蒜气味即可。要制作大蒜油，请压碎两到

三瓣大蒜，用伏特加浸湿以帮助释放大蒜油，然后用 4 盎司橄榄油覆盖它们。使用前用力摇匀混合物并在

冰箱中静置一小时。油应具有明显但不浓烈的大蒜气味。三到二十四小时内，大蒜素就会开始从油中消

散，其杀死微生物的作用也会减弱。但不要丢弃它。它仍然具有支持免疫和预防疾病的特性，可以添加到

宠物的膳食中。每次喂食每磅食物使用 ½ 至 1 平茶匙，具体取决于油的浓度。将大蒜油存放在带密封盖的

玻璃罐中，并存放在冰箱中。预计其保存时间不会超过一个月。与许多人的看法相反，大蒜本身并不能起

到防腐剂的作用，而且陈旧的大蒜油可能会产生肉毒杆菌中毒——一种对动物和人类来说可能致命的细

菌。添加的酒精（伏特加）也不足以预防肉毒杆菌中毒，但在大蒜油放入冰箱之前添加 1/4 茶匙维生素 E

油将有助于延长其保质期，同时添加新的营养支持元素。正如您所看到的，这证明了自己生产石油的任务

=== PAGE 192 ===
是合理的。许多由生大蒜生产的商业制备油没有提供有关其保持新鲜和有效时间的信息。

Scientific studies have shown that various compounds in garlic stimulate immune functions in the bloodstream at

levels of activity that are unparalleled by any other herb (yes, even by echinacea). Perhaps most intriguing is garlic’s

effect on the body’s natural killer cells—those cells that seek out and destroy cancer cells and invading microbes. In

a study conducted with human subjects who have AIDS, garlic was found to increase killer cell activity threefold.

Similar animal studies have been conducted with similar results. Given the fact that these studies were done on

subjects with depressed immune functions, it stands to reason that companion animals with healthy immune

functions may benefit from the added measure of immune support supplied through moderate garlic

supplementation in their diets.

科学研究表明，大蒜中的各种化合物可以刺激血液中的免疫功能，其活性水平是任何其他草药（是的，

甚至紫锥菊）都无法比拟的。也许最有趣的是大蒜对人体自然杀伤细胞的影响，这些细胞寻找并摧毁癌细

胞和入侵微生物。在对患有艾滋病的人类受试者进行的一项研究中，发现大蒜可以使杀伤细胞活性增加三

倍。类似的动物研究也得到了类似的结果。鉴于这些研究是针对免疫功能低下的受试者进行的，因此有理

由认为，具有健康免疫功能的伴侣动物可能会受益于通过在饮食中适量补充大蒜而提供的额外免疫支持措

施。

A 1988 study found that diallyl sulfide, a garlic constituent, prevented tumor formation in rats, and several other

studies have shown that garlic inhibits various forms of cancerous growths in the body. This effect may be

attributable to the liver-strengthening actions of at least six garlic components. In this capacity, garlic gently

enhances overall liver function and triggers enzyme responses to help break down waste materials before they go

into the bloodstream. In other words, garlic helps the liver cleanse the body and thus helps prevent toxic

accumulations that may lead to cancerous growths. Garlic also helps to lower blood cholesterol and triglyceride

levels, making it useful for miniature schnauzers, beagles, and other breeds that may be predisposed to

hyperlipidemia—a condition that may lead to chronic seizures. Any form of uncooked garlic performs these

functions, and its use is as simple as sprinkling it onto an animal’s food. A once-a-day dosage of ⅛–¼ teaspoon

(powdered or freshly chopped) per pound of food fed is usually sufficient for most animals.

1988 年的一项研究发现，大蒜的一种成分二烯丙基硫醚可以预防大鼠肿瘤的形成，其他几项研究也表明

大蒜可以抑制体内各种形式的癌症生长。这种作用可能归因于至少六种大蒜成分的强化肝脏作用。通过这

种能力，大蒜可以温和地增强整体肝功能，并引发酶反应，帮助在废物进入血液之前将其分解。换句话

说，大蒜有助于肝脏净化身体，从而有助于防止可能导致癌症生长的毒素积累。大蒜还有助于降低血液胆

固醇和甘油三酯水平，这对于迷你雪纳瑞、比格犬和其他可能易患高脂血症的品种非常有用，高脂血症可

能导致慢性癫痫发作。任何形式的生大蒜都具有这些功能，其使用方法就像将其撒在动物的食物上一样简

单。对于大多数动物来说，每天一次的剂量为每磅食物 ⅛–¼ 茶匙（粉末或新鲜切碎）。

We have seen very good results from the use of garlic against tapeworms. Used in powdered, fresh, or extract

forms, garlic might not kill these persistent parasites, but it will make their living quarters much less desirable.

Intestinal parasites don’t seem to like volatile oils or sulfur compounds, and if fed to an animal in correct dosages

over a period of one to two months, garlic helps to drive these pests out. In our experiences with dogs, an increase in

visible tapeworm segments in an animal’s stool is likely to occur after two to three weeks of daily garlic ingestion.

After about two months, populations of these parasites are usually back to acceptable levels, or they may disappear

completely.

我们已经看到使用大蒜对抗绦虫的效果非常好。以粉末、新鲜或提取物的形式使用大蒜可能不会杀死这

些持久性寄生虫，但会使它们的居住环境变得不太理想。肠道寄生虫似乎不喜欢挥发油或硫化合物，如果

在一到两个月内以正确剂量喂给动物，大蒜有助于驱除这些害虫。根据我们对狗的经验，每天摄入大蒜两

到三周后，动物粪便中可见的绦虫片段可能会增加。大约两个月后，这些寄生虫的数量通常会恢复到可接

受的水平，或者可能完全消失。

Garlic works in a similar fashion against protozoan infestations such as giardiasis, but in these cases a strong

presence of allicin is needed to be effective. Use fresh garlic and add Oregon grape root to your animal’s diet. This

adds an antimicrobial “double punch” against these tough organisms.

大蒜以类似的方式对抗贾第鞭毛虫病等原生动物感染，但在这些情况下，需要大量大蒜素才能有效。使

用新鲜大蒜并将俄勒冈葡萄根添加到动物的饮食中。这增加了针对这些顽固微生物的抗菌“双重打击”。

Garlic is one of the best all-around cardiovascular tonics in the plant world. In studies conducted in collaboration

with the New York Department of Health, a component called ajoene found in both fresh and dried forms of garlic

=== PAGE 193 ===
was found to be effective at preventing the formation of blood clots in the vascular system. In some provinces of

France, racehorses suffering from blood clots are routinely fed garlic in their grain feed, and, as a result, the clots

sometimes disappear in a matter of days. In fact, many researchers believe that garlic may be as useful as aspirin in

this capacity, which makes it especially promising for use in cats since they cannot tolerate the salicylate

constituents of aspirin. Garlic has also been shown to reduce cholesterol levels and the occurrence of atherosclerosis

(fat buildup in the arteries) in both animals and humans, thus reducing the possibility of stroke or heart attack. All of

these attributes, combined with the immune-supportive, liver-strengthening capabilities of garlic, make this herb an

excellent multisystem tonic for older animals—especially dogs, who tolerate regular feeding of garlic better than

cats do.

大蒜是植物界最好的全能心血管补品之一。在与纽约卫生部合作进行的研究中，发现在新鲜和干燥大蒜

中发现的一种称为阿霍烯的成分可以有效防止血管系统中血栓的形成。在法国的一些省份，患有血栓的赛

马通常在谷物饲料中添加大蒜，因此血栓有时会在几天内消失。事实上，许多研究人员认为，大蒜在这方

面可能与阿司匹林一样有用，这使得它特别适合用于猫，因为它们不能耐受阿司匹林的水杨酸盐成分。大

蒜还被证明可以降低动物和人类的胆固醇水平和动脉粥样硬化（动脉中脂肪堆积）的发生，从而降低中风

或心脏病发作的可能性。所有这些特性，再加上大蒜的免疫支持和增强肝脏的功能，使这种草药成为老年

动物的极佳多系统补品，尤其是狗，它们比猫更能耐受定期喂食大蒜。

Garlic’s effectiveness as a systemic flea or mosquito repellent is the subject of a great deal of debate among those

who have tried it. Some people claim good results; others believe that the usefulness of garlic in this capacity is

largely unfounded.

大蒜作为全身性跳蚤或蚊子驱避剂的有效性在尝试过大蒜的人中引起了大量争论。有些人声称效果很

好；有些人声称效果很好。其他人则认为大蒜的这种用途在很大程度上是没有根据的。

Availability: Supermarkets and health food retailers

可获得性：超市和保健食品零售商

Propagation and Harvest: Garlic is easy to grow. When sown in the fall, the plants thrive in even the harshest of

winter climates, usually producing bulbs by late summer. A sandy loam with a slightly alkaline pH level is the best

growing medium. In areas where winters are mild, the cloves can be pressed about 1 inch into the soil in late fall for

an early summer crop. In northern climes, plant your cloves 4 inches deep as late as you can still work the soil in

fall. Cover your planting with at least 6 inches of mulch. Expect to see sprouts shortly after the last hard frost. Garlic

should be harvested in midsummer to late summer, after the tops of the plants have died back. Dig up the bulbs, then

allow them to dry in the sun for two or three days before you store them in a cool, dry place indoors.

繁殖和收获：大蒜很容易生长。当秋天播种时，这些植物即使在最严酷的冬季气候下也能茁壮成长，通常

在夏末就长出球茎。 pH值呈弱碱性的沙质壤土是最好的生长介质。在冬季温和的地区，可以在秋末将丁香

压入土壤约 1 英寸，以收获初夏作物。在北方气候下，在秋季仍能耕作土壤时，将丁香种植 4 英寸深。用

至少 6 英寸厚的覆盖物覆盖您的植物。预计在最后一次严霜之后不久就会看到新芽。大蒜应该在仲夏至夏

末收获，待植株顶部枯死后。挖出球茎，然后让它们在阳光下干燥两到三天，然后将它们存放在室内阴凉

干燥的地方。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For topical treatment of bacterial infections, consider Oregon grape, Saint-John’s-wort,

bee balm, thyme, and chamomile as alternatives. For immune system and antioxidant support, investigate echinacea,

astragalus, licorice, alfalfa, red clover, and burdock as adjuncts or alternatives. For treating giardiasis and E. coli

infections, garlic combines well with Oregon grape or organically raised goldenseal.

替代品和辅助剂：对于细菌感染的局部治疗，可以考虑使用俄勒冈葡萄、圣约翰草、蜂香膏、百里香和洋

甘菊作为替代品。对于免疫系统和抗氧化支持，研究紫锥菊、黄芪、甘草、苜蓿、红三叶草和牛蒡作为辅

助剂或替代品。为了治疗贾第鞭毛虫病和大肠杆菌感染，大蒜与俄勒冈州葡萄或有机饲养的毛茛完美结

合。

Cautions and Comments: Toxic side effects from the consumption of garlic are rare in animals and humans alike,

=== PAGE 194 ===
but the possibility of harming your dog, your cat, or your herbivore with garlic does exist, and there is a growing

controversy about how much garlic is enough and how much is too much. At the root of this controversy is a

dangerous misconception: the notion that more garlic is always better. Despite all of the grand attributes we have

just described, moderation—the cardinal rule of all herb use—applies strictly to garlic, particularly when it is used in

cats.

注意和评论：食用大蒜产生的毒副作用在动物和人类中都很少见，但大蒜伤害你的狗、猫或食草动物的可

能性确实存在，并且关于大蒜的摄入量存在越来越多的争议足够了，多少就太多了。这场争论的根源是一

个危险的误解：认为大蒜越多越好。尽管我们刚刚描述了大蒜的所有重要属性，但适量（所有草药使用的

基本规则）严格适用于大蒜，特别是当它用于猫时。

When misused (used excessively or over an extended period), garlic may cause Heinz-body anemia, a potentially

life-threatening blood disease. Scientists theorize that two chemical compounds contained in garlic may be related to

this disorder: s-methyl cysteine sulfoxide, or n-propyl disuldhide. These compounds are believed to deplete a

naturally occurring glucose enzyme called Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD). This enzyme has a special

function of protecting the walls of red blood cells. Depletion of G6PD causes oxidative damage to the cells, thus

forming Heinz bodies and triggering the body to reject them from the bloodstream (usually via dark-colored urine).

If left unchecked, this process continues until the numbers of red blood cells are lowered to the point that the animal

becomes anemic and eventually dies. Fortunately, this nightmare is easily prevented with some common sense and a

few precautions.

如果误用（过量或长时间使用），大蒜可能会导致亨氏体贫血，这是一种可能危及生命的血液疾病。科

学家推测，大蒜中含有的两种化合物可能与这种疾病有关：s-甲基半胱氨酸亚砜或正丙基二硫醚。这些化合

物被认为会消耗一种天然存在的葡萄糖酶，称为葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶（G6PD）。这种酶具有保护红细胞壁

的特殊功能。 G6PD 的消耗会对细胞造成氧化损伤，从而形成亨氏小体并触发身体将其从血液中排出（通

常通过深色尿液）。如果不加以控制，这个过程会持续下去，直到红细胞数量降低到动物贫血并最终死亡

的程度。幸运的是，通过一些常识和一些预防措施，这个噩梦很容易避免。

Other side effects of garlic are more predictable and less threatening: digestive upset and gas when ingested (in

which case, reduce the dose and relieve the gas with chamomile) or redness and irritation when applied to the skin

(usually indicative of a preparation that is too concentrated).

大蒜的其他副作用更可预测且威胁较小：摄入时消化不良和胀气（在这种情况下，减少剂量并用洋甘菊

缓解胀气）或涂在皮肤上时发红和刺激（通常表明制剂是太集中）。

First, it stands to reason that animals with preexisting anemic conditions should not receive garlic internally in

any quantity. Puppies don’t begin reproducing new red blood cells until after six to eight weeks of age. Until then,

they need every red blood cell they are born with, so a diet that includes garlic is not appropriate for young puppies.

首先，按理说，患有贫血症的动物不应内服任何数量的大蒜。幼犬直到六到八周龄后才开始繁殖新的红

细胞。在那之前，它们需要与生俱来的每一个红细胞，因此包含大蒜的饮食不适合幼犬。

It’s important to know that the possibility of Heinz-body anemia is dose dependent, meaning the more garlic fed,

the greater the chances of a problem developing. While we still don’t know exactly how much is too much, most

recorded instances of Heinz-body anemia in animals involve the ingestion of large quantities of onions and other

garlic relatives, many of which are likely to contain much larger percentages of enzyme-depleting constituents than

a typical dose of garlic. Recorded cases of allium poisoning typically involve onion doses exceeding 0.5 percent of

the subject animals’ body weight—this means that a healthy 60-pound dog would have to eat a whole 5-ounce

onion, or several cloves of garlic, just to start the Heinz-body process. And since red blood cells are regenerated

quickly from the bone marrow, this grotesque overdose would probably have to be repeated several times on a

frequent basis to cause permanent harm. In further defense of garlic, several other foods can cause Heinz-body

anemia as well—large amounts of turnips, kale, rape, or anything rich in vitamin K may lead to the disorder,

especially in herbivores.

重要的是要知道亨氏小体贫血的可能性是剂量依赖性的，这意味着大蒜喂得越多，出现问题的可能性就

越大。虽然我们仍然不知道到底多少才算过量，但大多数有记录的动物亨氏小体贫血病例都涉及摄入大量

洋葱和其他大蒜亲戚，其中许多可能含有更高比例的酶-比典型剂量的大蒜消耗的成分。记录的葱中毒案例

通常涉及超过受试动物体重 0.5% 的洋葱剂量，这意味着一只 60 磅重的健康狗必须吃掉一整颗 5 盎司的洋

葱或几瓣大蒜，才能开始中毒。亨氏体过程。由于红细胞可以从骨髓中快速再生，这种奇怪的过量用药可

能需要经常重复几次才能造成永久性伤害。为了进一步保护大蒜，其他几种食物也会导致亨氏体贫血——

=== PAGE 195 ===
大量的萝卜、羽衣甘蓝、油菜或任何富含维生素 K 的食物都可能导致这种疾病，尤其是食草动物。

Small doses of garlic added to your companion animal’s food three or four days per week, perhaps 1/8 teaspoon

of garlic powder per pound of food fed, are probably going to be of great benefit to the overall health of your pet.

Just don’t overdo it.

每周三到四天在伴侣动物的食物中添加小剂量的大蒜，大约每磅食物添加 1/8 茶匙大蒜粉，可能会对宠物

的整体健康大有裨益。只是不要做得太过分。

Cats are much more sensitive to the side effects of garlic than dogs are, so they require more caution and attention

with its use. Watch for digestive upset and behavioral changes. And if your cat simply doesn’t want any garlic, don’t

force the issue. Your cat’s behavior may be more than just a finicky attitude—animals know their needs better than

we do.

猫对大蒜的副作用比狗更敏感，因此在使用大蒜时需要更加谨慎和注意。留意消化不良和行为变化。如

果你的猫根本不想要大蒜，不要强迫它。猫的行为可能不仅仅是一种挑剔的态度——动物比我们更了解自

己的需求。

Remember to use common sense and moderation and to have respect for garlic as more than just a table

condiment. No two animals are alike; one person’s miracle cure is another one’s poison. If you wish to use garlic in

a therapeutic capacity, get to know your animal first, then consult a professional (or carefully read the label on your

garlic product) before you proceed.

请记住使用常识和适度，并尊重大蒜不仅仅是一种餐桌调味品。没有两种动物是相同的；一个人的灵丹

妙药却是另一个人的毒药。如果您希望使用大蒜进行治疗，请先了解您的动物，然后在继续之前咨询专业

人士（或仔细阅读大蒜产品上的标签）。
