GINKGO

银杏

Ginkgo biloba

银杏叶

Ginkgo Family

银杏家族

Appearance: Characterized by its unique fan-shaped leaves, ginkgo is a slow-growing tree that may reach 100 feet

in height. A healthy tree can live to be one thousand years old. Ginkgo is one of the oldest plant medicines on earth.

In fact, it is one of the oldest species of trees still in existence.

外观：银杏树以其独特的扇形叶子为特征，是一种生长缓慢的树，最高可达 100 英尺。一棵健康的树可以

活到一千年。银杏是地球上最古老的植物药之一。事实上，它是现存最古老的树种之一。

Habitat and Range: It is estimated that the Ginkgo genus once included several hundred varieties that spanned the

globe for over two million years. Today, however, there is only one species, G. biloba, a native of China that has

been introduced into North America and most of Europe and Asia for ornamental and medicinal purposes.

栖息地和分布范围：据估计，银杏属曾经包括数百个品种，分布于全球超过两百万年。然而，如今只有一

种银杏，原产于中国，已被引入北美以及欧洲和亚洲大部分地区用于观赏和药用。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Ginkgo is a deciduous tree that blooms in early spring, just as the leaves are beginning to

develop into their fanlike shapes. Fruits (known as ginkgo nuts) develop and ripen by midsummer. The leaves turn

yellow and begin falling in early to late fall.

周期和开花季节：银杏是一种落叶树，在早春开花，此时叶子开始发育成扇形。果实（称为银杏果）在仲

夏发育并成熟。叶子变黄，并在初秋至晚秋开始掉落。

Parts Used: Although ginkgo nuts were used almost exclusively for thousands of years, the fall-harvested leaves are

of primary interest to contemporary herbalists.

使用部位：虽然数千年来几乎只使用银杏果，但当代草药学家对秋季收获的叶子最感兴趣。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Dilates blood vessels, anticoagulant, antioxidant, tonic

主要药用活性：扩张血管、抗凝、抗氧化、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Brain, circulatory system, eyes

最强的亲和力：大脑、循环系统、眼睛

Preparation: Tincture, tea, capsule

制剂：酊剂、茶、胶囊

Common Uses: Over four hundred scientific studies have been conducted to validate ginkgo’s effectiveness in both

=== PAGE 197 ===
animals and humans. In fact, in Germany and other European countries, G. biloba extract (commonly known as

GBE) is among the most frequently prescribed drugs of commerce.

常见用途：已经进行了四百多项科学研究来验证银杏对动物和人类的功效。事实上，在德国和其他欧洲国

家，银杏提取物（俗称 GBE）是最常用的商业处方药之一。

For a long time it was thought that almost all of ginkgo’s medicinal activity could be attributed to two groups of

chemical constituents: flavone glycosides and terpene lactones. Dozens of human and animal studies have shown

that these two groups of constituents act to improve blood circulation in small capillaries, a trait that makes gingko

especially useful in the treatment of various forms of vascular deficiency—including the effects of old age. But

current research indicates that these compounds represent only a small part of a complex array of interactive

components. Specifically, ginkgo inhibits the platelet aggregation factor (PAF), the mechanism that causes slow-

moving or obstructed blood to become “sticky” and begin forming into clots. Ginkgo does this especially well in

small capillaries that are particularly susceptible to blockage and that serve tissues that are not reached by larger

vessels such as areas of the brain, ears, and extremities. Ginkgo also helps regulate the tone and elasticity of blood

vessels, making them stronger and less susceptible to degenerative disease. These actions make ginkgo a first choice

cerebrovascular tonic for older animals. Increased blood flow in capillary-rich tissues of the brain means that the

brain is better fed and oxygenated, which in turn can reduce the likelihood of stroke and may equate to a longer,

higher-quality life for your pet. In fact, several studies have shown that the cerebrovascular activities of ginkgo may

be beneficial in treating degenerative age-related cases of chronic depression or abnormal behavior. If the brain is

not getting the blood it needs, mood and behavior will likely be affected—and Rover might start getting rather

snippy in his old age.

长期以来，人们认为银杏几乎所有的药用活性都可以归因于两组化学成分：黄酮苷和萜内酯。数十项人

类和动物研究表明，这两类成分可以改善小毛细血管的血液循环，这一特性使银杏在治疗各种形式的血管

缺陷（包括老年影响）方面特别有用。但目前的研究表明，这些化合物仅代表一系列复杂的相互作用成分

的一小部分。具体来说，银杏可以抑制血小板聚集因子（PAF），这种机制会导致流动缓慢或阻塞的血液

变得“粘稠”并开始形成凝块。银杏在小毛细血管中尤其有效，这些毛细血管特别容易堵塞，并且服务于较

大血管无法到达的组织，例如大脑、耳朵和四肢区域。银杏还有助于调节血管的张力和弹性，使它们更强

壮，不易患退行性疾病。这些作用使银杏成为老年动物的首选脑血管补品。富含毛细血管的大脑组织中的

血流量增加意味着大脑得到更好的喂养和充氧，这反过来又可以降低中风的可能性，并可能相当于您的宠

物的寿命更长、质量更高。事实上，多项研究表明，银杏的脑血管活性可能有益于治疗与年龄相关的慢性

抑郁症或异常行为的退化病例。如果大脑无法获得所需的血液，情绪和行为可能会受到影响，而罗弗在晚

年可能会开始变得脾气暴躁。

Most of the current hoopla surrounding ginkgo is focused on its use in the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease and

other forms of dementia, but its effectiveness as a vascular tonic in other parts of the body deserves equal

consideration. Ginkgo works as an effective vascular tonic throughout the body, especially in smaller, peripheral

capillaries of the legs, ears, and rectum. This makes it useful in a wide variety of circumstances where circulation

has been impaired by trauma, chronic or degenerative disease, or surgical intervention. By opening up and

strengthening the structural integrity of small capillaries in impaired areas, gingko improves circulation and enables

the body to heal itself more effectively, which is the primary goal of using herbal tonics.

当前围绕银杏的大部分宣传都集中在其用于治疗阿尔茨海默病和其他形式的痴呆症上，但其作为身体其

他部位血管补品的功效也值得同等考虑。银杏是一种有效的全身血管补品，特别是在腿部、耳朵和直肠的

较小的外围毛细血管中。这使得它在因创伤、慢性或退行性疾病或手术干预而导致循环受损的各种情况下

都很有用。通过打开和加强受损区域小毛细血管的结构完整性，银杏可以改善血液循环，使身体更有效地

自我修复，这是使用草药滋补品的主要目标。

Ginkgo also has been used for hundreds of years as a tonic for weak kidney function. While relatively little

research has been conducted to validate such use, ginkgo’s effectiveness in this capacity is likely attributable to the

same vascular tonic activities since the kidney is a blood-dependent organ. In fact, its vulnerability and demise in the

event of diminished blood supply is second only to the brain. In recent months, we have heard from veterinarians

and pet owners who have been using an herbal combination that includes ginkgo and hawthorn in the treatment of

early-stage renal failure. The anecdotal reports claim a general improvement in kidney function. This makes sense

because hawthorn acts to reduce blood pressure as it increases circulation within the larger arteries, while ginkgo

serves to open and tonify the smaller vessels.

=== PAGE 198 ===
数百年来，银杏一直被用作肾功能虚弱的补品。虽然验证这种用途的研究相对较少，但银杏在这种能力

方面的有效性可能归因于相同的血管强直活动，因为肾脏是一个血液依赖性器官。事实上，当血液供应减

少时，其脆弱性和死亡仅次于大脑。近几个月来，我们从兽医和宠物主人那里听说，他们一直在使用银杏

和山楂的草药组合来治疗早期肾衰竭。传闻称肾功能总体改善。这是有道理的，因为山楂可以增加大动脉

内的循环，从而降低血压，而银杏则可以打开和强化较小的血管。

Ginkgo biloba

银杏叶

In addition to its vascular actions, ginkgo also works as a nervous system tonic in the brain. Although the

mechanisms of its neurological activity are complex and still hold many mysteries, studies indicate that ginkgo

somehow increases energy levels in the brain and stimulates the release of various neurotransmitters, many of which

regulate constriction of important smooth-muscle tissues throughout the body—such as those of the heart, bladder,

and uterus. The fact that ginkgo works to influence brain function in ways that are exclusive of its circulatory

activities makes for a broad scope of therapeutic usefulness. In many cases, urinary incontinence, seizures, various

forms of neuralgia, skin problems, chronic digestive upset, cardiac arrhythmia, and behavioral disorders (to name

just a few) may be the result of cerebrovascular or neurological dysfunction that might be relieved with the proper

use of ginkgo.

除了其血管作用外，银杏还可以作为大脑神经系统的滋补剂。尽管其神经活动的机制很复杂并且仍然存

在许多谜团，但研究表明银杏以某种方式增加大脑的能量水平并刺激各种神经递质的释放，其中许多神经

递质调节全身重要平滑肌组织的收缩，例如如心脏、膀胱和子宫。银杏以循环活动之外的方式影响大脑功

能，这一事实使其具有广泛的治疗用途。在许多情况下，尿失禁、癫痫发作、各种形式的神经痛、皮肤问

题、慢性消化不良、心律失常和行为障碍（仅举几例）可能是脑血管或神经功能障碍的结果，通过适当的

治疗可以缓解这些功能障碍。使用银杏。

Many studies suggest that GBEs have been standardized to contain at least 24 percent ginkgolides. In our opinion,

however, excellent results can be obtained from any high-quality extract of the leaves. A typical dose for elderly

animals or for those who exhibit early signs of cerebrovascular deficiency, kidney failure, or impaired circulation in

=== PAGE 199 ===
the extremities is anywhere between 0.25 milliliters and 0.75 milliliters of the liquid extract, two or three times daily

for each 50 pounds of the animal’s body weight. Exact dosage varies according to the specific circumstances of

disease, size of the animal, potency of the extract, and duration of use. In other words, you are advised to seek a

qualified holistic practitioner for a complete workup of your animal before proceeding with ginkgo therapy.

许多研究表明，GBE 已标准化为含有至少 24% 的银杏内酯。然而，我们认为，任何高质量的叶子提取物

都可以获得优异的结果。对于老年动物或表现出脑血管缺陷、肾衰竭或四肢循环受损早期症状的动物，典

型剂量为 0.25 毫升至 0.75 毫升液体提取物，每 50 磅每日 2 至 3 次。动物的体重。确切的剂量根据疾病的

具体情况、动物的大小、提取物的效力和使用时间而有所不同。换句话说，建议您在进行银杏疗法之前先

寻求合格的整体医生对您的动物进行全面检查。

Availability: Widely available through health food stores and herb retailers. Ginkgo trees are available through

landscape nurseries.

可获得性：可通过保健食品商店和草药零售商广泛购买。银杏树可通过景观苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Ginkgo trees are not difficult to grow—all they need is room to spread their roots, a

moderate climate (hardy in the southern two-thirds of North America), and some water from time to time. The

problem is that they are slow growers, with yearly growth often measured in fractions of an inch. If you are lucky

enough to have access to a mature ginkgo tree, however, take advantage of the fresh leaves, which are far superior to

the dried leaves that are available at herb stores. Analysis of ginkgo leaves indicates that the broadest diversity of

medicinal constituents is found when the leaves are just beginning to turn yellow (in the fall). Gather the leaves just

as they are turning yellow, before they fall from the tree and in advance of any evidence of mold on the leaf

surfaces. The leaves can then be used fresh to make tincture, or they can be dried for future use. The dried leaves

keep for about one year.

繁殖和收获：银杏树的生长并不困难——它们所需要的只是伸展根部的空间、温和的气候（北美南部三分

之二的地区耐寒）以及时不时的一些水。问题是它们的生长速度很慢，每年的生长速度通常只有不到一英

寸。然而，如果您足够幸运能够接触到一棵成熟的银杏树，那么可以利用新鲜的叶子，它们比药草店里出

售的干叶子要好得多。对银杏叶的分析表明，当叶子刚刚开始变黄（秋天）时，发现了最广泛的药用成分

多样性。在叶子变黄时、在叶子从树上掉落之前以及在叶子表面出现任何霉菌迹象之前收集叶子。然后可

以用新鲜的叶子来制作酊剂，或者可以将它们干燥以供将来使用。干燥的叶子可以保存一年左右。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Gingko combines well with hawthorn for cardiovascular or kidney disorders. For use

as a general vascular tonic, ginkgo can be combined with garlic, cayenne, or yarrow.

替代品和辅助品：银杏与山楂完美搭配，可治疗心血管或肾脏疾病。作为一般血管补品，银杏可以与大

蒜、辣椒或西洋蓍草混合使用。

Cautions and Comments: By most standards, ginkgo is safe. But because of its ability to inhibit platelet

aggregation in the blood, its use may be contraindicated in the presence of blood-thinning drugs or in animals with

blood-clotting disorders. While ginkgo improves the body’s ability to heal after surgery, its use should be delayed

until all risk of postoperative hemorrhage has passed.

注意事项和评论：按照大多数标准，银杏是安全的。但由于它能够抑制血液中的血小板聚集，因此在存在

血液稀释药物或患有凝血障碍的动物中可能禁忌使用它。虽然银杏可以提高身体术后愈合的能力，但应推

迟使用它，直到所有术后出血的风险都过去。

=== PAGE 200 ===
GOLDENROD

金棒

Solidago spp.

一枝黄花属

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Goldenrod is a common wayside weed that is easy to identify by its spire-shaped or triangular clusters

of tiny bright goldenrod-yellow flowers. The leaves of the most common species are narrowly lance-shaped and may

or may not have serrated edges. Plants are erect and range from 2 inches (Solidago multiradiata—mountain

goldenrod) to 70 inches (S. canadensis; S. occidentalis; S. gigantea) in height. Most species share similar

appearances. This is especially true of the larger species, which may differ only in leaf texture or the presence of

stem hairs.

外观：黄花是一种常见的路边杂草，很容易通过其尖顶状或三角形的小明亮黄花花簇来识别。最常见物种

的叶子呈窄矛状，可能有也可能没有锯齿状边缘。植物直立，高度从 2 英寸（一枝黄花——山黄花）到 70

英寸（加拿大一枝黄花、西方一枝黄花、巨花一枝黄花）不等。大多数物种都有相似的外观。对于较大的

物种尤其如此，它们可能仅在叶子纹理或茎毛的存在上有所不同。

Habitat and Range: The Solidago genus can be divided into two categories: those that grow in moist soils and

those that prefer drier habitats. Generally speaking, most of the smaller mountain varieties are found in dry soils,

often at the edges of forest roads or in open meadows. The larger varieties are common to river and lake habitats,

irrigated fields, drainage ditches, and so on, from below sea level to about 4,000 feet in elevation. Several species

are widespread throughout North America, with S. canadensis (Canada goldenrod) being perhaps the most common.

栖息地和范围：一枝黄花属可分为两类：生长在潮湿土壤中的一类和喜欢干燥栖息地的一类。一般来说，

大多数较小的山地品种都生长在干燥的土壤中，通常在森林道路的边缘或开阔的草地上。较大的品种常见

于河流和湖泊栖息地、灌溉田、排水沟等，从海平面以下到海拔约 4,000 英尺。有几种物种在北美广泛分

布，其中加拿大黄花（S. canadensis）可能是最常见的。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Perennial, sometimes annual. Blooms throughout the summer months

周期和开花季节：多年生，有时是一年生。整个夏季都盛开

Parts Used: Entire flowering plant—roots and all

使用部分：整个开花植物——根部和所有部分

Primary Medicinal Activities: Astringent, tonic, diuretic, reduces inflammation of respiratory mucosa

(anticatarrhal), strengthens kidney functions (nephritic), anti-inflammatory, helps prevent or eliminate urinary stones

(antilithic), antibacterial, antifungal, stops bleeding

主要药用活性：收敛剂、滋补剂、利尿剂、减少呼吸道粘膜炎症（抗卡他）、增强肾功能（肾炎）、抗

炎、帮助预防或消除尿路结石（抗结石）、抗菌、抗真菌、止血

Strongest Affinities: Respiratory tract, urinary tract, and kidneys

=== PAGE 201 ===
最强的亲和力：呼吸道、泌尿道和肾脏

Preparation: Dried herb, tincture, tea

准备：干草药、酊剂、茶

Common Uses: As with many common wayside weeds, goldenrod’s usefulness is usually overshadowed by that of

other herbs that have greater mass-market appeal. This is unfortunate because while many people spend their hard-

earned money on the latest herb sensation, a better alternative may be growing in profuse abundance just behind the

house. Goldenrod is one such herb. It is extremely useful but far less marketable than many others simply because it

is too abundant to give notice to.

常见用途：与许多常见的路边杂草一样，黄花的用途通常被其他具有更大大众市场吸引力的草药所掩盖。

这是不幸的，因为虽然许多人把辛苦赚来的钱花在最新的草药上，但更好的选择可能是在房子后面大量种

植。一枝黄花就是这样的一种草药。它非常有用，但远不如其他许多产品有销路，只是因为它太多而难以

引起注意。

Goldenrod is an excellent anticatarrhal, an herb that helps to reduce the production of mucus in the bronchi by

decreasing inflammation of the mucous membranes. While the production of mucus is essential in the body’s

holistic efforts to eliminate pathogens and waste products from the respiratory tract during bacterial, viral, or fungal

infections, reducing the irritation of swollen membranes helps to comfort the sufferer while making the overall

healing effort more productive. For dogs and cats, a teaspoon or two of a flower or leaf tea (made with a teaspoon of

the dried herb in 8 ounces of water, cooled to lukewarm) often brings quick relief for a persistent wet cough. Horses

and other large herbivores can be fed a handful or two of the fresh herb for the same purpose.

一枝黄花是一种极好的抗卡他药，它是一种通过减少粘膜炎症来帮助减少支气管粘液产生的草药。虽然

粘液的产生对于身体在细菌、病毒或真菌感染期间消除呼吸道中的病原体和废物的整体努力至关重要，但

减少肿胀的粘膜的刺激有助于安慰患者，同时使整体治疗工作更有成效。对于狗和猫来说，一两茶匙的花

茶或叶茶（用一茶匙的干草药与 8 盎司的水制成，冷却至微温）通常可以快速缓解持续的湿咳。出于同样

的目的，可以给马和其他大型食草动物喂一把或两把新鲜药草。

=== PAGE 202 ===
Solidago canadensis

加拿大一枝黄花

Although relatively little scientific research has been conducted into goldenrod’s effectiveness as a kidney tonic, it

has been used successfully in this capacity for hundreds of years. Specifically, goldenrod is said to boost renal

function quickly, making it especially helpful for acute cases of nephritis, especially where anuresis (an inability to

pass urine from the kidneys) is a prevalent symptom. Goldenrod can also be useful in preventing or assisting in the

elimination of kidney stones. However, the activities of goldenrod may be contraindicated in advanced chronic cases

of kidney disease, where stimulation of renal function may cause added stress to overworked kidneys. The various

mechanisms and pathologies of kidney disease are difficult to assess accurately, and finding the correct approach

should be left to your holistic veterinarian.

尽管对黄花作为补肾药的功效进行的科学研究相对较少，但它已经成功地使用了数百年。具体来说，黄

花据说可以快速增强肾功能，对急性肾炎特别有帮助，特别是在无尿（无法从肾脏排出尿液）为普遍症状

的情况下。一枝黄花还可用于预防或帮助消除肾结石。然而，在晚期慢性肾脏疾病中，黄花的活动可能是

禁忌的，因为刺激肾功能可能会给过度劳累的肾脏带来额外的压力。肾脏疾病的各种机制和病理学很难准

确评估，找到正确的方法应该留给您的整体兽医。

In topical applications, goldenrod has remarkable hemostatic qualities, especially when the dried and powdered

flowers are used. The powder can be applied liberally to stop bleeding and inhibit bacterial infection of minor cuts

and abrasions.

在局部应用中，一枝黄花具有显着的止血功效，特别是当使用干花和粉末时。大量涂抹粉末可止血并抑

制轻微割伤和擦伤的细菌感染。

Goldenrod may moderate allergic reactions to airborne pollen and other allergens if taken for several weeks prior

to the start of hay fever season.

如果在花粉热季节开始前几周服用一枝黄花，可能会减轻对空气中花粉和其他过敏原的过敏反应。

When a measured amount of goldenrod—a potentially allergenic plant—is introduced into the body just before

hay fever season, the body begins building its antiallergen defenses before the real onslaught.

=== PAGE 203 ===
当在花粉热季节之前将一定量的黄花（一种可能引起过敏的植物）引入体内时，身体会在真正的攻击之

前开始建立抗过敏防御系统。

Availability: Available through herb retailers; profusely abundant in vacant lots and forests throughout North

America, Europe, and Asia.

供货情况：可通过药草零售商购买；北美、欧洲和亚洲的空地和森林中资源丰富。

Propagation and Harvest: Harvest the entire plant when it is in full bloom. The entire plant can then be chopped

and made into a tincture, or it can be dried for later use in teas.

繁殖和收获：在盛开时收获整个植物。然后可以将整个植物切碎并制成酊剂，或者可以将其干燥以供以后

用于茶中。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For upper respiratory infections, goldenrod combines especially well with echinacea

and Oregon grape. Consider mullein, coltsfoot, wild cherry, marshmallow, slippery elm, and grindelia as adjuncts or

alternatives for coughs. Dandelion, couch grass, corn silk, ginkgo, uva ursi, marshmallow, echinacea, and hawthorn

should be investigated for treating urinary and kidney disorders.

替代品和辅助剂：对于上呼吸道感染，黄花与紫锥菊和俄勒冈葡萄的结合效果特别好。考虑使用毛蕊花、

款冬、野樱桃、棉花糖、滑榆和银杏作为止咳的辅助剂或替代品。蒲公英、茅草、玉米须、银杏、熊果、

棉花糖、紫锥花和山楂可用于治疗泌尿和肾脏疾病。

Cautions and Comments: Goldenrod has no known toxicity but may be contraindicated in animals with certain

forms of kidney disease. Although goldenrod is not as allergenic as once thought (often it is blamed for allergies

caused by ragweed and other plants), it should be used with caution in animals who are predisposed to pollen

allergies.

注意事项和评论：一枝黄花没有已知的毒性，但可能禁忌用于患有某些形式的肾脏疾病的动物。虽然一枝

黄花并不像人们想象的那样容易引起过敏（通常人们认为它是由豚草和其他植物引起的过敏），但对于容

易对花粉过敏的动物来说，应谨慎使用它。

=== PAGE 204 ===
GOLDENSEAL

金印章

Hydrastis canadensis

加拿大水螅

Buttercup Family

毛茛家族

Appearance: Goldenseal is a perennial that may grow to 12 inches in height. The main stem of the plant is typically

forked to produce two nearly circular 2-inch to 6-inch-wide leaves, one of which is usually larger than the other. The

leaves are deeply lobed, five to seven times, with toothed margins. The plant may require three or more years of

growth before it blooms, then it produces a single whitish green flower that has no petals. In midsummer, the flower

develops into a single raspberry-like red fruit that contains ten to thirty small seeds. Stems are hairy. The

horizontally creeping root is thick and woody. All parts of the root have deep goldenrod-yellow inner tissues.

外观：金印草是一种多年生植物，可长至 12 英寸高。植物的主茎通常分叉，产生两片近圆形的 2 英寸至 6

英寸宽的叶子，其中一片通常比另一片大。叶子深裂，五到七次，边缘有齿。这种植物可能需要三年或更

长时间才能开花，然后开出一朵没有花瓣的白绿色花朵。在仲夏，花朵会发育成一个覆盆子状的红色果

实，其中含有十到三十颗小种子。茎有毛。水平匍匐根厚而木质。根部各部分均有深金黄色的内组织。

Habitat and Range: The range and population of this North American native are rapidly diminishing. The original

range of goldenseal once included most of eastern North America—from Minnesota and Vermont south into

Georgia. Today, most remaining stands of wild goldenseal are isolated in the central and northern reaches of the

Appalachians and, to a lesser extent, the Ozark Mountains.

栖息地和分布范围：这种北美原住民的分布范围和数量正在迅速减少。金印章的原始分布范围曾经包括北

美东部的大部分地区——从明尼苏达州和佛蒙特州南部到佐治亚州。如今，大部分剩余的野生金印草群都

被隔离在阿巴拉契亚山脉的中部和北部地区，以及较小范围内的奥扎克山脉。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A long-lived perennial that blooms in early spring

周期和开花季节：一种长寿的多年生植物，在早春开花

Parts Used: Primarily the root; to a lesser extent the leaves

使用部位：主要是根；叶子在较小程度上

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antimicrobial, reduces inflammation of respiratory mucosa, tonic, astringent,

stimulates the liver, antiparasitic

主要药用活性：抗菌、减少呼吸道粘膜炎症、滋补、收敛、刺激肝脏、抗寄生虫

Strongest Affinities: Mucous membranes of the respiratory tract, lower urinary tract, gastrointestinal tract, mouth,

and eyes.

最强的亲和力：呼吸道、下尿路、胃肠道、口腔和眼睛的粘膜。

=== PAGE 205 ===
Preparation: Tincture, tea, or poultice

制剂：酊剂、茶或膏剂

Common Uses: Wild goldenseal is vanishing because of greed, sensationalism, and misinformed use. The greatest

misconception about goldenseal is that it acts as an herbal antibiotic in the body, coursing its way through the body

systems via the bloodstream to attack any pathogenic microbes in its path. This is untrue. Goldenseal does not act as

an antibiotic. In fact, the antimicrobial alkaloids of this plant (namely berberine and hydrastine) act only to inhibit

bacteria, fungi, parasites, and protozoan bodies that they come in direct contact with in the mouth, gastrointestinal

tract, and urinary tract. These infection-fighting compounds are not absorbed into the bloodstream; they simply act

as contact disinfectants. With this in mind, goldenseal can be used against a broad spectrum of pathogens, including

Streptococcus sp., Staphylococcus sp., Shigella dysenteriae, Salmonella, and several others.

常见用途：由于贪婪、哗众取宠和误导性使用，野生金印草正在消失。关于白毛茛最大的误解是，它在体

内充当草药抗生素，通过血液流经身体系统，攻击其路径上的任何病原微生物。这是不真实的。白毛茛不

充当抗生素。事实上，这种植物的抗菌生物碱（即小檗碱和Hydrastine）仅能抑制口腔、胃肠道和泌尿道中

直接接触的细菌、真菌、寄生虫和原生动物体。这些抗感染化合物不会被吸收到血液中；它们只是充当接

触消毒剂。考虑到这一点，白毛茛可用于对抗多种病原体，包括链球菌属、葡萄球菌属、痢疾志贺氏菌、

沙门氏菌等。

Hydrastis candadensis

加拿大水螅

As an anti-inflammatory, goldenseal is effective for ulcers and irritations of the mouth, upper respiratory tract,

eyes, and, to a lesser degree, the digestive and urinary tracts. A poultice made from the powdered root can be

applied directly to infections or ulcers in the mouth. Results are often seen within hours of application.

作为一种抗炎药，白毛茛对口腔、上呼吸道、眼睛以及消化道和泌尿道的溃疡和刺激有效。由根粉制成

的膏剂可以直接应用于口腔感染或溃疡。通常在应用后数小时内即可看到结果。

=== PAGE 206 ===
For conjunctivitis that is secondary to bacterial or fungal infection in dogs, cats, birds, ferrets, rodents, horses, or

reptiles, a goldenseal eyewash serves as a strong antimicrobial agent and also quickly reduces inflammation and

redness. To use goldenseal in this capacity, make a strong tea from the chopped dry root, then add 12–20 drops of

the dark golden-yellow fluid into 1 ounce of sterile saline solution—the liquid marketed for people with contact

lenses. A few drops in each eye (or a fraction of a drop for small birds, rodents, and such) two or three times daily

usually brings relief quickly. Internally, we like to use goldenseal in conjunction with garlic for ridding our dogs and

cats of tapeworms, and we have received good reports from veterinarians we work with who find this combination

useful for treating giardiasis or E. coli infections in dogs, cats, and larger animals. Studies of the active component

berberine substantiate these claims.

对于狗、猫、鸟类、雪貂、啮齿动物、马或爬行动物继发于细菌或真菌感染的结膜炎，金印莲洗眼液可

作为强效抗菌剂，并能快速减少炎症和发红。要使用金毛茛的这种功能，请用切碎的干根泡一杯浓茶，然

后将 12-20 滴深金黄色液体加入到 1 盎司无菌盐水溶液中（这是一种专为戴隐形眼镜的人销售的液体）。

每只眼睛滴几滴（对于小鸟、啮齿类动物等，滴一小滴），每天两到三次，通常会很快缓解症状。在内

部，我们喜欢将白毛茛与大蒜结合使用来消灭我们的狗和猫的绦虫，并且我们收到了与我们合作的兽医的

良好报告，他们发现这种组合有助于治疗狗、猫和猫的贾第鞭毛虫病或大肠杆菌感染。较大的动物。对活

性成分小檗碱的研究证实了这些说法。

Wild goldenseal is one of the most endangered wild medicinal plants in North America, and it is still being

exploited by the “bad apples” of the herb industry. Fortunately, goldenseal can be replaced (in most cases) with

Oregon grape root (Mahonia aquifolium), a naturally abundant member of the barberry family that also contains an

impressive amount of the active constituent berberine. The continued survival of wild goldenseal is totally

dependent on human conscience and responsibility—if you think you need goldenseal, give Oregon grape a try first.

Chances are you will be pleased with the results. If you still see a need for goldenseal, spend the extra money to buy

goldenseal roots or goldenseal preparations that have come from certified organic (cultivated) sources. If you use

wildcrafted goldenseal, you are contributing to the rapid demise of a great healing treasure that can never be

replaced.

野生白毛茛是北美最濒危的野生药用植物之一，至今仍被药草业的“害群之马”所利用。幸运的是，在大

多数情况下，白毛茛可以用俄勒冈葡萄根（Mahonia aquifolium）替代，这是伏牛花家族中天然丰富的成

员，还含有大量的活性成分小檗碱。野生白毛茛的持续生存完全取决于人类的良知和责任——如果你认为

你需要白毛茛，请先尝试一下俄勒冈葡萄。您很可能会对结果感到满意。如果您仍然需要金毛草，请花额

外的钱购买来自经过认证的有机（栽培）来源的金毛草根或金毛草制剂。如果你使用野生的金印章，你就

会导致这种永远无法替代的伟大治疗宝藏的迅速消亡。

Availability: Herb retailers. Please buy goldenseal harvested from a cultivated source only.

供货情况：药草零售商。请仅购买从栽培来源收获的金印章。

Propagation and Harvest: If you have a piece of ground that can support goldenseal, grow some. The future

success of this plant may depend on people like you. The best place to plant goldenseal is in the shade of a dense,

hardwood canopy of a north-facing hillside. The plant requires deep compost-rich, well-drained soil with a pH level

between 5.5 and 6.5. With enough shade and the right soil amendments, goldenseal can be propagated in a garden as

well.

繁殖和收获：如果你有一块土地可以种植金印章，就种植一些。该工厂未来的成功可能取决于像您这样的

人。种植毛茛的最佳地点是朝北山坡上茂密的硬木树冠的阴凉处。该植物需要富含堆肥、排水良好的深层

土壤，pH 值在 5.5 至 6.5 之间。只要有足够的遮荫和适当的土壤改良，金印章也可以在花园中繁殖。

Goldenseal can be propagated from stratified seeds or from rhizomes spaced 4 inches apart in rows that are 12

inches apart. Planting should occur in fall. Goldenseal requires at least four to five years (preferably seven) to reach

maturity.

白毛茛可以用分层种子或用间隔 4 英寸、间隔 12 英寸的根茎繁殖。播种应在秋季进行。金毛草至少需要

四到五年（最好是七年）才能成熟。

=== PAGE 207 ===
Alternatives and Adjuncts: In many applications where an antimicrobial or anticatarrhal is indicated, any number

of plants that contain the yellow alkaloid berberine can be employed in place of goldenseal. Choices include Oregon

grape (Mahonia sp.), twinleaf (Jeffersonia diphylla), or yerba mansa (Anemiopsis californica ). Before any of these

herbs are employed, however, a fundamental question of holistic responsibility should be addressed in the minds of

all earth-conscious herb users: Does substituting a wildcrafted herb for an overharvested one benefit the future of

wild medicinal plants, or does it simply defer impact onto another species? The fact that Oregon grape is an

abundant wild substitute is beside the point. Humanity is efficient at disturbing or depleting virtually anything on

earth, and when we elect to abandon one natural resource for another in the absence of proactive holistic thinking,

we are only contributing to a continuum of human impact. With this in mind, we should elect to use wild substitutes

only when cultivated goldenseal is not available. Coptis sinensis, a species of goldthread that is widely cultivated in

China, may also serve as an excellent substitute for goldenseal. A small portion of goldthread or goldenseal added to

echinacea serves as a direct-intervention “double-punch” for infections of the mouth, urinary tract, and

gastrointestinal tract, while the echinacea does its job at boosting the immune system.

替代品和辅助剂：在许多需要抗菌或抗卡他药的应用中，可以使用任意数量的含有黄色生物碱小檗碱的植

物来代替白毛茛。选择包括俄勒冈葡萄 (Mahonia sp.)、双叶葡萄 (Jeffersonia diphylla) 或 yerba mansa

(Anemiopsis californica)。然而，在使用任何一种草药之前，所有具有地球意识的草药使用者都应该解决一

个整体责任的基本问题：用野生制作的草药代替过度采收的草药是否有利于野生药用植物的未来，或者是

否有利于野生药用植物的未来？只是推迟对另一个物种的影响？俄勒冈葡萄是一种丰富的野生替代品，这

一事实并不是重点。人类能够有效地扰乱或耗尽地球上的几乎任何东西，当我们在缺乏主动整体思维的情

况下选择放弃一种自然资源而转向另一种自然资源时，我们只会对人类产生连续的影响。考虑到这一点，

我们应该选择仅在无法获得栽培金印草时才使用野生替代品。黄连是一种在中国广泛种植的黄连植物，也

可以作为黄印章的绝佳替代品。在紫锥菊中添加一小部分黄连或金毛草，可作为针对口腔、泌尿道和胃肠

道感染的直接干预“双拳”，而紫锥菊则发挥增强免疫系统的作用。

Cautions and Comments: Some animal studies have shown that berberine calms the uterus, but other studies show

that it stimulates uterine contractions, so it is inadvisable to use goldenseal, Oregon grape, or other berberine-

containing plant medicines in pregnant animals. Goldenseal lowers blood sugar, so don’t use it in animals who are

hypoglycemic. Goldenseal also may alter the metabolism and may have the potential to cause hypertension. Long-

term internal use of goldenseal may overstimulate the liver and trigger excessive production of bile—a situation that

is likely to result in vomiting. Cats are especially prone to this side effect. In light of this, goldenseal should not be

used continuously, in excess of seven days, without a break. For proper dose and duration of therapy, and to

ascertain if internal use of goldenseal is indicated for your animal, consult a holistic veterinarian.

注意事项和评论：一些动物研究表明，小檗碱可以使子宫平静，但其他研究表明，它会刺激子宫收缩，因

此不建议在怀孕动物中使用白毛茛、俄勒冈葡萄或其他含小檗碱的植物药物。白毛茛会降低血糖，因此请

勿将其用于低血糖的动物。白毛茛还可能改变新陈代谢，并可能导致高血压。长期内服白毛茛可能会过度

刺激肝脏并引发胆汁分泌过多，这种情况可能会导致呕吐。猫特别容易出现这种副作用。鉴于此，白毛茛

连续使用不宜超过7天，不能间断。如需了解正确的剂量和治疗持续时间，并确定您的动物是否适合内服金

毛茛，请咨询整体兽医。

An unpleasant but not really threatening side effect may occur in cats that are fed goldenseal or any other plant

that contains berberine: excessive salivation. Since first writing this book we have heard from several cat owners

and veterinarians who report a “foaming at the mouth.” If this occurs, simply discontinue use—it simply means that

this may not be the best herbal choice for your particular kitty.

喂食金印草或任何其他含有小檗碱的植物的猫可能会出现令人不快但并不真正具有威胁性的副作用：流

涎过多。自从第一次写这本书以来，我们收到了几位猫主人和兽医的报告，他们报告说“口吐白沫”。如果

发生这种情况，只需停止使用 - 这仅仅意味着这可能不是适合您的特定小猫的最佳草药选择。

=== PAGE 208 ===
GOTU KOLA

积雪草

Centella asiatica

积雪草

Parsley Family

欧芹家族

Appearance: Gotu kola produces dark green, nearly circular, 1- to 3-inch leaves and purple flowers that are atypical

of the parsley family. The leaves have long petioles (stems) and leathery smooth surfaces that give the plant an

appearance similar to what lily pads would look like if they grew on land instead of in water.

外观：雷公根产生深绿色、近圆形、1 至 3 英寸的叶子和紫色的花朵，这是欧芹家族的非典型特征。叶子有

长叶柄（茎）和皮革般光滑的表面，使植物的外观类似于睡莲叶在陆地上而不是在水中生长的样子。

Centella asiatica

积雪草

Habitat and Range: Gotu kola is a native of India, south Asia, eastern Europe, and the Philippines. It inhabits

drainage ditches, streambeds, and moist waste areas, often in ground-covering abundance.

栖息地和分布范围：雷公根原产于印度、南亚、东欧和菲律宾。它栖息于排水沟、河床和潮湿的荒地，通

常地面覆盖丰富。

=== PAGE 209 ===
Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in summer

周期和开花季节：在夏季开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: Leaves

使用部件：叶子

Primary Medicinal Activities: Active against various skin problems (antidermatitic), peripheral vasodilator, helps

reduce arthritic inflammation, antioxidant, wound healing, diuretic

主要药用活性：有效对抗各种皮肤问题（抗皮炎）、外周血管扩张剂、帮助减少关节炎炎症、抗氧化剂、

伤口愈合、利尿

Strongest Affinities: Skin, nervous system, circulatory system

最强亲和力：皮肤、神经系统、循环系统

Preparation: Tea or tincture or any variety of topical preparation such as salves, lotions, and poultices

制剂：茶或酊剂或各种外用制剂，如药膏、洗剂和膏剂

Common Uses: Gotu kola is especially useful for burns, skin injuries, or dermatitis that involve vascular

insufficiency or accumulation of subcutaneous swelling. When taken internally it increases peripheral blood

circulation and serves as a mild diuretic, thus assisting with the body’s natural ability to cleanse and heal the

epidermis. When applied externally, it serves as an antioxidant and speeds the healing process by stimulating

regeneration of skin cells. It has also been shown to accelerate the production of healthy scar tissue after surgery. It

is known to promote hair and nail growth.

常见用途：积雪草对于治疗烧伤、皮肤损伤或涉及血管供血不足或皮下肿胀累积的皮炎特别有用。内服

时，它会增加末梢血液循环，并作为温和的利尿剂，从而有助于身体清洁和治愈表皮的自然能力。外用

时，它可以作为抗氧化剂，并通过刺激皮肤细胞的再生来加速愈合过程。它还被证明可以加速手术后健康

疤痕组织的产生。众所周知，它可以促进头发和指甲的生长。

Gotu kola is useful in treating leprosy (mycobacteriosis), an ulcerous bacterial infection of the skin that can occur

in dogs, cats, and other animals. In these cases, it is believed that a terpene compound called asiaticoside breaks

down the protective waxy coating of the disease-causing bacteria, leaving the invading microbes vulnerable to the

body’s immune system. Recent studies also suggest that the betulinic acid content of gotu kola is active against

melanoma, a life-threatening form of skin cancer.

积雪草可用于治疗麻风病（分枝杆菌病），这是一种可能发生在狗、猫和其他动物身上的皮肤溃疡性细

菌感染。在这些情况下，人们相信一种叫做积雪草苷的萜烯化合物会分解致病细菌的保护性蜡质涂层，使

入侵的微生物容易受到人体免疫系统的攻击。最近的研究还表明，雷公根中的桦木酸含量对黑色素瘤（一

种危及生命的皮肤癌）具有活性。

Gotu kola is said to improve mental clarity and to act as a mild sedative and nervine (moderates nerve

transmissions) in animals. In a study where rats were trained to do simple tasks, gotu kola was shown to improve

learning and memory. Researchers correlated this finding to a deceleration of neurotransmitter reproduction in the

brain—in other words, memory was retained because the process of neurotransmission remained less interrupted.

This makes gotu kola a potential candidate for treating senility in aging animals. Gotu kola may also be useful in the

treatment of epilepsy.

据说积雪草可以提高动物的思维清晰度，并起到温和的镇静剂和神经镇静剂（调节神经传递）的作用。

在一项训练老鼠完成简单任务的研究中，雷公根被证明可以改善学习和记忆。研究人员将这一发现与大脑

中神经递质复制的减慢联系起来——换句话说，记忆得以保留，因为神经传递过程的中断较少。这使得积

=== PAGE 210 ===
雪草成为治疗衰老动物衰老的潜在候选者。雷公根也可用于治疗癫痫。

For animals with arthritis, gotu kola improves circulation in the legs and helps to reduce inflammation. It has also

been shown to promote healing and reconstruction of connective tissue in the joints.

对于患有关节炎的动物，雷公根可改善腿部循环并有助于减少炎症。它还被证明可以促进关节结缔组织

的愈合和重建。

For external applications, gotu kola can be used as a skin rinse, poultice, or fomentation. Salves and oil infusions

work well too, especially when vitamin E oil is added. For internal uses in a dog or cat, a tea from the dried leaves (1

teaspoon of herb to 8 ounces of near-boiling water) can be fed directly or put in the animal’s food. Feed 1

tablespoon of the cooled tea per 30 pounds of the animal’s body weight, once daily. Alternatively, a tablespoon of

the fresh leaves can be finely chopped and added to each pound of an animal’s food (the young light-green leaves

are delicious in salads). Horses can be fed a handful of the leaves each day as a dietary adjunct. A low-alcohol

tincture is yet another option. For each 30 pounds of a dog’s body weight, add 0.5–1 milliliter of tincture to food

daily. Add 0.5 milliliters of tincture to your cat’s food daily.

对于外用，雷公根可用作皮肤冲洗剂、膏剂或热敷剂。药膏和油输液也很有效，尤其是添加维生素 E 油

时。对于狗或猫的内服，可以直接喂食干叶茶（1 茶匙药草加 8 盎司近沸水）或放入动物食物中。每 30 磅

动物体重喂 1 汤匙冷茶，每天一次。或者，可以将一汤匙新鲜叶子切碎并添加到每磅动物食物中（嫩浅绿

色的叶子在沙拉中非常美味）。每天可以给马喂一把叶子作为饮食辅助品。低酒精酊剂是另一种选择。每

狗体重 30 磅，每天在食物中添加 0.5-1 毫升酊剂。每天在猫的食物中添加 0.5 毫升酊剂。

Availability: Herb retailers and a few specialty seed and plant suppliers

可用性：药草零售商和一些专业种子和植物供应商

Propagation and Harvest: Although gotu kola is seldom grown in North America, its cultivation is certainly

possible. The plants must be kept warm—at tropical temperatures—throughout their lives, meaning that they will

need a greenhouse or a consistently warm, sunlit place indoors in order to flourish in most of North America. The

plants like nitrogen-rich soil, a mix of shade and sunlight, and room to spread.

繁殖和收获：虽然北美很少种植积雪草，但它的种植肯定是可能的。这些植物在整个生命周期中都必须保

持温暖（在热带温度下），这意味着它们需要温室或室内持续温暖、阳光充足的地方才能在北美大部分地

区蓬勃发展。这些植物喜欢富含氮的土壤、阴凉和阳光的混合以及蔓延的空间。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For external treatment of skin problems, consider calendula, chaparral, aloe, comfrey,

and chamomile as alternatives or adjuncts. For internal treatment of skin problems or arthritis, gotu kola combines

with alternatives such as burdock, red clover, or yellow dock. Diuretic, nutritive, and cholagogue herbs such as

dandelion leaf and root, Oregon grape, cleavers, and nettle should be considered as well. Licorice, devil’s claw, or

yucca root serves as anti-inflammatory adjuncts. For vascular problems, gotu kola combines with ginger, cayenne,

peppermint, ginkgo, yarrow, or hawthorn. To improve mental clarity and circulation in the brain, add ginkgo to your

gotu kola.

替代品和辅助品：对于皮肤问题的外部治疗，可以考虑使用金盏花、灌木丛、芦荟、紫草和洋甘菊作为替

代品或辅助品。对于皮肤问题或关节炎的内部治疗，可将积雪草与牛蒡、红三叶草或黄坞等替代品结合使

用。还应考虑利尿、营养和利胆的草药，如蒲公英叶和根、俄勒冈葡萄、菜刀和荨麻。甘草、魔爪草或丝

兰根可作为抗炎辅助剂。对于血管问题，可将积雪草与生姜、辣椒、薄荷、银杏、西洋蓍草或山楂结合使

用。为了提高思维清晰度和大脑循环，可以在雷公根中添加银杏。

Cautions and Comments: Although never witnessed by the authors or anyone we consult with, there is some

scientific literature that presents the theory that excessive doses of gotu kola may have narcotic effects in animals,

may cause photosensitivity, and may interfere with hypoglycemic therapies. Large doses may also present

abortifacient activities and therefore should not be used in pregnant animals.

注意和评论：尽管作者或我们咨询的任何人从未亲眼目睹，但有一些科学文献提出了这样的理论：过量服

=== PAGE 211 ===
用雷公根可能对动物产生麻醉作用，可能导致光敏性，并可能干扰降血糖治疗。大剂量也可能具有堕胎活

性，因此不应用于怀孕动物。

GRAVELROOT

砾根

Eupatorium purpureum

紫茎泽兰

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Gravelroot is a large perennial, sometimes reaching 12 feet tall. The lance-shaped leaves have short

petioles and grow directly off of the main stem in whorls of four or more. Leaves are distinctively textured and have

coarsely serrated edges. Stems are smooth, succulent, and covered with purple spots, especially at the leaf axils.

Flowers are small and pink, presented in showy slightly globe-shaped clusters at the top of the plant. Spotted

gravelroot (Eupatorium maculatum) shares the habitat of and looks similar to E. purpureum, except the mature

plants tend to be much smaller. Both are equally useful.

外观：Gravelroot 是一种大型多年生植物，有时可达到 12 英尺高。披针形的叶子有短叶柄，直接从主茎上

长出四个或更多的轮生。叶子纹理独特，边缘呈粗糙锯齿状。茎光滑、多汁，布满紫色斑点，尤其是叶腋

处。花朵很小，呈粉红色，在植物顶部呈华丽的略呈球形的簇状。斑点砾根（Eupatorium maculatum）与 E.

purpureum 有着相同的栖息地，并且看起来很相似，只是成熟的植物往往要小得多。两者同样有用。

Eupatorium purpureum

=== PAGE 213 ===
紫茎泽兰

Boneset (E. perfoliatum), a close relative of gravelroot, is a proportionately smaller plant that offers a different

range of therapeutic usefulness.

Boneset (E. perfoliatum) 是砾根的近亲，是一种相对较小的植物，提供不同范围的治疗用途。

Habitat and Range: Gravelroot is common at the edges of moist forest clearings, where it often forms dense

thickets. Its range includes most of the eastern United States from Minnesota and Nebraska eastward to the Atlantic

Ocean and south to Florida. In the West, E. maculatum is sporadically distributed from South British Columbia to

New Mexico.

栖息地和范围：砾根常见于潮湿的森林空地边缘，通常形成茂密的灌木丛。其范围包括美国东部大部分地

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in midsummer

周期和开花季节：在仲夏开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: Roots

使用部位：根部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Diuretic, anti-inflammatory, tonic, helps reduce arthritic inflammation, helps

prevent or eliminate urinary stress

主要药用活性： 利尿、抗炎、滋补，有助于减少关节炎炎症，有助于预防或消除尿压力

Strongest Affinities: Urinary tract

最强的亲和力：泌尿道

Preparation: Decoction or tincture of the root

制剂：根的汤剂或酊剂

Common Uses: Gravelroot is traditionally used for expelling small kidney and bladder stones (gravel) from the

urinary tract. It is effective for reducing the pain and inflammation of cystitis, and is sometimes used to treat swollen

prostates. The diuretic activities of gravelroot may help in the elimination of excess uric acid from the body, making

it potentially useful in the treatment of gout and other forms of rheumatism. Although little scientific validation

exists for the medicinal uses of this plant, its abundance and long-standing reputation among herbalists as a safe and

effective urinary tract remedy warrants attention. While this herb has been safely used in dogs and cats, we cannot

recommend gravelroot as a first-choice herb simply because we don’t know it as well as its alternatives. However,

gravelroot is a profusely abundant plant in many areas of North America, and it is a valuable resource when other

urinary tract herbs may not be available. It is also a plant that is likely to gain market popularity in coming years,

and chances are it will someday enter the market in some kind of pet formula. In any case, gravelroot is a good herb

to remember as an emergency standby resource.

常见用途：石砾根传统上用于排出尿道中的小肾结石和膀胱结石（砾石）。它可以有效减轻膀胱炎的疼痛

和炎症，有时用于治疗前列腺肿胀。砾根的利尿活性可能有助于消除体内多余的尿酸，使其可能用于治疗

痛风和其他形式的风湿病。尽管这种植物的药用用途几乎没有科学验证，但它的丰富性和在草药学家中作

为安全有效的泌尿道治疗药物的长期声誉值得关注。虽然这种草药已被安全地用于狗和猫，但我们不能仅

仅因为我们不了解它及其替代品而推荐砾根作为首选草药。然而，砾根在北美许多地区是一种丰富的植

物，当其他泌尿道草药可能无法获得时，它是一种宝贵的资源。它也是一种在未来几年可能会受到市场欢

=== PAGE 214 ===
迎的植物，并且很可能有一天它会以某种宠物配方奶粉的形式进入市场。无论如何，砾根是一种值得记住

的好药草，可以作为紧急备用资源。

Availability: Despite its long history as an herbal medicine, commercial sources of gravelroot are difficult to find in

many parts of North America, especially in the West. The solution to this problem is simple—grow your own! Seeds

are available through specialty catalogs.

可用性：尽管其作为草药的历史悠久，但在北美许多地区，尤其是西方，很难找到石根的商业来源。解决

这个问题的方法很简单——自己种植！种子可通过专业目录获得。

Propagation and Harvest: This perennial is easy to grow. It sends up shoots from its rhizomes shortly after it is

planted and forms a self-sufficient thicket. All it really needs is plenty of sun, rich soil, and frequent watering. Plants

do best if sheltered from wind because the stems tend to break easily.

繁殖和收获：这种多年生植物很容易生长。它在种植后不久就会从根茎中发出芽，形成一个自给自足的灌

木丛。它真正需要的只是充足的阳光、肥沃的土壤和经常浇水。植物在避风的情况下生长得最好，因为茎

很容易折断。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For removal of gravel from the urinary tract, gravelroot is often combined with

demulcent herbs such as marshmallow root, plantain, and corn silk. In urinary disorders that also involve

inflammation or bleeding, gravelroot can be combined with stronger astringents or other anti-inflammatory herbs

such as uva ursi, cleavers, and corn silk. As an alternative, consider couch grass.

替代品和辅助剂：为了清除尿道中的砾石，砾根通常与药蜀葵根、车前草和玉米须等缓和药草结合使用。

对于还涉及炎症或出血的泌尿系统疾病，石砾根可以与更强的收敛剂或其他抗炎草药（如熊果、菜刀和玉

米须）结合使用。作为替代方案，请考虑沙发草。

=== PAGE 215 ===
Cautions and Comments: Only the root of this plant should be used because the leaves, stems, and flowers contain

echinatine, a pyrrolizidine alkaloid that may be harmful to the liver if consumed in large enough quantities.

Although direct side effects appear to be rare in animals who eat this plant, raw milk taken from animals who have

grazed on gravelroot and then fed to humans and other animals may have toxic effects. The symptoms of overdose

may include weakness, nausea, vomiting, liver damage, tremors, collapse, difficult breathing, convulsions, coma, or

death. It is highly advisable to contact a veterinarian familiar with gravelroot before administering it to your dog or

cat.

注意事项和评论：只能使用这种植物的根，因为叶子、茎和花含有松果碱，这是一种吡咯里西啶生物碱，

如果大量食用，可能对肝脏有害。虽然食用这种植物的动物似乎很少出现直接副作用，但从吃砾根草的动

物身上提取的生奶然后喂给人类和其他动物可能会产生毒性作用。服用过量的症状可能包括虚弱、恶心、

呕吐、肝损伤、震颤、虚脱、呼吸困难、抽搐、昏迷或死亡。强烈建议在给您的狗或猫服用砾根之前先联

系熟悉砾根的兽医。

GRINDELIA

格林迪莉亚

Grindelia squarrosa

粗果银花

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: When grindelia is first encountered in the field, two thoughts often come to mind: This is a weed, and

this is obviously a member of the sunflower family. Grindelia has strong but flexible 1- to 3-foot-tall stems,

sawtoothed leaves, and bright yellow flowers that grow one per stem. Beneath the yellow rays, the flowers have

distinctive curved bracts. The flower heads have a sticky gumlike substance that has earned the plant the common

name of “gumweed.”

外观：当第一次在田野中遇到绿豆草时，脑海中经常会浮现出两个想法：这是一种杂草，而且这显然是向

日葵家族的一员。 Grindelia 拥有坚固而灵活的 1 至 3 英尺高的茎、锯齿状的叶子和每茎长一朵的亮黄色花

朵。在黄色光线下，花朵有独特的弯曲苞片。花头有一种粘稠的树胶状物质，这种物质为这种植物赢得

了“牙龈草”的俗名。

Habitat and Range: Several species of Grindelia range throughout the western two-thirds of North America. All

share similar appearances and most are inhabitants of wide-open plains or dry, sunny forest clearings.

栖息地和分布范围： 几种格林黛利亚分布在北美西部三分之二的地区。它们都有相似的外貌，大多数都是

广阔的平原或干燥、阳光明媚的森林空地的居民。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A biennial or short-lived perennial that reproduces by seed

周期和开花季节：通过种子繁殖的两年生或短命多年生植物

Parts Used: Flowers and leaves

使用部分：花和叶

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expectorant, sedative, cough suppressant, anti-inflammatory, lowers blood pressure,

relieves poison ivy–induced contact dermatitis

主要药用活性：祛痰、镇静、止咳、抗炎、降低血压、缓解毒藤引起的接触性皮炎

Strongest Affinities: Respiratory tract and skin

最强的亲和力：呼吸道和皮肤

Preparation: For internal uses: tincture or tea. For contact dermatitis: tea (skin rinse), salve, lotion, ointment, or

liniment (an externally applied tincture).

制剂：内服：酊剂或茶。对于接触性皮炎：茶（皮肤冲洗剂）、药膏、乳液、软膏或搽剂（外用酊剂）。

=== PAGE 217 ===
Common Uses: Very little scientific attention has been directed toward grindelia, but its effectiveness and

usefulness as a respiratory herb is well known among Western herbalists. Native Americans, who passed their herbal

wisdom to us, used grindelia to treat everything from tuberculosis and pneumonia to gonorrhea and postpartum pain.

From a scientific perspective, we know that the gummy substance secreted from the flower heads contains at least

20 percent resins, which are composed of substances that stimulate mucus secretion and reduce inflammation in the

upper respiratory tract, making a dry, hacking cough more productive. Adding to grindelia’s expectorant qualities

are sedative and antispasmodic activities that calm a spastic cough by relaxing the smooth muscles of the upper

respiratory tract while dilating the bronchioles. This makes grindelia useful for relieving the symptoms of asthma in

dogs and cats, especially when it is administered at the early onset of an attack. We also find it useful for easing the

symptoms of bordetella (kennel cough). To evaluate whether grindelia is appropriate for your pet and to determine a

proper dosage, talk to a holistic practitioner.

常见用途：很少有科学界对研磨草的关注，但其作为呼吸草药的有效性和实用性在西方草药学家中是众所

周知的。美洲原住民将他们的草药智慧传授给了我们，他们用苦参来治疗从肺结核、肺炎到淋病和产后疼

痛等各种疾病。从科学角度来看，我们知道花头分泌的胶质物质至少含有20%的树脂，这些物质由刺激粘

液分泌、减少上呼吸道炎症的物质组成，使干咳更有效。银杏的祛痰功效还具有镇静和解痉作用，可通过

放松上呼吸道平滑肌同时扩张细支气管来缓解痉挛性咳嗽。这使得金黛草可有效缓解狗和猫的哮喘症状，

尤其是在哮喘发作早期服用时。我们还发现它对于缓解博德特氏菌（犬窝咳）的症状很有用。要评估苦丁

草是否适合您的宠物并确定适当的剂量，请咨询整体医生。

Grindelia squarrosa

粗果银花

Many North American Indian tribes used decoctions or simple teas of grindelia leaves and flowers as a soothing

skin rinse for poison ivy–induced dermatitis, and in recent years, grindelia lotions have started to appear in European

markets for the same purpose. A simple homemade decoction or tincture serves this purpose—apply as needed to

the affected areas once or twice daily.

许多北美印第安部落使用金黛草叶和花的汤剂或简单的茶作为舒缓皮肤冲洗剂，治疗毒藤引起的皮炎，

=== PAGE 218 ===
近年来，出于同样目的，金黛草乳液开始出现在欧洲市场。一种简单的自制汤剂或酊剂即可达到此目的 -

根据需要每天一次或两次涂抹在受影响的区域。

Availability: Grindelia herb or herbal preparations are available through herb retailers. The seed is available through

specialty seed catalogs.

可用性：Grindelia 草药或草药制剂可通过草药零售商购买。该种子可通过专业种子目录获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Grindelia tolerates poor soil and can be propagated easily from seed. Harvest the

flowers and leaves when the plants are in full bloom.

繁殖和收获：Grindelia能耐受贫瘠的土壤，并且可以很容易地用种子繁殖。当植物盛开时收获花朵和叶子。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For asthma, a small amount of grindelia can be combined with nettle. Look at lobelia

as a possible adjunct or alternative. For kennel cough and other respiratory infections and irritations, check out

horehound, coltsfoot, comfrey, mullein, and wild cherry as possible alternatives or adjuncts.

替代品和辅助剂：对于哮喘，可以将少量的苦参与荨麻混合使用。将半边莲视为一种可能的辅助品或替代

品。对于犬舍咳嗽和其他呼吸道感染和刺激，可以考虑使用苦海草、款冬、紫草、毛蕊花和野樱桃作为可

能的替代品或辅助品。

Cautions and Comments: Internal use of grindelia may have a relaxing effect on the heart muscle and may cause a

decrease in blood pressure. As a result, grindelia may be contraindicated in animals with heart or other circulatory

problems. Excessive doses of grindelia are believed to cause renal irritation; therefore grindelia may be

contraindicated in animals with renal failure or other forms of kidney disease. Although it is generally regarded as

nontoxic but unpalatable to livestock and other animals, little research has been done on the effects of grindelia. Its

use should be limited to what the holistic pet care community has learned through clinical experience. See your

holistic veterinarian before administering this herb internally. Barring allergic sensitivity, external applications are

generally safe for home treatment of poison ivy dermatitis on most animals.

注意事项和评论： 内用苦参可能对心肌有放松作用，并可能导致血压下降。因此，患有心脏或其他循环系

统问题的动物可能禁用磨豆。过量服用银杏被认为会引起肾脏刺激；因此，患有肾功能衰竭或其他形式肾

脏疾病的动物可能禁用grindelia。尽管人们普遍认为它无毒，但对家畜和其他动物来说却难以食用，但对苦

参的影响却很少有研究。其使用应仅限于整体宠物护理界通过临床经验学到的知识。在内服这种草药之

前，请先咨询您的整体兽医。除非过敏，外用药物对于大多数动物的毒藤皮炎家庭治疗通常是安全的。

HAWTHORN

山楂

Crataegus sp.

山楂属

Rose Family

玫瑰家族

Appearance: Hawthorn is a small deciduous tree or large shrub (up to 16 feet tall) that is easily recognized and

quickly remembered by its nasty 1- to 3-inch curved thorns that are strategically spaced along the branches, often at

eye level. The leaves of most species are narrowly fan-shaped or oval. The margins of the 1- to 2-inch-long leaves

are toothed with all leaf tips pointing distinctly forward. The white 1/4-inch flowers are presented in flat clusters,

each blossom having five petals and numerous stamens (the pollen-bearing structures). When in full bloom, the

blossoms often have an unpleasant “dead” odor. In late summer, the flowers are replaced with clusters of red to

black berries that contain two to five seeds each.

外观：山楂是一种落叶小乔木或大型灌木（高达 16 英尺），因其 1 至 3 英寸的弯曲刺而易于识别并很快被

记住，这些刺沿着树枝巧妙地间隔开，通常与眼睛齐平。大多数物种的叶子是窄扇形或椭圆形的。 1 至 2

英寸长的叶子边缘有齿，所有叶尖明显向前。白色 1/4 英寸的花朵呈扁平簇状，每朵花有五个花瓣和许多雄

蕊（承载花粉的结构）。盛开时，花朵通常会散发出令人不快的“死”气味。夏末，花朵被一簇簇红色到黑

色的浆果取代，每个浆果含有两到五颗种子。

Habitat and Range: The Crataegus genus is large and varied with hundreds of species (all of which readily

hybridize) in North America. Most species are found in riparian thickets or moist meadows, where they serve as

important forage and nesting habitats for birds and other wildlife. They are found in Alaska and British Columbia

southward into California and are widely distributed eastward throughout the western interior states at valley and

foothill elevations. C. douglasii (black hawthorn, see photo) is one of the most common and widespread species.

栖息地和分布范围：北美的山楂属面积庞大，种类繁多，有数百个物种（所有这些物种都很容易杂交）。

大多数物种发现于河岸灌木丛或潮湿的草地中，它们是鸟类和其他野生动物的重要饲料和筑巢栖息地。它

们分布在阿拉斯加和不列颠哥伦比亚省向南进入加利福尼亚州，并向东广泛分布在整个西部内陆各州的山

谷和山麓海拔处。 C. douglasii（黑山楂，见照片）是最常见和分布最广的物种之一。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Deciduous perennial; blooms sometime between April and June

周期和开花季节：落叶多年生植物；四月至六月之间的某个时间开花

Parts Used: Fruits (berries) or flowers and leaf buds

使用部位：水果（浆果）或花和叶芽

Primary Medicinal Activities: Tonic (strengthens cardiovascular structures and functions), lowers blood pressure,

dilates blood vessels, nutritive, antioxidant

主要药用活性：滋补（增强心血管结构和功能）、降低血压、扩张血管、营养、抗氧化

Strongest Affinities: Cardiovascular system

=== PAGE 220 ===
最强的亲和力：心血管系统

Preparation: Fresh or dried berries, tincture, tea, and decoction

制剂：新鲜或干浆果、酊剂、茶和汤剂

Common Uses: Hawthorn berries have been considered one of nature’s best and safest heart and vascular tonics for

millennia. A great deal of scientific study has validated hawthorn’s usefulness in this capacity, and herbalists and

researchers agree that hawthorn benefits the heart and arteries in at least three ways:

常见用途：几千年来，山楂浆果一直被认为是自然界最好、最安全的心脏和血管滋补品之一。大量科学研

究已经验证了山楂在这方面的用途，草药学家和研究人员一致认为山楂至少在三个方面有益于心脏和动

脉：

• Hawthorn dilates both coronary vessels and vessels of the brain, helping to increase circulation and the

transport of nutrients and oxygen throughout the body. It accomplishes this in an effective and unique

fashion: while it dilates major vessels, it also increases blood flow from the heart to compensate for any

reduction of arterial blood volume. In other words, it helps the body push more blood around by increasing

cardiac output and decreasing blood flow resistance in the arteries so there is more blood flow at lower

pressure. This effect has been shown in studies performed with dogs, especially when used in small doses

over an extended period.

• 山楂可以扩张冠状血管和大脑血管，有助于增加血液循环以及营养物质和氧气在全身的运输。它以一

种有效且独特的方式实现这一目标：在扩张主要血管的同时，它还增加心脏的血流量，以补偿动脉

血量的减少。换句话说，它通过增加心输出量和降低动脉血流阻力来帮助身体推动更多的血液，从

而在较低的压力下有更多的血流。这种效果已在对狗进行的研究中得到证实，特别是在长时间小剂

量使用时。

• Hawthorn possesses antioxidant properties. It scavenges free-radical molecules that are known to rob the

blood of oxygen and may lead to various forms of vascular disease.

• 山楂具有抗氧化特性。它清除自由基分子，这些自由基分子会夺走血液中的氧气，并可能导致各种形

式的血管疾病。

• Hawthorn acts to steady and strengthen a weak or erratic heartbeat. In fact, it has been shown to be a possible

alternative to the drug digitalis and may actually serve as a potentiating adjunct to this cardiac drug.

• 山楂可以稳定和加强微弱或不稳定的心跳。事实上，它已被证明是洋地黄药物的可能替代品，并且实

际上可以作为这种心脏药物的增强辅助剂。

=== PAGE 221 ===
Crataegus douglassi

山楂

All of these activities are largely attributable to the vast array of flavonoid constituents held in hawthorn. Flavonoids

are typified as red pigments found in many kinds of fruits and vegetables, and hundreds of studies have indicated

that these compounds are essential in maintaining disease resistance and the integrity of smooth-muscle tissues

throughout the body. It so happens that hawthorn may be the richest natural source of these vital nutrients. In a

recent study using unfortunate rats, the flavonoid constituents held in hawthorn were shown to help prevent

myocardial damage in situations where the heart muscle was subjected to physiological stress. This means that

animals such as racehorses and working dogs, who are constantly under cardiovascular stress, are likely to find

preventative benefits from daily supplements of hawthorn berries in their diets. It stands to reason that this

cardiovascular tonic is useful in the daily care of older animals, especially those who suffer from chronic heart

problems such as congestive heart failure, postsurgical dysfunction, or cardiac anomalies that have resulted from

heartworm, bacterial or viral infections, or protracted chemotherapy. When combined with herbs that strengthen

kidney function, hawthorn may also serve as a good adjunct therapy in the early treatment of kidney failure.

Hawthorn’s vasodilator and hypotensive actions may help to improve blood circulation through the renal arteries

and smaller vessels of the kidneys without the added stress of increased blood pressure.

所有这些活性很大程度上归功于山楂中含有的大量黄酮类成分。黄酮类化合物是在多种水果和蔬菜中发现

的典型红色素，数百项研究表明这些化合物对于维持全身平滑肌组织的抗病性和完整性至关重要。碰巧山

楂可能是这些重要营养素最丰富的天然来源。最近一项针对不幸老鼠的研究表明，山楂中的类黄酮成分有

助于防止心肌受到生理应激时的心肌损伤。这意味着赛马和工作犬等经常承受心血管压力的动物可能会从

日常饮食中补充山楂浆果中获得预防益处。按理说，这种心血管补品对于老年动物的日常护理很有用，特

别是那些患有慢性心脏问题的动物，例如充血性心力衰竭、术后功能障碍或由心丝虫、细菌或病毒感染引

起的心脏异常，或长期化疗。当与增强肾功能的草药结合使用时，山楂还可以作为肾衰竭早期治疗的良好

辅助疗法。山楂的血管扩张和降血压作用可能有助于改善肾动脉和肾脏小血管的血液循环，而不会增加血

压升高的压力。

One of the nicest things about using hawthorn in treating animals is the fact that it tastes pretty good and is one of

the easiest herbs to feed to your pet. If you are lucky enough to have a hawthorn tree near your home and an animal

=== PAGE 222 ===
who likes red fruit, you can pick the ripe berries and feed them as tonic treats. As an alternative, the fully ripe berries

can be picked, dried on a clean sheet of paper, and ground by hand with a mortar and pestle (be forewarned: the

dried berries burn out small coffee grinders) into a coarse powder. The powder can then be added to your pet’s diet

—1 teaspoon per pound of food fed each day. If your animal won’t eat the berries either way, try making a tea and

pouring it over the food. If that doesn’t work, you can use hawthorn gel capsules wrapped with a little cheese, or,

better yet, you can use a low-alcohol hawthorn extract.

使用山楂治疗动物的最好的事情之一是它的味道非常好，并且是最容易喂养宠物的草药之一。如果您足

够幸运，家附近有一棵山楂树，并且有一只喜欢红色水果的动物，您可以采摘成熟的浆果并将其作为补品

喂养。作为替代方案，可以采摘完全成熟的浆果，在干净的纸上干燥，然后用研钵和研杵手动研磨（预先

警告：干浆果会烧坏小型咖啡研磨机）成粗粉。然后可以将粉末添加到宠物的饮食中——每天每磅食物添

加 1 茶匙。如果您的动物无论如何都不吃浆果，请尝试泡茶并将其倒在食物上。如果这不起作用，您可以

使用山楂凝胶胶囊，包裹上一点奶酪，或者更好的是，您可以使用低酒精山楂提取物。

The berries are the commonly used and marketed part of the hawthorn plant, probably because they make such a

pretty and palatable medicine. But in early spring, before the berries are available, the flowering branch ends

(leaves, flower buds, twigs, and thorns) can be clipped into small pieces and made into a decoction. Good luck

getting it into your animal though—unlike the berries, the “twig tea” tastes awful!

浆果是山楂植物中常用和销售的部分，可能是因为它们是一种美丽可口的药物。但在早春，在浆果成熟

之前，可以将开花的枝端（叶、花蕾、嫩枝和刺）剪成小块，制成汤剂。不过，祝你好运，让你的动物吃

到它——与浆果不同，“树枝茶”味道很糟糕！

Availability: Hawthorn berries and the dried leaves and flowers are available through herb retailers. Various

hawthorn preparations are available at health food stores.

可用性：山楂浆果以及干叶和花可通过药草零售商购买。保健食品商店出售各种山楂制剂。

Propagation and Harvest: A few species of hawthorn are available through nurseries, particularly those

specializing in native plants. Hawthorn is not difficult to grow—all it really requires is plenty of water. But it tends

to be a slow grower. Gather the berries when they are completely ripe, usually in midsummer. Depending on the

species, the berries are red or blue-red (almost black in the case of C. douglasii). The berries can then be used fresh,

or they can be dried for future use. When properly stored, they should keep for at least a year. The flowering end-

twigs should be harvested and used as soon as the blossoms open in early spring.

繁殖和收获：一些山楂品种可以通过苗圃获得，特别是那些专门种植本土植物的苗圃。山楂的种植并不困

难，它真正需要的只是充足的水。但它的生长速度往往很慢。当浆果完全成熟时（通常在仲夏）收集它

们。根据品种的不同，浆果呈红色或蓝红色（道格拉斯 C. douglasii 的浆果几乎是黑色）。浆果可以新鲜使

用，也可以晒干以备将来使用。如果储存得当，它们应该保存至少一年。早春花开后应立即采收花尾枝并

使用。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: When combined with a good natural diet and other tonic herbs, hawthorn acts exactly

as an herbal heart tonic should, filling the special cardiac needs in the golden years of an animal’s life. Other tonic

herbs can be used in combination with hawthorn to round out the supplemental needs of older animals. These might

include ginkgo or yarrow (for strengthening capillary walls), garlic (for added antioxidant and immune system

support), alfalfa and red clover (to nourish the blood, increase appetite, and raise energy levels), dandelion leaf (to

assist in the removal of excess water and lend tonic support to the kidneys), and oatstraw (as a nervous system

tonic).

替代品和辅助品：当与良好的天然饮食和其他滋补草药相结合时，山楂的作用完全相当于草药心脏补品，

可以满足动物生命黄金岁月的特殊心脏需求。其他滋补草药可以与山楂结合使用，以满足老年动物的补充

需求。这些可能包括银杏或西洋蓍草（用于增强毛细血管壁）、大蒜（用于增加抗氧化剂和免疫系统支

持）、苜蓿和红三叶草（用于滋养血液、增加食欲和提高能量水平）、蒲公英叶（用于帮助去除多余的水

分并为肾脏提供补品支持）和燕麦草（作为神经系统补品）。

=== PAGE 223 ===
Cautions and Comments: Hawthorn is safe. In fact, in the hundreds of animal studies that have been conducted

with this herb since 1900, hawthorn has shown extremely low toxicity in every animal tested. We place the toxicity

potential of hawthorn berries on the same level as that of rose hips, raspberries, or blueberries—in other words,

hawthorn is a medicinal food.

注意事项和评论：山楂是安全的。事实上，自 1900 年以来，在用这种草药进行的数百项动物研究中，山楂

对每只测试动物都显示出极低的毒性。我们将山楂浆果的潜在毒性与玫瑰果、覆盆子或蓝莓置于同一水

平，换句话说，山楂是一种药用食品。

=== PAGE 224 ===
HOP

Humulus lupulus

啤酒花

Mulberry Family

桑葚家族

Appearance: Hop is a beautiful trailing vine with deeply lobed leaves reminiscent of those of grapevines.

外观：啤酒花是一种美丽的蔓生藤本植物，叶子深裂，让人想起葡萄藤。

Habitat and Range: Originally a Eurasian plant, several varieties of hop are grown throughout the world. Many

have escaped cultivation and now adorn waste areas, railway easements, and ravines throughout North America.

栖息地和分布范围：啤酒花最初是一种欧亚植物，现在世界各地都有多种啤酒花种植。许多植物已经不再

种植，现在装饰着北美各地的荒地、铁路地役权和峡谷。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in mid–to late summer.

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，在夏中至夏末开花。

Parts Used: Strobiles (strobili), commonly known as hops

使用部分：Strobiles（strobili），俗称啤酒花

=== PAGE 225 ===
Humulus lupulus

啤酒花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Sedative, diuretic, stimulates digestion

主要药用活性：镇静、利尿、促进消化

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system, urinary tract, digestive tract

最强亲和力：神经系统、泌尿道、消化道

Preparation: Tea, tincture, fresh strobiles

准备：茶、酊剂、新鲜球果

Common Uses: Unlike many of the calming herbs we refer to as herbal sedatives, hop is truly sedative in nature. It

works as a mild but reliable nervous system depressant and hypnotic, whereas most other calming herbs work more

as muscle relaxants. Provided it is used with prudence and respect, hop serves as an excellent general-purpose

calming agent in cases of acute anxiety such as the dreaded trip to the groomer or a long horse-trailer ride on the

interstate. Provided the animals accept the bitter flavor, a handful or two of the fresh or dried strobiles can be fed to

horses, llamas, mules, or other herbivores just before or during an emotional crisis. A few drops of the tea or tincture

can be fed to dogs and cats.

常见用途：与许多我们称为草药镇静剂的镇静草药不同，啤酒花本质上具有真正的镇静作用。它作为一种

温和但可靠的神经系统抑制剂和催眠药，而大多数其他镇静草药更多地作为肌肉松弛剂。如果谨慎和尊重

地使用它，啤酒花可以作为一种极好的通用镇静剂，用于缓解急性焦虑的情况，例如可怕的美容之旅或在

州际公路上乘坐长途拖车。如果动物接受苦味，可以在情绪危机之前或期间将一把或两把新鲜或干燥的球

果喂给马、美洲驼、骡子或其他食草动物。可以将几滴茶或酊剂喂给狗和猫。

Hop is also good for separation anxiety and for episodes of hyperexcitability that occur subsequent to traumatic

=== PAGE 226 ===
events such as intermittent episodes of insomnia, whining, and restlessness that haunt an adopted pet who is

recovering from physical or emotional abuse. Giving 10–20 drops added to each quart of the animal’s drinking

water usually serves this purpose well. Hop is also good for helping an animal to relax in the presence of physical

pain, especially when hop is combined with valerian. While hop does not lend appreciable painkilling activities, it

does assist the animal in dealing with pain naturally. (Animals are much better at this than we are.) Giving ⅛

teaspoon for each 20 pounds of the animal’s weight, no more than three times daily, usually suffices for pain or

acute anxiety problems.

啤酒花还有助于治疗分离焦虑和创伤性事件后发生的过度兴奋，例如间歇性失眠、抱怨和不安，这些困

扰着正在从身体或情感虐待中恢复的领养宠物。在每夸脱动物的饮用水中添加 10-20 滴通常可以很好地达

到此目的。啤酒花还有助于帮助动物在身体疼痛时放松，特别是当啤酒花与缬草混合时。虽然啤酒花并没

有明显的止痛作用，但它确实可以帮助动物自然地应对疼痛。 （动物在这方面比我们好得多。）每 20 磅体

重的动物服用 ⅛ 茶匙，每天不超过 3 次，通常足以缓解疼痛或急性焦虑问题。

While hop may help to relieve the severity of pain or an emotional crisis, it is important to remember that it

cannot treat the underlying causes of behavioral disorders. Hyperactivity and excitability may be symptoms of a

nutritional deficiency, a metabolic imbalance, an infection, or hyperthyroidism. Look deep into your animal’s crisis

from as many perspectives as you can. Even if hop seems to be solving the problem, it may be only masking the

symptoms of a serious disease.

虽然啤酒花可能有助于缓解疼痛或情绪危机的严重程度，但重要的是要记住，它不能治疗行为障碍的根

本原因。多动和兴奋可能是营养缺乏、代谢失衡、感染或甲状腺功能亢进的症状。尽可能从多个角度深入

了解动物的危机。即使啤酒花似乎解决了问题，它也可能只是掩盖了严重疾病的症状。

Animal studies have confirmed that the humulone and lupulone constituents in hop are active against many forms

of gram-positive bacteria as well as some of the troublesome fungi, including Candida spp. Human studies have also

shown promising results from the use of hop in treating gallbladder inflammation and urinary incontinence. In the

incontinence study, 772 of 915 human patients who received a formula containing hop, uva ursi, and vitamin E

experienced excellent results.

动物研究已证实，啤酒花中的葎草酮和蛇麻酮成分对多种形式的革兰氏阳性细菌以及一些麻烦的真菌

（包括念珠菌属）具有活性。人体研究也显示出使用啤酒花治疗胆囊炎症和尿失禁的良好效果。在失禁研

究中，915 名人类患者中有 772 名接受了含有啤酒花、熊果和维生素 E 的配方奶粉，获得了优异的效果。

Availability: Dried hop is available through herb retailers or wherever beer-making supplies are sold. Avoid the

compressed pellets or strobiles and the concentrated hop syrups used for brewing. What you want is the whole dried

strobiles. The compressed pellets and syrups are concentrated and may cause a serious toxic reaction in your animal.

Ideally, of course, you should grow your own hop.

可获得性：干啤酒花可通过药草零售商或销售啤酒生产用品的任何地方购买。避免使用压缩颗粒或球菌以

及用于酿造的浓缩啤酒花糖浆。你想要的是整个干的球果。压缩颗粒和糖浆经过浓缩，可能会对您的动物

造成严重的毒性反应。当然，理想情况下，您应该自己种植啤酒花。

Propagation and Harvest: Hop vines are easy to grow, cold hardy, and attractive when trained to climb a trellis or

garden archway. The plants need moist, rich soil and full sun in order to thrive and bloom. Plants and root cuttings

are available through nurseries.

繁殖和收获：啤酒花藤很容易生长，耐寒，经过训练可以攀爬格子或花园拱门，并且具有吸引力。植物需

要潮湿、肥沃的土壤和充足的阳光才能茁壮成长和开花。植物和根插条可通过苗圃获得。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For pain and posttraumatic irritability, hop combines especially well with valerian. If

the pain is attributable to nerve trauma or dysfunction, consider skullcap, oatstraw, or Saint-John’s-wort as possible

adjuncts or alternatives. For anxiety and restlessness characterized by trembling or hyperexcitability to touch or a

sudden sound (the animal jumps when surprised), hop can be combined with skullcap or passionflower.

替代品和辅助剂：对于疼痛和创伤后烦躁，啤酒花与缬草的结合效果特别好。如果疼痛是由神经损伤或功

能障碍引起的，请考虑使用黄芩、燕麦草或圣约翰草作为可能的辅助剂或替代品。对于以颤抖或对触摸或

=== PAGE 227 ===
突然的声音（动物惊讶时跳起来）过度兴奋为特征的焦虑和不安，啤酒花可以与黄芩或西番莲结合使用。

Cautions and Comments: In 1998, the National Animal Poison Control Center had recorded eight instances of

dogs dying after eating hops that had been used and discarded during the process of brewing beer. All of these dogs

succumbed to malignant hyperthermia—an acute, uncontrollable fever the first symptom of which is heavy panting,

followed by rapid heartbeat and a rapid and continued rise in body temperature. Seven of the dogs were greyhounds,

and it appears that this breed is especially susceptible to hyperthermia from eating discarded hops. It also should be

noted that the deaths of these dogs were from the ingestion of the spent (postbrewing) hops used in making beer, not

from the medicinal-quality hops used in making tinctures. The problem appears to stem from three common

denominators:

注意事项：1998年，国家动物毒物防治中心记录了8起狗因食用啤酒酿造过程中使用和丢弃的啤酒花而死亡

的事件。所有这些狗都死于恶性高热——一种无法控制的急性发烧，其首发症状是严重气喘吁吁，随后是

心跳加速和体温快速持续升高。其中七只狗是灵缇犬，该品种似乎特别容易因食用废弃的啤酒花而出现体

温过高的情况。还应该指出的是，这些狗的死亡是由于摄入了用于制造啤酒的废（酿造后）啤酒花，而不

是来自用于制造酊剂的药用啤酒花。这个问题似乎源于三个共同点：

• The chemistry of spent hops or the manner by which they are metabolized by greyhounds may be quite

different from the manner in which fresh or dried strobiles are processed by the same animals. It is evident

that the chemical and biochemical relationships among hops, malt syrup, various sugars, and other elements

of beer-making may be responsible for the ultimate results and should be investigated. Heat raises yet

another question—the process of boiling the herb is likely to change the chemistry of hop and the entire

beer-making combination.

• 废啤酒花的化学成分或灰狗代谢啤酒花的方式可能与同一动物处理新鲜或干燥的球菌的方式有很大不

同。显然，啤酒花、麦芽糖浆、各种糖和啤酒酿造的其他元素之间的化学和生物化学关系可能是最

终结果的原因，应该进行研究。热量又引发了另一个问题——煮药草的过程可能会改变啤酒花和整

个啤酒酿造组合的化学成分。

• The hops used may have been compressed and therefore would have been concentrated.

• 使用的啤酒花可能已被压缩，因此会被浓缩。

• Although we still do not know why, it appears that greyhounds are especially predisposed to this problem, and

therefore they should never be fed hops.

• 尽管我们仍然不知道原因，但灰狗似乎特别容易出现此问题，因此永远不应该给它们喂食啤酒花。

In light of this problem, a subsequent study was conducted and published in The Journal of the American

Veterinary Medical Association. The study found that all of the greyhounds examined in an emergency clinic for the

disorder had ingested approximately 250 milliliters of spent hops each—that’s about one cup. Spent brewing hops

are sweet and tasty, making them a target for gluttony and toxic excess. Despite the fact that there have been no

additional reports of hopsrelated hyperthermia in dogs ten years later, caution dictates that it is best to limit your

dogs’ access to spent homebrew hops, especially if your pet is a greyhound. Limit your use of hops to small

quantities of a high-quality formulation designed for animals, or use unadulterated fresh or dried hops with

moderation.

鉴于这个问题，随后进行了一项研究并发表在《美国兽医协会杂志》上。研究发现，在急诊室检查的所

有灵缇犬均摄入了大约 250 毫升废啤酒花，即大约一杯啤酒花。用过的酿造啤酒花又甜又可口，使它们成

为暴饮暴食和有毒过量的目标。尽管十年后没有更多关于狗与啤酒花相关的体温过高的报道，但谨慎的态

度表明，最好限制你的狗接触用过的自制啤酒花，特别是如果你的宠物是灵缇犬。将啤酒花的使用量限制

在专为动物设计的高质量配方中，或者适量使用纯净的新鲜或干燥啤酒花。
