HORSETAIL

马尾

Equisetum arvense

木贼

Horsetail Family

马尾家族

Appearance: The horsetail family is generally divided into three groups: (1) annual varieties that produce separate

and distinctly different fertile and sterile stems, (2) annuals that produce sterile and fertile stems that are similar in

appearance, and (3) evergreen perennials that produce fertile and sterile stems that are alike. Despite these variances,

the entire family shares fundamentally similar characteristics: hollow, distinctively grooved and jointed stems and

dark, scalelike leaves that appear as sheaths surrounding the stems at the joints. In early spring, Equisetum arvense

produces a small 3- to 12-inch fertile stem that lacks chlorophyll (the constituent that makes plants green). This stem

dies back as its larger green, sterile counterpart matures. The subsequent, 6-inch to 2-foot-tall sterile stems have

whorled branches that resemble green bottlebrushes. Equisetum hyemale is much larger (up to 5 feet tall) and lacks

any branching characteristics. It looks like a prehistoric cross between miniature bamboo and an asparagus spear.

Both species are often seen growing side by side.

外观：木贼科通常分为三类：（1）一年生品种，产生独立且明显不同的可育和不育茎，（2）产生外观相

似的不育和可育茎的一年生植物，以及（3）常绿多年生植物产生相似的可育茎和不育茎。尽管存在这些差

异，整个家族都具有基本相似的特征：中空、有明显凹槽和关节的茎，以及在关节处围绕茎的鞘状黑色鳞

片状叶子。早春，问荆会长出 3 至 12 英寸的可育茎，但缺乏叶绿素（使植物呈绿色的成分）。当其较大的

绿色、不育的对应物成熟时，该茎就会枯死。随后的 6 英寸至 2 英尺高的不育茎具有类似于绿色洗瓶刷的

轮生枝。木贼属植物较大（高达 5 英尺）并且缺乏任何分枝特征。它看起来像是史前微型竹子和芦笋矛的

结合体。人们经常看到这两个物种并排生长。

Habitat and Range: Lakeshores, stream banks, and other wet areas, up into alpine elevations throughout North

America. Horsetails often represent the primary ground cover in shady wet thickets.

栖息地和范围：湖岸、河岸和其他潮湿地区，直至整个北美的高山海拔。马尾草通常代表阴凉潮湿灌木丛

中的主要地面覆盖物。

Cycle and Bloom Season: The green sterile plants emerge in spring. Perennial varieties remain green and usable

throughout the year; annual varieties die back in late fall.

周期和开花季节：绿色不育植物在春天出现。多年生品种全年保持绿色可用；一年生品种在深秋死去。

Parts Used: All aerial parts

使用零件：所有空中零件

Primary Medicinal Activities: Diuretic, astringent, stops bleeding, tonic

主要药用活性： 利尿、收敛、止血、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Musculoskeletal system, skin, and hair

=== PAGE 229 ===
最强的亲和力：肌肉骨骼系统、皮肤和头发

Preparation: Tincture or decoction for internal uses; a poultice for external compresses

制剂：内服酊剂或汤剂；一种用于外敷的膏药

Common Uses: Horsetail contains a vast array of synergistic chemical compounds that all contribute to myriad

medicinal uses, but most notable is its usefulness in healing bone and connective tissue injuries.

常见用途：马尾草含有大量的协同化合物，这些化合物都具有多种药用用途，但最值得注意的是它在治疗

骨骼和结缔组织损伤方面的用途。

Most of horsetail’s regenerative actions in the musculoskeletal system can be attributed to its remarkable content

of bioactive silicon. In the body, silicon is a fundamental starting point, or matrix, for the formation of bone,

cartilage, skin, and other connective tissues, including those of the aorta and trachea. Silicon is perhaps the most

common element on earth. In fact, most of the sand on our planet is composed largely of silicon but not in a form

that can be absorbed and used by the body. The silicon contained in horsetail is unique in that it is in a form that can

be metabolized for tissue repair and development.

问荆在肌肉骨骼系统中的大部分再生作用可归因于其显着的生物活性硅含量。在体内，硅是形成骨骼、

软骨、皮肤和其他结缔组织（包括主动脉和气管）的基本起点或基质。硅可能是地球上最常见的元素。事

实上，我们星球上的大部分沙子主要由硅组成，但不是可以被人体吸收和利用的形式。问荆中所含的硅的

独特之处在于，它的形式可以通过代谢来促进组织修复和发育。

For you and your companion, horsetail can help speed recovery from joint and bone injuries, including

postsurgical trauma. For internal use, a decoction or tincture preparation is needed. Horsetail is poorly water soluble

and is abrasive, so unless it is put into a form that the body can easily absorb, it may cause irritation to the urinary

tract and kidneys.

对于您和您的同伴来说，马尾草可以帮助加快关节和骨骼损伤（包括术后创伤）的恢复。内服时需要煎

剂或酊剂。问荆的水溶性差且具有磨蚀性，因此除非将其制成易于人体吸收的形式，否则可能会对尿道和

肾脏造成刺激。

To make a decoction, take a large handful of the dried herb and place it into a nonmetallic cooking vessel (to

avoid picking up metallic residues). Add a ½ teaspoon of sugar and enough water to barely cover the herb. The

sugar helps to extract the silicon constituents and makes a more palatable finished product. Simmer the mixture over

low heat for about twenty minutes or until the water has turned dark green. Strain through a fine cloth and allow to

cool. The clarified decoction can be added directly to your companion’s food—1 tablespoon per 20 pounds of the

animal’s body weight daily, five days a week. Horsetail tincture can be used the same way but at a smaller dosage of

¼ teaspoon (1 milliliter) per 20 pounds of body weight.

要制作汤剂，请取一大把干燥的草药并将其放入非金属烹饪容器中（以避免沾染金属残留物）。添加 ½

茶匙糖和足够的水，刚好没过药草。糖有助于提取硅成分并制成更美味的成品。用小火将混合物煮约二十

分钟或直到水变成深绿色。用细布过滤并冷却。澄清的汤剂可以直接添加到您同伴的食物中——每天每 20

磅动物体重添加 1 汤匙，每周 5 天。马尾酊的使用方法相同，但剂量较小，为每 20 磅体重 1/4 茶匙（1 毫

升）。

Horsetail is also useful for a variety of urinary tract problems, particularly those that involve bleeding or an

accumulation of superfluous tissue in the urinary tract. The hemolytic and antimicrobial properties of horsetail make

it beneficial for urinary tract infections that involve minor bleeding from the bladder or urethra. To help avoid

urinary tract irritation during long-term use (more than ten days), it’s a good idea to use horsetail in conjunction with

soothing, protecting, and lubricating herbs such as marshmallow, plantain, or chickweed. Marshmallow is our first

choice because it adds excellent antimicrobial properties to the therapeutic effort.

马尾草还可用于治疗各种泌尿道问题，特别是涉及泌尿道出血或多余组织堆积的问题。马尾草的溶血和

抗菌特性使其有益于涉及膀胱或尿道轻微出血的尿路感染。为了避免长期使用（超过十天）时出现尿路刺

激，最好将木贼草与具有舒缓、保护和润滑功效的草药（如棉花糖、车前草或繁缕）结合使用。棉花糖是

我们的首选，因为它为治疗效果增添了卓越的抗菌特性。

=== PAGE 230 ===
There is evidence to support claims that horsetail may help prevent bone degeneration, skin and coat disorders,

and even senility in older animals. Scientific studies have concluded that as a body ages, silicon levels in the

circulatory system and skin decrease, which in turn leads to tissue degeneration and a diminished capacity to form

new tissue. Other studies suggest that horsetail may be useful in preventing certain forms of senility and

degenerative bone disease, namely those directly related to the balance between silicon and aluminum in the body.

In theory, these ailments may result from a toxic excess of aluminum, a condition normally counteracted by the

presence of silicic acid, silicon, and other vital compounds that are contained in horsetail. In other words, dietary

supplementation with horsetail may help maintain a healthful balance of silicon in the bodies of aging animals. See

your holistic veterinarian to ascertain if and how much horsetail is suitable for your companion.

有证据支持马尾草可能有助于预防老年动物骨骼退化、皮肤和皮毛疾病，甚至衰老的说法。科学研究得

出的结论是，随着身体年龄的增长，循环系统和皮肤中的硅含量会降低，进而导致组织退化和形成新组织

的能力下降。其他研究表明木贼可能有助于预防某些形式的衰老和退行性骨病，即那些与体内硅和铝之间

的平衡直接相关的疾病。从理论上讲，这些疾病可能是由于铝过量而引起的，这种情况通常可以通过木贼

中含有的硅酸、硅和其他重要化合物来抵消。换句话说，膳食补充木贼可能有助于维持衰老动物体内硅的

健康平衡。请咨询您的整体兽医，以确定马尾是否适合以及多少适合您的伴侣。

Availability: A common plant throughout most of the world. The dried herb and tincture are available through herb

retailers.

可用性：世界大部分地区常见的植物。干药草和酊剂可通过药草零售商购买。

Propagation and Harvest: For medicine of optimum quality, harvest E. arvense in mid–to late spring while the

leaves of the bottlebrush-like plant still point skyward. Later, as the leaves spread horizontally, they become less

water soluble and therefore do not make as good a medicine. Clip the plants just above ground level, and spread

them out on a piece of newspaper to dry thoroughly before use.

繁殖和收获：为了获得最佳质量的药物，应在春季中后期收获问荆，此时洗瓶刷状植物的叶子仍指向天

空。后来，随着叶子水平展开，它们的水溶性降低，因此不能成为很好的药物。将植物夹在地面上方，然

后将它们铺在一张报纸上，在使用前彻底干燥。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Combines well with marshmallow, cleavers, plantain, chickweed, corn silk, or couch

grass for urinary tract problems. To help in the healing of bone and connective tissue injuries, horsetail tincture

combines well with comfrey or nettle and serves as an excellent adjunct to glucosamine and chondroiton sulfate

supplements. For nervous system support in older animals, horsetail serves as an excellent adjunct to hawthorn and

ginkgo.

替代品和辅助品：与棉花糖、切肉刀、车前草、繁缕、玉米须或沙发草完美结合，治疗尿路问题。为了帮

助骨骼和结缔组织损伤的愈合，木贼酊剂与紫草或荨麻很好地结合在一起，是葡萄糖胺和硫酸软骨素补充

剂的极好辅助剂。对于老年动物的神经系统支持，问荆是山楂和银杏的绝佳辅助品。

=== PAGE 231 ===
Equisetum arvense

木贼

Cautions and Comments: Do not use horsetail in cases of hypertension or cardiac disease. Horsetail may cause

breast milk to change flavor during lactation. If there is a history of silicate stones of the urinary system, caution

should be used. Do not gather this plant from areas that are downstream of commercial farming activities as it may

contain inorganic nitrates that are metabolized into abnormal nicotine-like alkaloids. Livestock have reportedly been

poisoned by eating large quantities of horsetail, possibly due to alkaloid interfering with either the production or use

of vitamin B1.

注意事项和评论：患有高血压或心脏病的人不要使用马尾草。马尾草可能会导致母乳在哺乳期间改变味

道。如果有泌尿系统硅酸盐结石病史，应谨慎使用。不要从商业农业活动下游的地区采集这种植物，因为

它可能含有无机硝酸盐，这些硝酸盐会代谢成异常的尼古丁样生物碱。据报道，牲畜因食用大量木贼草而

中毒，这可能是由于生物碱干扰了维生素 B 1 的产生或使用。

=== PAGE 232 ===
JUNIPER

杜松

Juniperus spp.

杜松属

Cypress Family

柏树家族

Appearance: There are over 130 species of juniper worldwide; about 26 of these species are native to North

America. The berries of all are useful, but Juniperus communis (common juniper) has a reputation among herbalists

and wild food epicureans as having the berries with the strongest medicine.

外观：全世界有130多种杜松；其中约 26 个物种原产于北美。所有的浆果都很有用，但杜松（Juniperus

communis）在草药学家和野食美食家中享有盛誉，因为它的浆果具有最强的药效。

Species of this large genus of evergreens are differentiated by their size (trees or low-growing shrubs) and the

specific characteristics of their leaves (needlelike or scalelike). All junipers can be easily identified by their foliage

and cones (commonly called juniper berries), which have a strong and distinctive ginlike aroma.

这种大型常绿植物属的物种根据其大小（乔木或低矮灌木）和叶子的具体特征（针状或鳞片状）来区

分。所有杜松子都可以通过其叶子和球果（通常称为杜松子）轻松识别，这些杜松子具有强烈而独特的杜

松子酒香气。

Habitat and Range: Common juniper is generally a mountain shrub that can be found on rocky hillsides and forest

clearings up to about 10,000 feet in elevation. Juniper is widespread from Alaska to California and throughout much

of temperate North America. The aforementioned tree varieties are high-desert dwellers of eastern California,

Nevada, Utah, Colorado, Wyoming, Arizona, and New Mexico.

栖息地和范围：常见的杜松通常是一种山地灌木，可以在海拔约 10,000 英尺的岩石山坡和森林空地上找

到。杜松广泛分布于从阿拉斯加到加利福尼亚以及北美温带大部分地区。上述树木品种是加利福尼亚州东

部、内华达州、犹他州、科罗拉多州、怀俄明州、亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州的高沙漠居民。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Evergreen, producing fruits that take two to three years to ripen

周期和开花季节：常绿，产生需要两到三年才能成熟的果实

Parts Used: Fruits (berries) and leaves (often called needles)

使用部分：水果（浆果）和叶子（通常称为针）

Primary Medicinal Activities: Astringent, diuretic, antimicrobial, strengthens kidney function, lowers blood sugar,

tonic

主要药用活性：收敛、利尿、抗菌、增强肾功能、降低血糖、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Genitourinary system (including the kidneys), skin

最强的亲和力：泌尿生殖系统（包括肾脏）、皮肤

=== PAGE 233 ===
Preparation: Decoction of the leaves or berries, tincture (berries), or whole (dried or fresh) berries can be fed

directly or as a food additive.

制备：叶子或浆果的汤剂、酊剂（浆果）或整个（干或新鲜）浆果可以直接喂养或作为食品添加剂。

Common Uses: Recent scientific studies conducted at the College of Medicine at Taiwan National University and

the Universidad de Granada in Spain have shown that juniper offers new hope in the treatment of diabetes and

cardiovascular disease. In the study conducted in Spain, a decoction of ripe juniper berries was administered to both

diabetic and healthy rats. In both test groups, the decoction was found to lower blood glucose levels by increasing

glucose uptake in the diaphragm, while at the same time increasing the amount of insulin released from the

pancreas. The result was a lower mortality rate in animals with insulin-dependent diabetes and new hope for those

with other forms of diabetes. In the study conducted in Taiwan, a compound derivative of the berries called 14

acetoxycedrol was found to have anticoagulant effects in the blood and a relaxing action on vascular tissues, actions

that should prove useful in reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease in humans and other animals. In the minds of

modern herbalists, these wonderful new discoveries only add to juniper’s long history as a healing ally.

常见用途：台湾国立大学医学院和西班牙格拉纳达大学最近进行的科学研究表明，杜松子为治疗糖尿病和

心血管疾病带来了新的希望。在西班牙进行的一项研究中，给患有糖尿病的老鼠和健康的老鼠服用了成熟

杜松子的汤剂。在两个测试组中，发现该汤剂通过增加隔膜中的葡萄糖摄取来降低血糖水平，同时增加胰

腺释放的胰岛素量。结果是患有胰岛素依赖型糖尿病的动物死亡率降低，并为患有其他形式糖尿病的动物

带来了新的希望。在台湾进行的一项研究中，发现一种名为 14 acetoxycedrol 的浆果化合物衍生物具有抗血

液凝结作用和对血管组织的松弛作用，这些作用应该被证明有助于降低人类和其他动物患心血管疾病的风

险。在现代草药学家的心目中，这些奇妙的新发现只会增添杜松作为治疗盟友的悠久历史。

During the black plague, many European physicians carried three or four juniper berries in their mouth at all times

to prevent infection. Medical instruments were soaked in a disinfecting decoction of the berries. Native Americans

used every part of the shrub for a variety of ailments ranging from sore throats to dandruff, sometimes bathing their

horses in a root tea to improve their coats. In fact, juniper has been used as a food and medicine for thousands of

years by cultures the world over and remains an ingredient in several mainstream over-the-counter diuretic and

laxative remedies today. The berries are a valuable culinary commodity as well, being used as the primary flavoring

agent in gin and as a rather expensive seasoning for gourmet dishes. (We like to use them in place of bay leaves in

chili and wild-food dishes.)

黑死病期间，许多欧洲医生嘴里一直含着三四个杜松子，以防止感染。将医疗器械浸泡在浆果的消毒汤

中。美洲原住民利用灌木的各个部分来治疗从喉咙痛到头皮屑等各种疾病，有时用根茶给马洗澡以改善皮

毛。事实上，数千年来，杜松子一直被世界各地的文化用作食品和药物，并且仍然是当今几种主流非处方

利尿剂和泻药的成分。这些浆果也是一种有价值的烹饪商品，被用作杜松子酒的主要调味剂和相当昂贵的

美食调味料。 （我们喜欢用它们代替辣椒和野味菜肴中的月桂叶。）

Modern-day herbalists use juniper to treat edema and arthritis as well as acute and severe cystitis and other

infections of the urinary tract. Juniper is also known to stimulate kidney function by increasing the rate of

glomerulus filtration, the process by which the kidneys filter out impurities and cleanse the blood. In lay terms,

juniper increases urine production and waste elimination. This effect is due to an irritant action attributable to

juniper’s generous content of volatile oils, especially one called terpineol. Because of these irritating effects, juniper

should never be used in animals with preexisting kidney problems, nor should it be used over long periods of time.

Also, juniper is known to have a vasodilating action in the uterus and was once used to promote menstrual flow;

therefore, it should never be used in pregnant animals. Fortunately, all of this sounds more ominous than it really is

since many stimulatory herbs work because of their abilities to selectively irritate the body. When used over a very

short period in the correct dosages, and in nonpregnant animals with healthy kidneys, juniper can safely increase

renal circulation and boost overall kidney function.

现代草药师使用杜松来治疗水肿和关节炎以及急性和严重的膀胱炎和其他泌尿道感染。杜松子还可以通

过提高肾小球滤过率来刺激肾功能，肾小球滤过率是肾脏过滤杂质和净化血液的过程。通俗地说，杜松子

可以增加尿液的产生和废物的排出。这种作用是由于杜松子富含挥发油，尤其是松油醇而产生的刺激作

用。由于这些刺激作用，杜松子不应该用于已有肾脏问题的动物，也不应该长期使用。此外，杜松子具有

=== PAGE 234 ===
子宫血管舒张作用，曾被用来促进月经量。因此，切勿将其用于怀孕动物。幸运的是，所有这些听起来比

实际情况更不祥，因为许多刺激性草药之所以起作用，是因为它们能够选择性地刺激身体。当在很短的时

间内以正确的剂量使用杜松子时，以及在肾脏健康的非怀孕动物中，杜松子可以安全地增加肾脏循环并增

强整体肾功能。

The antiseptic and astringent properties of the berries or leaves may be useful in relieving itchiness and infections

of the skin when applied topically in the form of a cooled dilute rinse. Because the plant is not water soluble, you

will first need to make a simple decoction (see chapter 1). After the decoction has cooled, dilute it with enough cold

water to give it the appearance of a weak tea (you should be able to see through a clear 8-ounce glass of the liquid.

Now you can pour the liquid over your dog (and as long as you don’t mind a few claw scratches, your cat) until the

animal is thoroughly soaked. Avoid getting any into your animal’s eyes.

当以冷却的稀释冲洗液的形式局部使用时，浆果或叶子的防腐和收敛特性可能有助于缓解皮肤瘙痒和感

染。由于该植物不溶于水，因此您首先需要制作简单的汤剂（参见第 1 章）。汤剂冷却后，用足够的冷水

稀释，使其呈现出淡茶的外观（您应该能够透过一杯 8 盎司的透明液体看到液体。现在您可以将液体倒在

您的狗身上（并且只要您不介意一些爪子抓伤（您的猫），直到动物彻底浸湿，避免任何进入动物的眼

睛。

Juniperis communis

杜松

Before using juniper in a rinse, be sure that the decoction is well diluted. While problems seldom occur when

using juniper as a skin rinse, the volatile oils in the plant can be irritating if the solution is too strong, especially if

your animal has sensitive skin to start with. (By the way, this applies to peppermint, pennyroyal, and eucalyptus

rinses as well.)

在使用杜松子冲洗之前，请确保汤剂已充分稀释。虽然使用杜松子作为皮肤冲洗剂时很少出现问题，但

如果溶液太浓，植物中的挥发油可能会产生刺激，特别是如果您的动物皮肤本来就敏感。 （顺便说一下，

这也适用于薄荷、薄荷和桉树漱口水。）

=== PAGE 235 ===
After you rinse your pet, she will smell like a conifer forest on a warm spring day!

给你的宠物洗澡后，她会闻起来像温暖春日的针叶林！

Availability: Juniper berries are available at the supermarket, but they are much too expensive considering how

common the shrubs are. Juniper leaf and berry extracts are available through herb retailers. Several shrub and small

tree varieties are available from nurseries.

可用性：杜松子可以在超市买到，但考虑到这种灌木的常见程度，它们的价格太贵了。杜松叶和浆果提取

物可通过草药零售商购买。苗圃中有几种灌木和小树品种。

Propagation and Harvest: Several species of juniper have been domesticated and are available at your local

nursery. Juniperus communis is frequently used as a low-growing landscaping shrub and is an excellent choice for

walkway borders and flower beds. Junipers are easy to grow but tend to grow slowly. Once established, they are

cold hardy (especially J. communis), drought tolerant, and they require minimal maintenance. Soil quality is of little

concern to these plants, but they do appreciate at least a slightly acidic pH level, so if necessary, amend your soil

with some redwood compost. When you visit the nursery, remember that only the female plants bear the sought-after

berries and that you will need at least two plants (a male and a female) to produce fruit.

繁殖和收获：几种杜松已经被驯化，可以在当地的苗圃中获得。杜松经常用作低矮的园林绿化灌木，是人

行道边界和花坛的绝佳选择。杜松很容易生长，但往往生长缓慢。一旦建立，它们就耐寒（尤其是J.

communis），耐旱，并且需要最少的维护。这些植物并不关心土壤质量，但它们至少喜欢微酸性的 pH

值，因此如有必要，请用一些红木堆肥来改良土壤。当您参观苗圃时，请记住，只有雌性植物才能结出受

欢迎的浆果，并且您至少需要两棵植物（雄性和雌性）才能结出果实。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For inflammations of the urinary tract, consider couch grass, gravelroot, corn silk,

plantain, and uva ursi before using juniper. Marshmallow adds soothing and lubricating protection when added to

juniper. For urinary tract infections, look at echinacea, sage, thyme, and Oregon grape as alternatives or adjuncts.

For treating fleabites and other skin irritations, juniper combines well in a skin rinse with calendula, chamomile, or

peppermint (or for that matter, any kind of mint).

替代品和辅助剂：对于尿路炎症，在使用杜松子之前，请考虑使用沙发草、砾根、玉米须、车前草和熊

果。添加到杜松子中的棉花糖可增加舒缓和润滑保护。对于尿路感染，可以考虑使用紫锥菊、鼠尾草、百

里香和俄勒冈葡萄作为替代品或辅助品。为了治疗跳蚤和其他皮肤刺激，杜松子与金盏花、洋甘菊或薄荷

（或就此而言，任何种类的薄荷）在皮肤冲洗液中很好地结合在一起。

Cautions and Comments: Do not use juniper internally in animals with preexisting kidney disease or in pregnant or

lactating animals. The key rule with juniper is one that applies to all herbal remedies: Use with caution and always

in moderation. And remember, what may be deemed excessive for one animal may be inadequate for another.

Proper use of juniper is entirely dependent upon an accurate assessment of your companion’s specific needs and

medical condition. Please see your holistic veterinarian first.

注意事项和评论：请勿在患有肾脏疾病的动物或怀孕或哺乳期动物体内使用杜松子。杜松子的关键规则适

用于所有草药：谨慎使用并始终适量。请记住，对一种动物来说可能被认为过度的东西可能对另一种动物

来说却不够。正确使用杜松子完全取决于对您同伴的具体需求和医疗状况的准确评估。请先去看您的整体

兽医。

LAVENDER

薰衣草

Lavandula angustifolia

狭叶薰衣草

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: With its delicate spikelike flowers, narrow silvery leaves, and sweet fragrance, lavender is a beautiful

adornment to any garden. There are several cultivars of Lavandula; the one most commonly found in nurseries is

English lavender (L. angustifolia).

外观：薰衣草拥有精致的穗状花朵、狭长的银色叶子和甜美的香气，是任何花园的美丽装饰品。薰衣草有

多个品种；苗圃中最常见的一种是英国薰衣草（L. angustifolia）。

Habitat and Range: A Mediterranean native that is in cultivation throughout much of the world

栖息地和分布范围：原产于地中海地区，在世界大部分地区都有种植

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in early to midsummer

周期和开花季节：在初夏至仲夏开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: Flowers, leaves, and stems

使用部位：花、叶、茎

Primary Medicinal Activities: Elevates mood (antidepressive), antibacterial, astringent, analgesic, antispasmodic,

tonic

主要药用活性： 提升情绪（抗抑郁）、抗菌、收敛、镇痛、解痉、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Skin, nervous system, respiratory tract, joints

最强的亲和力：皮肤、神经系统、呼吸道、关节

Preparation: Diluted essential oil, tea, dried flower bunches, sachets

准备：稀释精油、茶叶、干花束、香袋

Common Uses: The essential oil of lavender works wonders to calm a nervous or excited animal. In depressed or

aggressive animals, lavender can be used to lift spirits and adjust attitudes. In these applications, the oil is not

applied to the animal itself but is used in aromatherapy. An open bottle of the oil is waved under the animal’s

nostrils, or a few drops are put on a piece of cardboard that is placed near the animal’s bedding, under a car seat, or

on the outside of a travel carrier. The sweet aroma helps the animal (and her human guardian) to relax during an

otherwise restless experience. Oftentimes the effects are instantaneous. A small sachet bag can be filled with

lavender flowers and placed near the animal for the same (but less reliable) effect.

=== PAGE 237 ===
常见用途：薰衣草精油可以神奇地安抚紧张或兴奋的动物。对于抑郁或有攻击性的动物，薰衣草可以用来

振奋精神和调整态度。在这些应用中，油不应用于动物本身，而是用于芳香疗法。将一瓶打开的油在动物

的鼻孔下晃动，或者将几滴油滴在一块纸板上，该纸板放在动物的床上用品附近、汽车座椅下方或旅行箱

的外部。甜美的香气有助于动物（和她的人类监护人）在焦躁不安的经历中放松。通常效果是立竿见影

的。可以用一个小香袋装满薰衣草花并将其放在动物附近，以获得相同（但不太可靠）的效果。

A few drops of the essential oil can be added to some water and placed in a vaporizer (or a potpourri simmering

pot) and used to treat coughs and respiratory infections. When emitted near the animal in a closed room, the vapor

helps to open respiratory passages and inhibit bacterial reproduction in the lungs.

可以将几滴精油加入一些水中，然后放入蒸发器（或花香炖锅）中，用于治疗咳嗽和呼吸道感染。当在

封闭房间内的动物附近排放时，蒸气有助于打开呼吸道并抑制肺部细菌繁殖。

For joint inflammation, stiffness, or pain, 10 drops of the essential oil can be added to 1 ounce of apricot kernel or

almond oil (these absorb into skin more readily than olive oil). The mixture then can be liberally massaged into the

affected area to bring relief. The oil mixture is also useful for insect bites and stings and is an excellent addition to

first aid salves.

对于关节发炎、僵硬或疼痛，可将 10 滴精油添加到 1 盎司杏仁油或杏仁油中（这些精油比橄榄油更容易

被皮肤吸收）。然后可以将混合物充分按摩到受影响的区域以缓解疼痛。这种油混合物还可用于治疗昆虫

叮咬和蜇伤，并且是急救药膏的绝佳补充。

A good tick repellent oil for dogs can be made from 300 milliliters of olive oil or other oil, 500 milliliters of

essential oil of terebinth, 100 milliliters of Saint-John’s-wort–infused oil, and 100 milliliters of essential oil of

lavender. This recipe makes about a liter of the oil. It can be massaged on affected areas to help ticks drop off. As a

preventative, it can be massaged on areas of the dog that are most likely to come into contact with ticks. Avoid using

essential oils on or around cats.

好的狗用驱蜱油可以由 300 毫升橄榄油或其他油、500 毫升松节油、100 毫升圣约翰草浸油和 100 毫升薰

衣草精油制成。这个食谱大约可以制作一升油。可以在受影响的区域进行按摩，以帮助蜱虫脱落。作为预

防措施，可以在狗最有可能接触蜱虫的部位进行按摩。避免在猫身上或周围使用精油。

A tea of the fresh or dried flowers, leaves, and stems can be used as an external skin rinse for relief from pain and

itching caused by seborrhea, contact dermatitis, or fleabites. The rinse helps to fight bacterial infection as well. Be

sure the rinse is well diluted—the water should be slightly tinted but still fragrant.

新鲜或干燥的花、叶和茎的茶可用作外部皮肤冲洗剂，以缓解由皮脂溢、接触性皮炎或跳蚤引起的疼痛

和瘙痒。冲洗也有助于对抗细菌感染。确保冲洗液充分稀释——水应该稍微有颜色，但仍然有香味。

LICORICE

甘草

Glycyrrhiza glabra

光果甘草

and G. lepidota

和 G. lepidota

Pea Family

豌豆家族

Appearance: Licorice is a member of the pea family and can be characterized by its greenish white, pealike axillary

flowers; pinnately divided pealike leaves (divided into pairs of lance-shaped leaflets); and inclination to climb and

tangle among other plants. At first glance, licorice looks like any one of thousands of wild legumes. Fortunately, our

wild American licorice (Glycyrrhiza lepidota) has characteristics that make it unique and easy to identify. It is a

large legume (3–7 feet tall when mature) with an exceptionally stout reddish main stem. But even more

distinguishing are its 1/2-inch-long, tightly clustered seed pods, which are covered with conspicuous hooked spines.

No other legume in North America presents this characteristic.

外观：甘草是豌豆科的一员，其特征是其腋生绿白色、豌豆状的花；羽状分裂的豌豆状叶子（分成成对的

矛状小叶）；以及攀爬和与其他植物纠缠的倾向。乍一看，甘草就像数千种野生豆类中的任何一种。幸运

的是，我们的野生美国甘草（Glycyrrhiza lepidota）具有独特且易于识别的特征。它是一种大型豆科植物

（成熟时高 3-7 英尺），具有异常粗壮的微红色主茎。但更显着的是它的 1/2 英寸长、紧密聚集的种荚，上

面覆盖着明显的钩状刺。北美没有其他豆科植物具有这种特征。

Habitat and Range: The vast majority of licorice root sold in North America is G. glabra, a native of southeast

Europe that probably came over with the first Anglo settlers. Of the twenty-five or so species that can be found

worldwide, we have only one native species in North America: G. lepidota. All other species have been naturalized

from Europe or Asia. American licorice occurs sporadically across North America, and like its alien relatives that in

many areas have escaped cultivation, it is generally to be found in moist ravines, in roadside ditches, in waste areas,

and along the banks of irrigation canals where soils are rich and deep.

栖息地和分布范围：北美销售的绝大多数甘草是 G. glabra，原产于欧洲东南部，可能是随着第一批盎格鲁

殖民者来到这里的。在世界范围内发现的大约二十五个物种中，我们只有北美的本地物种：G. lepidota。所

有其他物种都是从欧洲或亚洲归化的。美洲甘草在北美各地零星出现，与许多地区已不再种植的外来亲戚

一样，它通常出现在潮湿的峡谷、路边沟渠、荒地以及土壤肥沃的灌溉渠沿岸。和深。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A biennial or short-lived perennial that reproduces by seed. Blooms in midsummer.

周期和开花季节：通过种子繁殖的两年生或短命多年生植物。盛夏时节盛开。

Parts Used: Roots

使用部位：根部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expectorant; helps with blood cleansing; lubricates, soothes, and protects mucous

membranes; anti-inflammatory; antiviral; adrenal stimulant; mild laxative; immunostimulant.

=== PAGE 241 ===
主要药用活性：祛痰；有助于血液净化；润滑、舒缓和保护粘膜；消炎（药;抗病毒物质;肾上腺兴奋剂；温

和的泻药；免疫增强剂。

Strongest Affinities: Respiratory, digestive, and endocrine systems

最强的亲和力：呼吸系统、消化系统和内分泌系统

Preparation: Fresh or dried chopped root, tea, tincture

准备：新鲜或干燥的切碎的根、茶、酊剂

Common Uses: Numerous studies have confirmed that licorice is an effective and fast-acting anti-inflammatory

agent. In fact, many herbalists regard it as nature’s answer to hydrocortisone and claim that it potentiates the

effectiveness of other herbs when added to compound formulas. All of this is primarily attributable to licorice’s

content of glycyrrhizin, a compound with a chemical structure similar to that of the corticosteroids that are naturally

released by the body’s adrenal glands. Glycyrrhizin effectively stimulates the adrenals into action and is especially

useful for treating Addison’s disease.

常见用途：大量研究已证实甘草是一种有效且速效的抗炎剂。事实上，许多草药学家将其视为氢化可的松

的天然答案，并声称将其添加到复合配方中可增强其他草药的功效。所有这一切主要归功于甘草中的甘草

甜素，这是一种化学结构类似于人体肾上腺自然释放的皮质类固醇的化合物。甘草甜素可有效刺激肾上腺

发挥作用，对于治疗阿狄森氏病特别有用。

Licorice provides anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, immunostimulant, and corticosteroid-like actions—thus

helping to relieve pain, itching, and inflammation without completely bypassing the body’s normal anti-

inflammatory functions and without seriously compromising the immune system. This makes licorice useful for a

wide variety of inflammatory diseases. In a study where arthritis was induced in rats through injections of

formaldehyde, a by-product of glycyrrhizin called glycyrrhetinic acid was produced in the body and was shown to

have obvious antiarthritic actions that were comparable to those of hydrocortisone. Glycyrrhizin has also been

shown to potentiate the effects of cortisone-like drugs in the body, which makes licorice a useful adjunct in

hydrocortisone therapies. The theory here is that the potentiating effect of licorice allows for lower drug dosages

without compromising therapeutic effectiveness. Used in this capacity, licorice should help reduce the debilitating

side effects of steroid drugs in long-term therapies and may also assure safe withdrawal when the patient is weaned

off of the steroids.

甘草具有抗炎、抗菌、免疫刺激和类皮质类固醇的作用，从而有助于缓解疼痛、瘙痒和炎症，而不会完

全绕过身体的正常抗炎功能，也不会严重损害免疫系统。这使得甘草可用于治疗多种炎症性疾病。在一项

通过注射甲醛诱发大鼠关节炎的研究中，体内产生了甘草甜素的副产物甘草次酸，并显示出具有与氢化可

的松相当的明显抗关节炎作用。甘草甜素还被证明可以增强体内可的松类药物的作用，这使得甘草成为氢

化可的松疗法的有用辅助剂。这里的理论是，甘草的增强作用允许降低药物剂量而不影响治疗效果。以这

种方式使用，甘草应该有助于减少长期治疗中类固醇药物的衰弱副作用，并且还可以确保患者戒掉类固醇

后安全戒断。

The anti-inflammatory properties of licorice root are also apparent when the herb is topically applied. Licorice tea,

salve, or oil infusion can be used to relieve the uncomfortable symptoms of various skin disorders such as psoriasis,

eczema, contact dermatitis, and flea allergies. Used in this capacity, licorice provides a degree of relief during long-

term holistic therapies, including a detoxification and allergy therapy consisting of internal doses of burdock,

dandelion, alfalfa, or other alterative herbs. In this example, the animal receives relief from suffering, but the

underlying metabolic causes are also addressed through tonification of the involved body systems.

当局部使用甘草根时，其抗炎特性也很明显。甘草茶、药膏或油浸液可用于缓解各种皮肤病的不适症

状，如牛皮癣、湿疹、接触性皮炎和跳蚤过敏。甘草以这种方式使用，可以在长期整体治疗中提供一定程

度的缓解，包括由内服牛蒡、蒲公英、苜蓿或其他替代草药组成的排毒和过敏治疗。在这个例子中，动物

从痛苦中得到缓解，但潜在的代谢原因也可以通过强化相关的身体系统来解决。

Glycyrrhiza lepidota

鳞片甘草

To make a simple oil infusion, all you need is some chopped dried licorice root (available at any good herb

retailer) and some olive oil. Put the root into a glass jar and cover it with enough oil to leave a ½-inch layer of liquid

above the herb. Cover the jar tightly, put it in a warm (55–75° F) place, away from sunlight, and let it sit for one

month. After a month, strain the oil through a sieve, then squeeze what you can from the herb by wrapping it in

unbleached muslin or cheesecloth. You’ll have a sweet-tasting licorice oil that keeps for several months if

refrigerated. Use it topically as needed, but expect your companion to lick it off—it tastes like candy.

要制作简单的油浸液，您需要的只是一些切碎的干甘草根（任何好的草药零售商都可以买到）和一些橄

榄油。将根放入玻璃罐中，并用足够的油覆盖，在药草上方留下 0.5 英寸的液体层。盖紧罐子，将其放在温

暖（55–75° F）的地方，避免阳光照射，并放置一个月。一个月后，用筛子过滤油，然后用未漂白的平纹细

布或粗棉布包裹，尽可能地从药草中榨出油。您将获得一种甜味甘草油，如果冷藏，可以保存几个月。根

据需要局部使用它，但希望你的同伴把它舔掉——它尝起来像糖果。

In addition to its powerful anti-inflammatory actions, licorice root is beneficial in the treatment and prevention of

many forms of liver disease. Over the past two decades, medical researchers in China and Japan have found

(through animal studies) that extracts of licorice root are useful in the treatment of chronic and chemically induced

hepatitis and that the herb has liver-protectant qualities similar to those offered by the popular liver herb milk thistle

(Silybum marianum). However, the mechanisms by which licorice root works in the liver are quite different from

those of milk thistle. While milk thistle has been shown to resist liver cell destruction largely through protection of

the cell walls and by antioxidant actions, licorice works through a broader set of effects. In addition to a protectant

action that glycyrrhizin has upon the liver cells, licorice also enhances interferon and T cell production, two natural

actions that are critical to liver repair and general resistance to disease. In Chinese medicine, licorice is commonly

used as a liver detoxifier in the treatment of obstructive jaundice. And in several studies, licorice has been shown to

benefit animals suffering from liver damage due to absorbed or ingested toxins such as carbon tetrachloride.

除了强大的抗炎作用外，甘草根还有益于治疗和预防多种肝脏疾病。在过去的二十年里，中国和日本的

医学研究人员（通过动物研究）发现，甘草根提取物可用于治疗慢性和化学性肝炎，并且该草药具有与甘

=== PAGE 243 ===
草相似的护肝功效。流行的肝脏草本水飞蓟（Silybum marianum）。然而，甘草根在肝脏中的作用机制与奶

蓟草的作用机制有很大不同。虽然奶蓟草已被证明主要通过保护细胞壁和抗氧化作用来抵抗肝细胞破坏，

但甘草通过更广泛的作用发挥作用。甘草甜素除了对肝细胞具有保护作用外，还可以增强干扰素和 T 细胞

的产生，这两种自然作用对于肝脏修复和一般抗病能力至关重要。在中医中，甘草常用作肝脏解毒剂，用

于治疗梗阻性黄疸。多项研究表明，甘草对因吸收或摄入四氯化碳等毒素而遭受肝损伤的动物有益。

In a recent study, the root of G. uralensis (an Asian species of licorice) was found to have a potentiating effect on

the reticuloendothelial system, the body’s first line of defense against infection. In essence, the reticuloendothelial

system is composed of specialized cells whose jobs are to seek out and eliminate invading microbes and dead blood

cells, and licorice helps to stimulate these little bloodstream warriors into action.

最近的一项研究发现，G. uralensis（一种亚洲甘草）的根部被发现对网状内皮系统具有增强作用，网状内

皮系统是人体抵御感染的第一道防线。从本质上讲，网状内皮系统由专门的细胞组成，其工作是寻找并消

除入侵的微生物和死亡的血细胞，而甘草有助于刺激这些小血流战士采取行动。

Licorice is also an excellent demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant for the gastrointestinal and upper

respiratory tracts. It is especially good for healing ulceration of the stomach and reducing the gastric acid secretions

that often contribute to the severity of ulcers. For bronchitis, licorice works well at reducing inflammation while

adding antiviral, antibacterial, and soothing demulcent actions to any variety of other respiratory herbs that may be

employed such as mullein, coltsfoot, and grindelia.

甘草还是一种极好的胃肠道和上呼吸道镇静剂、抗炎剂和祛痰剂。它特别有利于治愈胃溃疡并减少胃酸

分泌，而胃酸分泌通常会导致溃疡的严重程度。对于支气管炎，甘草可以很好地减轻炎症，同时为任何其

他可能使用的呼吸道草药（如毛蕊花、款冬和银地草）添加抗病毒、抗菌和舒缓镇静作用。

When giving licorice to your animal, you are likely to find the best results when using liquid extracts (tinctures).

Feeding dried chopped roots to herbivores is fine if tolerated, but dogs and cats have short digestive tracts that may

not absorb the active constituents quickly and completely. Herb tinctures are free-form medicines: their active

components are readily available and quickly assimilated early in the digestive process. This means that less of the

active material is lost during digestion and more ends up in your cat instead of in her litter box. Dosage is entirely

dependent upon individual needs and circumstances and should be determined by a trained practitioner, but 12–20

drops per 20 pounds of body weight, two times daily, of low-alcohol licorice extract is a conservative starting point

for dogs, cats, and other small animals. Horses can be fed the equivalent of up to 1 ounce (10–30 grams) of the dried

root, or about 1/4 ounce of the tincture daily. You can triple the liquid dosages if you are using a cooled tea (1

teaspoon of the root to 1 cup of water).

给动物喂食甘草时，使用液体提取物（酊剂）可能会获得最佳效果。如果可以的话，将干切碎的根喂食

草动物是可以的，但狗和猫的消化道较短，可能无法快速且完全地吸收活性成分。草药酊剂是自由形式的

药物：其活性成分很容易获得，并在消化过程的早期迅速被吸收。这意味着消化过程中损失的活性物质更

少，更多的活性物质最终进入猫体内而不是猫砂盆中。剂量完全取决于个人需求和情况，应由训练有素的

从业者确定，但对于狗、猫、狗、猫等动物来说，每 20 磅体重 12-20 滴、每天两次的低酒精甘草提取物是

保守的起始剂量。和其他小动物。马每天可以喂食相当于 1 盎司（10-30 克）的干根，或大约 1/4 盎司的酊

剂。如果您使用冷茶（1 茶匙根部兑 1 杯水），则可以将液体剂量增加三倍。

Availability: Licorice can be planted from root cuttings or seed, both of which are available from nursery catalogs

that specialize in herbs.

可用性：甘草可以用根插条或种子种植，这两种材料都可以从专门种植草药的苗圃目录中获得。

Propagation and Harvest: To grow licorice in your garden, plant it in moist, deep, well-drained, nutrient-rich

sandy loam with a neutral to slightly alkaline pH. Although it is adaptable to various climates, licorice does best in

areas with long, warm growing seasons. (If you can’t meet these demands, don’t worry. This plant survives just

about anywhere.)

繁殖和收获：要在花园中种植甘草，请将其种植在潮湿、深厚、排水良好、营养丰富、pH值为中性至微碱

性的沙质壤土中。尽管甘草能适应各种气候，但它在生长季节长而温暖的地区表现最好。 （如果您不能满

足这些要求，请不要担心。这种植物几乎可以在任何地方生存。）

=== PAGE 244 ===
Dig the perennial roots during the fall of their third or fourth year of growth—younger roots won’t be as potent.

After digging, cut the roots into small pieces and dry them on newspaper, away from sunlight. The completely dried

roots keep for one to two years if properly stored in plastic bags in a cool, dry, dark place.

在多年生根生长的第三年或第四年的秋天挖掉它们——年轻的根不会那么有效。挖好后，将根切成小

块，放在报纸上晾干，避免阳光照射。如果将完全干燥的根正确存放在塑料袋中并存放在阴凉、干燥、黑

暗的地方，则可以保存一到两年。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For stomach ulcers and other gastric disorders that are secondary to bacterial or

parasitic infection, licorice combines with Oregon grape. To provide secondary anti-inflammatory relief in the

gastrointestinal or urinary tract, consider corn silk, couch grass, or uva ursi as adjuncts. For respiratory problems,

consider elecampane, coltsfoot, grindelia, mullein, slippery elm, plantain, marshmallow, and wild cherry bark as

possible substitutes or adjuncts. For liver problems, look toward milk thistle, dandelion root, Oregon grape, red

clover, and burdock as possible adjuncts.

替代品和辅助剂：对于胃溃疡和继发于细菌或寄生虫感染的其他胃部疾病，甘草与俄勒冈葡萄相结合。为

了提供胃肠道或泌尿道的二次抗炎缓解作用，可以考虑使用玉米须、茅草或熊果作为辅助剂。对于呼吸系

统问题，可考虑将土木香、款冬、金蒂利亚、毛蕊花、滑榆、车前草、棉花糖和野樱桃树皮作为可能的替

代品或辅助品。对于肝脏问题，可以考虑使用水飞蓟、蒲公英根、俄勒冈葡萄、红三叶草和牛蒡作为可能

的辅助药物。

Cautions and Comments: As for all herbal medicines, the primary rule is moderation and insight when using

licorice. Throughout its long history as a medicine, licorice has been the subject of controversies. When used in

large, highly concentrated doses, especially over long periods, several hydrocortisone-like side effects may occur:

water retention, hypertension, loss of potassium, sodium retention, and other symptoms of adrenal hyperactivity. In

human studies, the large majority of these side effects have been observed following the excessive consumption of

European licorice candy, which is made from a concentrated pressed extract of the root. (American-produced

licorice candy contains absolutely no real licorice but instead an artificial flavoring or the extracts of other plants

that taste similar.) Most herbalists and practitioners agree that the risks of adverse side effects from licorice are

limited to those who abuse it. We, however, have never seen a case of licorice-induced toxicity. Nevertheless,

licorice should not be used with reckless abandon or in normal doses for periods exceeding two weeks without the

instruction of a qualified practitioner. If a licorice therapy does exceed two weeks, then the treated animal’s diet

should be adjusted to accommodate increased needs for potassium and to eliminate excess sodium. Dandelion leaf is

well indicated here because it works as an effective diuretic to prevent water retention while providing an excellent

source of supplemental potassium. Animals with preexisting cardiovascular conditions should not be given licorice

without professional guidance.

注意事项和评论：对于所有草药来说，使用甘草时的首要规则是适度和洞察力。纵观其作为药物的悠久历

史，甘草一直是争议的话题。当大剂量、高浓度使用时，尤其是长期使用时，可能会出现几种类似氢化可

的松的副作用：水潴留、高血压、钾流失、钠潴留和肾上腺功能亢进的其他症状。在人类研究中，大多数

副作用是在过量食用欧洲甘草糖后观察到的，欧洲甘草糖是由根部浓缩压榨提取物制成的。 （美国生产的

甘草糖绝对不含真正的甘草，而是含有人工香料或味道相似的其他植物提取物。）大多数草药师和从业者

都认为，甘草产生不良副作用的风险仅限于滥用它的人。然而，我们从未见过甘草引起的中毒案例。尽管

如此，在没有合格执业医师指导的情况下，不应鲁莽地放弃或以正常剂量使用甘草超过两周。如果甘草治

疗超过两周，则应调整受治疗动物的饮食，以适应对钾的需求增加并消除过量的钠。蒲公英叶在这里得到

很好的体现，因为它是一种有效的利尿剂，可以防止水潴留，同时提供补充钾的极好来源。未经专业指

导，不应给患有心血管疾病的动物服用甘草。

Licorice may temporarily elevate blood sugar levels and should be used with caution in diabetic animals. It has

also been shown to have estrogenic properties that may affect uterine functions. Therefore, licorice should be used

with caution in pregnant or nursing animals.

甘草可能会暂时升高血糖水平，对于糖尿病动物应谨慎使用。它还被证明具有可能影响子宫功能的雌激

素特性。因此，怀孕或哺乳的动物应谨慎使用甘草。

=== PAGE 245 ===
MARSHMALLOW

棉花糖

Althea officinalis

木槿花

Mallow Family

锦葵家族

Appearance: Marshmallow is a stout plant that may grow as high as 7 feet. It has alternate 3- to 5-lobed leaves and

showy 2- to 3-inch flowers that range in color from white to pale pink. The entire plant is covered with fine, soft

hairs, a trait that gives the foliage a dusty appearance.

外观：棉花糖是一种粗壮的植物，可长到 7 英尺高。它有 3 到 5 裂的叶子和艳丽的 2 到 3 英寸的花朵，颜

色从白色到淡粉色。整个植物都覆盖着细软的毛，这种特性使叶子看起来像灰尘一样。

Habitat and Range: A native of western and central Europe, marshmallow has become naturalized in the U.S.,

where it grows in marshes and moist meadows throughout the New England states. It has become a popular garden

herb throughout the world and is easy to grow.

栖息地和分布范围：棉花糖原产于西欧和中欧，现已在美国归化，生长在新英格兰各州的沼泽和潮湿的草

地上。它已成为世界各地流行的花园草本植物，并且易于种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms from late June through September

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，从六月下旬到九月开花

Parts Used: Primarily the root. The foliage is useful, too, but does not make as good a medicine.

使用部位：主要是根部。叶子也很有用，但不能作为很好的药物。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Soothes and lubricates internal tissues, soothes skin, antimicrobial, lowers blood

sugar, immunostimulant.

主要药用活性：舒缓和润滑内部组织，舒缓皮肤，抗菌，降低血糖，免疫增强剂。

Strongest Affinities: Skin and respiratory, digestive, and urinary tracts

最强的亲和力：皮肤和呼吸道、消化道和泌尿道

Preparation: Tea, low-alcohol tincture, fresh or dried chopped root

准备：茶、低度酊剂、新鲜或干切碎的根

Common Uses: Marshmallow has a long history as a medicine. The word Althea is derived from the ancient Greek

word altheo, meaning “to cure.” With few exceptions, marshmallow is among the safest and most versatile herbs for

animals. The root of the mature plant contains up to 35 percent mucilage. This makes marshmallow useful in

situations that involve surface irritation of the skin or internal mucous membranes. It is particularly helpful for

=== PAGE 246 ===
urinary tract inflammations compounded by the presence of gravel in the urine (urinary calculus) and in digestive

disorders where ulceration or infection is further aggravated by the presence of food or other solids. In these cases,

marshmallow provides a soothing, lubricating, protective barrier between mucous membranes and substances that

contribute to the irritation. Marshmallow also soothes upper respiratory irritations that are secondary to a dry, raspy

cough. Used on the surface of the body, marshmallow brings relief to insect bites, stings, abscesses, and

inflammations that are secondary to injury or infection. In addition to the soothing nature of mucilage, marshmallow

has antimicrobial and immune-stimulating properties. In animal studies, it has been shown to be active against

Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Proteus vulgaris, and Staphylococcus aureus, bacterial infections that are commonly seen

in the digestive tract, urinary tract, skin, and ears of dogs, cats, horses, ferrets, and other animals. A dab of

marshmallow tincture also serves as an excellent antimicrobial lubricant for a rectal thermometer.

常见用途：棉花糖作为药物有着悠久的历史。 Althea 这个词源自古希腊词 altheo，意思是“治愈”。除少数例

外，棉花糖是对动物来说最安全、用途最广泛的草药之一。成熟植物的根部含有高达35%的粘液。这使得

棉花糖在涉及皮肤或内部粘膜表面刺激的情况下非常有用。它对于因尿液中存在砾石（尿结石）而引起的

尿路炎症以及因食物或其他固体的存在而进一步加剧溃疡或感染的消化系统疾病特别有帮助。在这些情况

下，棉花糖在粘膜和引起刺激的物质之间提供了舒缓、润滑、保护屏障。棉花糖还可以缓解继发于干咳、

刺耳咳嗽的上呼吸道刺激。棉花糖用于身体表面，可以缓解昆虫叮咬、蜇伤、脓肿以及继发于伤害或感染

的炎症。除了粘液的舒缓特性外，棉花糖还具有抗菌和免疫刺激特性。在动物研究中，它已被证明对铜绿

假单胞菌、普通变形杆菌和金黄色葡萄球菌具有活性，这些细菌感染常见于狗、猫、马、雪貂和狗的消化

道、尿道、皮肤和耳朵中。其他动物。少量棉花糖酊剂也可作为直肠温度计的极佳抗菌润滑剂。

For internal use of marshmallow root, a tea or low-alcohol tincture is usually the best choice. The dried or fresh

root may be a better option for problems such as colitis that are deep within the digestive system. This is because

marshmallow’s mucilage is highly water soluble and may not reach the lower end of the digestive tract unless it is

carried there in a solid container, namely the chopped or ground root.

对于内服棉花糖根来说，茶或低酒精酊剂通常是最好的选择。对于消化系统深处的结肠炎等问题，干燥

或新鲜的根可能是更好的选择。这是因为棉花糖的粘液高度水溶性，可能无法到达消化道的下端，除非它

被装在固体容器（即切碎或磨碎的根）中。

If you opt to use a tincture of this herb, make sure that it doesn’t contain more than 20 percent alcohol (actually,

none is needed). The mucilage constituents aren’t taken up well in alcohol, and if too much is used in the tincture-

making process, the end product will cause nausea when ingested. We like glycerin tinctures of this herb, not only

for this reason but because the glycerin itself adds soothing, protective qualities to the medicine. Marshmallow

glycerite can be squirted directly into an animal’s mouth—about ¼ teaspoon (1 milliliter) per 20 pounds of the

animal’s body weight, three times daily or as needed. Alternatively, a tea can be made by steeping a teaspoon of the

dried chopped root (or 2 teaspoons of fresh root) in 8 ounces of very hot water. Stir the tea frequently until it has

cooled to lukewarm. You should be able to feel the slippery, oily nature of the mucilage when you rub a few drops

of the tea between your thumb and index finger. If not, add more marshmallow root. One teaspoon of the tea is a

good starting dose for dogs. Cats usually benefit from a ½ teaspoon. It’s also good for lubricating and expelling fur

balls. For lower gastrointestinal problems or to help relieve constipation (in a manner similar to that of psyllium

husks), the dried powdered root can be added to an animal’s food at a rate of a ½ teaspoon for each pound of food

fed (¼ teaspoon for cats and other small animals), once or twice daily. For horses, 1 ounce of the powdered root can

be added to feed each day to aid in cases of cystitis, colitis, or chronic spasmodic colic.

如果您选择使用这种草药的酊剂，请确保其酒精含量不超过 20%（实际上，不需要）。粘液成分不能很

好地被酒精吸收，如果在酊剂制作过程中使用过多，最终产品在摄入时会引起恶心。我们喜欢这种草药的

甘油酊剂，不仅是因为这个原因，还因为甘油本身为药物增添了舒缓和保护作用。棉花糖甘油可以直接喷

入动物嘴中——每 20 磅动物体重约 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升），每天 3 次或根据需要。或者，也可以将一茶匙切

碎的干根（或 2 茶匙新鲜根）浸泡在 8 盎司的热水中来泡茶。经常搅拌茶直至其冷却至微温。当您在拇指

和食指之间滴几滴茶时，您应该能够感觉到粘液的滑腻感。如果没有，添加更多的棉花糖根。对于狗来

说，一茶匙茶是一个很好的起始剂量。猫通常受益于 ½ 茶匙。它也有利于润滑和排出毛球。对于下消化道

问题或帮助缓解便秘（类似于车前子壳），可以将干燥的根粉添加到动物食物中，每磅食物添加 ½ 茶匙

（猫为 ¼ 茶匙）和其他小动物），每天一次或两次。对于马，每天可在饲料中添加 1 盎司粉末状根，以帮

助治疗膀胱炎、结肠炎或慢性痉挛性绞痛。

For problems that are close to the rectum such as a swollen anal gland irritated by bowel movements, a small gel

capsule might be necessary to carry the root powder through the digestive tract to the problem area. Another option

=== PAGE 247 ===
is to administer a small amount of the cooled tea or glycerite as a rectal suppository using a soft plastic pipette or ear

syringe.

对于靠近直肠的问题，例如排便刺激的肛门腺肿胀，可能需要一个小凝胶胶囊将根粉通过消化道运送到

问题区域。另一种选择是使用软塑料移液管或耳部注射器将少量冷却的茶或甘油作为直肠栓剂给药。

Marshmallow has been shown to cause hypoglycemic activity in animals. Although more research is warranted,

marshmallow might be useful in treating certain forms of diabetes. See your holistic veterinarian before trying it in

this capacity.

棉花糖已被证明会引起动物的低血糖活性。尽管需要进行更多研究，但棉花糖可能有助于治疗某些形式

的糖尿病。在尝试这种能力之前，请先咨询您的整体兽医。

Althea officinalis

木槿花

Availability: Marshmallow plants are available through most nurseries. Marshmallow root and various preparations

are available through herb retailers.

可用性：大多数苗圃都可以买到棉花糖植物。药蜀葵根和各种制剂可通过药草零售商购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Marshmallow is easy to grow. It can be propagated by seed, root cuttings, or transplants.

Although it requires ample water, it’s not picky about soil and is hardy and drought tolerant once established.

Planting should occur in early spring. The roots are ready for harvest anytime during their third year of growth and

every year thereafter. You do not have to kill your plant to dig up some of the root—simply divide what you need

from the existing root system, and give the plant extra water until the roots regenerate.

繁殖和收获：棉花糖很容易种植。它可以通过种子、根插条或移植来繁殖。虽然它需要充足的水，但它对

土壤不挑剔，一旦建立就耐寒、耐旱。播种应在早春进行。根部在生长的第三年以及此后的每年都可以随

时收获。你不必杀死你的植物来挖出一些根——只需从现有的根系中划分出你需要的部分，并给植物额外

=== PAGE 248 ===
的水，直到根再生。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For urinary problems, marshmallow combines well with couch grass, horsetail, uva

ursi, corn silk, echinacea, ginkgo, or any of the diuretic herbs. For coughs and upper respiratory irritations,

marshmallow combines with mullein, coltsfoot, elecampane, or grindelia. For digestive problems, consider

combining licorice, chamomile, calendula, cleavers, fennel, dill, or any variety of mint with marshmallow. In horses,

a combination of marshmallow, valerian, slippery elm, and licorice is good for a spastic colon. For infections or

irritations of the skin of most animals, calendula, mullein flower, garlic, comfrey, and aloe are all complemented by

marshmallow.

替代品和辅助品：对于泌尿系统问题，棉花糖可与茅草、马尾草、熊果、玉米须、紫锥菊、银杏或任何利

尿草药完美搭配。对于咳嗽和上呼吸道刺激，可将棉花糖与毛蕊花、款冬、土木香或银杏结合使用。对于

消化问题，可以考虑将甘草、洋甘菊、金盏花、菜刀、茴香、莳萝或任何种类的薄荷与棉花糖混合。对于

马来说，棉花糖、缬草、滑榆和甘草的组合对痉挛的结肠有好处。对于大多数动物的皮肤感染或刺激，金

盏花、毛蕊花、大蒜、紫草和芦荟都可以辅以棉花糖。

Cautions and Comments: Marshmallow has long been used as a food plant, and its safety is substantiated by many

years of use in both humans and animals. It is known to lower blood sugar levels, however, and therefore should be

used with caution in hypoglycemic animals. It may also retard the intestinal absorption of some drugs—at least for

short periods, until the thick, viscous mucilage can be broken down in the digestive tract.

注意事项和评论：棉花糖长期以来一直被用作食品植物，其安全性已通过人类和动物多年的使用得到证

实。然而，众所周知，它可以降低血糖水平，因此在低血糖动物中应谨慎使用。它还可能会延迟某些药物

的肠道吸收——至少在短时间内，直到粘稠的粘液在消化道中被分解。

=== PAGE 249 ===
MILK THISTLE

水飞蓟

Silybum marianum

水飞蓟

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: From a distance, milk thistle looks very much like any other thistle: deeply lobed, often spiny leaves;

stout, often spiny stems; and large, up to 2 inches wide, white to purple disk flowers, each resembling a miniature

artichoke (another thistle). Closer inspection of milk thistle reveals a weblike pattern on the surfaces of the leaves, a

characteristic that sets it apart from its many cousins. Milk thistle may grow to 7 feet tall.

外观：从远处看，奶蓟草看起来非常像任何其他蓟：叶子深裂，通常有刺；茎粗壮，通常有刺；还有大

的、宽达 2 英寸、白色到紫色的圆盘花，每朵都像微型朝鲜蓟（另一种蓟）。仔细观察水飞蓟，会发现叶

子表面有网状图案，这一特征使其与许多近亲区别开来。水飞蓟可以长到 7 英尺高。

Habitat and Range: A native of the Mediterranean region of Europe, milk thistle has become naturalized in many

portions of North America. In many areas it has earned the reputation of being an invasive weed. Milk thistle is

cultivated throughout much of the world for its medicinal seeds.

栖息地和分布范围：水飞蓟原产于欧洲地中海地区，现已在北美许多地区归化。在许多地区，它已赢得了

入侵杂草的声誉。水飞蓟因其种子药用而在世界大部分地区种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual or biennial that blooms June through July

周期和开花季节：一年生或两年生植物，六月至七月开花

Parts Used: Ripe seeds

使用部分：成熟种子

Primary Medicinal Activities: Protects and strengthens the liver

主要药用活性：保护和增强肝脏

Strongest Affinities: Liver

最强的亲和力：肝脏

Preparation: Alcohol tincture or a standardized powder extract (usually contained in gel capsules). A high

concentration of alcohol is required to extract the active constituents from the ground seeds. Be skeptical of milk

thistle tincture products whose labels claim low or no alcohol.

制剂：酒精酊剂或标准化粉末提取物（通常包含在凝胶胶囊中）。从磨碎的种子中提取活性成分需要高浓

度的酒精。对标签上声称酒精含量低或不含酒精的水飞蓟酊剂产品持怀疑态度。

=== PAGE 250 ===
Common Uses: Milk thistle has a long ethno-botanical history that gives it stature as much more than a liver herb. It

has been used to treat everything from cancer to poor milk production in nursing mothers, but it is most effective in

protecting and regenerating the liver.

常见用途：奶蓟草具有悠久的民族植物学历史，使其地位比肝脏药草还要重要。它已被用于治疗从癌症到

哺乳期母亲产奶量低等各种疾病，但它在保护和再生肝脏方面最有效。

Most of milk thistle’s usefulness can be attributed to its silymarin constituent. Dozens of studies have confirmed

that silymarin and its related compounds support and protect the liver during crisis by accelerating the rate of protein

synthesis and stimulating production of new cells to replace damaged ones. These compounds work as powerful

antioxidants and strengthen liver cell resistance to toxic compounds, while at the same time stimulating cellular

reproduction. Much of what we know about these activities stems from the discovery that silymarin can be used to

antidote amanita (death cap) mushroom poisoning. When intravenous silymarin is administered within twenty-four

to forty-eight hours of ingestion, toxic compounds that would normally destroy liver cells are prevented from

penetrating the cell walls, and liver damage is greatly minimized.

水飞蓟的大部分用途可归因于其水飞蓟素成分。数十项研究已证实，水飞蓟素及其相关化合物可以通过

加快蛋白质合成速度并刺激新细胞的产生来替代受损细胞，从而在危机期间支持和保护肝脏。这些化合物

作为强大的抗氧化剂，增强肝细胞对有毒化合物的抵抗力，同时刺激细胞繁殖。我们对这些活动的了解大

部分源于水飞蓟素可用于解毒鹅膏菌中毒的发现。当在摄入后二十四至四十八小时内静脉注射水飞蓟素

时，通常会破坏肝细胞的有毒化合物会被阻止渗透细胞壁，从而大大减少肝脏损伤。

Scientific research has also confirmed that milk thistle protects the liver from the harmful effects of various other

toxins. Specifically, milk thistle protects an animal’s liver during a toxicity-related crisis (such as exposure to toxic

chemicals or potentially harmful drug therapies) and helps the animal through a liver damage or disease crisis. It can

be used in dogs, cats, horses, goats, ferrets, and rodents to aid in liver or kidney damage, hepatitis, jaundice,

leptospirosis, and parvovirus recovery. Milk thistle may prove helpful for treating liver tumors, cancers, and skin

problems that are secondary to liver disease. Animals who have been on allopathic drugs, heartworm medication,

dewormers, vaccinations, anticonvulsive drugs, or chemotherapy might benefit from this herb as well. Milk thistle

can also help block the potential liverdamaging effects of anesthesia and is often used both before and after surgery

in Germany. Medical and biological studies support its use in reducing the toxic effect of heavy metals if

administered soon enough.

科学研究还证实，水飞蓟可以保护肝脏免受各种其他毒素的有害影响。具体来说，奶蓟草可以在与毒性

相关的危机（例如接触有毒化学物质或潜在有害的药物治疗）期间保护动物的肝脏，并帮助动物度过肝脏

损伤或疾病危机。它可用于狗、猫、马、山羊、雪貂和啮齿动物，以帮助肝脏或肾脏损伤、肝炎、黄疸、

钩端螺旋体病和细小病毒的恢复。水飞蓟可能有助于治疗肝肿瘤、癌症和继发于肝病的皮肤问题。服用过

对抗疗法药物、心丝虫药物、驱虫剂、疫苗接种、抗惊厥药物或化疗的动物也可能从这种草药中受益。水

飞蓟还可以帮助阻止麻醉对肝脏的潜在损害，并且在德国经常在手术前和手术后使用。医学和生物学研究

支持，如果尽快施用，它可以减少重金属的毒性作用。

Despite much of the publicity that has been generated about this “wonder herb,” milk thistle should not be used as

a daily food supplement. Milk thistle is a medicine that is best reserved for situations in which the liver is already

under abnormal stress. When used in absence of preexisting stress, milk thistle probably won’t do any harm, but on

the other hand it might cause digestive disorders or it might impair other body-cleansing functions of the liver. Many

herbalists believe that it can actually slow the metabolic functions of a healthy liver. In any case, milk thistle is

unnecessary unless there is a real and present need, and its use as a dietary supplement constitutes waste.

尽管人们对这种“神奇草药”进行了大量宣传，但水飞蓟不应该用作日常食品补充剂。水飞蓟是一种最适

合肝脏已经处于异常压力下的药物。当在没有预先存在的压力的情况下使用时，水飞蓟可能不会造成任何

伤害，但另一方面，它可能会导致消化紊乱，或者可能损害肝脏的其他身体清洁功能。许多草药学家认

为，它实际上可以减缓健康肝脏的代谢功能。无论如何，除非有真正的、当前的需要，否则奶蓟是不必要

的，并且将其用作膳食补充剂构成浪费。

=== PAGE 251 ===
Silybum marianum

水飞蓟

Alcohol tinctures are the best for administering milk thistle because they allow quick and complete absorption of

silymarin into the body. But in cases in which severe liver damage might be compounded by alcohol, or in animals

with alcohol hypersensitivity, a standardized powder extract (formulated to contain 60–80 percent silymarin) might

be a better choice. In cases in which stress on the liver is suspected but not yet serious, the alcohol extract can be

administered at a starting dose of ¼ teaspoon (1 milliliter) per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight. Before

feeding it to your animal, dilute each dose with an equal amount or more of water to make the tincture more

palatable and to minimize the astringency and burning sensation of the alcohol. The tincture can then be added to the

animal’s food. In any suspected case of liver disease, a holistic veterinarian should be consulted before proceeding

with the use of milk thistle or any other herb.

酒精酊剂是服用水飞蓟的最佳选择，因为它们可以使水飞蓟素快速而完全地吸收到体内。但如果酒精可

能导致严重的肝损伤，或者对酒精过敏的动物，标准化粉末提取物（配方中含有 60-80% 水飞蓟素）可能是

更好的选择。如果怀疑肝脏受到压力但尚未严重，可以按每 20 磅动物体重 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升）的起始剂量

施用醇提取物。在喂给动物之前，用等量或更多的水稀释每个剂量，以使酊剂更可口，并尽量减少酒精的

涩味和烧灼感。然后可以将酊剂添加到动物的食物中。对于任何疑似肝病的病例，在继续使用水飞蓟或任

何其他草药之前，应咨询整体兽医。

Availability: Available in various formulations through herb retailers

供货情况：可通过草药零售商购买各种配方

Propagation and Harvest: Milk thistle is easy to grow, but the small yield of seeds per plant makes cultivation a

pointless endeavor unless you own a farm rather than just a garden. Harvesting must be done when the seeds are

completely ripe and dry but before they leave the plant with a gust of wind. In other words, leave the task to the

people who farm it.

=== PAGE 252 ===
繁殖和收获：水飞蓟很容易种植，但每株植物的种子产量很少，除非您拥有一个农场而不仅仅是一个花

园，否则种植毫无意义。收获必须在种子完全成熟且干燥时但在它们被一阵风吹离植物之前进行。换句话

说，把任务留给耕种它的人。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Licorice is another excellent liver-repairing herb that possesses a broader spectrum of

medicinal activities than milk thistle. For mild to moderate liver disorders that are believed to be toxicity related and

that are signified by chronic constipation, indigestion, or skin problems, milk thistle can be combined with

dandelion, burdock, yellow dock, red clover, Oregon grape, or turmeric.

替代品和辅助品：甘草是另一种优秀的肝脏修复草药，具有比水飞蓟更广泛的药用活性。对于被认为与毒

性相关且以慢性便秘、消化不良或皮肤问题为特征的轻度至中度肝脏疾病，奶蓟草可以与蒲公英、牛蒡、

黄坞、红三叶草、俄勒冈葡萄或姜黄结合使用。

Cautions and Comments: Milk thistle is a very safe herb. In studies that involve giving laboratory animals high

doses of silymarin over long periods, the animals display no toxicity.

注意事项和评论：水飞蓟是一种非常安全的草药。在涉及长期给实验动物高剂量水飞蓟素的研究中，动物

没有表现出毒性。

MULLEIN

毛蕊花

Verbascum thapsus

毛蕊花

Figwort Family

玄参家族

Appearance: This conspicuous plant is recognized during its first year of growth as a ground-hugging rosette of

large, up to 12 inches long, broadly lance-shaped, profusely fuzzy leaves. During its second and final year of

growth, mullein heads skyward with a stout central stalk that may exceed 6 feet in height. Numerous yellow flowers

are then presented in a coblike cluster. There are several species of mullein to be found in North America.

Verbascum thapsus is the most common and widespread.

外观：这种引人注目的植物在生长的第一年被认为是一种紧贴地面的莲座丛，叶子长达 12 英寸，呈宽矛

状，叶子浓密。在生长的第二年也是最后一年，毛蕊花会长出粗壮的中央茎，高度可能超过 6 英尺。然

后，许多黄色的花朵呈鹅卵石状的簇状出现。北美发现了多种毛蕊花。毛蕊花是最常见和分布最广的。

Habitat and Range: Mullein is a Eurasian import that has made itself at home in any variety of disturbed sites

throughout North America. It is common to clear-cuts, burned areas, and partially developed lands in the West,

where it often serves as an important earth regenerator, helping to regain biological balances and prevent erosion.

栖息地和分布范围：毛蕊花是欧亚大陆进口的植物，它在北美各地各种受干扰的地方都安家落户。它在西

方的砍伐区、烧毁区和部分开发的土地中很常见，它通常充当重要的地球再生器，帮助恢复生物平衡并防

止侵蚀。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A biennial that blooms throughout the summer

周期和开花季节：两年一次，整个夏季开花

Parts Used: Leaves, flower heads, roots (each part represents different medicines)

使用部位：叶、花头、根（每个部位代表不同的药物）

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expectorant; antimicrobial; antiviral; cough suppressant; lubricates, soothes, and

protects mucous membranes; astringent

主要药用活性：祛痰；抗菌；抗病毒物质;止咳;润滑、舒缓和保护粘膜；涩

Strongest Affinities: Respiratory and urinary tracts, skin, and ears

最强的亲和力：呼吸道和泌尿道、皮肤和耳朵

Preparation: Tea, tincture, oil infusion, compress, poultice

准备：茶、酊剂、油浸剂、敷布、膏药

=== PAGE 254 ===
Common Uses: This wayside weed is extremely useful, providing safe and effective medicine for a wide variety of

ailments. The leaves are well known for their ability to ease spasmodic coughs while reducing inflammation and

increasing mucus production in the bronchi, making coughs more productive and allowing sufferers to rest easier.

These qualities combine with antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making mullein an herb of choice in the

treatment of canine tracheobronchitis (kennel cough) and various other forms of respiratory distress in animals.

常见用途：这种路边杂草非常有用，可以为多种疾病提供安全有效的药物。众所周知，这些叶子能够缓解

痉挛性咳嗽，同时减少炎症并增加支气管中粘液的产生，使咳嗽更有效率，让患者更容易休息。这些品质

与抗菌和抗病毒特性相结合，使毛蕊花成为治疗犬气管支气管炎（犬窝咳）和各种其他形式的动物呼吸窘

迫的首选草药。

Scientific studies have shown that a synergy of compounds contained in mullein leaf actively inhibits

reproduction of herpes simplex virus (HSV). This activity, combined with the antitussive and expectorant qualities

of the plant, might prove useful in treating canine herpes virus (CHV) and feline viral rhinotracheitis (FVR).

Although more study is needed to ascertain the effectiveness of mullein against HSV infections in animals, the

safety of this plant and its demonstrated ability to relieve many of the discomforts of these diseases justifies giving it

a try. A strong leaf tea can be used (10 milliliters per 30 pounds of a dog’s body weight, twice daily; 5 milliliters

twice daily for cats), or a glycerin tincture can be given directly into the mouth (1–2 milliliters per 20 pounds of an

animal’s weight, twice daily). Mullein leaf is also practical in the treatment of asthma, especially when it is

combined with elecampane, grindelia, or lobelia. (Please see the Lobelia section in the “Supplemental Herb List” for

cautions about this herb.)

科学研究表明，毛蕊花叶中所含化合物的协同作用可有效抑制单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV) 的繁殖。这种活性与

植物的镇咳和祛痰特性相结合，可能有助于治疗犬疱疹病毒（CHV）和猫病毒性鼻气管炎（FVR）。虽然

还需要更多的研究来确定毛蕊花对抗动物 HSV 感染的有效性，但这种植物的安全性及其缓解这些疾病的许

多不适的能力值得一试。可以使用浓叶茶（每 30 磅狗体重 10 毫升，每天两次；猫每天 5 毫升），或者可

以直接将甘油酊剂放入口中（每 20 磅体重 1-2 毫升）。动物的体重，每天两次）。毛蕊花也可用于治疗哮

喘，特别是与土木香、银杏或半边莲合用时。 （有关半边莲的注意事项，请参阅“补充草药清单”中的半边

莲部分。）

The large leaves of mullein also make an excellent antimicrobial and astringent poultice for minor wounds and

insect bites. Just mash up a few fresh or dried leaves with some water and apply the poultice directly to the affected

area. Mullein leaf is said to lower the acidity of urine, as well, making the herb useful in the treatment of various

urinary disorders where urine pH levels are too low.

毛蕊花的大叶子也是一种极好的抗菌和收敛膏剂，用于治疗小伤口和昆虫叮咬。只需将一些新鲜或干燥

的叶子与一些水捣碎，然后将药膏直接涂在患处即可。据说毛蕊花还能降低尿液的酸度，使这种草药可用

于治疗尿液 pH 值过低的各种泌尿系统疾病。

Verbascum thapsus

毛蕊花

The flowering tops of mullein have antimicrobial properties with a special affinity toward infections of the ears,

including those caused by ear mites. (Note: Ear problems are a sign of chronic disease in an animal who is on a

commercial diet.) The best way to use the flowers is in the form of an oil infusion. The flowers also contain rotenone

and a synergy of other insecticidal compounds, making mullein effective in the fight against fleas and mange.

毛蕊花的花顶具有抗菌特性，对耳朵感染（包括耳螨引起的感染）有特殊的亲和力。 （注意：耳朵问题

是接受商业饮食的动物患有慢性疾病的征兆。）使用这些花的最佳方法是以油浸剂的形式。这些花还含有

鱼藤酮和其他杀虫化合物的协同作用，使毛蕊花能够有效对抗跳蚤和疥癣。

Some herbalists maintain that a tincture of the root can be used to treat urinary incontinence. Urinary incontinence

can be due to estrogen or testosterone deficiencies, neurogenic dysfunction, anatomical abnormalities, or paradoxical

obstruction from urethral calculi or neoplasia, so contact your holistic vet to find the cause before proceeding with

the use of mullein root.

一些草药医生坚持认为根酊剂可以用来治疗尿失禁。尿失禁可能是由于雌激素或睾酮缺乏、神经源性功

能障碍、解剖异常或尿道结石或肿瘤引起的反常阻塞所致，因此在继续使用毛蕊花根之前，请联系您的整

体兽医找出原因。

Availability: An abundant weed in much of North America. The seeds are available through specialty seed catalogs.

可用性：北美大部分地区盛产杂草。这些种子可通过专业种子目录获得。

Propagation and Harvest: The leaves of mullein can be harvested anytime, provided they look healthy. The

flowers do not appear until the plants’ second year and should be plucked from the flower heads when they are wide

open (we prefer to use them fresh). The first-year roots should be dug in fall, whereas the second-year roots should

be dug in the spring, before the biennial plant begins to die.

=== PAGE 256 ===
繁殖和收获：毛蕊花的叶子可以随时收获，只要它们看起来健康即可。花朵要到植物第二年才会出现，应

该在花开时从花头中摘下（我们更喜欢新鲜使用）。第一年的根应该在秋天挖，而第二年的根应该在春天

挖，在二年生植物开始死亡之前。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For kennel cough and other respiratory problems, mullein leaf combines well with

elecampane, grindelia, or horehound. For use in the ears, nothing compares to a combination of garlic and mullein

flower oil. Saint-John’s-wort oil and vitamin are also great adjuncts here. Other herbs to consider for urinary

incontinence (alone or as adjuncts) include corn silk, uva ursi, couch grass, Saint-John’s-wort, and horsetail.

替代品和辅助剂：对于犬舍咳嗽和其他呼吸道疾病，毛蕊花叶与土木香、苦海草或苦海草可以很好地结合

使用。对于耳朵来说，没有什么比大蒜和毛蕊花油的组合更好的了。圣约翰草油和维生素也是很好的辅助

剂。其他可考虑治疗尿失禁的草药（单独或作为辅助品）包括玉米须、熊果、茅草、圣约翰草和马尾草。

Cautions and Comments: Keep mullein away from fish and amphibians. The rotenone contained in mullein is

toxic to aquatic life.

注意事项和评论：让毛蕊花远离鱼类和两栖动物。毛蕊花中含有的鱼藤酮对水生生物有毒。

NETTLE

荨麻

Urtica dioica

荨麻

Nettle Family

荨麻家族

Appearance: Stinging nettle is an erect plant that may grow as high as 7 feet where conditions permit. It reproduces

largely from its shallow horizontally creeping root system and is often found in dense patches. Its leaves are broadly

lance-shaped with coarsely toothed margins. Flowers are presented in inconspicuous drooping clusters. Stems are

covered with fine stinging hairs. Young plants often emerge a reddish color, later turning green as they mature.

外观：荨麻是一种直立植物，在条件允许的情况下可以长到 7 英尺高。它主要通过其浅水平匍匐根系繁

殖，并且经常出现在密集的斑块中。它的叶子呈宽矛状，边缘有粗齿。花朵呈不显眼的下垂簇状。茎上覆

盖着细小的刺毛。幼苗通常呈淡红色，随后成熟时变成绿色。

Habitat and Range: Several species of nettle inhabit drainage ditches, stream banks, and other moist soils

throughout North America and much of the Northern Hemisphere.

栖息地和分布范围：几种荨麻栖息在北美和北半球大部分地区的排水沟、河岸和其他潮湿土壤中。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial, annual, or biennial (depending on species and climate) that blooms in early

summer

周期和开花季节：多年生、一年生或二年生植物（取决于物种和气候），在初夏开花

Parts Used: Leaves and stems of the preflowering plant and, to a lesser extent, the root

使用部分：开花前植物的叶和茎，以及较小程度的根

Primary Medicinal Activities: Nutritive, antihistamine, astringent, tonic, helps with blood cleansing

主要药用活性：营养、抗组胺、收敛、滋补、帮助血液净化

Strongest Affinities: Genitourinary tract, blood, skin, and eyes

最强的亲和力：泌尿生殖道、血液、皮肤和眼睛

Preparation: Dried herb (directly fed), tea, poultice, tincture

准备：干药草（直接喂食）、茶、膏剂、酊剂

Common Uses: All species of Urtica cause an instantaneous contact dermatitis that is characterized by tiny blisters

and a burning sting. Fortunately, nettle’s unpleasant, self-initiated introduction is usually short lived, and those who

can learn to accept nettle’s characteristics are bound to realize the precious gifts this somewhat obnoxious plant has

to offer. Despite its downside, we recognize this plant as one of nature’s best nutraceuticals. Ironically, nettle is

=== PAGE 258 ===
actually quite delicious, nutritious, and rich with healing opportunities.

常见用途：所有种类的荨麻疹都会引起瞬时接触性皮炎，其特征是小水泡和灼痛的刺痛。幸运的是，荨麻

这种令人不快的、自发的介绍通常是短暂的，那些能够学会接受荨麻特性的人一定会意识到这种有点令人

讨厌的植物所提供的宝贵礼物。尽管有其缺点，但我们认为这种植物是自然界最好的营养保健品之一。具

有讽刺意味的是，荨麻实际上非常美味、营养丰富，而且富含治疗功效。

Although gloves and a long-sleeved shirt must be worn when gathering the greens, complete drying or cooking

neutralizes the plant’s antigenic proteins and formic acid compounds—the constituents responsible for the plant’s

sting. These compounds break down quickly when exposed to air or heat, and when correctly prepared, the leafy

greens of young nettle plants are delicious and contain a vast array of vitamins, minerals, and nutrients. In fact, 100

grams of dried preflowering nettle plant contains up to 30.4 grams (30 percent by weight) of crude protein, 2,970

milligrams of calcium, 680 milligrams of phosphorus, 32.2 milligrams of iron, 650 milligrams of magnesium, 20.2

milligrams of beta-carotene, and 3,450 milligrams of potassium, along with vitamins A, C, D, and B complex—all

in a highly palatable form that can be effectively assimilated into the body without adding excess stress upon the

liver, kidneys, or digestive tract. Nettle therefore makes an excellent addition to food for animals who need extra

trace minerals and vitamins in their diet but not necessarily in huge, multivitamin doses. This applies to animals who

are already on a natural diet or those who are sensitive to excessive vitamin or mineral supplementation because of

chronic digestive disorders, existing systemic toxicity, or urinary tract problems. The completely dried herb can be

sprinkled directly onto the animals’ food—½ teaspoon for each pound of food fed to dogs, or ⅓ teaspoon per meal

for cats. Herbivores can be fed the dried greens in their usual diet, and many will relish nettle as a special treat. In

Sweden and Russia, where the problem of producing nutrient-rich feeds is compounded by a short growing season,

winter-hardy nettles are sometimes cultivated as fodder crops and then dried.

虽然采摘蔬菜时必须戴手套和穿长袖衬衫，但完全干燥或烹饪可以中和植物的抗原蛋白和甲酸化合物

——这些成分是导致植物刺痛的成分。这些化合物在暴露于空气或热量时会迅速分解，如果处理得当，荨

麻幼苗的绿叶蔬菜非常美味，并且含有大量维生素、矿物质和营养物质。事实上，100克干燥的开花前荨麻

植物含有高达30.4克（按重量计30%）的粗蛋白、2,970毫克钙、680毫克磷、32.2毫克铁、650毫克镁、20.2

毫克β-胡萝卜素、3,450 毫克钾，以及维生素 A、C、D 和 B 复合物，所有这些都以非常适口的形式存在，

可以有效地吸收到体内，而不会给肝脏、肾脏或消化道增加过多的压力。因此，对于那些在饮食中需要额

外微量矿物质和维生素但不一定需要大量多种维生素的动物来说，荨麻是一种极好的食物补充。这适用于

已经采用自然饮食的动物，或由于慢性消化系统疾病、现有的全身毒性或尿路问题而对过量维生素或矿物

质补充敏感的动物。完全干燥的药草可以直接撒在动物的食物上——给狗喂每磅食物 1/2 茶匙，或者给猫每

餐 1/3 茶匙。草食动物可以在平常的饮食中喂食干蔬菜，许多人会把荨麻作为一种特殊的享受。在瑞典和俄

罗斯，生产营养丰富的饲料的问题因生长季节短而变得更加复杂，耐寒的荨麻有时被种植为饲料作物，然

后进行干燥。

For finicky pets who despise anything but what their humans are eating, try cooking the fresh young plants with

enough water to cover them until they are soft and tender. The cooked greens are excellent with butter, and after

your furry friend has watched you relish them for a while, you can stir some into her food.

对于挑剔的宠物来说，除了人类吃的东西之外，什么都看不起，可以尝试用足够的水来煮新鲜的幼苗，

以覆盖它们，直到它们变软。煮熟的蔬菜搭配黄油非常美味，当你毛茸茸的朋友看着你品尝它们一段时间

后，你可以在她的食物中搅拌一些。

Urtica dioica

荨麻

Although many herbal preparations for the eyes typically use a plant called eyebright (Euphrasia sp.) as a primary

anti-inflammatory agent, many herbalists are becoming concerned about the increasing scarcity of this wild-

harvested herb. Fortunately, nature always provides us with a diversity of herbal options—all that is required is for

us to ignore market sensationalism and embrace the use of our less compromised plant allies. Nettle, a much more

abundant plant, is a good alternative to eyebright.

尽管许多眼用草药制剂通常使用一种名为小米草（Euphrasia sp.）的植物作为主要抗炎剂，但许多草药学

家开始担心这种野生采摘草药的日益稀缺。幸运的是，大自然总是为我们提供多种草药选择——我们所需

要的只是忽视市场的轰动效应，拥抱使用我们不那么妥协的植物盟友。荨麻是一种更为丰富的植物，是小

米草的良好替代品。

Nettle leaf tea is an excellent skin and coat rinse that nourishes animals’ fur and provides symptomatic relief for

itchy skin and fleabites.

荨麻叶茶是一种极好的皮肤和皮毛冲洗剂，可以滋养动物的皮毛，并缓解皮肤瘙痒和跳蚤症状。

Many herbalists who suffer from seasonal allergies have found that nettle leaf tincture or tea helps lessen their

symptoms if taken on a regular basis. In a recent study involving sixty-nine patients who suffer from allergic

rhinitis, 58 percent found relief after taking a freeze-dried preparation of the leaf.

许多患有季节性过敏的草药医生发现，定期服用荨麻叶酊剂或茶有助于减轻症状。在最近一项涉及 69 名

过敏性鼻炎患者的研究中，58% 的患者在服用了叶子的冻干制剂后症状得到缓解。

Although the theories behind the medicinal actions of nettle are varied, we believe that part of the basis for

nettle’s antiallergenic usefulness may lie in the plant’s histamine content, which may work in a like-versus-like

manner similar to the concepts of homeopathy. What we mean is that by introducing a substance into the body that

acts mildly as an allergenic antagonist, the body is triggered into protecting itself from what it believes to be an

inevitable, allout attack of allergens. In short, nettle may prompt the body into preparing itself. For animals with

predictable seasonal occurrences of allergies, dietary supplementation with dried nettle leaf may help.

=== PAGE 260 ===
尽管荨麻的药用作用背后的理论各不相同，但我们相信荨麻的抗过敏作用的部分基础可能在于植物的组

胺含量，其作用可能类似于顺势疗法的概念。我们的意思是，通过将一种具有温和作用的过敏原拮抗剂的

物质引入体内，身体就会被触发来保护自己免受它认为不可避免的过敏原的全面攻击。简而言之，荨麻可

能会促使身体做好准备。对于可预测季节性过敏的动物，添加干荨麻叶的膳食补充剂可能会有所帮助。

Nettle root may be useful in the treatment of prostate enlargement, especially at early onset of the disorder.

Although a swollen prostate is not as common in animals as in humans, this disorder is sometimes secondary to a

chronic or acute infection, poor diet, inflammatory disease, or injuries of the urinary tract, especially in older

animals. In a study conducted on human subjects who had mild cases or early onset of prostatic adenoma (a

degenerative enlargement of the glandular part of the prostate that typically results in frequent urination during the

night), the fluid extract (tincture) of nettle root was found to reduce the duration and volume of urine retention and

thus the need to urinate throughout the night. The active constituent in this case is believed to be Beta-sitosterol, a

phytosterol known to possess mild anti-inflammatory activity. Although this action is not likely to reduce the

formation of scar tissue within the urinary tract and prostate, it is believed to relieve symptoms through reduction of

swelling in surrounding tissues. Given the safety of this herb and the functional similarities between the prostates of

animals and humans, nettle is certainly worth a try. Keep in mind that large doses of nettle can be irritating to the

kidneys if given over an extended period of time, particularly if an animal has preexisting kidney disease or if the

herb was gathered too late in its growth cycle.

荨麻根可能有助于治疗前列腺肥大，尤其是在疾病早期。虽然前列腺肿胀在动物中并不像在人类中那么

常见，但这种疾病有时继发于慢性或急性感染、不良饮食、炎症性疾病或尿路损伤，特别是在老年动物

中。在一项针对患有轻度前列腺腺瘤或早期发病的前列腺腺瘤（前列腺腺体部分的退行性增大，通常导致

夜间尿频）的人类受试者中进行的一项研究中，发现了荨麻根的液体提取物（酊剂）减少尿潴留的持续时

间和体积，从而减少整夜排尿的需要。这种情况下的活性成分被认为是β-谷甾醇，一种已知具有轻度抗炎

活性的植物甾醇。尽管这种作用不太可能减少尿道和前列腺内疤痕组织的形成，但据信它可以通过减少周

围组织的肿胀来缓解症状。考虑到这种草药的安全性以及动物和人类前列腺功能的相似性，荨麻当然值得

一试。请记住，如果长时间服用大剂量的荨麻可能会刺激肾脏，特别是如果动物已患有肾脏疾病或在其生

长周期中采集得太晚。

Availability: Available wherever bulk herbs are sold

供货情况： 凡是出售散装草药的地方均可买到

Propagation and Harvest: Nettle can be transplanted from root cuttings, but the plant tends to be somewhat choosy

about where it grows. Although we know exactly where the plant should thrive, our efforts to introduce nettle to

such an area have met with a less than 50 percent success rate. In other words, you are probably better off finding a

healthy patch of wild plants to collect your herb. Gather the plants before they bloom—the younger the better.

Mature plants begin to develop cystoliths, tiny crystalline particles in the leaf tissues that can irritate the urinary tract

and kidneys when ingested in large enough quantities. After gathering, you can boil the greens and serve them as

you would spinach, or you can spread them onto clean newspapers and allow them to dry in a well-ventilated,

sunlight-free location until they are crispy.

繁殖和收获：荨麻可以从根部插条移植，但该植物往往对生长地点有些挑剔。尽管我们确切地知道该植物

应该在哪里生长，但我们将荨麻引入该地区的努力的成功率还不到 50%。换句话说，您最好找到一片健康

的野生植物来采集药草。在植物开花之前收集它们——越年轻越好。成熟的植物开始在叶组织中形成乳

石，这是一种微小的结晶颗粒，当摄入足够多时，会刺激尿道和肾脏。收集后，您可以将蔬菜煮沸并像菠

菜一样食用，也可以将它们铺在干净的报纸上，然后在通风良好、无阳光的地方晾干，直至变脆。

For obvious reasons, gloves and a long-sleeved shirt should be worn when handling nettle plants. If a leaf or stem

manages to sneak under your shirtsleeve, try this trick: grasp a piece of the stem and squeeze some of the nettle juice

onto the affected area. The stem juice is rich in lecithin, which is believed to antidote the sting. We manage to get

stung by this plant several times each spring, and we find relief by using this method in many of our adverse

encounters.

出于显而易见的原因，处理荨麻植物时应戴手套和长袖衬衫。如果叶子或茎设法潜入你的衬衫袖子下，

请尝试这个技巧：抓住一片茎，将一些荨麻汁挤到受影响的区域。茎汁富含卵磷脂，据信可以解毒蜇伤。

=== PAGE 261 ===
每年春天，我们都会被这种植物蜇了好几次，在许多不利的遭遇中，我们都通过使用这种方法得到了缓

解。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For anti-inflammatory eye and skin washes, alternatives include raspberry leaf,

chamomile, dandelion, calendula, or oxeye daisy. For conjunctivitis that is secondary to bacterial or fungal infection,

nettle combines well with Oregon grape. Nutritive adjuncts include spirulina, flaxseed, red clover, and alfalfa. For

allergies, nettle combines well with elecampane, coltsfoot, goldenrod, lobelia, or licorice as lesser adjuncts. For

urinary incontinence and inflammations of the urinary tract, consider couch grass, corn silk, cleavers, uva ursi,

goldenrod, and marshmallow as adjuncts.

替代品和辅助剂：对于抗炎眼睛和皮肤清洗剂，替代品包括覆盆子叶、洋甘菊、蒲公英、金盏花或牛眼

菊。对于继发于细菌或真菌感染的结膜炎，荨麻与俄勒冈葡萄完美结合。营养辅助剂包括螺旋藻、亚麻

籽、红三叶草和苜蓿。对于过敏，荨麻可以与土木香、款冬、黄花、半边莲或甘草搭配使用，作为较小的

辅料。对于尿失禁和尿路炎症，可以考虑使用茅草、玉米须、菜刀、熊果、黄花和棉花糖作为辅助剂。

Cautions and Comments: Touching the live plant results in a painful, blistering sting. Thorough drying or cooking

neutralizes the toxic constituents. Some herbalists believe that this plant should be used before it flowers—mature

plants contain gritty particles that can irritate the kidneys. Animals who are predisposed to plant allergies may be

sensitive to nettle—proceed with care.

注意事项和评论：触摸活植物会导致疼痛、起泡。彻底干燥或烹饪可以中和有毒成分。一些草药医生认

为，这种植物应该在开花前使用——成熟的植物含有会刺激肾脏的砂砾颗粒。容易对植物过敏的动物可能

对荨麻敏感——谨慎行事。
