OAT

Avena sativa

燕麦

Grass Family

草家族

Appearance: Oats look very much like any other tall grass, and positive identification can be difficult if you’re not

familiar with the fine details specific to the various cultivars of the Avena genus. Wild oat (A. fatua), a common and

often hated weed, has the same medicinal attributes as its cultivated relatives. The leaves of the seedlings and seeds

of this 1- to 4-foot-tall plant have two unique features that differentiate it from its cultivated cousins and most other

wild grasses. The first feature is the leaves. Early in growth, they have a counterclockwise twist in them; as the plant

matures, the leaves progressively straighten out. The second unique characteristic is the plant’s seeds, which at

maturity are presented in loosely arranged drooping spikelets. Each spikelet contains two or three foxtail-like seeds

that have proportionately long hairlike awns, each of which has a right angle kink in it, giving the appearance of a

crimped cockroach feeler.

外观：燕麦看起来非常像任何其他高草，如果您不熟悉燕麦属各种品种的具体细节，则可能很难正确识

别。野燕麦 (A. fatua) 是一种常见且经常令人讨厌的杂草，与栽培的近亲具有相同的药用特性。这种 1 至 4

英尺高的植物的幼苗叶子和种子有两个独特的特征，使其有别于其栽培近亲和大多数其他野生草本植物。

第一个特征是叶子。在生长早期，它们有逆时针扭曲；随着植物的成熟，叶子逐渐伸直。第二个独特特征

是植物的种子，成熟时呈松散排列的下垂小穗。每个小穗包含两到三个狐尾状种子，这些种子具有相应的

长毛状芒，每个种子都有直角扭结，看起来像卷曲的蟑螂触角。

=== PAGE 263 ===
Avena sativa

燕麦

Habitat and Range: Several cultivars of A. sativa are commercially grown throughout the world. Wild oat (A.

fatua) is a native of Europe that has been introduced into meadows, pastures, and waste areas throughout much of

North America.

栖息地和分布范围： 苜蓿的几个品种在世界各地进行商业种植。野燕麦（A. fatua）原产于欧洲，已被引入

北美大部分地区的草地、牧场和荒地。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual that blooms from June to August. The seeds of wild oat can remain dormant

in the soil for more than eight years, making it difficult to eradicate from areas where it isn’t wanted.

周期和开花季节：一年生植物，从六月到八月开花。野燕麦的种子可以在土壤中休眠八年以上，因此很难

从不需要的地方根除。

Parts Used: Post-flowering tops are used before the seeds fully mature. This is called the plant’s milk stage.

Herbalists refer to these parts as oatstraw.

使用的部分：开花后的顶部在种子完全成熟之前使用。这称为植物的乳汁阶段。草药学家将这些部分称为

燕麦秆。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Improves nerve functions, nutritive, anti-inflammatory

主要药用活性：改善神经功能、营养、抗炎

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system

最强的亲和力：神经系统

Preparation: Tea, tincture, fresh or dried herb

制剂：茶、酊剂、新鲜或干草药

Common Uses: Oatstraw is perhaps the best nervous system tonic for aging or debilitated animals. Not only does

the herb contain considerable amounts of protein (gluten), vitamins, and minerals (especially calcium, manganese,

iron, copper, and zinc) that are essential to the maintenance of health, but it contains various alkaloid, sterol, and

flavonoid constituents that act together to safely optimize nervous system functions while stabilizing the highs and

lows between nervousness and mental lethargy. For instance, when fed in moderation to animals with chronic

nervousness, oatstraw tends to have a calming effect, but when fed to debilitated animals, it tends to stimulate the

nervous system. Oatstraw tea or tincture is an excellent choice for animals recovering from exhaustion or suffering

from depression disorders. It is known to improve nerve transmission and can be useful for problems such as

epilepsy, tremors, paralysis, and twitching. It is a good tonic for nourishing the body and strengthening nerve

function following periods of sedation or anesthesia.

常见用途：燕麦草可能是衰老或虚弱动物最好的神经系统补品。这种草药不仅含有大量维持健康所必需的

蛋白质（麸质）、维生素和矿物质（特别是钙、锰、铁、铜和锌），而且还含有各种生物碱、甾醇和类黄

酮这些成分共同作用，安全地优化神经系统功能，同时稳定紧张和精神昏睡之间的高低。例如，当适量喂

食患有慢性紧张的动物时，燕麦草往往具有镇静作用，但当喂给虚弱的动物时，它往往会刺激神经系统。

燕麦草茶或燕麦酊剂对于从疲惫中恢复或患有抑郁症的动物来说是一个绝佳的选择。众所周知，它可以改

善神经传递，可用于治疗癫痫、震颤、瘫痪和抽搐等问题。它是镇静或麻醉后滋养身体和增强神经功能的

良好滋补品。

Dried oatstraw brews into a delicious tea that can be poured directly onto dog or cat food as a quickly assimilated

tonic supplement. Infuse a heaping teaspoon of oatstraw in 8 ounces of hot water. Feeding 1 ounce of the cooled tea

=== PAGE 264 ===
daily is a good amount for cats and animals of similar size. Give 2–4 ounces to most dogs. Glycerin tinctures are

also good and can be added to your companion’s diet at a daily rate of ½–½ teaspoon (1–2 milliliters) per 20 pounds

of the animal’s body weight. Oatstraw is highly water soluble, so there is no point in using an alcohol-based tincture

if nonalcohol alternatives are available.

干燕麦草冲泡成美味的茶，可以直接倒在狗或猫的食物上，作为快速吸收的补品。将一茶匙燕麦草倒入 8

盎司热水中。对于猫和体型相似的动物来说，每天喂食 1 盎司冷茶就足够了。给大多数狗喂 2-4 盎司。甘

油酊剂也不错，可以添加到您同伴的饮食中，每日每 20 磅动物体重 ½–½ 茶匙（1–2 毫升）。燕麦草具有高

度水溶性，因此如果有非酒精替代品，则使用酒精酊剂是没有意义的。

Of course, oats are a well-known feed for horses and other herbivores and should be included as part of their daily

diet. In terms of tonic value, fresh oat greens are vastly superior to what is purchased in grain bags, but the greens

must be fed in moderation. A few large handfuls can be added to the daily diet, but too much may cause

hyperexcitability.

当然，燕麦是马和其他食草动物众所周知的饲料，应作为其日常饮食的一部分。就滋补价值而言，新鲜

燕麦绿叶菜比购买的粮袋要好得多，但必须适量喂食。可以在日常饮食中添加几大把，但过多可能会导致

过度兴奋。

Oatmeal can be included as part of your companion’s natural diet. It can also be used externally as a soothing bath

for skin problems.

燕麦片可以作为您伴侣自然饮食的一部分。它也可以作为外部沐浴来舒缓皮肤问题。

Availability: Oatstraw is available through health food stores

可获得性：燕麦秸秆可在保健食品商店购买

Propagation and Harvest: Oat is easy to grow, but it takes up a great deal of garden space. If you opt to grow it,

harvest the top 6–12 inches of the plants after the seeds have formed but before the plants begin to dry.

繁殖和收获：燕麦很容易种植，但它占用大量花园空间。如果您选择种植它，请在种子形成后但在植物开

始干燥之前收获植物顶部 6-12 英寸的部分。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For depression disorders, oatstraw can be combined with Saint-John’s-wort,

passionflower, or chamomile (but consider changing you companion’s diet first). For treating epilepsy, oatstraw

combines with skullcap, valerian, or kava kava. In animals who are recovering from anesthesia or sedation,

alterative and diuretic herbs should be combined with oatstraw in order to help cleanse and nourish the blood and

eliminate systemic waste. Possibilities include red clover, dandelion leaf, alfalfa, garlic, and nettle. For older animals

who need continuous nervous system support, oatstraw combines especially well with nettle, red clover, alfalfa, and

替代品和辅助剂：对于抑郁症，燕麦草可以与圣约翰草、西番莲或洋甘菊结合使用（但首先考虑改变你同

伴的饮食）。为了治疗癫痫，燕麦草与黄芩、缬草或卡瓦卡瓦结合使用。在从麻醉或镇静中恢复的动物

中，替代和利尿草药应与燕麦草结合使用，以帮助清洁和滋养血液并消除全身废物。可能的植物包括红三

叶草、蒲公英叶、苜蓿、大蒜和荨麻。对于需要持续神经系统支持的老年动物，燕麦草与荨麻、红三叶

草、苜蓿和螺旋藻的结合特别好。

Cautions and Comments: Too much oatstraw may cause excitability or vomiting. If this occurs, simply reduce the

amount being fed to the animal.

注意事项和评论：过多的燕麦草可能会导致兴奋或呕吐。如果发生这种情况，只需减少喂给动物的量即

可。

OREGON GRAPE

俄勒冈葡萄

Mahonia aquifolium

十大功劳

Barberry Family

小檗家族

Appearance: At first glance, Oregon grape looks similar to American holly (Ilex opaca)—the stuff we deck the

halls with during the Christmas season. The almost plasticlike leaves of this perennial evergreen plant are divided

into several opposing pairs of oval to lance-shaped, ½- to 3-inch-long leaflets. The leaf edges have conspicuous

sharp spines. Flowers are yellow and are borne in clusters at the end of a sturdy central stalk. By midsummer, the

flowers develop into clusters of juicy, purple, ¼-to ½-inch fruits that resemble tiny grapes. The fruits are edible but

very sour.

外观：乍一看，俄勒冈葡萄看起来与美国冬青（Ilex opaca）相似——我们在圣诞节期间装饰大厅的东西。

这种多年生常绿植物几乎像塑料一样的叶子被分成几对相对的椭圆形到矛形、1/2 到 3 英寸长的小叶。叶缘

有明显的尖刺。花朵呈黄色，簇生于粗壮的中央茎的末端。到了仲夏，花朵会长成一簇簇多汁、紫色、1/4

至 1/2 英寸的水果，类似于小葡萄。水果可以吃，但是很酸。

Habitat and Range: Three species of Oregon grape are common in the coniferous forests of western North

America, ranging through the mountains of central California and New Mexico northward into Canada. Tall Oregon

grape (Mahonia aquifolium) is a variety that grows up to 6 feet tall and is abundant in the coastal forests to the west

slopes of the Rocky Mountains. Mahonia repens and M. nervosa are smaller (up to 12 inches tall), ground-hugging

versions that are widespread throughout their range. A fourth less-common species (M. pinnata) inhabits the

mountains of Baja Mexico and California. All share similar appearances, the primary differentiating factor being

their size.

栖息地和分布范围：三种俄勒冈葡萄常见于北美西部的针叶林中，穿过加利福尼亚州中部和新墨西哥州的

山脉，向北延伸到加拿大。高大的俄勒冈葡萄（Mahonia aquifolium）是一种高度可达 6 英尺的品种，盛产

于落基山脉西坡的沿海森林中。匍匐十大功劳（Mahonia repens）和神经功劳十大功劳（M.nervosa）体型较

小（最高 12 英寸），贴地型，在其分布范围内广泛分布。第四种不太常见的物种（M. pinnata）栖息在下

墨西哥和加利福尼亚州的山区。所有这些都有相似的外观，主要的区别因素是它们的大小。

=== PAGE 266 ===
Mahonia aquifolium

十大功劳

Cycle and Bloom Season: Perennial evergreens that bloom in late spring

周期和开花季节：在晚春开花的多年生常绿植物

Parts Used: Roots

使用部位：根部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antimicrobial, stimulates bile production, anti-inflammatory, tonic, antiparasitic

主要药用活性：抗菌、刺激胆汁产生、抗炎、滋补、抗寄生虫

Strongest Affinities: Liver and digestive system, mucous membranes

最强的亲和力：肝脏和消化系统、粘膜

Preparation: Tincture, tea, decoction, oil infusion, powdered root

制剂：酊剂、茶、汤剂、油浸剂、根粉

Common Uses: For most purposes, Oregon grape serves as an excellent alternative to goldenseal (Hydrastis

canadensis), an herb that is currently at risk of going extinct from the pressures of overharvest and loss of habitat.

Fortunately, Oregon grape remains common and abundant over a much wider range than the overharvested

goldenseal and is much easier to cultivate. So unless you have access to a cultivated source of goldenseal, please use

Oregon grape instead.

=== PAGE 267 ===
常见用途：在大多数用途中，俄勒冈葡萄是白毛茛（Hydrastis canadensis）的绝佳替代品，白毛茛是一种草

本植物，目前由于过度采收和栖息地丧失的压力而面临灭绝的危险。幸运的是，俄勒冈葡萄仍然常见且丰

富，其范围比过度收获的金印草要广泛得多，而且更容易种植。因此，除非您可以获得金印章的栽培来

源，否则请使用俄勒冈葡萄。

As is the case for goldenseal, a bitter yellow alkaloid called berberine is primarily responsible for the strong

antimicrobial activity of Oregon grape. The antibacterial properties of berberine have been shown to be more

effective than some forms of prescription antibiotics, including chloramphenicol, when used against various forms

of staphylococci. Berberine has also been shown to be active against E. coli and other gram-negative-type bacteria.

It is even effective against giardiasis, a parasitic infestation of the digestive tract that is reputedly difficult to remedy.

Like goldenseal, Oregon grape extract is especially useful in the ears, eyes, and the mucous membranes of the

vagina and urinary tract, where it combats various fungal infections as well.

与白毛茛的情况一样，一种叫做小檗碱的苦黄色生物碱是俄勒冈葡萄具有强大抗菌活性的主要原因。当

用于对抗各种形式的葡萄球菌时，小檗碱的抗菌特性已被证明比某些形式的处方抗生素（包括氯霉素）更

有效。小檗碱还被证明对大肠杆菌和其他革兰氏阴性细菌具有活性。它甚至对贾第鞭毛虫病也有效，贾第

鞭毛虫病是一种消化道寄生虫感染，据说很难治愈。与白毛茛一样，俄勒冈葡萄提取物对耳朵、眼睛、阴

道和泌尿道粘膜特别有用，还能对抗各种真菌感染。

For bacterial ear infections or ear mites, an oil infusion of the fresh or dried root works best. To make an oil

infusion, cut up the root as finely as possible and place it into a food processor or blender that has a glass or stainless

steel blending vessel. (The roots are tough and might cause plastic to crack.) Cover the chopped root with enough

olive oil to leave a ½-inch-thick layer above the herb. Put the lid on and blend until the oil is a vibrant, goldenrod-

yellow color (about ten minutes). Strain the chopped root out through a fine sieve, and you’ll have a nice,

antimicrobial ear oil. If you don’t wish to use your blender, you can let the chopped herb and olive oil mixture stand

in a covered jar at room temperature for one month before straining. The finished product keeps for several months,

sometimes years, if refrigerated. To use the oil, apply 1–10 drops at a time in each ear one to two times a day until

the infection is gone. It is also good as a general topical antibiotic for stings, insect bites, cuts, abrasions, puncture

injuries of the paws, and other injuries.

对于细菌性耳部感染或耳螨，用新鲜或干燥的根部浸油效果最好。要制作油浸剂，请将根尽可能切碎，

然后将其放入具有玻璃或不锈钢混合容器的食品加工机或搅拌机中。 （根很硬，可能会导致塑料破裂。）

用足够的橄榄油覆盖切碎的根，在药草上方留下 0.5 英寸厚的一层。盖上盖子，搅拌直至油呈鲜艳的金黄色

（大约十分钟）。通过细筛将切碎的根过滤出来，你就会得到一种很好的抗菌耳油。如果您不想使用搅拌

机，可以将切碎的香草和橄榄油混合物放在有盖的罐子中，在室温下放置一个月，然后过滤。如果冷藏的

话，成品可以保存几个月，有时甚至几年。使用精油时，每次在每只耳朵上滴 1-10 滴，每天一到两次，直

到感染消失。它也是一种很好的通用外用抗生素，用于治疗蜇伤、昆虫叮咬、割伤、擦伤、爪子刺伤和其

他伤害。

Oregon grape is effective in treating conjunctivitis, where it fights infection and reduces inflammation. To treat

your companion’s eyes with Oregon grape, dilute 4 drops of the alcohol tincture (available at your favorite herb

store), or 8 drops of a root decoction, into 1 ounce of sterile saline (available anywhere contact lens supplies are

sold). Place a few drops into the infected eye, taking note of any discomfort that may result from the berberine or the

alcohol content of the tincture. Some animals are more intolerant than others. If the solution appears to irritate the

eyes, dilute it with more saline and flush the eye with plain saline before applying more solution.

俄勒冈葡萄可有效治疗结膜炎，抵抗感染并减少炎症。要使用俄勒冈葡萄治疗伴侣的眼睛，请将 4 滴酒

精酊剂（您最喜欢的药草店有售）或 8 滴根汤稀释到 1 盎司无菌盐水（任何出售隐形眼镜用品的地方都有

售）。将几滴滴入受感染的眼睛中，注意小檗碱或酊剂中的酒精含量可能引起的任何不适。有些动物比其

他动物更不宽容。如果溶液似乎刺激眼睛，请用更多的盐水稀释，并在使用更多溶液之前用生理盐水冲洗

眼睛。

Oregon grape root is also noted for its ability to stimulate liver function. It is particularly helpful in cases of

chronic constipation associated with poor protein or fat metabolism, situations that often lead to itchy, flaky skin and

a dull coat in animals. Used under these circumstances, Oregon grape extract can bring fast and dramatic results, and

it does so by addressing an underlying cause of the problem. Generally speaking from a holistic perspective, many

forms of dermatitis are symptoms of an underlying liver dysfunction. If the liver cannot eliminate excess toxins or is

functionally compromised by blockages that reduce bile flow or production, the digestive tract fails at its job of

=== PAGE 268 ===
eliminating waste. One of the first places the body tries to force elimination is through the skin. Oregon grape works

in the liver much like a strong version of dandelion—bile production and flow is increased, and digestive efficiency

is improved. But Oregon grape stimulates liver function much faster than does dandelion, irritating the organ into

working harder. For this reason, Oregon grape should not be used in animals with acute liver disease or existing

liver injuries without the supervision of a trained professional. And although Oregon grape is safe when used

properly, it is likely to overexcite the liver of most animals if used excessively. If this occurs, your animal will

probably vomit because of excessive bile in the stomach; you should stop using Oregon grape and consider a gentler

herb such as dandelion. In any case, it is best not to give any herbal medicine every day of an animal’s life. Instead,

give whatever herbs you are using four to five days per week, then let the animal’s system rest for two or three days

before proceeding. This break time also gives you an opportunity to monitor changes that may be occurring as a

result of your therapeutic efforts.

俄勒冈葡萄根还因其刺激肝功能的能力而闻名。它对于与蛋白质或脂肪代谢不良有关的慢性便秘特别有

帮助，这种情况通常会导致动物皮肤发痒、剥落和皮毛暗淡。在这些情况下使用俄勒冈葡萄提取物可以带

来快速而显着的效果，并且它通过解决问题的根本原因来实现这一点。一般来说，从整体角度来看，许多

形式的皮炎都是潜在肝功能障碍的症状。如果肝脏无法消除多余的毒素，或者因阻塞而导致胆汁流动或产

生减少，从而导致功能受损，那么消化道就无法完成消除废物的工作。身体首先尝试强制排泄的地方之一

是通过皮肤。俄勒冈葡萄在肝脏中的作用就像增强版的蒲公英一样——胆汁的产生和流动增加，消化效率

提高。但俄勒冈葡萄刺激肝功能的速度比蒲公英快得多，会刺激该器官更加努力地工作。因此，未经训练

有素的专业人员的监督，不应将俄勒冈葡萄用于患有急性肝病或现有肝损伤的动物。尽管俄勒冈葡萄在正

确使用时是安全的，但如果过度使用，它可能会使大多数动物的肝脏过度兴奋。如果发生这种情况，您的

动物可能会因为胃中胆汁过多而呕吐；您应该停止使用俄勒冈葡萄并考虑使用更温和的草药，例如蒲公

英。无论如何，最好不要在动物一生中每天都给予任何草药。相反，每周给予您使用的任何草药四到五

天，然后让动物的系统休息两到三天，然后再继续。 这个休息时间还让您有机会监测因治疗努力而可能发

生的变化。

The bitter tonic action of the alkaloid constituents in Oregon grape make this herb a useful digestive aid. When a

drop or two of the root tincture is placed on the tongue, or when a leaf is chewed, an instantaneous salivary response

occurs. At the same time, mechanisms are triggered that release bile and various other enzymes and acids into the

digestive tract. The digestive system is therefore primed into action before the food arrives. Giving this bitter tonic

daily is an excellent holistic approach to safely treating chronic indigestion and malabsorption. If you or your animal

has problems with excess gas or with foods that tend to pass through undigested, try using a small dose of Oregon

grape before each meal. The results will probably amaze you.

俄勒冈葡萄中生物碱成分的苦味补品作用使这种草药成为有用的消化助剂。当将一两滴根酊剂放在舌头

上或咀嚼一片叶子时，就会立即产生唾液反应。同时，触发机制将胆汁和各种其他酶和酸释放到消化道

中。因此，消化系统在食物到达之前就已做好准备。每天服用这种苦味补品是安全治疗慢性消化不良和吸

收不良的绝佳整体方法。如果您或您的动物存在气体过多或食物未消化的问题，请尝试在每餐前使用少量

俄勒冈葡萄。结果可能会让您感到惊讶。

Oregon grape can also be used as an antibacterial in the urinary tract and is regarded by herbalists as an effective

remedy for infections of the bladder, kidneys, and urethra. Again, the antibacterial effect of Oregon grape in the

urinary tract is attributable to berberine, which stays effective long enough to reach deep into the body. Since most

infections of the urinary tract are associated with uncomfortable inflammation, combining this herb with the

soothing effects of marshmallow, licorice, or plantain is a good idea. Generally, a formula made with one part

Oregon grape to two parts of other soothing herbs is a good infection-fighting, pain-relieving approach.

俄勒冈葡萄还可用作泌尿道抗菌剂，被草药学家视为治疗膀胱、肾脏和尿道感染的有效药物。同样，俄

勒冈葡萄在泌尿道中的抗菌作用归因于小檗碱，它的有效时间足够长，可以深入到体内。由于大多数尿路

感染都与不舒服的炎症有关，因此将这种草药与具有舒缓作用的棉花糖、甘草或车前草结合起来是个好主

意。一般来说，用一份俄勒冈葡萄和两份其他舒缓草药制成的配方是一种很好的抗感染、缓解疼痛的方

法。

When combined in small proportions with echinacea, Oregon grape combats the infection directly while the

immune system plays catch-up with invading pathogens. At the same time, Oregon grape helps to support the liver

at its job of keeping the body clean through elimination of waste, a critical process of maintaining balanced body

functions while the body heals. And while conventional antibiotic therapies tend not to discriminate between

beneficial microbes and bad ones, the body is allowed to fight infection by natural mechanisms with a properly

=== PAGE 269 ===
proportioned berberine-containing herbal support formula without compromising its own microbial warriors.

Instead, it receives a measured degree of outside support and is gently stimulated into working harder toward

victory. A formula consisting of 10 percent Oregon grape and 90 percent echinacea is generally appropriate for this

purpose.

当俄勒冈葡萄与紫锥菊少量混合时，可以直接对抗感染，同时免疫系统可以追赶入侵的病原体。与此同

时，俄勒冈葡萄有助于支持肝脏通过消除废物来保持身体清洁，这是在身体康复时保持身体功能平衡的关

键过程。虽然传统的抗生素疗法往往不会区分有益微生物和有害微生物，但身体可以通过自然机制，使用

适当比例的含有小檗碱的草药支持配方来对抗感染，而不会损害其自身的微生物战士。相反，它会得到一

定程度的外部支持，并受到温和的刺激，更加努力地争取胜利。由 10% 俄勒冈葡萄和 90% 紫锥菊组成的配

方通常适合此目的。

In addition to its liver and disinfectant benefits, berberine is known to possess mild but useful sedative qualities

and may be effective as an anticonvulsive remedy. It has also been shown to help lower blood pressure and is

believed to slightly elevate blood sugar levels in hypoglycemic animals.

除了其肝脏和消毒功效外，小檗碱还具有温和但有用的镇静作用，并且可能作为一种有效的抗惊厥药

物。它还被证明有助于降低血压，并被认为可以略微提高低血糖动物的血糖水平。

Availability: The plants are available through landscape nurseries. Oregon grape root is available in a variety of

forms from herb retailers.

可用性：这些植物可通过景观苗圃获得。俄勒冈葡萄根可从药草零售商处购买到多种形式。

Propagation and Harvest: Oregon grape is widely adaptable to gardens throughout most of North America. Tall

Oregon grape (M. aquifolium) is the most common variety in commerce and is becoming popular as a landscape

shrub. It is quite easy to grow from root cuttings, seeds, or transplants. These plants are drought tolerant and winter

hardy. All they essentially need is slightly acidic soil and plenty of redwood compost, but they flourish when

afforded at least three hours of shade each day and a good weekly watering. Roots can be dug from mature plants

anytime during the year. They can be dried and kept in plastic bags for two or three years.

繁殖和收获：俄勒冈葡萄广泛适应北美大部分地区的花园。高大的俄勒冈葡萄（M. aquifolium）是商业上最

常见的品种，并且作为景观灌木而变得流行。它很容易通过根插条、种子或移植物生长。这些植物耐旱、

耐寒。它们所需要的只是微酸性土壤和大量的红木堆肥，但只要每天至少三个小时的阴凉处和每周良好的

浇水，它们就会茂盛生长。一年中的任何时候都可以从成熟的植物中挖出根。它们可以干燥并在塑料袋中

保存两到三年。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: In ear oils, combine with garlic and vitamin E oil. To aid in liver congestion and to

improve digestion, dandelion root serves as a weaker alternative. For Giardia and worms, Oregon grape combines

with garlic. In eyewashes, Oregon grape combines especially well with raspberry leaf. For urinary tract infections,

marshmallow, plantain, or licorice serve as soothing adjuncts.

替代品和添加剂：在耳油中，与大蒜和维生素 E 油混合。为了帮助肝脏充血并改善消化，蒲公英根是一种

较弱的替代品。对于贾第鞭毛虫和蠕虫，俄勒冈葡萄与大蒜结合使用。在洗眼剂中，俄勒冈葡萄与覆盆子

叶的结合特别好。对于尿路感染，棉花糖、车前草或甘草可作为舒缓辅助剂。

Cautions and Comments: Oregon grape should not be used in animals with acute liver disease or existing liver

injuries without the supervision of a professional. It has been theorized that too much berberine may inhibit vitamin

B assimilation.

注意事项和评论：未经专业人士的监督，俄勒冈葡萄不应用于患有急性肝病或现有肝损伤的动物。据推

测，过多的小檗碱可能会抑制维生素 B 的同化。

Appearance: It brings us satisfaction to tell you about useful plants that can be easily grown in any garden, but it

brings us special joy to tell you about useful plants that already grow on the edges of driveways and in vacant lots.

Oxeye daisy is such a plant. To the herbalist, a weed is simply a plant with attributes that have yet to be realized.

When the usefulness of such plants is brought to light, people reconsider their approaches to weed control. This

usually means a reduction in the use of toxic herbicides, which end up in the environment.

外观：告诉您可以在任何花园中轻松种植的有用植物让我们感到满意，但告诉您已经在车道边缘和空地上

生长的有用植物让我们感到特别高兴。牛眼菊就是这样一种植物。对于草药师来说，杂草只是一种具有尚

未实现的属性的植物。当这些植物的用途被揭露后，人们重新考虑他们的杂草控制方法。这通常意味着减

少最终进入环境的有毒除草剂的使用。

Oxeye daisy is a wild relative of pyrethrum daisy (genus Pyrethrum), which is cultivated for its insecticidal

properties. Oxeye daisy looks similar to the pyrethrum daisy; in fact at first glance it looks like any other white

daisy. But close examination of this plant’s unique leaf characteristics makes it easy to differentiate from all others

during any stage of its perennial growth cycle. The basal leaves of oxeye have proportionately long petioles (leaf

stems) and are spoon-shaped with rounded teeth along the edges. The leaves of the upper plant lack petioles, and the

flowers are typically daisylike: white with yellow centers and up to 3 inches wide. The entire plant may reach 3 feet

in height.

牛眼菊是除虫菊（除虫菊属）的野生近缘种，因其具有杀虫特性而被种植。牛眼菊看起来与除虫菊相

似。事实上，乍一看，它看起来和其他白色雏菊没什么两样。但仔细检查这种植物独特的叶子特征，可以

很容易地将其在多年生生长周期的任何阶段与其他植物区分开来。牛眼草的基生叶具有比例较长的叶柄

（叶茎），呈匙形，边缘有圆形齿。上部植物的叶子没有叶柄，花朵通常呈雏菊状：白色，中心黄色，宽

达 3 英寸。整个植物的高度可达3英尺。

Habitat and Range: Oxeye daisy is a Eurasian import that is now common to roadsides and dry waste areas

throughout the northern half of North America, up to about 6,000 feet in elevation.

栖息地和分布范围：牛眼菊是欧亚大陆进口的植物，现在常见于北美洲北半部海拔约 6,000 英尺的路边和干

燥荒地。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Plants bloom first in early summer, then often remain in bloom until fall.

周期和开花季节：植物在初夏首先开花，然后通常一直开花到秋天。

Parts Used: Leaves and flowers

使用部分：叶子和花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antihistamine, insecticidal (used for fleas), diuretic, stops bleeding

主要药用活性：抗组胺药、杀虫剂（用于跳蚤）、利尿剂、止血剂

Strongest Affinities: Respiratory tract, skin

最强的亲和力：呼吸道、皮肤

Preparation: Tea, tincture, or dried powdered herb

准备：茶、酊剂或干药草粉

Common Uses: The leaves are recognized by some contemporary herbalists for their diuretic and hemostatic

qualities, and clinical research suggests that the leaf tea may also be effective as an antihistamine medicine that

slows the body’s responses to allergens while helping to reduce excess secretions of mucus. The flower tea is

especially useful for helping to relieve seasonal hay fever characterized by sneezing and watery discharges from the

nose and eyes. At the onset of symptoms, 1 tablespoon of the strong tea can be fed to dogs as part of their daily diet

throughout the crisis period. Cats and other small mammals need only 1 teaspoon. Horses and other herbivores can

be allowed to eat the fresh plants from their pastures, and rabbits can be given a stem or two of the flowering plant

each day.

常见用途：一些当代草药学家认为叶子具有利尿和止血的功效，临床研究表明，叶茶也可能有效作为一种

抗组胺药，可以减缓身体对过敏原的反应，同时有助于减少粘液的过量分泌。花茶特别有助于缓解季节性

花粉热，其特征是打喷嚏和鼻子和眼睛流水样分泌物。症状出现时，可以给狗喂一汤匙浓茶，作为整个危

机期间日常饮食的一部分。猫和其他小型哺乳动物只需要 1 茶匙。马和其他食草动物可以吃牧场上的新鲜

植物，兔子每天可以吃一两根开花植物的茎。

As is true of its cultivated cousins, the flowers of oxeye daisy contain useful amounts of pyrethrin, a natural

insecticide that is useful for controlling fleas. To use oxeye daisy in this capacity, make a skin rinse from the fresh

chopped flowers or apply the dried flowers as a mildly effective but safe and natural flea powder.

与它的栽培近亲一样，牛眼菊的花朵含有大量的除虫菊酯，这是一种天然杀虫剂，可用于控制跳蚤。要

以这种方式使用牛眼菊，请用新鲜切碎的花冲洗皮肤，或将干花用作温和有效但安全且天然的跳蚤粉。

Pyrethrum roseum

除虫菊

As a diuretic, oxeye daisy can increase urinary output and dilute urine that is over-concentrated, strong smelling,

and too acidic, and it lends weak but measurable astringent and antimicrobial properties to inflamed urinary

membranes.

作为一种利尿剂，牛眼菊可以增加尿量并稀释浓度过高、气味强烈且酸性过高的尿液，并且它对发炎的

尿膜具有微弱但可测量的收敛和抗菌特性。

Oxeye daisy is often abundant on the margins of horse and stock trails, making it readily available as a first aid

remedy for minor cuts, fly bites, and such. The fresh-leaf poultice can be applied directly to the site of injury to help

stop bleeding. Combine it with one of many antimicrobial herbs that grows nearby (such as yarrow or bee balm),

and you’ll have an excellent, broad-spectrum field dressing.

牛眼菊通常长在马道和牲畜道的边缘，可以作为轻微割伤、苍蝇叮咬等的急救药物。新鲜叶子的膏药可

以直接涂抹在受伤部位，以帮助止血。将其与附近生长的多种抗菌草药之一（例如西洋蓍草或蜂香膏）结

合使用，您将获得一种出色的广谱野外敷料。

Availability: A widely distributed weed, oxeye daisy is available through nurseries.

可用性：牛眼菊是一种分布广泛的杂草，可通过苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Oxeye daisy is easy to grow from seeds or transplants. It is drought tolerant, winter

hardy, and adaptable to any soil. All oxeye daisy really needs is full sun.

繁殖和收获：牛眼菊很容易通过种子或移植来生长。它耐旱，耐寒，适应任何土壤。牛眼菊真正需要的只

是充足的阳光。

=== PAGE 273 ===
Alternatives and Adjuncts: As a fleafighting alternative, try feverfew. For seasonal allergies, oxeye daisy can be

combined with or replaced by nettle. Dandelion leaf is a much more effective diuretic.

替代品和辅助品：作为跳蚤的替代品，尝试小白菊。对于季节性过敏，牛眼菊可以与荨麻结合使用或用荨

麻代替。蒲公英叶是一种更有效的利尿剂。

Cautions and Comments: Some animals may be highly allergic to this plant—test a small amount of the tea on

your companion’s skin before using. If redness or any other response occurs, don’t feed it to your animal!

注意事项和评论：有些动物可能对这种植物高度过敏，使用前请在同伴的皮肤上测试少量茶。如果出现发

红或任何其他反应，请勿将其喂给您的动物！

PARSLEY

香菜

Petroselinum crispum

岩芹

Parsley Family

欧芹家族

Appearance: There are numerous cultivars of this familiar herb—their primary differences being leaf size and root

variations. The most common varieties have tightly curled leaves, whereas Italian parsley (P. crispus var.

neapolitanum) has leaves that are more like those of celery. Hamburg parsley (P. crispum var. tuberosum ) has a

thick turniplike taproot and fernlike leaves. All produce terminate umbel flowers, and most will grow to about 3 feet

tall.

外观：这种熟悉的草本植物有许多品种，它们的主要区别在于叶子的大小和根的变化。最常见的品种有紧

密卷曲的叶子，而意大利欧芹（P. Crispus var. neapolitanum）的叶子更像芹菜。汉堡欧芹（P. Criscum var.

tuberosum）有粗大的萝卜状主根和蕨类植物的叶子。所有产品都会终止伞形花序，大多数会长到约 3 英尺

高。

Habitat and Range: Originally a native of southeast Europe and west Asia, parsley is now cultivated worldwide.

栖息地和范围：欧芹原产于东南欧和西亚，现在在世界各地种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms in midsummer

周期和开花季节：在仲夏开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: Leaves, seeds, and roots

使用部分：叶、种子和根

Primary Medicinal Activities: Expels intestinal gas, lowers blood pressure, nutritive, diuretic, helps reduce

arthritic inflammation, promotes menstrual discharge, insecticidal, antimicrobial

主要药用活性：排出肠道气体、降低血压、营养、利尿、帮助减少关节炎炎症、促进月经排出、杀虫、抗

菌

Strongest Affinities: Digestive and urinary tracts, joints

最强的亲和力：消化道、泌尿道、关节

Preparation: Tea, tincture, or fresh or dried herb

制剂：茶、酊剂、新鲜或干草药

Common Uses: Parsley is much more than a plate garnish. In fact, it is one of the most versatile medicinal plants

around—it is an absolute “must have” in the home herb garden.

=== PAGE 275 ===
常见用途：欧芹不仅仅是盘子装饰。事实上，它是用途最广泛的药用植物之一——它绝对是家庭药草园

的“必备品”。

Parsley root is known by herbalists as an excellent diuretic that is especially beneficial in the treatment of

rheumatoid conditions. For humans, it is considered a specific remedy in the treatment of gout; it is believed to help

with the elimination of uric acid that would otherwise contribute to the buildup of painful crystals in the joints. For

animals, parsley root is useful in cases of arthritis that are compounded or perhaps even caused by poor waste

elimination, a problem that is often the result of a poor diet. For these purposes, dogs and cats can be given a strong

tea of the dried or freshly grated root (1 teaspoon of the strong tea per day for cats; 1–2 tablespoons for dogs), or a

tincture can be used (1–2 milliliters per 30 pounds of the animal’s body weight). Horses can be fed a few handfuls of

the entire fresh plant (leaves, roots, and all) each day, or a cup of the dried herb daily. Parsley root is especially

effective when combined with alternatives, hepatics, and anti-inflammatory herbs.

欧芹根被草药学家认为是一种极好的利尿剂，对于治疗类风湿性疾病特别有益。对于人类来说，它被认

为是治疗痛风的特效药物；它被认为有助于消除尿酸，否则尿酸会导致关节中疼痛晶体的积聚。对于动物

来说，欧芹根对于治疗由废物消除不良引起的复合关节炎或什至可能是由不良饮食引起的问题很有用。为

此，可以给狗和猫喝干的或新鲜磨碎的根的浓茶（猫每天 1 茶匙浓茶；狗 1-2 汤匙），或者可以使用酊剂

（1-2每 30 磅动物体重毫升）。每天可以给马喂几把整个新鲜植物（叶子、根等），或者每天喝一杯干草

本植物。欧芹根与替代品、护肝药和抗炎药草结合使用特别有效。

Parsley leaves and stems are very nutritious, containing up to 22 percent protein and impressive amounts of

vitamins A, C, B1, B2, and K, as well as fiber, calcium, riboflavin, potassium, iron, magnesium, niacin, and

phosphorus. This makes parsley an excellent nutritive in the treatment of anemia. The leaves also contain apiol and

several other volatile oils that have antiseptic qualities, making the herb useful for urinary tract infections. And

because parsley is a diuretic, it may help boost kidney function in cases of noninflammatory, early-onset renal

failure. Apiol also has a stimulant and strengthening effect on intestinal and uterine muscles, making it suitable for

improving uterine muscle tone after a difficult pregnancy. In the digestive tract, this tonic activity combines with

parsley’s carminative properties, making it effective in the treatment of flatulent dyspepsia and colic.

欧芹叶和茎营养丰富，含有高达 22% 的蛋白质和大量维生素 A、C、B 1 、B 2 和 K，以及纤维、钙、核

黄素、钾、铁、镁、烟酸和磷。这使得欧芹成为治疗贫血的极佳营养品。叶子还含有芹菜醇和其他几种具

有防腐功效的挥发油，使这种草药可用于治疗尿路感染。由于欧芹是一种利尿剂，它可能有助于在非炎症

性早发性肾衰竭的情况下增强肾功能。 Apiol 还对肠道和子宫肌肉有刺激和强化作用，使其适合在困难妊娠

后改善子宫肌张力。在消化道中，这种滋补活性与欧芹的驱风特性相结合，使其能够有效治疗胀气性消化

不良和绞痛。

Perhaps the best way to use parsley leaf for gastric or urinary disorders or for its nutritional qualities is to juice it.

If you don’t have a vegetable juicer, pack an electric blender halfway full with fresh leaves and add just enough

water to liquefy the leaves into a dark green soup. The juice, or “blender soup,” can be fed directly to an animal with

an empty stomach (the best option) or added to your companion’s drinking water (second best) or food (the last

resort)—1 teaspoon per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight. The juice (or a few drops of the leaf tincture) also

serves as an excellent breath freshener.

也许使用欧芹叶治疗胃病或泌尿系统疾病或其营养品质的最佳方法是将其榨汁。如果您没有蔬菜榨汁

机，请在电动搅拌机中放入半满的新鲜叶子，然后添加足够的水，将叶子液化成深绿色的汤。果汁或“搅拌

汤”可以直接喂给空腹的动物（最佳选择），也可以添加到同伴的饮用水（次佳）或食物中（最后的选择）

——每 20 磅动物加入 1 茶匙。动物的体重。果汁（或几滴叶酊剂）也可以作为极好的口气清新剂。

Availability: Plants are available through nurseries. The herb is also available in various forms through health food

and herb retailers everywhere.

可用性：植物可通过苗圃获得。这种草药还可以通过各地的保健食品和草药零售商以各种形式购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Parsley is easy to grow from seed or transplants. If given rich, well-drained soil, it will

return year after year. If allowed to go to seed, it will sprout up all over the garden.

繁殖和收获：欧芹很容易通过种子或移植来生长。如果给予肥沃、排水良好的土壤，它会年复一年地回

=== PAGE 276 ===
归。如果允许播种，它会在整个花园里发芽。

Petroselinum crispum

岩芹

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For rheumatoid conditions, shepherd’s purse serves as an effective substitute. For

urinary infections, consider corn silk, couch grass, echinacea, uva ursi, and horsetail as alternatives or adjuncts. For

colic and other digestive disorders, fennel, dill, slippery elm, plantain, marshmallow, cleavers, and licorice should

all be investigated. Raspberry leaf or nettle serves as alternative uterine tonics or nutritives.

替代品和辅助品：对于类风湿性疾病，荠菜是一种有效的替代品。对于泌尿道感染，可以考虑使用玉米

须、茅草、紫锥菊、熊果和木贼作为替代品或辅助品。对于绞痛和其他消化系统疾病，茴香、莳萝、滑

榆、车前草、棉花糖、切肉刀和甘草都应该进行研究。覆盆子叶或荨麻可作为替代子宫补品或营养品。

Cautions and Comments: Parsley, in dried, fresh, or tea form is very safe. However, highly concentrated

preparations of the seed, such as parsley essential oil, are rich in volatile oils that can be absorbed into the placenta,

so don’t use the essential oil internally or externally during an animal’s pregnancy. While it is thought to aid the

healing process after birthing, it may reduce lactation and should be used conservatively in nursing mothers. Parsley

should not be used if inflammation of the kidneys exists.

注意事项和评论：干欧芹、新鲜欧芹或茶形式的欧芹都是非常安全的。然而，高度浓缩的种子制剂，例如

欧芹精油，富含可以被胎盘吸收的挥发油，因此在动物怀孕期间不要内服或外用精油。虽然它被认为有助

于产后的愈合过程，但它可能会减少哺乳期，因此哺乳期母亲应保守使用。如果肾脏存在炎症，则不应使

用欧芹。

Parsley seeds contain the highest concentration of volatile oils, including a considerable amount of myristicin.

Myristicin can have strong hypotensive and hallucinogenic effects, especially in cats, and may cause liver damage or

photosensitivity if ingested in large enough quantities. Although such instances are rare, and it’s unlikely that an

animal could eat enough parsley seed to cause such problems, it’s best to be safe by using only parsley leaves,

=== PAGE 277 ===
stems, and roots, which contain much lower concentrations of myristicin.

欧芹种子含有最高浓度的挥发油，其中包括大量的肉豆蔻苷。肉豆蔻甙具有强烈的降血压和致幻作用，

尤其是对猫来说，如果摄入足够多，可能会导致肝损伤或光过敏。尽管这种情况很少见，而且动物吃足够

的欧芹种子不太可能导致此类问题，但为了安全起见，最好只使用欧芹叶、茎和根，因为它们的肉豆蔻苷

浓度要低得多。

PLANTAIN

芭蕉

Plantago sp.

车前子属

Plantain Family

车前草家族

Appearance: Common plantain (Plantago major) is characterized by its low-growing rosette of broad leaves and its

rather drab but distinctive flower cluster. The sturdy succulent leaves are on proportionately long petioles and have

distinct parallel veins that contain strong fibers. Flowers are small and inconspicuous, borne in tightly arranged

sausage-shaped spikes atop leafless stalks that reach well above the rest of the plant. Ten or more species of the

Plantago genus inhabit western North America, with common plantain by far the most widespread and abundant.

外观：普通车前草（Plantago Major）的特点是其低矮的宽叶莲座丛和相当单调但独特的花簇。坚固的多汁

叶子长在相当长的叶柄上，并具有明显的平行叶脉，其中含有坚固的纤维。花朵小而不显眼，长在无叶茎

上的紧密排列的香肠状穗状花序中，茎远高于植物的其他部分。北美西部栖息着十种或更多车前草属植

物，其中普通车前草是迄今为止分布最广、数量最多的。

Habitat and Range: Common plantain is frequently found in high impact areas, growing in the center of dirt roads,

walkways, and even the cracks in highways. It is widespread throughout most of North America.

栖息地和分布范围：普通车前草常见于高影响地区，生长在土路、人行道甚至高速公路裂缝的中心。它广

泛分布于北美大部分地区。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual or perennial that blooms March through August

周期和开花季节：一年生或多年生植物，三月至八月开花

Parts Used: All parts of the plant

使用部件： 工厂的所有部件

Primary Medicinal Activities: Lubricates, soothes, and protects internal mucous membranes; emollient; astringent;

anti-inflammatory; stops bleeding

主要药用活性：润滑、舒缓和保护内部粘膜；润肤剂；涩;消炎（药;止血

Strongest Affinities: Digestive and urinary tracts, skin

最强亲和力：消化道、泌尿道、皮肤

Preparation: Tincture, tea, poultice, or dried seed husks

制剂：酊剂、茶、膏剂或干种子壳

Common Uses: Plantain is one of many useful plants that have been forgotten by virtue of its abundance and its

=== PAGE 279 ===
reputation as a weed. Many of us step on it while en route to the vegetable garden, unaware that it may be more

nutritious than the vegetables we tend. Plantain is high in vitamins C, A, and K.

常见用途：车前草是许多有用的植物之一，但由于其丰富性和杂草的声誉而被遗忘。我们中的许多人在去

菜园的路上踩到它，没有意识到它可能比我们种植的蔬菜更有营养。车前草富含维生素 C、A 和 K。

In essence, plantain can be used in the same ways as slippery elm. The mucilaginous and astringent qualities of

plantain make it an excellent remedy for reducing inflammations inside and on the body. The aucubin and saponin

constituents of plantain have been shown to have antibacterial properties, especially against Micrococcus flavus,

Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus subtilus. All of these activities combine to make plantain useful in a wide range

of urinary, digestive, and respiratory ailments.

从本质上讲，车前草的使用方法与滑榆相同。车前草的粘液和收敛特性使其成为减少体内和身体炎症的

绝佳药物。车前草的桃叶珊瑚苷和皂苷成分已被证明具有抗菌特性，特别是针对黄微球菌、金黄色葡萄球

菌和枯草芽孢杆菌。所有这些活性结合在一起，使车前草可用于治疗多种泌尿、消化和呼吸系统疾病。

In the urinary tract, plantain can help stop minor bleeding, reduce inflammation, and relieve pain that is secondary

to bacterial infection or the passing of small stones (gravel). In the digestive tract, plantain relieves diarrhea and the

symptoms of various types of inflammatory bowel disease. Its lubricating properties and anti-inflammatory activities

make it useful for treating irritations of the stomach and intestinal tract that occur when an animal eats something

that is difficult to pass such as pine needles, a bottle cap, or a brand-new sequined handbag. Plantago psyllium is

widely known for its seeds and husks, which are used as an effective laxative and a source of dietary fiber. In the

upper respiratory tract, plantain helps soothe raspy coughs such as those caused by inhaled dust or canine

tracheobronchitis (kennel cough).

在泌尿道中，车前草可以帮助止血、减轻炎症并缓解继发于细菌感染或小结石（砾石）排出的疼痛。在

消化道中，车前草可以缓解腹泻和各种炎症性肠病的症状。它的润滑特性和抗炎活性使其可用于治疗动物

吃了松针、瓶盖或全新亮片手提包等难以排出的东西时引起的胃和肠道刺激。车前子以其种子和外壳而闻

名，它们被用作有效的泻药和膳食纤维的来源。在上呼吸道，车前草有助于缓解刺耳的咳嗽，例如由吸入

灰尘或犬气管支气管炎（犬窝咳）引起的咳嗽。

Plantain is best used fresh. If you have an electric juicer, liquefy the entire plant, roots and all. Otherwise, chop

the washed plants as finely as you can, pack them loosely into a blender, add just enough warm water to cover the

herb, and blend the mixture into a dark-green gooey soup. Don’t use boiling water because it destroys hydrolytic

enzymes that have antibacterial properties. You might end up with a tangle of the strong leaf fibers wrapped around

the blades of your machine—this is normal. Strain the liquid through a sieve and refrigerate it in a sealed glass jar

until you need it. It will keep for about two weeks in a very cold refrigerator. To use the juice for internal problems,

1 teaspoon can be fed for each 20 pounds of a dog’s body weight, once or twice daily. Cats can take up to a teaspoon

of the juice twice daily. It’s best to administer the juice before a meal and with as little added water as possible. If

this isn’t possible, the juice can be added to your companion’s food. For colic, the removal of sand in the digestive

tract, and other digestive problems in horses or other large animals, a handful or two of the fresh plants can be fed as

part of a daily diet.

车前草最好新鲜使用。如果您有电动榨汁机，请将整个植物、根部等全部液化。否则，将洗净的植物尽

可能切碎，松散地放入搅拌机中，加入足够的温水覆盖药草，然后将混合物混合成深绿色的粘稠汤。不要

使用沸水，因为它会破坏具有抗菌特性的水解酶。您最终可能会在机器的叶片上缠绕一团坚固的叶纤维

——这是正常现象。通过筛子过滤液体，然后将其冷藏在密封的玻璃罐中，直到您需要为止。它可以在非

常冷的冰箱中保存大约两周。要使用果汁治疗内部问题，每 20 磅体重的狗可以喂 1 茶匙，每天一到两次。

猫每天最多可以喝两次一茶匙的果汁。最好在饭前喝果汁，并尽可能少加水。如果不可能，可以将果汁添

加到您同伴的食物中。对于马或其他大型动物的绞痛、消化道沙子的清除以及其他消化问题，可以将一把

或两把新鲜植物作为日常饮食的一部分。

A poultice of plantain is one of the best topical first aid remedies for insect bites, stings, minor burns, and site-

specific contact dermatitis (such as minor bouts with stinging nettle). An oil infusion or salve of the fresh or dried

plant can be used for the same purposes.

车前草膏剂是治疗昆虫叮咬、蜇伤、轻微烧伤和特定部位接触性皮炎（例如轻微荨麻发作）的最佳局部

急救药物之一。新鲜或干燥植物的油浸剂或药膏可用于相同目的。

=== PAGE 280 ===
Plantago major

车前子

Availability: A widely distributed weed. The husks of P. psyllium are available through any respectable health food

store, and several psyllium products are now being produced specifically for use in animals. The seeds of several

varieties can be purchased through specialty catalogs.

可用性：一种广泛分布的杂草。车前草的外壳可以通过任何一家受人尊敬的保健食品商店购买，并且现在

正在生产一些专门用于动物的车前草产品。可以通过专业目录购买多个品种的种子。

Propagation and Harvest: Plantain is easy to grow—all it needs is ample water during its germination. Sow the

tiny seeds as sparsely as you can under 1/8 inch of soil, and keep them wet until they sprout. The plants can be

harvested and used anytime, but the mature second-year and older plants make the best medicine.

繁殖和收获：车前草很容易生长——它在发芽期间只需要充足的水即可。将微小的种子尽可能稀疏地撒在

1/8 英寸的土壤下，并保持湿润直至发芽。这些植物可以随时收获和使用，但成熟的二年及老植物是最好的

药物。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Plantain can be used as a substitute for slippery elm, a hardwood tree that is being

overharvested for its medicinal inner bark. Marshmallow root contains far more mucilage than plantain does, and it

serves as a more effective alternative in cases in which digestive or urinary tract lubrication is needed. In situations

in which the astringency and mucilage content of plantain are not enough to bring relief to urinary irritations, try

combining marshmallow with a stronger astringent such as uva ursi or rose bark.

替代品和辅助品：车前草可以用作滑榆树的替代品，滑榆树是一种硬木树，因其药用内皮而被过度采伐。

药蜀葵根含有比车前草更多的粘液，在需要消化道或泌尿道润滑的情况下，它是更有效的替代品。如果车

前草的收敛剂和粘液含量不足以缓解尿路刺激，请尝试将棉花糖与熊果或玫瑰皮等更强的收敛剂混合。

=== PAGE 281 ===
Cautions and Comments: Side effects are rare with this plant, but some animals may be allergic to it. If your

companion is predisposed to plant allergies, test for sensitivity by applying a small amount to the skin. If no reaction

occurs, proceed with a small internal dose (a few drops), and watch for sneezing, watery eyes, or other signs of

allergic response.

注意和评论：这种植物很少有副作用，但有些动物可能会对它过敏。如果您的同伴容易对植物过敏，请在

皮肤上涂抹少量以测试敏感性。如果没有发生反应，请继续少量内服（几滴），并注意是否打喷嚏、流泪

或其他过敏反应迹象。

RASPBERRY

覆盆子

Rubus sp.

悬钩子属sp。

Rose Family

玫瑰家族

Appearance: Raspberries are generally categorized by color—red or black. Leaf and stem characteristics vary

between species of this widespread genus of shrubs. Most have divided leaves and five-petal flowers that range from

white to crimson in color. The plants are generally found as tangled masses of thorny trailing biennial stems that

yield a tasty reward to those brave enough to reach the choicest berries. All species are medicinally useful.

外观：覆盆子通常按颜色分类——红色或黑色。这种分布广泛的灌木属物种之间的叶子和茎特征各不相

同。大多数有分裂的叶子和五瓣花，颜色从白色到深红色。这些植物通常是一丛丛缠结的、带刺的二年生

茎，对于那些勇敢地摘取精选浆果的人来说，它们会带来美味的奖励。所有物种均具有药用价值。

Habitat and Range: As one travels northward through the Rocky Mountains and the coastal states of the West, the

diversity of species and the number of roadside bramble patches encountered progressively increases. Many species

of Rubus are regarded as invasive weeds. They are common and often abundant inhabitants of pastures, roadside

ditches, and riparian habitats. This genus often cross-pollinates, making exact identification of species difficult in

many areas. And many species have escaped cultivation, making it anybody’s guess where one of these plants will

pop up next. Red raspberry (R. idaeus—illustrated) is one of the most common indigenous species found throughout

North America.

栖息地和范围：随着向北穿越落基山脉和西部沿海各州，物种的多样性和路边荆棘丛的数量逐渐增加。许

多悬钩子属植物被视为入侵杂草。它们是牧场、路边沟渠和河岸栖息地的常见且数量丰富的居民。该属经

常异花授粉，因此在许多地区很难准确识别物种。许多物种已经逃脱了种植，因此人们都在猜测其中一种

植物接下来会在哪里出现。红树莓（R. idaeus - 如图所示）是北美最常见的本土树种之一。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Perennials that bloom and produce fruit from second-year plants, known as canes

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，从第二年植物（称为手杖）开花并结果实

Parts Used: Dried leaves and, of course, the delicious fruit

使用的部分：干叶子，当然还有美味的水果

Primary Medicinal Activities: Astringent, strengthens the uterus (uterotonic), nutritive, diuretic, laxative, mild

sedative

主要药用活性：收敛剂、增强子宫（子宫收缩）、营养、利尿、轻泻剂、温和镇静剂

Strongest Affinities: Female reproductive system, eyes, skin

最强亲和力：女性生殖系统、眼睛、皮肤

Preparation: Infusion, poultice, or tincture

Common Uses: Raspberry leaf is a safe and gentle medicinal food. Aside from its nutritional value (it is especially

high in vitamin C), raspberry leaf tea has mild astringent qualities that make it useful for a wide variety of remedial

and tonic therapies. Taken internally, the tea is useful for treating minor digestive tract inflammations and can be

used as a remedy for mild cases of diarrhea. In such instances, a strong infusion can be fed at a dose of 2 ounces per

20 pounds of an animal’s body weight (or 1 ounce for cats), twice daily as needed for relief. Alternatively, the dried

leaf can be used—1 teaspoon per 20 pounds of the animal’s weight, sprinkled onto food daily. For bleeding or

inflamed gums, the powdered leaf can be applied directly to the site of the problem, or the tea can be applied to the

gums with a cotton swab.

常见用途：覆盆子叶是一种安全温和的药用食品。除了其营养价值（维生素 C 含量特别高）之外，覆盆子

叶茶还具有温和的收敛特性，使其可用于多种治疗和滋补疗法。内服茶可有效治疗轻微的消化道炎症，并

可用于治疗轻度腹泻。在这种情况下，可以按照每 20 磅动物体重 2 盎司（或猫 1 盎司）的剂量喂浓输液，

每天两次，以缓解症状。或者，也可以使用干燥的叶子——每 20 磅动物体重使用 1 茶匙，每天撒在食物

上。对于牙龈出血或发炎，可以将粉末状的叶子直接涂抹在有问题的部位，或者用棉签将茶涂抹在牙龈

上。

Traditionally, the leaf tea is perhaps the most widely used “female tonic” in existence. It acts to improve the tone

and elasticity of smooth muscle tissues in and around the uterus. It is useful as a prepregnancy tonic and in pregnant

or postpartum dogs, cats, horses, and other animals during the final weeks of pregnancy. The dried leaf can be

sprinkled onto your animal’s food (at the previously mentioned doses) as a daily tonic, or it can be fed as a tea.

Make the tea by steeping 1 teaspoon of the dried leaf (in a tea ball) in 8 ounces of hot water. The tea can be added to

your animal’s drinking water until the water is noticeably colored. The animal can then drink at will.

传统上，叶茶可能是目前使用最广泛的“女性补品”。它的作用是改善子宫内和子宫周围平滑肌组织的张

力和弹性。它可用作孕前补品，也适用于怀孕或产后的狗、猫、马和其他动物在怀孕的最后几周。干叶子

可以撒在动物的食物上（按照前面提到的剂量）作为日常补品，也可以作为茶喂食。将 1 茶匙干茶叶（放

入茶球中）浸泡在 8 盎司热水中泡茶。可以将茶添加到动物的饮用水中，直到水明显变色。然后动物就可

以随意喝水了。

Raspberry leaf is especially beneficial in the form of a saline eyewash for symptomatic relief of conjunctivitis. To

make an eyewash, infuse 1 teaspoon of dried raspberry leaf in 8 ounces of hot distilled water. Allow the tea to cool,

strain it through a coffee filter, then combine it with enough sterile saline solution to produce a slightly tinted

solution. The cooled full-strength tea can also be used as a soothing scalp or skin rinse—its astringency helps to

relieve minor itchiness.

覆盆子叶以盐水洗眼的形式特别有益于缓解结膜炎症状。要制作洗眼液，请将 1 茶匙干覆盆子叶注入 8

盎司热蒸馏水中。让茶冷却，通过咖啡过滤器过滤，然后将其与足够的无菌盐水溶液混合以产生稍微有色

的溶液。冷却后的浓茶还可以用作舒缓头皮或皮肤冲洗剂——它的收敛性有助于缓解轻微的瘙痒。

Availability: Raspberry leaf is available at health food stores. The canes are available through most nurseries.

可获得性：覆盆子叶可在保健食品商店购买。大多数托儿所都可以买到手杖。

Propagation and Harvest: Raspberries are easy to grow. Transplanted canes produce an abundance of leaves, and

they produce their first fruit during their second year of growth and every year thereafter. The plants like moist,

potassiumrich soil and full sun. Harvest the leaves just before the plants bloom in spring or early summer. Dry them

on a clean non-metallic surface until they are crispy dry. The dried leaves can be stored in plastic bags for a year or

more.

繁殖和收获：覆盆子很容易种植。移植的甘蔗会长出丰富的叶子，并在生长的第二年和此后的每一年结出

第一个果实。植物喜欢潮湿、富含钾的土壤和充足的阳光。在春季或初夏植物开花之前收获叶子。将它们

放在干净的非金属表面上干燥，直至酥脆干燥。干燥的叶子可以在塑料袋中保存一年或更长时间。

Rubus idaeus

悬钩子

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Raspberry serves as a less-threatened substitute for eyebright (Euphrasia spp.), a plant

that is currently at risk of disappearing because of overharvest. The leaves of strawberry (Fragaria spp.) can be used

as a substitute for raspberry leaf. As a female tonic, nettle leaf tea serves as a better substitute because it contains a

much richer array of vital nutrients. Nettle can also be used in eye and skin washes. For conjunctivitis or

inflammation of the mouth that is secondary to bacterial or fungal infection, raspberry leaf combines well with

Oregon grape and echinacea. If the problem appears to be of viral origin, mullein leaf or Saint-John’s-wort may

serve as an effective adjunct. For diarrhea and internal bleeding, stronger alternatives include uva ursi, horsetail,

plantain, and cayenne.

替代品和辅助品：覆盆子是小米草（Euphrasia spp.）的威胁较小的替代品，小米草目前因过度采收而面临

消失的风险。草莓（Fragaria spp.）的叶子可以用作覆盆子叶的替代品。作为女性滋补品，荨麻叶茶是更好

的替代品，因为它含有更丰富的重要营养素。荨麻也可用于眼睛和皮肤清洗。对于继发于细菌或真菌感染

的结膜炎或口腔炎症，覆盆子叶与俄勒冈葡萄和紫锥菊完美结合。如果问题似乎是由病毒引起的，毛蕊花

或圣约翰草可以作为有效的辅助剂。对于腹泻和内出血，更强效的替代品包括熊果、木贼、车前草和辣

椒。

Cautions and Comments: Never use raspberry leaves that are not completely dry. As the leaves wilt, they

temporarily develop toxins that can be nauseating to your animal.

注意和评论：切勿使用未完全干燥的覆盆子叶。当叶子枯萎时，它们会暂时产生毒素，使您的动物感到恶

心。

Despite old claims of raspberry leaf causing uterine contractions, no qualified reports of toxicity have been

recorded for this herb.

尽管过去一直声称覆盆子叶会导致子宫收缩，但尚未记录到这种草药的毒性合格报告。

RED CLOVER

红三叶草

Trifolium pratense

红车轴草

Pea Family

豌豆家族

Appearance: Red clover was introduced to the U.S. from Europe as a feed crop for livestock and has since escaped

cultivation to make itself at home throughout North America. It is characterized by the predominantly threelobed

leaves of the Trifolium genus, of which dozens of species and cultivars are distributed throughout the West. The

differences among these many species may be minute, and positive identification of a specific Trifolium sp. can be

challenging. First, the identification of red clover can begin by recognizing its red, globe-shaped flowers and its soft,

hairy stems. Second, we can see that the flower stems (pedicels) are shorter in length than each of the leaf stems

(petioles). And finally, red clover has a small carrotlike taproot, whereas many clovers have horizontally creeping

roots systems (rhizomes). If all of this fails to answer the question of identity, cheat—find some red clover that has

been cultivated and formulate personalized notes for future reference.

外观：红三叶草作为牲畜饲料作物从欧洲引入美国，后来不再种植，而是在北美各地安家落户。它的特点

是主要是三叶草属的三叶叶，该属植物有数十个物种和品种分布在整个西部地区。这些许多物种之间的差

异可能很小，并且可以肯定地鉴定出特定的三叶草属物种。可能具有挑战性。首先，红三叶草的识别可以

从识别其红色、球形的花朵和柔软、多毛的茎开始。其次，我们可以看到花茎（花梗）的长度比每个叶茎

（叶柄）的长度短。最后，红三叶草有一个像胡萝卜一样的小主根，而许多三叶草有水平匍匐的根系统

（根茎）。如果所有这些都无法回答身份问题，那就作弊吧——找一些已经种植的红三叶草，制定个性化

的笔记以供将来参考。

Habitat and Range: Red clover is widespread in cultivated fields, road margins, gardens, and other disturbed areas

where the plant has been introduced largely through agricultural activities.

栖息地和分布范围：红三叶草广泛分布于耕地、道路边缘、花园和其他受干扰的地区，该植物主要是通过

农业活动引入的。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A short-lived perennial that blooms in early summer

周期和开花季节：一种短暂的多年生植物，在初夏开花

Parts Used: Flowering tops

使用部件： 开花顶部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Helps with blood cleansing, diuretic, expectorant, tonic, antispasmodic, nutritive,

antitumor, effects estrogen production in the body (estrogenic)

主要药用活性：帮助净化血液、利尿、祛痰、滋补、解痉、营养、抗肿瘤、影响体内雌激素的产生（雌激

素）

Strongest Affinities: Liver, blood, and skin

=== PAGE 286 ===
最强的亲和力：肝脏、血液和皮肤

Preparation: Tea, dried or fresh herb, or tincture

准备：茶、干或新鲜药草、或酊剂

Common Uses: Although traditionally red clover has been used and highly acclaimed as a blood-purifying

alterative and anticancer agent for hundreds, perhaps thousands, of years, few scientific studies have been conducted

to substantiate these claims. Regardless, thousands of herbalists and an equal number of people who have witnessed

red clover’s potential as a healing agent and preventative seem to know something. At the root of red clover’s

attributes is an impressive array of protein, magnesium, calcium, potassium, and vitamin C and B complex. All of

these nutrients are joined with a complex assortment of medicinally active chemical compounds. In the mind of a

holistically oriented herbalist, all of these components synergistically amount to an excellent remedy for psoriasis,

eczema, and other skin disorders, especially those believed to be secondary to excess waste materials in the

bloodstream. For such disorders, red clover may be used internally or externally. Internally, a flower tea or tincture

gently stimulates the liver and gallbladder to help optimize digestion and replenish the blood. Externally, a cooled

tea or poultice can be applied to flaky dry, itchy skin for symptomatic relief. Added to an animal’s daily diet as a

preventive measure, you can give a pinch of dried red clover to a dog; a tinier pinch to a cat; and a handful to horses,

llamas, and sheep. A rabbit can be fed a flower or two a day, and for other animals, as with any herb, moderation is

the single-word golden rule.

常见用途：虽然传统上红三叶草一直被用作血液净化替代品和抗癌剂，并广受好评数百年甚至数千年，但

很少有科学研究来证实这些说法。不管怎样，成千上万的草药医生和同等数量的亲眼目睹了红三叶草作为

治疗剂和预防剂的潜力的人似乎都知道一些事情。红三叶草属性的根源在于一系列令人印象深刻的蛋白

质、镁、钙、钾以及维生素 C 和 B 复合物。所有这些营养素都与各种复杂的药用活性化合物结合在一起。

在以整体为导向的草药医生看来，所有这些成分协同作用，是治疗牛皮癣、湿疹和其他皮肤病的极好药

物，特别是那些被认为是继发于血液中过量废物的疾病。对于此类疾病，红三叶草可以内服或外用。在内

部，花茶或酊剂会温和刺激肝脏和胆囊，帮助优化消化和补充血液。在外部，可以将冷却的茶或药膏涂抹

在片状干燥、发痒的皮肤上，以缓解症状。作为预防措施，您可以将一小撮干红三叶草添加到动物的日常

饮食中；对猫来说更小的捏；还有少数是马、美洲驼和羊。兔子每天可以喂一两朵花，对于其他动物来

说，就像任何草药一样，适量是金科玉律。

In horses, red clover is sometimes fed to speed recovery from viral infections of the respiratory tract, particularly

when a persistent cough or excessive secretion of thick mucus from inflamed mucous membranes (catarrh) seem to

be slowing the healing process by adding stress to a rundown animal. Feed ½–2 cups of the flower heads daily as

part of the animal’s feed. If tea is a better option, 3 or 4 heaping tablespoons of the dried flowers steeped in a pint of

water can be fed daily.

对于马，有时会喂红三叶草以加速呼吸道病毒感染的恢复，特别是当持续咳嗽或发炎粘膜（卡他）分泌

过多浓稠粘液时，似乎会增加马匹压力，从而减缓愈合过程。动物。每天喂 ½–2 杯头状花序作为动物饲料

的一部分。如果茶是更好的选择，可以每天喂 3 到 4 汤匙干花，浸泡在一品脱水中。

Much of red clover’s reputation as an anticancer herb stems from its inclusion in the famed Hoxsey Formula and

the still popular Essiac Formula, although skeptics argue that the effectiveness of these formulas are without

validation. Both of these formulas have been used extensively during the past seventy-five years, and many cancer

sufferers, practitioners, and pet owners have claimed near-miraculous results from them. In addition to these

formulas, red clover is often used by itself—again with many favorable claims. As mentioned, scientific evidence to

support these claims is scarce but certainly exists. In 1988, a study published in The Journal of Cancer Research

indicated that the anticancer activity of red clover may in fact be a scientific reality. Specifically, it was found that

the flavonoid constituents in red clover blossoms inhibit the harmful activities of a carcinogenic substance called

benzopyrene, a compound present in charbroiled foods. In an earlier 1970 study that was published in the same

journal, the flavonoid quercetin found in red clover was shown to prevent benzopyrene from becoming active in the

liver and small intestines. While these studies fall short of identifying the breadth of red clover’s activity against

various other carcinogens, they certainly indicate that further research is warranted and add credibility to what

holistic practitioners have been telling us all along.

=== PAGE 287 ===
红三叶草作为抗癌草药的声誉很大程度上源于其被包含在著名的 Hoxsey Formula 和仍然流行的 Essiac

Formula 中，尽管怀疑论者认为这些配方的有效性未经验证。这两种配方在过去七十五年中都被广泛使用，

许多癌症患者、从业者和宠物主人都声称它们具有近乎奇迹的效果。除了这些配方之外，红三叶草还经常

单独使用——同样有许多有利的说法。如前所述，支持这些说法的科学证据很少，但确实存在。 1988年，

《癌症研究杂志》发表的一项研究表明，红三叶草的抗癌活性可能确实是一个科学事实。具体来说，人们

发现红三叶草花中的黄酮类成分可以抑制一种叫做苯并芘的致癌物质的有害活动，苯并芘是一种存在于炭

烤食品中的化合物。 1970 年早些时候发表在同一期刊上的一项研究表明，红三叶草中发现的黄酮类槲皮素

可以防止苯并芘在肝脏和小肠中变得活跃。虽然这些研究未能确定红三叶草对抗各种其他致癌物的活性广

度，但它们无疑表明有必要进行进一步的研究，并增加了整体实践者一直告诉我们的可信度。

Trifolium pratense

红车轴草

In animals with cancerous lesions of the skin or extremities, a poultice of red clover flowers can be applied in the

form of a compress for several hours each day until the animal’s condition (hopefully) improves. Internal doses of

the flower tea or tincture can be used in dogs, cats, horses, and other animals as well. In the fight against cancer,

anything that can be applied safely and without contributing stress to an already stressed body is certainly worth a

try. In our minds, red clover is at the top of the list.

对于皮肤或四肢有癌性病变的动物，可以每天敷用红三叶草花药膏几个小时，直到动物的病情（希望）

得到改善。花茶或酊剂的内部剂量也可用于狗、猫、马和其他动物。在对抗癌症的过程中，任何可以安全

应用且不会给已经承受压力的身体带来压力的方法当然值得一试。在我们看来，红三叶草位居榜首。

Availability: Seed catalogs, feed stores, health food stores, and other herb retailers

可用性：种子目录、饲料商店、保健食品商店和其他草药零售商

=== PAGE 288 ===
Propagation and Harvest: If you have rich, moist soil and a section of garden you wish to delegate to the

spreading, strong-rooted nature of this plant, red clover can be easily propagated from seed. Harvest the flowers

during dry weather in early summer. Use them fresh or dry them indoors on a piece of clean paper. The dried

flowers keep for a year if properly stored.

繁殖和收获：如果您有肥沃、潮湿的土壤和一块花园，您希望将这种植物的传播、根系牢固的特性委托给

您，那么红三叶草可以很容易地用种子繁殖。在初夏干燥的天气里收获花朵。新鲜使用或在室内用一张干

净的纸擦干。如果储存得当，干花可以保存一年。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For skin problems that are secondary to poor liver metabolism or excessive systemic

waste, red clover combines well with yellow dock, alfalfa, burdock, dandelion root, and nettle.

替代品和辅助品：对于因肝脏代谢不良或全身废物过多而继发的皮肤问题，红三叶草可与黄坞、苜蓿、牛

蒡、蒲公英根和荨麻完美搭配。

Cautions and Comments: When properly used, red clover is a safe herb, but, as is true for many plants, its use does

demand some attention and respect. First, do not use red clover for animals with clotting disorders or in the presence

of internal or external bleeding. This plant contains the compound coumarin, which is cited in many toxicology texts

as having blood-thinning qualities. However, recent studies suggest that the coumarin alone do not really possess

blood-thinning properties. Instead, it is now thought that blood-thinning properties may only occur when certain

molds or fungi develop on the herb as result of improper drying. Red clover is also known to contain estrogenic

isoflavone constituents that may prove toxic to livestock and other animals if fed in large quantities. Cases of acute

skin and digestive disorders have been reported in horses, sheep, cattle, and other animals who have been allowed to

excessively overgraze on fresh red clover. Red clover also possesses some phytoestrogenic principles that

contraindicate this herb’s use in pregnant or lactating animals.

注意和评论：如果使用得当，红三叶草是一种安全的药草，但是，正如许多植物一样，它的使用确实需要

一些关注和尊重。首先，不要将红三叶草用于患有凝血障碍或存在内出血或外出血的动物。这种植物含有

化合物香豆素，许多毒理学文献都引用它具有稀释血液的特性。然而，最近的研究表明，单独的香豆素并

不真正具有稀释血液的特性。相反，现在人们认为，只有当草药因干燥不当而产生某些霉菌或真菌时，才

会出现血液稀释特性。红三叶草还含有雌激素异黄酮成分，如果大量喂养，可能会对牲畜和其他动物有

毒。据报道，马、羊、牛和其他动物因过度吃新鲜红三叶草而出现急性皮肤和消化系统疾病。红三叶草还

具有一些植物雌激素原理，禁止在怀孕或哺乳期动物中使用这种草药。

=== PAGE 289 ===
ROSE

玫瑰

Rosa spp.

蔷薇属

Rose Family

玫瑰家族

Appearance: Most people are familiar with roses. Hundreds of cultivars adorn flower beds to please the senses and

stir the emotions of millions of people worldwide. In addition to the healing power of their beauty, all roses are

medicinally useful. The wild species (of which there are dozens in North America) offer the best-tasting, most

nutritional hips. Wild roses look and smell very much like their domesticated counterparts except that they have

smaller flowers and leaves. Characterized by their white-topink (sometimes yellow), five-petaled flowers, thorny

stems, and bright red to purplish fruit (hips), these plants represent a safe, easy-to-identify, delightful introduction to

nature’s pantry and apothecary.

外观：大多数人都熟悉玫瑰。数百个品种装饰着花坛，以愉悦全世界数百万人的感官并激发他们的情感。

除了美丽的治愈能力之外，所有玫瑰都具有药用价值。野生品种（北美有数十种）提供味道最好、营养最

丰富的臀部。野玫瑰的外观和气味与驯化的玫瑰非常相似，只是它们的花朵和叶子较小。这些植物的特点

是白顶粉红色（有时是黄色）、五瓣花、带刺的茎和鲜红色到紫色的果实（臀部），这些植物代表了对大

自然食品储藏室和药剂师的安全、易于识别、令人愉快的介绍。

Habitat and Range: Wild roses like consistently moist soil and are often found standing in dense thickets at road

margins, in irrigation ditches, and especially as the “defensive edge” of riparian habitats up to about 6,000 feet in

elevation. Several species are native throughout North America. Wood’s rose (Rosa woodsii ) represents one of the

most widespread pink-flowered species to be found in western North America. Multiflora rose (R. multiflora) grows

profusely throughout the midwestern U.S. and eastern Canada, where it forms dense thickets and is often considered

a troublesome weed.

栖息地和范围：野玫瑰喜欢持续湿润的土壤，经常生长在道路边缘、灌溉沟渠的茂密灌木丛中，尤其是海

拔约 6,000 英尺的河岸栖息地的“防御边缘”。有几个物种原产于北美各地。伍德玫瑰（Rosa woodsii）是北

美洲西部分布最广泛的粉红色花品种之一。多花玫瑰（R. multiflora）在美国中西部和加拿大东部大量生

长，形成茂密的灌木丛，通常被认为是一种麻烦的杂草。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms June through August

周期和开花季节：一种多年生植物，六月至八月开花

Parts Used: Hips, flower petals, leaves, stems, and bark

使用部位：臀部、花瓣、叶子、茎和树皮

Primary Medicinal Activities: Nutritive, astringent, bacteriostatic

主要药用活性：营养、收敛、抑菌

Strongest Affinities: Digestive system, urinary tract, skin

=== PAGE 290 ===
最强亲和力：消化系统、泌尿道、皮肤

Preparation: Fresh or dried hips, petals, leaves, and bark; tincture, tea, or decoction

准备：新鲜或干燥的臀部、花瓣、叶子和树皮；酊剂、茶或汤剂

Common Uses: When we think of roses as medicine, we tend to remember reading “Vitamin C with Rose Hips” on

product labels. But actually, the nutritive value of rose hips represents only a small fraction of the healing attributes

this plant has to offer.

常见用途：当我们将玫瑰视为药物时，我们往往会记得在产品标签上读过“玫瑰果维生素 C”。但实际上，

玫瑰果的营养价值仅代表这种植物所提供的治疗功效的一小部分。

Native Americans used all parts of Rosa spp. in a wide variety of applications. The seeds were cooked and

ingested for relief from muscular pains. The roots were used as a general purpose astringent for diarrhea, sore throat,

conjunctivitis, and to stop bleeding. The flower petals were employed as a bacteriostatic protective bandage on

burns and minor wounds and as a treatment for colic and heartburn. A poultice of the leaves was used for insect

stings and bites. All of these uses can be safely applied to animals.

美洲原住民使用蔷薇属植物的所有部分。在各种各样的应用中。将种子煮熟并摄入以缓解肌肉疼痛。根

部被用作通用收敛剂，用于治疗腹泻、喉咙痛、结膜炎和止血。花瓣被用作烧伤和小伤口的抑菌保护绷

带，以及治疗绞痛和胃灼热。叶子的膏剂用于治疗昆虫叮咬和叮咬。所有这些用途都可以安全地应用于动

物。

Each part of a rose plant represents a different level of astringency. The flower petals are mildly to moderately

astringent and can be made into a sweet-smelling rinse for animals with dry, itchy skin. Petal tea is also useful for

mild to moderate cases of colic and diarrhea or for minor irritations of the mouth and stomach. Making a tea is

simple—infuse a handful of fresh petals in a cup of near-boiling water. After the tea has cooled, it can be fed to dogs

and cats at a dose of 1 tablespoon per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, as needed. If necessary it can be added

to your companion’s drinking water. The cooled and strained tea is also useful as an anti-inflammatory eyewash,

especially in cases where redness and eye rubbing is attributable to dust or other environmental irritants.

玫瑰植物的每个部分代表不同程度的涩味。花瓣有轻微至中度的涩味，可制成气味香甜的漱口水，供皮

肤干燥发痒的动物使用。花瓣茶还可用于治疗轻度至中度绞痛和腹泻，或缓解口腔和胃部的轻微刺激。泡

茶很简单——将一把新鲜的花瓣浸入一杯近沸水中。茶冷却后，可以根据需要以每 20 磅动物体重 1 汤匙的

剂量喂给狗和猫。如有必要，可以将其添加到您同伴的饮用水中。冷却并过滤的茶也可用作抗炎洗眼剂，

特别是在眼睛发红和揉眼睛是由于灰尘或其他环境刺激物引起的情况下。

=== PAGE 291 ===
Rosa woodsii

木蔷薇

The leaves are stronger than the flower petals and can be decocted for use as a rinse for contact dermatitis or

inflamed fleabites or fly bites. Internally, the leaf decoction is useful for cystitis and acute digestive tract

inflammations that may be secondary to bacterial or parasitic infection. A typical dose is a 1/2 teaspoon for each 30

pounds of the animal’s weight, once or twice daily, for no longer than four days. The bark and stems offer the

strongest astringency and may be useful for acute cases of urinary or digestive tract inflammation that involve

labored or painful urination, gushing diarrhea, or minor bleeding. Care must be taken to avoid feeding sharp rose

thorns to your companion. The dose is the same as for a leaf decoction, but the maximum duration of use is shorter

—the bark and stem decoction should not be used internally for more than two days.

叶子比花瓣更坚固，可以煎汤作为冲洗剂，用于治疗接触性皮炎或发炎的跳蚤或苍蝇叮咬。在内部，叶

煎剂可用于治疗膀胱炎和可能继发于细菌或寄生虫感染的急性消化道炎症。典型的剂量是每 30 磅动物体重

1/2 茶匙，每天一次或两次，持续不超过四天。树皮和茎具有最强的收敛性，可用于治疗急性泌尿道或消化

道炎症，包括排尿困难或疼痛、腹泻或轻微出血。必须小心避免将锋利的玫瑰刺喂给你的同伴。剂量与叶

煎剂相同，但最长使用时间较短，树皮和茎煎剂内服不应超过两天。

Rose hips are high in vitamin C and serve as a tasty and nutritious treat for animals. Our dogs harvest and eat

them as trail snacks! The whole hip can be fed either fresh or dried. Dried hips can be ground in an electric coffee

grinder and added to your companion’s food as a nutritional supplement. Dogs and cats can be fed ½–1 teaspoon of

the ground hips per cup of food. Horses and other large herbivores can be fed a handful or two each day. Because of

the ascorbic acid content, too much rose hip causes stomach upset or diarrhea. If this happens, cut back on the

amount in the daily feedings.

玫瑰果富含维生素 C，是动物的美味营养食品。我们的狗收获它们并将其作为越野零食食用！整个臀部

可以新鲜或干燥喂养。干臀部可以在电动咖啡研磨机中研磨，然后添加到同伴的食物中作为营养补充剂。

每杯食物可以给狗和猫喂 ½–1 茶匙碎臀肉。马和其他大型食草动物每天可以喂一两把。由于玫瑰果含有抗

坏血酸，过多会导致胃部不适或腹泻。如果发生这种情况，请减少每日喂食量。

=== PAGE 292 ===
Availability: Hundreds of rose varieties are available through nurseries. The best are the smaller-flowered wild

species that are available through nurseries that specialize in native plants.

供应：苗圃可提供数百种玫瑰品种。最好的是花朵较小的野生物种，可以通过专门种植本土植物的苗圃获

得。

Propagation and Harvest: Roses are easy to grow. They prosper in moist, slightly acidic soil. Leaves and flowers

can be harvested any time as long as they look healthy. The hips are harvested in the fall after they turn bright red

but before they shrivel. The hips can be dried indoors on a clean piece of paper. They keep for several years if stored

in a glass jar and kept away from direct sunlight. Don’t grind the hips until you need them, otherwise you greatly

shorten their shelf life. Harvest the stem bark when you prune your roses each year. Most domesticated varieties

have large thorns that can be snapped off. If this isn’t possible, you can use the small thornless end stems and

peduncles (the stem part just beneath the flowers and hips). The stems can be cut into small segments with pruning

clippers or chopped with a sharp knife. They can then be decocted, just like the bark.

繁殖和收获：玫瑰很容易生长。它们在潮湿、微酸性的土壤中生长茂盛。叶子和花可以随时采收，只要它

们看起来健康即可。秋天，臀部变成鲜红色后、枯萎之前收获。臀部可以在室内用一张干净的纸擦干。如

果存放在玻璃罐中并避免阳光直射，它们可以保存几年。在需要的时候不要磨臀部，否则会大大缩短它们

的保质期。每年修剪玫瑰时收获茎皮。大多数驯化品种都有大刺，可以折断。如果不可能，您可以使用小

的无刺末端茎和花序梗（茎部分位于花朵和臀部下方）。茎可以用修枝剪切成小段或用锋利的刀切碎。然

后可以像树皮一样将它们煎煮。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Raspberry leaf, nettle, and chamomile serve as alternatives where a mild urinary or

digestive astringent is indicated. For acute cystitis or colic, rose leaf or bark combines with marshmallow, licorice,

or slippery elm. Skin rinse alternatives include calendula, chamomile, uva ursi, and juniper. For conjunctivitis,

raspberry leaf serves as a replacement, and Oregon grape serves as an excellent antimicrobial adjunct.

替代品和辅料：覆盆子叶、荨麻和洋甘菊可作为需要轻度泌尿或消化收敛剂的替代品。对于急性膀胱炎或

绞痛，玫瑰叶或树皮与棉花糖、甘草或滑榆混合。皮肤冲洗替代品包括金盏花、洋甘菊、熊果和杜松。对

于结膜炎，覆盆子叶可以作为替代品，俄勒冈葡萄可以作为极好的抗菌辅助剂。

Cautions and Comments: The high tannin content in the bark can irritate the urinary tract and kidneys and can

trigger uterine contractions, therefore rose bark is best avoided in pregnant animals or those with preexisting kidney

problems. Internal use should be limited to acute disorders and short-term therapies (two days or less). Call your

veterinarian immediately if internal bleeding is evident, diarrhea is persistent, or urination is labored.

注意和评论：树皮中的高单宁含量会刺激尿道和肾脏，并可能引发子宫收缩，因此怀孕动物或患有肾脏问

题的动物最好避免使用玫瑰树皮。内部使用应仅限于急性疾病和短期治疗（两天或更短时间）。如果出现

明显内出血、持续腹泻或排尿困难，请立即联系您的兽医。
