ROSEMARY

迷迭香

Rosmarinus officinalis

迷迭香

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: A creeping or erect shrub that can grow to 6 feet tall, rosemary is characterized by its piney fragrance;

narrow, leathery, and densely arranged opposite leaves; and white, pink, or blue 3/8-inch-long flowers.

外观：迷迭香是一种匍匐或直立的灌木，可长到 6 英尺高，其特点是松香；狭长、革质、密集排列的对生

叶；以及白色、粉色或蓝色 3/8 英寸长的花朵。

Habitat and Range: Rosemary is a native of the Mediterranean region, but several cultivars of rosemary are grown

worldwide.

栖息地和范围：迷迭香原产于地中海地区，但世界各地都有种植迷迭香的几个品种。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms anytime from early spring to late summer, depending on climate

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，从早春到夏末随时开花，具体取决于气候

Parts Used: Leaves, stems, and flowers

使用部位：叶、茎、花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Tonic, antidepressant, stimulant, analgesic, expels intestinal gas, antispasmodic,

promotes menstrual discharge, astringent, antioxidant, antimicrobial, insect repellent

主要药用活性： 滋补剂、抗抑郁剂、兴奋剂、镇痛剂、排出肠气、解痉、促进月经排出、收敛剂、抗氧化

剂、抗菌剂、驱虫剂

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system, digestive tract, circulatory system, respiratory tract, and skin

亲和力最强：神经系统、消化道、循环系统、呼吸道和皮肤

Preparation: Tea, tincture

准备：茶、酊剂

Common Uses: Rosemary is an extremely useful herb. At the top of its list of medicinal attributes are nervine,

antidepressant, antispasmodic, and carminative properties that combine to make rosemary an excellent remedy for

flatulent dyspepsia and other digestive problems that are secondary to general nervousness, excitability, or

irritability. Adding to rosemary’s utility as a calming agent are borneol and an assortment of volatile oils that are

known to have antispasmodic effects upon the heart and other smooth muscles of the body. These activities not only

help moderate cardiac arrhythmia but also serve to strengthen heart function, making rosemary especially beneficial

=== PAGE 294 ===
in situations where an animal is recovering from a fearful or traumatic experience, or even shock. The rosmarinic

acid contained in the plant is believed to have painkilling properties. In any of the aforementioned instances, about

⅛ teaspoon (0.5 milliliter) of tincture can be given orally as a starting dose for each 20 pounds of an animal’s body

weight, up to three times daily. Horses and other large herbivores can be fed a handful of the fresh stems and leaves

daily.

常见用途：迷迭香是一种非常有用的草药。迷迭香的首要药用特性是镇静、抗抑郁、解痉和驱风，这些特

性结合在一起，使迷迭香成为治疗胀气性消化不良和其他继发于一般紧张、兴奋或烦躁的消化问题的绝佳

药物。除了迷迭香作为镇静剂的功效外，冰片和各种挥发油也被认为对心脏和身体其他平滑肌具有解痉作

用。这些活动不仅有助于缓解心律失常，还可以增强心脏功能，使迷迭香在动物从恐惧或创伤经历甚至休

克中恢复的情况下特别有益。该植物中含有的迷迭香酸被认为具有止痛特性。在任何上述情况下，每 20 磅

动物体重可口服约 1/8 茶匙（0.5 毫升）酊剂作为起始剂量，每天最多 3 次。马和其他大型食草动物每天可

以喂一把新鲜的茎和叶。

Rosmarinus officinalis

迷迭香

In addition to its uses as a calming agent, rosemary can be employed as a general cardiovascular tonic, where it

not only serves to moderate and improve heart function but also helps to strengthen capillary structures. And when

added to your companion’s food, rosemary helps mask the flavor of less-palatable herbs and serves as a natural

barrier against food-borne bacteria. The ursolic acid and carnisol constituents of rosemary have antioxidant and

antimicrobial properties that are effective against Pseudomonas fluorescens , Rhodoturula glutinius, and other

pathogens that contribute to food spoilage. In fact, rosemary’s effectiveness is comparable to that of the more

harmful chemical preservatives BHA or BHT. To use rosemary as a preservative, add ¼ teaspoon of powdered herb

to each pound of a dog’s or cat’s homemade diet.

除了用作镇静剂外，迷迭香还可用作一般心血管补品，不仅可以调节和改善心脏功能，还有助于增强毛

细血管结构。当添加到同伴的食物中时，迷迭香有助于掩盖不太美味的草药的味道，并作为抵抗食源性细

菌的天然屏障。迷迭香中的熊果酸和肉尼醇成分具有抗氧化和抗菌特性，可有效对抗荧光假单胞菌、粘红

=== PAGE 295 ===
酵母和其他导致食物腐败的病原体。事实上，迷迭香的功效与危害更大的化学防腐剂 BHA 或 BHT 相当。

要使用迷迭香作为防腐剂，请在每磅狗或猫的自制饮食中添加 1/4 茶匙迷迭香粉。

Rosemary also has excellent antimicrobial properties inside or on your companion’s body. Scientific studies have

shown that it is active against various types of fungi, as well as numerous gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria,

including Staphylococcus albus, Staphylococcus aureus, E. coli, Vibrio cholerae, and corynebacteria.6 This makes

rosemary useful in antibacterial skin and eye rinses; for minor cuts and burns; and for fighting infections of the

mouth, throat, and urinary and digestive tracts.

迷迭香在您伴侣的身体内部或表面还具有出色的抗菌特性。科学研究表明，它对多种类型的真菌以及许

多革兰氏阳性和革兰氏阴性细菌具有活性，包括白色葡萄球菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌、霍乱弧菌和

棒状杆菌。 6 这使得迷迭香在以下方面非常有用：抗菌皮肤和眼睛冲洗液；用于轻微割伤和烧伤；以及对

抗口腔、喉咙、泌尿道和消化道的感染。

Ten drops of rosemary essential oil can be diluted with 1 ounce of apricot kernel or almond oil for topical use in

the treatment of sprains, arthritic joints, sciatica, and neuralgia. Rubbed into the skin at the site of discomfort, the oil

stimulates capillary circulation and helps to relieve muscular and nerve pain. Do not use undiluted rosemary oil

internally or externally, though, because it is strong and can cause immediate irritation. The oil is contraindicated for

animals who have any type of seizure disorder.

10 滴迷迭香精油可与 1 盎司杏仁油或杏仁油稀释，局部用于治疗扭伤、关节炎、坐骨神经痛和神经痛。

将精油涂抹在不适部位的皮肤上，可刺激毛细血管循环，有助于缓解肌肉和神经疼痛。不过，请勿在内部

或外部使用未稀释的迷迭香油，因为它的强度很强，会立即引起刺激。该油禁止用于患有任何类型癫痫症

的动物。

Availability: Rosemary plants are available through nurseries. The dried or fresh herb is available at grocery and

health food stores.

可获得性：迷迭香植物可通过苗圃获得。干或新鲜的药草可在杂货店和健康食品店购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Rosemary is easy to grow from transplants and can be kept as a houseplant in areas

where winters are severe. It’s not particular about soil and does best in full sun. In the southern and West Coast

portions of the U.S., rosemary is often seen as a hedge-forming landscape shrub, which, unfortunately, is unheard of

in colder climates.

繁殖和收获：迷迭香很容易通过移植生长，并且可以在冬季严寒的地区作为室内植物保存。它对土壤的要

求不高，在阳光充足的情况下生长效果最好。在美国南部和西海岸地区，迷迭香通常被视为一种形成树篱

的景观灌木，不幸的是，在寒冷的气候中这是闻所未闻的。

Rosemary can be started from seed, but germination percentages are poor and the seedlings grow slowly.

Rosemary can be harvested anytime, but the leaves’ medicinal qualities are strongest in late summer.

迷迭香可以从种子开始种植，但发芽率较差，幼苗生长缓慢。迷迭香可以随时采收，但叶子的药用价值

在夏末时最强。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For depressive disorders or nervousness, rosemary can be combined with skullcap or

oatstraw. If such a problem is causing digestive disorders, such as vomiting, flatulence, and colic, look toward

fennel, dill, flaxseed, parsley, or chamomile as an adjunct. For use as an antimicrobial, rosemary is strengthened by

Oregon grape. For topical first aid, rosemary oil combines with arnica, Saint-John’s-wort, cayenne, aloe, calendula,

or willow bark. For itchy skin and fleas, rosemary and calendula combine as a soothing, healing flea-repellent rinse.

替代品和辅助品：对于抑郁症或紧张症，迷迭香可以与黄芩或燕麦草结合使用。如果此类问题导致消化系

统疾病，例如呕吐、肠胃胀气和绞痛，可以将茴香、莳萝、亚麻籽、欧芹或洋甘菊作为辅助品。作为抗菌

剂，迷迭香通过俄勒冈葡萄得到增强。对于局部急救，迷迭香油可与山金车、圣约翰草、辣椒、芦荟、金

盏花或柳树皮混合使用。对于瘙痒的皮肤和跳蚤，迷迭香和金盏花结合起来可作为舒缓、愈合、驱跳蚤的

冲洗液。

=== PAGE 296 ===
Cautions and Comments: In horses, the volatile oils of rosemary may be detectable in a blood sample; is

possible that it may be considered a “prohibited substance” under Jocky Club or other horse show rules. Otherwise,

rosemary is a very safe herb.

注意事项和评论：对于马，血液样本中可能会检测到迷迭香的挥发油；根据赛马俱乐部或其他马术表演

规则，它可能被视为“违禁物质”。否则，迷迭香是一种非常安全的草药。

=== PAGE 297 ===
SAGE

智者

Salvia officinalis

丹参

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: Over eight hundred species of Salvia exist worldwide, and most are medicinally useful. Most

gardeners and Epicureans are familiar with S. officinalis, common garden sage. Many of the wild species share the

same unique “pebbled” leaf texture and have a similar but much stronger flavor and aroma. Flowers of the Salvia

genus range from white to deep purple. It’s important to know that many wild plants with a sagelike fragrance, or

even a common name that contains the word sage are unrelated to the sage we use in the kitchen. One example is

sagebrush (Artemisia tridentata), a member of the sunflower family that smells like sage but can be harmful if used

internally. Given the availability and effectiveness of culinary sage, there’s little reason to harvest wild sage for your

companion. If, however, you do opt to use a wild sage, learn its Latin name first. If the plant you are considering

isn’t a Salvia, then it’s a different medicine as well.

外观：全世界有超过八百种丹参，其中大多数具有药用价值。大多数园丁和伊壁鸠鲁主义者都熟悉药用鼠

尾草，一种常见的花园鼠尾草。许多野生物种都具有相同的独特“卵石”叶子纹理，并且具有相似但更强烈

的风味和香气。鼠尾草属的花朵从白色到深紫色。重要的是要知道，许多具有鼠尾草香味的野生植物，甚

至是包含鼠尾草一词的常见名称，都与我们在厨房中使用的鼠尾草无关。一个例子是山艾树（Artemisia

tridentata），它是向日葵科的一种，闻起来像鼠尾草，但如果内服可能有害。鉴于烹饪鼠尾草的可用性和有

效性，没有理由为您的伴侣收获野生鼠尾草。但是，如果您确实选择使用野生鼠尾草，请先了解它的拉丁

名称。如果您正在考虑的植物不是丹参，那么它也是一种不同的药物。

Habitat and Range: Common sage is a native of the Mediterranean region. Dozens of cultivars have been

developed and are farmed throughout the world.

栖息地和范围：普通鼠尾草原产于地中海地区。已开发出数十个品种并在世界各地种植。

In the coastal canyons of southern California, native species such as white sage (S. apiana), black sage (S.

mellifera), Munz’s sage (S. munzii), and purple sage (S. leucophylla) often stand as the predominant flora, growing

in dense stands of 2- to 6-foot-high shrubs that may cover the landscape for miles. As one travels north or east, the

distribution of Salvia species becomes more scattered and less varied, and the plants tend to be small and less

predominant. In the deserts of eastern Washington and Oregon, grayball sage (S. dorrii) brings the dry, brushy

landscape alive with vibrant hues of purple.

在南加州的沿海峡谷中，白鼠尾草 (S. apiana)、黑鼠尾草 (S. mellifera)、芒兹鼠尾草 (S. munzii) 和紫色鼠

尾草 (S. leucophylla) 等本地物种通常是主要植物群，生长在 2 至 6 英尺高的茂密灌木丛中，这些灌木丛可

能覆盖数英里的景观。当人们向北或向东旅行时，鼠尾草物种的分布变得更加分散且种类较少，而且植物

往往较小且不那么占优势。在华盛顿州东部和俄勒冈州的沙漠中，灰球鼠尾草 (S. dorrii) 为干燥、灌木丛生

的景观带来了生机勃勃的紫色色调。

=== PAGE 298 ===
Salvia leucophylla

白叶鼠尾草

Cycle and Bloom Season: Perennials that bloom in early to late spring

周期和开花季节：在早春至晚春开花的多年生植物

Parts Used: Leaves, small stems, and flowers

使用部分：叶、小茎和花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antiseptic, astringent, antispasmodic, expels intestinal gas, inhibits sweating (is an

antihydrotic)

主要药用活性：抗菌、收敛、解痉、排出肠道气体、抑制出汗（是一种抗水药）

Strongest Affinities: Mouth, digestive tract, skin

最强的亲和力：口腔、消化道、皮肤

Preparation: Tea or tincture

准备：茶或酊剂

Common Uses: Sage is an excellent remedy for infections or ulcerations of the mouth, skin, or digestive tract. Most

of its antimicrobial activity is attributable to its content of thujone, a volatile oil that is effective against E. coli,

Shigella sonnei, Salmonella spp., Klebsiella ozanae, Bacillus subtillis, and various fungi—namely Candida

albicans, Candida krusei, Candida pseudotropicalis, Torulopsis glabrata , and Cryptococcus neoformans. A strong

=== PAGE 299 ===
sage tea or tincture is useful for treating and preventing gingivitis as well as infection that is secondary to injury or

dental surgery. For bacterial or fungal infections of the throat and digestive tract, sage serves as a safe and effective

antibiotic and helps to expel gas and ease gastric cramping. Horses and other large herbivores can be fed a handful

or two of the fresh leaves or a cup of dried leaves in their daily food ration as a treatment for colic and flatulence that

is secondary to bacterial or fungal infection. For smaller animals, the tea can be added to drinking water, or a

tincture can be administered directly by mouth. If you choose to make tea, steep 1 tablespoon of the dried leaves in a

cup of near-boiling water. Stir the mixture frequently until it has cooled to lukewarm. Strain out the plant material

but don’t discard it if you’re treating a localized infection or ulcer. It can be used as a poultice by directly applying it

to an affected area. The tea can be sweetened with honey (which has its own healing properties) and fed at a rate of 1

fluid ounce per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, two or three times daily. If you choose to use a tincture, a

good starting dose is 0.5–1.0 milliliter per 30 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily.

常见用途：鼠尾草是治疗口腔、皮肤或消化道感染或溃疡的极好药物。其大部分抗菌活性归因于其侧柏酮

含量，侧柏酮是一种挥发油，可有效对抗大肠杆菌、宋内氏志贺氏菌、沙门氏菌、克雷伯氏菌、枯草芽孢

杆菌和各种真菌（即白色念珠菌、克柔念珠菌、拟热带念珠菌） 、光滑球拟酵母和新型隐球菌。浓鼠尾草

茶或酊剂可用于治疗和预防牙龈炎以及损伤或牙科手术继发的感染。对于喉咙和消化道的细菌或真菌感

染，鼠尾草是一种安全有效的抗生素，有助于排出气体并缓解胃痉挛。马和其他大型食草动物可以在日常

食物配给中喂食一把或两片新鲜叶子或一杯干叶子，以治疗继发于细菌或真菌感染的绞痛和胀气。对于较

小的动物，可以将茶添加到饮用水中，或者可以直接口服酊剂。如果您选择泡茶，请将一汤匙干茶叶浸泡

在一杯接近沸水中。经常搅拌混合物直至其冷却至微温。滤出植物材料，但如果您正在治疗局部感染或溃

疡，请不要丢弃它。它可以作为膏剂直接涂抹在患处。茶可以用蜂蜜（蜂蜜有其自身的治疗功效）加甜，

并以每 20 磅动物体重 1 液体盎司的比例喂食，每天 2 到 3 次。如果您选择使用酊剂，较好的起始剂量是每

30 磅动物体重 0.5–1.0 毫升，每天两次。

In the form of a rinse, poultice, or fomentation, sage tea is useful for treating bacterial or fungal infections of the

skin, including ringworm. In such instances, thoroughly soak your companion with the cooled tea once or twice

daily. The tea is also a safe and natural disinfectant for turtle or lizard enclosures and may be combined with liquid

soap for use as a hand wash after handling animals who may carry salmonella.

鼠尾草茶以冲洗剂、膏剂或热敷的形式可用于治疗皮肤的细菌或真菌感染，包括癣。在这种情况下，每

天用冷茶彻底浸泡你的伴侣一到两次。该茶也是一种安全、天然的乌龟或蜥蜴饲养场消毒剂，在处理可能

携带沙门氏菌的动物后，可以与液体肥皂混合用作洗手液。

Availability: Fresh or dried sage is available at food stores. The plants are available at most nurseries.

可获得性：新鲜或干燥的鼠尾草可在食品店购买。大多数苗圃都有这些植物。

Propagation and Harvest: Sage is an easy-to-grow “must have” for the home herb gardener. It likes heavy, slightly

acid soil and full sun. It is drought resistant and winter hardy, but in regions where temperatures reach below–10° F,

a thick fall mulch is required. Collect the leaves and small stems during midday, when the volatile oils are most

concentrated in the leaves, and preferably when the plants are just beginning to bloom. The best way to dry sage is

to tie the leaves into small bundles and hang them indoors. When the leaves are crunchy dry, they are ready to store

in an airtight glass jar away from sunlight. Properly stored, the herb keeps for two or three years—as long as it

smells strong, it’s still good medicine.

繁殖和收获：鼠尾草是家庭药草园丁易于种植的“必备品”。它喜欢粘重、微酸性的土壤和充足的阳光。它

抗旱、耐寒，但在气温低于华氏 10 度的地区，需要厚厚的秋季覆盖物。在中午收集叶子和小茎，此时挥发

油在叶子中最集中，最好是在植物刚刚开始开花时。干燥鼠尾草的最佳方法是将叶子扎成小捆，然后挂在

室内。当叶子变脆干燥时，就可以将它们存放在密封的玻璃罐中，避免阳光照射。如果储存得当，这种药

草可以保存两三年——只要气味浓烈，它仍然是良药。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For mouth infections, thyme, rosemary, and bee balm are also effective, and consider

Oregon grape and myrrh as strong adjuncts or alternatives. For digestive problems, sage combines with Oregon

grape, licorice, fennel, parsley, dill, or marshmallow. For infections of the skin, calendula, aloe, chaparral,

chamomile, rosemary, and uva ursi all deserve some study.

=== PAGE 300 ===
替代品和辅助剂：对于口腔感染，百里香、迷迭香和蜂香膏也有效，并考虑俄勒冈葡萄和没药作为强效辅

助剂或替代品。对于消化问题，鼠尾草与俄勒冈葡萄、甘草、茴香、欧芹、莳萝或棉花糖混合。对于皮肤

感染，金盏花、芦荟、灌木丛、洋甘菊、迷迭香和熊果都值得研究。

Cautions and Comments: The undiluted essential oil of sage can cause skin irritation and should not be given

internally. Sage is said to inhibit lactation.

注意事项和评论：未稀释的鼠尾草精油会引起皮肤刺激，不应内服。据说鼠尾草可以抑制泌乳。

=== PAGE 301 ===
SAINT-JOHN’S-WORT

圣约翰草

Hypericum perforatum

贯叶金丝桃

Saint-John’s-Wort Family

圣约翰草家族

Appearance: Saint-John’s-wort is a sturdy perennial weed distinguished by its yellow five-petaled flowers and its

small (up to ¾ inch long) narrowly lance-shaped to elliptical leaves. The flowers and leaves are covered with tiny

purplish black dots, each containing hypericin, a medicinally active compound that is often visible as a red stain on

the skin after rubbing the foliage between one’s fingertips. Saint-John’s-wort varies in size among species, but all of

them are similar in appearance. The largest and most widespread species, Hypericum perforatum , may reach 32

inches in height, whereas H. anagalloides (bog Saint-John’s-wort), one of the smallest species, grows in mats

seldom exceeding 4 inches in height.

外观：圣约翰草是一种坚固的多年生杂草，其特征在于其黄色五瓣花和小（长达 3/4 英寸长）狭长矛形至椭

圆形的叶子。花朵和叶子上覆盖着微小的紫黑色点，每个点都含有金丝桃素，这是一种具有药用活性的化

合物，用指尖摩擦叶子后，通常可以在皮肤上看到红色斑点。圣约翰草的大小因品种而异，但外观相似。

最大、分布最广的物种贯叶金丝桃 (Hypericum perforatum) 高度可达 32 英寸，而 H. anagalloides (bog Saint-

John’s-wort) 是最小的物种之一，生长在高度很少超过 4 英寸的垫子中。

Habitat and Range: Habitat varies according to species, but generally the larger species prefer dry to moist open

hillsides up to about 6,000 feet in elevation, whereas higher elevations and wetter habitats tend to yield the smaller

species. In the Pacific Northwest, H. perforatum and H. formosum are common and often profuse on open range

lands at foothill elevations, where they are considered noxious weeds because of their alleged toxicity to livestock.

Saint-John’s-wort is a European import that now ranges throughout the Pacific and Rocky Mountain states and in

isolated stands through the central and eastern portions of North America.

栖息地和范围：栖息地因物种而异，但一般较大的物种更喜欢海拔约 6,000 英尺的干燥或潮湿的开阔山坡，

而较高的海拔和潮湿的栖息地往往会产生较小的物种。在太平洋西北地区，贯叶连翘和台湾连翘很常见，

并且经常大量生长在山麓海拔的开阔土地上，由于据称它们对牲畜有毒，因此被认为是有毒杂草。圣约翰

草是从欧洲进口的，现在遍布太平洋和落基山脉各州，并在北美中部和东部地区有孤立的分布。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that is sometimes referred to as Fourth of July flower, Saint-John’s-wort

usually blooms from early July through August.

周期和开花季节：圣约翰草是一种多年生植物，有时被称为国庆节花，通常从七月初到八月开花。

=== PAGE 302 ===
Hypericum perforatum

贯叶金丝桃

Parts Used: The top 12 inches of the flowering plant

使用部位：开花植物顶部 12 英寸

Primary Medicinal Activities: Wound healing, moderates nerve transmissions (nervine), antiseptic, antiviral,

antidepressive, immunostimulant.

主要药用活性：伤口愈合、调节神经传递（神经）、防腐剂、抗病毒、抗抑郁、免疫刺激。

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system, skin

最强的亲和力：神经系统、皮肤

Preparation: Tea, tincture, or topical preparation of the fresh herb

制剂：茶、酊剂或新鲜草药的外用制剂

Common Uses: It’s amazing how our opinions can change by simply looking closer at what we take for granted.

Saint-John’s-wort has long been regarded as an invasive weed in the western portions of the U.S. Until recently,

people wanted to eradicate this plant from the range lands on which it so successfully flourishes, competes with

native plants, and threatens grazing livestock with possible toxic side effects. But now, in light of extensive

scientific research, Saint-John’s-wort has been promoted from the status of a universally hated weed to that of a

valued medicine that offers a wealth of curative power. Our awareness of Saint-John’s-wort’s benefits comes in the

midst of an enormous health care crisis and forces us to reevaluate our shortsighted approaches to plants we

ignorantly view as our enemies. As well as giving us a valuable opportunity to reconsider the true values in our

=== PAGE 303 ===
surroundings, Saint-John’s-wort offers new hope in the treatment of AIDS, chronic depression, nervous system

disorders, and various forms of herpes virus. A plant is seen as a weed only when we cannot recognize its useful

purpose. Because of the lesson we’ve learned from Saint-John’s-wort, we are forced to wonder about the usefulness

of all plants and to consider the price we may be paying when we choose to eradicate certain plants in favor of

agricultural economics.

常见用途：令人惊奇的是，只要仔细观察我们认为理所当然的事情，我们的观点就能改变。圣约翰草长期

以来一直被认为是美国西部地区的一种入侵杂草。直到最近，人们还想将这种植物从牧场上根除，这种植

物在其上成功繁盛，与本地植物竞争，并威胁到放牧牲畜。可能的毒副作用。但现在，根据广泛的科学研

究，圣约翰草已经从一种普遍讨厌的杂草提升为一种具有丰富疗效的有价值的药物。我们对圣约翰草益处

的认识是在一场巨大的医疗保健危机中产生的，这迫使我们重新评估我们对植物的短视做法，我们无知地

将其视为我们的敌人。圣约翰草不仅为我们提供了重新考虑周围环境的真正价值观的宝贵机会，还为治疗

艾滋病、慢性抑郁症、神经系统疾病和各种形式的疱疹病毒提供了新的希望。只有当我们无法认识植物的

有用用途时，才会将其视为杂草。由于我们从圣约翰草中学到的教训，我们被迫思考所有植物的有用性，

并考虑当我们选择根除某些植物以支持农业经济时我们可能付出的代价。

Saint-John’s-wort has received a great deal of media attention for its demonstrated ability to act as an

antidepressant in both humans and animals. Literally hundreds of recent scientific studies have confirmed that it may

act as a safe, effective, and natural alternative to antidepressant drugs. In Germany and other European countries,

where the most research is being conducted on Saint-John’s-wort and its derivatives, the plant has been deemed safe

and effective by the government, and millions of people are using the plant daily to treat chronic depression without

ill side effects. In fact, one pharmaceutical brand of Saint-John’s-wort is being prescribed in Germany at a rate of

seven to one over the popular antidepressant drug Prozac. And in the U.S., an increasing number of holistic

veterinarians are using the herb to treat separation anxiety and aggression disorders in dogs and cats. Contrary to

popular belief, however, Saint-John’s-wort does not offer a neatly packaged holistic solution to depressive disorders,

especially not for animals.

圣约翰草因其在人类和动物中表现出的抗抑郁作用而受到了媒体的广泛关注。最近数百项科学研究已经

证实，它可以作为抗抑郁药物的安全、有效和天然的替代品。在德国和其他欧洲国家，大多数研究都是针

对圣约翰草及其衍生物进行的，政府认为这种植物是安全有效的，数百万人每天都在使用这种植物来治疗

慢性抑郁症，而无需担心。不良的副作用。事实上，在德国，圣约翰草的一种制药品牌的处方比例是流行

的抗抑郁药物百忧解的七比一。在美国，越来越多的整体兽医正在使用这种草药来治疗狗和猫的分离焦虑

和攻击性障碍。然而，与普遍看法相反，圣约翰草并没有为抑郁症提供整齐包装的整体解决方案，尤其是

对动物而言。

The antidepressive qualities of Saint-John’s-wort represent only a small portion of what this plant has to offer.

Saint-John’s-wort also has antiviral, vulnerary (wound and burn healing), nerve tonic, and antibacterial activities

that are unparalleled by any other herb. And while a great deal of research and marketing has been focused on the

hypericin constituents (a red pigment contained within tiny glands that dot the flower petals and leaves of the plant)

of Saint-John’s-wort, this herb contains dozens of other chemical compounds that have been shown to possess a

tremendous range of healing actions. These compounds include various essential oils, flavonoids, tannins, and

phytosterol constituents—all of which combine to make Saint-John’s-wort active against a wide variety of bacteria,

fungi, and even viruses.

圣约翰草的抗抑郁功效仅代表该植物所提供的一小部分。圣约翰草还具有任何其他草药无法比拟的抗病

毒、治疗创伤（伤口和烧伤）、神经滋补和抗菌活性。虽然大量的研究和营销都集中在圣约翰草的金丝桃

素成分（植物花瓣和叶子上的微小腺体中含有的一种红色素）上，但这种草药还含有数十种其他化学物质

已被证明具有广泛的治疗作用。这些化合物包括各种精油、类黄酮、单宁和植物甾醇成分，所有这些成分

结合在一起，使圣约翰草能够有效对抗多种细菌、真菌，甚至病毒。

For the treatment of burns and wounds, Saint-John’s-wort helps speed the healing process while reducing pain at

the site of injury. As an antibiotic, preparations of Saint-John’s-wort extract have been shown to be as effective as

many of their pharmaceutical counterparts, including sulfonamides, a group of general-use antibiotics commonly

prescribed for treatment of bacterial infections in dogs, cats, horses, and a wide variety of other animals. Saint-

John’s-wort is especially useful in instances where soft tissues, joints, or nerve endings have been crushed, crimped,

or bruised, a condition that may occur when a cattle dog is stomped or kicked or when a cat expends another of her

nine lives in a run-in with an automobile. For first aid purposes, Saint-John’s-wort can be applied directly to the site

of injury in the form of a salve, a tincture, or an oil infusion, or the tincture can be administered internally. We

=== PAGE 304 ===
would probably opt to do both in the described circumstances as the topical application helps to prevent infection

and speed healing, while the phytosterol and flavonoid constituents of the internal dose help with nerve pain and

repair. Giving 12 drops of the tincture per 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, administered twice daily, is a

good starting point in terms of internal dosage.

对于烧伤和伤口的治疗，圣约翰草有助于加速愈合过程，同时减轻受伤部位的疼痛。作为一种抗生素，

圣约翰草提取物制剂已被证明与许多同类药物一样有效，包括磺胺类药物，这是一组通用抗生素，通常用

于治疗狗、猫、马、以及各种各样的其他动物。圣约翰草在软组织、关节或神经末梢被压碎、卷曲或瘀伤

的情况下特别有用，这种情况可能发生在牧牛犬被踩踏或踢打，或者猫消耗了另外九分之一的时间时。与

汽车发生冲突。出于急救目的，圣约翰草可以以药膏、酊剂或输油剂的形式直接涂抹在受伤部位，也可以

将酊剂内服。在所描述的情况下，我们可能会选择同时使用这两种方法，因为局部应用有助于预防感染和

加速愈合，而内部剂量的植物甾醇和类黄酮成分有助于缓解神经疼痛和修复。就内部剂量而言，每 20 磅动

物体重滴 12 滴酊剂，每天两次，是一个很好的起点。

Saint-John’s-wort offers a great deal of promise in the treatment of various forms of viral and retroviral infections,

including AIDS, FIV, Epstein-Barr virus, influenza, herpes, and viral hepatitis (particularly in ducks and other fowl).

In essence, Saint-John’s-wort inhibits reproduction of these viruses, especially if the herb is administered during the

earliest stages of disease. In AIDS research, the hope is that Saint-John’s-wort will prove to slow the progression of

the HIV virus. So far studies have been promising, but it’s too early to define the depth of Saint-John’s-wort’s role

in this capacity. Regardless, its use in fighting human or feline AIDS is worth a serious try.

圣约翰草在治疗各种形式的病毒和逆转录病毒感染方面具有巨大的前景，包括艾滋病、FIV、EB 病毒、

流感、疱疹和病毒性肝炎（特别是鸭和其他家禽）。从本质上讲，圣约翰草可以抑制这些病毒的繁殖，特

别是在疾病的早期阶段服用该草药。在艾滋病研究中，人们希望圣约翰草能够减缓艾滋病病毒的传播。到

目前为止，研究一直很有希望，但现在定义圣约翰草在这种能力中的作用还为时过早。无论如何，它在对

抗人类或猫艾滋病方面的用途值得认真尝试。

Saint-John’s-wort extract may be effective as a preventive measure in dogs who have been exposed to a

potentially fatal canine herpes viral infection or in cats, horses, or other animals suffering from a herpes virus. The

point to remember is that Saint-John’s-wort will not cure the animal of herpes, but it may help keep the virus in

check. In our experience with people who suffer from herpes, simultaneous internal and external applications of

Saint-John’s-wort extract expedites remission of the virus and often helps to lengthen the comfortable period

between outbreaks.

圣约翰草提取物对于接触过可能致命的犬疱疹病毒感染的狗或患有疱疹病毒的猫、马或其他动物可能是

有效的预防措施。需要记住的一点是，圣约翰草不能治愈动物的疱疹，但它可能有助于控制病毒。根据我

们对疱疹患者的经验，同时内服和外用圣约翰草提取物可以加速病毒的缓解，并且通常有助于延长两次爆

发之间的舒适期。

Availability: Saint-John’s-wort is a widely distributed weed in the western U.S. Seeds are available from specialty

seed catalogs. The dried herb and its various preparations are available through herb retailers.

可用性：圣约翰草是美国西部广泛分布的杂草。种子可从专业种子目录中获得。干药草及其各种制剂可通

过药草零售商购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Saint-John’s-wort is easy to transplant or start from seed, but before you plant it, be

aware that it is listed as a harmful weed in many areas of the country. If you introduce this plant into your herb

garden, be careful that it doesn’t escape cultivation. Harvest when the plants are in full bloom, usually in early to

mid-July. Clip off the flowering tops, and plan on making tincture or an oil infusion as quickly after harvest as

possible—this plant is most effective if made into medicine while it is fresh.

繁殖和收获：圣约翰草很容易移植或从种子开始，但在种植之前，请注意它在该国许多地区被列为有害杂

草。如果您将这种植物引入您的药草园，请小心不要让它逃脱栽培。在植物盛开时收获，通常在七月上旬

至中旬。剪掉开花的顶部，并计划在收获后尽快制作酊剂或油浸剂——这种植物如果在新鲜时入药是最有

效的。

=== PAGE 305 ===
Alternatives and Adjuncts: For anxiety and depressive disorders, lemon balm, skullcap, valerian, and

passionflower serve as adjuncts or alternatives. For injuries, Saint-John’s-wort combines well with comfrey,

calendula, aloe, cayenne, yarrow, or arnica. Licorice, devil’s claw, or yucca root all serve as anti-inflammatory

adjuncts. Consider oatstraw, skullcap, cayenne, and valerian as possible alternatives or adjuncts for nerve-related

problems. As an antiviral or antiseptic, Saint-John’s-wort combines with echinacea, Oregon grape, certified organic

goldenseal, bee balm, thyme, or sage.

替代品和辅助品：对于焦虑症和抑郁症，蜂蜜花、黄芩、缬草和西番莲可作为辅助剂或替代品。对于损

伤，圣约翰草与紫草、金盏花、芦荟、辣椒、西洋蓍草或山金车可以很好地结合。甘草、魔爪草或丝兰根

都可以作为抗炎辅助剂。考虑将燕麦草、黄芩、辣椒和缬草作为治疗神经相关问题的可能替代品或辅助

品。作为一种抗病毒剂或防腐剂，圣约翰草与紫锥菊、俄勒冈葡萄、经过认证的有机金毛茛、蜂香膏、百

里香或鼠尾草相结合。

Cautions and Comments: Recent scientific studies have taught us that this herb may strengthen the effects of

general anesthesia. Therefore, Saint-John’s-wort should not be used within 48 hours preceding surgery. While other

adverse side effects are rare, some animals can develop a photosensitive rash from its use. Specifically, people or

animals with light skin pigments may be susceptible to sunburnlike effects if they consume too much Saint-John’s-

wort and subsequently spend too much time in bright sunlight. This side effect has been observed in livestock who

have foraged on large quantities of the plants and is one of the main reasons Saint-John’s-wort is the subject of

herbicidal intervention in some areas of the West. Common sense should preside here—use extra caution if your

animal has white hair, white or pink skin pigment, or a short coat. If a rash does develop, get the animal out of direct

sunlight and discontinue use of Saint-John’s-wort. Consider finding an alternative therapy—it may be that your

animal is not a proper candidate for Saint-John’s-wort. As always, it is a good idea to consult a holistic veterinarian

before diagnosing your pet’s condition and self-prescribing any course of therapy.

注意事项和评论：最近的科学研究告诉我们，这种草药可能会增强全身麻醉的效果。因此，术前 48 小时内

不应使用圣约翰草。虽然其他不良副作用很少见，但一些动物可能会因使用而出现光敏性皮疹。具体来

说，如果皮肤色素浅的人或动物食用过多的圣约翰草并随后在明亮的阳光下度过过多的时间，可能会容易

受到晒伤的影响。在大量采食圣约翰草的牲畜中观察到了这种副作用，这也是圣约翰草在西方某些地区受

到除草干预的主要原因之一。这里应以常识为主——如果您的动物有白毛、白色或粉红色皮肤色素或短

毛，请格外小心。如果确实出现皮疹，请让动物远离阳光直射，并停止使用圣约翰草。考虑寻找替代疗法

——您的动物可能不适合使用圣约翰草。与往常一样，在诊断您的宠物的病情并自行制定任何治疗方案之

前，最好先咨询整体兽医。

SHEPHERD’S PURSE

荠菜

Capsella bursa-pastoris

荠菜

Mustard Family

芥末家族

Appearance: Shepherd’s purse is a common lawn and vacant lot weed that begins its life as a ground-hugging

rosette of 1- to 2-inch leaves that are hairy underneath and smooth on top. Later, the upper plant develops one or

more slender, erect stems that can grow to about 20 inches tall. The lance-shaped leaves of the upper plant grow

alternately, clasping the stem at their bases.

外观：荠菜是一种常见的草坪和空地杂草，它的生命开始时是1到2英寸叶子的贴地莲座丛，叶子下面有

毛，上面光滑。随后，上部植物长出一根或多根细长、直立的茎，可长至约 20 英寸高。上部植物的矛状叶

子交替生长，基部紧握茎。

Small, white, inconspicuous flowers are presented at the top of the plant. The flowers develop into seed-bearing

capsules that look like tiny (½ inch or smaller), pointed heart-shaped purses—a characteristic that likely earned the

plant its common name. These little purses are two-celled, have a single ridge along one side, and are slightly

concave along the other. Each cell contains tiny seeds.

植物顶部开有白色、不显眼的小花。这些花发育成含有种子的蒴果，看起来像微小（½英寸或更小）的尖

心形钱包——这一特征可能为这种植物赢得了俗名。这些小钱包有两个单元，一侧有一个脊，另一侧稍微

凹入。每个细胞都含有微小的种子。

Many herbalists take the purse characteristics of shepherd’s purse for granted and don’t look closely enough when

identifying the plant before harvesting. Subsequently, many of them end up gathering and using the wrong plant.

Although the impostor is usually another harmless member of the mustard family (Cruciferae), it is often

medicinally useless. The seed capsules of the look-alikes have two cells, but each cell contains only two seeds,

whereas shepherd’s purse always has several seeds.

许多草药师认为荠菜的钱包特征是理所当然的，在收获前识别植物时没有仔细观察。随后，他们中的许

多人最终采集并使用了错误的植物。尽管冒名顶替者通常是芥菜科（十字花科）的另一种无害成员，但它

通常没有药用价值。相似的种子蒴果有两个细胞，但每个细胞只含有两粒种子，而荠菜总是有几粒种子。

Habitat and Range: Shepherd’s purse is a European import that is widely distributed across North America. It is

common in cultivated fields, gardens, lawns, vacant lots, livestock grazing areas, and other disturbed areas. It can be

found in almost any environment, from cracks in city streets to remote mountain campsites. It is adaptable to any

elevation from below sea level to timberline.

栖息地和分布范围：荠菜是欧洲进口的植物，广泛分布于北美各地。它常见于耕地、花园、草坪、空地、

牲畜放牧区和其他受干扰的地区。它几乎可以在任何环境中找到，从城市街道的裂缝到偏远的山区露营

地。它适用于从海平面以下到林线的任何海拔。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual that continuously reseeds itself

周期和开花季节：不断自我重新播种的一年生植物

Parts Used: Entire plant, including roots

=== PAGE 307 ===
使用部分：整个植物，包括根

Primary Medicinal Activities: Diuretic, astringent, stops bleeding, tonic

主要药用活性： 利尿、收敛、止血、滋补

Strongest Affinities: Urinary tract, joints

最强的亲和力：泌尿道、关节

Preparation: Tea, tincture, fresh or dried herb

制剂：茶、酊剂、新鲜或干草药

Common Uses: Shepherd’s purse is especially useful in cases of minor urinary system bleeding. The diuretic

activity of this plant is strong enough to increase urinary volume and thus lower the concentration of acidic strong,

dark urine, while its mild astringency helps to reduce inflammation in the bladder, urethra, and kidneys. Although it

is a relatively weak diuretic, its low volatile oil content makes it a gentle alternative to oil-rich herbs such as parsley

root, which are contraindicated in preexisting cases of kidney disease. Shepherd’s purse is indicated for arthritic

conditions that are believed to be compounded by retention of excess systemic waste materials, where it is believed

to help with the removal of fluid and various acid compounds from the joints.

常见用途：荠菜对于泌尿系统轻微出血特别有用。这种植物的利尿活性足够强，可以增加尿量，从而降低

酸性强、深色尿液的浓度，而其温和的收敛性有助于减少膀胱、尿道和肾脏的炎症。虽然它是一种相对较

弱的利尿剂，但其挥发油含量较低，使其成为欧芹根等富含油的草药的温和替代品，而欧芹根在已有肾脏

疾病的情况下是禁忌的。荠菜适用于治疗关节炎，这种疾病被认为是由于体内多余的废物滞留而加剧的，

据信它有助于清除关节中的液体和各种酸性化合物。

Studies have shown that the hemostatic activity of shepherd’s purse in the uterus and urinary tract is attributable

to more than just simple tissue-shrinking astringency. The plant contains an assortment of amine and flavonoid

constituents that are believed to actually strengthen capillaries and reduce their permeability. This makes shepherd’s

purse an excellent urinary tonic for animals who exhibit occasional blood in the urine as a result of structural

anomalies, scar tissue, or nonspecific atony of the bladder. It has also been found to enhance uterine tone, contract

the uterine walls, and lower blood pressure, making it useful in postpartum bleeding and difficult placenta delivery.

研究表明，荠菜在子宫和泌尿道中的止血活性不仅仅归因于简单的组织收缩收敛作用。该植物含有多种

胺和类黄酮成分，据信这些成分实际上可以增强毛细血管并降低其渗透性。对于因结构异常、疤痕组织或

非特异性膀胱无力而偶尔出现尿血的动物来说，荠菜是一种极好的泌尿补品。它还被发现可以增强子宫张

力、收缩子宫壁并降低血压，从而有助于治疗产后出血和胎盘难产。

Externally, a poultice of the fresh plant can be applied to wounds to stop bleeding. A tincture, poultice, or water

or oil infusion can be applied to the skin, as a weak alternative to mustard, to increase subcutaneous capillary

circulation at the site of closed-tissue injuries and to help improve the strength and structure of capillaries.

在外部，可以将新鲜植物的药膏涂在伤口上以止血。可以将酊剂、膏剂或水或油浸剂涂抹在皮肤上，作

为芥末的弱替代品，以增加闭合组织损伤部位的皮下毛细血管循环，并帮助改善毛细血管的强度和结构。

Availability: A widespread weed; available through specialty seed catalogs

可用性：广泛分布的杂草；可通过专业种子目录获得

Propagation and Harvest: Rather than buy dried shepherd’s purse at an herb store, it’s best to harvest your own

fresh herb. The herb loses much of its medicinal potency when it dries and should be used or made into tincture as

soon as it is harvested. This plant is easy to grow and spreads all over the garden if allowed. It grows in most soils

but grows best in heavily manured soil, which is why it is so common in pastures. Harvest by pulling up the entire

=== PAGE 308 ===
plant after the seed capsules have developed but before the plant dries.

繁殖和收获：最好自己采摘新鲜的药草，而不是在药草店购买干荠菜。这种草药在干燥后会失去大部分药

效，因此应在收获后立即使用或制成酊剂。这种植物很容易生长，如果允许的话可以遍布整个花园。它可

以在大多数土壤中生长，但在施肥较多的土壤中生长最好，这就是为什么它在牧场上如此常见。在种子蒴

果发育后但在植物干燥之前拔起整个植物来收获。

Capsella bursa-pastoris

荠菜

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Shepherd’s purse can be combined with yarrow in fresh herb tea for bleeding fibroids

or as an external first aid remedy (use the two herbs in a poultice). For arthritis, shepherd’s purse combines with

yucca root, boswellia, devil’s claw, licorice, or alfalfa. Dandelion leaf serves as a stronger, yet equally safe, diuretic.

For urinary bleeding that is secondary to infection, combine with marshmallow, echinacea, and Oregon grape.

替代品和辅助品：荠菜可以与西洋蓍草混合在新鲜花草茶中治疗子宫肌瘤出血或作为外用急救药物（将两

种草药制成膏剂）。对于关节炎，荠菜与丝兰根、乳香、魔爪草、甘草或苜蓿结合使用。蒲公英叶是一种

更强效但同样安全的利尿剂。对于继发于感染的尿道出血，可与棉花糖、紫锥菊和俄勒冈葡萄混合使用。

Cautions and Comments: The authors have never witnessed any side effects from the use of this herb, but it has

been theorized by others that Shepherd’s purse can cause contractions of the uterus and should not be administered

to pregnant animals—reserve it for the postpartum period. It is also thought to have hemostatic properties that may

interfere with blood-thinning drugs. Therefore, caution and common sense dictates that this herb is best avoided in

animals with clotting disorders.

注意事项和评论：作者从未见过使用这种草药的任何副作用，但其他人提出的理论是荠菜会导致子宫收

缩，不应该给怀孕的动物服用——保留在产后时期。人们还认为它具有止血特性，可能会干扰血液稀释药

物。因此，谨慎和常识表明，最好避免在患有凝血障碍的动物中使用这种草药。

SKULLCAP

骷髅帽

Scutellaria lateriflora

黄芩

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: Skullcap is differentiated from other mints by its blue or white flowers, which are borne (in most

species) at the top third of the plant in symmetrically arranged sets of two or more. The flowers are two lobed and

tubular; one lobe forms an upper lip, and one forms a larger apronlike lower lip. The lance-shaped, finely to coarsely

toothed leaves oppose one another, as in all mints. Like most mints, skullcap has distinctly four-sided stems.

外观：黄芩与其他薄荷的区别在于其蓝色或白色的花朵，这些花朵（在大多数物种中）以对称排列的两朵

或两朵以上的形式出现在植物的顶部三分之一处。花是二裂的和管状的；一个叶形成上唇，一个叶形成较

大的围裙状下唇。与所有薄荷糖一样，矛状、细齿到粗齿的叶子彼此相对。与大多数薄荷糖一样，黄芩有

明显的四边茎。

Habitat and Range: Several native species of skullcap grow in North America, most of which live in moist

meadows, seeps from springs, and riparian thickets. Scutellaria lateriflora and several other cultivars are grown

throughout the world.

栖息地和分布范围：北美有几种本土黄芩物种，其中大多数生活在潮湿的草地、泉水渗水和河岸灌木丛

中。黄芩和其他几个品种在世界各地都有种植。

Cycle and Bloom Season: An annual or perennial (depending on species and climate) that blooms from June to

August

周期和开花季节：一年生或多年生植物（取决于物种和气候），从六月到八月开花

Parts Used: Leaves, stems, and flowers

使用部位：叶、茎、花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Moderates nerve transmissions, sedative, antispasmodic, anticonvulsant

主要药用活性：调节神经传导、镇静、解痉、抗惊厥

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system

最强的亲和力：神经系统

Preparation: Tea, tincture, dried or fresh herb

制剂：茶、酊剂、干或新鲜药草

Common Uses: For centuries, herbalists have recognized skullcap as one of the most effective herbal nervines

=== PAGE 310 ===
available. It is commonly used for acute or chronic cases of nervous tension or anxiety and to help relieve pain from

nerve-related injury or disease. Historically, it has been used to treat convulsions, epilepsy, multiple sclerosis,

hysteria, and delirium tremens, which is shaking and delirium associated with withdrawals from alcohol (also called

d.t.’s). Scutellaria lateriflora is still known by many people as “mad dog weed” from its use in the eighteenth

century as a cure for rabies. Yet despite its rich history and current popularity among herbalists, very little scientific

study has been focused on this plant. From the studies that have been conducted, we have learned that the chemistry

of skullcap varies considerably between species, although all species that are marketed and used as herbal medicine

contain scutellarin, a flavonoid compound that has been shown to possess sedative and antispasmodic qualities.

常见用途：几个世纪以来，草药学家一直认为黄芩是最有效的草药神经元之一。它通常用于治疗急性或慢

性神经紧张或焦虑，并有助于缓解神经相关损伤或疾病引起的疼痛。历史上，它曾被用于治疗惊厥、癫

痫、多发性硬化症、癔症和震颤性谵妄，即与戒酒有关的颤抖和谵妄（也称为 d.t.'s）。黄芩至今仍被许多

人称为“疯狗草”，因为它在十八世纪被用来治疗狂犬病。然而，尽管它有着丰富的历史并且目前在草药学

家中很受欢迎，但很少有科学研究关注这种植物。从已经进行的研究中，我们了解到黄芩的化学成分在物

种之间存在很大差异，尽管所有作为草药销售和使用的物种都含有灯盏花乙素，这是一种黄酮类化合物，

已被证明具有镇静和抗痉挛的功效。

We find skullcap especially effective for general nervousness and excitability in dogs and cats and for any

condition characterized by oversensitivity of the peripheral nerves. It helps relieve nervous tension related to pain or

a traumatic experience, and it is useful as an antispasmodic in nervous irritations of the cerebrospinal system such as

sciatica or posttraumatic neuralgia.

我们发现黄芩对于狗和猫的一般紧张和兴奋以及任何以周围神经过度敏感为特征的疾病特别有效。它有

助于缓解与疼痛或创伤经历相关的神经紧张，并且可用作脑脊髓系统神经刺激（如坐骨神经痛或创伤后神

经痛）的解痉药。

Unlike valerian and other herbal sedatives, skullcap by itself does not bring about drowsiness, nor does it dull the

reflexes or interfere with motor coordination. Instead, skullcap acts to moderate an animal’s responsiveness to

physical or nonphysical stimuli and helps to alleviate general restlessness and nervous twitching. This makes it

suitable for highstrung felines who are recovering from a frightful experience but who need all of their survival

mechanisms intact during their daily outdoor adventures.

与缬草和其他草药镇静剂不同，黄芩本身不会导致困倦，也不会使反应迟钝或干扰运动协调。相反，黄

芩可以调节动物对物理或非物理刺激的反应，并有助于缓解普遍的不安和神经抽搐。这使得它适合高度紧

张的猫科动物，这些猫科动物正在从可怕的经历中恢复过来，但在日常户外探险中需要保持所有生存机制

完好无损。

Herbalists consider skullcap a specific remedy for grand mal epileptic seizures. We have received several

encouraging reports from people who are using skullcap to reduce the severity and frequency of seizures in their

epileptic dogs, especially when the herb is combined in equal parts with valerian. Science has not yet revealed

exactly how skullcap works in this capacity, but herbalists theorize that it may calm nerve impulses throughout the

body, while inhibiting activity in higher brain centers where epileptic seizures might be triggered. Skullcap’s

effectiveness in moderating epileptic episodes may explain its traditional reputation as a cure for rabies: back in the

eighteenth century, little was known about epilepsy, and it’s likely that many epilepsy sufferers were misdiagnosed

as having rabies.

草药学家认为黄芩是治疗癫痫大发作的特效药物。我们收到了一些令人鼓舞的报告，这些报告来自人

们，他们使用黄芩来降低癫痫犬癫痫发作的严重程度和频率，特别是当这种草药与缬草等量混合时。科学

尚未确切揭示黄芩如何发挥这种作用，但草药学家推测，它可以平息全身的神经冲动，同时抑制可能引发

癫痫发作的高级大脑中心的活动。黄芩在缓解癫痫发作方面的功效可能解释了它作为治疗狂犬病的传统疗

法的声誉：早在十八世纪，人们对癫痫病知之甚少，许多癫痫患者很可能被误诊为患有狂犬病。

For epileptic dogs, 0.5 to 1 milliliter of a low-alcohol tincture can be fed two or three times daily, but see your

holistic veterinarian for a thorough workup of your companion before proceeding. For generalized nervousness or to

help relieve pain in dogs and cats, 0.5 milliliter per 20 pounds of the animal’s weight can be fed as needed, up to

three times daily for up to a week. It’s important to remember, though, that skullcap and other herbal sedatives can

only relieve the symptoms of such disorders; they cannot address the underlying causes. For nervousness in a horse,

mule, or goat, ½–1 ounce of the dried herb can be added to the animal’s feed once per day, as needed.

对于癫痫犬，每天可以喂食 2 到 3 次 0.5 至 1 毫升的低酒精酊剂，但在继续之前请咨询您的整体兽医，对

=== PAGE 311 ===
您的伴侣进行彻底检查。对于全身性紧张或帮助缓解狗和猫的疼痛，可以根据需要每 20 磅动物体重喂食

0.5 毫升，每天最多 3 次，持续一周。但重要的是要记住，黄芩和其他草药镇静剂只能缓解此类疾病的症

状。他们无法解决根本原因。对于马、骡子或山羊的紧张情绪，可以根据需要每天一次将 1/2-1 盎司的干草

药添加到动物饲料中。

A study in 1957 showed that skullcap can prevent a rise in serum cholesterol in animals on a high-cholesterol diet,

which means that the herb might be useful as a dietary adjunct in animals, such as miniature schnauzers and beagles,

who are predisposed to hyperlipidemia.

1957 年的一项研究表明，黄芩可以防止高胆固醇饮食动物血清胆固醇升高，这意味着该草药可能可用作

动物的饮食辅助剂，例如容易患高脂血症的小型雪纳瑞和比格犬。

Scutellaria lateriflora

黄芩

Availability: Skullcap can be purchased through herb retailers in dried herb form or tinctures. The plants are

available through nurseries that specialize in herbs.

可用性：黄芩可以通过草药零售商以干草药形式或酊剂购买。这些植物可通过专门种植草药的苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Easy to grow from transplants, skullcap likes consistently moist, rich soil and does best

when allowed a few hours of shade each day. Harvest the plants by clipping the upper third of the flowering plant.

The plant can be hung in small bunches and dried for later use (the herb keeps for about a year), or the fresh herb

can be made into tincture (the optimum choice).

繁殖和收获：黄芩很容易移植生长，喜欢持续湿润、肥沃的土壤，每天有几个小时的阴凉处效果最好。通

过修剪开花植物的上三分之一来收获植物。可以将植物分成小束悬挂并干燥以备后用（药草可保存约一

年），或者将新鲜药草制成酊剂（最佳选择）。

=== PAGE 312 ===
Alternatives and Adjuncts: For epileptic dogs or for use as a nerve-calming sedative, skullcap can be combined

with an equal part of valerian. Oatstraw and gotu kola also serve as good adjuncts. For nerve pain and spinal

injuries, combine skullcap with an equal amount of Saint-John’s-wort.

替代品和辅助剂：对于癫痫犬或用作镇静神经的镇静剂，黄芩可以与等量的缬草混合使用。燕麦草和雷公

根也是很好的佐料。对于神经疼痛和脊柱损伤，将黄芩与等量的圣约翰草混合。

Cautions and Comments: Some texts and many toxicology databases still claim that skullcap, when used in large

quantities, can be damaging to the liver. However, in the years following the first writing of this book, we have

learned that such claims are inaccurate. The reports of hepatotoxicity that fueled earlier controversies over the safety

of this herb involved skullcap that had been adulterated with germander; an inexpensive look alike that really can be

damaging to the liver. Fortunately, the standards by which skullcap is cultivated, processed, and analytically

identified are better than ever, and safe, good quality skullcap is in ample supply. Just buy it from a reputable

source. This is a very safe herb.

注意事项和评论：一些文献和许多毒理学数据库仍然声称，大量使用黄芩可能会损害肝脏。然而，在本书

首次写作后的几年里，我们了解到这种说法是不准确的。早期有关这种草药安全性的争议的报道涉及掺有

石斑鱼的黄芩的肝毒性。一种廉价的外观确实会损害肝脏。幸运的是，黄芩的种植、加工和分析鉴定标准

比以往任何时候都更好，安全、优质的黄芩供应充足。只需从信誉良好的来源购买即可。这是一种非常安

全的草药。

=== PAGE 313 ===
SLIPPERY ELM

榆

Ulmus fulva

榆树

Elm Family

榆树家族

Appearance: Slippery elm is a deciduous tree that can grow to 80 feet tall. The outer bark is thick, furrowed, and

pinkish brown. The broadly lance-shaped alternate leaves are 4–8 inches long and have toothed margins. The upper

surfaces of the leaves feel like sticky sandpaper.

外观：滑榆是一种落叶乔木，可以长到 80 英尺高。外树皮厚，有皱纹，呈粉棕色。宽矛状互生叶长 4-8 英

寸，边缘有齿。叶子的上表面感觉像粘砂纸。

Habitat and Range: Deciduous forests of the eastern half of the U.S. and Canada; slippery elm is at risk of

endangerment in many areas.

栖息地和范围：美国和加拿大东半部的落叶林；滑榆在许多地区都面临濒临灭绝的危险。

Cycle and Bloom Season: The tree flowers from March to June and loses its leaves in the fall.

周期和开花季节：该树从三月到六月开花，在秋天落叶。

Parts Used: Inner bark

使用部位：内树皮

Primary Medicinal Activities: Lubricates, soothes, and protects internal mucous membranes; emollient, astringent,

anti-inflammatory, nutritive

主要药用活性：润滑、舒缓和保护内部粘膜；润肤、收敛、抗炎、营养

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract, respiratory tract, skin

亲和力最强：消化道、呼吸道、皮肤

Preparation: Tea, tincture, dried and powdered inner bark

准备：茶、酊剂、干燥的内树皮粉末

Common Uses: Slippery elm is best used in the digestive tract, where it serves as a soothing, protecting, and

lubricating demulcent and a general astringent at the same time. These effects make slippery elm applicable in a

wide variety of circumstances. For diarrhea, enteritis, colitis, and irritations of the stomach, the tannin constituents

of slippery elm tighten digestive mucosa to reduce inflammation and inhibit the entrance of excess fluids into the

intestines. At the same time, the slippery, oily mucilage constituents of the herb help lubricate the digestive tract to

assist in the elimination of waste. In cases of constipation, slippery elm soothes, protects, and lubricates mucous

=== PAGE 314 ===
membranes, assisting and relaxing smooth muscles that have been working extra hard to eliminate waste. Higher up

in the digestive tract, the mucilaginous astringency of the herb lubricates and helps reduce inflammation in the

throat, making swallowing easier and soothing a painful cough. It plays the same roles in the upper respiratory

passages, where it relieves the discomforts of kennel cough and other types of bronchitis.

常见用途：滑榆最适合用于消化道，它可以作为舒缓、保护和润滑的缓和剂，同时也可以作为一般的收敛

剂。这些效果使滑榆适用于各种情况。对于腹泻、肠炎、结肠炎和胃部刺激，滑榆的单宁成分可以收紧消

化粘膜，减少炎症并抑制多余液体进入肠道。同时，草药中滑溜溜的油性粘液成分有助于润滑消化道，帮

助消除废物。在便秘的情况下，滑榆可以舒缓、保护和润滑粘膜，帮助和放松一直在努力消除废物的平滑

肌。在消化道的较高处，这种草药的粘液涩味可以润滑并有助于减少喉咙炎症，使吞咽更容易并缓解疼痛

的咳嗽。它在上呼吸道中起着相同的作用，可以缓解犬舍咳嗽和其他类型支气管炎的不适。

Slippery elm is also nutritious; it was used as a food staple during times of economic hardship in Appalachia. It

contains vitamins A, B complex, C, and K and high amounts of calcium, magnesium, and sodium. The fresh inner

bark has a slightly sweet pecanlike flavor and was often given to children as a treat to chew on (like chewing gum).

It can be fed to convalescing animals as a nutritional digestive tonic—1 teaspoon of the dried inner bark steeped in 8

ounces of hot water to which 1 teaspoon of honey has been added. If constipation is a problem, 1 teaspoon of

organic yogurt (a brand that has live cultures) can be added to the mixture. The entire mixture, inner bark and all, is

then fed to the animals. Many animals will eat this formula in the absence of anything else, and it is useful for a

wide variety of digestive or respiratory problems in dogs and cats. If your companion cannot tolerate honey because

of diabetes, allergies, or other problems, eliminate honey from the recipe. If your companion won’t eat the bark,

strain the fluid through a fine sieve and pour it onto her food. A glycerin-based tincture is also effective and offers

the convenience of administering a squirt or two into the mouth. A good starting dose for the tincture is ¼–½

teaspoon (1–2 milliliters) for each 20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, once or twice daily.

滑榆也有营养；在阿巴拉契亚经济困难时期，它被用作主食。它含有维生素 A、复合 B、C 和 K 以及大

量的钙、镁和钠。新鲜的内树皮有一种微甜的山核桃味道，经常给孩子们作为咀嚼的零食（就像口香

糖）。它可以作为营养消化补品喂给正在康复的动物——将 1 茶匙干燥的内树皮浸泡在 8 盎司热水中，并

加入 1 茶匙蜂蜜。如果存在便秘问题，可以在混合物中添加 1 茶匙有机酸奶（含有活菌的品牌）。然后将

整个混合物（包括内皮和所有东西）喂给动物。许多动物会在没有其他任何东西的情况下吃这种配方奶

粉，它对狗和猫的各种消化或呼吸问题很有用。如果您的伴侣因糖尿病、过敏或其他问题而不能耐受蜂

蜜，请从食谱中去除蜂蜜。如果你的同伴不吃树皮，可以用细筛子过滤液体，然后倒在她的食物上。甘油

酊剂也很有效，并且可以方便地将一两滴注入口中。酊剂的最佳起始剂量是每 20 磅动物体重 1/4 茶匙（1-2

毫升），每天一次或两次。

On the skin, a poultice of slippery elm bark can be applied to wounds, ulcers, boils, or abscesses. In essence, it is

used the same way as plantain (Plantago sp.), a common weed that is better suited for this purpose because of its

abundance and resilience to human impact.

在皮肤上，可以将滑榆树皮膏敷在伤口、溃疡、疖子或脓肿上。从本质上讲，它的使用方式与车前草

(Plantago sp.) 相同，车前草是一种常见杂草，由于其丰富性和对人类影响的适应能力而更适合此目的。

=== PAGE 315 ===
Ulmus fulva

榆树

Availability: Available at herb retailers. When you buy slippery elm bark, make sure that you’re getting the inner

bark only. The powder or bark should be light, fluffy, and pale pinkish tan in color. If it has darker flecks in it or

appears corky, stringy, or woody, it was probably carelessly harvested and the inner bark was not separated from the

outer bark. Inclusion of the outer bark dramatically changes the nature of the medicine. The outer bark contains a

greater amount of tannin constituents, which may cause digestive or urinary tract irritation.

供货情况：可在药草零售商处购买。当您购买滑榆树皮时，请确保只购买内皮。粉末或树皮应该是浅色、

蓬松、浅粉红棕褐色的。如果它里面有深色斑点或者看起来是木栓质、丝状或木质的，那么它可能是不小

心收获的，并且内树皮没有与外树皮分离。外树皮的加入极大地改变了药物的性质。外树皮含有大量单宁

成分，可能会引起消化道或泌尿道刺激。

Propagation and Harvest: Slippery elm is available through nurseries that specialize in native plants. This tree is

not difficult to grow, but, like most trees, it grows slowly. If you have room for one of these beautiful shade trees, by

all means plant one! You will be doing a dwindling species a great favor.

繁殖和收获：滑榆可通过专门种植本土植物的苗圃获得。这棵树并不难生长，但是，像大多数树一样，它

生长得很慢。如果您有空间容纳一棵这些美丽的遮荫树，请务必种植一棵！你将为日益减少的物种做一件

大事。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: Slippery elm has remained quite popular among herb users for centuries.

Unfortunately, many of its consumers remain unaware of its declining population in the wild. Slippery elm is being

overharvested, and many of the trees are succumbing to Dutch elm disease—a fungal infection that kills trees.

Adding to these problems are careless methods by which much of the bark is harvested: the entire tree, which may

be one hundred years old, is cut down, stripped of its bark, then used as firewood or hardwood lumber with little

regard to sustenance of the species. All in all, consumer demand is currently outstripping natural supply.

=== PAGE 316 ===
替代品和辅助品：几个世纪以来，滑榆一直深受草药使用者的欢迎。不幸的是，它的许多消费者仍然没有

意识到它在野外的数量正在减少。滑榆被过度采伐，许多树木都死于荷兰榆树病——一种导致树木死亡的

真菌感染。雪上加霜的是，大部分树皮的采伐方法都是粗心大意的：整棵可能有一百年树龄的树被砍倒，

剥去树皮，然后用作柴火或硬木木材，很少考虑到木材的生计。的物种。总而言之，目前消费者的需求超

过了自然供给。

We include slippery elm here so that you know to use this herb conservatively, respectfully, and in a proper

therapeutic context. Slippery elm should be reserved for circumstances where alternatives are ineffective, and every

effort should be made to support the tree’s cultivation and conservation in the wild. Fortunately, some effective and

accessible alternatives exist for slippery elm. In many instances, slippery elm can be substituted with the common

weed plantain (Plantago sp.). If a more mucilaginous remedy is needed, marshmallow root (Althea officinalis) is an

excellent alternative, especially when it is combined with an astringent such as goldenrod or raspberry leaf, or a

tincture or decoction of uva ursi or juniper.

我们在这里添加了滑榆，以便您知道在适当的治疗背景下保守、尊重地使用这种草药。滑榆应保留在替

代品无效的情况下，并应尽一切努力支持该树的野外种植和保护。幸运的是，滑榆有一些有效且易于使用

的替代品。在许多情况下，滑榆可以用常见杂草车前草（Plantago sp.）代替。如果需要更具粘液性的药

物，药蜀葵根（Althea officinalis）是一个很好的选择，特别是当它与收敛剂（如黄花或覆盆子叶）或熊果

或杜松酊剂或汤剂结合使用时。

Cautions and Comments: With the rare exception of possible allergic reactions, slippery elm is generally safe for

animals. The outer bark, however, (which shouldn’t be in the slippery elm you buy) can cause irritation to the

digestive and urinary tracts and may induce abortion in pregnant animals.

注意事项和评论：除了可能出现过敏反应的罕见情况外，滑榆通常对动物是安全的。然而，外层树皮（不

应该出现在您购买的滑榆树中）会对消化道和泌尿道造成刺激，并可能导致怀孕动物流产。
