THYME

百里香

Thymus vulgaris

百里香

Mint Family

薄荷家族

Appearance: Most species of thyme are ground-hugging plants with strong sprawling stems, small (⅛ inch)

opposite leaves, and tiny cylindrical flowers that range in color from white to pale purple. There are countless

variations of leaf color, fragrance, and even flavor available to the gardener. In fact there are so many variations of

Thymus spp., it is possible to dedicate an entire garden to them.

外观：大多数百里香品种都是贴地植物，具有粗壮的蔓生茎、对生的小（⅛英寸）叶子和微小的圆柱形花

朵，颜色从白色到淡紫色不等。园丁可以选择的叶子颜色、香味甚至味道有无数种变化。事实上，百里香

属植物有很多变种，甚至可以将整个花园专门用于它们。

Habitat and Range: Thyme originated in the Mediterranean region. Over 350 species of Thymus exist worldwide

most of which are cultivated as a seasoning herb or landscape shrub.

栖息地和分布范围：百里香原产于地中海地区。全世界有超过 350 种百里香，其中大多数被栽培为调味草

本植物或景观灌木。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Most of the species of thyme are evergreen perennials. Blooming occurs from early

spring to midsummer.

周期和开花季节：大多数百里香品种都是常绿多年生植物。花期从早春到仲夏。

Parts Used: Leaves, stems, and flowers

使用部位：叶、茎、花

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antimicrobial, expels intestinal gas, antispasmodic, cough suppressant, expectorant,

astringent, expels worms

主要药用活性：抗菌、排出肠道气体、解痉、止咳、祛痰、收敛、驱虫

Strongest Affinities: Digestive and respiratory tracts

最强的亲和力：消化道和呼吸道

Preparation: Tea or tincture

准备：茶或酊剂

Common Uses: Most of thyme’s medicinal activity is attributable to its volatile oil constituents, which are thymol

and carvacrol. Thymol is a good antiseptic for the mouth and throat and is useful for fighting gingivitis in dogs and

=== PAGE 318 ===
cats. In fact, it is used as the active ingredient in many commercial toothpaste and mouthwash formulas.

常见用途：百里香的大部分药用活性归因于其挥发油成分，即百里香酚和香芹酚。百里香酚是口腔和喉咙

的良好防腐剂，可用于对抗狗和猫的牙龈炎。事实上，它被用作许多商业牙膏和漱口水配方中的活性成

分。

Combined with thyme’s infection-fighting qualities are cough suppressant and expectorant properties, which

make the herb effective against raspy, unproductive coughs that are secondary to fungal or bacterial infection. As an

antispasmodic, thyme helps to ease bronchial spasms related to asthma. A glycerin tincture, or an alcohol tincture

that has been sweetened with honey, serves well for most internal applications—¼ teaspoon (1 milliliter) for each 30

pounds of an animal’s body weight (12–20 drops for cats), fed to the animal as needed up to twice daily. A cooled

tea works too, provided it has been brewed with near-boiling water to draw out the volatile oil constituents—1

teaspoon per 30 pounds of body weight for dogs, ¼ teaspoon for cats, fed directly into the mouth two to three times

daily. For infections of the mouth or as a preventative against gingivitis, the tincture or a strong tea can be directly

applied to the gum lines or infected sites with a swab. In the digestive tract, it is a useful carminative and

antispasmodic in cases of dyspepsia, irritable bowel, and colitis. It also helps expel parasites, especially hookworms.

In these cases, the dried or fresh herb can be fed with your companion’s food—1 teaspoon per pound of food fed to

dogs, a sprinkling for cats. Horses and other large herbivores with digestive problems can be fed a ½ cup of the

dried herb or a handful of the fresh plants daily. Rabbits, birds, and other small animals can be fed a couple of fresh

sprigs daily. On the surface of the body, thyme tea (skin rinse) or an oil infusion is appropriate for various fungal or

bacterial infections of the skin. In the urinary tract, the tea or tincture serves as an antimicrobial as well as a mildly

astringent tonic that is said to treat urinary incontinence. Use the tincture doses we have suggested for respiratory

problems.

百里香的抗感染特性还具有镇咳和祛痰的特性，这使得百里香能够有效对抗继发于真菌或细菌感染的刺

耳、干咳。作为一种解痉剂，百里香有助于缓解与哮喘相关的支气管痉挛。甘油酊剂或用蜂蜜增甜的酒精

酊剂适合大多数内服——每 30 磅体重的动物使用 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升）（猫为 12-20 滴），喂给动物根据需

要每天最多两次。冷茶也有效，只要用接近沸水冲泡即可提取挥发油成分——狗每 30 磅体重 1 茶匙，猫

1/4 茶匙，直接喂入嘴中，每天 2 到 3 次。对于口腔感染或预防牙龈炎，可以用棉签将酊剂或浓茶直接涂抹

在牙龈线或感染部位。在消化道中，它是一种有用的驱风剂和解痉剂，可治疗消化不良、肠易激和结肠

炎。它还有助于排出寄生虫，尤其是钩虫。在这些情况下，干或新鲜的药草可以与你同伴的食物一起喂食

——给狗喂每磅食物一茶匙，给猫撒一点。有消化问题的马和其他大型食草动物每天可以喂 ½ 杯干药草或

一把新鲜植物。兔子、鸟类和其他小动物每天可以喂几根新鲜的小树枝。在身体表面，百里香茶（皮肤冲

洗液）或油浸液适用于皮肤的各种真菌或细菌感染。在泌尿道中，茶或酊剂可作为抗菌剂以及温和的收敛

补品，据说可以治疗尿失禁。 使用我们建议的治疗呼吸系统问题的酊剂剂量。

=== PAGE 319 ===
Thymus vulgaris

百里香

Availability: Thyme can be purchased at any food market. The plants are available at nurseries.

可获得性：百里香可以在任何食品市场购买。这些植物可在苗圃中获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Thyme is easy to grow from seeds or transplants. It prefers light soil with neutral acidity

but can be grown just about anywhere. It is an excellent choice for rock gardens and walkway borders.

繁殖和收获：百里香很容易通过种子或移植来生长。它喜欢中性酸性的轻质土壤，但几乎可以在任何地方

种植。它是岩石花园和走道边界的绝佳选择。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For infections of the mouth, thyme combines with myrrh, Oregon grape, certified

organic goldenseal, bee balm, or sage. For respiratory infections, combine with garlic, echinacea, bee balm, or sage.

For asthma, thyme works best when used in conjunction with elecampane, mullein leaf, nettle, or lobelia. For

digestive problems, fennel, parsley seeds, chamomile, and peppermint are all good herbs to combine with thyme.

For worms, try combining thyme with equal amounts of garlic and raw pumpkin seeds.

替代品和辅助剂：对于口腔感染，百里香与没药、俄勒冈葡萄、经过认证的有机金印、蜂香膏或鼠尾草混

合。对于呼吸道感染，可与大蒜、紫锥菊、蜂香膏或鼠尾草混合使用。对于哮喘，百里香与土木香、毛蕊

花、荨麻或半边莲一起使用效果最佳。对于消化问题，茴香、欧芹籽、洋甘菊和薄荷都是与百里香搭配的

好药草。对于蠕虫，尝试将百里香与等量的大蒜和生南瓜子混合。

Cautions and Comments: Thyme is safe, but when it’s ingested in large amounts, it has been known to affect

menstrual cycles. Therefore, it should be used with moderation in pregnant animals. When isolated from the rest of

the plant, thymol is toxic. Do not use an essential oil of thyme in or on your animal.

注意和评论：百里香是安全的，但大量摄入时，已知会影响月经周期。因此，怀孕动物应适量使用。当与

=== PAGE 320 ===
植物的其余部分分离时，百里香酚是有毒的。请勿在动物体内或体表使用百里香精油。

In horses, the volatile oils of thyme may be detectable in a blood sample, and it may be considered a “prohibited

substance” under Jockey Club or other horse show rules.

在马身上，百里香的挥发油可以在血液样本中检测到，并且根据赛马俱乐部或其他马术表演规则，它可

能被视为“禁用物质”。

=== PAGE 321 ===
UVA URSI

紫外可见分光光度计

Arctostaphylos uva-ursi

熊果树

Heath Family

希斯家族

Appearance: Also known as kinnikinnick (an American Indian word meaning “smoking mixture”), uva ursi is a

matforming, densely branched ground cover with woody trailing stems. Several other species of Arctostaphylos are

small to medium (up to 10 feet tall) erect hardwood shrubs. In mountainous areas of the southwestern U.S., A.

manzanita is often seen as a predominant shrub. Despite their size differences, all species present leaf, flower, and

fruit characteristics that distinguish them as members of the Arctostaphylos genus, and all are medicinally useful

despite the fact that A. uva-ursi is the species of primary interest among herbalists. The leathery leaves are spoon to

lance shaped, with upper surfaces darker green than their undersides. Flowers are pink and urn shaped, and they are

arranged in nodding, few-flowered terminal clusters. The fruits are mealy red berries that look like tiny apples.

外观：熊果也被称为 kinnikinnick（美洲印第安语，意思是“吸烟混合物”），是一种席状、浓密分枝的地被

植物，具有木质尾茎。 Arctostaphylos 的其他几种物种是小型到中型（高达 10 英尺）的直立硬木灌木。在

美国西南部的山区，A. manzanita 通常被视为主要灌木。尽管大小不同，但所有物种都呈现出叶、花和果实

的特征，这些特征使它们成为 Arctostaphylos 属的成员，并且尽管 A. uva-ursi 是草药学家最感兴趣的物种，

但所有物种都具有药用价值。革质叶子呈勺状至矛状，上表面比下表面深绿色。花朵呈粉红色，呈瓮形，

排列成点头状、少花的顶生簇。水果是粉红色浆果，看起来像小苹果。

Habitat and Range: Open forest clearings from the montane zone up to the timberline. Arctostaphylos uva-ursi is

the predominant species, ranging throughout the northern third of the U.S., Canada, and Europe. In the mountains of

Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Arizona, New Mexico, and especially California (where A. manzanita is protected by

law), several of the larger shrub varieties are predominant.

栖息地和范围：从山地地带到林线的开阔森林空地。 Arctostaphylos uva-ursi 是主要物种，分布于美国北部

三分之一、加拿大和欧洲。在华盛顿州、俄勒冈州、内华达州、亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州，尤其是加利福

尼亚州（其中 A. manzanita 受到法律保护）的山区，几种较大的灌木品种占主导地位。

Cycle and Bloom Season: Blooms April through June. Fruits begin to develop in midsummer.

周期和开花季节：四月至六月开花。果实在仲夏开始发育。

Parts Used: Leaves and twigs

使用部分：树叶和树枝

Primary Medicinal Activities: Astringent, antimicrobial, diuretic

主要药用活性：收敛剂、抗菌剂、利尿剂

Strongest Affinities: Urinary tract and skin

最强的亲和力：泌尿道和皮肤

=== PAGE 322 ===
Preparation: Decoction or tincture

制剂：汤剂或酊剂

Common Uses: Uva ursi contains a considerable amount of tannins (up to 40 percent), making it one of nature’s

most powerful astringents. It also contains hydroquinones—an assortment of chemical compounds that are active

against a wide variety of pathogens, including Mycobacterium smegmatis, Staphylococcus aureus, Bacillus subtilus,

E. coli, and various Shigella species. Each of these pathogens are often implicated in urinary tract infections. It’s

important to know, however, that for uva ursi to be an effective treatment for urinary tract infections, an alkaline

reaction is necessary to release the hydroquinone into an active form. This means that uva ursi cannot contribute

antibacterial activities to a urinary system in which urine is acidic, a condition that is common in animals, especially

cats, with chronic urinary tract problems. In these circumstances, it is necessary either to elevate urine pH into a

healthier alkaline state or to combine uva ursi with other antibacterial herbs (the easier option). Regardless of urine

pH, uva ursi serves as an effective astringent to stop bleeding and reduce urinary tract inflammation.

常见用途：熊果含有大量单宁（高达 40%），使其成为自然界最强大的收敛剂之一。它还含有对苯二酚

——一种对多种病原体具有活性的化合物，包括耻垢分枝杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、枯草芽孢杆菌、大肠杆

菌和各种志贺氏菌。这些病原体中的每一种通常都与尿路感染有关。然而，重要的是要知道，熊果要想有

效治疗尿路感染，碱性反应对于将氢醌释放成活性形式是必要的。这意味着熊果不能对尿液呈酸性的泌尿

系统发挥抗菌活性，这种情况在患有慢性泌尿道问题的动物（尤其是猫）中很常见。在这种情况下，有必

要将尿液 pH 值提高到更健康的碱性状态，或者将熊果与其他抗菌草药结合使用（更简单的选择）。无论尿

液 pH 值如何，熊果酸都可以作为有效的收敛剂来止血和减少尿路炎症。

Uva ursi is a strong herb, and its high tannin content can irritate the kidneys if used for more than a few

consecutive days. Therefore, it is best reserved for situations in which quick intervention is needed.

熊果是一种强效草本植物，如果连续使用几天以上，其高单宁含量会刺激肾脏。因此，最好将其保留用

于需要快速干预的情况。

To use uva ursi internally, make a decoction from the fresh or dried leaves and stems. Use 1 cup of the dried herb

for each 3 cups of water. The leathery, almost plasticlike structure of this plant makes it nearly impervious to water,

so a simple tea is not an option. For dogs, 1 teaspoon of the cooled decoction can be fed once daily for no more than

three days. Cats and ferrets require only ¼–½ teaspoon. Have the animal drink as much water as possible when

using this herb, even if you must resort to using a meat broth. The idea is to course the herb through the urinary tract

so it can quickly alleviate infection and reduce inflammation. Then, after a day or two, gentler astringent herbs can

be used to finish the therapy safely and effectively. Horses and other large herbivores can be fed 1 cup of the dried

leaves daily for up to three days. For contact dermatitis, seborrhea, and fleabites, the decoction can be diluted (1 cup

decoction to 1 quart of water) and used as an antibacterial and astringent skin rinse.

内服熊果时，可将新鲜或干燥的叶和茎制成汤剂。每 3 杯水使用 1 杯干草药。这种植物的坚韧、几乎像

塑料的结构使其几乎不透水，所以简单的茶不是一个选择。对于狗来说，每次1茶匙冷却的汤剂可以每天喂

一次，最多不超过三天。猫和雪貂只需 ¼–½ 茶匙。使用这种草药时，让动物尽可能多地喝水，即使您必须

使用肉汤。这个想法是让草药通过泌尿道，这样它就可以快速缓解感染并减少炎症。然后，一两天后，可

以使用温和的收敛草药来安全有效地完成治疗。马和其他大型食草动物每天可以喂 1 杯干树叶，持续三

天。对于接触性皮炎、皮脂溢和跳蚤，可以将煎剂稀释（1杯煎剂兑1夸脱水）并用作抗菌和收敛皮肤冲洗

剂。

=== PAGE 323 ===
Arctostaphylos uva-ursi

熊果树

Availability: Uva ursi is available through herb retailers. The plants are available through nurseries that specialize

in native plant landscaping.

可用性：熊果可通过药草零售商购买。这些植物可通过专门从事本土植物景观美化的苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Uva ursi is hardy northward to central Canada and serves as an excellent antierosion

ground cover. It’s not particular about soil but prefers slightly to moderately acid conditions. Uva ursi and other

members of the Arctostaphylos genus are especially good landscape choices in mountain areas of the western United

States and Canada. The leaves and trailing stems can be clipped, dried, and used anytime during their evergreen

growth.

繁殖和收获：熊果耐寒，向北延伸至加拿大中部，是极好的防侵蚀地被植物。它对土壤并不挑剔，但更喜

欢微酸性至中酸性的条件。熊果和 Arctostaphylos 属的其他成员是美国西部和加拿大山区特别好的景观选

择。叶子和尾茎可以在常绿生长期间随时修剪、干燥和使用。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: When treating most forms of urinary tract infection, it’s a good idea to help flush the

animal’s system with the use of diuretic herbs. Dandelion leaf, chickweed, cleavers, or shepherd’s purse serves this

purpose well. For animals with overly concentrated acidic urine, uva ursi can be preceded (by an hour or so) by a

dose of mullein leaf tea, which is moderately effective at alkalinizing the urine. Uva ursi also can be combined with

antimicrobials such as Oregon grape, sage, thyme, or echinacea. Marshmallow serves as a soothing and lubricating

adjunct in urinary tract therapies and is especially useful in the passage of stones and gravel. Corn silk, couch grass,

horsetail, raspberry leaf, and cleavers all serve as weaker urinary astringents that are suitable for minor to

moderately severe urinary ailments.

替代方案和辅助疗法：在治疗大多数形式的尿路感染时，最好使用利尿草药帮助冲洗动物的系统。蒲公英

叶、繁缕、菜刀或荠菜都能很好地达到这个目的。对于酸性尿液过于浓缩的动物，可以在熊果之前（一小

=== PAGE 324 ===
时左右）喝一剂毛蕊花茶，这对于碱化尿液有一定的效果。熊果还可以与俄勒冈葡萄、鼠尾草、百里香或

紫锥菊等抗菌剂结合使用。棉花糖在泌尿道治疗中用作舒缓和润滑辅助剂，在结石和砾石的排出中特别有

用。玉米须、茅草、木贼、覆盆子叶和菜刀都是较弱的泌尿收敛剂，适用于轻微至中度严重的泌尿系统疾

病。

Cautions and Comments: Uva ursi is believed to inhibit oxygen delivery to the uterus and therefore should not be

used in pregnant animals. Like all strong astringents, long-term internal use of uva ursi may irritate the kidneys,

bladder, and urethra. Uva ursi may be contraindicated in cases of preexisting kidney inflammation or renal failure.

See your veterinarian in these circumstances.

注意事项和评论：熊果被认为会抑制氧气输送到子宫，因此不应用于怀孕动物。与所有强效收敛剂一样，

长期内服熊果可能会刺激肾脏、膀胱和尿道。在已有肾脏炎症或肾功能衰竭的情况下，熊果可能是禁忌

的。在这种情况下请去看兽医。

=== PAGE 325 ===
VALERIAN

缬草

Valeriana officinalis

缬草

Valerian Family

缬草家族

Appearance: Many people relate the strongly aromatic roots of valerian to the odor of dirty gym socks. Once you

have experienced the odor of this plant, identification becomes as simple as probing a finger into the soil to scratch a

root. The foliage of this plant is unique as well—the plant first emerges as a cluster of loosely arranged lance-shaped

leaves that usually remain larger than the leaves of the mature upper plant. Upper leaves are divided and become

progressively smaller toward the top of the plant. Flowers are borne in branched clusters of small white to pink

blossoms at the top of the plant. Roots are stringy, brown, and pungent. Several native species of Valeriana occur

throughout North America, with size being the primary difference among species. Most wild valerians remain under

a foot in height, while domestic valerian can grow in excess of 5 feet tall.

外观：许多人将缬草的强烈芳香根与脏运动袜的气味联系起来。一旦您体验了这种植物的气味，识别就变

得像用手指探入土壤中刮擦根部一样简单。这种植物的叶子也很独特——植物首先出现时是一簇松散排列

的矛状叶子，这些叶子通常比成熟的上部植物的叶子大。上部叶子被分开，并向植物顶部逐渐变小。花朵

长在植物顶部，长有白色到粉红色的小花，呈分枝状。根呈丝状，棕色，有辛辣味。缬草的几种本土物种

遍布北美，大小是物种之间的主要区别。大多数野生缬草的高度都在一英尺以下，而家养的缬草可以长到

超过 5 英尺高。

Habitat and Range: Valerian is generally found in soils that retain moisture well into summer. Look for it on north-

facing banks or hillsides or in partially shaded soils that are high in organic matter. Several native species occur

throughout the western third of the U.S. and Canada. It is less common in the midwestern and eastern portions of

North America, but in some areas, especially in New England, V. officinalis has escaped cultivation and is thriving.

栖息地和范围：缬草通常存在于能在夏季保持水分的土壤中。在朝北的河岸或山坡上或有机质含量高的部

分阴影土壤中寻找它。一些本地物种遍布美国西部三分之一的地区和加拿大。它在北美中西部和东部地区

不太常见，但在某些地区，特别是在新英格兰，V. officinalis 已经不再种植，并且正在蓬勃发展。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms from May to July

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，从五月到七月开花

Parts Used: Primarily the fall root. The upper parts of the plant are useful, too, but make weaker medicine.

使用部位：主要是秋根。植物的上部也很有用，但药效较弱。

Primary Medicinal Activities: Sedative, antispasmodic, anticonvulsive, expels intestinal gas, lowers blood pressure

主要药用活性：镇静、解痉、抗惊厥、排出肠道气体、降低血压

Strongest Affinities: Nervous system, digestive tract

最强亲和力：神经系统、消化道

=== PAGE 326 ===
Preparation: Tincture, tea, fresh or dried root

制剂：酊剂、茶、新鲜或干燥的根

Common Uses: Valerian is without doubt the most widely recognized herbal sedative. As a sedative, valerian works

safely and gently to help calm the nerves and achieve physical relaxation. It does not induce an altered state like one

would expect from a prescription sedative or from consumption of alcohol. Contrary to what many people believe,

valerian is not a precursor of the tranquilizer Valium. Valium is the brand name for diazepam, a prescription drug

that shares no chemical relationship with valerian.

常见用途：缬草无疑是最广泛认可的草药镇静剂。作为一种镇静剂，缬草安全而温和地发挥作用，有助于

镇定神经并实现身体放松。它不会像处方镇静剂或饮酒那样引起状态改变。与许多人的看法相反，缬草并

不是镇静剂安定的前身。安定是地西泮的商品名，地西泮是一种处方药，与缬草没有化学关系。

Herbalists use valerian for insomnia and nervous anxiety and to help the body relax in the presence of physical

pain. It is useful in calming animals during thunderstorms and on trips to the vet or groomer or to help your

companion rest after surgery. For epileptic animals, it sometimes helps to reduce the frequency and severity of

seizures.

草药师使用缬草治疗失眠和神经焦虑，并帮助身体在出现身体疼痛时放松。它可用于在雷暴期间以及去

看兽医或美容师时使动物平静下来，或帮助您的同伴在手术后休息。对于癫痫动物，它有时有助于减少癫

痫发作的频率和严重程度。

Animal studies have concluded that valerenic and valerenal acid work similarly to the drug phenobarbital, a

central nervous system depressant that is used as an anticonvulsive. And the herb has been shown to inhibit

production of an enzyme that breaks down gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), an amino acid that is responsible for

inhibiting and regulating neurotransmissions in the brain. The theory is this: by preventing the breakdown of GABA

with valerian, the increased neural activity that precedes an epileptic seizure is circumvented, and the triggering

mechanism is disabled.

动物研究得出结论，戊烯酸和戊烯酸的作用与药物苯巴比妥类似，苯巴比妥是一种中枢神经系统抑制

剂，用作抗惊厥药。这种草药已被证明可以抑制分解γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）的酶的产生，GABA 是一种负责

抑制和调节大脑神经传递的氨基酸。该理论是这样的：通过用缬草阻止 GABA 的分解，可以避免癫痫发作

前神经活动的增加，并禁用触发机制。

When employed as a sedative, valerian is most effective when small doses are fed several times daily over a

period of several days. This is especially true when it is used in anticipation of a high-anxiety event, such as a

planned interstate trip or a show. In these circumstances, dogs can be fed 5 drops of the tincture three or four times

daily, starting three days prior to the event. Cats need only 1 or 3 drops two or three times daily.

当用作镇静剂时，在几天内每天多次喂食小剂量的缬草是最有效的。当它用于预期高度焦虑事件（例如

计划的州际旅行或演出）时尤其如此。在这种情况下，可以从活动前三天开始，每天给狗喂食三到四次，

每次 5 滴酊剂。猫每天只需要 1 或 3 滴 2 到 3 次。

=== PAGE 327 ===
Valeriana officinalis

缬草

In the digestive tract, valerian is a useful antispasmodic for situations in which nervousness is compounded by a

spastic colon or an upset stomach. But because of valerian’s soaplike content, large amounts of this herb may cause

nausea and vomiting. For digestive and antiepileptic uses, 0.25–0.5 milliliter of the tincture can be fed for each 30

pounds of an animal’s body weight two to three times daily. In horses, valerian helps to reduce anxiety and

nervousness without inducing drowsiness or affecting physical performance. Add ½ ounce of the dried and chopped

herb or 2 tablespoons of the tincture to the horse’s daily feed.

在消化道中，缬草是一种有用的解痉剂，适用于因结肠痉挛或胃部不适而导致紧张的情况。但由于缬草

含有类似肥皂的成分，大量服用这种草药可能会引起恶心和呕吐。对于消化和抗癫痫用途，每 30 磅体重的

动物可喂食 0.25-0.5 毫升酊剂，每日 2-3 次。对于马来说，缬草有助于减少焦虑和紧张，而不会引起困倦或

影响身体表现。在马的每日饲料中添加 ½ 盎司干燥并切碎的药草或 2 汤匙酊剂。

For reasons that remain a mystery, a small percentage of human or animal subjects experience completely

opposite effects from valerian—it acts as a stimulant rather than a sedative.

由于仍然是个谜的原因，一小部分人类或动物受试者经历了缬草完全相反的效果——它起到兴奋剂而不

是镇静剂的作用。

Availability: Various forms of valerian preparations are available through herb retailers. Plants are available

through nurseries.

可用性：各种形式的缬草制剂可通过草药零售商购买。植物可通过苗圃获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Valerian can be grown from seeds or transplants. It likes rich, consistently moist soil

and full sun or partial shade. It is best to plant valerian early in the spring, when the seedlings and young plants can

fully benefit from cool temperatures and precipitation. The roots are dug in late fall of the second year of growth.

The fresh roots can be made into tincture or they can be chopped and dried for later use. When properly stored in

=== PAGE 328 ===
plastic bags, the dried roots keep for up to three years.

繁殖和收获：缬草可以通过种子或移植物种植。它喜欢肥沃、持续湿润的土壤和充足的阳光或部分遮荫。

最好在早春种植缬草，此时幼苗和幼苗可以充分受益于凉爽的气温和降水。在生长第二年的秋末挖根。鲜

根可制成酊剂，也可切碎晒干备用。如果正确存放在塑料袋中，干燥的根可以保存长达三年。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For epileptic animals, valerian combines well with skullcap. For anxiety and

nervousness, valerian can be combined with skullcap, passionflower, hop, oatstraw, or catnip. These herbs also serve

as alternatives for animals who have an opposite response to valerian.

替代品和辅助剂：对于癫痫动物，缬草与黄芩可以很好地结合。对于焦虑和紧张，缬草可以与黄芩、西番

莲、啤酒花、燕麦草或猫薄荷混合使用。这些草药也可以作为对缬草有相反反应的动物的替代品。

Cautions and Comments: Valerian can cause digestive upset if used in large doses, and it should not be used in

pregnant animals. Otherwise, it is a safe herb.

注意事项和评论：如果大剂量使用缬草会导致消化不良，并且不应用于怀孕动物。否则，它是一种安全的

草药。

=== PAGE 329 ===
WORMWOOD

蒿

Artemesia absinthum

苦艾

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Wormwood is attractive to the eyes and intriguing to the nose. It has silky, finely divided, gray-green

leaves and a strong fragrance that is reminiscent of both sage and pine. The tiny yellow ball-like flowers of the plant

are presented in loose clusters on the upper branches of the plant. The entire plant may grow to the size of a small

bush up to 4 feet tall.

外观：艾草养眼、引鼻。它有丝滑、细碎的灰绿色叶子和浓郁的香味，让人想起鼠尾草和松树。该植物的

黄色小球状花朵以松散的簇状出现在植物的上部枝条上。整株植物可长至小灌木大小，最高可达 4 英尺。

Habitat and Range: A native of Europe, wormwood is cultivated as a garden plant throughout the Northern

Hemisphere and has found its way into wild areas throughout most of North America.

栖息地和分布范围：艾草原产于欧洲，在整个北半球作为园林植物种植，并已进入北美大部分地区的野生

地区。

It is most commonly found along roadways, in vacant lots, on the edges of cultivated fields, and in other waste

areas.

它最常见于道路沿线、空地、耕地边缘和其他废弃区域。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A long-lived perennial that blooms from June to August

周期和开花季节：一种长寿的多年生植物，从六月到八月开花

Parts Used: Leaves

使用部件：叶子

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antiseptic, antifungal, astringent, expels worms

主要药用活性：抗菌、抗真菌、收敛、驱虫

Strongest Affinities: Skin and digestive tract

最强的亲和力：皮肤和消化道

Preparation: Tea or dried leaves

准备：茶叶或干树叶

Common Uses: As its common name implies, wormwood is among the most well-known herbal worming agents.

=== PAGE 330 ===
Hundreds of years of successful use stand in testament to its ability to expel tapeworms, threadworms, and

especially roundworms from the intestinal tracts of dogs, cats, horses, goats, sheep, cattle, and humans. We seldom

use it, however.

常见用途：顾名思义，艾草是最著名的草药驱虫剂之一。数百年的成功使用证明了它能够驱除狗、猫、

马、山羊、绵羊、牛和人类肠道中的绦虫、线虫，尤其是蛔虫。然而我们很少使用它。

Although wormwood makes life miserable for intestinal parasites, it can also be hard on the host. This is because

wormwood contains an assortment of strong volatile oils, bitter principles, and tannins. If used excessively, these

constituents can be irritating to the liver and kidneys, and in extreme cases may even damage the nervous system.

This is not to say that wormwood can’t be used safely, but an extra measure of care and moderation is certainly

warranted. The problems with using wormwood are multifaceted: too small a dose is ineffective, but a larger dose

might be toxic. Small doses administered over a long period might be effective, but at what cumulative cost to the

animal’s kidneys, liver, and nervous system? Our conclusion is this: wormwood is useful when the absolute

necessity of quick parasite intervention outweighs the risk of toxicity. In holistic animal care, this circumstance is a

rarity because therapeutic focus is placed upon the whole animal, not just one or more symptoms of disease.

尽管艾草让肠道寄生虫的生活变得痛苦，但它也可能对宿主造成伤害。这是因为艾草含有多种强烈的挥

发油、苦味成分和单宁酸。如果过量使用，这些成分会刺激肝脏和肾脏，在极端情况下甚至可能损害神经

系统。这并不是说艾草不能安全使用，但额外的谨慎和节制确实是必要的。使用艾草的问题是多方面的：

剂量太小无效，但剂量太大可能有毒。长期服用小剂量可能有效，但对动物的肾脏、肝脏和神经系统造成

的累积成本是多少？我们的结论是：当快速寄生虫干预的绝对必要性超过毒性风险时，艾草是有用的。在

整体动物护理中，这种情况很少见，因为治疗重点放在整个动物上，而不仅仅是一种或多种疾病症状。

To use wormwood, up to ¼ teaspoon of the dried powdered herb or about ⅛ teaspoon (0.5 milliliter) of a low-

alcohol tincture can be administered daily at mealtime for each 30 pounds of a dog’s body weight. Cats can receive

up to ⅛ teaspoon daily. Do not administer wormwood internally for more than three consecutive days. Wormwood

has an extremely bitter flavor, making it a difficult herb to use. To ease the process of getting it into a hissing cat or

tight-lipped dog, the powder or tincture can be placed in a small gel capsule and wrapped with cheese, meat, or other

special treat. Externally, wormwood is an effective skin rinse (see chapter 1) for bacterial or fungal infections of the

skin, including various forms of dermatophytosis.

要使用艾草，每只体重 30 磅的狗每天可在进餐时服用最多 1/4 茶匙干药草粉或约 ⅛ 茶匙（0.5 毫升）低

酒精酊剂。猫每天最多可以摄入 ⅛ 茶匙。不要连续三天以上内服艾草。艾草味极苦，是一种很难使用的草

药。为了简化将其放入发出嘶嘶声的猫或守口如瓶的狗体内的过程，可以将粉末或酊剂放入小凝胶胶囊

中，并用奶酪、肉或其他特殊食物包裹起来。外用时，艾草是一种有效的皮肤冲洗剂（参见第 1 章），可

治疗皮肤细菌或真菌感染，包括各种形式的皮肤癣菌病。

Availability: Wormwood is available through herb retailers. Plants and seeds are available from nurseries that

specialize in herbs.

可用性：艾草可通过药草零售商购买。植物和种子可从专门种植草药的苗圃中获得。

Propagation and Harvest: Wormwood is easy to grow, requiring average soil, full sunlight, and only occasional

watering. It is hardy northward to central Canada, and plants often live in excess of ten years. The leaves can be

harvested anytime, but they are most potent when gathered on a hot summer afternoon.

繁殖和收获：艾草很容易生长，需要普通的土壤，充足的阳光，只需偶尔浇水。它向北到加拿大中部地区

耐寒，植物的寿命通常超过十年。叶子可以随时采收，但在炎热的夏日午后采收时效果最强。

=== PAGE 331 ===
Artemesia absinthum

苦艾

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For intestinal parasites, garlic, pumpkin seeds, black walnut hulls, sage, thyme, and

Oregon grape all serve as effective and safer substitutes. For infections of the skin, wormwood combines with

calendula, gotu kola, or aloe. Sage serves similar purposes as a topical antimicrobial.

替代品和辅助剂：对于肠道寄生虫，大蒜、南瓜子、黑胡桃壳、鼠尾草、百里香和俄勒冈葡萄都是有效且

更安全的替代品。对于皮肤感染，艾草与金盏花、雷公根或芦荟结合使用。鼠尾草作为局部抗菌剂具有类

似的用途。

Cautions and Comments: The volatile oil thujone, which may be present in alcohol extractions of this plant, can be

damaging to the liver, kidneys, and nervous system if used excessively. Alcohol preparations of this herb should

never be used in animals who suffer from seizures, kidney problems, or liver disease. Wormwood is generally safe

when used in dried herb form, or when prepared without alcohol in the form of water infusions (teas) or as a

glycerite. However, all forms are best avoided in pregnant or lactating animals.

注意事项和评论：这种植物的酒精提取物中可能存在挥发油侧柏酮，如果过度使用，可能会损害肝脏、肾

脏和神经系统。这种草药的酒精制剂绝对不能用于患有癫痫、肾脏问题或肝脏疾病的动物。当以干药草形

式使用时，或以不含酒精的水浸剂（茶）或甘油酯形式制备时，艾草通常是安全的。然而，怀孕或哺乳期

动物最好避免使用所有形式的药物。

=== PAGE 332 ===
YARROW

西洋蓍草

Achillea millefolium

蓍草

Sunflower Family

向日葵家族

Appearance: Yarrow is characterized by its flat-topped terminal clusters of small white to pinkish white flowers

and its alternate, finely dissected, featherlike leaves (millefolium translates to “thousand-leafed”). The entire plant is

strongly aromatic, with a pungency much like that of mothballs. Stems are often woolly haired. Several cultivars of

yarrow have been developed for the floral industry, and many have escaped cultivation. These plants are usually not

as cold hardy as their wild cousins and can be identified by their yellow, peach, or red flowers.

外观：西洋蓍草的特征是它的平顶顶生簇状小白色到粉红色白色花朵和其交替的、精细解剖的羽毛状叶子

（millefolium 翻译为“千叶”）。整个植物有浓郁的芳香，带有类似樟脑丸的辛辣味。茎常被毛。一些西洋

蓍草品种已被开发用于花卉产业，但许多品种已不再种植。这些植物通常不像它们的野生近亲那样耐寒，

可以通过黄色、桃色或红色的花朵来识别。

Habitat and Range: Yarrow is a native of Asia that has made itself at home throughout the northern hemisphere

from sea level to above the timberline. The density of plant populations increases as one travels north through the

western U.S.

栖息地和分布范围：西洋蓍草原产于亚洲，在从海平面到林线以上的整个北半球都安家落户。当你向北穿

过美国西部时，植物种群的密度就会增加。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that often remains in bloom throughout the spring and summer

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，通常在整个春季和夏季保持开花

Parts Used: Flowers, leaves, and stems

使用部位：花、叶、茎

Primary Medicinal Activities: Antiseptic, analgesic, dilates blood vessels, promotes sweating, expectorant, anti-

inflammatory, stops bleeding, tonic, lowers blood pressure, fever reducing (febrifuge), insect repellent, expels

worms

主要药理作用：抗菌、镇痛、扩张血管、发汗、祛痰、抗炎、止血、滋补、降血压、退热、驱虫、驱虫

Strongest Affinities: Circulatory and respiratory systems, urinary and digestive tracts, skin

最强的亲和力：循环和呼吸系统、泌尿道和消化道、皮肤

Preparation: Dry or fresh herb, tea, tincture, or oil infusion

制备：干或新鲜药草、茶、酊剂或油浸剂

=== PAGE 333 ===
Common Uses: Yarrow is one of the most versatile and well-known herbs in nature’s apothecary. In ancient

Europe, yarrow was known as “wound wort” by warriors who used the plant (presumably for their horses as well as

themselves) to stop bleeding and disinfect wounds on the battlefield. The genus name, Achillea, is derived from the

name of the ancient Greek warrior Achilles.

常见用途：西洋蓍草是自然界药剂师中用途最广泛、最知名的草药之一。在古代欧洲，西洋蓍草被战士们

称为“伤口麦芽汁”，他们在战场上使用这种植物（大概是为了他们的马和他们自己）来止血和消毒伤口。

属名 Achillea 源自古希腊战士阿喀琉斯的名字。

The powder or poultice of the dried or fresh plant is useful for treating less deliberate open wounds such as a

barbed wire cut or a foot pad laceration caused by a broken bottle. To effectively stop bleeding and inhibit bacteria,

simply crush the herb as finely as possible and apply it directly to the wound. A cooled tea of the plant can be used

as a pain- and itch-relieving antiseptic skin rinse, and the aromatic nature of the plant may be of help in repelling

fleas, mosquitoes, and biting flies.

干燥或新鲜植物的粉末或膏剂可用于治疗不太故意的开放性伤口，例如铁丝网割伤或由破碎的瓶子引起

的脚垫撕裂伤。为了有效止血和抑制细菌，只需将草药尽可能粉碎并直接涂在伤口上即可。该植物的冷却

茶可用作止痛和止痒的消毒皮肤冲洗液，该植物的芳香性质可能有助于驱除跳蚤、蚊子和叮咬苍蝇。

Yarrow is a unique peripheral vasodilator and vascular tonic. When taken internally, the flavonoid constituents of

yarrow act to dilate and strengthen peripheral blood vessels and help clear away small blood clots, thus increasing

circulation to the skin and extremities. Combined with this are anti-inflammatory qualities, making yarrow helpful

for problems such as arthritis, navicular syndrome in horses, and severe cases of dermatitis in which peripheral

circulation has been impaired by inflammation. It is also useful for subcutaneous blood clots of the ears and the skin,

especially when internal doses of the tincture are used simultaneously with external applications of an oil infusion.

西洋蓍草是一种独特的外周血管扩张剂和血管补品。内服时，西洋蓍草的类黄酮成分可以扩张和强化外

周血管，帮助清除小血栓，从而增加皮肤和四肢的循环。除此之外，西洋蓍草还具有抗炎作用，有助于治

疗关节炎、马舟骨综合症以及因炎症损害外周循环的严重皮炎等问题。它对于耳朵和皮肤的皮下血栓也很

有用，特别是当内服酊剂与外用油输液同时使用时。

In the urinary tract, a yarrow tea or tincture serves as a bacteriostatic agent in the treatment of chronic or acute

cystitis. It is useful in the early stage of a kidney infection. In the lungs, yarrow’s bacteriostatic and expectorant

properties help the body in its effort to eliminate invading microbes and other foreign bodies. At the same time, the

herb dilates and tonifies respiratory blood vessels to improve pulmonary efficiency. Because of this remarkable

combination of activities, yarrow is among the first herbs we reach for in cases of pneumonia. Yarrow also may be

beneficial for racehorses who suffer from hemorrhagic pulmonary edema (bleeding from the respiratory tract) as a

result of too much strenuous exercise.

在泌尿道中，西洋蓍草茶或酊剂可作为治疗慢性或急性膀胱炎的抑菌剂。它在肾脏感染的早期阶段很有

用。在肺部，西洋蓍草的抑菌和祛痰特性有助于身体消除入侵的微生物和其他异物。同时，该草药可以扩

张和强化呼吸道血管，以提高肺部效率。由于这种显着的活性组合，西洋蓍草是我们治疗肺炎时首先使用

的草药之一。欧蓍草还可能对因过度剧烈运动而患有出血性肺水肿（呼吸道出血）的赛马有益。

In the digestive tract, yarrow is marginally effective at expelling worms and is useful for inflammations, bleeding,

and bacterial infections of the stomach and colon. The bitter principles stimulate digestion and appetite. And yarrow

is well known among herbalists as a fever-reducing remedy. It is especially effective when taken as a tea at the onset

of a fever.

在消化道中，西洋蓍草驱虫效果有限，对治疗胃和结肠的炎症、出血和细菌感染也有帮助。苦味成分能

刺激消化和食欲。西洋蓍草作为一种退烧药物在草药学家中广为人知。在发烧时作为茶饮用尤其有效。

Scientists once thought that yarrow’s therapeutic qualities were chiefly attributable to tannins and a volatile oil

called azulene. The chemical makeup of yarrow is extremely complex, however, and recent studies have found that

the plant contains sterols and various other compounds that possess a much wider range of medicinal activities than

originally thought. One study suggests that yarrow may be a useful antitumor agent and may play an active role in

the treatment of certain types of leukemia.

科学家曾经认为西洋蓍草的治疗功效主要归因于单宁酸和一种名为甘菊环的挥发油。然而，西洋蓍草的

=== PAGE 334 ===
化学组成极其复杂，最近的研究发现，该植物含有甾醇和各种其他化合物，其药用活性范围比最初想象的

要广泛得多。一项研究表明，西洋蓍草可能是一种有用的抗肿瘤剂，并可能在治疗某些类型的白血病中发

挥积极作用。

To use yarrow internally in dogs and cats, a tincture is usually preferable over a tea because the herb is bitter and

hard to feed in appreciable quantities. For dogs, about ¼ teaspoon (1 milliliter) of the tincture can be fed for each 30

pounds of an animal’s body weight, two to three times daily. Cats and similar-sized animals need only ⅛ teaspoon

twice daily. Horses and other large herbivores can be allowed to eat the plants from their pastures as they wish, or

they can be fed 1 ounce of the dried herb as part of their daily ration.

为了给狗和猫内服西洋蓍草，酊剂通常比茶更好，因为这种药草很苦，很难大量喂食。对于狗来说，每

30 磅体重的动物可以喂食约 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升）的酊剂，每天 2 至 3 次。猫和类似体型的动物每天两次只需

⅛ 茶匙。马和其他大型食草动物可以随意食用牧场上的植物，也可以将 1 盎司干草本植物作为日常口粮的

一部分喂给它们。

Achillea millefolium

蓍草

Availability: Yarrow is a widely distributed weed that is also available through herb retailers and nurseries.

可用性：西洋蓍草是一种分布广泛的杂草，也可以通过药草零售商和苗圃购买。

Propagation and Harvest: Yarrow is easy to grow from seed or transplants. True yarrow (A. millefolium) is hardy

down to at least -30° F and is drought tolerant as well. The yellow and hybrid varieties (of which there are several

colors) are less hardy but are still easy to grow in most areas of North America. Moderately rich, slightly acid soil

and full sun yields healthy plants, which usually don’t bloom until their second year of growth. Harvest the upper

third of the flowering plant (stems, leaves, and flowers) in midsummer on a dry, warm day— this is when the

highest concentration of active constituents are found in the plant.

繁殖和收获：西洋蓍草很容易通过种子或移植来生长。真正的西洋蓍草 (A. millefolium) 能耐受至少 -30° F

=== PAGE 335 ===
的温度，并且也耐旱。黄色和杂交品种（有多种颜色）的耐寒性较差，但在北美大部分地区仍然很容易种

植。中等肥沃、微酸性的土壤和充足的阳光会产生健康的植物，通常要到生长的第二年才会开花。在仲夏

干燥温暖的日子里收获开花植物的上三分之一（茎、叶和花）——此时植物中活性成分的浓度最高。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: To stop bleeding, nothing compares with a first aid powder made from a fifty-fifty mix

of dried yarrow and cayenne. For situations requiring a vascular tonic or peripheral vasodilator, yarrow combines

well with garlic, cayenne, ginkgo, hawthorn, or ginger.

替代品和辅助剂：为了止血，没有什么比用干西洋蓍草和辣椒混合制成的急救粉更好的了。对于需要血管

补品或外周血管扩张剂的情况，西洋蓍草与大蒜、辣椒、银杏、山楂或生姜可以很好地结合。

For urinary tract infections, marshmallow, couch grass, horsetail, echinacea, and Oregon grape combine well with

yarrow. For infections of the digestive tract, combine yarrow with Oregon grape. For topical treatment of

inflammations and infections of the skin, consider sage, rosemary, calendula, chamomile, and juniper as adjuncts or

alternatives. For topical treatment of closed injuries, yarrow combines especially well with arnica.

对于尿路感染，棉花糖、茅草、木贼、紫锥花和俄勒冈葡萄与西洋蓍草搭配效果很好。对于消化道感

染，将西洋蓍草与俄勒冈葡萄混合。对于皮肤炎症和感染的局部治疗，可以考虑使用鼠尾草、迷迭香、金

盏花、洋甘菊和杜松作为辅助剂或替代品。对于闭合性损伤的局部治疗，西洋蓍草与山金车的结合特别

好。

Cautions and Comments: Allergic reactions to yarrow are fairly common, and the volatile oils of the plant may

cause dermatitis when they are applied to the skin of sensitive animals. This plant contains thujone, a substance that

is poorly water soluble but may be present in alcohol extractions of the herb. Any herb preparation that contains

appreciable amounts of thujone has a potential of being toxic, especially if large quantities are consumed over an

extended period of time (meaning that moderation is the key to safe long-term use). Like most herbs that are rich

with volatile oils, yarrow should be used with caution in pregnant or lactating animals, as these constituents have

been shown to cross the placenta to the fetus and are known to have stimulant effects upon the uterus if they are

ingested in sufficiently large quantities.

注意事项和评论：对西洋蓍草的过敏反应相当常见，当将植物的挥发油涂在敏感动物的皮肤上时，可能会

引起皮炎。这种植物含有侧柏酮，这是一种水溶性较差的物质，但可能存在于该草药的醇提取物中。任何

含有大量侧柏酮的草药制剂都可能有毒，尤其是在长时间内大量食用的情况下（这意味着适量是安全长期

使用的关键）。与大多数富含挥发油的草药一样，西洋蓍草在怀孕或哺乳期动物中应谨慎使用，因为这些

成分已被证明可以穿过胎盘到达胎儿，并且已知如果在怀孕或哺乳期动物摄入这些成分，会对子宫产生刺

激作用。足够大的数量。

YELLOW DOCK

黄色码头

Rumex crispus

酸模

Buckwheat Family

荞麦家族

Appearance: Yellow dock is a hearty perennial that may grow up to 5 feet. The elongated lance-shaped leaves at

the base of the plant grow up to 12 inches long and 4 inches wide. The leaves are often curled at their margins

(hence another common name for the plant: curly dock). The alternate stem leaves are smaller but more numerous.

The single stout stem is often red and bears long clusters of small, greenish white flowers above the rest of the plant.

As the flowers mature and dry, they turn a rust-red color that often stands in bold contrast to the surrounding flora.

外观：黄坞是一种茂盛的多年生植物，可长至 5 英尺。植物基部细长的矛状叶子长至 12 英寸，宽 4 英寸。

叶子的边缘通常卷曲（因此该植物的另一个俗名是：卷曲码头）。互生的茎叶较小但数量较多。单根粗壮

的茎通常是红色的，在植物的其余部分上方开有长簇的绿色白色小花。当花朵成熟并干燥时，它们会变成

铁锈红色，通常与周围的植物形成鲜明的对比。

Habitat and Range: Widely distributed in disturbed areas throughout North America. The entire Rumex genus is

imported from Europe.

栖息地和分布范围：广泛分布于整个北美受干扰的地区。整个酸模属都是从欧洲进口的。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial that blooms May through August

周期和开花季节：多年生植物，五月至八月开花

Parts Used: Roots

使用部位：根部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Stimulates bile production, helps with blood cleansing, laxative, antimicrobial,

nutritive

主要药用活性：刺激胆汁产生，帮助血液净化，通便，抗菌，营养

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract, skin, and liver

最强的亲和力：消化道、皮肤和肝脏

Preparation: Tincture, tea, and dried root

准备：酊剂、茶、干根

Common Uses: Yellow dock is well described as a quick-cleansing herb. The root contains a combination of

anthraquinone, small amounts of oxalic acid and oxalates, and other constituents that stimulate liver function and

=== PAGE 337 ===
contractions of intestinal smooth muscles (peristalsis). In effect, the body is prompted to work harder at eliminating

waste from the bloodstream and digestive tract. This makes yellow dock especially useful for treating chronic or

acute dermatitis that may be attributable to toxic excesses and elimination deficiencies in the body. It is also

beneficial in treating rheumatoid arthritis that is secondary to similar circumstances. Because of its ability to quickly

flush the body of systemic waste, yellow dock is sometimes used in the herbal treatment of cancer. Because the root

is extremely high in iron, it is considered a traditional remedy for anemia.

常见用途：黄坞被描述为一种快速清洁的草药。根部含有蒽醌、少量草酸和草酸盐以及刺激肝功能和肠道

平滑肌收缩（蠕动）的其他成分的组合。实际上，身体会更加努力地清除血液和消化道中的废物。这使得

黄坞特别适用于治疗慢性或急性皮炎，这些皮炎可能是由于体内有毒物质过量和消除不足所致。它还有益

于治疗继发于类似情况的类风湿性关节炎。由于它能够快速冲洗体内的系统废物，黄坞有时被用于癌症的

草药治疗。由于根部铁含量极高，因此被认为是治疗贫血的传统药物。

Yellow dock is effective when used within the parameters we have just described. It is somewhat of a “heroic

remedy,” an herb that forces quick, dramatic responses in the body, much like an allopathic drug. Therefore, its use

in the holistic care of animals should be limited to short-term applications at the onset of detoxification therapies that

are focused on long-term holistic results. Alternatively, it can be used as a potentiating adjunct in combination with

tonic herbs such as burdock, dandelion, red clover, slippery elm, and alfalfa. Using yellow dock as a symptomatic

quick fix (such as for constipation) amounts to little more than substituting an herb for a drug.

在我们刚刚描述的参数范围内使用时，黄色码头是有效的。它在某种程度上是一种“英雄疗法”，是一种

能够迫使身体产生快速、剧烈反应的草药，就像一种对抗疗法药物一样。因此，其在动物整体护理中的使

用应仅限于在注重长期整体效果的解毒疗法开始时的短期应用。或者，它可以与牛蒡、蒲公英、红三叶

草、滑榆和苜蓿等滋补草药结合使用，作为增强佐剂。使用黄坞作为症状的快速解决方案（例如便秘）无

异于用草药代替药物。

Externally, yellow dock can be used as an itch-relieving, alterative skin rinse or poultice in the treatment of skin

disorders such as seborrhea, pyoderma, and contact dermatitis. To use yellow dock internally, consult your holistic

veterinarian.

外用时，黄坞可用作止痒、替代性皮肤冲洗剂或膏剂，用于治疗皮脂溢、脓皮病和接触性皮炎等皮肤

病。要内部使用黄色码头，请咨询您的整体兽医。

Availability: A widely distributed weed. Available through herb retailers and seed catalogs that specialize in

medicinal plants.

可用性：一种广泛分布的杂草。可通过药草零售商和专门从事药用植物的种子目录购买。

Rumex crispus

酸模

Propagation and Harvest: Yellow dock is easy to grow once it’s established, but the seeds can remain dormant in

the soil for several years before germinating. However, the plants grow in just about any soil and need little care.

The roots are dug in fall after the plant has gone to seed and the leaves have begun to die back for winter.

繁殖和收获：黄坞一旦建立就很容易生长，但种子在发芽前可以在土壤中休眠数年。然而，这些植物几乎

可以在任何土壤中生长，几乎不需要照顾。秋天植物结籽后挖根，叶子开始枯死过冬。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For situations that require stimulation of the liver, consider dandelion root and Oregon

grape as less “heroic” alternatives. For anemia, yellow dock combines well, in proportionately small amounts, with

alfalfa, garlic, red clover, spirulina, and nettle.

替代品和辅助品：对于需要刺激肝脏的情况，可以考虑蒲公英根和俄勒冈葡萄作为不那么“英雄”的替代

品。对于贫血，黄坞可以与苜蓿、大蒜、红三叶草、螺旋藻和荨麻搭配使用，但用量要适量。

Cautions and Comments: Even though yellow dock is a much gentler laxative than most herbs that contain

considerable amounts of anthraquinones, yellow dock should not be used in situations involving either intestinal

bleeding or preexisting obstructions such as intestinal tumors. When it is used in moderation, yellow dock is quite

safe, but excessive use of the herb is likely to result in intestinal cramping, diarrhea, and vomiting, and it may lead to

laxative dependency. Like all stimulant laxatives, yellow dock should not be used during pregnancy.

注意和评论：尽管黄坞是一种比大多数含有大量蒽醌的草药更温和的泻药，但黄坞不应用于涉及肠道出血

或已有阻塞（如肠道肿瘤）的情况。适量使用黄坞是相当安全的，但过量使用该草药可能会导致肠痉挛、

腹泻和呕吐，并可能导致泻药依赖。与所有刺激性泻药一样，怀孕期间不应使用黄坞。

YUCCA

丝兰

Yucca schidigera

丝兰

Lily Family

百合家族

Appearance: Although argument exists among botanists over yucca’s specific family classification, yucca is not a

cactus. Essentially, “old scholars” consider yucca a member of Agavaceae, the agave family, while current botanists

refer to yucca as a member of Liliaceae, the Lily family. We opt for the latter. Once you see yucca’s beautiful

cream-colored flower clusters, you will likely agree that it’s a lily. The showy 1- to 3-inch flowers are presented in

dense clusters atop a proportionately tall central stalk.

外观：虽然植物学家对丝兰的具体科分类存在争议，但丝兰不是仙人掌。本质上，“老学者”认为丝兰是龙

舌兰科的成员，而现代植物学家则将丝兰视为百合科的成员。我们选择后者。一旦您看到丝兰美丽的米色

花簇，您可能会同意它是百合。艳丽的 1 至 3 英寸的花朵密集地簇拥在比例较高的中央花茎上。

The rest of the plant is characterized by its sharply pointed, swordlike leaves. The various species differ primarily

by their size, but the most distinguishable of them is Y. brevifolia, commonly called Joshua tree, which grows up to

20 feet tall. This large yucca is an inhabitant of the high southwestern deserts of Arizona, Nevada, western New

Mexico, and especially California, where it is protected by law. Most yucca species, however, share similar

appearances with Y. schidigera (Mojave yucca), a long-leafed variety that grows as a 1- to 6-foot-high clump of

pain-inflicting puncturing green swords.

该植物其余部分的特点是其尖锐的剑状叶子。各种物种的主要区别在于它们的大小，但其中最明显的是

短叶 Y. brevifolia，通常称为约书亚树，可长到 20 英尺高。这种大型丝兰是亚利桑那州、内华达州、新墨

西哥州西部，尤其是加利福尼亚州西南高沙漠的居民，在那里它受到法律保护。然而，大多数丝兰物种与

Y. schidigera（莫哈韦丝兰）具有相似的外观，Y. schidigera 是一种长叶品种，生长为 1 至 6 英尺高的丛生

刺痛的绿色剑。

Habitat and Range: Yucca schidigera’s natural habitats are the dry coastal canyons of California and the inland

deserts of the western U.S. This is the primary variety of commerce, and it is widely harvested and marketed by the

natural products and landscape industries.

栖息地和范围：丝兰的自然栖息地是加利福尼亚州干燥的沿海峡谷和美国西部的内陆沙漠。这是主要的商

业品种，被天然产品和景观行业广泛收获和销售。

Several other species of yucca range throughout the deserts and plains of North America. Although most of us

associate plants such as yucca with hot, dry desert environments, the true definition of desert pertains only to rainfall

limitations, and various species of yucca have adapted to dramatically contrasting temperatures. For example, Y.

glauca (small soapweed) thrives in many areas of the northern plains states and Canada, where summers are

excruciatingly hot and dry, but winters are subarctic in average temperature.

其他几种丝兰遍布北美的沙漠和平原。尽管我们大多数人将丝兰等植物与炎热、干燥的沙漠环境联系在

一起，但沙漠的真正定义仅与降雨量限制有关，并且各种丝兰已经适应了截然不同的温度。例如，Y.

glauca（小皂草）在北部平原各州和加拿大的许多地区繁衍生息，那里的夏季极其炎热干燥，但冬季的平均

气温却处于亚北极水平。

Cycle and Bloom Season: A perennial, yucca’s bloom frequency and duration depend largely on available

=== PAGE 340 ===
precipitation. Cultivated plants may bloom once every one to three years, while wild plants may remain dormant for

decades.

周期和开花季节：丝兰是多年生植物，其开花频率和持续时间很大程度上取决于可用的降水量。栽培植物

可能每一到三年开花一次，而野生植物可能会休眠数十年。

Parts Used: Roots

使用部位：根部

Primary Medicinal Activities: Nutritive, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor

主要药用活性：营养、抗炎和抗肿瘤

Strongest Affinities: Digestive tract, musculoskeletal system

最强的亲和力：消化道、肌肉骨骼系统

Preparation: Chopped and dried herb or tincture

准备：切碎并干燥的草药或酊剂

Common Uses: Yucca contains notable quantities of vitamin C, beta-carotene, calcium, iron, magnesium,

manganese, niacin, phosphorus, protein, and B vitamins, but its greater healing powers are chiefly attributable to its

impressive content of saponin compounds. Saponins are a group of soaplike plant glycosides that are characterized

by their tendency to dramatically foam up when agitated with water. While dozens of saponins are present in

hundreds of useful plants, two root-borne saponins stand out among others as yucca’s primary active constituents:

sarsasapogenin and smilagenin. These two compounds are irritating, cleansing, and penetrating to the mucous

membranes of the small intestine. It is theorized that these actions aid in the assimilation of important minerals and

vitamins by allowing increased passage of critical nutrients through the intestinal walls. This in turn optimizes the

nutritional value of an animal’s food.

常见用途：丝兰含有大量的维生素 C、β-胡萝卜素、钙、铁、镁、锰、烟酸、磷、蛋白质和 B 族维生素，

但其更强的治愈能力主要归功于其皂苷化合物的含量。皂苷是一组类似肥皂的植物苷，其特征是与水搅拌

时会急剧起泡。虽然数百种有用植物中存在数十种皂苷，但丝兰的主要活性成分有两种根部皂苷：菝葜皂

苷元和菝葜皂苷元。这两种化合物具有刺激性、清洁性并能渗透到小肠粘膜。从理论上讲，这些作用可以

增加关键营养物质通过肠壁的通道，从而有助于重要矿物质和维生素的吸收。这反过来又优化了动物食物

的营养价值。

Although many of the specifics of yucca’s medicinal actions remain unclear to scientists, the results of feeding

yucca can be astounding. In studies conducted at Colorado State University, cattle who received a small quantity of

yucca in their feed showed greater weight gain than those who didn’t. Other trial accounts have concluded that

chickens who are fed yucca have a tendency to lay more eggs, and dairy cattle tend to produce more milk.

尽管科学家们仍不清楚丝兰药用作用的许多细节，但喂养丝兰的结果可能令人震惊。在科罗拉多州立大

学进行的研究中，在饲料中添加少量丝兰的牛比没有添加丝兰的牛体重增加得更多。其他试验报告得出的

结论是，喂食丝兰的鸡往往会产更多的鸡蛋，而奶牛往往会产更多的牛奶。

Another reason you may find yucca in dog, cat, horse, or cattle feed is because it has been found to reduce the

emission of unpleasant odors in urine and feces. In studies that examined the chemical breakdown of urea (the

body’s final by-product of digested proteins), it was found that the anhydrous ammonia that is largely responsible

for the less-than-delightful odor of animal excrement is caused by a single microbial enzyme called urease. Further

studies concluded that food supplements of Y. schidigera inhibit the production of urease, and as a result, fecal and

urine odors are reduced by up to 56 percent in dogs and 49 percent in cats. Believe it or not, this attribute has

brought about tremendous market appeal for yucca, as millions of people find the notion of less offensive animal

waste an attractive alternative to promptly cleaning it up. The holistic question is, What are the deeper purposes of

=== PAGE 341 ===
the urease enzymes we wish to suppress? Urease is a natural by-product of a natural metabolic process, and we can

only speculate about the long-term results of our interference. People who accept this concept without question

simply don’t realize (or don’t care) that poor-quality proteins produce excess urea and larger, more offensive stools.

If an animal is fed a balanced natural diet, excess fecal and urine odor shouldn’t occur.

您可能在狗、猫、马或牛饲料中发现丝兰的另一个原因是，它被发现可以减少尿液和粪便中难闻气味的

散发。在检查尿素（人体消化蛋白质的最终副产品）化学分解的研究中发现，无水氨是动物粪便中难闻气

味的主要原因，它是由一种微生物酶引起的称为脲酶。进一步的研究得出结论，Y. schidigera 的食品补充剂

可抑制脲酶的产生，因此，狗的粪便和尿液气味减少了 56%，猫的粪便和尿液气味减少了 49%。不管你相

信与否，这一属性为丝兰带来了巨大的市场吸引力，因为数百万人发现，减少攻击性的动物粪便是一种有

吸引力的替代方案，可以迅速清理它。整体问题是，我们希望抑制的脲酶的更深层次目的是什么？脲酶是

自然代谢过程的天然副产品，我们只能推测我们干扰的长期结果。毫无疑问地接受这一概念的人根本没有

意识到（或不在乎）劣质蛋白质会产生过量的尿素和更大、更难闻的粪便。如果给动物喂食均衡的天然饮

食，就不会出现过多的粪便和尿液气味。

Yucca schidigera

丝兰

Although much of yucca’s nutritive value is likely attributable to its actions upon the intestinal membranes, the

mystique surrounding this plant’s impressive track record as a medicine becomes much clearer when we take a close

look at its active ingredients. Sarsasapogenin and smilagenin are known by the scientific and herbal community as

phytosterols, or more specifically steroidal saponins, which are compounds that act as precursors to the

corticosteroids naturally produced in the body. Both of these compounds are extracted from yucca and various other

herbs as starter substances in the production of pharmaceutical corticosteroid drugs. If this sounds ominous to those

of you who are seeking natural alternatives to such drugs, please rest assured.

尽管丝兰的大部分营养价值可能归因于其对肠膜的作用，但当我们仔细研究其活性成分时，这种植物作

为药物的令人印象深刻的记录的神秘性就变得更加清晰。菝葜皂苷元和异菝葜皂苷元被科学和草药界称为

植物甾醇，或更具体地说是甾体皂苷，它们是体内自然产生的皮质类固醇的前体化合物。这两种化合物都

=== PAGE 342 ===
是从丝兰和各种其他草药中提取的，作为皮质类固醇药物生产中的起始物质。如果这对于那些正在寻求此

类药物的天然替代品的人来说听起来不祥，请放心。

The differences between a phytosterol and a synthetic steroid drug are extreme. The process by which

phytosterols are used to manufacture pharmaceutical steroids starts with a simple plant compound and proceeds

from there into a complex scientific process that would have given Einstein a headache. Comparing yucca to a

corticosteroid drug is like comparing a single chemical compound in a packet of active dry yeast with a loaf of

finished twelve-grain bread. The terms plant steroids and plant hormones are erroneous—no known plant actually

carries steroidal hormones into the body. In essence, phytosterols stimulate and assist the body in using and

producing its own corticosteroids and corticosteroid-related hormones. Furthermore, steroidal saponins work with

the natural immune functions of the body, whereas synthetically produced counterparts such as the prescription drug

prednisolone are designed and introduced into the body with the intent of suppressing immune functions to attain the

desired results.

植物甾醇和合成类固醇药物之间的差异是巨大的。植物甾醇用于制造药用类固醇的过程从一种简单的植

物化合物开始，然后进入一个复杂的科学过程，这会让爱因斯坦头疼。将丝兰与皮质类固醇药物进行比较

就像将一包活性干酵母中的单一化合物与一条成品十二粒面包进行比较。植物类固醇和植物激素这两个术

语是错误的——没有一种已知的植物实际上将类固醇激素带入体内。从本质上讲，植物甾醇刺激并协助身

体使用和产生自身的皮质类固醇和皮质类固醇相关激素。此外，甾体皂苷与人体的天然免疫功能一起发挥

作用，而合成生产的对应物（例如处方药泼尼松龙）的设计并引入体内的目的是抑制免疫功能，以达到预

期的效果。

Although this theory has not been proven as fact by the scientific community, it can be reasonably hypothesized

that the natural corticosteroid-like actions of yucca may play a role in the body’s natural production of growth

hormones. This in turn may contribute significantly to the accelerated growth and production we see in animals who

receive this plant in their food. We do know, however, that yucca is safe when fed in moderation.

尽管这一理论尚未被科学界证实为事实，但可以合理地假设丝兰的天然皮质类固醇样作用可能在人体自

然产生生长激素中发挥作用。这反过来可能对我们在食物中摄入这种植物的动物的加速生长和生产做出重

大贡献。然而，我们确实知道，适量食用丝兰是安全的。

A water extract (tea) of Y. glauca (small soapweed) has been shown to have antitumor activity against certain

melanomas in mice. Its mechanism in this context is believed to stem from polysaccharide constituents, not

necessarily steroidal saponins.

Y. glauca（小肥皂草）的水提取物（茶）已被证明对小鼠的某些黑色素瘤具有抗肿瘤活性。在这方面，

其机制被认为源于多糖成分，而不一定是甾体皂苷。

In a study conducted at the beginning of the twentieth century, the “saponin extract” from the “desert yucca plant”

was found to bring about safe and effective relief from pain and inflammation in human arthritis patients who were

given the extract four times daily over an extended period. Although this study has been repeatedly discredited by

the American Arthritis Foundation because of the controversial manner in which it was conducted, the beneficial

effects of yucca in humans and animals remain clearly validated in the minds of holistic practitioners who have used

it repeatedly and have witnessed positive results. Several contemporary naturopaths, veterinarians, and animal

nutritionists who use yucca in their practices claim that yucca has a 50 to 80 percent success rate in bringing relief to

patients suffering from either osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis. Again, yucca’s effectiveness here is likely

attributable to the plant’s nutrition-assisting and anti-inflammatory actions of its steroidal saponin constituents.

二十世纪初进行的一项研究发现，来自“沙漠丝兰植物”的“皂苷提取物”可以安全有效地缓解人类关节炎患

者的疼痛和炎症，每天服用该提取物四次以上。较长的一段时间。尽管这项研究因其进行方式有争议而多

次遭到美国关节炎基金会的质疑，但丝兰对人类和动物的有益作用在反复使用丝兰并见证了积极效果的整

体实践者的心目中仍然得到了明确的证实。结果。几位在实践中使用丝兰的当代自然疗法师、兽医和动物

营养学家声称，丝兰在缓解骨关节炎或类风湿性关节炎患者的症状方面有 50% 至 80% 的成功率。同样，丝

兰在这里的功效可能归因于该植物的甾体皂苷成分的营养辅助和抗炎作用。

To stimulate appetite and increase absorption of nutrients or to relieve the pain and inflammation of arthritis, add

a ½ teaspoon of the dried and powdered root to each pound of a dog’s daily food ration. Cats need only ¼ teaspoon

daily. If you opt to use a tincture, find or make one that contains less than 5 percent alcohol because high-alcohol

preparations of this herb may nauseate animals. A good tincture dose is about ⅛ teaspoon (0.5 milliliter) for each 20

pounds of an animal’s body weight, once daily before a meal. Half a cup of the dried, chopped root is a sufficient

=== PAGE 343 ===
daily dose for horses and other large animals.

为了刺激食欲并增加营养吸收或缓解关节炎的疼痛和炎症，请在狗的每磅每日食物配给中添加 1/2 茶匙干

燥的粉末状根。猫每天只需要 ¼ 茶匙。如果您选择使用酊剂，请找到或制作酒精含量低于 5% 的酊剂，因

为这种草药的高酒精制剂可能会使动物感到恶心。酊剂的最佳剂量为每 20 磅动物体重约 ⅛ 茶匙（0.5 毫

升），每日一次，饭前服用。对于马和其他大型动物来说，半杯干燥、切碎的根就足够了。

Availability: Herb retailers and landscape nurseries

可用性：药草零售商和景观苗圃

Propagation and Harvest: Because of their moderate size, attractive flowers and foliage, and low water and

maintenance requirements, Y. schidigera and Y. glauca have become popular as landscape plants in areas with

moderate temperatures and low to moderate precipitation. These plants do well in depleted soils, and once

established they require little care.

繁殖和收获：由于其大小适中、花朵和叶子有吸引力、水分和维护要求低，Y. schidigera 和 Y. glauca 在温

度适中、低至中等降水量的地区作为景观植物而广受欢迎。这些植物在贫瘠的土壤中生长良好，一旦生长

就不需要太多照顾。

Alternatives and Adjuncts: For arthritis, yucca combines well with alfalfa, licorice, dandelion, or shepherd’s purse.

替代品和辅助品：对于关节炎，丝兰与苜蓿、甘草、蒲公英或荠菜完美搭配。

Cautions and Comments: If used in large dosages or over an extended period of time, yucca may become irritating

to the stomach lining and intestinal mucosa, which may cause vomiting. This problem can be especially dangerous

in horses and other large animals who are unable to vomit (instead they bloat). Many Indian tribes of the American

Southwest used yucca preparations to induce vomiting in cases of food poisoning. For this reason we would not use

any food additive that contains in excess of 15 percent yucca root unless instructed to do so by a veterinarian or

trained animal nutritionist. We do not recommend feeding yucca every day in an animal’s diet either; rather, give the

animal at least a two-day break from the herb each week. Many holistic practitioners believe that if the plant is used

constantly over an extended period of time, the saponins in yucca actually begin to have a reverse effect, slowing

nutrient absorption (especially fat-soluble vitamins such as vitamin D) in the small intestine. Allowing breaks in

your animal’s diet helps to alleviate the possibility of a cumulative irritating effect in her digestive tract.

注意事项和评论：如果大剂量或长时间使用，丝兰可能会刺激胃壁和肠粘膜，从而导致呕吐。对于无法呕

吐（而是肿胀）的马和其他大型动物来说，这个问题尤其危险。美国西南部的许多印第安部落在食物中毒

时使用丝兰制剂来催吐。因此，我们不会使用丝兰根含量超过 15% 的任何食品添加剂，除非兽医或经过培

训的动物营养师指示这样做。我们也不建议每天在动物饮食中喂养丝兰；相反，每周至少让动物休息两

天。许多整体治疗师认为，如果长时间持续使用丝兰植物，丝兰中的皂苷实际上会开始产生相反的作用，

减缓小肠中营养物质的吸收（尤其是脂溶性维生素，如维生素 D）。允许动物的饮食中断有助于减轻其消

化道累积刺激作用的可能性。

FLEABANE

蓬

Conyza canadensis

加拿大芋

Primary Medicinal Activities: Stops bleeding, possible flea repellent

Common Uses: This common weed traditionally has been used as a broad-spectrum insecticide. The plant contains

常见用途：这种常见杂草传统上被用作广谱杀虫剂。该植物含有大量柠檬烯，这是一种以其杀跳蚤特性而

姜

Zingiber officinale

生姜

主要药用活性：排出体内气体、兴奋剂、增加排汗、导致皮肤发红

Common Uses: Indigestion (dyspepsia), flatulence, and colic. Used to increase peripheral circulation. May help in

常见用途：消化不良（消化不良）、胀气和绞痛。用于增加末梢循环。可能对某些晕动病有帮助。在小动

安全/注意事项/禁忌症：据报道，它往往会增加心肌和血管的张力（强心剂）并抑制体外血液凝固。在体内

An Herbal Repertory for Animals

动物草药库

在本章中，我们讨论动物监护人在动物整体护理中可能遇到的一些更常见的疾病。每种疾病均按其占主导

的伴侣找到治疗或治疗的解决方案。

To learn more about the herb choices we present in this chapter, and to determine whether one or more of these

not discussed here, and we urge you to also access the excellent texts included in the bibliography. This repertory is

also not intended to serve as a substitute for the advice and care of a licensed veterinarian. Its purpose only is to

express our experiences and opinions. Please keep in mind that we are herbalists, not licensed animal care providers.
