=== PAGE 391 ===
ANXIETY, NERVOUSNESS, AND BEHAVIORAL PROBLEMS

焦虑、紧张和行为问题

HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

It is part of human nature to impose our ideals of acceptable behavior upon our beloved animals. Unfortunately,

though, many of us find it difficult to separate these ideals from what makes each animal special, unique, and happy.

Thousands of animals are euthanized each year because they were “untrainable” or “uncontrollable,” “barked too

much,” or were simply “too much to bear.” Many of these animals were put to death not because there was

something untreatably wrong with them but because their identities clashed with their caregivers’.

将我们可接受的行为理想强加给我们心爱的动物是人性的一部分。但不幸的是，我们中的许多人发现很难

将这些理想与每种动物的特殊、独特和快乐分开。每年有数以千计的动物被安乐死，因为它们“无法训

练”或“无法控制”，“吠叫太多”，或者只是“难以忍受”。许多动物被处死并不是因为它们出现了无法治愈的

问题，而是因为它们的身份与照顾者的身份发生冲突。

One of the greatest gifts offered to us by animals comes when we learn to look beyond our own needs to their

happiness. Our eight-year-old shepherd/husky dog, Willow, still barks incessantly, whines obnoxiously on trips to

the river, and jumps up onto house guests despite our continuing efforts to direct her toward our needs. Sometimes

we want to pull out our own hair and tie her snout shut with it, but instead we have developed patience and respect

for her personal nature. Willow is simply doing what she must do to be complete and happy, and while we are still

working on the guest-mauling issue, we have learned to accept her just the way she is. By reaching this level of

acceptance, we have been rewarded with the joy she brings to us as we rejoice with her in her rapturous journey

through life. Granted, there is a social stigma attached to certain types of animal behavior. However, before we step

in and choose what is best for us, we owe it to our animal companions to try to look at the world through their eyes

—perhaps even before we bring one of them home.

当我们学会超越自己的需求而关注动物的幸福时，动物给予我们的最伟大的礼物之一就出现了。我们八

岁的牧羊犬/哈士奇狗威洛（Willow）仍然不停地吠叫，在河边发出令人讨厌的哀鸣，尽管我们不断努力引

导她满足我们的需求，但它仍然会跳到客人身上。有时我们想拔掉自己的头发，用它把她的鼻子绑起来，

但相反，我们对她的个性产生了耐心和尊重。威洛只是在做她必须做的事情，让她变得完整和快乐，虽然

我们仍在解决殴打客人的问题，但我们已经学会了接受她本来的样子。通过达到这种接受程度，我们就得

到了她给我们带来的快乐，因为我们在她的人生旅程中与她一起欢欣鼓舞。诚然，某些类型的动物行为存

在社会耻辱。然而，在我们介入并选择最适合我们的东西之前，我们应该感谢我们的动物伙伴，尝试通过

他们的眼睛来看待世界——也许甚至在我们把其中一只带回家之前。

=== PAGE 392 ===
We owe it to our animal companions to look at the world through their eyes.

我们应该通过我们的动物伙伴的眼睛来看待世界。

Anxiety, nervousness, fear, occasional aggression, and depression are normal emotions of each and every

animal’s life. Some animals may be terrified of thunder, cars, vets, and stairs. Others may dislike children or other

animals. Active dog breeds (such as border collies) usually need wide-open spaces to run, and they become anxious

if confined. Many cats who would rather sleep than play become nervous wrecks during car rides. But if your

animal’s behavior changes suddenly or if his nervous tendencies worsen over time, your animal may be ill.

焦虑、紧张、恐惧、偶尔的攻击性和抑郁是每只动物生活中的正常情绪。有些动物可能害怕雷声、汽

车、兽医和楼梯。其他人可能不喜欢儿童或其他动物。活跃的犬种（例如边境牧羊犬）通常需要宽敞的空

间才能奔跑，如果受到限制，它们会变得焦虑。许多宁愿睡觉也不愿玩耍的猫在乘车时会变得神经衰弱。

但如果你的动物的行为突然改变，或者随着时间的推移，他的神经倾向恶化，你的动物可能生病了。

Contrary to conventional standards, holistic treatment of anxiety, nervousness, or behavioral problems does not

begin with the use of sedative or antidepressive medicines but with a critical examination of the caregiver’s

perspective of a situation. Are we really treating anxiety or aggression, or is the problem a symptom of something

deeper within the animal or his environment? Perhaps the problem is not really the animal’s at all but instead

emanates from the caregiver’s unfulfilled expectations.

与传统标准相反，焦虑、紧张或行为问题的整体治疗并不是从使用镇静剂或抗抑郁药物开始，而是从严

格检查护理人员对情况的看法开始。我们是否真的在治疗焦虑或攻击性，或者这个问题是动物或其环境中

更深层次的症状？也许问题根本不是动物的问题，而是源于照顾者未实现的期望。

=== PAGE 393 ===
CHRONIC PROBLEMS

慢性问题

Emotional, behavioral, and nervous disorders can result from nutritional deficiencies, endocrine disease, vaccinosis,

drug side effects, parasites, neurological disease, or psychological problems. Like humans, animals can suffer from

chronic depression that is secondary to chemical imbalances in the brain. But before treating depression with Prozac

(fluoxetine HCl) or Saint-John’s-wort, you should make a thorough assessment of the animal’s diet, health care

history, and environment. In most cases, the caregiver is likely to find that the problem is correctable with dietary

changes, some loving attention, and perhaps the correct homeopathic remedy.

情绪、行为和神经障碍可能由营养缺乏、内分泌疾病、疫苗接种、药物副作用、寄生虫、神经系统疾病或

心理问题引起。和人类一样，动物也可能患有慢性抑郁症，这是继发于大脑化学物质失衡的。但在用百忧

解（盐酸氟西汀）或圣约翰草治疗抑郁症之前，您应该对动物的饮食、医疗保健史和环境进行彻底评估。

在大多数情况下，护理人员可能会发现，通过改变饮食、一些关爱，或许还有正确的顺势疗法，问题是可

以纠正的。

Our approach toward aggression, depression (which is manifested by a lack of energy, whining, separation

anxiety, to name a few symptoms), nervousness, chronic anxiety, or hyperactivity always begins with changing the

animal’s diet (usually to raw food) and supplementing it with a complement of vitamins, minerals, and EFAs. If this

does not effect a positive change, the animal should be checked by a veterinarian for underlying physiological

disorders such as thyroid or adrenal gland problems, malabsorption, tumors, parasites, or diabetes mellitus. Once the

underlying causes are identified, they can be treated with applicable herbs, homeopathic remedies, aromatherapy,

flower essences, or nutritional therapies. Behavioral training, therapeutic touch, or a few sessions with a reputable

animal communicator may also yield good results.

我们应对攻击性、抑郁（表现为缺乏精力、抱怨、分离焦虑等症状）、紧张、慢性焦虑或多动的方法总

是从改变动物的饮食（通常是生食）和补充营养开始。它富含维生素、矿物质和必需脂肪酸。如果这没有

产生积极的变化，兽医应检查动物是否存在潜在的生理疾病，例如甲状腺或肾上腺问题、吸收不良、肿

瘤、寄生虫或糖尿病。一旦确定了根本原因，就可以采用适用的草药、顺势疗法、芳香疗法、花精或营养

疗法进行治疗。行为训练、治疗性触摸或与信誉良好的动物交流者进行几次课程也可能会产生良好的效

果。

In all chronic cases, the sedative herbs (e.g., valerian, skullcap, passionflower) should be limited to temporary

control of symptoms during times of added stress such as dreaded car rides to the veterinarian. We do not condone

the use of sedative herbs on a daily lifelong basis—not only because of potential side effects but also because they

may mask symptoms that are important to recognize in reaching curative solutions. Similarly, Saint-John’s-wort and

other antidepressants should be reserved for cases in which chronic depression is known to be secondary to brain

chemical imbalances.

在所有慢性病例中，镇静草药（例如缬草、黄芩、西番莲）应仅限于在压力增加（例如可怕的乘车去看

兽医）期间暂时控制症状。我们不容忍每天终生使用镇静草药——不仅因为潜在的副作用，还因为它们可

能掩盖在达成治疗方案时需要识别的重要症状。同样，圣约翰草和其他抗抑郁药应该保留用于已知慢性抑

郁症继发于大脑化学物质失衡的情况。

=== PAGE 394 ===
Determine the cause of any emotional or behavioral disorder before treating it.

在治疗之前确定任何情绪或行为障碍的原因。

Adaptogenic herbs such as Siberian ginseng, astragalus, and certified-organic ginseng, may be used continually in

moderation to boost the body’s functional abilities under stress.

西伯利亚人参、黄芪和经过认证的有机人参等适应性草药可以适量持续使用，以增强身体在压力下的功

能能力。

=== PAGE 395 ===
AGGRESSION AND DEPRESSION DISORDERS

攻击性和抑郁症

As of 1999, the use of Prozac had become almost as fashionable for treating aggressive animals as it had for humans

with chronic depression disorders. Likewise, Saint-John’s-wort had been touted as “the herbal alternative to Prozac,”

and it too had become popular for treating aggression and other behavioral and emotional disorders in animals.

截至 1999 年，使用百忧解治疗攻击性动物几乎和治疗患有慢性抑郁症的人类一样流行。同样，圣约翰草被

吹捧为“百忧解的草药替代品”，它也因治疗动物的攻击性和其他行为和情绪障碍而变得流行。

Although Saint-John’s-wort and psychotropic drugs may have a place in the treatment of certain disorders, they

are not the panaceas that some companies would like us to believe they are. Many experts believe that these

substances may actually cause a reverse effect in some animals. In Peter Neville’s acclaimed book Do Dogs Need

Shrinks? he cites case histories in which Prozac not only failed to curb aggression but seemingly increased it. One

case involved a two-year-old Staffordshire bull terrier who was given the drug to stop him from assaulting other

dogs. Initially the attacks stopped, but later the dog resumed his hostile behavior—and when he was taken off

Prozac, he became more aggressive than ever. Another case involved a three-year-old pointer who was given Prozac

to stop her from constantly chasing shadows. After three days she began attacking real dogs instead.

尽管圣约翰草和精神药物可能在某些疾病的治疗中占有一席之地，但它们并不是一些公司希望我们相信

的万能药。许多专家认为，这些物质实际上可能会对某些动物造成相反的影响。在彼得·内维尔（Peter

Neville）广受好评的著作《狗需要收缩吗？》中他引用了一些案例，其中百忧解不仅未能抑制攻击性，而

且似乎还增加了攻击性。其中一个案例涉及一只两岁的斯塔福德郡斗牛梗，它被注射药物是为了阻止它攻

击其他狗。最初，攻击停止了，但后来狗又恢复了敌对行为——当它戒掉百忧解后，它变得比以往任何时

候都更具攻击性。另一个案例涉及一只三岁的指示犬，她被给予百忧解以阻止她不断追逐阴影。三天后，

她开始攻击真正的狗。

Chamomile can help lift your pet’s mood naturally.

洋甘菊可以帮助您自然地提升宠物的情绪。

Compounding the potential problems of reverse or other adverse side effects is our limited ability to identify

accurately the causes of aggression and depression disorders in animals. The diagnosis needed to prudently prescribe

such drugs is severely limited by lack of verbal communication between animal and healer. In other words,

psychotropic drugs (and even the safer Saint-John’s-wort) are usually prescribed as a speculative “shot in the dark”

approach to suppression of symptoms, rather than as part of a curative solution that is based on holism.

=== PAGE 396 ===
我们准确识别动物攻击性和抑郁症原因的能力有限，这使得逆转或其他不良副作用的潜在问题变得更加

复杂。由于动物和治疗者之间缺乏口头交流，谨慎开出此类药物所需的诊断受到严重限制。换句话说，精

神药物（甚至是更安全的圣约翰草）通常被用作抑制症状的投机性“黑暗中的一枪”方法，而不是作为基于

整体论的治疗解决方案的一部分。

From a holistic perspective, treatment of aggression begins in the mind of the human guardian—not the animal.

The question of what may be missing from the animal’s well-being must be answered before anything else. Is the

animal receiving all of the nutrients needed for proper brain function? Was the animal abused or neglected in the

past? Is there a genetic predisposition to be addressed? Is there anything in the animal’s living environment that

might be contributing to the problem? Has the animal had adequate opportunities to socialize with other animals and

people? Is the animal’s behavior related to your own? (This is fairly common—animals often pick up the emotional

tone of their living environment.)

从整体角度来看，攻击性的治疗始于人类监护人的思想，而不是动物的思想。首先必须回答动物的福祉

可能缺失什么的问题。动物是否获得了大脑正常功能所需的所有营养？该动物过去是否受到虐待或忽视？

是否存在需要解决的遗传倾向？动物的生活环境中是否存在任何可能导致该问题的因素？该动物是否有足

够的机会与其他动物和人类交往？动物的行为与你自己的行为有关吗？ （这是相当常见的——动物经常会

适应其生活环境的情绪基调。）

After the animal’s diet is changed and supplemented, sessions with a good animal behaviorist are highly

recommended. Animal behaviorists do not teach “sit-stay” obedience but use their expert knowledge of animal

behavior and human-animal relationships to help identify and provide fulfillment of psychological requirements. For

instance, most dogs who are “fear biters” do not exhibit aggressive behavior out of hate or neurological disease but

because they are insecure in the hierarchy of their “pack.” These dogs feel that their human alpha leader is not in

charge of their surroundings and therefore feel constantly threatened. The animal behaviorists’ job in this situation is

to help the guardian and the animal define their positions as leader-protector (the human) and safe-subordinate pack

member (the dog). Horses and other herbivores, of course, have completely different psychologies—but they too can

find a happier coexistence with their humans with some help from a professional behavior trainer.

在改变动物的饮食并补充营养后，强烈建议与优秀的动物行为学家进行会谈。动物行为学家并不教授“静

坐”服从，而是利用他们对动物行为和人与动物关系的专业知识来帮助识别和满足心理需求。例如，大多

数“恐惧症患者”的狗并不是出于仇恨或神经系统疾病而表现出攻击性行为，而是因为它们在“群体”的等级制

度中缺乏安全感。这些狗认为他们的人类领袖无法掌控周围的环境，因此经常感到受到威胁。在这种情况

下，动物行为学家的工作是帮助监护人和动物确定他们作为领导者保护者（人类）和安全下属群体成员

（狗）的地位。当然，马和其他食草动物有着完全不同的心理——但在专业行为训练师的帮助下，它们也

可以找到与人类更快乐的共处。

Once you have begun a curative, long-term approach toward your animal’s aggression or depression, herbs can be

used for symptomatic relief during occasions when stress levels are particularly high. Although many herbalists

recommend valerian as a first choice herb for anxiety and aggression, it can have a reverse, sometimes stimulating,

effect in some animals. It’s a depressant and tends to compound irritability and depression. Instead of lifting the

subject’s spirit, it slows him down and often turns him into a groggy grump. So rather than reaching for valerian, we

opt for herbs such as passionflower, lemon balm, chamomile, or catnip that serve more as mood elevators. Rescue

Remedy (a flower essence formula) is also one of our first choices.

一旦您开始对动物的攻击性或抑郁症采取长期治疗方法，在压力水平特别高的情况下，可以使用草药来

缓解症状。尽管许多草药医生推荐缬草作为治疗焦虑和攻击性的首选草药，但它对某些动物可能产生相反

的、有时是刺激的作用。它是一种抑制剂，往往会加剧烦躁和抑郁。它非但没有提振对象的精神，反而减

慢了他的速度，常常让他变得昏昏沉沉、脾气暴躁。因此，我们不会选择缬草，而是选择西番莲、柠檬香

脂、洋甘菊或猫薄荷等草本植物，这些草本植物更能起到提升情绪的作用。 Rescue Remedy（花精配方）也

是我们的首选之一。

=== PAGE 397 ===
ACUTE NERVOUSNESS AND ANXIETY

极度紧张和焦虑

Everyone has his or her own sources of psychological stress. Some people get nervous and tense during airplane

landings. Our dogs get anxious and frightened while inside crowded buildings. Stephanie the cat trembles during the

first half-hour of long car rides.

每个人都有自己的心理压力来源。有些人在飞机着陆时会感到紧张和紧张。当我们的狗在拥挤的建筑物内

时会感到焦虑和害怕。斯蒂芬妮猫在长途汽车旅行的前半个小时里会发抖。

Herbs can be helpful for gently calming an animal during stressful occasions. In circumstances in which fear and

anxiety prohibit an otherwise passive animal from relaxing, valerian may induce just enough sedation to allow

napping. If the animal’s anxiety is causing him to hiss, spit, bite, or make other demonstrations of potential violence,

a dose or two of passionflower, lemon balm, or catnip may help normalize attitude and defuse the situation. If

nervousness is causing trembling or hypersensitivity to touch and sound, skullcap or oatstraw can be very effective

—especially if combined with valerian or passionflower. A small dose (0.25 milliliters per 30 pounds of an animal’s

body weight) of vervain (Verbena officinalis) tincture may reduce muscle twitching and restlessness, but too much

of this herb may have a reverse effect. In situations in which nervousness is causing an upset stomach, chamomile,

valerian, catnip, or a combination of all three may help induce relaxation and prevent vomiting.

在紧张的情况下，草药有助于温和地安抚动物。在恐惧和焦虑阻止其他被动动物放松的情况下，缬草可

能会产生足够的镇静作用以允许小睡。如果动物的焦虑导致它发出嘶嘶声、吐口水、咬人或做出其他潜在

的暴力行为，一两剂西番莲、柠檬香脂或猫薄荷可能有助于使其态度正常化并缓和局势。如果紧张导致颤

抖或对触觉和声音过敏，黄芩或燕麦草可能非常有效，尤其是与缬草或西番莲结合使用。小剂量（每 30 磅

动物体重 0.25 毫升）马鞭草 (Verbena officinalis) 酊剂可能会减少肌肉抽搐和不安，但过多的这种草药可能

会产生相反的效果。在紧张导致胃部不适的情况下，洋甘菊、缬草、猫薄荷或三者的组合可能有助于放松

并防止呕吐。

Before you reach for valerian or any other herb, try giving your pet a few drops of Rescue Remedy (flower

essence formula), which you can purchase at health food stores. You and your companion may be pleasantly

surprised.

在您使用缬草或任何其他草药之前，请尝试给您的宠物滴几滴 Rescue Remedy（花精配方），您可以在健

康食品商店购买。您和您的同伴可能会感到惊喜。

=== PAGE 398 ===
ARTHRITIS AND HIP DYSPLASIA

关节炎和髋关节发育不良

The term arthritis is general, referring to the inflammation of a joint. Polyarthritis is the inflammation of several

joints. Degenerative arthritis is a term that refers to the condition caused by the wearing of joints as the animal ages.

It is also known as degenerative joint disease and is sometimes caused by trauma to the joints, bones, ligaments, or

cartilage. Osteoarthritis is usually the result of some type of secondary damage to the joint structures. The damage

could result from rupture of ligaments, poor anatomical alignment, or joint dislocation.

关节炎一词是通用的，指的是关节的炎症。多关节炎是多个关节的炎症。退行性关节炎是一个术语，指随

着动物年龄的增长，关节磨损而引起的病症。它也被称为退行性关节疾病，有时是由关节、骨骼、韧带或

软骨损伤引起的。骨关节炎通常是关节结构某种类型的继发性损伤的结果。损伤可能是由于韧带断裂、解

剖结构排列不良或关节脱位造成的。

Inflammatory arthritis can be caused by an infection or an immune-mediated disease that leads to destructive

arthritic lesions. In other words, its onset is caused when the immune system actually turns against the body it’s

supposed to protect.

炎性关节炎可能是由感染或免疫介导的疾病引起的，这些疾病会导致破坏性关节炎病变。换句话说，当

免疫系统实际上转而对抗它应该保护的身体时，就会发生这种情况。

Catnip can help calm an animal who is suffering from anxiety.

猫薄荷可以帮助焦虑的动物平静下来。

Arthritis may also take the form of hip dysplasia. Hip dysplasia is the abnormal development of the “ball and

socket” joint of the hips of dogs. This condition may vary from a slightly abnormal hip joint to the actual dislocation

of the joint. There is controversy among holistic and homeopathic veterinarians regarding the underlying cause of

hip dysplasia. Some holistic veterinarians believe that this condition might be caused by vaccinations, specifically

the rabies vaccine. Others say it is caused by heredity—but if this is so, and conscientious breeders are taking care

not to breed animals who show signs of it, then why is it not being eliminated? Why is it appearing in an increasing

number of breeds more frequently? Despite the evidence, many veterinarians maintain that hip dysplasia is a genetic

predisposition in many breeds of dogs. To an extent this may be true, but we believe that there are too many

coincidences between hip dysplasia and overvaccination. If your dog is young and may be prone to hip dysplasia,

=== PAGE 399 ===
you might want to consider not vaccinating every year.

关节炎也可能表现为髋关节发育不良。髋关节发育不良是指狗的髋部“球窝”关节发育异常。这种情况可

能有所不同，从轻微的髋关节异常到关节的实际脱位。关于髋关节发育不良的根本原因，整体兽医和顺势

疗法兽医之间存在争议。一些整体兽医认为这种情况可能是由疫苗接种引起的，特别是狂犬病疫苗。其他

人则说这是由遗传引起的，但如果真是这样，而且认真的饲养员都小心翼翼地不饲养有这种迹象的动物，

那么为什么它没有被消灭呢？为什么它越来越频繁地出现在越来越多的品种中？尽管有证据，许多兽医仍

然认为髋关节发育不良是许多品种狗的遗传倾向。在某种程度上，这可能是正确的，但我们认为髋关节发

育不良和过度接种疫苗之间有太多的巧合。如果您的狗还年轻并且可能容易出现髋关节发育不良，您可能

需要考虑不要每年都接种疫苗。

Comfrey can help repair aching bones and joints.

紫草可以帮助修复疼痛的骨骼和关节。

The belief that hip dysplasia is strictly a hereditary disease discourages many people from growing attached to

dogs who are believed to be predisposed. This is truly a shame. Not only can a predisposed breed of dog lead a

normal, healthy life but there is a good possibility that hip dysplasia can be prevented by taking some simple,

lifelong measures.

髋关节发育不良严格来说是一种遗传性疾病，这一信念阻止了许多人对那些被认为患有这种疾病的狗产

生依恋。这实在是一种耻辱。易患髋关节发育不良的狗不仅可以过上正常、健康的生活，而且通过采取一

些简单的、终身的措施，很有可能预防髋关节发育不良。

In the book Alternative and Complementary Veterinary Medicine: Principles and Practice, Wendell O. Belfield,

D.V.M., states that hip dysplasia may be caused more by biochemical factors than by genetic inheritance. He

=== PAGE 400 ===
believes that hip dysplasia may be an easily controlled biochemical condition in most breeds of dogs caused by

insufficient collagen synthesis. He says that if insufficient amounts of Vitamin C exist in affected dogs, they may

have difficulty synthesizing enough collagen to assist in maintaining joint stability. Dr. Belfield substantiates his

statement with a study he conducted involving eight litters of German shepherd puppies who came from bloodlines

that were believed to be afflicted with hereditary hip dysplasia. During their pregnancy, bitches were administered

megadoses of vitamin C, and the puppies were maintained on a similar regimen until adulthood. As a result, no signs

of canine hip dysplasia were noted in any of the offspring.

Wendell O. Belfield, D.V.M. 在《替代和补充兽医学：原理与实践》一书中指出，髋关节发育不良可能更

多地是由生化因素引起的，而不是由遗传遗传引起的。他认为，对于大多数品种的狗来说，髋关节发育不

良可能是一种容易控制的生化病症，由胶原蛋白合成不足引起。他说，如果受影响的狗体内维生素 C 含量

不足，它们可能难以合成足够的胶原蛋白来帮助维持关节稳定性。贝尔菲尔德博士通过一项研究证实了他

的说法，该研究涉及八窝德国牧羊犬幼犬，这些幼犬的血统被认为患有遗传性髋关节发育不良。在怀孕期

间，母犬被注射大剂量的维生素 C，幼犬则维持类似的治疗方案直至成年。结果，在任何后代中都没有发

现犬髋关节发育不良的迹象。

Unless onset is acute, such as after a joint injury, the first sign of arthritis is usually lameness that may be

worsened by cold, inclement weather or exercise. You might first notice that your animal isn’t getting around as

easily as he once did. You might observe your companion having difficulty getting on or off the couch, climbing the

stairs, or perhaps jumping in and out of the car. If you are keenly perceptive of subtle changes in your companion,

early onset of arthritis might be signified by abnormal behavior that points to physical discomfort—perhaps your

friend just isn’t his “old self” or appears irritable for no apparent reason. Watch the daily appearance and behavior of

your companion closely. Keep a health care diary for your animal, bearing in mind that nothing you observe is

insignificant. If you do keep a diary, you will be much more effective in preventing simple morning stiffness from

becoming a crippling disease.

除非发病是急性的，例如关节受伤后，否则关节炎的第一个症状通常是跛行，寒冷、恶劣天气或运动可

能会加剧跛行。您可能首先注意到您的动物不再像以前那样轻松地四处走动。您可能会发现您的同伴难以

上下沙发、爬楼梯，或者可能跳进跳出汽车。如果你对伴侣的细微变化有敏锐的洞察力，关节炎的早期发

作可能会表现为身体不适的异常行为——也许你的朋友已经不再是“原来的自己”了，或者表现得无缘无故

地烦躁。密切观察同伴的日常外表和行为。为你的动物写一份健康护理日记，记住你观察到的任何事情都

是无关紧要的。如果你坚持写日记，就能更有效地防止单纯性晨僵变成一种严重的疾病。

As an animal ages, his joints don’t move quite as easily as they once did (Don’t we all know that feeling when

getting in and out of our favorite easy chair?), but if joint stiffness appears to be progressing ahead of your

companion’s age, it’s time to take remedial measures. But before you start administering herbal remedies, you

should know the exact nature of your companion’s arthritis. This may require the opinion of a holistic veterinarian

who can diagnose the many different kinds of arthritis.

随着动物年龄的增长，他的关节不再像以前那样容易移动（难道我们不都知道进出我们最喜欢的安乐椅

时的感觉吗？），但如果关节僵硬似乎在提前发展，你同伴的年龄，是时候采取补救措施了。但在开始使

用草药之前，您应该了解同伴关节炎的确切性质。这可能需要能够诊断多种不同类型关节炎的整体兽医的

意见。

=== PAGE 401 ===
HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

If your animal has arthritis, his immune system needs either to be boosted or brought back into balance with the rest

of his body. But if the arthritis is related to immune system dysfunction, you may find that immunostimulant herbs

such as echinacea aggravate your companion’s condition. Remember that the inflammation associated with

rheumatoid arthritis is likely caused by an autoimmune attack upon the joints. If we stimulate the immune system

into working harder, we might actually make the arthritis worse.

如果您的动物患有关节炎，则需要增强其免疫系统或使其与身体其他部位恢复平衡。但如果关节炎与免疫

系统功能障碍有关，您可能会发现紫锥菊等免疫刺激草药会加重您同伴的病情。请记住，与类风湿性关节

炎相关的炎症很可能是由关节的自身免疫攻击引起的。如果我们刺激免疫系统更加努力地工作，实际上可

能会使关节炎变得更糟。

Instead, holistic efforts should be directed at what is causing the dysfunction. This starts with a critical assessment

of the animal’s diet, an evaluation of possible food allergies, and a thorough investigation of present and historical

influences that may be affecting your companion’s immune system. Such influences may include vaccinations,

antibiotic or steroid drug therapies, or toxic elements in your animal’s environment. Any associated disorders should

be identified and corrected as well. For example, does your arthritic companion suffer from chronic constipation,

weight problems, hair loss, diarrhea, bladder or kidney problems, chronic infections, or a skin condition? If so, such

conditions are likely related to the arthritis. When you have identified as many of these factors as possible, it’s time

to take remedial action by piecing this holistic puzzle together. It’s important to remember that because arthritis is

such a complex and variable disease, there is no singular herbal approach to treating it. Instead, holistic treatment is

multifaceted, including nutritional supplementation and herbs that are tailored to an animal’s individual needs.

相反，整体努力应该针对导致功能障碍的原因。首先对动物的饮食进行严格评估，评估可能的食物过

敏，并对可能影响同伴免疫系统的当前和历史影响进行彻底调查。此类影响可能包括疫苗接种、抗生素或

类固醇药物治疗，或动物环境中的有毒元素。任何相关的疾病也应该被识别和纠正。例如，您的关节炎同

伴是否患有慢性便秘、体重问题、脱发、腹泻、膀胱或肾脏问题、慢性感染或皮肤病？如果是这样，这种

情况可能与关节炎有关。当您尽可能多地确定这些因素后，就可以采取补救措施，将这个整体难题拼凑在

一起。重要的是要记住，由于关节炎是一种复杂多变的疾病，因此没有单一的草药方法可以治疗它。相

反，整体治疗是多方面的，包括根据动物的个体需求定制营养补充剂和草药。

If the arthritis is due to wear-and-tear joint deterioration (a frequent problem with working or hard-playing

animals), then the supplements glucosamine sulfate and chondroitin sulfate might assist the body in repairing itself.

Glucosamine and its related products, glucosamine sulfate and n-acetylglucosamine, have found a use as nutritional

anti-osteoarthritic agents by helping protect and regenerate connective tissue and cartilage in affected joints. N-

acetylglucosamine has shown promise in the treatment of inflammatory disorders, including inflammatory bowel

disease, Crohn’s disease, and colitis.

如果关节炎是由于关节磨损恶化（工作或努力玩耍的动物经常遇到的问题）引起的，那么补充硫酸氨基

葡萄糖和硫酸软骨素可能有助于身体自我修复。氨基葡萄糖及其相关产品硫酸氨基葡萄糖和 n-乙酰氨基葡

萄糖可作为营养性抗骨关节炎药物，帮助保护和再生受影响关节的结缔组织和软骨。 N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖在

治疗炎症性疾病方面显示出良好的前景，包括炎症性肠病、克罗恩病和结肠炎。

Bovine or shark cartilage, vitamin C, and EFA supplements help repair joint tissue damage. Horsetail herb might

be of help too, as it contains a bioavailable form of silicon, an element that serves as the active matrix in connective

tissue development. Comfrey is also considered a classic bone and joint repair herb. In addition to their internal uses,

these herbs can be effective when applied in the form of an external compress, especially when combined with

cayenne and willow bark, which should not be used in cats.

牛或鲨鱼软骨、维生素 C 和 EFA 补充剂有助于修复关节组织损伤。马尾草也可能有帮助，因为它含有生

物可利用的硅，这是一种在结缔组织发育中充当活性基质的元素。紫草也被认为是经典的骨骼和关节修复

草药。除了内服外，这些草药以外敷的形式也能有效，特别是与辣椒和柳树皮结合使用时，猫不宜使用这

些草药。

Mineral- and vitamin-rich herbs such as nettle and dandelion provide nutrients that are needed for joint repair

=== PAGE 402 ===
along with diuretic activities to help remove excess metabolic wastes from the body, via the urinary tract, that may

otherwise contribute to solid buildups in the joints. These herbs also help strengthen kidney function during the

ordeal. Another herb to consider is shepherd’s purse—this diuretic is believed to have a special affinity toward

removal of waste compounds from arthritic joints. Celery seed and parsley root are also excellent choices.

富含矿物质和维生素的草药，如荨麻和蒲公英，可以提供关节修复所需的营养物质，并具有利尿作用，

有助于通过尿道排出体内多余的代谢废物，否则可能会导致关节中的固体积聚。这些草药还有助于在严酷

的考验中增强肾功能。另一种值得考虑的草药是荠菜——这种利尿剂被认为对清除关节炎关节中的废物有

特殊的亲和力。芹菜籽和欧芹根也是不错的选择。

Alterative herbs such as alfalfa, red clover, and burdock are strongly indicated to build up blood structure and to

assist with the transport of systemic waste from body tissues. Liver supporting herbs (hepatics) such as dandelion

root, yellow dock, and Oregon grape help by strengthening liver and gallbladder function, thus helping with

digestion, nutrient absorption, and solid waste elimination. Lymphatic herbs such as cleavers and calendula may be

of assistance by aiding the circulation of tissue-cleansing lymph in and around inflamed areas.

紫花苜蓿、红三叶草和牛蒡等替代草药强烈表明可以增强血液结构并协助转运身体组织中的全身废物。

护肝草药（如蒲公英根、黄坞和俄勒冈葡萄）有助于增强肝脏和胆囊功能，从而帮助消化、营养吸收和固

体废物排出。淋巴草本植物，如切肉刀和金盏花，可能有助于炎症区域内和周围组织清洁淋巴液的循环。

Cayenne and ginger also may be useful. Both are vasodilators and may benefit the arthritic animal by increasing

blood circulation to affected areas. In some animals, though, these same actions may aggravate an inflammatory

condition. For this reason, internal use of these herbs should proceed with caution, and it is best to administer them

in small doses that are proportioned as lesser ingredients to a formula composed of other anti-inflammatory and

alterative herbs.

辣椒和生姜也可能有用。两者都是血管扩张剂，可以通过增加受影响区域的血液循环而使患有关节炎的

动物受益。然而，在某些动物中，这些相同的行为可能会加剧炎症。因此，内服这些草药时应谨慎进行，

最好以小剂量服用，并在由其他抗炎和替代草药组成的配方中按较少成分比例服用。

Herbs that are useful internally for inflammation and pain of arthritis and hip dysplasia include licorice, yucca,

and willow bark (the latter is not for cats). Alfalfa also has a long-standing reputation for relieving the discomforts

of arthritis. It should be among one of the first herbs to be considered for internal use because it can be safely fed as

a daily food supplement (1 teaspoon per pound of food fed each day).

内服治疗关节炎和髋关节发育不良的炎症和疼痛的草药包括甘草、丝兰和柳树皮（后者不适用于猫）。

苜蓿在缓解关节炎不适方面也享有盛誉。它应该是首先考虑内服的草药之一，因为它可以作为每日食品补

充剂安全喂养（每天每磅食物喂食 1 茶匙）。

Tonics as well as herbs can be helpful in treating arthritis. Circulatory tonics such as yarrow, hawthorn, rosemary,

and ginkgo are worth considering for internal use. They provide a gentle increase of blood flow in tissues

surrounding arthritic joints, so muscles remain oxygenated and more flexible.

补品和草药都有助于治疗关节炎。西洋蓍草、山楂、迷迭香和银杏等循环补品值得考虑内服。它们可以

温和地增加关节炎关节周围组织的血流量，从而使肌肉保持充氧且更加灵活。

On the facing page is a basic tonic formula for arthritic animals. Ingredients can be changed, added to, and

proportioned to serve the specific needs of your animal. The arthritis relief compress that follows might also help to

relieve the pain of arthritis.

对页是关节炎动物的基本滋补配方。可以更改、添加成分并按比例调整成分，以满足动物的特定需求。

随后的关节炎缓解热敷也可能有助于缓解关节炎的疼痛。

Animals have a reputation for not letting their chronic problems slow them down much. As a result, arthritic

joints sometimes become aggravated and inflamed because of physical exertion or injury. Provided that there is no

open wound, a simple external application of arnica oil or tincture on the affected joints often brings fast

symptomatic relief. Some good “strain and sprain” herbal ointments, salves, and liniments are also available on the

market, many of which contain time-proven topical analgesics such as eucalyptus, cayenne, or camphor. Olbas oil or

tiger balm are among our favorites, but do not use these products if your animal is under homeopathic care as they

may antidote the homeopathic remedy. Also, be careful not to apply any undiluted oil or herbal ointment to an

animal, especially cats, who can be sensitive to these types of products. Animals also may lick these products off of

their fur and skin, and some of these products may prove toxic if ingested.

=== PAGE 403 ===
动物以不会让慢性问题拖慢它们的速度而闻名。结果，关节炎关节有时会因体力消耗或受伤而恶化和发

炎。如果没有开放性伤口，在受影响的关节上简单地外用山金车油或酊剂通常可以快速缓解症状。市场上

也有一些好的“拉伤和扭伤”草药软膏、药膏和搽剂，其中许多含有经过时间考验的局部止痛药，如桉树、

辣椒或樟脑。奥尔巴斯油或万金油是我们的最爱，但如果您的动物正在接受顺势疗法护理，请勿使用这些

产品，因为它们可能会解毒顺势疗法。另外，请注意不要将任何未稀释的油或草药膏涂抹在动物身上，尤

其是猫，它们可能对这些类型的产品敏感。动物也可能会从皮毛和皮肤上舔掉这些产品，其中一些产品如

果摄入可能会有毒。

A SYSTEMIC SUPPORT FORMULA FOR CHRONIC ARTHRITIS

慢性关节炎的系统支持配方

Combine the following either as dried herbs or tinctures:

将以下物质混合为干草药或酊剂：

2 parts alfalfa

2份苜蓿

1 part dandelion root

1 份 蒲公英根

1 part parsley root

1 份 欧芹根

1 part cleavers or calendula

1 份切肉刀或金盏花

This formula can be used as a dry herb food supplement. If you do choose to use dry herbs instead of

tinctures, use calendula instead of cleavers because cleavers is almost useless after it is dried. An appropriate

dose for each 30 pounds of the animal’s body weight is 1 tablespoon mixed into food daily. If you opt to use

tinctures, find those that contain little or no alcohol. (They are much easier to feed and much safer on the

digestive tract.) You can administer 2–4 milliliters of the tincture for each 30 pounds of body weight directly

into the animal’s mouth or drop it onto his food daily. This combination is safe for dogs, cats, horses, and

most other mammals and can be given over an extended period with no ill side effects. If your companion

tolerates its bitter flavor, a one-part portion of yarrow can be added to this formula to serve as a vascular

tonic.

该配方可用作干草本食品补充剂。如果您确实选择使用干草药而不是酊剂，请使用金盏花代替切肉

刀，因为切肉刀在干燥后几乎毫无用处。每 30 磅动物体重的适当剂量是每天将 1 汤匙混入食物中。

如果您选择使用酊剂，请找到那些含有很少或不含酒精的酊剂。 （它们更容易喂养，对消化道也更

安全。）您可以每天将每 30 磅体重 2-4 毫升的酊剂直接放入动物的嘴里或滴在食物上。这种组合对

于狗、猫、马和大多数其他哺乳动物来说是安全的，并且可以长期服用，不会产生不良副作用。如

果您的伴侣能忍受其苦味，可以将一份西洋蓍草添加到该配方中，作为血管补品。

Arthritis Relief Compress1

缓解关节炎压缩 1

3 parts dried willow bark

3份干柳树皮

3 parts dried comfrey leaf

=== PAGE 404 ===
3份干紫草叶

3 parts dried yarrow

3份干欧蓍草

1 part powdered cayenne

1 份 辣椒粉

To make this compress, first make a decoction from the willow bark by gently simmering in enough water to

cover it for about 20 minutes. Remove from heat but do not drain. While the water is still hot, add the other

three ingredients. Mix thoroughly, adding just enough boiling water to make a thick paste. Let the mixture

stand until it is cool enough to handle but still hot. The poultice is now ready to use as a compress. (See the

“Basics of Herbal Preparations” in chapter 1 for further instructions.)

为了制作这种敷料，首先将柳树皮煎成汤剂，用足够的水轻轻煮约 20 分钟。从火上移开，但不要沥

干。当水还热的时候，加入其他三种成分。充分混合，加入足够的沸水制成浓稠的糊状物。让混合

物静置直至其冷却到可以处理但仍然很热。现在膏药就可以用作敷布了。 （有关进一步说明，请参

阅第 1 章中的“草药制剂基础知识”。）

After applying the compress, check it after about 5 minutes to assure that the cayenne is not causing

excessive irritation to the animal’s skin. If it is, remove the compress and either lower the proportion of

cayenne or remove it from the formula (make a new batch). For best results, the compress should be left on

the animal for an hour.

敷布后，大约 5 分钟后检查，以确保辣椒不会对动物的皮肤造成过度刺激。如果是，请移除压缩

物并降低辣椒的比例或将其从配方中移除（制作新批次）。为了获得最佳效果，应将敷料留在动物

身上一个小时。

The discomforts of arthritis can be approached with internal herbal therapies as well, and often the fastest results

are reached when topical and internal applications are used simultaneously. See the box on this page for a simple

formula for symptomatic relief.

关节炎的不适也可以通过内服草药疗法来解决，并且当同时使用外用和内服时通常可以达到最快的效

果。请参阅本页上的方框，了解缓解症状的简单配方。

Of course, nutrition is the crux of any of the holistic healing modalities and is the most important factor in the

prevention of arthritis. Many times changing to a raw food diet helps the animal and obviates more drastic measures.

当然，营养是任何整体治疗方式的关键，也是预防关节炎的最重要因素。很多时候，改变生食饮食对动

物有帮助，并避免采取更严厉的措施。

Some animals benefit from occasional chiropractic adjustments from a qualified holistic vet who is trained in the

proper manipulation of an animal’s spine. Acupuncture may also help many arthritic animals who are in pain.

有些动物会受益于合格的整体兽医偶尔进行的脊椎按摩调整，这些兽医接受过正确操作动物脊柱的培

训。针灸还可以帮助许多患有关节炎的动物缓解疼痛。

CANCER

癌症

When we hear the word cancer, many of us immediately think, “Oh no—this is the end!”

当我们听到癌症这个词时，许多人立即想到：“哦，不——这就是结局了！”

But cancer is not always a death sentence. There are many ways to deal with cancer, and many types of cancer

can be treated holistically with the help and advice of a qualified holistic veterinarian.

但癌症并不总是意味着死刑。治疗癌症的方法有很多，并且在合格的整体兽医的帮助和建议下，许多类

型的癌症都可以得到整体治疗。

A SYMPTOMATIC RELIEF FORMULA

缓解症状的配方

Combine the following tinctures:

结合以下酊剂：

1 part alfalfa

1 份 苜蓿

1 part yucca

1 份 丝兰

1 part licorice

1 份 甘草

for dogs, cats, horses, and most other mammals

适用于狗、猫、马和大多数其他哺乳动物

Feed 1–2 milliliters of this formula for each 20 pounds of an animal’s body weight, one to three times daily

for up to ten days or until pain and inflammation are reduced.

每 20 磅体重的动物喂食 1-2 毫升该配方奶粉，每天 1 到 3 次，持续长达 10 天或直到疼痛和炎症减

轻。

In traditional Western medicine, we have been taught to believe that the best way to treat cancer is to poison it or

cut it out. In holistic medicine, the treatment of cancer goes far beyond the physical nature of the disease to address

the emotional and spiritual aspects of the sufferer as well. Many holistic practitioners believe that by cutting out or

poisoning the cancer, we are only driving it else-where—perhaps deeper into the body where it can progress more

insidiously.

在传统的西医中，我们被教导相信治疗癌症的最好方法是毒害它或切除它。在整体医学中，癌症的治疗

远远超出了疾病的身体本质，还解决了患者的情感和精神方面的问题。许多整体治疗师认为，通过切除或

毒害癌症，我们只会将其驱赶到其他地方——也许会更深入地进入身体，在那里它会更加隐蔽地发展。

For example, when the “check engine” light goes on in your car, you may stop, check under the hood, and add

some oil if needed, or you may park the car and not drive it until the problem is identified. You’re not going to rip

out the wire that controls the light so it won’t be a nuisance anymore. Unfortunately, in the case of your car, this

quick-fix approach doesn’t address the worn-out crankshaft bearing that degenerates and grinds away the engine

block as you continue driving down the road—and when the car breaks down next, the damage is far more likely to

=== PAGE 406 ===
be irreparable. Ripping out the wire is exactly what traditional Western medicine does in many cases of cancer.

Voilà, cut and yank, and the problem has been “remedied.”

例如，当汽车中的“检查发动机”灯亮起时，您可以停下来，检查引擎盖下，并在需要时添加一些机油，

或者您可以停车并在发现问题之前不要驾驶它。你不会扯掉控制灯光的电线，这样就不会再造成麻烦了。

不幸的是，就您的汽车而言，这种快速修复方法并不能解决磨损的曲轴轴承问题，当您继续在路上行驶

时，曲轴轴承会退化并磨掉发动机缸体，而当汽车接下来发生故障时，损坏更有可能是无法挽回的。拔掉

金属丝正是传统西医在许多癌症病例中所做的事情。瞧，剪切并猛拉，问题就得到了“解决”。

In holistic medicine, the whole individual is treated, not just the cancer. Cancer is only a symptom of what is

going on deeper within the being. In the treatment or prevention of cancer, all components of body, mind, and spirit

need to be evaluated and supported. A critical assessment of diet is the first place to look—feeding poor-quality

commercial food that is laden with artificial colors, preservatives, and by-products only makes the problem worse.

The second step is to eliminate unnecessary vaccinations from the animal’s life. A body that is working extra hard to

build a cancer-fighting immune system doesn’t need the stressful interference of vaccinations.

在整体医学中，整个个体都得到治疗，而不仅仅是癌症。癌症只是存在内部更深处发生的事情的一个症

状。在癌症的治疗或预防中，身体、思想和精神的所有组成部分都需要得到评估和支持。首先要对饮食进

行严格评估——喂养含有人工色素、防腐剂和副产品的劣质商业食品只会让问题变得更糟。第二步是消除

动物生活中不必要的疫苗接种。一个正在加倍努力建立抗癌免疫系统的身体不需要疫苗接种的压力干扰。

=== PAGE 407 ===
HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

Nothing would please us more than to inform you of a new herbal “silver bullet” against cancer, but unfortunately

such a thing does not exist. Although countless studies support the usefulness of herbs and various other holistic

medicines in treating cancer, the disease is far too complex, variable, and adaptable for singular therapeutic

approaches. In fact, cancer has so many faces that its early symptoms can include anything from a minor cough or

excess shedding to occasional diarrhea. Just as varied is the list of possible causes—it seems that everything science

looks at closely enough (foods, environmental toxins, natural and synthetic chemicals) carries the potential of

causing cancer.

没有什么比告诉您一种新的草药“银弹”来对抗癌症更让我们高兴的了，但不幸的是这种东西并不存在。尽

管无数研究支持草药和各种其他整体药物在治疗癌症方面的有用性，但这种疾病过于复杂、多变且难以适

应单一的治疗方法。事实上，癌症有很多方面，其早期症状可能包括从轻微咳嗽或过度脱落到偶尔腹泻等

各种症状。可能的原因也多种多样——似乎科学仔细观察过的所有事物（食物、环境毒素、天然和合成化

学物质）都有可能导致癌症。

When cancer has progressed to a point where the diagnosis is certain, curative treatment is often less effective.

But, if the disease is caught in its earliest stages, the prognosis can be quite positive. Effective prevention and

treatment of cancer must begin with the guardian’s intimate familiarity with his or her animal. Nobody offers more

diagnostic insight into cancer than the person who keeps a detailed observational diary of his or her companion

animal.

当癌症进展到确诊的程度时，治愈性治疗通常效果较差。但是，如果在疾病的最早阶段发现这种疾病，

预后可能会相当积极。有效预防和治疗癌症必须从监护人对其动物的密切熟悉开始。没有人比对自己的伴

侣动物记录详细观察日记的人更能提供对癌症的诊断见解。

The diary should include lifelong records of illnesses or odd behavior or appearances. More important, though, it

should reflect what the animal is like during times of optimal health. The guardian’s capacity to notice minor

deviations from perfect health is the most powerful tool in the early treatment of cancer and most other types of

chronic disease.

日记应包括终生的疾病或奇怪行为或外表的记录。但更重要的是，它应该反映动物在最佳健康时期的状

况。监护人注意到与完美健康的微小偏差的能力是早期治疗癌症和大多数其他类型慢性病的最有力工具。

Following are a few common warning signs the Veterinary Cancer Society recommends that pet owners look for

in dogs. These symptoms apply to other animals as well. Remember, nothing here represents a conclusive diagnosis

of cancer, but any symptoms listed should illuminate a red “check engine” light:

以下是兽医癌症协会建议宠物主人在狗身上寻找的一些常见警告信号。这些症状也适用于其他动物。请

记住，这里没有任何内容代表癌症的结论性诊断，但列出的任何症状都应亮起红色“检查引擎”灯：

• abnormal swellings that continue to grow, especially in the lymph

• 异常肿胀持续增长，尤其是在淋巴中

• sores that do not heal

• 无法愈合的疮口

• bleeding or discharge from the mouth, nose, urinary tract, vagina, or rectum

• 口腔、鼻子、尿道、阴道或直肠出血或分泌物

• offensive odor

• 难闻的气味

• difficulty eating or swallowing

• 进食或吞咽困难

• difficulty breathing

=== PAGE 408 ===
• 呼吸困难

• difficulty urinating or defecating

• 排尿或排便困难

• hesitation to exercise or loss of energy

• 犹豫是否要锻炼或失去精力

• loss of appetite, weight loss

• 食欲不振、体重减轻

• persistent lameness or stiffness of movement

• 持续跛行或动作僵硬

• lumps in the mammary glands

• 乳腺肿块

• abnormalities or difference in size of testicles

• 睾丸大小异常或差异

All of these symptoms may represent a cancer that has developed beyond its early stages, and therefore the animal

should be taken to a holistic veterinarian immediately.

所有这些症状可能代表癌症已经超出早期阶段，因此应立即将动物带到整体兽医处。

What might be indicative of the earliest onset of cancer? Well, just about anything out of the ordinary: a chronic

cough or skin problem, decreased energy, aggression, pain, or stiffness—the list of early symptoms is endless. This

doesn’t mean you should live in constant fear of your companion developing cancer, but you should remain aware

that a change that appears to be minor can develop into a serious condition. Don’t ignore any changes in your

animal. If a minor problem persists, consult a veterinarian.

什么可能表明癌症最早发病？好吧，几乎任何不寻常的事情：慢性咳嗽或皮肤问题、精力下降、攻击

性、疼痛或僵硬——早期症状的清单是无穷无尽的。这并不意味着您应该始终担心您的伴侣患上癌症，但

您应该始终意识到，看似微小的变化可能会发展成为严重的病症。不要忽视动物的任何变化。如果小问题

仍然存在，请咨询兽医。

All forms of cancer share a common characteristic: the disease starts when atypical cells begin reproducing and

invading other cells. As healthy cells are destroyed and replaced by cancerous ones, lesions and tumors form and the

body structures they occupy become dysfunctional.

所有形式的癌症都有一个共同的特征：当非典型细胞开始繁殖并侵入其他细胞时，疾病就开始了。当健

康细胞被破坏并被癌细胞取代时，病变和肿瘤就会形成，它们所占据的身体结构也会变得功能失调。

Many holistic healers theorize that cancer is not really an acquired disease but rather the result of a metabolic

imbalance that has progressed out of control. Cancerous tumors begin as small pinpoint lesions that occur off and on

throughout an animal’s lifetime. In most cases, the immune system is able to stop the tumors before they develop

their own blood supply and begin consuming cell structures elsewhere in the body. But if the body is not in

homeostasis (a state of balanced, harmonious health), it may not be able to eliminate the tumor before it takes

control of its surroundings and a malignancy results. From this holistic perspective, carcinogenic compounds, excess

ultraviolet light and radiation, and other substances that are said to cause cancer are not seen as “carriers” of the

disease but as triggering or encouraging mechanisms.

许多整体治疗师认为，癌症实际上并不是一种后天性疾病，而是代谢失衡失控的结果。癌性肿瘤始于微

小的针状病变，在动物的一生中断断续续地发生。在大多数情况下，免疫系统能够在肿瘤形成自己的血液

供应并开始消耗身体其他部位的细胞结构之前阻止肿瘤。但如果身体不处于稳态（一种平衡、和谐的健康

状态），它可能无法在肿瘤控制周围环境并导致恶性肿瘤之前消除肿瘤。从这个整体角度来看，致癌化合

物、过量的紫外线和辐射以及据说会导致癌症的其他物质并不被视为疾病的“载体”，而是被视为触发或鼓

励机制。

The potential for cancer exists within every animal (human and otherwise). The key to preventing it lies inside a

healthy body, not only in the outside influences that we consider threats. Perhaps you have noticed (as we have) that

=== PAGE 409 ===
a disproportionate number of seemingly healthy people develop cancer despite all external efforts to avoid it. Why is

this? It is because despite all the measures they may have taken toward eliminating potential carcinogens from their

lives, deeper issues of physical, emotional, and spiritual health have not been addressed, and the people have fallen

from homeostasis.

每种动物（人类和其他动物）都存在患癌症的可能性。预防它的关键在于健康的身体内部，而不仅仅是

我们认为威胁的外部影响。也许您已经注意到（正如我们一样），尽管采取了各种外部努力来避免癌症，

但看似健康的人中却有不成比例的人患上了癌症。为什么是这样？这是因为，尽管他们采取了所有措施来

消除生活中潜在的致癌物，但更深层次的身体、情感和精神健康问题尚未得到解决，人们已经失去了体内

平衡。

None of this is to say that we should disregard the existence of carcinogenic substances in food, water, and the

environment. To the contrary, every effort should be made to become aware of and eliminate cancer-causing factors

in our lives and the lives of our animals. But we must also provide our bodies with the proper elements of nutrition

and systemic support that are needed to maintain homeostasis and prevent cancer. Furthermore, the immune system

must be properly equipped and always ready to respond to a nearly infinite number of cancer-causing influences. It

must be allowed to do its job without interference from antibiotics, immune-suppressing corticosteroid drugs, and

vaccine therapies. Every time we interfere with natural immune system functions we may be compromising the

body’s ability to respond to and correct cellular or immune system imbalances that could develop into cancer.

这并不是说我们应该忽视食物、水和环境中致癌物质的存在。相反，我们应该尽一切努力认识并消除我

们和动物生活中的致癌因素。但我们还必须为我们的身体提供维持体内平衡和预防癌症所需的适当营养元

素和系统支持。此外，免疫系统必须配备适当的设备，并随时准备好应对几乎无数的致癌影响。必须让它

在不受抗生素、免疫抑制皮质类固醇药物和疫苗疗法干扰的情况下发挥作用。每次我们干扰自然免疫系统

功能时，我们都可能会损害身体响应和纠正可能发展为癌症的细胞或免疫系统失衡的能力。

=== PAGE 410 ===
WHEN CANCER OCCURS

当癌症发生时

The immune system represents the most complete form of disease intervention on earth. If allowed or enabled to

function, it is infinitely more efficient than anything human beings can comprehend, much less devise. When cancer

takes hold, the body’s defenses need all of their resources to fight it. The holistic approach to cancer begins, then, by

providing the body with every opportunity to perform optimally. This means supplying it with supplemental

measures of nutritional and systemic support.

免疫系统代表了地球上最完整的疾病干预形式。如果允许或使其能够发挥作用，它的效率将比人类所能理

解的任何东西都要高得多，更不用说设计了。当癌症发生时，身体的防御系统需要动用所有的资源来对抗

它。因此，治疗癌症的整体方法首先是为身体提供一切最佳表现的机会。这意味着为其提供营养和系统支

持的补充措施。

Several diet programs have been designed to strengthen and support animals with cancer. Many involve foods that

are rich in fiber and antioxidant compounds. Intensive vitamin, mineral, and other supplemental therapies are often

employed as well. These typically include vitamins A, B complex, C, and E, as well as selenium, iron, coenzyme

Q10 (CoQ10), EFAs, digestive enzymes, and dimethylglycine. The best anticancer diet for your animal is one

tailored specifically to his individual needs by a holistic veterinarian who is familiar with treating the disease.

一些饮食计划旨在增强和支持患有癌症的动物。许多涉及富含纤维和抗氧化化合物的食物。通常还采用

强化维生素、矿物质和其他补充疗法。这些通常包括维生素 A、复合 B、C 和 E，以及硒、铁、辅酶 Q10

(CoQ10)、EFAs、消化酶和二甲基甘氨酸。最适合您的动物的抗癌饮食是由熟悉治疗该疾病的整体兽医根

据其个人需求专门定制的饮食。

=== PAGE 411 ===
HERBAL THERAPIES

草药疗法

Herbs play important roles in supporting the body in its effort to rid itself of cancer. Herbal therapies focus on tonic

support of organs and systems that have special significance in the fight. Because cancer is so variable, it’s difficult

to generalize an herbal approach. Every case of cancer is different, as are the metabolic requirements of each animal

who has cancer. But a good starting point for herbal treatment of all animals with cancer is to support the liver,

kidneys, and lymphatic system—the body’s waste filtering and elimination systems. By helping the body cleanse

itself, the immune system is less encumbered with cleanup chores and better able to fight cancer. The infamous

Essiac and Hoxsey formulas were designed for this purpose. Although the formulas for both have likely been

changed several times over the past years, each contains an array of alterative and cholagogue herbs that are targeted

toward cleaning the blood, improving digestion, and eliminating waste (primarily via the digestive tract). The Essiac

formula is commonly marketed in health food stores.

草药在支持身体摆脱癌症方面发挥着重要作用。草药疗法侧重于对在战斗中具有特殊意义的器官和系统的

滋补支持。由于癌症的变异性很大，因此很难推广草药治疗方法。每一种癌症病例都是不同的，每只患有

癌症的动物的代谢需求也是不同的。但对所有患有癌症的动物进行草药治疗的一个良好起点是支持肝脏、

肾脏和淋巴系统——体内的废物过滤和消除系统。通过帮助身体进行自我清洁，免疫系统可以减少清理工

作的负担，并且能够更好地对抗癌症。臭名昭著的 Essiac 和 Hoxsey 配方就是为此目的而设计的。尽管这两

种药物的配方在过去几年中可能已经改变了几次，但每种药物都含有一系列替代和利胆草药，旨在清洁血

液、改善消化和消除废物（主要通过消化道）。 Essiac 配方通常在保健食品商店出售。

The Hoxsey formula is available in various interpretations most of which contain at least six different herbs.

Some herbalists, however, believe that the original formula contained only two: red clover and burdock.

Hoxsey 配方有多种解释，其中大多数包含至少六种不同的草药。然而，一些草药学家认为，最初的配方

只含有两种成分：红三叶草和牛蒡。

Red clover is at the top of our list of anticancer herbs because it inhibits the activities of carcinogenic compounds,

helps improve blood structure, and strengthens lymphatic functions that are crucial in cleansing cell tissues

throughout the body. It also contains sterol constituents that may inhibit the production of blood vessels that supply

and support newly formed tumors. Alfalfa provides similar alterative activities, but we don’t know yet if it possesses

the same tumor-inhibiting properties as red clover.

红三叶草在我们的抗癌草药清单中名列前茅，因为它可以抑制致癌化合物的活性，有助于改善血液结

构，并增强淋巴功能，这对于清洁全身细胞组织至关重要。它还含有甾醇成分，可以抑制供应和支持新形

成的肿瘤的血管的产生。苜蓿提供类似的替代活性，但我们尚不知道它是否具有与红三叶草相同的肿瘤抑

制特性。

Burdock and dandelion root provide gentle stimulation to the liver, thus improving digestion and the removal of

waste. These herbs do not cause added strain upon the filtering organs, and therefore they can be used continuously

over a long period. In situations in which toxic buildup of systemic waste must be eliminated quickly in order to

liberate the immune system, yellow dock serves as a much stronger liver stimulant and in fact is known as a

traditional remedy for heavy metal toxicity (it is also a laxative). Milk thistle may be helpful for protecting the liver

against harmful by-products of the cancer or from damage that may result after protracted drug therapies.

牛蒡和蒲公英根对肝脏提供温和的刺激，从而改善消化和清除废物。这些草药不会对过滤器官造成额外

的压力，因此可以长期连续使用。在必须快速消除全身废物有毒积聚以释放免疫系统的情况下，黄坞可作

为更强的肝脏兴奋剂，事实上被称为重金属毒性的传统疗法（它也是一种泻药） 。水飞蓟可能有助于保护

肝脏免受癌症有害副产物或长期药物治疗后可能造成的损害。

=== PAGE 412 ===
Red clover has many anticancer and tumor-inhibiting properties.

红三叶草具有许多抗癌和抑制肿瘤的特性。

Diuretic herbs may also aid in removal of systemic waste via the kidneys and urinary tract. At the top of the

diuretic list are dandelion leaf and nettle. These herbs stimulate urine production and provide potassium and other

minerals that need to be continually replaced throughout the cleansing process.

利尿草药还可以帮助通过肾脏和泌尿道清除全身废物。排在利尿剂榜首的是蒲公英叶和荨麻。这些草药

刺激尿液产生并提供在整个清洁过程中需要不断补充的钾和其他矿物质。

To help remove toxic waste, slippery elm, marshmallow, flaxseed, and plantain serve as useful devices for

lubricating, protecting, and reducing inflammation of mucous membranes throughout the urinary and digestive

tracts. If poor liver function has caused chronic constipation, frequent small doses of turkey rhubarb tincture (0.25

milliliters per 30 pounds of the animal’s body weight, three times daily) serve as an effective laxative. It should be

limited to as-needed, short-term use because it can cause diarrhea, intestinal cramping, and other discomforts.

为了帮助清除有毒废物，滑榆、棉花糖、亚麻籽和车前草可以作为润滑、保护和减少整个泌尿道和消化

道粘膜炎症的有用工具。如果肝功能不佳导致慢性便秘，经常服用小剂量火鸡大黄酊剂（每 30 磅动物体重

0.25 毫升，每日 3 次）可作为有效的泻药。应仅限于按需短期使用，因为它可能导致腹泻、肠道痉挛和其

他不适。

Immunostimulant herbs may help boost your companion’s immune response to the cancer. Astragalus is

especially well suited for this purpose because it adds energy-boosting adaptogenic qualities to its immunostimulant

properties in cancer-debilitated animals. Garlic is another excellent immune system tonic to consider. While

boosting production of killer T cells and other immune system components, it has also been shown to trigger

enzyme responses that help break down waste materials before they enter the bloodstream.

免疫刺激草药可能有助于增强您伴侣对癌症的免疫反应。黄芪特别适合此目的，因为它在癌症衰弱的动

物中为其免疫刺激特性添加了增强能量的适应性品质。大蒜是另一种值得考虑的极好的免疫系统补品。在

促进杀伤性 T 细胞和其他免疫系统成分的产生的同时，它还被证明可以触发酶反应，帮助在废物进入血液

之前将其分解。

Once the specific characteristics of the cancer have been identified and correlated with the animal’s holistic needs

and cancer-fighting abilities, herbal medicines may be administered directly against the cancer. As we mentioned

earlier, this approach requires the experience of a trained professional who is used to recognizing and treating

cancer. Many herbal devices have shown great promise in combating specific forms of cancer. Acemannan, a

compound derived from aloe vera, has been shown to be effective against fibrosarcoma and FeLV. It is theorized

that acemannan triggers an increase in the immune attack upon the viruses believed to cause these usually fatal

diseases. An intravenous drug called Carnivora is derived from the Venus’s flytrap plant for treatment of malignant

tumors. Although it has not been approved for use in North America as of 1999, Carnivora has shown some

=== PAGE 413 ===
incredible tumor-reducing results in Europe. Herbalists have also seen good results from the use of violet leaf extract

in the treatment of certain cancers. It, too, is believed to have tumor-reducing qualities.

一旦确定了癌症的具体特征并将其与动物的整体需求和抗癌能力联系起来，就可以直接使用草药来对抗

癌症。正如我们之前提到的，这种方法需要训练有素、习惯于识别和治疗癌症的专业人员的经验。许多草

药装置在对抗特定形式的癌症方面显示出巨大的前景。 Acemannan 是一种从芦荟中提取的化合物，已被证

明可有效对抗纤维肉瘤和 FeLV。据推测，乙酰甘露聚糖会引发对病毒的免疫攻击增加，这些病毒被认为会

导致这些通常致命的疾病。一种名为 Carnivora 的静脉注射药物源自维纳斯捕蝇草植物，用于治疗恶性肿

瘤。尽管截至 1999 年 Carnivora 尚未在北美获得批准使用，但 Carnivora 在欧洲已显示出一些令人难以置信

的肿瘤减少效果。草药学家也发现使用紫罗兰叶提取物治疗某些癌症有良好的效果。它也被认为具有减少

肿瘤的作用。

A TONIC SUPPORT FORMULA FOR

滋补支持配方

ANIMALS WITH CANCER

患有癌症的动物

Combine the following low-alcohol (glycerin) herb tinctures:

混合以下低酒精（甘油）草药酊剂：

2 parts red clover

2份红三叶草

1 part astragalus

1份黄芪

1 part dandelion root

1 份 蒲公英根

1 part garlic

1 份 大蒜

This formula can be fed to the animal continuously over a long period: 0.5 milliliters per 20 pounds of the

animal’s body weight, three times daily. If constipation is part of your animal’s problem, try adding 2 parts

marshmallow to the formula. If this fails to bring results, add 1 part yellow dock. If that doesn’t work, try

substituting the yellow dock with turkey rhubarb. If liver damage is evident or a threat, twice-daily doses of

milk thistle may be fed in addition to this formula to help repair and protect the liver. A standardized milk

thistle preparation that contains at least 70 percent silymarin constituents is best for repairing an already

damaged liver.

该配方可以长期连续喂给动物：每20磅动物体重0.5毫升，每天3次。如果您的动物存在便秘问题，请

尝试在配方中添加 2 份棉花糖。如果这无法带来结果，请添加 1 部分黄色底座。如果这不起作用，

请尝试用火鸡大黄代替黄色码头。如果肝脏损伤明显或存在威胁，除了该配方奶之外，还可以每日

喂食两次水飞蓟，以帮助修复和保护肝脏。含有至少 70% 水飞蓟素成分的标准化水飞蓟制剂最适合

修复已经受损的肝脏。

CARDIOVASCULAR PROBLEMS

心血管问题

In contrast with the vast array of cardiovascular disorders that loom over their human guardians, animals have little

risk of contracting heart or arterial disease during the first three-quarters of their lives. Strokes and heart attacks are

almost unheard of in dogs and cats simply because their bodies are naturally designed to metabolize the meat and

animal fats that send many of their caretakers to an early grave. This doesn’t mean that animals aren’t susceptible to

the ills of chemical preservatives, excess sodium, and refined sugar. Nor does it mean their cardiovascular systems

are more resilient to abuse or neglect. It means only that unhealthy foods, chemicals, and environmental influences

may have a different effect on our companion animals than they do on us. Simply put, a dog or cat on a low-quality,

poorly digestible commercial diet is far more likely to die from kidney failure than arteriosclerosis. On the same

note, an animal’s cardiovascular system will fail, just as ours will, unless all requirements of good nutrition,

exercise, and environmental quality are met.

与人类守护者面临的大量心血管疾病相比，动物在生命的前四分之三时间内感染心脏病或动脉疾病的风险

很小。在狗和猫身上，中风和心脏病几乎是闻所未闻的，因为它们的身体天生就可以代谢肉类和动物脂

肪，而这些肉类和动物脂肪会让它们的许多照顾者早早死去。这并不意味着动物不会受到化学防腐剂、过

量钠和精制糖的危害。这也不意味着他们的心血管系统对虐待或忽视的抵抗力更强。这仅意味着不健康的

食品、化学品和环境影响可能对我们的伴侣动物产生与我们不同的影响。简而言之，食用低质量、难消化

的商业饮食的狗或猫死于肾衰竭的可能性远高于动脉硬化。同样，除非满足良好营养、运动和环境质量的

所有要求，否则动物的心血管系统将会衰竭，就像我们的心血管系统一样。

Ginkgo helps to increase circulation.

银杏有助于增加血液循环。

The heart and vascular system operates continuously and under constant pressure throughout an animal’s life.

Factors such as excessive body fat, chronic illness, secondhand smoke, and aging add to the stress and inevitable

wear and tear of this vital system. Unlike us, however, our companions have little choice in how their cardiovascular

health is maintained—that determination is left up to us.

在动物的一生中，心脏和血管系统在恒定的压力下持续运转。身体脂肪过多、慢性疾病、二手烟和衰老

等因素都会增加这个重要系统的压力和不可避免的磨损。然而，与我们不同的是，我们的同伴在如何维持

心血管健康方面几乎没有选择——这个决定权取决于我们。

=== PAGE 415 ===
DIET AND EXERCISE: THE HEART OF HEART HEALTH

饮食和锻炼：心脏健康的核心

Cardiovascular health all begins with a complete diet. The heart consists of specially adapted smooth muscles and

connective tissues that must perform optimally throughout every moment during an animal’s life; therefore, the

heart needs to be continually fed and repaired. The vascular system must remain strong, free of obstructions, and

responsive to the body’s needs. It, too, must be continually supplied with the tools and fuel needed for self-

maintenance and flawless function. A big problem arises, however, when an animal is afforded only an average

“maintenance diet” for subsistence. The cardiovascular system’s nutritional daily requirements are never static but

instead are continually fluctuating and changing as challenges arise. This means that no single commercial diet, no

matter how complete, organic, or digestible it might be, can contain all of the nutritional elements your companion’s

heart needs on a day-to-day basis.

心血管健康都始于完整的饮食。心脏由特殊适应的平滑肌和结缔组织组成，它们必须在动物一生中的每时

每刻都保持最佳状态；因此，心脏需要不断地滋养和修复。血管系统必须保持强健、畅通无阻，并对身体

的需求做出反应。它还必须不断地为其提供自我维护和完美运行所需的工具和燃料。然而，当动物仅获得

平均的“维持饮食”来维持生存时，就会出现一个大问题。心血管系统的日常营养需求从来都不是静态的，

而是随着挑战的出现而不断波动和变化。这意味着没有任何一种商业饮食，无论它多么完整、有机或易消

化，都可以包含您伴侣心脏日常所需的所有营养元素。

The only way to be sure that your animal is receiving the nutrition needed for good cardiovascular health is to

provide a diversity of fresh whole foods throughout his life. Supplemental vitamins, minerals, and EFAs also help

assure that your companion’s cardiovascular system is getting the special considerations it needs. Amino acids are

especially important, as they serve as the protein building blocks of smooth-muscle development and repair. Cats

must have taurine in their diets, and dogs must have a sufficient supply of l-carnitine, or degenerative heart disease

(idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy) may result. Coenzyme Q10 also plays important roles in prevention and

treatment of heart problems. It has been shown to help protect the heart muscle from damage secondary to hypoxia,

infection, and inflammation.

确保您的动物获得心血管健康所需营养的唯一方法是在其一生中提供各种新鲜的天然食品。补充维生

素、矿物质和必需脂肪酸还有助于确保您伴侣的心血管系统得到所需的特殊照顾。氨基酸尤其重要，因为

它们是平滑肌发育和修复的蛋白质组成部分。猫的饮食中必须含有牛磺酸，狗必须有足够的左旋肉碱，否

则可能会导致退行性心脏病（特发性扩张型心肌病）。辅酶 Q 10 在预防和治疗心脏问题方面也发挥着重要

作用。它已被证明有助于保护心肌免受缺氧、感染和炎症继发的损伤。

=== PAGE 416 ===
CARDIOVASCULAR PROBLEMS IN DOGS AND CATS

狗和猫的心血管问题

In cats, the most common form of noninherited (acquired) heart disease is hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, an

enlargement of the left ventricular wall and septum that reduces the heart’s functional ability to pump blood. In

dogs, the most common form of acquired heart disease is valvular degeneration in which the heart valves fail to

completely close when they should, causing an audible (with a stethoscope) heart murmur and decreased cardiac

output. This condition can lead to poor circulation to the extremities, the formation of blood clots in the veins and

arteries, and congestive heart failure. In both dogs and cats, acquired cardiomyopathy is most likely to occur in

middle-aged or older animals.

在猫中，最常见的非遗传性（后天性）心脏病是肥厚性心肌病，即左心室壁和隔膜增大，降低心脏泵血的

功能。在狗中，最常见的获得性心脏病是瓣膜变性，其中心脏瓣膜在应有的时候无法完全关闭，导致听到

（用听诊器）心脏杂音和心输出量减少。这种情况会导致四肢血液循环不良、静脉和动脉形成血栓以及充

血性心力衰竭。在狗和猫中，获得性心肌病最有可能发生在中年或老年动物中。

Animals may suffer from inherited forms of heart disease as well. In dogs, one of the most common is patent

ductus arteriosus, a congenital defect (most commonly seen in miniature poodles and German shepherds) that

essentially amounts to a leak between chambers of the heart. In cats, congenital defects in the mitral and tricuspid

valves of the heart are fairly common.

动物也可能患有遗传性心脏病。在狗中，最常见的一种是动脉导管未闭，这是一种先天性缺陷（最常见

于小型贵宾犬和德国牧羊犬），本质上相当于心室之间的渗漏。在猫中，心脏二尖瓣和三尖瓣的先天性缺

陷相当常见。

Other forms of cardiovascular disease may be secondary to bacterial, protozoan, or viral infection. Congestive

heart failure, a condition in which high pressure in the left atrium of the heart causes a backup of fluid into the

pulmonary capillaries and lungs, is common in obese or geriatric animals or those with heart defects or dysfunction.

其他形式的心血管疾病可能继发于细菌、原生动物或病毒感染。充血性心力衰竭是一种心脏左心房高压

导致液体回流到肺毛细血管和肺部的疾病，在肥胖或老年动物或患有心脏缺陷或功能障碍的动物中很常

见。

Animals with heart problems may exhibit shortness of breath, coughing, and diminished physical stamina. Further

examination may reveal cardiac arrhythmia, pulmonary edema, or blood pressure problems. If you suspect that your

animal companion has a heart problem, you should get him to a holistic veterinarian right away.

患有心脏病的动物可能会表现出呼吸急促、咳嗽和体力下降。进一步检查可能会发现心律失常、肺水肿

或血压问题。如果您怀疑您的动物伴侣有心脏问题，您应该立即带他去看整体兽医。

=== PAGE 417 ===
HERBAL THERAPIES

草药疗法

The herbal approach to heart disorders is to strengthen and support cardiovascular and pulmonary function and

efficiency. Tonic herbal therapies are especially helpful in older animals who need a gentle measure of daily

cardiovascular support. In all cases, a daily supplement of hawthorn helps improve coronary blood flow, moderate

blood pressure, and strengthen heartbeat. Garlic may also be of benefit. Ginkgo, yarrow, or cayenne should also be

considered to help increase circulation in the extremities, brain, and throughout the peripheral capillaries of the

body. If rapid, erratic heartbeat is part of your companion’s disorder, bugleweed may be useful to safely slow and

strengthen the heart. If myocardial inflammation or pulmonary edema is present (such as with congestive heart

failure), a daily regimen of strong dandelion leaf tea helps remove excess fluid from the body. At the same time, it

supplies the body with potassium, a mineral that is essential to healthy heart function.

治疗心脏病的草药方法是增强和支持心血管和肺功能和效率。滋补草药疗法对于需要温和的日常心血管支

持的老年动物特别有帮助。在所有情况下，每日补充山楂有助于改善冠状动脉血流量、调节血压和增强心

跳。大蒜也可能有好处。银杏、欧蓍草或辣椒也应该被认为有助于增加四肢、大脑和整个身体周围毛细血

管的循环。如果快速、不稳定的心跳是您同伴疾病的一部分，那么牛杂草可能有助于安全地减慢和增强心

脏功能。如果存在心肌炎症或肺水肿（例如充血性心力衰竭），每日饮用浓蒲公英叶茶有助于清除体内多

余的液体。同时，它为身体提供钾，这是一种对健康心脏功能至关重要的矿物质。

Adaptogenic herbs such as astragalus or Siberian ginseng may increase overall energy levels in the animal.

Astragalus is also known to have antiviral qualities that are specific to heart infections. Echinacea or other

immunostimulant herbs are indicated in circumstances where bacterial or viral infection is involved.

黄芪或西伯利亚人参等适应性草药可以提高动物的整体能量水平。黄芪还具有针对心脏感染的抗病毒特

性。紫锥花或其他免疫刺激草药适用于涉及细菌或病毒感染的情况。

A CARDIOVASCULAR TONIC

心血管补品

Combine the following glycerin tinctures:

混合以下甘油酊剂：

2 parts hawthorn

山楂 2 份

2 parts dandelion leaf

2 份 蒲公英叶

1 part yarrow

1 份 西洋蓍草

1 part ginkgo

1份银杏

An appropriate dose for dogs, cats, and other small animals is 0.05–1.0 milliliter for each 20 pounds of the

animal’s body weight daily. Horses and other large herbivores can receive 20–30 milliliters daily. If more

practical, horses and other large herbivores can be fed 1–2 liters of the fresh herbs daily (in lieu of the

tincture formula).

对于狗、猫和其他小动物来说，每天每 20 磅体重服用 0.05-1.0 毫升是合适的剂量。马和其他大型食

草动物每天可以吸收 20-30 毫升。如果更实际的话，马和其他大型食草动物可以每天喂食 1-2 升新鲜

草药（代替酊剂配方）。

In addition to this formula, dietary supplementation of garlic may be of benefit to the animal.

除了这个配方之外，在饮食中补充大蒜可能对动物也有好处。

=== PAGE 419 ===
DIGESTIVE SYSTEM PROBLEMS

消化系统问题

We are all familiar with the sounds and sights of an animal suffering from digestive upset—and with cleaning up the

aftermath. This is not a pleasant part of taking care of animals, but it’s a fact of life, nonetheless.

我们都熟悉患有消化不良的动物的声音和景象，以及清理善后事宜。这并不是照顾动物的一个令人愉快的

部分，但这却是生活的事实。

It’s normal for a healthy animal to vomit or get diarrhea on occasion. Dogs and cats may intuitively induce

vomiting by eating grass or other plants. This action serves to cleanse the stomach. Diarrhea may occur if your

animal eats something that he is not accustomed to or eats too much of something that his body doesn’t need, such

as salty food that was sneaked beneath the dinner table. Vomiting and diarrhea are usually harmless and self-

correcting, but they could also be symptoms of a much more serious condition.

对于健康的动物来说，偶尔呕吐或腹泻是正常的。狗和猫可能会通过吃草或其他植物直觉地诱发呕吐。

这个动作可以起到净化肠胃的作用。如果您的动物吃了一些他不习惯的东西或吃了太多身体不需要的东

西，例如偷偷放在餐桌下面的咸味食物，则可能会发生腹泻。呕吐和腹泻通常是无害的并且可以自我纠

正，但它们也可能是更严重疾病的症状。

Digestive upset could be indicative of a parasite imbalance, pancreatitis, colitis, giardiasis, ulcers, liver

dysfunction, bacterial or protozoan infection, or even cancer. This leads us back to what holistic animal healing is all

about: caring about your animal enough to recognize the difference between an isolated incident and a serious

illness.

消化不良可能表明寄生虫失衡、胰腺炎、结肠炎、贾第鞭毛虫病、溃疡、肝功能障碍、细菌或原生动物

感染，甚至癌症。这让我们回到了整体动物治疗的全部内容：足够关心你的动物，以认识到孤立事件和严

重疾病之间的区别。

=== PAGE 420 ===
THE REALITY OF DIGESTIVE UPSET

消化不良的现实

Human nature dictates that anything unpleasant to any of the human senses must be immediately suppressed or

ignored. To think about vomit or diarrhea, much less look at what it contains, is virtually taboo. Humanity’s

aversion toward secondhand food material is a limiting factor in the holistic care of animals. If we are to care for

beloved companions who cannot articulate how they feel, we must learn to set aside this aversion long enough to

consider fully what vomiting and having diarrhea might actually mean in terms of their health. Is that mess on the

sofa just a wad of grass or a hair ball, or does it contain blood (which sometimes looks like coffee grounds), worms,

or thick yellow discharge? Forcing yourself to thoroughly examine the mess rather than covering it up immediately

with half a roll of paper towels might make the difference between health and sickness for your companion.

人性决定任何对人类感官不愉快的事情都必须立即抑制或忽略。思考呕吐或腹泻实际上是一种禁忌，更不

用说看看其中含有什么了。人类对二手食品的厌恶是动物整体护理的一个限制因素。如果我们要照顾无法

表达自己感受的挚爱伴侣，我们必须学会将这种厌恶情绪搁置足够长的时间，以充分考虑呕吐和腹泻对他

们的健康实际上意味着什么。沙发上的乱七八糟的东西只是一团草或一个毛球，还是含有血液（有时看起

来像咖啡渣）、蠕虫或浓稠的黄色分泌物？强迫自己彻底检查乱七八糟的东西，而不是立即用半卷纸巾盖

住它，可能会决定你的同伴的健康与疾病。

The conventional way of dealing with digestive upset is to suppress the uncomfortable or unpleasant symptoms.

For diarrhea, there are stool hardeners. For constipation, there are laxatives. For vomiting, there are antiemetic

drugs. But from a holistic perspective, the paramount question of what caused the problem in the first place remains

unanswered with these approaches. In fact, stopping the body’s efforts to purge itself may do more harm than good.

处理消化不良的传统方法是抑制不舒服或不愉快的症状。对于腹泻，有大便硬化剂。对于便秘，有泻

药。对于呕吐，有止吐药。但从整体角度来看，这些方法仍然没有回答最初导致问题的最重要问题。事实

上，停止身体自我净化的努力可能弊大于利。

If your animal is experiencing chronic diarrhea or is vomiting but is exhibiting no other signs of disease, try

changing his diet. Oftentimes when an animal is placed on a natural diet, these occurrences are greatly diminished or

eliminated altogether. Food supplementation with digestive probiotics and enzymes often helps too. If your animal’s

stool or vomit looks odd or if the situation is severe or persistent, see your veterinarian immediately.

如果您的动物正在经历慢性腹泻或呕吐，但没有表现出其他疾病迹象，请尝试改变他的饮食。通常，当

动物采用自然饮食时，这些现象会大大减少或完全消除。含有消化益生菌和酶的食物补充剂通常也有帮

助。如果您的动物的粪便或呕吐物看起来很奇怪，或者情况严重或持续存在，请立即去看兽医。

=== PAGE 421 ===
APPETITE LOSS (ANOREXIA) AND MALABSORPTION

食欲不振（厌食症）和吸收不良

Loss of appetite in animals is seen in many different illnesses. It can be very dangerous for cats, who may suffer

from hepatic lipidosis, a degenerative condition where the liver becomes congested and dysfunctional from a rapid

buildup of fat. A cat with hepatic lipidosis loses his ability to use stored fat, and as a result, the body utilizes its own

muscle mass as a source of protein. About 35 percent of cats with this disease eventually die from it.

动物食欲不振可见于许多不同的疾病。这对猫来说非常危险，它们可能会患有肝脂质沉积症，这是一种退

化性疾病，肝脏因脂肪快速积聚而变得充血和功能障碍。患有肝脂质沉积症的猫失去了利用储存脂肪的能

力，因此，身体利用自身的肌肉质量作为蛋白质来源。大约 35% 患有这种疾病的猫最终会死于这种疾病。

If your companion chooses not to eat, don’t jump to conclusions and panic. For various reasons, some animals

may naturally decide to fast. Fasting should be allowed if it doesn’t continue for more than a few days and as long as

the animal seems healthy in all other ways. Keep a close eye for signs of weakness, weight loss, fever, runny eyes,

or any other signs of ill health. If after a few days of fasting your companion is still turning up his nose to his

favorite treats, assume that something is wrong—even if he seems otherwise healthy—and get to a vet!

如果您的同伴选择不吃东西，请不要急于下结论并惊慌失措。由于各种原因，一些动物可能会自然地决

定禁食。如果禁食持续时间不超过几天，并且只要动物在所有其他方面看起来都很健康，就应该允许禁

食。密切关注虚弱、体重减轻、发烧、流泪或任何其他健康状况不佳的迹象。如果禁食几天后，你的同伴

仍然对他最喜欢的食物不屑一顾，那么就假设出了什么问题——即使他看起来很健康——然后去看兽医！

A gum or tooth infection, ulcers of the mouth, periods of strenuous exercise, or warm weather may cause

decreased appetite. Intestinal parasites, digestive ulcers, tumors or other masses, digestive flora imbalances, bacterial

or fungal infections, and liver dysfunction are just a few causes of appetite loss. Your companion also may be

depressed or simply bored with his diet. In other words, the possibilities are endless and some are life threatening. If

your companion isn’t eating and you can’t pinpoint the cause on your own within a few days, the best course of

action is to consult your holistic veterinarian for medical help.

牙龈或牙齿感染、口腔溃疡、剧烈运动或温暖的天气可能会导致食欲下降。肠道寄生虫、消化溃疡、肿

瘤或其他肿块、消化菌群失衡、细菌或真菌感染以及肝功能障碍只是食欲不振的几个原因。您的同伴也可

能感到沮丧或只是对自己的饮食感到厌倦。换句话说，可能性是无限的，有些甚至会危及生命。如果您的

同伴没有进食，并且您无法在几天内自行查明原因，最好的做法是咨询您的整体兽医寻求医疗帮助。

It’s difficult to generalize about how to approach appetite loss because the possible causes are too diverse and

extensive. It is safe to say, however, that vitamins, probiotics, and enzyme supplements play important roles in

animals who aren’t cleaning their plates. In addition, a few herbs stand out in their abilities to stimulate appetite and

improve nutrient absorption in the digestive systems of some animals. One such herb is yucca, which contains

saponin constituents that are believed to increase nutrient permeability in the small intestine while at the same time

stimulating appetite. By improving the absorption of nutrients, animals who are eating less are able to make the best

use of the food they do eat. Alfalfa is another herb to consider—it is nutritious and is also regarded as an appetite

stimulant in animals. Both yucca and alfalfa should be used in moderation (especially with horses), as they may

actually cause digestive upset or bloat if fed in too much abundance. Bitter herbs such as gentian, dandelion, and

Oregon grape may help get the digestive juices flowing to trigger an increase in appetite, as might peppermint,

fennel, or garlic.

很难一概而论如何应对食欲减退，因为可能的原因多种多样且广泛。然而，可以肯定地说，维生素、益

生菌和酶补充剂对于不清洁盘子的动物发挥着重要作用。此外，一些草药在刺激食欲和改善某些动物消化

系统营养吸收方面的能力也很突出。其中一种草药是丝兰，它含有皂苷成分，据信可以增加小肠的营养渗

透性，同时刺激食欲。通过改善营养物质的吸收，吃得较少的动物能够充分利用它们所吃的食物。苜蓿是

另一种值得考虑的草本植物，它营养丰富，也被认为是动物的食欲兴奋剂。丝兰和苜蓿都应适量使用（尤

其是马），因为如果喂食过多，它们实际上可能会导致消化不良或腹胀。龙胆、蒲公英和俄勒冈葡萄等苦

味药草可能有助于促进消化液流动，从而引发食欲增加，薄荷、茴香或大蒜也可能如此。

=== PAGE 422 ===
COLIC AND FLATULENCE

绞痛和胀气

The term colic is generic, referring to any condition that causes pain, inflammation, or other discomfort in the colon.

Most commonly, colic is caused by flatulence (trapped gas), which is usually associated with abdominal distention

and irritability. Colic is most often caused by something the animal ingested, but bacterial, fungal, or parasitic

infection may also be the cause, as could a deficiency in liver or gallbladder functions or an ulcer, a tumor, or an

injury somewhere in the digestive tract. Regardless of the onset, colic can be especially serious in horses—so serious

that herbs may not act fast enough to prevent a life-threatening situation. If your horse is suffering from colic, call

your vet immediately!

绞痛这个术语是通用的，指的是引起结肠疼痛、炎症或其他不适的任何病症。最常见的是，绞痛是由胀气

（滞留气体）引起的，胀气通常与腹胀和烦躁有关。绞痛通常是由动物摄入的东西引起的，但细菌、真菌

或寄生虫感染也可能是原因，肝脏或胆囊功能缺陷或消化道某处溃疡、肿瘤或损伤也可能是原因。无论是

何种原因，绞痛对马来说都可能特别严重，严重到草药可能无法足够快地发挥作用来防止危及生命的情

况。如果您的马患有绞痛，请立即致电您的兽医！

To find a long-term solution to colic (especially chronic, recurring cases), you must first identify the underlying

causes. Then and only then can a holistic, long-term solution be found. Until you find the answer, it is possible to

relieve the uncomfortable symptoms of colic with herbs. The first course of remedial action is to aid in the

elimination of excess gas and help reduce pain and spasms in the colon. Chamomile, fennel, dill, catnip, or

peppermint are all good choices for this. If inflammation appears to be part of the problem, slippery elm, plantain,

marshmallow, raspberry leaf, certified organic goldenseal, or nettle may help. If an ulcer is suspected, licorice lends

antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that are especially well suited for the problem. If giardiasis, E. coli,

or some other form of parasitic, bacterial, or fungal infection is part of the problem, consider combining Oregon

grape or goldenseal tincture with an equal amount of licorice tincture (0.5–1 milliliter for each 20 pounds of an

animal’s body weight, twice daily). This helps inhibit the invading microbes while speeding the healing of digestive

mucosa. Fresh echinacea can be especially helpful for horses suffering from colic of bacterial origin—allow the

animals to eat as much of the fresh plants (roots, flowers, and all) as they intuitively desire.

要找到绞痛（尤其是慢性、反复发作的病例）的长期解决方案，您必须首先找出根本原因。只有这样，

才能找到全面、长期的解决方案。在找到答案之前，可以用草药缓解绞痛的不适症状。第一个补救措施是

帮助消除多余的气体并帮助减轻结肠的疼痛和痉挛。洋甘菊、茴香、莳萝、猫薄荷或薄荷都是不错的选

择。如果炎症似乎是问题的一部分，滑榆、车前草、棉花糖、覆盆子叶、经过认证的有机金毛茛或荨麻可

能会有所帮助。如果怀疑有溃疡，甘草具有抗菌和抗炎特性，特别适合解决该问题。如果贾第鞭毛虫病、

大肠杆菌或其他形式的寄生虫、细菌或真菌感染是问题的一部分，请考虑将俄勒冈葡萄或金毛酊与等量的

甘草酊剂（每 20 磅甘草酊剂 0.5-1 毫升）混合使用。动物体重，每天两次）。这有助于抑制入侵的微生

物，同时加速消化粘膜的愈合。新鲜的紫锥菊对于患有细菌性肠绞痛的马特别有帮助——让动物按照它们

的直觉想要吃尽可能多的新鲜植物（根、花等等）。

=== PAGE 423 ===
Dill expels intestinal gas and soothes the stomach.

莳萝可以排出肠道气体并舒缓胃部。

=== PAGE 424 ===
DIARRHEA

腹泻

Diarrhea is caused by an overabundance of fluid entering the intestinal tract. This in turn can interfere with the

digestion process and may result in malabsorption and severe dehydration if left unaddressed. From a holistic

perspective, diarrhea is a by-product of systemic dysfunction or the body’s effort to deal with some form of excess.

Normally, nutrients pass through intestinal mucous membranes to enter the bloodstream. To aid in this metabolic

process, the membranes allow a measured amount of water, bile, and other digestive fluids to enter the intestinal

tract from the opposite direction (from the body). When too much fluid is allowed to enter the intestinal tract for

whatever reason, loose stool is the result. Conversely, when too little fluid is allowed into the intestinal tract,

constipation occurs.

腹泻是由于过多的液体进入肠道而引起的。如果不加以解决，这反过来会干扰消化过程，并可能导致吸收

不良和严重脱水。从整体角度来看，腹泻是全身功能障碍或身体努力处理某种形式的过量的副产品。正常

情况下，营养物质通过肠道粘膜进入血液。为了帮助这个代谢过程，膜允许一定量的水、胆汁和其他消化

液从相反方向（从身体）进入肠道。无论出于何种原因，当过多的液体进入肠道时，就会导致稀便。相

反，当进入肠道的液体太少时，就会发生便秘。

A BASIC FORMULA FOR COLIC

绞痛的基本配方

Combine the following ingredients either as teas, tinctures, or dried herbs:

将以下成分混合为茶、酊剂或干草药：

1 part fennel seed

1 份 茴香籽

1 part marshmallow root

1 份 棉花糖根

1 part chamomile

1 份 洋甘菊

An appropriate starting dose for most dogs is either 1 tablespoon of the dried herbs, 1 milliliter of a low-

alcohol tincture combination, or 2 tablespoons of a strong tea sprinkled on a small amount of food, twice

daily. Cats should receive half of the dog dose. Horses and other herbivores can be fed 2–4 cups of the dried

herbs or 4–8 cups of the fresh herbs daily.

对于大多数狗来说，合适的起始剂量是 1 汤匙干草药、1 毫升低酒精酊剂组合，或 2 汤匙浓茶撒在少

量食物上，每天两次。猫应接受狗剂量的一半。马和其他食草动物每天可以喂 2-4 杯干香草或 4-8 杯

新鲜香草。

The standard, symptomatic approach to diarrhea is to inhibit the entrance of fluid into the intestinal tract. This is

usually accomplished with the use of astringent herbs or drugs—those that cause contraction (shrinking) of mucous

membranes. By quickly shrinking intestinal membranes, excess fluid is prohibited from entering the digestive tract,

and the stool firms up. If herbs are the medicine of choice, those containing large amounts of tannin constituents,

such as uva ursi, rose bark, or white oak bark, are generally the quickest acting. The problem is that these and most

other “tannin heavyweights” can be irritating to the stomach and kidneys and therefore must be used only for a short

duration—about a day or two at a time. The better approach is to be patient. Try gentler astringents first, such as

chamomile or raspberry leaf. If these fail, try slippery elm or plantain (our favorite)—these herbs combine their

tannin constituents with the soothing and protecting effects of mucilage. If these herbs fail, try combining one of the

=== PAGE 425 ===
aforementioned astringents with an equal amount of marshmallow root. The soothing, mucilaginous quality of the

marshmallow helps moderate the irritating effect of the tannins.

治疗腹泻的标准对症方法是抑制液体进入肠道。这通常是通过使用收敛草药或药物来实现的，这些草药

或药物会导致粘膜收缩（收缩）。通过快速收缩肠膜，多余的液体被阻止进入消化道，粪便变硬。如果选

择草药，那么那些含有大量单宁成分的药物，如熊果、玫瑰树皮或白橡树皮，通常起效最快。问题是这些

和大多数其他“重量级单宁”可能会刺激胃和肾脏，因此只能短期使用——一次大约一两天。更好的方法是

要有耐心。首先尝试温和的收敛剂，例如洋甘菊或覆盆子叶。如果这些方法无效，请尝试滑榆或车前草

（我们最喜欢的）——这些草药将其单宁成分与粘液的舒缓和保护作用结合在一起。如果这些草药无效，

请尝试将上述收敛剂之一与等量的蜀葵根混合。棉花糖具有舒缓的粘液性质，有助于减轻单宁的刺激作

用。

With all of that said, it’s now time to reconsider the use of astringents altogether. Remember, the goal of holistic

herbal medicine is to assist the body in its abilities to correct and heal itself. When we use astringent herbs to treat

diarrhea, we are only suppressing the body’s response to deeper problems. Plus, we have to consider that the

diarrhea actually might be part of the body’s natural healing process. The bottom line is this: if your animal is

suffering from a sudden onset of diarrhea, try to make lifestyle arrangements that allow you to live with the situation

for a day or two—until it passes. Encourage your animal to drink plenty of water, restrict salt intake, and let nature

take its course. If bacterial infection or giardiasis is the suspected cause, Oregon grape or certified organic

goldenseal might help solve the problem.

话虽如此，现在是时候重新考虑收敛剂的使用了。请记住，整体草药的目标是帮助身体纠正和治愈自身

的能力。当我们使用收敛草药治疗腹泻时，我们只是抑制了身体对更深层次问题的反应。另外，我们必须

考虑到腹泻实际上可能是身体自然愈合过程的一部分。底线是：如果您的动物突然腹泻，请尝试做出生活

方式安排，让您能够忍受这种情况一两天，直到它过去。鼓励您的动物喝大量的水，限制盐的摄入量，顺

其自然。如果怀疑是细菌感染或贾第鞭毛虫病，俄勒冈葡萄或经过认证的有机金印草可能有助于解决问

题。

Regardless of what you might suspect, if the problem persists or worsens, take your companion to a holistic vet

for a thorough examination. At the very least, have the stool analyzed for the presence of blood, worms, or other

evidence of deeper health problems, and be sure that the animal is drinking plenty of water to avoid dehydration.

Once the underlying causes are identified, a holistic course of action can be directed at the root cause (not the

symptoms) of the problem.

无论您怀疑什么，如果问题持续存在或恶化，请带您的伴侣去看整体兽医进行彻底检查。至少，分析粪

便中是否存在血液、蠕虫或其他更深层次健康问题的证据，并确保动物喝大量的水以避免脱水。一旦确定

了根本原因，就可以针对问题的根本原因（而不是症状）采取整体行动。

A TONIC FORMULA FOR CHRONIC CONSTIPATION

治疗慢性便秘的滋补配方

Combine the following as either dried herbs, low-alcohol tinctures, or strong teas:

将以下物质混合为干草药、低酒精酊剂或浓茶：

2 parts dandelion root

2 份 蒲公英根

2 parts marshmallow root

2 份 棉花糖根

1 part Oregon grape

1 份 俄勒冈葡萄

1 part yellow dock

=== PAGE 426 ===
1 部分黄色码头

1 part fennel (to relieve any associated gas or griping)

1 份茴香（用于缓解任何相关气体或绞痛）

*This diet should be supplemented with flaxseed or psyllium husks.

*这种饮食应补充亚麻籽或车前子壳。

For dogs, try 1 teaspoon of the strong, combined, cooled teas or 1 milliliter of the tincture per 30 pounds of

对于狗，每 30 磅体重尝试 1 茶匙浓混合冷茶或 1 毫升酊剂，每天 2 到 3 次。

Cats can receive ¼ to ½ teaspoon of the strong, combined, cooled teas or 0.25–0.50 milliliters of the

每 15 磅体重，猫可以喝 1/4 到 1/2 茶匙浓茶或 0.25–0.50 毫升酊剂，每天 2 到 3 次。
