CONSTIPATION

便秘

Constipation is usually caused when the body is unable to fully digest food or when other materials cause a

blockage. If an animal is receiving a healthy, well-balanced diet, constipation should not be a problem, and contrary

to what many conventional dog and cat care texts may say, a healthy diet should include fresh raw bones from an

organic source, if possible. The idea that raw bones cause digestive blockages in dogs and cats is untrue, at least if

the animal is healthy to start with. Carnivores are naturally designed to digest and metabolize bones. If they can’t

digest them and constipation occurs, it’s because their digestive system is not working efficiently (or perhaps they’re

eating too many bones).

便秘通常是由于身体无法完全消化食物或其他物质造成堵塞而引起的。如果动物接受健康、均衡的饮食，

便秘就不应该成为问题，而且与许多传统的狗和猫护理文本可能所说的相反，如果可能的话，健康的饮食

应该包括来自有机来源的新鲜生骨头。生骨头会导致狗和猫消化道阻塞的想法是不正确的，至少在动物一

开始就健康的情况下是这样。食肉动物天生就具有消化和代谢骨骼的能力。如果他们无法消化它们并发生

便秘，那是因为他们的消化系统无法有效工作（或者可能他们吃了太多骨头）。

In treating constipation, the first step is to rule out the possibility that your companion ate something he shouldn’t

have—such as a piece of wood; pine needles; some tough dry grass; or perhaps that heirloom tapestry that was

handed down through your family for fifteen generations. If ingestion of “something different” is ruled out, then

look deeper for some sort of interrelated problem. Start with a thorough reevaluation of diet and make sure that your

animal is receiving the enzymes and probiotics needed for healthy digestive flora. Try feeding your companion some

organic, live-cultured yogurt. Eating yogurt activates reproduction of digestive flora and often has quick and natural

laxative effects. If the animal is straining to pass stool, then some ground flaxseed, psyllium husk, or marshmallow

root might help lubricate the intestines. Feed 1/4 teaspoon of any of these herbs for each 20 pounds of an animal’s

weight along with plenty of water. Fresh chickweed can be fed to horses, goats, llamas, dogs, cats, birds, and other

animals for a gentle laxative and soothing effect.

治疗便秘的第一步是排除你的同伴吃了不该吃的东西的可能性，比如一块木头；松针;一些坚韧的干草；

或者也许是你家族传了十五代的传家宝挂毯。如果排除了摄入“不同的东西”，那么就更深入地寻找某种相

互关联的问题。首先彻底重新评估饮食，确保您的动物获得健康消化菌群所需的酶和益生菌。尝试给你的

同伴喂一些有机的、活培养的酸奶。吃酸奶可以激活消化菌群的繁殖，通常具有快速、自然的通便作用。

如果动物排便费力，那么一些磨碎的亚麻籽、洋车前子壳或药蜀葵根可能有助于润滑肠道。每 20 磅体重的

动物喂食 1/4 茶匙这些草药以及大量的水。新鲜的繁缕可以喂马、山羊、美洲驼、狗、猫、鸟类和其他动

物，具有温和的通便和舒缓作用。

Chronic constipation is often a cumulative effect of liver or gallbladder congestion or dysfunction. If bile

production is reduced in the liver, or if the gallbladder or a bile duct is blocked by solid waste or inflammation, then

the digestive tract cannot receive the chemicals it needs to effectively break down food materials. The result is

constipation. Again, this condition is usually caused by one or more elements of the diet (such as low-grade protein

or too much fat) that cannot be effectively digested and metabolized. Aside from a change in diet, the herbal

approach is to improve bile production and transport with cholagogue herbs such as dandelion root and Oregon

grape. If the problem is believed to be associated with liver damage or inflammation, milk thistle, turmeric, or

licorice should be added to the program to help protect and regenerate liver cells. Essential fatty acids, such as those

found in the oils of flaxseed, evening primrose, and borage, serve critical roles in liver repair as well.

慢性便秘通常是肝脏或胆囊充血或功能障碍的累积效应。如果肝脏中的胆汁产生减少，或者胆囊或胆管

被固体废物或炎症堵塞，那么消化道就无法接收有效分解食物所需的化学物质。结果就是便秘。同样，这

种情况通常是由饮食中的一种或多种元素（例如低级蛋白质或过多的脂肪）无法有效消化和代谢引起的。

除了改变饮食之外，草药方法还包括使用蒲公英根和俄勒冈葡萄等利胆草药来改善胆汁的产生和运输。如

果问题被认为与肝脏损伤或炎症有关，则应在计划中添加水飞蓟、姜黄或甘草，以帮助保护和再生肝细

胞。必需脂肪酸，例如亚麻籽油、月见草油和琉璃苣油中的脂肪酸，在肝脏修复中也发挥着关键作用。

By now you may have noticed that we have not mentioned the use of laxative herbs. This is because constipation

is almost always a by-product of a deeper problem for which a laxative can serve only as a symptomatic quick fix.

=== PAGE 428 ===
The strongest laxative herbs are those containing anthraquinone constituents. Anthraquinones stimulate peristalsis—

spasmodic smooth-muscle contractions of the bowels. In effect, these spasms force stool out of the body, causing

uncomfortable cramping, griping pain, gas, and loss of smooth-muscle tone. With long-term use, laxatives can even

cause digestive dependency (i.e., your animal will not be able to pass stool without the laxative). Since the holistic

approach to animal health is focused on assisting (as opposed to forcing) the body with its natural functions, strong

laxatives such as senna, aloe, cascara sagrada, and turkey rhubarb should be reserved for times when all else fails

and bowel movement is an immediate necessity. Before resorting to any of these herbs, give yellow dock a try.

Although it too contains considerable amounts of anthraquinones, it tends to be much more gentle, and it imparts

liver and digestive stimulating qualities that add to its value in treating constipation. We find it especially effective

when used in small proportions with liver tonic herbs, such as dandelion root.

现在您可能已经注意到我们没有提到使用泻药草药。这是因为便秘几乎总是更深层次问题的副产品，而

泻药只能作为症状的快速解决方案。最强的泻药草药是含有蒽醌成分的草药。蒽醌会刺激蠕动——肠道平

滑肌的痉挛性收缩。实际上，这些痉挛迫使粪便排出体外，导致不舒服的痉挛、绞痛、胀气和平滑肌张力

丧失。长期使用泻药甚至会导致消化依赖性（即，如果没有泻药，您的动物将无法排便）。由于动物健康

的整体方法侧重于帮助（而不是强迫）身体发挥其自然功能，因此应在其他方法均无效且排便困难时保留

番泻叶、芦荟、鼠李皮和火鸡大黄等强效泻药是迫在眉睫的需要。在使用任何这些草药之前，请尝试一下

黄坞。虽然它也含有大量的蒽醌，但它往往更加温和，并且具有刺激肝脏和消化的特性，增加了其治疗便

秘的价值。我们发现它与蒲公英根等补肝药以小比例一起使用时特别有效。

Finally, when encountering constipation in pregnant animals, the safest approach is to avoid anything that

contains anthraquinones. Instead, look to marshmallow, chickweed, flaxseed, or psyllium husks to provide colonic

lubrication without stressing the reproductive organs or the fetus.

最后，当怀孕动物出现便秘时，最安全的方法是避免任何含有蒽醌的物质。相反，可以使用棉花糖、繁

缕、亚麻籽或洋车前子壳来润滑结肠，而不会对生殖器官或胎儿造成压力。

Horses and other herbivores seldom get constipated, but they commonly suffer from various other forms of colic.

When these animals do get constipated, it’s usually attributable to poor-quality feed or forage or to the ingestion of

sand, gravel, and other nonorganic materials. In these circumstances, dietary supplementation with a few

tablespoons of ground or finely chopped marshmallow, flaxseed, or psyllium husks usually assist with elimination.

马和其他食草动物很少便秘，但它们通常患有各种其他形式的绞痛。当这些动物确实出现便秘时，通常

是由于饲料或草料质量差，或者摄入沙子、砾石和其他无机材料。在这种情况下，在饮食中添加几汤匙磨

碎或切碎的棉花糖、亚麻籽或车前子壳通常有助于消除。

HAIR BALLS

毛球

Anyone who has been licked by a cat knows that felines have rough, “barbed” tongues. This makes it difficult for

them to spit hair out after each of their hundred or so daily baths, so they must swallow the hair. This in turn may

lead to vomiting and the possibility of intestinal obstructions.

任何被猫舔过的人都知道，猫科动物的舌头很粗糙，带有“倒刺”。这使得他们每天洗澡一百次左右之后很

难吐出头发，所以他们必须把头发吞下去。这反过来可能导致呕吐和肠梗阻的可能性。

One conventional approach to hair balls is to feed the affected cat some petroleum jelly, a practice we feel is

especially dangerous because the jelly, being totally insoluble in water, can be aspirated into the lungs of a choking

or vomiting cat and cause life-threatening pneumonia. Other approaches employ laxatives, the theory being that the

hair balls can be expeditiously eliminated out the opposite end of the kitty. Again we frown—the poor cat is having

a tough enough time without suffering a caretaker-induced case of intestinal cramping and diarrhea.

解决毛球的一种传统方法是给受影响的猫喂一些凡士林，我们认为这种做法特别危险，因为完全不溶于

水的凡士林可能会被吸入窒息或呕吐的猫的肺部，从而危及生命。肺炎。其他方法使用泻药，其理论是毛

球可以迅速从小猫的另一端排出。我们再次皱起眉头——这只可怜的猫已经过得很艰难了，没有遭受看护

人引起的肠道痉挛和腹泻的情况。

Fortunately, there are some safe and effective actions you can take to help your feline eliminate hair balls more

easily. Foremost is a well-balanced, raw food diet. Raw meats, bones, and vegetables contain the fiber and roughage

necessary to bind with ingested hair and carry it out of the body. Giving ¼ teaspoon of bran, psyllium husks, or

ground flaxseed also provides fiber and lubricating mucilage to help remove hair balls. Giving ½ teaspoon of

marshmallow root tea or 12–20 drops of the glycerin tincture will likely help lubricate the process as well. If your

cat will eat marshmallow root au natural, ¼–½ teaspoon of fresh or dried root can be finely chopped and added to

Kitty’s food for a similar effect. Adding a teaspoon of olive oil to the food can be helpful too.

幸运的是，您可以采取一些安全有效的措施来帮助您的猫更轻松地消除毛球。最重要的是均衡的生食饮

食。生肉、骨头和蔬菜含有与摄入的毛发结合并将其排出体外所必需的纤维和粗饲料。给予 1/4 茶匙的麸

皮、车前子壳或磨碎的亚麻籽也可以提供纤维和润滑粘液，帮助去除毛球。给予 ½ 茶匙棉花糖根茶或 12-

20 滴甘油酊剂也可能有助于润滑该过程。如果您的猫喜欢吃天然的棉花糖根，则可以将 1/4-1/2 茶匙新鲜或

干燥的根切碎并添加到猫咪的食物中，以获得类似的效果。在食物中添加一茶匙橄榄油也有帮助。

For rabbits who get intestinal obstructions of fur, a common practice by some rabbit caretakers is to feed

pineapple juice to “melt” the fur away. The fur passing more easily is probably due to the enzymatic action of the

juice, and supplementing with digestive enzymes would most likely work in a similar fashion when used as a

preventative.

对于因毛皮引起肠梗阻的兔子，一些兔子饲养员的常见做法是喂菠萝汁来“融化”毛皮。毛皮更容易通过

可能是由于果汁的酶作用，并且补充消化酶当用作预防剂时很可能以类似的方式发挥作用。

INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE

炎症性肠病

Inflammatory bowel disease and colitis involve mucosal inflammation of the colon. Animals with inflammatory

bowel disease often suffer from severe diarrhea, labored or painful bowel movements, gastric distention, and rectal

bleeding or mucus discharge. In cats, the problem is sometimes labeled Crohn’s disease. Causes are often difficult to

pinpoint, even with the best diagnostic methods. Immune system disorders, circulatory impairment in the intestinal

tract, parasitic infections, defects in permeability of the intestinal wall, dietary sensitivities, or adverse drug reactions

are all part of a long list of causative possibilities.

炎症性肠病和结肠炎涉及结肠粘膜炎症。患有炎症性肠病的动物经常患有严重腹泻、排便费力或疼痛、胃

扩张以及直肠出血或粘液排出。对于猫来说，这个问题有时被称为克罗恩病。即使使用最好的诊断方法，

通常也很难查明原因。免疫系统紊乱、肠道循环障碍、寄生虫感染、肠壁通透性缺陷、饮食敏感性或药物

不良反应都是一长串致病可能性的一部分。

Conventional approaches to inflammatory bowel disease include feeding a controlled diet that may include

supplemental dietary fiber and the use of corticosteroids and other immunosuppressive drugs. In cats, inflammation

is often treated with sulfasalazine (Azulfidine), a compound that is also used in humans for similar disorders.

炎症性肠病的传统方法包括控制饮食，其中可能包括补充膳食纤维以及使用皮质类固醇和其他免疫抑制

药物。对于猫来说，炎症通常用柳氮磺吡啶（Azulfidine）来治疗，这种化合物也用于人类治疗类似的疾

病。

Natural therapies usually start with adjustments in diet and supplementation with vitamins and probiotics that

support digestion and moderate immune system activities. A daily regimen of n-acetylglucosamine (250–1,500

milligrams), glutamine (250–3,000 milligrams), Lactobacillus acidophilus (20–500 million microorganisms),

proanthocyanidin complex (10–200 milligrams), dimethylglycine (50–250 milligrams), and vitamin C (250–3000

milligrams) represents one suggested nutritional therapy for dogs and cats. Papaya supplements may also prove

beneficial in improving digestion, but care must be taken to assure that any or all of these supplements do not cause

or worsen diarrhea.

自然疗法通常从调整饮食和补充维生素和益生菌开始，以支持消化和适度的免疫系统活动。每日方案包

括 N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖（250–1,500 毫克）、谷氨酰胺（250–3,000 毫克）、嗜酸乳杆菌（20–5 亿微生物）、

原花青素复合物（10–200 毫克）、二甲基甘氨酸（50–250 毫克）和维生素 C（250-3000 毫克）是一种建议

的狗和猫营养疗法。木瓜补充剂也可能有助于改善消化，但必须注意确保任何或所有这些补充剂不会引起

或加重腹泻。

The symptoms of inflammatory bowel disease can often be relieved with the same herbs we recommend for

treating gastritis. Because reduction of mucosal inflammation is of critical importance, anti-inflammatory and

demulcent herbs such as licorice, slippery elm, plantain, marshmallow, flaxseed, and psyllium husks may be

especially useful. Aloe vera juice or calendula may also relieve the discomforts of inflammatory bowel disease.

Certified organic goldenseal may help to reduce mucosal inflammation. Astragalus is well suited for immune

support in cases in which infection may be involved because it tends not to overstimulate the immune system when

an increased autoimmune response may already be a contributing factor in the inflammation.

使用我们推荐的治疗胃炎的相同草药通常可以缓解炎症性肠病的症状。由于减少粘膜炎症至关重要，因

此抗炎和缓和药草如甘草、滑榆、车前草、棉花糖、亚麻籽和洋车前子壳可能特别有用。芦荟汁或金盏花

也可以缓解炎症性肠病的不适。经过认证的有机金印草可能有助于减少粘膜炎症。黄芪非常适合在可能涉

及感染的情况下提供免疫支持，因为当自身免疫反应增加可能已经成为炎症的一个促成因素时，黄芪往往

不会过度刺激免疫系统。

LEAKY GUT SYNDROME (INTESTINAL DYSBIOSIS AND HYPERPERMEABILITY)

肠漏综合征（肠道功能失调和高渗透性）

Leaky gut is a term used for a condition in which food compounds abnormally permeate intestinal barriers to enter

the bloodstream. Oftentimes, this leads to an immediate defensive attack by the immune system and severe food

allergies. In some cases, systemic infection, arthritis, seborrhea, or other forms of autoimmune disease may result.

肠漏是指食物化合物异常渗透肠道屏障进入血液的病症。通常，这会导致免疫系统立即发起防御性攻击和

严重的食物过敏。在某些情况下，可能会导致全身感染、关节炎、皮脂溢或其他形式的自身免疫性疾病。

Leaky gut syndrome has many causes, any number of which may be secondary to another. Poor diet; excessive

use of antibiotic drugs; or bacterial, parasitic, or fungal infections may alter digestive flora to the point that intestinal

mucosal barriers will be vulnerable and weakened by certain food-carried chemicals. The problem may also be

caused by chronic inflammatory bowel disease—when the intestinal mucosa is inflamed, its structural integrity may

be altered in a way that allows unusually large food particles, bacteria, parasites, fungi (such as Candida albicans),

or protozoa to cross intestineblood barriers.

肠漏综合症有很多原因，其中任何一个都可能继发于另一个。不良的饮食习惯;过度使用抗生素药物；细

菌、寄生虫或真菌感染可能会改变消化菌群，导致肠粘膜屏障因某些食物携带的化学物质而变得脆弱和削

弱。该问题也可能是由慢性炎症性肠病引起的——当肠粘膜发炎时，其结构完整性可能会发生改变，从而

导致异常大的食物颗粒、细菌、寄生虫、真菌（如白色念珠菌）或原生动物进入肠道。跨越肠血屏障。

The most effective approach to avoid leaky gut is with a natural diet that contains all of the probiotic elements

necessary for healthy digestive flora, structure, and function. Research has shown that glutamine, a fatty acid

component, plays important roles in maintaining gut tonicity, thus reducing the possibility of leaky gut. One study

concluded that animals deprived of glutamine were more likely to suffer sepsis, bacterial infection of the blood.

避免肠漏的最有效方法是采用天然饮食，其中含有健康消化菌群、结构和功能所需的所有益生菌元素。

研究表明，谷氨酰胺（一种脂肪酸成分）在维持肠道张力方面发挥着重要作用，从而减少肠漏的可能性。

一项研究得出结论，缺乏谷氨酰胺的动物更容易患败血症，即血液细菌感染。

Leaky gut can be progressive and debilitating shortly after onset. The holistic approach toward correcting the

problem is to provide supplemental measures of digestive probiotics to build intestinal flora and strengthen mucosal

barriers. Plantain, marshmallow, raspberry leaf, certified organic goldenseal, and chamomile can be used to reduce

inflammation, tonify intestinal mucosa, and provide an additional barrier against invading microbes. Flaxseed is also

strongly indicated, as it provides soothing, cleansing, and protective mucilage and fiber constituents as well as an

added measure of mucosa-strengthening omega-3 fatty acids.

肠漏症在发病后不久可能会逐渐恶化并导致患者衰弱。解决这个问题的整体方法是提供消化益生菌的补

充措施，以建立肠道菌群并增强粘膜屏障。车前草、棉花糖、覆盆子叶、经过认证的有机白毛茛和洋甘菊

可用于减少炎症、增强肠粘膜，并提供额外的屏障，防止微生物入侵。亚麻籽也受到强烈推荐，因为它提

供舒缓、清洁和保护性的粘液和纤维成分，以及增强粘膜的 omega-3 脂肪酸。

EAR PROBLEMS

耳朵问题

Ear problems most commonly come in the form of bacterial or fungal infections, mites, fleas, or foreign objects

(foxtails, dirt, etc.) lodged in the ear canal. Some other common problems include hematoma of the earflap and

tumors of the inner ear.

耳朵问题最常见的形式是细菌或真菌感染、螨虫、跳蚤或异物（狐尾草、污垢等）滞留在耳道中。其他一

些常见问题包括耳瓣血肿和内耳肿瘤。

Mullein flower, Oregon grape, garlic, marshmallow, ginkgo, and yarrow are especially well suited for treating

infections and parasite infestations of the ear. Mullein flower, garlic, and Oregon grape are all strong antimicrobials

with strong affinities toward inhibition of mites and various pathogens that may cause ear problems. The slippery

oily mucilage of marshmallow root provides soothing relief and a protective, antimicrobial barrier on inflamed

tissues of the outer ear. Yarrow is especially useful for treating small hematomas of the earflap. Used externally, the

oil helps strengthen exterior capillary walls, while internal doses of yarrow and ginkgo tea or tincture improve

capillary circulation and internal tonicity. Witch hazel may also be effective for external treatment of earflap

hematomas, as its strong astringency quickly constricts weak or inflamed blood vessels.

毛蕊花、俄勒冈葡萄、大蒜、棉花糖、银杏和西洋蓍草特别适合治疗耳朵感染和寄生虫感染。毛蕊花、

大蒜和俄勒冈葡萄都是强效抗菌剂，对抑制螨虫和各种可能导致耳朵问题的病原体有很强的亲和力。棉花

糖根滑溜溜的油性粘液可以舒缓疼痛，并为外耳发炎组织提供保护性抗菌屏障。西洋蓍草对于治疗耳瓣的

小血肿特别有用。外用时，该油有助于增强外毛细血管壁，而内服西洋蓍草和银杏茶或酊剂可改善毛细血

管循环和内部张力。金缕梅对于耳瓣血肿的外部治疗也可能有效，因为它具有很强的收敛性，可以迅速收

缩脆弱或发炎的血管。

ELDERLY ANIMAL CARE

老年动物护理

What is considered old for a pet? We know that to a certain degree longevity varies with the type, size, and breed of

an animal. For example, a small dog may live into his teens, while a larger breed of dog may be entering his golden

years at only seven or eight years of age. But for those of us who strive to understand what life must be like from the

animal’s perspective, a different question comes to mind: What would our pets themselves regard as old age?

对于宠物来说什么才算老？我们知道，在某种程度上，寿命因动物的类型、大小和品种而异。例如，一只

小狗可能会活到十几岁，而较大品种的狗可能只有七八岁就进入了黄金时期。但对于我们这些努力从动物

的角度理解生活是什么样子的人来说，一个不同的问题浮现在脑海中：我们的宠物自己会认为什么是老

年？

We all grow old. Various body parts become fatigued from oxidation and wear and tear, systemic efficiency

begins to decline, and certain bodily functions simply don’t work as well as they used to. But how much of the aging

process is actually relative to time and physiological degeneration, and how much is the result of surrendering to the

thought of being old and feeble? We raise this question on behalf of the animals who have taught us just how

carefree and fun the latter part of life can really be. Unlike humans, animals age without even considering the

concepts of mortality and personal vanity, and those of us who pay close enough attention to them can gain some

precious insight about what being old really means.

我们都会变老。身体的各个部位因氧化和磨损而变得疲劳，全身效率开始下降，某些身体功能根本无法

像以前那样发挥作用。但衰老过程有多少实际上与时间和生理退化有关，有多少是屈服于年老体弱的想法

的结果？我们代表动物们提出这个问题，它们教会了我们生命的后半段是多么无忧无虑和有趣。与人类不

同，动物在衰老时甚至不考虑死亡和个人虚荣的概念，而我们这些对它们足够关注的人可以对衰老的真正

含义获得一些宝贵的见解。

For humans, old age is as much a product of mind-set as it is of physical circumstances. To animals, the entire

idea of “yielding to the wheels of time” does not apply—an elderly animal does not live in anticipation of death but

in celebration of life. As his human guardians roll their tired old bodies out of bed in the morning and moan, groan,

and complain about their hemorrhoids, the elderly dog waits by the door virtually shouting, “Who cares about not

having teeth anymore? There’s a squirrel out there and it’s near my doghouse! Let’s go get him!” There are some

powerful lessons about life and happiness here.

对于人类来说，衰老既是心态的产物，也是身体环境的产物。对于动物来说，“屈服于时间之轮”的整个

理念并不适用——年老的动物不会生活在对死亡的期待中，而是在庆祝生命。当他的人类监护人早上把疲

惫的身体从床上滚起来，呻吟、呻吟、抱怨自己的痔疮时，这只老狗在门口等着，几乎在喊道：“谁在乎没

有牙齿了？那里有一只松鼠，它就在我的狗屋附近！我们去找他吧！”这里有一些关于生活和幸福的有力教

训。

Chronic diseases are often disregarded as just a part of growing old. In fact, many pet owners see their animals’

old age as a downhill slide to inevitable suffering and death. As a result of this mind-set, countless numbers of

animals are euthanized not because their time has naturally passed but because their guardians are fearful of

watching the animals grow old and die a natural death. Granted, it’s difficult to live in anticipation of a companion’s

death, but all things considered, this is really our problem, not theirs.

慢性病常常被视为衰老的一部分而被忽视。事实上，许多宠物主人将他们的动物的老年视为不可避免的

痛苦和死亡的下滑。由于这种心态，无数的动物被安乐死，不是因为它们的生命已经自然流逝，而是因为

它们的监护人害怕看着动物变老并自然死亡。诚然，生活在同伴死亡的预期中是很困难的，但综合考虑，

这确实是我们的问题，而不是他们的问题。

=== PAGE 436 ===
Providing your pet with a healthful diet, holistic lifestyle, and a lifetime of love can help him enjoy his later years.

为您的宠物提供健康的饮食、整体的生活方式和一生的爱可以帮助他享受晚年。

The fact that an animal is growing old and becoming more susceptible to illness does not automatically predispose

him to chronic disease, it just means that he needs some added care and attention. With your loving support, your

old best friend can enjoy life right up to his last day.

动物变老并且更容易生病的事实并不自动使其容易患慢性病，这只意味着它需要额外的照顾和关注。在

您的关爱支持下，您最好的老朋友可以享受生活直到生命的最后一天。

We are firm believers that animals who receive plenty of love and attention, a wholesome homemade diet, a

minimum of vaccinations, and holistic measures of health care throughout their lives can beat the odds of longevity

set by genetics, breeding, and physical size. By affording them the elements of sustained health and well-being,

animals reward us before and after they pass from our lives. They leave us with the peace of mind that comes from

knowing that their lives were totally fulfilled by kindhearted and respectful human beings who cared enough to

allow them to live and age gracefully and innocently—as animals do.

我们坚信，如果动物在一生中得到充足的爱和关注、健康的自制饮食、最少的疫苗接种以及全面的医疗

保健措施，那么它们就能超越由遗传、繁殖和体型决定的长寿几率。通过为它们提供持续健康和福祉的要

素，动物在它们离开我们的生命之前和之后都会奖励我们。他们给我们留下了心灵的平静，因为我们知道

他们的生活完全是由善良和尊重的人类所实现的，这些人类足够关心他们，让他们像动物一样优雅而天真

地生活和衰老。

=== PAGE 437 ===
HERBAL THERAPIES

草药疗法

Most chronic problems seen in elderly animals are the results of poor or incomplete nutrition. Liver problems,

chronic renal failure, diabetes, arthritis and hip dysplasia, and neurological problems (such as canine cognitive

dysfunction) are just a few of the conditions that may be prevented by lifelong good nutrition. Tailor a dietary

program to your companion’s specific needs as early as possible. Each month of nutritional deficiency can trim

healthy years from the latter end of your animal’s life. A holistic veterinarian can assist you in determining the

proper diet and nutrients for the age, physical condition, and lifestyle of your companion.

老年动物的大多数慢性问题都是营养不良或不完整的结果。肝脏问题、慢性肾功能衰竭、糖尿病、关节炎

和髋关节发育不良以及神经系统问题（例如犬认知功能障碍）只是终身良好营养可以预防的一些疾病。尽

早根据您同伴的具体需求定制饮食计划。每个月的营养缺乏都会缩短动物生命后期的健康年数。整体兽医

可以帮助您根据伴侣的年龄、身体状况和生活方式确定适当的饮食和营养。

In older animals, herbs are especially useful for providing added support to body functions and systems that are

becoming less efficient. Nothing can compare with spirulina or other forms of blue-green algae for tonic nutritional

support of an aging body. Astragalus is an especially well-suited general tonic for older animals because it provides

a measured degree of immune system support while also strengthening the animal’s resistance to stress. Garlic

serves this purpose as well, but added care must be exercised in assuring that it does not cause digestive upset in

elderly animals.

对于老年动物来说，草药对于为效率较低的身体功能和系统提供额外支持特别有用。对于衰老身体的滋

补营养支持来说，没有什么能与螺旋藻或其他形式的蓝绿藻相比。黄芪是一种特别适合老年动物的普通补

品，因为它可以提供一定程度的免疫系统支持，同时还能增强动物对压力的抵抗力。大蒜也有这个作用，

但必须格外小心，以确保它不会导致老年动物消化不良。

The liver and digestive organs endure a lifetime of abusive environmental toxins and systemic waste materials, so

it stands to reason that they will eventually begin to fail in the later years of life. To support liver and digestive

functions, an animal’s diet should be frequently reevaluated and adjusted as needed to accommodate any reduction

in these organs’ metabolic capacities. Additionally, digestion and waste elimination can be improved with digestive

enzymes and mild liver stimulants, such as dandelion or burdock root. These help with the removal of solid wastes

from the body while increasing the production of bile and digestive enzymes. Marshmallow root, fed fresh, dried, or

in any form of low-alcohol liquid, aids in the passage of stool by providing a protective, anti-inflammatory, and

lubricating barrier to the intestinal mucosa. Flaxseed or psyllium husks work in a similar manner as well.

肝脏和消化器官终其一生都承受着滥用的环境毒素和全身废物，因此理所当然地，它们最终将在生命的

晚年开始衰竭。为了支持肝脏和消化功能，应经常重新评估和调整动物的饮食，以适应这些器官代谢能力

的任何降低。此外，消化酶和温和的肝脏兴奋剂（例如蒲公英或牛蒡根）可以改善消化和废物消除。这些

有助于清除体内的固体废物，同时增加胆汁和消化酶的产生。新鲜、干燥或以任何形式的低酒精液体喂养

的棉花糖根，通过为肠粘膜提供保护性、抗炎和润滑屏障来帮助粪便通过。亚麻籽或洋车前子壳也有类似

的作用。

The kidneys have a difficult life too because they must filter and eliminate waste from the blood over the course

of a lifetime. Over time they may become scarred and dysfunctional from repetitive infections, stones, and other

damaging influences that may or may not have been detected earlier. To increase urinary efficiency and help

strengthen mucous membranes in the urinary tract, a tea of dandelion leaf, nettle, cleavers, or parsley leaf can be

added to the animal’s drinking water—just enough to noticeably tint the water. Giving one of these herbs provides

alterative qualities that the animal’s body can selectively utilize to eliminate waste and maintain clean, well-

nourished blood. This can be done every day for the remainder of the animal’s life.

肾脏的生活也很困难，因为它们必须在一生中过滤和消除血液中的废物。随着时间的推移，它们可能会

因反复感染、结石和其他可能或可能未被早期发现的破坏性影响而变得伤痕累累和功能障碍。为了提高排

尿效率并帮助强化尿道粘膜，可以在动物的饮用水中添加蒲公英叶、荨麻、切肉刀或欧芹叶的茶——足以

使水明显着色。给予其中一种草药可以提供替代特性，动物的身体可以选择性地利用这些特性来消除废物

并保持清洁、营养良好的血液。在动物的余生中，每天都可以这样做。

=== PAGE 438 ===
If the animal displays early symptoms of renal failure, twice-daily doses of ginkgo and hawthorn help to improve

blood circulation and reduce blood pressure in the kidneys, while corn silk, marshmallow, and plantain help to

reduce any inflammation.

如果动物出现肾衰竭的早期症状，每天两次剂量的银杏和山楂有助于改善血液循环并降低肾脏血压，而

玉米须、棉花糖和车前草则有助于减少炎症。

Oatstraw serves as an excellent nervous system tonic that can be fed daily to help improve and regulate nerve

transmission. In animals who display diminished mental clarity or odd behavior that is attributable to brain

dysfunction (e.g., cognitive dysfunction in canines) blood circulation and neurological functions of the brain can be

assisted and sometimes improved with the use of ginkgo, gotu kola, or peppermint. In certain cases, Saint-John’s-

wort may be beneficial as well, but this determination should be made by a holistic veterinarian who is familiar with

your animal.

燕麦秸秆是一种极好的神经系统补品，可以每天食用，以帮助改善和调节神经传递。对于由于大脑功能

障碍（例如犬科动物的认知功能障碍）而表现出精神清晰度下降或行为奇怪的动物，可以通过使用银杏、

积雪草或薄荷来帮助甚至有时改善大脑的血液循环和神经功能。在某些情况下，圣约翰草也可能有益，但

这一决定应由熟悉您的动物的整体兽医做出。

Aches, pains, and loss of mobility that result from joint and connective tissue degeneration may be relieved with

supplements of glucosamine or chondroitin sulfate, horsetail, or yucca root. In cases of arthritis flare-ups, licorice,

devil’s claw, or boswellia may bring symptomatic relief.

补充葡萄糖胺或硫酸软骨素、问荆或丝兰根可以缓解因关节和结缔组织变性而导致的疼痛和活动能力丧

失。如果关节炎发作，甘草、魔爪草或乳香可能会缓解症状。

Cardiovascular efficiency can be supported with daily supplementation of hawthorn berries. If circulatory

impairment is evident in the legs, ears, or tail of the animal, ginkgo, yarrow, or cayenne may be of assistance. The

Animal Essentials dry herb and vitamin formula is also a good broad-spectrum daily supplement.

每天补充山楂浆果可以支持心血管效率。如果动物的腿、耳朵或尾巴有明显的循环障碍，银杏、西洋蓍

草或辣椒可能会有帮助。 Animal Essentials 干草本和维生素配方也是一种很好的广谱日常补充剂。

=== PAGE 439 ===
WHEN THE END IS NEAR

当末日临近时

If your companion receives a good diet, plenty of exercise, and a lot of loving attention, chances are excellent that he

will live happily to a ripe old age. However, any animal guardian must be prepared for the inevitable end. This can

involve the need for you to make the weighty and difficult decision of whether your pet’s death should be kindly

assisted. This choice is ultimately up to you, and there’s no easy way around it. Recently, there has been some

interest in hospices for animals, similar to the hospices we are familiar with for people. Vets become involved in the

hospice-care team and help teach a caregiver how to maintain and care for an animal who is dying in the home. It

can make the dying experience much less confusing for both the animal and his guardian.

如果你的伴侣得到良好的饮食、充足的锻炼和大量的关爱，他很有可能会幸福地活到晚年。然而，任何动

物守护者都必须为不可避免的结局做好准备。这可能涉及您需要做出重大而困难的决定：您的宠物的死亡

是否应该得到善意协助。这个选择最终取决于你，并且没有简单的方法可以解决。最近，人们对动物临终

关怀产生了一些兴趣，类似于我们熟悉的人类临终关怀。兽医加入临终关怀团队，帮助教导护理人员如何

饲养和照顾家中垂死的动物。它可以让动物和他的监护人在临终时的经历不再那么困惑。

=== PAGE 440 ===
ENDOCRINE SYSTEM AND RELATED PROBLEMS

内分泌系统及相关问题

The endocrine system consists of glandular organs and structures that are situated throughout the body, each of

which produces and secretes specific hormones and other substances for distribution via the blood or lymph. The

specific substances produced by the various components of the endocrine system play key roles in activating or

regulating organ functions and countless other metabolic activities and balances throughout the body. If one or more

components of this complex and interrelated system fails, a chain reaction of dysfunction can be triggered

throughout the body.

内分泌系统由遍布全身的腺体器官和结构组成，每个腺体器官和结构都会产生和分泌特定的激素和其他物

质，并通过血液或淋巴液进行分配。内分泌系统各组成部分产生的特定物质在激活或调节器官功能以及全

身无数其他代谢活动和平衡方面发挥着关键作用。如果这个复杂且相互关联的系统的一个或多个组成部分

发生故障，就会引发整个身体功能障碍的连锁反应。

Because endocrine system diseases and disorders can affect a wide variety of organs and functions throughout the

body, such conditions are easily misdiagnosed and often written off as behavioral disorders or dietary problems. The

insidious nature of endocrine disease is compounded by its typically slow progression, and oftentimes a problem is

not accurately identified until the animal’s condition is irreversible. This is when loving attentiveness and a well-

kept diary by a holistic caregiver can really pay off. By noticing and addressing subtle symptoms when they first

occur, a guardian can take corrective measures against most endocrine system problems before they become life

threatening.

由于内分泌系统疾病和紊乱会影响全身的多种器官和功能，因此这些疾病很容易被误诊，并经常被误认

为是行为障碍或饮食问题。内分泌疾病的阴险性质因其通常缓慢的进展而变得更加复杂，并且通常在动物

的病情不可逆转之前无法准确识别问题。这时，全面护理人员的关爱和精心保存的日记才能真正得到回

报。通过在首次出现时注意到并解决微妙的症状，监护人可以在大多数内分泌系统问题威胁生命之前对其

采取纠正措施。

=== PAGE 441 ===
ADRENAL GLAND DISORDERS

肾上腺疾病

The adrenal glands produce various hormones that are important in nervous system functions, regulation of the

immune system, and bodily responses to stressful situations. The adrenal cortex (the outer tissues of the adrenal

glands) is chiefly responsible for the body’s production of corticosteroids, the hormones responsible for natural

control of inflammation.

肾上腺产生各种激素，这些激素对于神经系统功能、免疫系统调节以及身体对压力情况的反应非常重要。

肾上腺皮质（肾上腺的外层组织）主要负责体内皮质类固醇的产生，皮质类固醇是负责自然控制炎症的激

素。

Addison’s Disease (Hypoadrenocorticism)

艾迪生氏病（肾上腺皮质功能减退症）

Addison’s disease is caused by deficient secretion of cortisone and other hormones from the adrenal cortex. The

cause of the disease is unknown, but it may be secondary to an immune system disorder that is responsible for

destroying the adrenal glands. Usually the disease progresses slowly, allowing an attentive caregiver to take

remedial action early.

艾迪生氏病是由肾上腺皮质分泌的可的松和其他激素不足引起的。这种疾病的病因尚不清楚，但可能是继

发于导致肾上腺破坏的免疫系统疾病。通常疾病进展缓慢，细心的护理人员可以及早采取补救措施。

Secondary hypoadrenocorticism is caused when synthetic corticosteroids are introduced into the body, natural

adrenal functions are replaced, and the adrenal cortex subsequently begins to shut down. Many animals who are

finishing prednisolone or other steroid therapies or animals who have been subjected to excessive vaccinations

suffer from this form of hypoadrenocorticism.

当合成皮质类固醇被引入体内，天然肾上腺功能被取代，肾上腺皮质随后开始关闭时，会引起继发性肾

上腺皮质功能减退症。许多正在完成泼尼松龙或其他类固醇治疗的动物或接受过多疫苗接种的动物都患有

这种形式的肾上腺皮质功能减退症。

Addison’s disease occurs most frequently in middle-aged female dogs. It rarely occurs in cats. Early symptoms

may be subtle and include occasional lack of appetite, digestive upset, and decreased energy and stamina. In many

cases, symptoms may be apparent only during or after an activity that causes physical or psychological stress, such

as a car ride, a frightening encounter with a big, mean dog, or a dreaded trip to the vet. Symptoms progressively

worsen over time until the slightest measure of stress may result in debilitation.

艾迪生氏病最常见于中年母犬。它很少发生在猫身上。早期症状可能很微妙，包括偶尔食欲不振、消化

不良以及精力和耐力下降。在许多情况下，症状可能只有在导致身体或心理压力的活动期间或之后才会显

现出来，例如乘车、与一只凶恶的大狗发生可怕的遭遇，或者一次可怕的兽医之旅。随着时间的推移，症

状逐渐恶化，直到最轻微的压力都可能导致虚弱。

Degeneration of the adrenal glands is generally irreversible, but if the nutrients needed for maintaining a healthy

body and balanced immune system are provided, progression of the disease can be slowed dramatically. An organic

raw food diet, free from pesticide residues, antibiotics, and livestock growth or milk production hormones, is likely

to yield the best results. Additionally, a high-quality dietary supplement that contains a full complement of vitamins,

minerals, and EFAs is strongly indicated. Supplemental feeding of dried nettle, dandelion leaf, or parsley leaf

provides the body with an array of vitamins and minerals that are essential in maintaining strong adrenal functions.

Any or all of these herbs can be mixed with the animal’s food—1 level teaspoon per pound of food fed daily.

Spirulina is also an excellent supplement for adrenal care—¼ teaspoon for each pound of food fed daily. An

excellent herb and vitamin supplement called Animal Essentials is well suited for animals that have Addison’s

disease or diabetes mellitus.

=== PAGE 442 ===
肾上腺的退化通常是不可逆转的，但如果提供维持健康身体和平衡免疫系统所需的营养，则可以大大减

缓疾病的进展。有机生食饮食，不含农药残留、抗生素、牲畜生长或产奶激素，可能会产生最佳效果。此

外，强烈建议使用含有全套维生素、矿物质和必需脂肪酸的高质量膳食补充剂。补充喂养干荨麻、蒲公英

叶或欧芹叶可为身体提供一系列维生素和矿物质，这些维生素和矿物质对于维持强大的肾上腺功能至关重

要。这些草药中的任何一种或全部都可以与动物的食物混合——每天每磅食物添加 1 平茶匙。螺旋藻也是

一种极好的肾上腺保健补充剂——每天每磅食物添加 1/4 茶匙。一种名为“动物必需品”的优质草药和维生素

补充剂非常适合患有艾迪生氏病或糖尿病的动物。

Borage leaf may help gently boost adrenal output, particularly in cases associated with extended steroid therapies.

Licorice offers a much stronger boost to adrenal function. It’s important to note, however, that these herbs only

stimulate adrenal function, they do not repair or adequately nourish the glands. Siberian ginseng or other

adaptogenic herbs may be useful for reducing the impact of stress upon the adrenal glands.

琉璃苣叶可能有助于温和地增加肾上腺输出，特别是在与长期类固醇治疗相关的情况下。甘草对肾上腺

功能有更强的促进作用。然而，值得注意的是，这些草药只能刺激肾上腺功能，不能修复或充分滋养腺

体。西伯利亚人参或其他适应原草药可能有助于减少压力对肾上腺的影响。

Cushing’s Disease (Hyperadrenocorticism)

库欣病（肾上腺皮质机能亢进）

The opposite of Addison’s disease is Cushing’s disease in which overactive adrenal glands produce too much

cortisone and other hormones. This is most commonly caused (in about 85 percent of all cases) by a malignant or

benign tumor of the pituitary gland. The tumor causes the pituitary to overproduce a hormone that stimulates the

adrenal gland, causing Cushing’s disease. The disease may also be caused by excessive use of corticosteroid drugs

or by a tumor of one or both adrenal glands.

与艾迪生氏病相反的是库欣氏病，其中过度活跃的肾上腺会产生过多的可的松和其他激素。这种情况最常

见（约占所有病例的 85%）是由垂体恶性或良性肿瘤引起的。肿瘤导致垂体过度产生刺激肾上腺的激素，

导致库欣病。该疾病也可能是由于过度使用皮质类固醇药物或一侧或双侧肾上腺肿瘤引起的。

Cushing’s disease occurs in dogs, cats, horses, and other animals. The condition progresses with tumor growth.

Symptoms include increased thirst and appetite; increased urination; abdominal distention; increased panting;

obesity; muscle weakness; hair loss; and dry, scaly, or wrinkled skin.

库欣病发生在狗、猫、马和其他动物身上。病情随着肿瘤的生长而进展。症状包括口渴和食欲增加；排

尿增多；腹胀；气喘吁吁；肥胖;肌肉无力;脱发；以及干燥、鳞状或皱纹的皮肤。

Conventional treatment is based on the diagnosis of the cause. In cases that stem from a pituitary or adrenal gland

tumor, surgical removal or drug therapies are both options. The prognosis is variable according to the amount of

disease progression.

常规治疗基于病因诊断。对于源自垂体或肾上腺肿瘤的病例，手术切除或药物治疗都是选择。预后根据

疾病进展的程度而变化。

Herbal therapy is limited to tonic support of organs and systems that are subjected to additional stress because of

the disease. Dandelion root, burdock, garlic, and nettle are good choices for supporting an overtaxed liver and

digestive system and to help replace potassium that is lost as a result of increased urination. Adaptogenic herbs such

as Siberian ginseng or astragalus help buffer adrenal responses to stress. Kelp is especially useful for maintaining

iodine and other trace mineral levels that are essential for adrenal function. If your companion has Cushing’s

disease, avoid licorice, borage leaf, and other herbs that stimulate adrenal activity.

草药疗法仅限于对因疾病而承受额外压力的器官和系统进行滋补支持。蒲公英根、牛蒡、大蒜和荨麻都

是不错的选择，可以支持负担过重的肝脏和消化系统，并帮助补充因排尿增加而流失的钾。西伯利亚人参

或黄芪等适应性草药有助于缓冲肾上腺对压力的反应。海带对于维持肾上腺功能必需的碘和其他微量矿物

质水平特别有用。如果您的同伴患有库欣病，请避免使用甘草、琉璃苣叶和其他刺激肾上腺活动的草药。

=== PAGE 443 ===
DIABETES MELLITUS

糖尿病

Diabetes comes in many forms, each requiring specific courses of treatment. To simplify, the most common form of

diabetes (diabetes mellitus) occurs when the pancreas becomes dysfunctional and produces too little insulin.

Because of this deficit, the body is unable to effectively utilize or store the glucose, proteins, fats, and carbohydrates

needed to maintain homeostasis. Consequently, serious imbalances are triggered throughout the body. If left

untreated, animals with diabetes mellitus suffer and are likely to succumb to kidney failure, loss of vision, or any

number of autoimmune, heart, or nervous system problems.

糖尿病有多种形式，每种形式都需要特定的治疗疗程。简而言之，最常见的糖尿病（糖尿病）发生在胰腺

功能失调且产生的胰岛素过少时。由于这种缺陷，身体无法有效利用或储存维持体内平衡所需的葡萄糖、

蛋白质、脂肪和碳水化合物。结果，引发了整个身体的严重失衡。如果不及时治疗，患有糖尿病的动物会

遭受痛苦，并可能死于肾衰竭、视力丧失或任何自身免疫、心脏或神经系统问题。

Unfortunately, there is no cure for diabetes. Conventional treatment of advanced cases usually involves insulin

replacement therapy. This approach can be effective, but all too often other relative factors are never addressed.

These factors include special trace mineral or EFA needs that arise from special demands placed upon overworked

organs, as well as kidney damage that has already occurred from the disease.

不幸的是，糖尿病无法治愈。晚期病例的常规治疗通常涉及胰岛素替代疗法。这种方法可能是有效的，

但其他相关因素往往从未得到解决。这些因素包括因过度劳累的器官的特殊需求而产生的特殊微量矿物质

或必需脂肪酸的需求，以及疾病已经发生的肾脏损伤。

Diabetic animals should receive regular exercise and good, wholesome food fed in small amounts, several times

throughout the day. By ingesting many small meals, the body has an easier time producing, using, and stabilizing

insulin and glucose levels. Dietary yeast may be added to the animal’s diet to aid in the metabolism of glucose, and

25 to 200 IU of vitamin E each day may help reduce an animal’s insulin requirement. For dogs and cats, a daily

regimen of 50–300 micrograms of chromium; 500–6,000 milligrams of vitamin C; 4–160 milligrams of digestive

enzymes; 200–1,500 milligrams of n-acetylglucosamine; and 10–200 milligrams of proanthocyanidin complex may

be of benefit as well. Regular exercise is important for maintaining healthy body weight and cardiopulmonary

function and may also help decrease the animal’s insulin need.

患有糖尿病的动物应该接受定期锻炼，并在一天中多次少量喂食优质、有益健康的食物。通过少食多

餐，身体可以更轻松地产生、使用和稳定胰岛素和血糖水平。膳食酵母可以添加到动物的饮食中以帮助葡

萄糖代谢，每天 25 至 200 IU 的维生素 E 可能有助于减少动物的胰岛素需求。对于狗和猫，每日摄入 50-

300 微克铬； 500–6,000 毫克维生素 C； 4–160毫克消化酶； 200–1,500 毫克 N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖； 10-200 毫

克的原花青素复合物也可能有好处。定期运动对于保持健康的体重和心肺功能很重要，也可能有助于减少

动物的胰岛素需求。

The primary role of herbs in treating diabetes is to help strengthen and support systems of the body that have been

ravaged by the metabolic chaos of the disease. Because a diabetic body has a diminished capacity to utilize critical

nutrients, herbs that strengthen digestion and nutrient absorption are strongly indicated. These include bitter herbs

such as dandelion leaf, chamomile (both the leaf and the flower), calendula, and hop. In addition, yucca and alfalfa

are useful for increasing absorption of nutrients in the small intestine. Dandelion root and burdock root both contain

considerable amounts of inulin, a compound that helps moderate and maintain blood sugar levels. Bilberry

(Vaccinium myrtillus) or huckleberry leaf (Vaccinium sp.) may also be effective in moderating glucose levels in the

blood, and a few juniper berries added to each feeding may help optimize the body’s utilization of insulin.

Cardiovascular and kidney efficiency can be improved with the use of hawthorn and ginkgo. Scientific studies have

shown that aloe vera and chemical compounds found in fenugreek seeds may also reduce blood glucose levels and

stimulate insulin production in diabetic animals. Animal Essentials is an excellent herb and vitamin supplement for

diabetic dogs and cats.

草药在治疗糖尿病中的主要作用是帮助加强和支持因疾病代谢混乱而受到破坏的身体系统。由于糖尿病

患者的身体利用关键营养素的能力下降，因此强烈建议使用增强消化和营养吸收的草药。这些包括苦草

本，如蒲公英叶、洋甘菊（叶和花）、金盏花和啤酒花。此外，丝兰和苜蓿有助于增加小肠对营养物质的

=== PAGE 444 ===
吸收。蒲公英根和牛蒡根都含有大量菊粉，这种化合物有助于调节和维持血糖水平。越橘 (Vaccinium

myrtillus) 或越橘叶 (Vaccinium sp.) 也可能有效调节血液中的葡萄糖水平，每次喂养时添加一些杜松子可能

有助于优化身体对胰岛素的利用。使用山楂和银杏可以提高心血管和肾脏的效率。科学研究表明，芦荟和

胡芦巴种子中发现的化合物还可以降低糖尿病动物的血糖水平并刺激胰岛素的产生。 Animal Essentials 是一

种极好的草药和维生素补充剂，适用于患有糖尿病的狗和猫。

=== PAGE 445 ===
PANCREATITIS

胰腺炎

The pancreas produces insulin, a substance that enables the body to utilize and store glucose (the body’s fuel). It also

produces pancreatic enzymes that are essential for digesting food and assimilating nutrients in the digestive tract. It

is a delicate organ that is easily damaged and slow to heal.

胰腺产生胰岛素，这种物质使身体能够利用和储存葡萄糖（身体的燃料）。它还产生胰酶，这对于消化道

中消化食物和吸收营养物质至关重要。它是一个脆弱的器官，很容易受损且愈合缓慢。

Pancreatitis, inflammation of the pancreas, can result from a high-fat diet, obesity, traumatic injury, or excessive

use of corticosteroid, antibiotic, or diuretic drugs. It can also be related to underlying systemic problems such as

liver, gallbladder, or kidney disease; cardiovascular disease; or bacterial infection. Symptoms may include

abdominal pain, restlessness, severe vomiting and diarrhea (sometimes with blood present), diminished appetite, and

weakness. Onset can occur quickly (acute pancreatitis), or symptoms can progressively worsen over time (chronic

pancreatitis). Pancreatitis is most common in middle-aged dogs, especially those who are overweight from being

“pampered” with generous junk-food handouts. The disease is less common in cats.

胰腺炎（胰腺炎症）可能由高脂肪饮食、肥胖、外伤或过度使用皮质类固醇、抗生素或利尿药物引起。

它还可能与潜在的全身问题有关，例如肝脏、胆囊或肾脏疾病；心血管疾病;或细菌感染。症状可能包括腹

痛、烦躁不安、严重呕吐和腹泻（有时带血）、食欲减退和虚弱。发病可能很快（急性胰腺炎），或者症

状可能随着时间的推移逐渐恶化（慢性胰腺炎）。胰腺炎在中年犬中最常见，尤其是那些因大量垃圾食

品“纵容”而超重的犬。这种疾病在猫中较少见。

Natural treatment of pancreatitis is centered on diet and nutrition. To ease the inflamed organ’s burden, meals

should be doled out in small portions and fed three or more times per day. Food should be served with probiotic

(e.g., acidophilus, bifidus) and enzyme supplements at room temperature, which make the food easier for the animal

to digest. And excess fat and foods that contribute to digestive upset should be eliminated from the diet. In addition

to healthy food and food combining, daily supplements of EFAs such as stabilized flaxseed, fish oils and vitamins A

and E are said to help repair and strengthen the pancreas.

胰腺炎的自然治疗以饮食和营养为中心。为了减轻发炎器官的负担，膳食应少量多次，每天喂食三次或

以上。食物中应在室温下添加益生菌（例如嗜酸菌、双歧杆菌）和酶补充剂，这使得食物更容易被动物消

化。饮食中应消除多余的脂肪和导致消化不良的食物。除了健康食品和食物组合外，每日补充必需脂肪酸

（例如稳定亚麻籽、鱼油以及维生素 A 和 E）据说有助于修复和强化胰腺。

Meats, grains, vegetables, and fats are digested and absorbed at different metabolic rates, the pancreas must

produce different enzymes for each. A diseased pancreas may have difficulty producing all the enzymes needed to

digest a meal that includes too many food groups; so therefore, pancreatic efficiency can be optimized if each meal

is composed of food types that are of similar digestibility. For example, grains and vegetables can be served

together, as can grains and fruits or protein (meat) and vegetables. Meat and grains should not be combined during

the same meal, however, because their digestion requirements are different. (For more information on food

combining, pick up a copy of Keep Your Pet Healthy the Natural Way by Pat Lazarus.)

肉类、谷物、蔬菜和脂肪以不同的代谢率消化和吸收，胰腺必须为每种食物产生不同的酶。患病的胰腺

可能难以产生消化包含过多食物组的膳食所需的所有酶；因此，如果每餐都由消化率相似的食物类型组

成，则可以优化胰腺效率。例如，谷物和蔬菜可以一起食用，谷物和水果或蛋白质（肉）和蔬菜也可以一

起食用。然而，肉类和谷物不应该在同一餐中混合食用，因为它们的消化要求不同。 （有关食物组合的更

多信息，请阅读帕特·拉扎勒斯 (Pat Lazarus) 撰写的《以自然方式保持宠物健康》一书。）

Herbal therapies are best directed toward supporting organs and systems related to pancreatic function and the

onset of pancreatitis. A thorough veterinary examination is needed to determine which therapy to use. In almost all

cases, treatment of pancreatic disease requires tonic support of the liver and digestive system. Milk thistle helps to

regenerate and restore normal function to a liver that is damaged as a result of drug therapies or infection.

Dandelion, burdock root, or Oregon grape can help improve digestion and reduce pancreatic stress by gently

increasing bile and enzyme production in the liver. If bacterial infection is present, echinacea helps to boost the

immune system’s response to the invading microbes. Yarrow is said to help reduce pancreatic inflammation and

=== PAGE 446 ===
improve blood circulation to the organ.

草药疗法最好针对支持与胰腺功能和胰腺炎发作相关的器官和系统。需要进行彻底的兽医检查来确定使

用哪种疗法。在几乎所有情况下，胰腺疾病的治疗都需要肝脏和消化系统的补品支持。水飞蓟有助于再生

和恢复因药物治疗或感染而受损的肝脏的正常功能。蒲公英、牛蒡根或俄勒冈葡萄可以通过温和地增加肝

脏中胆汁和酶的产生来帮助改善消化并减轻胰腺压力。如果存在细菌感染，紫锥菊有助于增强免疫系统对

入侵微生物的反应。据说西洋蓍草有助于减少胰腺炎症并改善该器官的血液循环。

THYROID PROBLEMS

甲状腺问题

The thyroid gland consists of two lobes, one located on each side of the trachea. The gland secretes important

hormones, including thyroxine (T4), triiodothyronine (T3), and calcitonin. Release of these hormones is controlled

by yet another hormone, called thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the pituitary gland.

甲状腺由两个叶组成，一个位于气管的每一侧。该腺体分泌重要的激素，包括甲状腺素 (T 4 )、三碘甲状腺

原氨酸 (T 3 ) 和降钙素。这些激素的释放是由另一种激素控制的，称为促甲状腺激素（TSH），它是由垂体

产生的。

Thyroid hormones control the intensity of critical functions throughout the body, including heart rate, body

temperature, fat and glucose metabolism, digestion, and neurological activities. If the thyroid becomes

dysfunctional, some serious health problems occur.

甲状腺激素控制全身关键功能的强度，包括心率、体温、脂肪和葡萄糖代谢、消化和神经活动。如果甲

状腺功能失调，就会出现一些严重的健康问题。

Hyperthyroidism

甲状腺功能亢进症

Hyperthyroidism occurs when a thyroid tumor, a viral or bacterial infection, or environmental or nutritional factors

cause the thyroid gland to secrete excess hormones into the blood. Symptoms may include ravenous appetite, weight

loss, increased water consumption and urination, aggressive or hyperactive behavior, and rapid or erratic heartbeat

and respiration. The problem occurs more frequently in cats than in dogs or other animals.

当甲状腺肿瘤、病毒或细菌感染、或者环境或营养因素导致甲状腺向血液中分泌过量激素时，就会发生甲

状腺功能亢进症。症状可能包括食欲旺盛、体重减轻、饮水量和排尿量增加、攻击性或过度活跃行为以及

心跳和呼吸快速或不稳定。这个问题在猫身上比在狗或其他动物身上更常见。

Conventional treatment of hyperthyroidism ranges from chemotherapy to surgery to radiation therapy. One

approach involves destroying the thyroid completely with radiation and then putting the animal on hormone

replacement therapy for the rest of his life.

甲状腺功能亢进症的常规治疗范围从化疗到手术再到放射治疗。一种方法是用辐射完全破坏甲状腺，然

后让动物在余生接受激素替代疗法。

Once the thyroid becomes damaged or dysfunctional, its condition is difficult (some say impossible) to reverse.

Therefore, the best holistic approach toward hyperthyroidism is to help prevent it by providing a good natural diet

and avoiding unnecessary chemical or environmental hazards, including X-rays, antibiotic therapies, food

preservatives, and unneeded vaccinations. Daily supplements of vitamin B complex, vitamin C, CoQ10, and EFAs

are also important contributors for maintaining healthy thyroid function.

一旦甲状腺受损或功能失调，其状况就很难（有人说不可能）逆转。因此，治疗甲状腺功能亢进症的最

佳整体方法是通过提供良好的天然饮食并避免不必要的化学或环境危害（包括 X 射线、抗生素治疗、食品

防腐剂和不必要的疫苗接种）来帮助预防甲状腺功能亢进。每日补充复合维生素 B、维生素 C、CoQ 10 和

EFA 也是维持健康甲状腺功能的重要因素。

Herbal therapies include symptomatic treatment and tonic support of systems that are under added stress from an

increased metabolic rate. Bugleweed is considered a specific symptomatic remedy for hyperthyroidism because it is

known to slow thyroid function by reducing production of TSH. Its use, however, should be monitored by a holistic

veterinarian. Hawthorn is helpful for moderating an erratic heartbeat, while skullcap and valerian may help calm and

reduce the “jittery jumpiness” of a hyperthyroid animal. Kelp and other rich sources of iodine should be avoided

because iodine stimulates thyroid function.

=== PAGE 448 ===
草药疗法包括对因代谢率增加而承受额外压力的系统进行对症治疗和滋补支持。 Bugleweed 被认为是治

疗甲状腺功能亢进症的特效药物，因为众所周知，它可以通过减少 TSH 的产生来减缓甲状腺功能。然而，

其使用应由整体兽医进行监控。山楂有助于缓和不稳定的心跳，而黄芩和缬草可能有助于平静和减少甲状

腺功能亢进动物的“紧张不安”。应避免海带和其他富含碘的来源，因为碘会刺激甲状腺功能。

Hypothyroidism

甲状腺功能减退症

The opposite of hyperthyroidism is hypothyroidism—deficient production of hormones by the thyroid.

Hypothyroidism is usually caused by physical degeneration of the thyroid gland, which can be the result of

protracted drugs or therapies, radiation such as X-ray exposure, vaccinosis, genetic predisposition, or nutritional

deficiencies. Hypothyroidism occurs rarely in cats and horses or other large animals, but it is fairly common in dogs.

Destruction of the thyroid is generally irreversible, and animals who are suffering advanced stages of thyroid

degeneration may need hormone replacement therapy.

甲状腺功能亢进症的反面是甲状腺功能减退症——甲状腺产生的激素不足。甲状腺功能减退症通常是由甲

状腺的物理退化引起的，这可能是长期药物或治疗、X射线照射等辐射、疫苗接种、遗传倾向或营养缺乏的

结果。甲状腺功能减退症很少发生在猫、马或其他大型动物身上，但在狗身上相当常见。甲状腺的破坏通

常是不可逆的，患有甲状腺退化晚期的动物可能需要激素替代疗法。

Symptoms of hypothyroidism include weight gain, reduced appetite, mental dullness, lack of energy, hair loss on

the trunk and tail, and a dry coat that pulls easily from the skin. If left untreated, the problem can lead to chronic

seizures, head tilt, lack of coordination, and other serious neurological disorders.

甲状腺功能减退症的症状包括体重增加、食欲减退、精神迟钝、精力不足、躯干和尾部毛发脱落、皮毛

干燥、容易从皮肤上脱落。如果不及时治疗，该问题可能会导致慢性癫痫发作、头部倾斜、缺乏协调性和

其他严重的神经系统疾病。

Iodine is critical in the functions of a healthy thyroid, and many holistic practitioners believe that dietary

supplementation of iodine-rich kelp helps stimulate an underactive thyroid. Many researchers and practitioners

believe, however, that supplemental iodine may contribute to immune-related factors of the disease and trigger a

worsening effect.

碘对于健康甲状腺的功能至关重要，许多整体治疗师认为，膳食补充富含碘的海带有助于刺激甲状腺功

能低下的甲状腺。然而，许多研究人员和从业者认为，补充碘可能会导致该病的免疫相关因素，并引发病

情恶化。

Licorice may have a slight stimulant effect on an unproductive but physically intact thyroid, and adaptogens such

as organically grown ginseng, astragalus, or Siberian ginseng might help energy levels and the body’s response to

stress. Otherwise, herb use is limited to treating the discomforts subsequent to hypothyroidism. For instance, related

digestive disorders can be treated with dandelion root, Oregon grape, or yellow dock, whereas seborrhea might be

relieved by gotu kola, burdock, or red clover.

甘草可能对生产力低下但身体完好的甲状腺有轻微的刺激作用，而有机种植的人参、黄芪或西伯利亚人

参等适应原可能有助于提高能量水平和身体对压力的反应。否则，草药的使用仅限于治疗甲状腺功能减退

症引起的不适。例如，相关的消化系统疾病可以用蒲公英根、俄勒冈葡萄或黄坞来治疗，而皮脂溢则可以

用积雪草、牛蒡或红三叶草来缓解。

In our opinion, homeopathy and the use of glandular preparations offer more effective courses of early- to late-

term treatment than herbs do.

我们认为，顺势疗法和腺体制剂的使用提供了比草药更有效的早期到晚期治疗过程。

EPILEPSY, CONVULSIONS, AND SEIZURES

癫痫、抽搐和癫痫发作

A seizure can be frightening if you’ve never seen one before. Some animals may experience a seizure once in their

lives and then never again. On the other hand, some have several seizures every day of their lives.

如果您以前从未见过癫痫发作，那么癫痫发作可能会很可怕。有些动物一生中可能会经历一次癫痫发作，

然后就再也不会发作了。另一方面，有些人一生中每天都会有几次癫痫发作。

The causes of seizures are widely varied, ranging from epilepsy to nervous system disease or injury. In dogs,

hyperthermia, poisoning, low blood sugar, nutritional deficiencies, distemper, intestinal parasites that have entered

the bloodstream, tumors, low blood calcium after birthing, liver or kidney disease, and thyroid problems may be

underlying factors. In cats, convulsions may be linked to feline infectious peritonitis (FIP), toxoplasmosis,

lymphosarcoma (leukemia), thiamine deficiency, or a heart disorder.

癫痫发作的原因多种多样，从癫痫到神经系统疾病或损伤。对于狗来说，高热、中毒、低血糖、营养缺

乏、犬瘟热、进入血液的肠道寄生虫、肿瘤、产后低血钙、肝脏或肾脏疾病以及甲状腺问题可能是潜在因

素。对于猫来说，抽搐可能与猫传染性腹膜炎 (FIP)、弓形体病、淋巴肉瘤（白血病）、硫胺素缺乏或心脏

病有关。

All cases of seizures involve electrical disturbances of the brain that result in muscle contractions of variable

intensity and loss of motor control. Many animals lose consciousness and bladder or bowel control during a seizure,

and some may exhibit overly affectionate, frightened, or “clingy” behavior immediately before an epileptic episode.

Digestive disorders, hair loss, neuralgia, and several other problems may also be associated with chronic convulsive

disorders.

所有癫痫发作都涉及大脑电干扰，导致不同强度的肌肉收缩和运动控制丧失。许多动物在癫痫发作期间

失去意识和膀胱或肠道控制，有些动物可能在癫痫发作前立即表现出过度深情、害怕或“粘人”的行为。消

化系统疾病、脱发、神经痛和其他一些问题也可能与慢性惊厥性疾病有关。

Conventional therapies typically involve the use of phenobarbital, potassium bromide, or other anticonvulsant

drugs. These measures can prove to be effective, but they cannot address the underlying causes of chronic

convulsive disorders.

传统疗法通常涉及使用苯巴比妥、溴化钾或其他抗惊厥药物。这些措施被证明是有效的，但它们无法解

决慢性惊厥性疾病的根本原因。

=== PAGE 450 ===
HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

Holistic treatment usually entails a lifelong effort, beginning with a dietary and environmental assessment and

adjustment, and continuing with nutritional supplementation and herbal therapies that focus on normalizing and

maintaining nervous system function. All possible environmental causes of or contributors to seizures should be

removed from your home. Eliminate all possible contact with antifreeze fluids, household chemicals, pesticides and

herbicides, lead-based paints, and other neurotoxins from your companion’s environment. (These substances are

harmful to humans, as well.)

整体治疗通常需要终生努力，从饮食和环境评估和调整开始，然后继续营养补充和草药疗法，重点是使神

经系统功能正常化和维持正常化。所有可能导致癫痫发作的环境原因或促成因素都应从您的家中清除。消

除与同伴环境中的防冻液、家用化学品、杀虫剂和除草剂、含铅油漆以及其他神经毒素的所有可能接触。

（这些物质也对人类有害。）

Skullcap is one of several herbs that can be used to treat epilepsy.

黄芩是可用于治疗癫痫的几种草药之一。

Animals with epilepsy or other convulsive disorders should be on a natural, whole foods diet. Cats with epilepsy,

however, should not be fed raw fish because it contains thiaminase, an enzyme that breaks down vitamin B1

(thiamine). Vitamin B1 is essential for healthy nervous system functions. In all animals, dietary supplementation

with omega-3 and omega-6 EFAs is important in the development and maintenance of healthy nervous system

structure and function. Animal Essentials makes an excellent EFA supplement for dogs and cats. In addition to

EFAs, supplementing your companion’s diet with essential and nonessential vitamins, minerals, and digestive

enzymes and with probiotics is indicated to assure that the nervous system is getting everything it needs to heal and

function optimally. A daily supplementation of 100-300 milligrams of betaine HCl; 50-500 milligrams of

dimethylglycine; 200-1000 milligrams of taurine; and 10-200 milligrams of proanthocyanidin complex is said to be

helpful for epileptic dogs. Recent studies have shown that a ketogenic diet can be effective for treating severe

epilepsy in humans, but at this point we can only speculate about the usefulness of this approach in animals.

=== PAGE 451 ===
患有癫痫或其他惊厥性疾病的动物应该采用天然的全食饮食。然而，患有癫痫的猫不应该喂生鱼，因为

它含有硫胺素酶，一种分解维生素 B 1 （硫胺素）的酶。维生素 B 1 对于健康的神经系统功能至关重要。在

所有动物中，膳食补充 omega-3 和 omega-6 必需脂肪酸对于健康神经系统结构和功能的发育和维持非常重

要。 Animal Essentials 为狗和猫提供了极好的全民教育补充剂。除了必需脂肪酸外，还可以在伴侣的饮食中

补充必需和非必需的维生素、矿物质、消化酶以及益生菌，以确保神经系统获得最佳愈合和功能所需的一

切。每日补充100-300毫克盐酸甜菜碱； 50-500毫克二甲基甘氨酸； 200-1000毫克牛磺酸；据说10-200毫克

的原花青素复合物对癫痫犬有帮助。最近的研究表明，生酮饮食可以有效治疗人类的严重癫痫症，但目前

我们只能推测这种方法在动物身上的有效性。

We have seen promising results with the use of skullcap in the treatment of epileptic animals. This nervine is

believed to moderate overactive synaptic activity in the higher brain centers in which epileptic episodes may be

triggered. We have received many good reports about valerian and oatstraw, too, especially when they are combined

in equal proportions with skullcap. Although these herbs do not represent a cure for epilepsy, their reported effects

include less frequent and less severe episodes. Lemon balm, ginkgo, rosemary, hop, passionflower, and perhaps

kava kava (research is promising in the area of controlling seizures in rodents) may also be effective in the treatment

of chronic seizures. Additionally, flower essences of vervain or chestnut bud may be helpful in moderating seizures.

我们已经看到使用黄芩治疗癫痫动物的有希望的结果。这种神经被认为可以调节可能引发癫痫发作的高

级大脑中心过度活跃的突触活动。我们也收到了许多关于缬草和燕麦草的良好报告，特别是当它们与黄芩

以相同比例混合时。尽管这些草药不能治愈癫痫，但据报道，它们的作用包括减少发作频率和减轻严重程

度。香蜂草、银杏、迷迭香、啤酒花、西番莲，也许还有卡瓦卡瓦（在控制啮齿动物癫痫发作领域的研究

很有前景）也可能有效治疗慢性癫痫发作。此外，马鞭草或栗子花蕾的花精可能有助于缓解癫痫发作。

FIRST AID FOR SEIZURES

癫痫发作的急救

If your animal experiences a seizure, gently protect his head from sharp or hard objects until the episode passes.

Don’t attempt to restrain the animal’s body—the muscle contractions of a violent convulsion can be self-injurious if

the animal cannot move and jerk about freely. Never place your hand in or near your animal’s mouth during a

seizure—your companion may be unaware of your presence and may unknowingly bite you with incredible force! If

you are indoors during the episode, dimming the lights and speaking softly to your companion helps reduce the fear

and confusion that sometimes precedes and usually follows the episode. Rescue Remedy rubbed on the ears before,

during, and after a seizure sometimes helps moderate the episode and calm the animal. Be sure to take a hearty dose

yourself!

如果您的动物癫痫发作，请轻轻保护其头部免受尖锐或坚硬物体的伤害，直到发作过去。不要试图限制动

物的身体——如果动物无法自由移动和抽搐，剧烈抽搐的肌肉收缩可能会造成自残。在癫痫发作期间，切

勿将手放入或靠近动物的嘴中 - 您的同伴可能没有意识到您的存在，并可能在不知不觉中以令人难以置信

的力量咬您！如果您在发作期间在室内，调暗灯光并轻声与同伴说话有助于减少发作前后有时出现的恐惧

和困惑。在癫痫发作之前、期间和之后将救援药物涂在耳朵上有时有助于缓解发作并使动物平静下来。一

定要自己吃足剂量！

=== PAGE 453 ===
EYE PROBLEMS

眼睛问题

Many eye problems are just subtle signs of chronic underlying diseases. You might think your animal is the “picture

of perfect health,” but if he has runny eyes or the beginning of cataracts, these conditions indicate that there is an

underlying imbalance. Many times herbs alone are not enough to correct that imbalance. A vet who is trained well in

classic homeopathy can address the underlying disease and help the body heal itself.

许多眼睛问题只是慢性基础疾病的微妙征兆。您可能认为您的动物“完美健康”，但如果他流泪或开始出现

白内障，这些情况表明存在潜在的不平衡。很多时候，仅靠草药不足以纠正这种不平衡。在经典顺势疗法

方面接受过良好培训的兽医可以解决潜在的疾病并帮助身体自我治愈。

In some cases of simple infection or irritation, an herbal wash of saline solution and raspberry leaf tea clears up

the problem immediately. In other cases, eye problems mark the beginning of a lifelong course of holistic therapy.

在某些简单感染或刺激的情况下，用盐水溶液和覆盆子叶茶进行草药清洗可以立即解决问题。在其他情

况下，眼睛问题标志着终身整体治疗过程的开始。

=== PAGE 454 ===
CATARACTS

白内障

Cataracts are white opacities that block the passage of light into the eyes. They are caused by loss of water or

rearrangement of fibrous tissue in the eye lens. Formation of cataracts (known as senile cataracts) is a normal part of

the aging process. They seldom result in blindness and usually cause little or no vision impairment in older animals,

even if the pupils take on the blue-white hue that is characteristic of the condition. Cataracts sometimes involve

leakage of lens protein into the inner eye. When this happens, an immune response is triggered and the animal

suffers serious inflammation of the eye.

白内障是一种白色混浊物，阻碍光线进入眼睛。它们是由晶状体失水或纤维组织重新排列引起的。白内障

（称为老年性白内障）的形成是衰老过程的正常部分。它们很少导致失明，并且通常对老年动物造成很少

或根本没有视力损害，即使瞳孔呈现出该病特有的蓝白色调。白内障有时会导致晶状体蛋白渗漏到内眼

中。当这种情况发生时，就会触发免疫反应，动物的眼睛会出现严重的炎症。

Providing a well-balanced natural diet throughout an animal’s life is the surest way to prevent the development of

problematic cataracts. In cats, cataracts have been linked with vitamin B2 (riboflavin) deficiency, a problem that

stems more from poor nutrient assimilation than it does from lack of vitamin B2 in the average feline diet. Lactation

is also believed to deplete the feline body of B2. Therefore, dietary supplementation of the digestive enzymes and

probiotics necessary to metabolize B2 is an important part of cataract prevention—especially in nursing cats. Other

recommended vitamin supplements include glutathione, vitamin C, CoQ10, proanthocyanidin complex, vitamin E,

and dimethylglycine.

在动物的一生中提供均衡的天然饮食是预防白内障问题发生的最可靠方法。对于猫来说，白内障与维生

素 B 2 （核黄素）缺乏有关，对于普通猫科动物来说，这一问题更多地源于营养吸收不良，而不是缺乏维生

素 B 2 饮食。哺乳期也被认为会消耗猫体内的 B 2 。因此，通过饮食补充代谢 B 2 所需的消化酶和益生菌是

预防白内障的重要组成部分，尤其是对于哺乳期的猫。其他推荐的维生素补充剂包括谷胱甘肽、维生素

C、辅酶 Q 10 、原花青素复合物、维生素 E 和二甲基甘氨酸。

A SIMPLE ASTRINGENT EYEWASH

简单的收敛洗眼液

Using a clean dropper bottle, combine the following:

使用干净的滴管瓶，混合以下物质：

½ tsp of cooled clear raspberry leaf or nettle tea 2

½ 茶匙冷却的透明覆盆子叶或荨麻茶 2

½ tsp of Oregon grape or goldenseal tea 2

½ 茶匙俄勒冈葡萄或金印茶 2

Add 1 oz of sterile saline (available in the eye care section of supermarkets and pharmacies)

添加1盎司无菌生理盐水（超市和药店的眼科护理部分有售）

Shake the mixture thoroughly—the finished solution should be tinted yellow.

彻底摇匀混合物——最终的溶液应呈黄色。

If possible, hold the animal’s head to one side and use a dropper pipette to thoroughly rinse the eye laterally,

from the nose outward, toward the animal’s cheek. The idea is to wash any irritating particles away from the

animal’s eye. This process can be repeated two or three times daily until the condition improves. If the rinse

causes further irritation, stop using it—your companion may be sensitive to the herb you are using. Other

=== PAGE 455 ===
herbs to consider for use in eyewashes include calendula, chamomile, thyme, bee balm, chickweed,

dandelion leaf, or rose petals. Regardless of which herbs you use, be extra careful in assuring that they are

free of dust, pollen, or toxic residues (such as herbicides or car exhaust), as the eyes are extremely sensitive

to such foreign substances.

如果可能，将动物的头放在一侧，并使用滴管从鼻子向外向动物的脸颊横向彻底冲洗眼睛。这个想

法是为了洗掉动物眼睛上的任何刺激性颗粒。这个过程可以每天重复两到三次，直到病情改善。如

果冲洗液引起进一步刺激，请停止使用——您的同伴可能对您正在使用的草药敏感。其他可考虑用

于洗眼的草药包括金盏花、洋甘菊、百里香、蜂香、繁缕、蒲公英叶或玫瑰花瓣。无论您使用哪种

草药，都要格外小心，确保它们没有灰尘、花粉或有毒残留物（例如除草剂或汽车尾气），因为眼

睛对这些异物极其敏感。

An herbal wash may clear up a simple eye infection or irritation.

草药洗剂可以消除简单的眼部感染或刺激。

=== PAGE 456 ===
Homeopathic eyedrops may eliminate cataracts.

顺势疗法眼药水可以消除白内障。

Both conventional and herbal approaches to treating cataracts are limited. Conventional treatment includes

cataract surgery, a procedure that can be very effective. While some herbalists claim that a small dab of eucalyptus

honey applied to the inside of the lower eyelid each day for several weeks can reduce the opacity of the eye lens,

another approach involves the internal use of an ancient Chinese herbal formula called Hachimijiogan. Animal

studies have shown that Hachimijiogan is capable of slowing the progression of cataracts, especially if therapy

commences during early stages of the disease. Bilberry, when used in conjunction with vitamin E supplements, has

been shown to help stop progression of senile cataracts in humans. In this approach, a standardized (to 25 percent

anthocyanosides) bilberry extract is administered at a dose of 20-40 milligrams per 40 pounds of body weight, three

times daily.

治疗白内障的传统方法和草药方法都有限。常规治疗包括白内障手术，这种手术非常有效。虽然一些草

药医生声称，每天在下眼睑内侧涂抹少量桉树蜂蜜，持续数周可以减少眼睛晶状体的混浊，但另一种方法

是内部使用一种名为八味姜黄的古老中草药配方。动物研究表明，八味姜丸能够减缓白内障的进展，特别

是在疾病的早期阶段开始治疗。越橘与维生素 E 补充剂一起使用时，已被证明有助于阻止人类老年性白内

障的进展。在这种方法中，标准化（花青素含量为 25%）越橘提取物的给药剂量为每 40 磅体重 20-40 毫

克，每天 3 次。

According to veterinarian Susan G. Wynn, homeopathic preparation eye-drops made from the juice of Cineraria

maritima can be effective for eliminating cataracts in animals. Wynn says to dilute the drops by half with artificial

tears (sterile saline solution) because the juice stings when used full strength. When using this method, she

sometimes sees cataracts disappear in two to three months.

兽医苏珊·韦恩 (Susan G. Wynn) 表示，用瓜叶菊汁制成的顺势疗法滴眼剂可以有效消除动物的白内障。

韦恩说，要用人工泪液（无菌盐水溶液）将滴液稀释一半，因为当全力使用时，汁液会产生刺痛感。使用

这种方法时，她有时会看到白内障在两到三个月内消失。

CONJUNCTIVITIS

结膜炎

Conjunctivitis is a generic term that refers to inflammation of the mucous membranes and soft tissues surrounding

the eye. The problem occurs when bacteria, fungi, or other foreign substances come in contact with these tissues and

tearing fails to eliminate the irritating elements. Most cases are acute and are caused by dust, plant material, or other

environmental irritants. In these cases, a simple saline eye rinse usually brings relief. An astringent eyewash using

raspberry leaf or nettle tea combined with a tea of certified organic goldenseal or Oregon grape root offers further

assistance by fighting infection and quickly reducing inflammation and soreness.

结膜炎是一个通用术语，是指眼睛周围的粘膜和软组织的炎症。当细菌、真菌或其他异物与这些组织接触

并且撕裂无法消除刺激性元素时，就会出现问题。大多数病例都是急性病例，由灰尘、植物材料或其他环

境刺激物引起。在这些情况下，简单的盐水洗眼通常可以缓解症状。使用覆盆子叶或荨麻茶与经过认证的

有机金印或俄勒冈葡萄根茶混合的收敛洗眼液可通过对抗感染并快速减轻炎症和酸痛提供进一步的帮助。

GLAUCOMA

青光眼

Glaucoma involves abnormally high inner eye pressure. It can occur in most animals, but it is especially common in

cats and in certain breeds of dogs. The disease is often secondary to other intraocular diseases such as inflammatory

adhesions and tumors. Signs of glaucoma may include swollen or reddened eyes, dilated fixed pupils, loss of vision,

and corneal edema. Conventional approaches to glaucoma usually involve antiglaucoma drugs that help reduce

intraocular pressure. In some cases, corticosteroid therapies are used.

青光眼涉及异常高的内眼压。它可以发生在大多数动物中，但在猫和某些品种的狗中尤其常见。该疾病通

常继发于其他眼内疾病，例如炎性粘连和肿瘤。青光眼的症状可能包括眼睛肿胀或发红、瞳孔散大、视力

丧失和角膜水肿。治疗青光眼的传统方法通常涉及有助于降低眼内压的抗青光眼药物。在某些情况下，使

用皮质类固醇疗法。

Although glaucoma is difficult to treat with herbs, perhaps the greatest success comes from the reduction of

intraocular pressure with herbs such as ginkgo and bilberry. Cannabis sativa (marijuana) can be effective, too, but,

of course, its accessibility is severely limited by legal restrictions.

虽然青光眼很难用草药治疗，但最大的成功也许来自于用银杏和越橘等草药降低眼内压。大麻（Cannabis

sativa）也可能有效，但当然，它的可及性受到法律限制的严重限制。

Coleus forskohlii, an herb that’s used in ayurvedic medicine, contains forskolin, a substance that has been shown

to significantly reduce intraocular pressure in humans, monkeys, and rabbits. However, its safety and effectiveness

in various other animals have yet to be determined.

毛喉锦紫苏是一种用于阿育吠陀医学的草药，含有毛喉素，这种物质已被证明可以显着降低人类、猴子

和兔子的眼内压。然而，其在其他各种动物中的安全性和有效性尚未确定。

FIRST AID

急救

BE PREPARED!

做好准备！

The old scout motto “Be Prepared” really rings true if you’re out walking your dog and he is attacked by another

dog, cuts himself on barbed wire, or sprains his paw while playing Frisbee. Having a first aid kit specially designed

for your animal and knowing how to use it provides insurance for the well-being of your companion. Taking a

course from the Red Cross or a local vet, kennel, or shelter enables you to deal with everything from life-threatening

emergencies to minor cuts and sprains.

如果你出去遛狗，而他被另一只狗攻击，被铁丝网割伤，或者在玩飞盘时扭伤了爪子，那么古老的童子军

座右铭“做好准备”确实是正确的。拥有专为您的动物设计的急救箱并了解如何使用它可以为您的同伴的健

康提供保障。参加红十字会或当地兽医、狗舍或庇护所的课程可以让您处理从危及生命的紧急情况到轻微

割伤和扭伤的各种情况。

In addition to the basic first aid necessities (plenty of gauze dressings and bandages, tweezers, cotton swabs, a

bulb syringe, and a variety of herbal medicines), we also carry a homeopathic travel kit with us wherever we go.

Homeopathic remedies are compact, convenient, effective, and especially useful for emergency situations. It’s also

important to learn canine and feline cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and the ABCs of basic first aid.

Regardless of how extensive your first aid kit or classroom training might be, everything you compile is functionally

useless if you are unable to react properly in a crisis situation. The most crucial aspects of emergency preparedness

are proactive study and mental conditioning. An emergency situation is a poor time to read up on what to do or give.

During a crisis, time is of the essence, especially if your companion is bleeding severely or having a difficult time

breathing. When placed under the stress of an emotional, adrenaline-pumped situation (such as after you watch your

cat get hit by a careless motorist), the human mind loses much of its ability to formulate an effective plan of action

—the mind begins to race, the knees start to shake, dizziness sets in, and it’s difficult to think. Instead of thinking

the situation through, the brain must react by instinct. If there is no plan imbedded deep in the mind’s subconscious,

panic sets in and all control of the situation is lost to a rampant avalanche of emotion and confusion.

除了基本的急救必需品（大量纱布敷料和绷带、镊子、棉签、灯泡注射器和各种草药）外，我们还随身

携带顺势疗法旅行包。顺势疗法紧凑、方便、有效，对于紧急情况特别有用。学习犬科动物和猫科动物的

心肺复苏 (CPR) 以及基本急救知识也很重要。无论您的急救箱或课堂培训有多么广泛，如果您无法在危机

情况下做出正确反应，那么您编写的所有内容在功能上都是毫无用处的。应急准备最关键的是主动学习和

心理调节。紧急情况不适合阅读该做什么或该给予什么。在危机期间，时间至关重要，尤其是当您的同伴

流血严重或呼吸困难时。当处于情绪激动、肾上腺素激增的情况下（例如当你看到你的猫被粗心的驾车者

撞到后）时，人类的大脑会失去制定有效行动计划的大部分能力——大脑开始竞速膝盖开始颤抖，头晕目

眩，难以思考。大脑必须本能地做出反应，而不是仔细考虑情况。如果没有深植于大脑潜意识深处的计

划，恐慌就会随之而来，对局势的所有控制都会因情绪和混乱的蔓延而失去。

Panic is our worst enemy in an emergency situation because the confusion it causes paralyzes our abilities to take

effective actions. It’s best to prepare for stressful emergency situations before they occur. This is done by visualizing

crisis situations so that the mind is better prepared to respond intuitively and effectively when a real emergency

occurs. For instance, if you are an avid backcountry equestrian, spend some time each week with your eyes closed,

imagining various emergency situations that could occur to you and your companion on your upcoming trail trips.

Be creative but realistic in your visualization of each unfortunate event—imagine the fall, your companion’s pain

and terror, your racing heart, and the initial surge of panic and doubt that starts to envelop you. Then imagine

overcoming that surge and taking control of your emotions to assess the situation. Imagine opening your first aid kit

and systematically selecting the items your companion needs as you calm him down by softly petting him and

assuring him that you are in charge of the situation. Imagine yourself remedying the situation and knowing that

everything will be fine.

在紧急情况下，恐慌是我们最大的敌人，因为它造成的混乱使我们无法采取有效行动。最好在紧张的紧

急情况发生之前做好准备。这是通过想象危机情况来完成的，以便在真正的紧急情况发生时，大脑能够更

好地做出直观、有效的反应。例如，如果您是一名狂热的野外马术爱好者，请每周花一些时间闭上眼睛，

想象一下您和您的同伴在即将到来的越野旅行中可能会发生的各种紧急情况。在想象每一个不幸事件时要

有创意但现实——想象一下跌倒、你同伴的痛苦和恐惧、你的心跳加速，以及最初开始笼罩你的恐慌和怀

疑的浪潮。然后想象一下克服这种激增并控制自己的情绪来评估情况。想象一下，打开你的急救箱，系统

地选择你的同伴需要的物品，同时轻轻地抚摸他，让他平静下来，并向他保证你能掌控局势。想象一下你

自己正在纠正这种情况，并且知道一切都会好起来的。

When we worked in emergency services, we called this exercise “crisis rehearsal”—others call it “creative

visualization.” To some of you, this may sound like a program for paranoia, but it is quite the opposite. Paranoia is

born from fear and a conscious sense of being helpless and out of control. Crisis rehearsal builds confidence and

subconsciously prepares the mind for unforeseeable events. Each time you practice this technique, your

subconscious mind stores experiential memories from which to act in emergencies. In other words, you don’t need

to think, worry, or be paranoid of unforeseeable possibilities each time you take your companion on an adventure—

instead, you have the elements of effective crisis management stored beneath the enjoyment of your adventure,

where instinct can retrieve and use them if the need arises. This is an extremely effective technique for preparing for

the worst. It has saved our lives and the lives of others more than a few times. Crisis rehearsal can make the

difference between life and death for you and your companion.

当我们在紧急服务部门工作时，我们将这种练习称为“危机预演”，其他人则称之为“创意可视化”。对于你

们中的一些人来说，这可能听起来像是一个偏执狂的程序，但事实恰恰相反。偏执症源于恐惧和一种有意

识的无助和失控感。危机预演可以建立信心，并在潜意识中为不可预见的事件做好准备。每次练习这种技

巧时，你的潜意识都会储存经验记忆，以便在紧急情况下采取行动。换句话说，每次带你的同伴去冒险

时，你不需要思考、担心或偏执于不可预见的可能性——相反，你在冒险的乐趣之下储存了有效的危机管

理要素，其中本能如果需要，可以检索并使用它们。这是为最坏情况做好准备的极其有效的技术。它多次

拯救了我们和他人的生命。危机预演可以决定您和您同伴的生死。

圣约翰草

Apply this first aid oil immediately to blunt injuries where subdermal bleeding is evident. After a day or two

when the bleeding has stopped and the healing process has begun, arnica oil can be applied sparingly to the

injury site for up to three days (any longer might irritate the skin). This will help move congested fluids out

of the injured area by opening up capillaries.

立即将这种急救油涂抹在皮下出血明显的钝伤处。一两天后，当出血停止并且愈合过程开始时，可

以将山金车油少量涂抹在受伤部位，最多持续三天（时间再长可能会刺激皮肤）。这将有助于通过

打开毛细血管将充血的液体排出受伤区域。

BITES AND STINGS

咬伤和蜇伤

If your companion receives a bite or a sting, the first course of action is to try to identify what launched the attack.

Of course, this is not always possible, but if you can learn about the nature of the bite or sting, you will be more

effective at treating it. In most cases, the primary course of action is to minimize pain, swelling, and the possibility

of infection with the use of astringent and antimicrobial herbs. A poultice or infusion of plantain, sage, bee balm,

mullein, calendula, or chamomile can be directly applied to the site of an insect bite or sting for these purposes. To

make a poultice, simply mash a few fresh leaves of the herb with a small amount of water to make a crude pestolike

paste. In the field, the herb can be crushed and chewed in your mouth, then applied as a paste to the wound. Oregon

grape, goldenseal, myrrh, thyme, or echinacea tincture, oil infusion, or salve can be applied to the area if stronger

antimicrobial agents are warranted. One or all of these herbal preparations are excellent choices for building a first

aid kit. An infusion of rosemary can be used for a bite or sting to gently bathe and soothe the surrounding area.

Adding 6–8 drops of tea tree oil diluted in 1 ounce of water is also good for direct application to bites and stings, but

be careful with animals who have sensitive skin—the oil is strong.

如果您的同伴被咬或被蜇，首先要做的就是尝试确定是什么发起了攻击。当然，这并不总是可能的，但如

果您能够了解咬伤或刺痛的性质，您将能够更有效地治疗它。在大多数情况下，主要的做法是使用收敛剂

和抗菌草药来尽量减少疼痛、肿胀和感染的可能性。出于这些目的，可以将车前草、鼠尾草、蜂香膏、毛

蕊花、金盏花或洋甘菊的膏剂或浸液直接涂抹在昆虫叮咬或蜇伤的部位。要制作膏剂，只需将几片新鲜的

草药叶子与少量水捣碎，制成粗制的香蒜酱。在野外，可以将这种草药压碎并放在嘴里咀嚼，然后将其制

成糊状涂在伤口上。如果需要更强的抗菌剂，可以将俄勒冈葡萄、白毛茛、没药、百里香或紫锥菊酊剂、

浸油或药膏涂抹在该区域。这些草药制剂中的一种或全部都是构建急救箱的绝佳选择。迷迭香浸液可用于

治疗叮咬或刺痛，轻轻沐浴并舒缓周围区域。将 6-8 滴茶树油稀释在 1 盎司水中，也可以直接涂抹在叮咬

处，但要小心皮肤敏感的动物——茶树油的浓度很高。

For severe welts and inflammation, strong astringents such as decoctions of uva ursi, rose bark, white oak bark, or

juniper leaves can be liberally applied to affected areas. A clay poultice made with bentonite clay is also effective,

especially when herbs such as echinacea and Oregon grape are added to support lymphatic functions and inhibit

infection. When applied to the site of a sting or bite, the clay pulls antigens away from the body to reduce swelling

and help prevent capillary transport of venom into other areas.

对于严重的伤痕和炎症，可以在受影响的部位涂抹强效收敛剂，例如熊果、玫瑰皮、白橡树皮或杜松叶

的煎剂。用膨润土制成的粘土膏剂也很有效，特别是当添加紫锥菊和俄勒冈葡萄等草药来支持淋巴功能和

抑制感染时。当将其涂在被蜇伤或咬伤的部位时，粘土会将抗原从体内拉走，以减少肿胀，并有助于防止

毛细血管将毒液输送到其他区域。

Bites from toxic spiders, such as the brown recluse or black widow, or venomous snakes should be immediately

followed with large doses of vitamin C and echinacea to build the body’s immune defenses and increase lymphatic

cleansing of involved tissues. Immediate administration of the appropriate homeopathic remedy is also highly

advisable. In the case of a bee or wasp sting, the homeopathic remedies Apis and Ledum help relieve stinging and

swelling. If there is an anaphylactic reaction, or if the airway is compromised in any way, get to a veterinarian

immediately. If you already know that your companion is predisposed to acute allergic reactions, you should be

carrying a prescription injectable epinephrine and antihistamine kit (Anakit or Epipen) that helps to antidote your

animal’s reaction to insect or reptile venoms. See your veterinarian about obtaining a kit.

被有毒蜘蛛（如棕隐士蜘蛛、黑寡妇蜘蛛）或毒蛇咬伤后，应立即服用大剂量的维生素 C 和紫锥菊，以

增强身体的免疫防御能力，并加强对相关组织的淋巴净化。强烈建议立即采取适当的顺势疗法。如果被蜜

蜂或黄蜂蜇伤，顺势疗法蜜蜂和杜香有助于缓解刺痛和肿胀。如果出现过敏反应，或者气道受到任何损

害，请立即去看兽医。如果您已经知道您的同伴容易发生急性过敏反应，您应该携带处方注射肾上腺素和

抗组胺药盒（Anakit 或 Epipen），以帮助解毒您的动物对昆虫或爬行动物毒液的反应。请咨询您的兽医以

获取套件。

=== PAGE 464 ===
BRUISES, BUMPS, AND OTHER BLUNT TRAUMAS

瘀伤、肿块和其他钝伤

Contusions (bruises) are caused when blunt impact or crushing pressure causes tissue damage and bleeding beneath

the skin. In humans, contusions are usually characterized by their purplish red color. Because animals have different

skin pigments and hair, feathers, fur, or scales to hide such evidence of injury, contusions and other forms of

traumatic, subdermal hematoma must be identified by other symptoms. Usually there is swelling and tenderness at

the site of a contusion. The animal may favor or lick the injured body area. Close examination (beneath the animal’s

coat) usually reveals discoloration at the site.

当钝器撞击或挤压压力导致组织损伤和皮下出血时，就会造成挫伤（瘀伤）。在人类中，挫伤通常以紫红

色为特征。由于动物具有不同的皮肤色素和毛发、羽毛、皮毛或鳞片来隐藏此类损伤、挫伤和其他形式的

外伤、皮下血肿的证据，因此必须通过其他症状来识别。通常挫伤部位会出现肿胀和压痛。动物可能会喜

欢或舔受伤的身体部位。仔细检查（在动物皮毛下面）通常会发现该部位变色。

Since contusions are contained beneath the skin, the risk of infection is low (provided the animal is healthy to

begin with). First aid usually begins with applying an ice pack to slow bleeding and assist the coagulation process.

Contrary to what some herbalists may think, arnica oil or salve is sometimes contraindicated in the early treatment

of contusions or subdermal hematoma. Arnica, a peripheral vasodilator that works rapidly, may actually increase

bleeding at the site of injury. Instead of reaching for your handy first aid vial of arnica oil, reach for an oil infusion

of yarrow. Yarrow is remarkable because it acts as a vasodilator when ingested but as a fast-acting vasoconstrictor

and hemostatic agent when applied topically. This makes it very useful for reducing the severity of fresh contusions,

especially when combined with an oil infusion of Saint-John’s-wort. Having a special affinity toward the repair of

crushed nerve endings, Saint-John’s-wort helps to relieve pain and minimize the possibility of lasting nerve

impairment. Comfrey oil, salve, and poultice are also excellent first aid devices for blunt trauma injuries because

they gently assist with lymph circulation without contributing to internal bleeding, and they accelerate the

regeneration of damaged cell structures.

由于挫伤位于皮下，因此感染的风险很低（只要动物一开始就健康）。急救通常从使用冰袋来减缓出血

并协助凝血过程开始。与一些草药医生的想法相反，山金车油或药膏有时在挫伤或皮下血肿的早期治疗中

是禁忌的。山金车是一种快速起效的外周血管扩张剂，实际上可能会增加受伤部位的出血。不要伸手去拿

手边的急救瓶山金车油，而是伸手去拿西洋蓍草油。西洋蓍草之所以引人注目，是因为它在摄入时可起到

血管扩张剂的作用，但在局部使用时可起到快速作用的血管收缩剂和止血剂的作用。这使得它对于减轻新

鲜挫伤的严重程度非常有用，特别是与圣约翰草油浸液结合使用时。圣约翰草对修复受损的神经末梢具有

特殊的亲和力，有助于缓解疼痛并最大限度地减少持久神经损伤的可能性。紫草油、药膏和膏药也是治疗

钝性创伤的极佳急救工具，因为它们可以温和地促进淋巴循环，而不会导致内出血，并且可以加速受损细

胞结构的再生。
