BURNS AND SCALDS

烧伤和烫伤

There are two important considerations to keep in mind when your companion suffers a burn. One is that until the

site of the injury cools down, cellular damage can continue for several minutes after a burn first occurs. This is

especially true if the burn was caused by steam or scalding fluid, which can penetrate tissues and carry injurious heat

deep beneath the skin. Another consideration to keep in mind is that when the skin is damaged, its ability to resist

infection is greatly impaired. To defend itself against invading bacteria, the skin relies upon delicate cell membranes

and thousands of tiny capillaries to carry lymph, blood, and various antibodies throughout its structure. When a burn

occurs, circulation is obstructed within the site of injury, and the deprived tissues are left vulnerable to infection.

当您的同伴被烧伤时，需要记住两个重要的注意事项。一是在烧伤部位冷却之前，细胞损伤可能会在烧伤

发生后持续几分钟。如果烧伤是由蒸汽或滚烫液体引起的，则尤其如此，因为蒸汽或滚烫液体可以穿透组

织并将有害热量带到皮肤深处。另一个需要记住的考虑因素是，当皮肤受损时，其抵抗感染的能力会大大

受损。为了抵御入侵的细菌，皮肤依靠脆弱的细胞膜和数千个微小的毛细血管在其整个结构中携带淋巴

液、血液和各种抗体。当烧伤发生时，受伤部位的血液循环会受到阻碍，受损的组织很容易受到感染。

The first course in treating a burn is to cool it down. Ideally, the site of the burn should be liberally irrigated with

cool sterile saline, which greatly reduces the continued destruction of cells. If sterile saline is not available, clean

water (preferably distilled), snow, or ice can be generously applied—just keep in mind that the area you are

irrigating is especially susceptible to any infectious microbes that may be in the water (i.e., the cleaner it is, the

better). Never apply a salve, oil, or ointment to a burn—these types of preparations can seal in heat and bacteria,

making the situation worse. Don’t cover the burned area with a bandage either unless you will be able to keep the

dressing continually soaked with cool, clean water.

治疗烧伤的第一个步骤是冷却烧伤。理想情况下，烧伤部位应该用冷无菌盐水充分冲洗，这大大减少了

细胞的持续破坏。如果没有无菌盐水，可以大量使用干净的水（最好是蒸馏水）、雪或冰——请记住，您

正在灌溉的区域特别容易受到水中可能存在的任何传染性微生物的影响（即，越干净越好）。切勿在烧伤

处涂抹药膏、油或药膏——这些类型的制剂会锁住热量和细菌，使情况变得更糟。也不要用绷带覆盖烧伤

区域，除非您能够使敷料持续被凉爽、干净的水浸泡。

If the burn appears to be deep (second or third degree) or if it involves the mouth, nose, feet, or a large percentage

of the animal’s body, get the animal to a veterinarian immediately—the situation might be serious.

如果烧伤看起来很深（二度或三度），或者涉及到动物的嘴、鼻子、脚或身体的很大一部分，请立即将

动物送往兽医处，情况可能会很严重。

The second course of action (for minor burns) is to take continuing measures to assure that the burn is kept clean.

Irrigate the burn several times each day with sterile saline. Aloe juice can be directly applied to the burn after each

irrigation to help fight infection, reduce pain, and speed the healing process. A cooled tea of chaparral, calendula, or

gotu kola can be effective for these purposes as well, as might a poultice of fresh chickweed. Comfrey is useful too,

but it should not be applied until you are absolutely sure that the risk of infection has passed. Comfrey heals wounds

so fast that it can seal bacteria or fungi into the wound! A skin rinse of chamomile, peppermint, catnip, bee balm, or

thyme may bring relief from pain. Lavender oil (8 drops diluted into each ounce of clean water) is also good for

relieving the pain of burns and scalds.

第二个行动方案（针对轻微烧伤）是采取持续措施以确保烧伤处保持清洁。每天用无菌盐水冲洗烧伤部

位数次。每次冲洗后，芦荟汁可以直接涂在烧伤处，以帮助抵抗感染、减轻疼痛并加速愈合过程。丛林

树、金盏花或雷公根的凉茶也能有效达到这些目的，新鲜繁缕的膏剂也能有效达到这些目的。紫草也很有

用，但在您完全确定感染风险已经过去之前不应使用。紫草治愈伤口的速度非常快，可以将细菌或真菌封

入伤口！用洋甘菊、薄荷、猫薄荷、蜂香膏或百里香进行皮肤冲洗可以缓解疼痛。薰衣草油（每盎司清水

中稀释 8 滴）也有助于缓解烧伤和烫伤的疼痛。

The homeopathic remedies Apis and Urtica spp. (nettle) are effective treatments for burns. We keep a bottle of

diluted Urtica tincture in our kitchen for use on burns. It takes the sting away immediately and prevents blistering. It

can also be given internally.

=== PAGE 466 ===
顺势疗法是蜜蜂和荨麻属。 （荨麻）是治疗烧伤的有效方法。我们在厨房里放了一瓶稀释的荨麻酊剂，

用于治疗烧伤。它可以立即消除刺痛并防止起泡。也可以内部给予。

To help the healing process from inside out, dietary supplements of vitamins C and E are important, as are fatty

acids. Gotu kola can be added to an animal’s diet to help with skin regeneration, as can horsetail.

为了帮助从内到外的愈合过程，维生素 C 和 E 以及脂肪酸的膳食补充剂很重要。雷公根可以添加到动物

的饮食中，以帮助皮肤再生，木贼也可以。

FRACTURES

骨折

Obviously, herbs cannot be expected to realign and set a broken bone, but a variety of herbs are useful throughout

the postclinical healing process. Horsetail, nettle, comfrey, and alfalfa all contain nutritional components that play

important roles in the healing of bone tissue. Yarrow and ginkgo help by increasing blood circulation in impaired

extremities. Licorice, yucca, devil’s claw, Saint-John’s-wort, and cayenne are all useful for reducing inflammation

and pain. Valerian, skullcap, passionflower, or hop can be used to help a recovering animal rest and relax.

显然，不能指望草药能够重新排列和固定断骨，但多种草药在整个临床后愈合过程中都是有用的。马尾

草、荨麻、紫草和苜蓿都含有在骨组织愈合中发挥重要作用的营养成分。西洋蓍草和银杏有助于增加受损

四肢的血液循环。甘草、丝兰、魔爪草、圣约翰草和辣椒都有助于减轻炎症和疼痛。缬草、黄芩、西番莲

或啤酒花可用于帮助恢复中的动物休息和放松。

HEATSTROKE, HYPERTHERMIA, AND HEAT EXHAUSTION

中暑、高热和热衰竭

Heatstroke or heat exhaustion can occur as a result of too much strenuous exercise or excessive exposure to heat. If

heatstroke is not treated immediately the animal’s body temperature may rise to irreversible levels and brain

damage, kidney failure, or death may quickly follow. Symptoms of heat illness include excessive panting or

difficulty breathing, high body temperature (above 104° F for a dog or cat), lethargy or collapse, loss of appetite,

bloody diarrhea or vomit, increased heart rate, increased respiratory rate, reddened tongue or eye tissues, hot and

flushed skin, and seizures or coma.

剧烈运动或过度受热可能会导致中暑或热衰竭。如果中暑不立即得到治疗，动物的体温可能会上升到不可

逆转的水平，并且很快就会出现脑损伤、肾衰竭或死亡。热病的症状包括过度气喘或呼吸困难、体温过高

（狗或猫高于 104°F）、嗜睡或虚脱、食欲不振、血性腹泻或呕吐、心率加快、呼吸频率加快、舌头发红或

发红。眼组织、皮肤发热、潮红、癫痫发作或昏迷。

ALL-PURPOSE FIRST AID OIL OR SALVE

通用急救油或药膏

Saint-John’s-wort oil infusion

圣约翰草油输液

Oregon Grape oil infusion

俄勒冈州葡萄油输液

Comfrey oil infusion

紫草油输液

1 oz grated beeswax

1 盎司磨碎的蜂蜡

Combine equal amounts of the oil infusions. Add the grated beeswax to the combined oils. Gently heat the

mixture over a low flame, stirring constantly until the beeswax has completely melted and combined with the

oils. Remove from heat and pour into salve jars immediately—it thickens as it cools.

混合等量的油浸液。将磨碎的蜂蜡添加到混合油中。用小火轻轻加热混合物，不断搅拌，直到蜂蜡

完全融化并与油混合。从火上移开并立即倒入药膏罐中——冷却时它会变稠。

Perhaps the most common cause of heat-related illness and death in dogs and cats occurs when they are left in

cars on a warm or hot day. Don’t ever leave your companion in the car unless the weather is mild, there is ample

shade to park under, the windows can be left rolled down, and the animal is left with plenty of drinking water. Even

on days that don’t seem hot, the temperature in a well-ventilated vehicle can exceed 100° F in a matter of minutes.

With the windows rolled up, the temperature can climb to 180° F (a steak cooks at 140° F)! Dogs and cats need to

pant and get fresh air to cool themselves. If you find an animal in a car that is closed up, try to contact the owner and

offer to give a bowl of water to his or her companion who “looks thirsty.” If done in a nonthreatening way, without

offending the person, you could save an animal’s life. If the person insists on letting the animal suffer, call the local

law enforcement agency.

狗和猫与热有关的疾病和死亡的最常见原因可能是当它们在温暖或炎热的天气里被留在车里时。永远不

要把你的同伴留在车里，除非天气温和、有足够的阴凉处可以停车、车窗可以摇下、并且动物有充足的饮

用水。即使在看起来不热的日子里，通风良好的车辆内的温度也可能在几分钟内超过 100°F。当车窗摇起

=== PAGE 469 ===
时，温度可升至 180°F（牛排的烹饪温度为 140°F）！狗和猫需要喘气并呼吸新鲜空气来给自己降温。如果

您在封闭的车内发现动物，请尝试联系车主并主动为“看起来口渴”的同伴提供一碗水。如果以不具威胁性

的方式进行，且不冒犯他人，您就可以挽救动物的生命。如果该人坚持让动物受苦，请致电当地执法机

构。

If your companion displays signs of heat-related illness, get to a cool area immediately, wet the animal with

water, and if possible, take the animal’s rectal temperature. If the animal’s temperature seems abnormally high, get

to a vet immediately. If you are carrying a homeopathic kit with you, you might try administering a dose of

Glonoinum (30C) while en route. Rescue Remedy (a flower essence formula) might be helpful as well. Allow your

animal to drink as much cool water as he needs.

如果您的同伴出现与热有关的疾病迹象，请立即前往凉爽的地方，用水弄湿动物，如果可能，测量动物

的直肠温度。如果动物的体温异常高，请立即去看兽医。如果您随身携带顺势疗法套件，您可以尝试在途

中服用一剂 Glonoinum (30C)。 Rescue Remedy（花精配方）也可能有帮助。让您的动物根据需要喝尽可能

多的凉水。

After the danger has passed and your companion appears to be recovering, you can begin replacing lost minerals

and nutrients by feeding him herbs such as nettle or chickweed tea.

危险过去并且您的同伴似乎正在康复后，您可以开始通过给他喂荨麻或繁缕茶等草药来补充失去的矿物

质和营养。

MOTION SICKNESS

晕车

Motion sickness is fairly common among dogs and cats, especially puppies and those who seldom take rides in cars.

The causes of motion sickness are varied. The inner ears of puppies and other young animals continue to develop

until the animals approach adolescence, which means that their equilibrium may be especially sensitive to motion.

Another factor comes into play in animals who are frightened or become hyperactive during car rides. In these

animals, extreme nervousness may cause stomach upset, dizziness, or hyperventilation, all of which can result in

vomiting.

晕车在狗和猫中相当常见，尤其是小狗和那些很少乘车的人。晕车的原因多种多样。小狗和其他幼年动物

的内耳持续发育，直到动物接近青春期，这意味着它们的平衡可能对运动特别敏感。另一个因素会影响动

物在乘车时受到惊吓或变得过度活跃。在这些动物中，极度紧张可能会导致胃部不适、头晕或换气过度，

所有这些都会导致呕吐。

In most cases, motion sickness becomes less of a problem as an animal matures or becomes accustomed to the

feeling of hurtling through space in a “crate on wheels.” Have you ever thought about how an animal might perceive

such an unnatural occurrence as a car ride? With this in mind, it’s important to help your companion to consider car

rides to be fun as early in life as possible. Make a point to play with your companion at the destinations of her first

couple dozen car trips to replace confusion and fear with anticipation of a good time. For many animals, this

approach is effective. We dearly remember riding to our mountain cabin with our dog Mollie on weekends. The

winding highway and steep ravines often made her nervous and carsick, so each time we reached the most

challenging part of the highway, we would begin saying to her, “Get your Frisbee! Get your stick! Do you want to

go swimming? Find the cat (her beloved friend and playmate)!” After a few verses of this, her mind would be so

focused on the playtime that would soon follow that she would forget about the frightening ride and car sickness

wasn’t a problem. Eventually, her nervousness during car rides was completely replaced by the thrill of another

adventure.

在大多数情况下，随着动物成熟或习惯了在“带轮子的板条箱”中飞驰穿过太空的感觉，晕动病就不再是

一个问题。您是否想过动物会如何看待开车这样的不自然事件？考虑到这一点，帮助您的伴侣尽早认识到

开车是一件很有趣的事情很重要。记得和你的同伴一起去她前几次汽车旅行的目的地玩，用对美好时光的

期待来取代困惑和恐惧。对于许多动物来说，这种方法是有效的。我们深深地记得周末和我们的狗莫莉一

起骑车去我们的山间小屋。蜿蜒的公路和陡峭的山沟经常让她紧张和晕车，所以每次我们到达公路上最有

挑战性的部分时，我们都会开始对她说：“拿起你的飞盘！拿起你的棍子！你想去游泳吗？找到那只猫（她

心爱的朋友和玩伴）！”读完几节之后，她的注意力就会集中在接下来的游戏时间上，以至于忘记了可怕的

旅程，晕车也不再是问题了。最终，她在乘车时的紧张完全被另一场冒险的兴奋所取代。

Of course, some animals may never get over motion sickness, and anything that might help is certainly

appreciated, especially if you’re sharing a subcompact sedan with a Newfoundland. Ginger, peppermint, catnip,

fennel, or dill might help relieve an upset stomach that might lead to vomiting. Ginkgo is known to improve blood

circulation in the inner ear and may help with equilibrium problems. Valerian helps calm a hyperactive animal and

also eases a nervous stomach. Skullcap, passionflower, and oatstraw are all excellent nervine-sedatives that can help

reduce nervous anxiety. Of course, before you try any of these (in combination or singularly), give Rescue Remedy

(flower essences) a try. A few drops on your animal’s tongue just before you get into the car might make the

difference between an unpleasant episode and a fun car ride.

当然，有些动物可能永远无法克服晕动病，任何可能有帮助的东西肯定会受到赞赏，特别是如果您与纽

芬兰共享一辆超小型轿车。生姜、薄荷、猫薄荷、茴香或莳萝可能有助于缓解可能导致呕吐的胃部不适。

众所周知，银杏可以改善内耳的血液循环，并可能有助于解决平衡问题。缬草有助于使过度活跃的动物平

静下来，也能缓解紧张的胃部症状。黄芩、西番莲和燕麦草都是极好的神经镇静剂，可以帮助减少神经焦

虑。当然，在尝试其中任何一种（组合或单独）之前，请先尝试一下 Rescue Remedy（花精）。在你上车之

前在你的动物的舌头上滴几滴可能会导致一次不愉快的经历和一次有趣的乘车之旅。

=== PAGE 471 ===
PENETRATING INJURIES (CUTS, SCRAPES, PUNCTURES)

穿透伤（割伤、擦伤、刺伤）

Penetrating injuries are part of life, especially if you have an active outdoor animal. Animals tolerate wounds much

better than we humans do, and provided animals have healthy lymph and immune systems and no blood-clotting

disorders, minor open injuries usually heal quickly and completely. The primary concern here is that the injury is

kept clean and as well ventilated as cleanliness allows. From a holistic perspective, an animal licking his open

wound is a natural part of the healing process. This is how animals cleanse wounds, and, in fact, the saliva of dogs

and cats contain antimicrobial properties that help fight infection and speed healing.

穿透伤是生活的一部分，特别是如果您有一只活跃的户外动物。动物比我们人类更能忍受伤口，只要动物

有健康的淋巴和免疫系统并且没有凝血障碍，轻微的开放性损伤通常会快速完全愈合。这里最主要的问题

是保持伤口清洁并在清洁允许的情况下保持良好的通风。从整体角度来看，动物舔开放性伤口是愈合过程

的自然组成部分。这就是动物清洁伤口的方式，事实上，狗和猫的唾液含有抗菌特性，有助于抵抗感染和

加速愈合。

At the onset of a penetrating injury, the first course of action is to make sure that the bleeding is in no way life

threatening. If bleeding is profuse, nothing serves as a better hemostatic agent than a half-and-half mix of powdered

cayenne and yarrow. When applied liberally and directly into a wound, these two herbs work amazingly well to stop

hemorrhage and inhibit infection. After the powder is applied, gauze compresses can then be placed on top to assist

the process and keep the injury clean. Treat for shock, and get your companion to a veterinarian immediately.

发生穿透伤时，首要措施是确保出血不会危及生命。如果出血较多，没有什么比辣椒粉和西洋蓍草各半

的混合物更好的止血剂了。当大量直接涂抹到伤口上时，这两种草药可以非常有效地止血和抑制感染。涂

抹粉末后，可以将纱布敷在上面以协助该过程并保持伤口清洁。治疗休克，并立即让您的同伴去看兽医。

If the wound does not appear to be life threatening, allow it to flush and seal itself, and thoroughly clean the site

with fresh water (use sterile saline if possible) or some hydrogen peroxide as soon as possible. Oregon grape,

goldenseal, Saint-John’s-wort, thyme, sage, echinacea, or yarrow tea or liniment can be used to irrigate the wound

each day to help prevent infection. Tea tree oil is effective too, but it must be diluted. Add 8 drops into 1 ounce of

olive, almond, or apricot kernel oil. Calendula, comfrey, gotu kola, or aloe can be added to the daily regimen after

risk of infection has passed to help speed the healing process and reduce scarring. Any or all of the herbs we just

mentioned can be used in the form of a first aid salve that is applied between each daily cleansing. The salve is also

useful for field treatment of minor wounds.

如果伤口看起来没有危及生命，请让它自行冲洗并密封，并尽快用淡水（如果可能，使用无菌盐水）或

一些过氧化氢彻底清洁该部位。每天可以使用俄勒冈葡萄、白毛茛、圣约翰草、百里香、鼠尾草、紫锥菊

或西洋蓍草茶或搽剂来冲洗伤口，以帮助预防感染。茶树油也有效，但必须稀释。将 8 滴加入 1 盎司橄榄

油、杏仁油或杏仁油中。感染风险过去后，可以将金盏花、紫草、积雪草或芦荟添加到日常护理中，以帮

助加快愈合过程并减少疤痕。我们刚才提到的任何或所有草药都可以以急救药膏的形式使用，在每次日常

清洁之间使用。该药膏还可用于现场治疗小伤口。

POISONING

中毒

A shocking number of companion animals die each year of poisoning. Some cases involve cruel human intent,

others an unfortunate discovery or accident. But most companion animal poisonings are the direct result of

carelessness. Improperly stored or disposed of automotive antifreeze fluid represents one of the most frequent causes

of accidental animal poisoning. Ethylene glycol, the compound found in antifreeze, has a sweet flavor that is

appealing to dogs, cats, and other animals. It destroys the kidneys, and as little as 1 tablespoon can be fatal to a

medium or large dog.

每年都有数量惊人的伴侣动物死于中毒。有些案件涉及残酷的人类意图，其他案件则涉及不幸的发现或事

故。但大多数伴侣动物中毒都是由于粗心大意造成的。汽车防冻液储存或处理不当是动物意外中毒的最常

见原因之一。乙二醇是防冻剂中的化合物，具有甜味，对狗、猫和其他动物很有吸引力。它会破坏肾脏，

只要一汤匙就可能对中型或大型狗致命。

Lead poisoning from old house paint, discarded batteries, spilled petroleum products, or industrial waste is also a

common cause of companion animal poisoning. Pesticides, herbicides, and household cleaning chemicals are

familiar toxins as well.

旧房屋油漆、废弃电池、溢出的石油产品或工业废物导致的铅中毒也是伴侣动物中毒的常见原因。杀虫

剂、除草剂和家用清洁化学品也是常见的毒素。

The mechanisms by which poisons act against the body are as varied as their chemistries. Lead-based poisons

cause brain damage, while pesticides, herbicides, and household chemicals may cause nervous system damage, liver

and kidney damage, internal bleeding, hypoxic blood disorders, or even cancer. Certain plants may cause poisoning

too, although animals are less likely to ingest them, and their effects are mostly limited to digestive upset,

photosensitive reactions, rashes, and in a few cases, internal bleeding. Food poisoning is usually limited to the

digestive tract and is generally corrected by vomiting.

毒物作用于人体的机制与其化学成分一样多种多样。铅类毒物会导致脑损伤，而杀虫剂、除草剂和家用

化学品可能会导致神经系统损伤、肝肾损伤、内出血、缺氧性血液疾病，甚至癌症。某些植物也可能引起

中毒，尽管动物摄入它们的可能性较小，而且它们的影响大多仅限于消化不良、光敏反应、皮疹，在少数

情况下还会导致内出血。食物中毒通常仅限于消化道，通常通过呕吐来纠正。

The chemical structure of a poison and the way it behaves in the body dictates the manner in which an animal is

treated. In some cases, vomiting is induced to expel the poison from the body as quickly as possible. But in other

instances, such as ingestion of petroleum products or acids, vomiting may further compound the problem by

allowing poison to enter the lungs or burn the esophagus on the way out. This makes a general approach to

poisoning impossible and illustrates why it’s critically important to identify the source of poisoning as quickly as

possible.

毒药的化学结构及其在体内的作用方式决定了对待动物的方式。在某些情况下，会诱导呕吐以尽快将毒

物排出体外。但在其他情况下，例如摄入石油产品或酸，呕吐可能会导致毒物进入肺部或在排出时烧伤食

道，从而进一步加剧问题。这使得不可能采用一般的中毒方法，并说明了为什么尽快识别中毒源至关重

要。

To prepare for the unforeseeable, keep some activated charcoal on hand. This is fed to a poisoned animal under

the direction of a veterinarian to help absorb many forms of poison as the animal is rushed to the veterinary hospital.

为了应对不可预见的情况，请准备一些活性炭。当动物被送往兽医医院时，在兽医的指导下将其喂给中

毒的动物，以帮助吸收多种形式的毒物。

If a poisoning does happen, don’t waste time with home treatment—get your companion to a veterinarian

immediately! If two or more humans are present, one should transport the animal, while the other(s) should confirm

the identity of the suspected poison and relay that information to the waiting veterinarian.

如果确实发生中毒，不要浪费时间进行家庭治疗——立即让你的同伴去看兽医！如果有两人或多人在

场，其中一人应运送动物，而其他人应确认可疑毒物的身份，并将该信息传递给等待的兽医。

=== PAGE 473 ===
Although many types of herbs such as violet root, elderberry, and aloe can be used to induce vomiting in certain

cases of poisoning, this action is not recommended unless you know the exact nature of the poison and the proper

course of action. Guessing can be fatal. Therefore, herbs are best reserved to support and help rejuvenate an animal’s

body after the crisis has passed.

虽然紫罗兰根、接骨木和芦荟等许多类型的草药可以在某些中毒病例中用于催吐，但不建议这样做，除

非您知道毒物的确切性质和正确的操作步骤。猜测可能是致命的。因此，在危机过后，最好保留草药来支

持和帮助动物的身体恢复活力。

To help repair the liver after a poisoning, milk thistle is strongly indicated. If the liver is inflamed, licorice may be

of benefit. Mild cholagogue, alterative, and diuretic herbs, such as dandelion (root and leaf), burdock, alfalfa, and

red clover, assist the body in efforts to eliminate residual toxins and their metabolic by-products. Yellow dock is

believed to help remove heavy metals from the body. Immunostimulant and antioxidant herbs such as echinacea and

garlic give the immune system a needed boost, while adaptogens such as astragalus or Siberian ginseng can help

improve the body’s overall responses to the added stress. If kidney damage is evident, marshmallow, corn silk,

ginkgo, hawthorn, horsetail, and couch grass are all candidates for use.

为了帮助中毒后修复肝脏，强烈建议使用水飞蓟。如果肝脏发炎，甘草可能会有帮助。温和的利胆药、

替代药和利尿药草，如蒲公英（根和叶）、牛蒡、苜蓿和红三叶草，有助于身体消除残留毒素及其代谢副

产物。黄坞被认为有助于清除体内的重金属。紫锥菊和大蒜等免疫刺激剂和抗氧化草药可以增强免疫系统

所需的功能，而黄芪或西伯利亚人参等适应原则可以帮助改善身体对额外压力的整体反应。如果肾脏损伤

明显，棉花糖、玉米须、银杏、山楂、马尾草和茅草都可以使用。

If you wish to learn more about poisonings or need help during an emergency, call the Animal Poison Control

Center at 1-888-426-4435. A consultation fee of $60 applies.

如果您想了解有关中毒的更多信息或在紧急情况下需要帮助，请致电动物中毒控制中心：1-888-426-

4435。需支付 60 美元的咨询费。

SHOCK

震惊

Shock occurs when the vascular system is unable to provide adequate blood supply to vital organs. Hemorrhagic

shock is caused when blood pressure and volume are reduced as a result of internal or external bleeding.

Cardiogenic shock occurs when heart disease or dysfunction causes a reduction of blood delivery to other organs.

Septic shock is caused when bacteria invade the heart muscle, other organs, or the blood itself and cause enough

injury to cells to interfere with their ability to utilize oxygen. All types of shock create a situation in which various

body tissues are deprived of oxygen that would normally be provided by the blood. Shock is therefore a life-

threatening situation that demands immediate and decisive first aid attention. Get to a vet! You must stop bleeding

and take measures to increase blood volume immediately. If the animal’s breathing is labored, try to position his

body in a way that appears to make breathing easier. If possible, try to keep the lower half of the animal’s body

slightly higher than the heart and head—this helps to keep blood volume at the brain, heart, and lungs.

当血管系统无法为重要器官提供足够的血液供应时，就会发生休克。失血性休克是由于内出血或外出血导

致血压和血容量降低而引起的。当心脏病或功能障碍导致其他器官的血液输送减少时，就会发生心源性休

克。当细菌侵入心肌、其他器官或血液本身并对细胞造成足够的损伤以干扰其利用氧气的能力时，就会引

起感染性休克。所有类型的休克都会造成各种身体组织失去通常由血液提供的氧气。因此，休克是一种危

及生命的情况，需要立即采取果断的急救措施。去看兽医！必须立即止血并采取措施增加血容量。如果动

物呼吸困难，请尝试将其身体摆在看起来更容易呼吸的位置。如果可能的话，尽量让动物的下半身略高于

心脏和头部——这有助于保持大脑、心脏和肺部的血容量。

While en route to the veterinarian, Rescue Remedy can be applied to the ears, paws, or lips of a conscious or

unconscious animal. TTouch, acupressure, and homeopathic remedies (Aconite and Arnica) may also prove helpful.

If you’ve been trained, be prepared to perform CPR in the event of cardiac arrest.

在去看兽医的途中，可以将救援药物涂抹在有意识或无意识的动物的耳朵、爪子或嘴唇上。触摸、穴位

按摩和顺势疗法（附子和山金车）也可能有帮助。如果您接受过培训，请准备好在心脏骤停时进行心肺复

苏。

After a shock crisis is over, cardiopulmonary function can be assisted with the use of cardiovascular tonics.

Hawthorn and ginkgo can be fed to strengthen the heart and increase blood circulation throughout the body. Yarrow

or cayenne can be used to increase blood circulation and oxygenation in the lungs. Nettle, spirulina, and alfalfa are

good nutritives for building healthy blood. Garlic feeds the blood and also has antioxidant, vascular tonic, and

immunotonic qualities.

休克危机结束后，可以使用心血管补品来辅助心肺功能。常食山楂、白果可强心、增加全身血液循环。

西洋蓍草或辣椒可用于增加肺部的血液循环和氧合。荨麻、螺旋藻和苜蓿是构建健康血液的良好营养物

质。大蒜可以滋养血液，还具有抗氧化、强血管和免疫功能。

=== PAGE 475 ===
TENDONITIS, SPRAINS, AND LIGAMENT INJURIES

肌腱炎、扭伤和韧带损伤

Injuries of fibrous tissues that connect muscle with bone can be extremely painful and slow to heal. Generally

speaking, the sooner herbal therapy starts, the faster the animal’s recovery will be.

连接肌肉和骨骼的纤维组织受伤可能会非常痛苦且愈合缓慢。一般来说，越早开始草药治疗，动物的恢复

速度就越快。

Arnica oil, salve, or poultice should be applied immediately after the injury occurs—this begins the healing

process by increasing capillary circulation and lymphatic infusion. However, Arnica should not be used on open

wounds. If Arnica is not available, yarrow, cayenne, or Saint-John’s-wort may prove beneficial, as will a poultice

compress of comfrey. Homeopathic Arnica, Ledum, Rhus toxicodendron, or Ruta (depending on symptoms) may be

effective first aid treatments as well.

受伤发生后应立即使用山金车油、药膏或膏剂——通过增加毛细血管循环和淋巴液灌注来开始愈合过

程。然而，山金车不应用于开放性伤口。如果没有山金车，西洋蓍草、辣椒或圣约翰草可能会有所帮助，

紫草敷料也可能有效。顺势疗法山金车、杜香、漆树或芸香（取决于症状）也可能是有效的急救疗法。

To continue the healing process, the animal’s diet can be supplemented with vitamin C and glucosamine sulfate or

chondroitin sulfate. These supplements play positive roles in the reconstruction of connective tissues. Feeding your

companion animal horsetail and comfrey can also aid in the reconstructive process. To help minimize pain and

inflammation, yucca, licorice, willow bark (but not for cats), devil’s claw, and boswellia are all choices to consider.

Yarrow and ginkgo can be fed to maintain good blood circulation in the affected extremity.

为了继续愈合过程，可以在动物的饮食中补充维生素 C 和硫酸氨基葡萄糖或硫酸软骨素。这些补充剂在

结缔组织的重建中发挥积极作用。给你的伴侣动物喂马尾草和紫草也有助于重建过程。为了帮助减轻疼痛

和炎症，丝兰、甘草、柳树皮（但不适用于猫）、魔爪草和乳香都是可以考虑的选择。可以喂西洋蓍草和

银杏，以维持患肢良好的血液循环。

=== PAGE 476 ===
IMMUNE SYSTEM CARE

免疫系统护理

To recognize and treat immune system disorders effectively, it’s important to have a general understanding of what

the immune system is and how it works. The immune system is composed of a complex assortment of various cells

and molecules, all of which are joined in an interdependent effort to maintain a balanced state of health. Each and

every organ, tissue, and cell of the body has an integral role in this effort—the liver and kidneys, for instance, are

responsible for filtering toxins and waste from the blood, and the skin serves as a first line of defense against

pathogenic microbes and other environmental threats. Working beneath or within the structures and functions of the

various organs and tissues of the body is a sophisticated army of frontline defenders—the millions of special cells,

molecules, and microbes we know specifically as the immune system. Each member of this elite army has a special

function—some members serve as sentries and detectives with the sole purpose of seeking out and identifying

harmful invaders or waste products, while others serve as responding attackers to kill and remove invading microbes

and other foreign substances.

为了有效地识别和治疗免疫系统疾病，重要的是要对免疫系统是什么及其工作原理有一个大致的了解。免

疫系统由各种复杂的细胞和分子组成，所有这些细胞和分子相互依存，共同维持健康的平衡状态。身体的

每一个器官、组织和细胞在这项工作中都发挥着不可或缺的作用——例如，肝脏和肾脏负责过滤血液中的

毒素和废物，而皮肤则是抵御细菌感染的第一道防线。病原微生物和其他环境威胁。在身体各个器官和组

织的结构和功能之下或内部工作的是一支复杂的前线防御军队——数以百万计的特殊细胞、分子和微生

物，我们称之为免疫系统。这支精锐军队的每个成员都有特殊的职能——一些成员充当哨兵和侦探，其唯

一目的是寻找和识别有害入侵者或废物，而另一些成员则充当响应攻击者，杀死和清除入侵的微生物和其

他外来物质。

Like any army, the immune system must quickly reach each battlefield, or site of infection, to be effective. To

allow a rapid response, the blood and lymphatic system serve as the army’s transport and incursion system. The

blood carries antibodies (specialized proteins that serve to detect and report any foreign presence to the army’s

soldiers), lymphocytes and monocytes (the first-response assault teams), and interleukins and various other

cytokines (messenger molecules that provide communication between other elements of the army), as well as

oxygen and nutrients that are necessary to feed tissues and wage a battle wherever the immune army is needed. To

clean up the aftermath of battle, the spleen filters the blood and serves as a fatal trap for foreign bodies that were not

killed by the body’s warriors.

像任何军队一样，免疫系统必须快速到达每个战场或感染地点才能发挥作用。为了实现快速反应，血液

和淋巴系统充当军队的运输和入侵系统。血液携带抗体（用于检测并向军队士兵报告任何异物存在的特殊

蛋白质）、淋巴细胞和单核细胞（第一反应突击队）以及白细胞介素和各种其他细胞因子（在身体其他成

分之间提供通讯的信使分子）。军队），以及为组织提供营养所需的氧气和营养物质，并在需要免疫军队

的地方发动战斗。为了清理战斗的余波，脾脏会过滤血液，并成为未被身体战士杀死的异物的致命陷阱。

The lymphatic system’s purpose is to cleanse and nourish cells and tissues and to carry the immune effort across

barriers that cannot be effectively reached by the blood. Lymphocytes are produced in the bone marrow, thymus

(hence the “T” in killer T cells), and throughout the body in various mucosal-associated lymphoid tissues. The

lymph (a clear, viscous fluid) then carries these warriors via an intricate network of tiny vessels on an endless

journey in and out of the bloodstream and the body’s various tissues. As the lymphocytes seek and destroy foreign

invaders, the lymph picks up their dead bodies and other debris. The waste is then filtered out and surviving invaders

are destroyed at lymph nodes that are strategically positioned throughout the body.

淋巴系统的目的是清洁和滋养细胞和组织，并携带免疫努力穿过血液无法有效到达的屏障。淋巴细胞在

骨髓、胸腺（因此是杀伤性 T 细胞中的“T”）以及全身各种粘膜相关淋巴组织中产生。然后，淋巴液（一种

透明的粘性液体）携带这些战士通过复杂的微小血管网络，在血液和身体的各种组织中进行无尽的进出之

旅。当淋巴细胞寻找并消灭外来入侵者时，淋巴液会拾起他们的尸体和其他碎片。然后废物被过滤掉，幸

存的入侵者在遍布全身的淋巴结处被消灭。

=== PAGE 477 ===
Autoimmune disease or dysfunction occurs when one or more elements of the immune system becomes deficient,

overwhelmed, or overactive. Holistic treatment of autoimmune diseases (such as lupus, arthritis, FIV, allergies, to

name a few) centers on assisting the body in its innate ability to establish and maintain balance and preparedness

within the immune system. The use of vaccines, antibiotics, and steroid drugs is contradictory to the holistic healing

effort because these substances are antagonistic to the body’s natural defense mechanisms. Such measures work by

suppressing, confusing, or bypassing natural immune functions, which amounts to an artificially induced state of

autoimmune deficiency.

当免疫系统的一种或多种要素变得不足、不堪重负或过度活跃时，就会发生自身免疫性疾病或功能障

碍。自身免疫性疾病（例如狼疮、关节炎、FIV、过敏等）的整体治疗重点是帮助身体发挥其固有能力，在

免疫系统内建立和维持平衡和准备。疫苗、抗生素和类固醇药物的使用与整体治疗工作相矛盾，因为这些

物质与人体的自然防御机制相反。这些措施通过抑制、混淆或绕过自然免疫功能发挥作用，这相当于人为

诱导的自身免疫缺陷状态。

Barring genetic predisposition, animals who are consistently well nourished and properly cared for have strong

immune systems throughout their long, healthy lives. On the other hand, animals who are subjected to

immunosuppressive drug therapies eventually develop some form of immune dysfunction—perhaps arthritis,

chronic seborrhea, allergies, or diminished resistance to certain strains of bacteria, fungi, or parasites.

除非有遗传倾向，持续得到良好营养和适当照顾的动物在其漫长、健康的一生中都具有强大的免疫系

统。另一方面，接受免疫抑制药物治疗的动物最终会出现某种形式的免疫功能障碍——可能是关节炎、慢

性皮脂溢、过敏或对某些细菌、真菌或寄生虫菌株的抵抗力减弱。

Stimulating the immune system with echinacea may be counter-productive to the healing process.

用紫锥菊刺激免疫系统可能会对愈合过程产生反作用。

Whether or not to vaccinate your companion involves heated arguments among animal care professionals on both

sides of the issue, as well as political, social, economic, and legal interests. At the root of all the confusion lies a

pressing question: Should well-informed animal guardians be allowed to decide what is best for their beloved

companion animals? We, of course, believe that owners should have that right. Although we cannot advise anyone

to break the law in areas where vaccinations are deemed mandatory, we are holistically opposed to vaccinating

animals.

是否给你的伴侣接种疫苗涉及动物护理专业人士双方的激烈争论，以及政治、社会、经济和法律利益。

HERBS FOR IMMUNE SYSTEM SUPPORT

支持免疫系统的草药

Many of the diseases and problems discussed in this book are related to the immune system. A few diseases or

syndromes are recognized as being directly related to immunity and might be considered autoimmune diseases.

When most herb users think of immune system support, immunostimulant standbys such as echinacea immediately

come to mind. For many immune-related disorders, however, increased stimulation of immune system functions

represents only a small part of a complete herbal therapy, and in some cases, stimulation of immune activities may

actually be counterproductive in the healing effort. A good case in point is discoid lupus erythematosus (DLE), a

disease that occurs primarily in dogs and less commonly in cats. Discoid lupus erythematosus is a chronic

inflammatory condition of the skin (primarily that of the nose, lips, cheeks, and ears) that occurs as the result of a

failure in the regulating mechanisms of the immune system, specifically those that prevent the body from attacking

its own cells. In other words, the immune army works against the body it is supposed to protect. Animals with DLE

typically suffer from pyoderma, seborrhea, and other chronic conditions of the skin, as well as arthritis, kidney

problems, and other immune-mediated forms of disease. For obvious reasons, it would be inadvisable to further

stimulate the immune system with herbs such as echinacea. On the other hand, many herbs can act as immune

moderators, meaning that they help adjust the immune system into balance. Such herbs include astragalus, shiitake

and reishi mushrooms, garlic, and ginseng.

本书讨论的许多疾病和问题都与免疫系统有关。一些疾病或综合症被认为与免疫直接相关，可能被认为是

自身免疫性疾病。当大多数草药使用者想到免疫系统支持时，立即想到的是紫锥菊等免疫刺激备用品。然

而，对于许多与免疫相关的疾病，增加免疫系统功能的刺激仅代表完整草药疗法的一小部分，并且在某些

情况下，刺激免疫活动实际上可能会在治疗过程中起反作用。盘状红斑狼疮 (DLE) 就是一个很好的例子，

这种疾病主要发生在狗身上，猫身上较少见。盘状红斑狼疮是一种慢性皮肤炎症（主要是鼻子、嘴唇、脸

颊和耳朵），是由于免疫系统调节机制（特别是那些阻止身体攻击的调节机制）失败而发生的。它自己的

细胞。换句话说，免疫大军正在对抗它本应保护的身体。患有 DLE 的动物通常患有脓皮病、皮脂溢和其他

慢性皮肤病，以及关节炎、肾脏问题和其他免疫介导的疾病。出于显而易见的原因，不建议用紫锥菊等草

药进一步刺激免疫系统。另一方面，许多草药可以充当免疫调节剂，这意味着它们有助于调整免疫系统平

衡。这些草药包括黄芪、香菇、灵芝、大蒜和人参。

The immune system and its variable problems are complex, and no single herb serves as a panacea for immune

system dysfunction. Because a great deal of sensationalism has been placed on herbs that have been shown to

stimulate immune system functions, many people have been led to believe that an herb such as echinacea is always

the first thing to reach for to fight any problem that involves the immune system. Entrepreneurs have made such

claims a multimillion dollar affair, but the claims simply aren’t true.

免疫系统及其各种问题很复杂，没有一种草药可以作为治疗免疫系统功能障碍的灵丹妙药。由于人们对

那些已被证明可以刺激免疫系统功能的草药进行了大量的耸人听闻的宣传，许多人被引导相信，紫锥菊等

草药始终是解决任何涉及免疫系统问题的首选草药。系统。企业家们声称这种说法是一件耗资数百万美元

的事情，但这些说法根本不属实。

Contrary to what many herb product manufacturers might lead you to believe, immune system support does not

begin with stimulation. In fact, stimulation should be limited to activating a healthy immune system in times when

increased immune response is necessary to repel viral, bacterial, or fungal infection. In some cases of immune-

mediated disease, immunostimulants may ultimately do more harm than good. For instance, echinacea and Saint-

John’s-wort are capable of stimulating reproduction of killer T cells, the search-and-destroy soldiers whose numbers

are severely diminished in people or animals with AIDS. On the surface of the problem, stimulation of T cells may

sound like a good idea, but by stimulating their reproduction, we may also be aggravating and accelerating the

mechanisms that are causing their destruction. Therefore, the best course of action in immune-mediated problems is

to support the body in its efforts to reestablish and maintain healthy balance among all aspects of natural immunity.

与许多草药产品制造商可能会让您相信的相反，免疫系统支持并不是从刺激开始的。事实上，当需要增

强免疫反应来抵抗病毒、细菌或真菌感染时，刺激应仅限于激活健康的免疫系统。在某些免疫介导疾病的

情况下，免疫刺激剂最终可能弊大于利。例如，紫锥菊和圣约翰草能够刺激杀伤性 T 细胞的繁殖，杀伤性

T 细胞是一种搜索和消灭士兵，在患有艾滋病的人或动物中，其数量严重减少。从表面上看，刺激 T 细胞

可能听起来是个好主意，但通过刺激它们的繁殖，我们也可能会加剧和加速导致其破坏的机制。因此，解

If stimulating the immune system is indicated, several herbs are available that have immunostimulant qualities.

Some herbs, such as echinacea, have strong and specific immune-stimulating activities, making them especially

useful when the immune system needs a quick boost. Others, such as garlic, Siberian ginseng, astragalus, licorice,

shiitake and reishi mushrooms, and turmeric, offer immune-supportive qualities in addition to a wide spectrum of

tonic activities. For instance, astragalus, shiitake and reishi mushrooms, and Siberian ginseng are all adaptogens,

meaning that they help increase energy levels and improve the body’s ability to respond to stressful situations (such

as systemic disease, infection, or emotional trauma). Garlic offers strong antimicrobial, antioxidant, and hypotensive

activities in addition to being an immunostimulant device. Turmeric stimulates liver and digestive functions as part

making them useful in treating Addison’s disease (hypoadrenocorticism) or problems that stem from steroid drug

如果需要刺激免疫系统，可以使用几种具有免疫刺激特性的草药。一些草药，例如紫锥菊，具有强烈且

特定的免疫刺激活性，当免疫系统需要快速增强时，它们特别有用。其他的，如大蒜、西伯利亚人参、黄

芪、甘草、香菇、灵芝和姜黄，除了广泛的滋补作用外，还提供免疫支持特性。例如，黄芪、香菇、灵芝

In summary, before you pick up echinacea for immune system support, educate yourself. Find out more about

ALLERGIES

过敏

Allergies occur when antigenic substances (allergens) enter the body and trigger a disproportionately aggressive

immune response. Conventional treatment usually involves the use of antihistamine and corticosteroid drugs. These

drugs suppress immune system functions so that the uncomfortable symptoms of allergy cannot occur. This action

alleviates the symptoms for a while but leaves their actual causes unaddressed. In fact, such drugs may compound

the underlying immune system dysfunction that is causing the problem in the first place.

当抗原物质（过敏原）进入体内并引发不成比例的攻击性免疫反应时，就会发生过敏。常规治疗通常涉及

使用抗组胺药和皮质类固醇药物。这些药物会抑制免疫系统功能，从而不会出现过敏引起的不适症状。这

种做法可以暂时缓解症状，但并未解决其真正原因。事实上，此类药物可能会加剧导致问题的潜在免疫系

统功能障碍。

Allergies are a symptom of an immune system disorder that may be related to a nutritional deficiency or excess,

steroid or antibiotic therapies, vaccinosis, or metabolic dysfunction. Therefore, the questions to ask in the holistic

treatment of allergies are threefold: (1) What substance is causing an immune response, (2) Why is the immune

system responding so disproportionately to the substance, and (3) What can be done to help correct this response?

过敏是免疫系统疾病的症状，可能与营养缺乏或过量、类固醇或抗生素治疗、疫苗接种或代谢功能障碍

有关。因此，在过敏的整体治疗中要问的问题有三个：（1）什么物质引起免疫反应，（2）为什么免疫系

统对该物质的反应如此不成比例，以及（3）可以采取什么措施帮助纠正这个反应？

Holistic treatment is focused on moderating immune responses and improving the body’s ability to process and

eliminate potential allergens. The effort begins with an intensive assessment of the animal’s diet, environment, and

health care history. As causative factors are identified and dealt with, herbal therapy begins with tonic support of

liver, digestive, lymphatic, and urinary functions that are responsible for filtering and eliminating problematic

substances from the body. This in turn supports and improves immune activities by helping to remove antigenic

substances and metabolic waste products that might be compounding the problem. At the core of this approach are

alterative, diuretic, and cholagogue herbs. Burdock, red clover, dandelion root, spirulina, and alfalfa are all worthy

candidates for improving liver efficiency and building strong, healthy blood. The oils or stabilized powders of

flaxseed, borage seed, black currant seed, and evening primrose seed contain EFAs that play important roles in

immune system development and health. Dandelion leaf serves especially well as an effective diuretic agent to aid in

the elimination of waste products that are carried out of the body via the urine. Nettle is an excellent tonic for

animals who suffer from seasonal allergies, as it lends mild antihistamine relief in addition to strong diuretic and

blood-nourishing qualities. The Basic Support Formula under “Skin Problems” is useful for all of these purposes.

整体治疗的重点是调节免疫反应并提高身体处理和消除潜在过敏原的能力。这项工作首先对动物的饮

食、环境和医疗保健历史进行深入评估。在识别和处理致病因素后，草药疗法从对肝脏、消化、淋巴和泌

尿功能的滋补支持开始，这些功能负责过滤和消除体内有问题的物质。这反过来又通过帮助去除可能使问

题复杂化的抗原物质和代谢废物来支持和改善免疫活动。这种方法的核心是替代、利尿和利胆的草药。牛

蒡、红三叶草、蒲公英根、螺旋藻和苜蓿都是提高肝脏效率和建立强壮、健康血液的候选药物。亚麻籽、

琉璃苣籽、黑醋栗籽和月见草籽的油或稳定粉末含有必需脂肪酸，在免疫系统发育和健康中发挥着重要作

用。蒲公英叶是一种特别有效的利尿剂，有助于消除通过尿液排出体外的废物。对于患有季节性过敏的动

改善或支持身体对压力环境的反应的草药，如西伯利亚人参或黄芪，可能有助于重建和维持过敏动物的免

MOUTH AND NOSE PROBLEMS

口腔和鼻子问题

MOUTH PROBLEMS

口腔问题

Some animals have problems with their teeth and gums throughout their lives. Others seem to be lucky or in such

good health that their gums and teeth remain healthy for life. A healthy, natural, raw food diet is paramount to

healthy gums and teeth. For dogs and cats, this means raw, meaty bones and a diversity of enzyme- and nutrient-rich

fresh vegetables. Many herbivores have needs that go beyond simple dietary cleansing and nutrition—their teeth

need to be continuously worn down by the foods they eat to prevent the teeth from becoming too long and to remove

weak and decaying outer layers of enamel. Fresh, whole, fibrous vegetables and grains are an absolute necessity for

this process.

有些动物的牙齿和牙龈一生都会出现问题。其他人似乎很幸运或健康状况良好，他们的牙龈和牙齿终生保

持健康。健康、天然、生食饮食对于健康的牙龈和牙齿至关重要。对于狗和猫来说，这意味着生的肉骨头

和各种富含酶和营养的新鲜蔬菜。许多食草动物的需求不仅仅是简单的饮食清洁和营养——它们的牙齿需

要被所吃的食物不断磨损，以防止牙齿变得太长，并去除脆弱和腐烂的牙釉质外层。新鲜、完整、纤维状

的蔬菜和谷物是这个过程的绝对必要条件。

Most mouth problems are easily taken care of at home with a few simple herbal preparations. But if your animal

is having difficulty chewing and eating or is pawing at his mouth, he may have a minor tooth or gum infection that

can progress into a serious condition if not addressed. In cases of gingivitis, bacteria can eventually infect the

kidneys, causing irreversible damage to these vital organs. If your herbal efforts fail to remedy your companion’s

bad breath or oral discomfort or if the animal’s gums are severely inflamed, bleeding, or discharging pus, get to a

veterinarian immediately. A red gum line (along the base of an animal’s teeth) may also be indicative of a serious

underlying problem that demands professional attention.

大多数口腔问题都可以在家中通过一些简单的草药制剂轻松解决。但如果你的动物咀嚼和进食有困难，

或者用爪子抓着嘴，他可能有轻微的牙齿或牙龈感染，如果不及时治疗，可能会发展成严重的病症。在牙

龈炎的情况下，细菌最终会感染肾脏，对这些重要器官造成不可逆转的损害。如果你的草药努力无法治愈

你同伴的口臭或口腔不适，或者动物的牙龈严重发炎、出血或流脓，请立即去看兽医。红色牙龈线（沿着

动物牙齿的基部）也可能表明存在严重的潜在问题，需要专业人士的关注。

Gingivitis and Infections of the Mouth

牙龈炎和口腔感染

Gingivitis is an inflammation of the gums that is usually caused by bacterial infection. Symptoms may include bad

breath; reddened, swollen, and sometimes ulcerated gums; and pain and difficulty while eating. Gingivitis rarely

occurs in healthy animals who receive a balanced, raw food diet. It’s therefore important to make sure your

companion receives the vitamins, minerals, enzymes, and probiotics he needs to maintain a strong immune system

and good oral health. For dogs and cats, nothing compares with raw, meaty bones for maintaining healthy teeth and

gums.

牙龈炎是牙龈的炎症，通常由细菌感染引起。症状可能包括口臭；牙龈发红、肿胀，有时甚至溃疡；以及

进食时的疼痛和困难。牙龈炎很少发生在接受均衡生食饮食的健康动物身上。因此，确保您的伴侣获得维

持强大的免疫系统和良好的口腔健康所需的维生素、矿物质、酶和益生菌非常重要。对于狗和猫来说，没

有什么比生肉骨头更能保持牙齿和牙龈健康了。

口腔感染的其他原因包括打架或吵闹造成的刺伤（小狗和小猫的牙齿会造成危险的下颌摔跤）、咀嚼非

Dietary supplementation of CoQ10, vitamin C, and a variety of antimicrobial herbs may prove useful for reducing

To inhibit bacteria or fungi directly, a tincture of certified organic goldenseal, Oregon grape, thyme, sage, rosemary,

NOSE AND SINUS PROBLEMS

鼻子和鼻窦问题

Nose and sinus problems are usually due to environmental influences such as bites, stings, allergens, microbial

infection, or litter box dust (a major cause of sinus problems in cats). Provided the problem is isolated to the nose

and nasal passages and is related to foreign substances, not a tumor or other metabolic disorder, nose and sinus

problems can be treated effectively with simple herbal preparations. If the problem is secondary to other disorders,

the therapeutic approach varies according to the nature of onset. For instance, sinusitis secondary to seasonal

allergies is best approached with dietary adjustment and herbs that support the various systems involved.

Inflammation secondary to an insect sting requires topical (astringent) applications to help relieve uncomfortable

symptoms and immunotonic and lymphatic herbs such as echinacea and calendula to support the metabolic

processes of removing foreign substances from involved tissues.

鼻子和鼻窦问题通常是由于环境影响造成的，例如咬伤、蜇伤、过敏原、微生物感染或猫砂盆灰尘（猫鼻

窦问题的主要原因）。如果问题仅限于鼻子和鼻道，并且与异物有关，而不是肿瘤或其他代谢紊乱，则可

以通过简单的草药制剂有效治疗鼻子和鼻窦问题。如果问题继发于其他疾病，则治疗方法会根据发病的性

质而有所不同。例如，季节性过敏继发的鼻窦炎最好通过饮食调整和支持各个系统的草药来治疗。昆虫叮

咬继发的炎症需要局部（收敛）应用来帮助缓解不适症状，并使用免疫补剂和淋巴草药（如紫锥菊和金盏

花）来支持从相关组织中清除异物的代谢过程。

Swab antimicrobial herbal tinctures directly on your dog’s gums to treat oral infections.

将抗菌草药酊剂直接涂抹在狗的牙龈上以治疗口腔感染。

Sometimes, abnormal nasal discharge, inflammation, sneezing, or other symptoms may be difficult to link to a

cause. In these cases, the diagnostic capabilities and holistic insights of an experienced veterinarian should not be

overlooked. If a problem is found to stem from deeper health issues, holistic treatment must begin at those issues

and not with the nasal symptoms. This is important: Don’t assume anything. Identify the cause of disease before

beginning any herbal treatment. If you don’t, you may be neglecting your companion’s real needs.

有时，异常的鼻分泌物、炎症、打喷嚏或其他症状可能很难与病因联系起来。在这些情况下，经验丰富

的兽医的诊断能力和整体洞察力不应被忽视。如果发现问题源于更深层次的健康问题，则必须从这些问题

开始进行整体治疗，而不是从鼻部症状开始。这很重要：不要假设任何事情。在开始任何草药治疗之前先

确定病因。如果你不这样做，你可能会忽视同伴的真正需求。

For bacterial or fungal infections of the nostrils, sinuses, or outer tissues of the nose, a saline-based preparation of

calendula, Oregon grape, and usnea lichen can be effective against a broad spectrum of bacteria and fungi.

Externally, this preparation can be liberally applied to all affected areas. For infections inside the nose and sinuses, it

can be administered with a dropper or as a nasal spray (empty bottles for nasal spray are available from pharmacies).

对于鼻孔、鼻窦或鼻子外部组织的细菌或真菌感染，金盏花、俄勒冈葡萄和松萝地衣的盐水制剂可以有

可以用滴管或鼻喷雾剂给药（药店有售鼻喷雾剂空瓶）。

PARASITE-RELATED PROBLEMS: HOW TO LIVE WITH FLEAS,

WORMS, MITES, AND OTHER THINGS THAT SUCK

寄生虫相关问题：如何与跳蚤、蠕虫、螨虫和其他讨厌的东西共存

If you’re like most people who share their homes with companion animals, there’s a good chance that this is the first

part of the book you’ve turned to. Parasites are the most common source of torment and frustration shared by

animals and their human guardians. From an animal’s perspective, fleas, mites, and other bloodsucking freeloaders

are often the causes of sustained torture and misery. To an animal guardian, parasites are evil, disgusting, and

invasive. Creatures that latch onto flesh and suck the life fluids from their hosts have earned top billing in our

nightmares.

如果您像大多数与伴侣动物同住的人一样，那么这很可能是您翻阅本书的第一部分。寄生虫是动物及其人

类守护者共同遭受折磨和沮丧的最常见来源。从动物的角度来看，跳蚤、螨虫和其他吸血的贪图便宜的动

物往往是造成持续折磨和痛苦的原因。对于动物守护者来说，寄生虫是邪恶的、恶心的、具有侵略性的。

那些附着在肉上并从宿主身上吸取生命液的生物在我们的噩梦中名列前茅。

Unfortunately, while we struggle with our hate for such creatures by engaging in a relentless and futile battle to

wipe parasites from the face of the planet, we often overlook the deeper reasons they cause so much misery to our

animals. After all, tapeworms, fleas, ticks, mites, and other sucking insects have coexisted with animals for millions

of years, which implies that there must be natural provisions to allow for a more harmonious coexistence. How did

animals cope before humanity developed poisons and vaccines to reduce parasite populations? Did all animals suffer

from chronic problems such as flea allergies, digestive dysfunction, or heart disease because they were infested with

too many parasites? Of course not. Then why do some animals nowadays live their entire lives virtually undisturbed

by parasites, while others with the same level of exposure are constantly tormented by them? To find the answers to

such questions, we need to step away from our antiparasitic obsessions long enough to consider the life of a parasite.

不幸的是，当我们与对这些生物的仇恨作斗争时，我们进行了一场无情而徒劳的战斗，将寄生虫从地球

表面消灭，但我们常常忽视了它们给我们的动物带来如此多痛苦的更深层次原因。毕竟，绦虫、跳蚤、蜱

虫、螨虫和其他吸吮昆虫已经与动物共存了数百万年，这意味着必须有自然条件才能实现更和谐的共存。

在人类发明毒药和疫苗来减少寄生虫数量之前，动物是如何应对的？是否所有动物都因为感染过多寄生虫

而患有跳蚤过敏、消化功能障碍或心脏病等慢性问题？当然不是。那么，为什么现在有些动物一生几乎没

有受到寄生虫的干扰，而其他接触寄生虫程度相同的动物却不断受到寄生虫的折磨呢？为了找到这些问题

的答案，我们需要足够长的时间摆脱对寄生虫的痴迷，以考虑寄生虫的生命。

=== PAGE 488 ===
HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

Parasites, as repulsive as the fact may be, exist inside and on top of every living thing on earth. They even live on

each other. In fact, a body (human or otherwise) is home for a teeming biocommunity of millions of interdependent

life-forms, many of which happen to be parasites. From a holistic perspective, parasite-related health problems

emanate not from the mere presence of these vampires but from the host’s inability to deal with them effectively.

Some animals may test positive for Dirofilaria immitis (heartworm) but never suffer ill health. On the other hand,

some animals who appear to be healthy cannot tolerate a single fleabite without getting sick.

尽管事实可能令人厌恶，但寄生虫存在于地球上每一种生物的内部和顶部。他们甚至互相依赖而生活。事

实上，身体（人类或其他）是数以百万计相互依存的生命形式组成的丰富生物群落的家园，其中许多恰好

是寄生虫。从整体角度来看，与寄生虫相关的健康问题不仅仅源于这些吸血鬼的存在，而是源于宿主无法

有效应对它们。有些动物可能检测出恶丝虫（恶丝虫）呈阳性，但从未出现健康问题。另一方面，一些看

似健康的动物不能忍受一次跳蚤而不生病。

Parasites are opportunity seekers that exploit the weaknesses of their host. Their goal in doing so is to reproduce

and take control of their environment. If the host is malnourished and poorly equipped to keep parasite populations

in check, the parasites will take advantage of the body’s inadequate defenses and begin reproducing, eating, and

creating waste faster than the body can clean and replenish itself. If the immune system is dysfunctional and

responds too aggressively to the parasites, an “allergic response” occurs.

寄生虫是利用宿主弱点的机会寻求者。他们这样做的目的是繁殖并控制他们的环境。如果宿主营养不

良，且控制寄生虫数量的能力较差，寄生虫就会利用人体防御能力不足的优势，开始繁殖、进食和产生废

物，其速度快于人体自身清理和补充的速度。如果免疫系统功能失调并且对寄生虫的反应过于激烈，就会

发生“过敏反应”。

The most effective and holistic approach to parasite infection is to keep your animal well nourished and healthy.

An animal with a strong, properly functioning immune system presents an inhospitable living environment for

parasites and is less likely to suffer from parasite-related allergies. But there’s still an important question to be asked

before the holistic picture is complete: What happens to this scenario when we give in to our hatred and fear of

parasites and opt to use preventive drug measures in our pets? Any answer to this question is likely to raise

controversy. Antiparasitic drugs represent a multibillion-dollar industry in the U.S., and many veterinarians support

manufacturers’ claims that modern dewormers, skin-absorbed flea control agents, and other internal measures are

effective and generally safe. On the other side of the issue, though, holistic practitioners and naturally oriented

animal guardians are concerned about the serious long-term effects associated with such drugs. Of course, we’re

among those on this side of the issue, and here’s why.

对付寄生虫感染最有效、最全面的方法是让您的动物保持良好的营养和健康。具有强大且功能正常的免

疫系统的动物为寄生虫提供了一个不适宜生存的环境，并且不太可能患有与寄生虫相关的过敏。但在全面

了解之前，仍然有一个重要的问题需要问：当我们屈服于对寄生虫的仇恨和恐惧并选择对宠物使用预防性

药物措施时，这种情况会发生什么？这个问题的任何答案都可能引起争议。抗寄生虫药在美国是一个价值

数十亿美元的产业，许多兽医支持制造商的说法，即现代驱虫剂、皮肤吸收的跳蚤控制剂和其他内部措施

是有效且总体安全的。然而，在问题的另一方面，整体实践者和自然导向的动物监护人担心与此类药物相

关的严重的长期影响。当然，我们是站在这个问题这一边的人之一，原因如下。

To start with, anything that can poison a parasite cannot be good for the host. From a holistic standpoint, anything

that bypasses or interferes with natural body functions is likely to create its own state of imbalance in the body. For

instance, chemical wormers (aside from being potentially toxic to animals) are not 100 percent selective in what they

kill, meaning that beneficial microbes, such as those that play important roles in digestion and nutrient absorption,

might be compromised. In addition to this possibility, most antiparasitic agents come with their own long lists of

potential side effects, including seizures, liver failure, or even death. Ivermectin, a drug commonly used to treat and

prevent heartworm infection, may not only cause central nervous system depression but also act as an

immunosuppressant. That is, while it works to kill heartworms it also makes the body more vulnerable to countless

other diseases.

=== PAGE 489 ===
首先，任何能够毒害寄生虫的东西都不会对宿主有好处。从整体的角度来看，任何绕过或干扰自然身体

功能的事物都可能造成身体自身的不平衡状态。例如，化学驱虫剂（除了对动物具有潜在毒性外）并不是

100% 选择性杀死的微生物，这意味着有益微生物，例如那些在消化和营养吸收中发挥重要作用的微生物，

可能会受到损害。除了这种可能性之外，大多数抗寄生虫药物都有一长串潜在的副作用，包括癫痫、肝功

能衰竭，甚至死亡。伊维菌素是一种常用于治疗和预防心丝虫感染的药物，它不仅可能导致中枢神经系统

抑制，而且还可以起到免疫抑制剂的作用。也就是说，虽然它可以杀死心丝虫，但它也使身体更容易受到

无数其他疾病的影响。

The holistic herbalist does not see parasites as a cause of disease but as symptoms of a deeper imbalance.

Parasites themselves are viewed as what they really are—tough, adaptable, ancient life-forms that will likely inhabit

the earth long after humankind is gone. They are part of nature. Therefore, effective natural solutions to parasite-

related disorders are not found through fervent and dangerous attempts to destroy them but from learning to coexist

with them.

整体草药医生并不将寄生虫视为疾病的原因，而是将其视为更深层次不平衡的症状。寄生虫本身被认为

是它们真正的样子——坚韧、适应性强、古老的生命形式，在人类消失很久之后，它们很可能会居住在地

球上。它们是大自然的一部分。因此，针对寄生虫相关疾病的有效自然解决方案不是通过热情而危险的消

灭它们的尝试找到的，而是通过学习与它们共存来找到的。

In our minds (and remember, we’re herbalists, not veterinarians), stopping a symptom with chemicals that can

harm the patient does not constitute preventive or curative medicine—it only represents a dangerous, short-term

intervention that may actually compound the animal’s health problems. Indeed, some forms of parasitic infection

can be serious, even life threatening. The benefits of antiparasitic drugs are their convenience and their effectiveness

at bringing symptomatic relief to an animal who is already suffering. But what are the potential costs to the animal?

To find answers, check the back label or product information sheet for a list of side effects of the next antiparasitic

drug you consider for your companion. Regardless of the danger issues, you owe your animal the opportunity to stay

healthy and naturally free from parasite-related problems. This, of course, is what holistic animal care is all about.

在我们看来（请记住，我们是草药师，而不是兽医），用可能伤害患者的化学物质来阻止症状并不构成

预防或治疗药物，它只代表一种危险的短期干预措施，实际上可能会加剧动物的症状。健康问题。事实

上，某些形式的寄生虫感染可能很严重，甚至危及生命。抗寄生虫药物的好处在于它们的便利性以及它们

能够有效地缓解已经遭受痛苦的动物的症状。但动物的潜在成本是多少？要找到答案，请检查背面标签或

产品信息表，了解您考虑用于伴侣的下一种抗寄生虫药物的副作用列表。无论存在什么危险问题，您都应

该让您的动物有机会保持健康，自然地免受寄生虫相关问题的困扰。当然，这就是整体动物护理的全部内

容。

=== PAGE 490 ===
NUTRITION AND OTHER PREVENTION CONSIDERATIONS

营养和其他预防考虑因素

As we’ve stated before, the most effective treatment and prevention for all problems related to parasites is to make

sure your companion gets the nutrition he needs. Without a complete natural diet, your animal’s resistance and

ability to adjust to parasites is greatly diminished. Equally important is the need to identify and correct any element

of diet, environment, or activity that may be causing added stress on one or more body systems. If, for instance, your

dog has an allergy to the wheat he receives in his daily meals, his immune system will already be compromised

when new parasites enter his body. Likewise, if he has undergone long-term drug therapies, his immune system may

be in a depressed state and his defenses may be low. Remember that parasites are opportunity seekers.

正如我们之前所说，对于所有与寄生虫相关的问题，最有效的治疗和预防是确保您的伴侣获得他所需的营

养。如果没有完整的天然饮食，动物的抵抗力和适应寄生虫的能力就会大大降低。同样重要的是需要识别

和纠正可能对一个或多个身体系统造成额外压力的饮食、环境或活动的任何因素。例如，如果你的狗对日

常膳食中的小麦过敏，那么当新的寄生虫进入他的身体时，他的免疫系统就已经受到损害。同样，如果他

接受了长期的药物治疗，他的免疫系统可能会处于低迷状态，他的防御能力可能会很低。请记住，寄生虫

是机会寻求者。

Digestive enzymes and probiotic bacteria supplements can be of help in maintaining a healthy balance between

potentially harmful “digestive bugs,” and those that lead the preventive fights for good health. A full array of

vitamins and minerals is necessary to keep the blood healthy and the immune system operating at its peak potential.

Omega-3 and omega-6 EFAs, along with the proper balance of antioxidant vitamins (especially C, A, and E) and

minerals, are necessary for healthy, resilient skin that offers less opportunity for enterprising mites, fleas, and

parasitic fungi. In addition to vitamin C’s roles as an essential nutrient and antioxidant, it has been shown to lend

allergy relief through the antihistamine qualities it possesses. Exercise is also important, as is a clean environment.

The harder you work at helping your animal stay healthy, the less time and money you’ll spend on treating parasite-

related problems after the fact. As is the case in all forms of medicine, prevention truly is the cure.

消化酶和益生菌补充剂有助于在潜在有害的“消化细菌”和那些导致健康的预防性斗争之间保持健康平

衡。全面的维生素和矿物质对于保持血液健康和免疫系统发挥最大潜力是必需的。 Omega-3 和 omega-6 必

需脂肪酸以及抗氧化维生素（尤其是 C、A 和 E）和矿物质的适当平衡对于健康、有弹性的皮肤是必要的，

这样可以减少螨虫、跳蚤和寄生真菌的滋生机会。维生素 C 除了作为必需营养素和抗氧化剂的作用外，它

还被证明可以通过其抗组胺特性缓解过敏。锻炼也很重要，清洁的环境也很重要。您越努力帮助您的动物

保持健康，您在事后治疗与寄生虫相关的问题上花费的时间和金钱就越少。正如所有形式的医学一样，预

防确实是治疗的方法。

=== PAGE 491 ===
FLEAS

跳蚤

Animals who are hypersensitive to fleas may suffer a severe reaction from a single bite—so severe that they pull

their hair out and chew bloody patches from their skin. Conventional approaches to flea-contact dermatitis typically

start with medicated shampoos, flea control devices, and corticoid ointments and then lead to internal corticosteroid

drug therapies if conditions worsen. Anyone who has watched a companion suffer from a flea allergy knows how

easy it is to look past the dangers of prednisolone. The problem is, prednisolone and other corticosteroid drugs don’t

just suppress uncomfortable symptoms but they also suppress the immune system. Add to this the possible long-term

side effects of water retention, hypertension, liver damage, thyroid dysfunction, obesity, and heart attack, and

suddenly the corticosteroid option doesn’t sound so kind.

对跳蚤过敏的动物可能会因为被跳蚤咬一口而产生严重反应，严重到它们会拔掉毛发并咀嚼皮肤上的血

斑。治疗跳蚤接触性皮炎的传统方法通常是从含药洗发水、跳蚤控制装置和皮质类固醇软膏开始，如果情

况恶化，则进行内部皮质类固醇药物治疗。任何目睹过同伴患有跳蚤过敏的人都知道，忽视泼尼松龙的危

险是多么容易。问题是，泼尼松龙和其他皮质类固醇药物不仅能抑制不适症状，还能抑制免疫系统。再加

上水潴留、高血压、肝损伤、甲状腺功能障碍、肥胖和心脏病等可能的长期副作用，皮质类固醇的选择突

然听起来就不那么友好了。

To approach the flea dilemma from a holistic standpoint means to embrace a perspective that includes the animal

as a whole body in crisis. We must ask ourselves why fleas are bothering our animals in the first place rather than

focus solely on their elimination. Effective flea control starts inside your pet and in his living environment. Holistic

therapy does not begin with shampoos, coat dips, rinses, or sprays; it begins by strengthening the host and by

making your animal’s living quarters less hospitable to fleas. It’s important to remember that flea problems are

always secondary to something else, and it’s that “something else” that makes your companion an attractive “bed

and breakfast” for fleas. Healthy animals with healthy coats and properly functioning immune defenses generally

don’t have many fleas. And even if healthy animals do pick up a few fleas, their systems are able to handle the bites

without the excessive histamine responses that cause all of the itching.

从整体的角度来处理跳蚤的困境意味着要接受一种将处于危机中的动物作为一个整体的观点。我们必须

问自己，为什么跳蚤首先困扰我们的动物，而不是仅仅专注于消灭跳蚤。有效的跳蚤控制始于您的宠物体

内及其生活环境。整体治疗不是从洗发水、浸泡、冲洗或喷雾开始；首先要加强宿主的力量，让动物的居

住环境不那么适合跳蚤。重要的是要记住，跳蚤问题总是次要的，而正是这种“其他东西”使你的伴侣成为

跳蚤有吸引力的“床和早餐”。具有健康皮毛和正常免疫防御功能的健康动物通常不会有很多跳蚤。即使健

康的动物确实沾染了一些跳蚤，它们的系统也能够处理叮咬，而不会产生导致瘙痒的过度组胺反应。

To help your healthy animal deal with parasites comfortably, feed him small amounts of garlic as a supplement to

a proper diet. Contrary to what many believe, though, garlic should not be fed in quantities that cause that garlic

odor to exude from the animal’s skin. This is not only a waste of garlic but potentially harmful to your animal.

为了帮助您的健康动物轻松应对寄生虫，请喂食少量大蒜作为适当饮食的补充。然而，与许多人的看法

相反，大蒜的喂食量不应导致动物皮肤散发大蒜气味。这不仅浪费大蒜，而且可能对您的动物有害。

Dietary supplementation with brewer’s yeast and vitamin B complex have been popular for years as antiflea

measures, the theory being that these supplements adjust body chemistry in a way that makes the animal less

appealing to fleas. The effectiveness of such measures is questionable, and many animals are allergic to brewer’s

yeast (especially if it is low grade), but nevertheless, these supplements are worth a try.

多年来，作为抗跳蚤措施，添加啤酒酵母和复合维生素 B 的膳食补充剂一直很受欢迎，其理论是这些补

充剂可以调整身体化学成分，从而降低动物对跳蚤的吸引力。这些措施的有效性值得怀疑，而且许多动物

对啤酒酵母过敏（尤其是低等级啤酒酵母），但尽管如此，这些补充剂还是值得一试。

If your animal has an autoimmune deficiency, immunostimulants such as echinacea, Saint-John’s-wort, or

astragalus may be of help. However, immunostimulants should be used with caution or may be contraindicated in

animals with severe allergies or other diseases that are associated with an overactive immune system or with

immune functions that are working against the body (such as lupus and FIV).

=== PAGE 492 ===
如果您的动物患有自身免疫缺陷，紫锥菊、圣约翰草或黄芪等免疫刺激剂可能会有所帮助。然而，对于

患有严重过敏或与免疫系统过度活跃或免疫功能对身体不利（例如狼疮和 FIV）相关的其他疾病的动物，

应谨慎使用免疫刺激剂，或者可能禁忌使用免疫刺激剂。

In addition to garlic, alterative herbs such as burdock root, dandelion, and red clover serve as useful dietary

adjuncts by helping the body eliminate waste and allowing natural defense systems to work more freely in coping

with fleabites. Nettle may be sprinkled onto your animal’s food to lend nutritive support and a mild antihistamine

action that may reduce the severity of an allergic response. Giving ½–1 teaspoon of the dried herb for each pound of

food fed is a good starting dosage range. If your animal won’t eat dried nettle, you can steep it in hot water or salt-

free meat broth, which you can then add to your companion’s food. Oxeye daisy (Chrysanthemum leucanthemum), a

common waste-area weed, is also said to have mild antihistamine qualities that don’t really block histamine but may

help slow its release.

除了大蒜之外，牛蒡根、蒲公英和红三叶草等替代草药也可以作为有用的饮食添加剂，帮助身体消除废

物，让自然防御系统更自由地应对跳蚤。荨麻可以撒在动物的食物上，以提供营养支持和温和的抗组胺作

用，可以减轻过敏反应的严重程度。每磅食物喂 ½–1 茶匙干草药是一个很好的起始剂量范围。如果您的动

物不吃干荨麻，您可以将其浸泡在热水或无盐肉汤中，然后将其添加到您同伴的食物中。牛眼菊

（Chrysanthemum leucanthemum）是一种常见的荒地杂草，据说也具有温和的抗组胺特性，虽然不能真正阻

止组胺，但可能有助于减缓其释放。

Nettle (dried or steeped in hot water or broth) can reduce an animal’s allergic response to fleas.

荨麻（干燥或浸泡在热水或肉汤中）可以减少动物对跳蚤的过敏反应。

HERBAL FLEA REPELLENT POWDER

草本跳蚤驱除粉

Combine the following dry ingredients:

混合以下干成分：

1 part diatomaceous earth

1份硅藻土

2 parts feverfew flowers

2 份 小白菊花

2 parts mullein flowers

2 份毛蕊花

2 parts yarrow flowers, leaves, and stems

2 份欧蓍草花、叶和茎

1 part sage or thyme

1 份鼠尾草或百里香

Sprinkle and brush into your animal’s coat daily

每天喷洒并刷入动物的皮毛中

If fleabite allergies are severe, itching is persistent, and the skin is red and inflamed, licorice can be used as an

internal anti-inflammatory remedy.

如果跳蚤过敏严重，瘙痒持续，皮肤发红发炎，可以用甘草内服消炎药。

Externally, fleas and their effects can be addressed several ways. The animals’ living environment can be

sprinkled with diatomaceous earth, the sandlike remains of ancient marine organisms. Its activity against parasites is

strictly mechanical, as each tiny particle has sharp points and edges that penetrate the bodies of fleas to cause their

miserable deaths. Because of its gritty, penetrating nature, diatomaceous earth should not be applied to dry, irritated,

hypersensitive skin, and it should never be allowed to contact eyes or other mucous membranes. Care also needs to

be taken when spreading the substance onto carpets since walking around can stir up the dust and may cause

silicosis, a form of pneumonia related to breathing the dust of silica and other sands. Otherwise it’s generally quite

safe. In fact, it’s approved by the FDA for both internal and external use in livestock animals and has been used

safely in the natural care of companion animals for years.

从外部来看，跳蚤及其影响可以通过多种方式解决。这些动物的生活环境可以撒上硅藻土，这是古代海

洋生物的沙状遗迹。它对抗寄生虫的活性完全是机械性的，因为每个微小颗粒都有锋利的点和边缘，可以

穿透跳蚤的身体，导致它们悲惨的死亡。由于硅藻土具有坚韧、渗透性，因此不应将其涂在干燥、受刺

激、过敏的皮肤上，并且切勿接触眼睛或其他粘膜。将物质撒在地毯上时也需要小心，因为四处走动会激

起灰尘，并可能导致矽肺，这是一种与呼吸二氧化硅和其他沙子粉尘有关的肺炎。否则通常是相当安全

的。事实上，它已获得 FDA 批准可用于家畜动物的内部和外部使用，并且多年来一直安全地用于伴侣动物

的自然护理。

Some pet owners may have heard that borax products are good flea exterminators, but borates can be quite toxic

and may cause death if misused, according to Dr. Michael W. Dryden of the American Veterinary Medical

Association (AVMA). One of the manufacturers of borax states that borax is not intended for application to carpet

and upholstery.

美国兽医协会 (AVMA) 的 Michael W. Dryden 博士表示，一些宠物主人可能听说过硼砂产品是很好的跳蚤

灭虫剂，但硼酸盐的毒性很大，如果使用不当可能会导致死亡。硼砂制造商之一表示，硼砂不适用于地毯

和室内装潢。

Frequent vacuuming, washing your animal’s bedding, and regularly steamcleaning your carpet also helps reduce

flea populations in the environment. Some products made with nematodes are available to “infect” and kill fleas

where they live in your house and in the lawns around the house. All of these measures are available through natural

pet-product retailers.

经常用吸尘器吸尘、清洗动物的床上用品以及定期用蒸汽清洁地毯也有助于减少环境中的跳蚤数量。一

些用线虫制成的产品可以“感染”并杀死您家中和家周围草坪上的跳蚤。所有这些措施都可以通过天然宠物

产品零售商获得。

=== PAGE 494 ===
To help eliminate fleas from your animal’s coat and to soothe and heal his itchy skin, several herbs come to mind.

Flowers of feverfew, pyrethrum daisy, or oxeye daisy (or just about any other flower from the Chrysanthemum

genus) contain compounds known as pyrethrins. Pyrethrins are well known to have paralytic activities in fleas. In

fact, pyrethrins and their synthesized derivatives are common in many brands of flea spray. In their natural form,

pyrethrins are safe and can be quite effective. Pyrethrins used in the form of a crude herbal preparation, however,

won’t always kill fleas but may only paralyze them temporarily. This means you should take additional measures to

assure that fleas are out of your life forever.

为了帮助消除动物皮毛上的跳蚤并舒缓和治愈他发痒的皮肤，我想到了几种草药。小白菊、除虫菊或牛

眼菊（或菊花属的任何其他花）的花朵都含有称为除虫菊酯的化合物。众所周知，除虫菊酯对跳蚤具有麻

痹作用。事实上，除虫菊酯及其合成衍生物在许多品牌的跳蚤喷雾剂中都很常见。天然形式的除虫菊酯是

安全的并且非常有效。然而，以粗制草药制剂形式使用的除虫菊酯并不总能杀死跳蚤，而只能暂时麻痹它

们。这意味着您应该采取额外措施，确保跳蚤永远远离您的生活。

Making a pyrethrin flea rinse is as simple as plucking a few handfuls of feverfew flowers, putting them into a cup,

and steeping them in enough hot water to cover them. Briskly stir the mixture every couple of minutes until the

mixture is cool enough to pour over your pet. You can strain the tea away from the flowers or just pour the entire

mixture over your pet, but use the rinse right away—the active compounds break down and lose potency shortly

after the tea is made. Be sure to soak the animal all the way down to the skin, and allow the rinse to air dry on your

companion until the fur is damp but not dripping. Then, at a location that is as far away from the house as possible

(remember, many of the fleas will recover with a hunger), rinse the animal with a strong stream of water while

combing his coat, and look for paralyzed vampires.

制作除虫菊酯跳蚤冲洗剂非常简单，只需摘几把小白菊花，将它们放入杯子中，然后将它们浸泡在足够

的热水中以覆盖它们即可。每隔几分钟快速搅拌一次混合物，直到混合物冷却到足以倒在你的宠物身上。

您可以将茶从花中滤出，或者将整个混合物倒在您的宠物身上，但请立即使用冲洗液 - 茶泡制后不久，活

性化合物就会分解并失去效力。一定要把动物一直浸泡到皮肤，然后让冲洗液在你的同伴身上风干，直到

皮毛湿润但不滴水。然后，在离房子尽可能远的地方（记住，许多跳蚤会在饥饿后恢复），用强力水流冲

洗动物，同时梳理它的外套，并寻找瘫痪的吸血鬼。

Apply oxeye daisy flowers as a flea rinse.

使用牛眼菊花作为跳蚤冲洗剂。

Other flea-killing plant compounds include rotenone and limonene. Rotenone is readily available in the flowers of

mullein (Verbascum thapsus), an Asian weed that occurs in waste areas throughout most of North America and

Europe. The flowering tops are best if used fresh in the form of a strong decoction, but the dried blossoms (available

through herb retailers) can be used too, again in the form of a cooled tea. When using mullein flowers or any other

form of rotenone, be sure to keep the herb away from fish tanks or any amphibians—although it’s safe for mammals,

it is quite toxic to aquatic life forms. Limonene is a volatile oil found in citrus and many of the culinary herbs

=== PAGE 495 ===
belonging to the parsley (Umbelliferae) family. A good source of limonene is contained in celery seeds (up to 60

percent limonene). For the best results, harvest the seeds while they are green and juicy, and make a tea rinse

immediately. Good-quality dried seeds can be used as a second source. Other limonene-bearing “umbels” include

dill (leaf and seed) and fennel (seed).

其他杀死跳蚤的植物化合物包括鱼藤酮和柠檬烯。毛蕊花（Verbascum thapsus）的花中很容易含有鱼藤

酮，毛蕊花是一种亚洲杂草，生长在北美和欧洲大部分地区的荒地中。开花的顶部最好以浓汤的形式新鲜

使用，但干花（可通过草药零售商购买）也可以以冷茶的形式使用。当使用毛蕊花或任何其他形式的鱼藤

酮时，一定要让这种草药远离鱼缸或任何两栖动物——尽管它对哺乳动物来说是安全的，但它对水生生物

来说毒性很大。柠檬烯是一种挥发油，存在于柑橘和许多属于欧芹（伞形科）家族的烹饪香草中。芹菜籽

中含有柠檬烯的良好来源（柠檬烯含量高达 60%）。为了获得最佳效果，请在种子绿色多汁时收获，并立

即冲茶。优质的干种子可以作为第二来源。其他含有柠檬烯的“伞形花序”包括莳萝（叶子和种子）和茴香

（种子）。

Another herb that has been regaining popularity in recent years as an antiflea device is Canadian fleabane (Conyza

canadensis). Until recently, Canadian fleabane (also called horseweed) was known by herbalists primarily as a

urinary astringent. Its common name has caught the attention of several natural pet-product manufacturers, who

claim that it is one of nature’s greatest allies against fleas. Current research has concluded that Canadian fleabane

contains flea-killing limonene as well. A much stronger source of limonene is essential oil of bitter orange, available

through most stores that carry aromatherapy oils. This essential oil is very concentrated—just 6–10 drops diluted

into 8 ounces of water is said to be an effective rinse against fleas. Simply moisten the animal’s skin and coat with

the mixture daily.

另一种近年来重新流行的抗跳蚤药草是加拿大蓬（Conyza canadensis）。直到最近，草药学家还认为加拿

大蓬（也称为马草）主要是一种泌尿收敛剂。它的俗名引起了几家天然宠物产品制造商的注意，他们声称

它是大自然对抗跳蚤的最强大盟友之一。目前的研究得出的结论是，加拿大蓬蓬还含有可杀死跳蚤的柠檬

烯。柠檬烯的更强大来源是苦橙精油，大多数出售香薰油的商店都可以买到。这种精油非常浓缩，只需将

6-10 滴精油稀释到 8 盎司水中，据说就能有效地冲洗掉跳蚤。只需润湿动物的皮肤并每天涂上混合物即

可。

To help relieve itching and promote healing, a calendula rinse is a good choice, as is aloe juice, which can be

diluted with 4 parts water (e.g., 1 cup of aloe juice to 4 cups of water). Peppermint or lavender may help bring relief

as well. If scratching has left oozing, infected scabs, yarrow, rosemary, or thyme can be generously added to the

rinse. One advantage of using yarrow is that it adds its own insect-repellent qualities to the effort. If inflammation is

severe and scratching has lead to hair loss, an astringent skin rinse may be indicated. Also, many good herbal flea

and coat shampoos are on the market. These can be useful for bringing soothing relief. Don’t shampoo your animal

too often, though, or you might dry out the skin and cause added irritation. When using shampoos, also remember

that their overuse can result in microbial imbalances on the surface of the body. Your animal’s skin supports a

natural community of interdependent organisms, many of which serve antiparasitic or cleansing purposes. To let

them do their jobs it’s probably best not to shampoo your animal more than once or twice a week during a crisis.

为了帮助缓解瘙痒并促进愈合，金盏花冲洗液是一个不错的选择，芦荟汁也是不错的选择，可以用 4 份

水稀释（例如，1 杯芦荟汁加 4 杯水）。薄荷或薰衣草也可能有助于缓解症状。如果抓伤后留下渗液，可以

在冲洗液中加入大量的受感染的痂、西洋蓍草、迷迭香或百里香。使用西洋蓍草的一个优点是它可以增加

其自身的驱虫特性。如果炎症严重且抓挠导致脱发，则可能需要进行收敛性皮肤冲洗。此外，市场上还有

许多优质的草药除跳蚤和外套洗发水。这些可以有效缓解疼痛。不过，不要经常给你的动物洗澡，否则你

的皮肤可能会变得干燥并引起额外的刺激。使用洗发水时，还请记住，过度使用会导致身体表面的微生物

失衡。动物的皮肤支持着相互依存的有机体的自然群落，其中许多具有抗寄生虫或清洁的目的。为了让它

们完成工作，在危机期间最好每周给动物洗头的次数不要超过一到两次。

By now you might be wondering why we haven’t mentioned North American pennyroyal (Hedeoma pulegioides).

Well, we won’t argue about the effectiveness of pennyroyal at deterring fleas. In fact, it’s one of the best antiflea

herbs around, which is why it is included in dozens of commercial flea preparations. The problem with it is that the

volatile oils (composed mostly of an oil called pulegone) contained in pennyroyal can be toxic to animals, with the

list of potential side effects beginning with nausea, vomiting, and abortifacient properties and ending with elevated

blood pressure and possible kidney and liver damage. While most flea dips, sprays, and powders that contain

pennyroyal include relatively dilute concentrations of the volatile oil, a cumulative risk may exist to animals who

lick off these topical preparations. Cats can be very sensitive to pennyroyal, and those with preexisting kidney

disease (a widespread, chronic problem in cats) might even die from it. In our minds, such risks are unnecessary in

the presence of safer, more holistic flea control measures. One such measure is the Triple-Punch Herbal Flea Rinse.

现在您可能想知道为什么我们没有提到北美薄荷（Hedeoma pulegioides）。好吧，我们不会争论薄荷醇在

阻止跳蚤方面的有效性。事实上，它是最好的抗跳蚤草药之一，这就是为什么它被包含在数十种商业跳蚤

制剂中。问题是，薄荷油中含有的挥发油（主要由一种叫做胡薄荷酮的油组成）可能对动物有毒，潜在的

副作用包括恶心、呕吐和堕胎特性，最后是血压升高和血压升高。可能的肾脏和肝脏损害。虽然大多数含

有薄荷醛的跳蚤药液、喷雾剂和粉末含有相对较稀浓度的挥发油，但舔掉这些外用制剂的动物可能存在累

积风险。猫对彭尼罗非常敏感，患有肾脏疾病（猫中普遍存在的慢性问题）的猫甚至可能因此而死亡。我

们认为，如果有更安全、更全面的跳蚤控制措施，这种风险是不必要的。其中一项措施是三重草药跳蚤冲

洗液。

Make a tea rinse of the herbs by covering the mixture with boiling water and allowing it to stand until
