each 8 ounces of rinse.

用沸水覆盖混合物并静置直至冷却，对草药进行茶冲洗。为了给配方添加更多“冲击力”，可以在每 8

盎司的冲洗液中添加 6-10 滴苦橙精油。

Herbal flea powders usually aren’t as effective as rinses, but they are handy for animals and people on the go. The

key to success in making a powder is to be sure that all of the herbal ingredients are as fresh as possible. Pyrethrin-

bearing plants lose much of their potency after they are dried, and aromatic herbs such as lavender or yarrow lose

their flea-repellent pungency eventually. The best you can hope for with a homemade flea powder is “flea

discouragement.” It’s unlikely that you will succeed in eliminating or repelling every biting flea without taking other

measures as well. To keep your flea powder as fresh and active as possible, make it in small, frequent batches. An

electric coffee grinder or a mortar and pestle can be used to grind your herbs into powder.

草药除蚤粉通常不如漱口水有效，但对于忙碌的动物和人来说很方便。成功制作粉末的关键是确保所有

草药成分尽可能新鲜。含有除虫菊素的植物在干燥后会失去大部分效力，而薰衣草或西洋蓍草等芳香草本

最终会失去驱除跳蚤的刺激性。自制跳蚤粉所能达到的最大效果就是“抑制跳蚤”。如果不采取其他措施，

您不太可能成功消灭或驱除每只咬人的跳蚤。为了尽可能保持跳蚤粉的新鲜和活性，请小批量、频繁地制

作。可以使用电动咖啡研磨机或研钵和研杵将草药磨成粉末。

=== PAGE 498 ===
MITES

螨类

Mites are an excellent example of just how common parasites are. These tiny, often microscopic, arachnids are

everywhere and on everything. A healthy human body carries millions of them. In fact, all living land animals carry

mites—even fleas and mites have mites!

螨虫就是一个很好的例子，说明了寄生虫是多么常见。这些微小的、通常是微观的蜘蛛纲动物无处不在、

无处不在。健康的人体携带着数以百万计的细胞。事实上，所有活着的陆地动物都携带螨虫——甚至跳蚤

和螨虫也有螨虫！

When you’re finished scratching, it’s important to know that relatively few of the parasitic varieties of mites cause

problems. Those that do cause problems burrow under the top layers of the skin to cause hair loss, skin

disfigurement, and painful lesions on the skin and in the ears. In dogs, cats, horses, and other mammals, various

species of skin mites are commonly referred to as mange. In instances of human infection, we usually refer to them

as scabies.

当您完成抓挠后，重要的是要知道相对较少的寄生螨虫品种会引起问题。那些确实会引起问题的物质会

钻入皮肤表层，导致脱发、皮肤变形以及皮肤和耳朵上的疼痛性病变。在狗、猫、马和其他哺乳动物中，

各种皮螨通常被称为疥螨。在人类感染的情况下，我们通常将其称为疥疮。

Various species of mange are differentiated by the specific nature of the infections they cause. Sarcoptic mange

(Sarcoptes scabiei) is the most contagious (some species can be transmitted to humans) and often the most severe

form of mange, characterized most frequently by crusty, reddish brown lesions that usually appear first on the head

and neck, between the legs, or in the “armpits” of the victim animal. Demodectic mange, or red mange (genus

Demodex), is a far less contagious mite that infects hair follicles, often causing hair loss and a foul-smelling bacterial

infection of the skin. Both chorioptic mange (genus Chorioptis) and psoroptic mange (genus Psoroptes) are common

in cattle, horses, sheep, and goats and produce similar symptoms. Otitis externa, or otodectic ear mange, occurs in

dogs and cats and is characterized by inflammation and brown, waxy discharge from the ears. Rabbits are

susceptible to ear mange as well. Occurrence of ear mites in horses and other large animals is relatively uncommon.

不同种类的疥癣因其引起的感染的具体性质而有所不同。疥癣菌（Sarcoptes scabiei）是最具传染性的

（某些物种可以传染给人类），并且通常是最严重的疥癣形式，最常见的特征是硬皮、红棕色病变，通常

首先出现在头部和颈部、腿部之间，或在受害动物的“腋下”。蠕形螨或红疥螨（蠕形螨属）是一种传染性

极低的螨虫，它会感染毛囊，经常导致脱发和皮肤出现恶臭的细菌感染。绒毛疥癣（Chorioptis 属）和皮肤

疥癣（Psoroptes 属）在牛、马、绵羊和山羊中都很常见，并且会产生相似的症状。外耳炎或耳道性耳疥疮

发生在狗和猫身上，其特征是耳朵发炎并排出棕色蜡状分泌物。兔子也容易感染耳疥癣。马和其他大型动

物中耳螨的发生相对罕见。

All of the mange-causing mites have one thing in common: they are all opportunity-seeking parasites that prefer a

defenseless host. Therefore, prevention in the form of a well-balanced natural diet that provides immune system

support should begin before an infection occurs.

所有引起疥癣的螨虫都有一个共同点：它们都是寻求机会的寄生虫，更喜欢无防御能力的宿主。因此，

应在感染发生之前开始以提供免疫系统支持的均衡天然饮食的形式进行预防。

Fortunately, herbal measures can be quite effective against the various forms of mange. The foremost herb to

consider is garlic. Mites don’t tolerate sulfur compounds, and garlic contains hundreds of them (which is why garlic

smells like it does). For ear mites or localized mite infestations on birds and mammals, garlic oil can be applied to

the affected areas twice daily. In addition to its direct intervention with mites, garlic oil helps minimize bacterial

infection. When using garlic oil, however, make sure that it’s not too concentrated or it may cause irritation. Another

good ear mite herb is mullein flower oil. Mullein flowers possess antiparasitic and antibacterial activities that seem

well suited to infections of the ear, especially when combined with garlic oil. Vitamin E oil can be added to this

combination to help promote healing. The olive oil used as a base for both of these oils also lends soothing and

healing qualities to the skin.

幸运的是，草药措施可以非常有效地对抗各种形式的疥癣。最重要的草药是大蒜。螨虫不能耐受硫化合

=== PAGE 499 ===
物，而大蒜中含有数百种硫化合物（这就是大蒜闻起来像这样的原因）。对于耳螨或鸟类和哺乳动物的局

部螨虫感染，可以将大蒜油涂抹在受影响的区域，每天两次。除了直接干预螨虫之外，大蒜油还有助于最

大程度地减少细菌感染。但是，使用大蒜油时，请确保其浓度不要太高，否则可能会引起刺激。另一种很

好的耳螨药草是毛蕊花油。毛蕊花具有抗寄生虫和抗菌活性，似乎非常适合耳部感染，尤其是与大蒜油结

合使用时。可以将维生素 E 油添加到该组合中以帮助促进愈合。作为这两种油的基础的橄榄油还可以舒缓

和治愈皮肤。

For mange infestations that are localized close to the eyes of an animal, you will probably want to purchase or

make an ointment or salve preparation. This minimizes the risk of the herb contacting the eyes.

对于靠近动物眼睛的疥癣感染，您可能需要购买或制作药膏或药膏制剂。这可以最大限度地减少草药接

触眼睛的风险。

Other herbs to consider for mite infections are lavender, yarrow, Oregon grape, goldenseal (provided it is from

cultivated sources), and licorice. Any of these herbs can be used in oils, salves, or ointments as well, or they can be

made into a skin rinse (a good option for infections that are generalized over larger portions of the animal’s body).

Licorice serves as a good alternative for animals who are sensitive to topical applications of garlic. If you have

access to it, neem leaf (Azadirachta indica), from a tree found in India and Pakistan, can make an effective skin

rinse against many forms of mange.

其他可用于治疗螨虫感染的草药有薰衣草、西洋蓍草、俄勒冈葡萄、金印草（前提是来自栽培来源）和

甘草。这些草药中的任何一种都可以用于油、药膏或软膏中，或者可以制成皮肤冲洗液（对于动物身体较

大部位普遍存在的感染来说是一个不错的选择）。对于对局部使用大蒜敏感的动物来说，甘草是一个很好

的替代品。如果您有机会获得印度和巴基斯坦的印楝叶（Azadirachta indica），可以有效地冲洗皮肤，对抗

多种形式的疥癣。

For birds who are crawling with mites, a pinch of Oregon grape or lavender can be infused into their birdbath. For

lizards with mite infections, a wet towel wipe of weak Oregon grape, yarrow, or lavender tea might help.

对于爬满螨虫的鸟类，可以将一小撮俄勒冈葡萄或薰衣草注入水盆中。对于患有螨虫感染的蜥蜴，用湿

毛巾擦拭淡味俄勒冈葡萄、西洋蓍草或薰衣草茶可能会有所帮助。

=== PAGE 500 ===
LICE

虱子

Several species of lice can infest both mammals and birds. They can generally be divided into two categories: those

that suck blood from their hosts (Anopleura) and those that bite their victims (Mallophaga). Regardless, the term

lousy is derived from the concept of louse infestation, and the repulsiveness the word conveys describes the situation

accurately. Louse infestation is a common problem for animals who live in cramped or unclean living quarters. The

problem is characterized by irritated, itchy skin and frequent scratching.

几种虱子可以感染哺乳动物和鸟类。它们通常可分为两类：吸食宿主血液的昆虫（Anopleura）和叮咬受害

者的昆虫（Mallophaga）。无论如何，“糟糕”一词源自虱子侵扰的概念，这个词所传达的令人厌恶的感觉准

确地描述了这种情况。对于生活在狭窄或不干净的生活区的动物来说，虱子侵扰是一个常见问题。该问题

的特点是皮肤发炎、发痒和经常抓挠。

Lice are tough critters and can be hard to beat with herbs. The most effective and time-honored herb approaches

for lice include toxic heavyweights such as tansy (Tanacetum vulgare) and even water hemlock (Cicuta spp.), either

of which can kill an animal host. On the safer side of the herbal spectrum are licorice, yucca, wormwood, sage,

yarrow, yellow dock, lavender, and bee balm. All of these herbs can be used singly or in combination in the form of

a daily skin rinse. A daily sprinkling of diatomaceous earth onto the animal’s coat may be effective, too.

虱子是顽强的生物，很难用草药打败。针对虱子最有效且历史悠久的草药方法包括有毒的重量级药物，

例如艾菊（Tanacetum vulgare）甚至水毒芹（Cicuta spp.），这两种药物都可以杀死动物宿主。比较安全的

草药有甘草、丝兰、艾草、鼠尾草、西洋蓍草、黄坞、薰衣草和蜂香膏。所有这些草药都可以单独使用，

也可以以每日皮肤冲洗的形式组合使用。每天在动物的皮毛上撒上硅藻土也可能有效。

=== PAGE 501 ===
INTESTINAL WORMS

肠道蠕虫

Worms are often viewed as parasites at their most disgusting worst, but again this is largely because we have a big

problem with the thought of things crawling around inside our bodies. Sorry if this gives you the “crawlies,” but

worms are a natural fact of life. We all have them in one form or another.

蠕虫通常被视为最恶心的寄生虫，但这很大程度上是因为我们对物体在我们体内爬行的想法有一个很大的

问题。很抱歉，如果这让您感到“爬行”，但蠕虫是生活中的自然现象。我们都以一种或另一种形式拥有它

们。

Animal guardians tend to overreact to the possibility of worms with the precautionary use of chemical wormers.

As we mentioned earlier, such practice is contrary and counterproductive to the purposes of holistic health care. We

are not saying that worms cannot be life threatening but that the health risks associated with preventive drug

therapies may outweigh the actual need for them, especially in healthy animals who are not likely to be exposed to

roundworms, whipworms, or hookworms.

动物监护人往往会对蠕虫的可能性反应过度，并预防性地使用化学驱虫剂。正如我们前面提到的，这种

做法与整体医疗保健的目的背道而驰，适得其反。我们并不是说蠕虫不会危及生命，而是说与预防性药物

治疗相关的健康风险可能超过其实际需要，特别是对于不太可能接触蛔虫、鞭虫或钩虫的健康动物。

The most common type of intestinal parasites are known as cestodes, or tapeworms. Tapeworms can be

transmitted by fleas, feces, or food sources. In rural areas, dogs and cats often become infected by eating rodents.

Tapeworms may live in an animal’s digestive tract for quite a while, sometimes indefinitely, before they are

detected, and they are seldom harmful to the host animal. Usually, we won’t even know that our companions have

tapeworms until a fecal analysis is done or until we see the worms’ body segments in the animals’ stools. The

segments (put your sandwich down!) look very much like grains of rice. The potential of tapeworms to cause harm

to an animal is relative to the general health of the animal and the extent of the tapeworm infestation. In other words,

if an animal is generally healthy, a moderate population of intestine-dwelling tapeworms is usually harmless. And if

the animal is holistically healthy, has a strong immune system, properly balanced intestinal flora, and is being fed a

good diet, tapeworm infestations are likely to be a temporary issue. For instance, we live on 60 remote acres in the

Montana Rockies, where our two dogs roam freely around the house. Both occasionally eat a ground squirrel or two

(sometimes in the form of carrion), and we expect both of them to have tapeworms by the end of summer. But

because they are healthy, most if not all of the worms (as confirmed by fecal analysis) are gone from their bodies

after a couple of months of infestation. The opportunity seekers just can’t find a stronghold, or they don’t like the

accommodations.

最常见的肠道寄生虫类型被称为绦虫或绦虫。绦虫可以通过跳蚤、粪便或食物传播。在农村地区，狗和

猫经常因食用啮齿动物而受到感染。在被发现之前，绦虫可能会在动物的消化道中生活相当长一段时间，

有时甚至是无限期，而且它们很少对宿主动物造成伤害。通常，在进行粪便分析或在动物粪便中看到蠕虫

的身体部分之前，我们甚至不会知道我们的同伴患有绦虫。这些片段（放下你的三明治！）看起来非常像

米粒。绦虫对动物造成伤害的可能性与动物的总体健康状况和绦虫感染的程度有关。换句话说，如果动物

总体上是健康的，那么肠道内一定数量的绦虫通常是无害的。如果动物整体健康，具有强大的免疫系统，

肠道菌群适当平衡，并且饮食良好，绦虫感染可能只是暂时的问题。例如，我们住在蒙大拿州落基山脉 60

英亩的偏远土地上，我们的两只狗在房子周围自由地漫步。两者偶尔都会吃一两只地松鼠（有时以腐肉的

形式），我们预计到夏末它们都会感染绦虫。但由于它们是健康的，大多数（如果不是全部）蠕虫（经粪

便分析证实）在感染几个月后就会从它们的体内消失。寻求机会的人只是找不到据点，或者他们不喜欢这

里的住宿条件。

It’s our contention that in most instances, the reason tapeworms are approached with chemical interventions is not

always because a real and urgent need to eliminate them exists but because we can’t deal with their less-than-

appealing nature. Yes, they’re disgusting. But are we really helping an animal when we use unnecessary, potentially

toxic measures to expel them? We don’t think so.

我们的观点是，在大多数情况下，采用化学干预措施来对付绦虫的原因并不总是因为存在真正而紧迫的

消灭它们的需要，而是因为我们无法应对它们不那么吸引人的本质。是的，他们很恶心。但是，当我们使

=== PAGE 502 ===
用不必要的、可能有毒的措施来驱逐动物时，我们真的在帮助它们吗？我们不这么认为。

Roundworms, hookworms, whip-worms, and threadworms present a much greater risk to your companion

because these worms can cause severe intestinal damage and can leave the digestive tract to infest the blood and

other organs. Once these parasites leave the digestive tract, they can be difficult to treat.

蛔虫、钩虫、鞭虫和蛔虫对您的伴侣构成更大的风险，因为这些蠕虫会导致严重的肠道损伤，并可能离

开消化道感染血液和其他器官。一旦这些寄生虫离开消化道，就很难治疗。

To help your dog or cat keep intestinal populations in check and to encourage earlier expulsion by less invasive,

more natural means, garlic can be fed in moderation on the animal’s food. Fennel, grated raw carrot, shredded

coconut, and cooked grains also might be of benefit if added to the animal’s diet. (Feed as much as the animal wants

to eat.) Fresh, raw, unsalted pumpkin seeds help expel worms and generous portions can be fed as a wholesome treat

to any animal. The seeds may need to be ground up and added to your pet’s food. (You can grind a small batch

ahead of time and keep it in a jar in the freezer until you’re ready to use it.) Diatomaceous earth is effective at

reducing intestinal parasite populations and can be fed at the following recommended rates (approved by the FDA)

—large dogs over 55 pounds can have up to 1 tablespoon per day, small dogs and cats can have 1 teaspoon per day.

Goats, sheep, cattle, horses, and other large animals can be fed in portions up to 1 percent of their daily dry rations;

and chickens and most birds can receive up to 5 percent. Oregon grape may be given internally to birds, dogs, cats,

horses, and other mammals as a low-alcohol tincture or decoction. A dose of 12 drops per 20 pounds of the animal’s

body weight (or just a few drops for birds), twice daily for up to one week is appropriate. After one week, give the

animal’s system a break for two or three days before continuing the twice-daily doses. Chamomile has mild worm-

expelling properties, and pineapple weed (Matricaria matricarioides ), a wild and weedy cousin of chamomile, is

believed to possess much stronger activities against roundworms and whipworms.

为了帮助您的狗或猫控制肠道菌群，并通过侵入性较小、更自然的方式鼓励其尽早排出，可以在动物食

（动物想吃多少就喂多少。）新鲜、生的、无盐的南瓜子有助于驱除蠕虫，大量的南瓜子可以作为任何动

Other worming agents include black walnut and wormwood. Black walnut hull is an effective worming agent, but

it must be used with care because of the potentially irritating tannin constituents it contains. Black walnut should not

be used in or around horses, as it may be toxic to them. Wormwood, of course, is a classic dewormer, but it should

not be used for long periods and not at all in animals with liver disease. Even more dangerous are tansy and rue. In

our opinion, these herbs should be avoided altogether because they’re too harsh on the liver.

其他驱虫剂包括黑胡桃和艾草。黑胡桃壳是一种有效的驱虫剂，但必须小心使用，因为它含有潜在刺激

性的单宁成分。黑胡桃木不应该在马体内或周围使用，因为它可能对马有毒。当然，艾草是一种经典的驱

Herbs that are rich in soaplike saponin constituents such as yucca, valerian, and licorice are sometimes effective

as worming agents. Yucca also helps by optimizing absorption of nutrients in the small intestine, an attribute that

might be useful in cases of severe infection in which nutrient absorption is hindered by the presence of too many

hungry parasites.

富含肥皂样皂苷成分的草药，如丝兰、缬草和甘草，有时可作为有效的驱虫剂。丝兰还有助于优化小肠

中营养物质的吸收，这一特性在严重感染的情况下可能有用，在严重感染的情况下，营养吸收因存在太多

饥饿的寄生虫而受到阻碍。

Many herbal wormers contain laxative or emetic herbs such as senna, cascara sagrada, aloe, or turkey rhubarb.

The idea behind their inclusion is to flush out the parasites by stimulating bowel movement and loosening the stool.

In holistic reality, this approach adds stress to the body, causes discomfort to the animal, may cause dehydration and

nutrient depletion, and may lead to laxative dependency if used for too long a period. The overall effectiveness of

expelling worms is outweighed by the invasiveness of the therapy. If constipation is associated with a worm

infestation, marshmallow, plantain, or slippery elm can be used to lubricate the digestive tract without pulling

needed fluids from the body, and hepatics such as yellow dock, Oregon grape, or a small pinch of turmeric can be

fed to increase bile production and improve digestion. Slippery elm or plantain may be beneficial in cases of

wormrelated diarrhea because these herbs contain astringent qualities that gently regulate the passage of fluid into

the intestine. A safe, general worming remedy that can be added to your companion’s food can be found on page

273.

激排便和疏松粪便来清除寄生虫。从整体上看，这种方法会给身体增加压力，导致动物不适，可能导致脱

水和营养消耗，如果使用时间过长，还可能导致泻药依赖。治疗的侵入性超过了驱虫的整体效果。如果便

秘与蠕虫感染有关，可以使用棉花糖、车前草或滑榆来润滑消化道，而不需要从体内抽出所需的液体，并

且可以使用肝脏药物，例如黄坞、俄勒冈葡萄或一小撮姜黄。喂食以增加胆汁产生并改善消化。滑榆或车

GIARDIASIS

贾第鞭毛虫病

Giardiasis is a digestive disease caused by cyst-forming impregnation of protozoa of the Giardia genus in the

mucosal lining of the intestines. The result is nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and other flulike symptoms for several

weeks. The most common means of infestation comes from ingestion of water that has been contaminated by the

fecal matter of fish and other animals. Animals are much more resistant to Giardia than humans are, but they are still

susceptible. As with all parasites, severity of infestation depends on the overall health of the host. Symptoms range

from loss of appetite to diarrhea, vomiting, weight loss, dehydration, and general debility.

贾第鞭毛虫病是一种消化系统疾病，由贾第鞭毛虫属原生动物在肠粘膜内壁形成包囊而引起。结果是恶

心、呕吐、腹泻和其他类似流感的症状持续数周。最常见的感染途径是摄入被鱼类和其他动物粪便污染的

水。动物对贾第鞭毛虫的抵抗力比人类强得多，但它们仍然很容易感染。与所有寄生虫一样，感染的严重

程度取决于宿主的整体健康状况。症状包括食欲不振、腹泻、呕吐、体重减轻、脱水和全身虚弱。

Herbal interventions are moderately successful at best. Tinctures are the best form of application here because

their high concentrations of readily available constituents are needed against these tough little beasties. Of particular

interest are Oregon grape, goldenseal (from cultivated sources), and other herbs that contain the active alkaloid

constituent berberine. Berberine, being water soluble, highly assimilable, and able to withstand the digestive acids

that destroy many other types of antibiotic agents, finds it way deep into the digestive tract to work its wonders,

especially when given in concentrated extract form over periods of several days. Garlic may lend antiprotozoa

support as well. Licorice is a good adjunct, lending antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and healing properties to the

effort. Cleavers helps drain lymph-engorged tissues that surround the cysts.

草药干预最多只能取得一定的成功。酊剂是最好的应用形式，因为它们需要高浓度的现成成分来对抗这

些顽强的小野兽。特别令人感兴趣的是俄勒冈葡萄、白毛茛（来自栽培来源）和其他含有活性生物碱成分

小檗碱的草药。小檗碱是水溶性的，高度同化，能够抵抗消化酸，这些酸会破坏许多其他类型的抗生素药

物，它可以深入消化道发挥其神奇作用，特别是在连续几天以浓缩提取物形式服用时。大蒜也可以提供抗

原虫支持。甘草是一种很好的辅助剂，具有抗菌、抗炎和治疗功效。切割刀有助于排出囊肿周围充满淋巴

液的组织。

HEARTWORM

心丝虫

The term heartworm is really a misnomer, as the parasitic worm (Dirofilaria immitis) that causes the disease usually

infects the pulmonary arteries, not the heart itself.

心丝虫一词确实用词不当，因为引起这种疾病的寄生虫（恶丝虫）通常感染肺动脉，而不是心脏本身。

Heartworm is generally passed by mosquitoes, who pick up the parasite from the bloodstreams of dogs (less

frequently from cats and ferrets) while the worms are in their prelarval stage. While inside the mosquito, the infant

parasites called microfilaria mature into infective adults that are deposited into other host animals. After two to four

months, the parasites penetrate blood vessel walls and travel to the pulmonary arteries, where they reproduce if

conditions are right. While the worms are in the pulmonary arteries, the body launches an immunologic attack

against them. If the worms have already reproduced to numbers that the immune system cannot effectively control,

an allergic response ensues, and the pulmonary arteries and surrounding lung tissues may become severely inflamed,

causing a life-threatening situation. Animals with advanced stages of heartworm infestation may exhibit chronic

coughing; labored breathing; diminished physical stamina and a low tolerance to stress; weight loss; and heart

failure.

心丝虫通常由蚊子传播，当蠕虫处于幼虫前期时，蚊子会从狗的血液中感染寄生虫（猫和雪貂的情况较

少）。在蚊子体内，称为微丝蚴的婴儿寄生虫成熟为感染性成虫，并沉积在其他宿主动物体内。两到四个

月后，寄生虫会穿透血管壁并到达肺动脉，如果条件合适，它们会在那里繁殖。当蠕虫在肺动脉中时，身

体会对它们发起免疫攻击。如果蠕虫繁殖到免疫系统无法有效控制的数量，就会发生过敏反应，肺动脉和

周围的肺组织可能会严重发炎，导致危及生命的情况。患有心丝虫感染晚期的动物可能会表现出慢性咳

嗽；呼吸困难；体力下降，抗压能力低；减肥；和心力衰竭。

Unfortunately, the scenario becomes even more frightening when we consider conventional treatment of the

disease, which involves the use of thiacetarsamide, an intravenously administered arsenic derivative that poisons the

parasites at great expense to the host animal’s liver. In our opinion and that of several holistic veterinarians, the

deworming medication ivermectin and other preventive measures for heartworm can also be detrimental to an

animal, which brings us to an especially important point in the prevention of the disease.

不幸的是，当我们考虑该疾病的常规治疗时，这种情况变得更加可怕，其中涉及使用硫乙酰胺，一种静

脉注射的砷衍生物，它会毒害寄生虫，对宿主动物的肝脏造成巨大的损害。我们和几位整体兽医认为，驱

虫药物伊维菌素和其他心丝虫预防措施也可能对动物有害，这使我们在预防这种疾病方面尤为重要。

In some areas of the U.S., heartworm is a real and constant threat to companion animals. But in many areas of

North America, it is more of a fear-induced paranoia than an actual danger. In Montana, for instance (where we

live), heartworm is almost unheard of. Unfortunately, horror stories about heartworm lead many people to medicate

their animals anyway. We believe that people should rationally weigh the pros and cons as well as the need of

administering a preventive heartworm treatment to their animal companions.

在美国的一些地区，心丝虫对伴侣动物来说是一种真正且持续的威胁。但在北美的许多地区，这更多的

是一种恐惧引起的偏执，而不是真正的危险。例如，在蒙大拿州（我们居住的地方），心丝虫几乎闻所未

闻。不幸的是，有关心丝虫的恐怖故事导致许多人无论如何都对他们的动物进行药物治疗。我们认为，人

们应该理性权衡利弊以及对动物伙伴进行预防性心丝虫治疗的必要性。

Another problem arises from the blood and antigen tests that are performed to detect heartworms. In these tests,

30 percent of infested dogs do not test positive, meaning that the disease may progress unchecked. Likewise, a

positive test for heartworm does not necessarily mean that the parasites will become problematic, especially if the

host animal is healthy.

另一个问题来自于检测心丝虫的血液和抗原测试。在这些测试中，30% 的受感染狗的测试结果不呈阳

性，这意味着疾病可能会不受控制地发展。同样，心丝虫检测呈阳性并不一定意味着寄生虫会出现问题，

特别是在宿主动物健康的情况下。

Natural prevention of heartworm begins with identifying just how much “at risk” your companion is. If you live

in a high-risk area, your animal’s coat should never be cut. Allow it to grow to full length and serve its natural

=== PAGE 507 ===
function as an antimosquito barrier. Areas where mosquito populations are especially high (such as swamps,

sloughs, and other breeding grounds) should be avoided, and perhaps a tightly knit cotton or breathable nylon

garment is in order for shorthaired dogs. (Several clothing catalogs for dogs are available.) Proper nutrition and tonic

immune system support will build and maintain your companion’s resistance to the parasite. In addition to a full

array of supplemental vitamins and minerals, garlic can be added to an animal’s diet to strengthen the immune

system. When venturing into higher-risk areas, echinacea can be preventatively administered for two or three days

before the excursion and continue for three days after.

对心丝虫的自然预防首先要确定您的伴侣的“危险程度”。如果您生活在高风险地区，切勿剪掉动物的皮

毛。让它充分生长并发挥其作为防蚊屏障的天然功能。应避免蚊子数量特别多的地区（例如沼泽、泥沼和

其他滋生地），对于短毛狗来说，也许穿紧密编织的棉质或透气尼龙衣服。 （有多种狗的服装目录可供选

择。）适当的营养和滋补免疫系统支持将增强并维持您的伴侣对寄生虫的抵抗力。除了一系列补充维生素

和矿物质之外，大蒜还可以添加到动物的饮食中以增强免疫系统。当冒险进入高风险地区时，可以在旅行

前两三天预防性服用紫锥菊，并在旅行后持续三天。

If your animal does contract heartworm, don’t panic. Instead, continue supporting the immune system and call

your holistic veterinarian to determine the next step of action. There are many options. Among them may be black

walnut hull tincture (made from unripe green hulls instead of dried ones). As of 1999, we had been contacted by

several individuals who claim that black walnut hull may be effective at controlling the parasites. Given what we

know about this herb and the parasite, we remain skeptical but hopeful that clinical use will validate this claim.

如果您的动物确实感染了心丝虫，请不要惊慌。相反，继续支持免疫系统并致电您的整体兽医来确定下

一步行动。有很多选择。其中可能是黑胡桃壳酊剂（由未成熟的绿色外壳而不是干燥的外壳制成）。截至

1999 年，已有几位人士联系我们，声称黑胡桃壳可能能有效控制寄生虫。鉴于我们对这种草药和寄生虫的

了解，我们仍然持怀疑态度，但希望临床使用能够验证这一说法。

PREGNANCY AND LACTATION

怀孕和哺乳期

One of the most frequently asked questions we hear as animal herbalists is, What should I be giving to a pregnant

animal? Our response is often a cause of disappointment: Aside from the elements of good nutrition, as little as

possible.

作为动物草药师，我们最常听到的问题之一是，我应该给怀孕的动物吃什么？我们的反应常常令人失望：

除了良好的营养元素之外，尽可能少。

During pregnancy and lactation, a mother’s body is in a state of continual hormonal fluctuation. Her nutritional

demands change as her body experiences a roller-coaster ride of metabolic events that are incomparable to any other

experience. It is a period when her body must maintain delicate checks and balances while responding to

unprecedented demands. These are times when the proactive efforts of an animal herbalist really pay off. Having

received a good natural diet, a healthy living environment, and complementary measures of health-supporting

vitamin, mineral, and herb supplements throughout her life, the pregnant animal is physically and mentally prepared

to undertake the rigors of childbirth and motherhood. This is a time when the body should be allowed to work its

natural wonders without interference from introduced stimulation, suppression, or irritation. With this in mind, the

bigger and better question is, What herbs shouldn’t be used in pregnant or lactating animals?

在怀孕和哺乳期间，母亲的身体处于荷尔蒙持续波动的状态。当她的身体经历代谢事件的过山车之旅

时，她的营养需求发生变化，这是任何其他经历都无法比拟的。在这个时期，她的身体必须保持微妙的制

衡，同时应对前所未有的需求。这些时候，动物草药师的积极努力才真正得到回报。怀孕的动物在一生中

接受了良好的自然饮食、健康的生活环境以及支持健康的维生素、矿物质和草药补充剂的补充措施，在身

体和精神上都做好了承担分娩和母亲的严酷准备。在这个时候，身体应该被允许发挥其自然奇迹，而不受

引入的刺激、抑制或刺激的干扰。考虑到这一点，更大更好的问题是，哪些草药不应该用于怀孕或哺乳期

的动物？

=== PAGE 509 ===
HERBS TO AVOID

应避免的草药

Many herbs should not be given to pregnant or lactating animals. Herbs that contain considerable amounts of

volatile oil constituents such as juniper, any of the aromatic mints, and parsley seed should not be used during

pregnancy because the oils are capable of crossing the placenta to the fetus. Volatile oils may also infiltrate a

mother’s milk, so these herbs should be avoided during lactation as well. Herbs that stimulate or suppress hormone

production should also be avoided—these include licorice, wild yam, and yucca root. Herbs that are high in tannin

constituents such as uva ursi, white oak bark, black walnut hulls, and slippery elm may cause uterine contractions

and miscarriage. Herbal laxatives that contain anthraquinone constituents such as senna, cascara sagrada, turkey

rhubarb, and yellow dock should be avoided as well. If your companion becomes constipated during pregnancy, try

lubricating her digestive tract by feeding marshmallow, flaxseed, or psyllium husks. Chickweed can also serve as a

safe and effective laxative in pregnant animals.

许多草药不应该给怀孕或哺乳期的动物服用。怀孕期间不应使用含有大量挥发油成分的草药，例如杜松

子、任何芳香薄荷和欧芹籽，因为这些油能够穿过胎盘到达胎儿。挥发油也可能渗入母乳，因此哺乳期间

也应避免使用这些草药。还应避免刺激或抑制激素产生的草药，包括甘草、野山药和丝兰根。熊果、白橡

树皮、黑胡桃壳和滑榆等富含单宁成分的草药可能会导致子宫收缩和流产。也应避免使用含有蒽醌成分的

草药泻药，如番泻叶、鼠李皮、火鸡大黄和黄坞。如果您的伴侣在怀孕期间出现便秘，请尝试通过喂棉花

糖、亚麻籽或洋车前子壳来润滑她的消化道。繁缕还可以作为怀孕动物安全有效的泻药。

Herbs that contain large percentages of bitter alkaloids such as Oregon grape and goldenseal may have

abortifacient activities and should not be used. Red clover, feverfew, and ginkgo all inhibit platelet aggregation in

the blood and may contribute to excessive hemorrhage during or after birthing.

含有大量苦味生物碱的草药（例如俄勒冈葡萄和白毛茛）可能具有堕胎活性，不应使用。红三叶草、小

白菊和银杏都会抑制血液中的血小板聚集，并可能导致分娩期间或分娩后过度出血。

In summary, if you’re not sure about the safety of an herb during pregnancy, assume that it’s contraindicated and

don’t use it!

总之，如果您不确定怀孕期间某种草药的安全性，请假设它是禁忌的并且不要使用它！

=== PAGE 510 ===
TONIC SUPPORT

滋补支持

Contrary to what many herbalists regard as tradition, we do not use most of the “classic birthing and pregnancy

herbs” (such as blue cohosh) during this fragile time. Instead, our approach is strictly nutritive. Raspberry leaf tea

has been long regarded as an excellent uterine tonic for pregnant humans and animals, but it should not be given

during the first few weeks of pregnancy. Nor should it be fed in large amounts, as there is a small risk that its

astringent activities may trigger abortion in sensitive animals (especially cats). In our opinion, nettle leaf and

spirulina are both better choices as uterine tonics because they contain higher concentrations and broader

assortments of essential and trace minerals and vitamins. This means they can be fed more conservatively, and the

risk (as low as that risk may be) of inducing uterine contractions is thereby reduced.

与许多草药学家所认为的传统相反，在这个脆弱的时期，我们不使用大多数“经典的分娩和怀孕草药”（例

如蓝升麻）。相反，我们的方法是严格营养的。覆盆子叶茶长期以来一直被认为是怀孕人类和动物的极佳

子宫滋补品，但在怀孕的最初几周不宜饮用。也不宜大量喂养，因为其收敛活性可能会导致敏感动物（尤

其是猫）流产。我们认为，荨麻叶和螺旋藻都是子宫滋补品的更好选择，因为它们含有更高浓度和更广泛

的必需微量矿物质和维生素。这意味着可以更保守地喂养它们，从而降低诱发子宫收缩的风险（尽可能

低）。

=== PAGE 511 ===
HERBS AND LACTATION

草药和哺乳期

Healthy animals who receive all necessary elements of nutrition during motherhood should have no problems with

milk production or quality. If a nursing mother is not providing her young with enough milk, it’s probably because

of a nutritional deficiency, hormonal imbalance, or another dysfunction. Fennel seed, borage, dill, and yucca root are

all said to increase milk production in nursing mothers, but these herbs are useful only to healthy animals who need

more milk to feed a big, hungry litter. If your dog or cat has given birth to a small- or average-sized litter and is

having trouble feeding her young, then deeper problems need to be addressed before you start trying to induce milk

production. Forcing a mother’s body to perform beyond its capacity with estrogenic herbs may only worsen an

already serious situation. In many cases, switching an animal from a commercial diet to one that offers a diversity of

whole, raw foods makes a world of difference. Moderate quantities of supplemental vitamins, minerals, probiotics,

and EFAs can be of tremendous help as well because lactation can deplete an animal’s reserve supply of vital

nutrients. In cats, this depletion can cause a life-threatening deficiency of taurine, an amino acid that is critical to the

heart.

在母性期间接受所有必需营养元素的健康动物应该不会出现产奶或质量问题。如果哺乳期的母亲没有为孩

子提供足够的乳汁，可能是因为营养缺乏、荷尔蒙失衡或其他功能障碍。据说茴香籽、琉璃苣、莳萝和丝

兰根都可以增加哺乳期母亲的产奶量，但这些草药只对需要更多牛奶来喂养饥饿的大窝的健康动物有用。

如果您的狗或猫生下了小或中等大小的窝，并且在喂养幼崽时遇到困难，那么在您开始尝试诱导产奶之

前，需要解决更深层次的问题。使用雌激素草药强迫母亲的身体超出其承受能力可能只会使本已严重的情

况变得更糟。在许多情况下，将动物从商业饮食转变为提供多种完整生食的饮食会带来很大的不同。适量

补充维生素、矿物质、益生菌和必需脂肪酸也有很大帮助，因为哺乳期会耗尽动物重要营养素的储备供

应。对于猫来说，这种消耗可能会导致危及生命的牛磺酸缺乏，牛磺酸是一种对心脏至关重要的氨基酸。

=== PAGE 512 ===
RESPIRATORY PROBLEMS

呼吸系统的问题

COUGHING AND SNEEZING: NATURAL HEALING MECHANISMS

咳嗽和打喷嚏：自然治疗机制

Occasional coughing or sneezing is part of a body’s normal health maintenance program. Most animal guardians

know that when dust particles, pollen, or other foreign matter enters the trachea, spasms are triggered to expel the

material from the body. Yet many people try to suppress coughing and sneezing rather than allow the body to do its

job because the conventional Western mind-set dictates that anything that is socially offensive or that causes

discomfort must be suppressed. To tend to an animal’s holistic health needs, we must learn to control our urge to

interfere with the body’s natural functions. Suppressing activities such as sneezing, coughing, and discharging

mucus deprives the body of its natural healing mechanisms and may actually contribute to the underlying disease by

prohibiting expulsion of pathogenic microbes and other foreign substances.

偶尔咳嗽或打喷嚏是身体正常健康维护计划的一部分。大多数动物监护人都知道，当灰尘颗粒、花粉或其

他异物进入气管时，会引发痉挛，将这些物质排出体外。然而，许多人试图抑制咳嗽和打喷嚏，而不是让

身体发挥作用，因为传统的西方思维模式规定，任何具有社会攻击性或引起不适的行为都必须受到抑制。

为了满足动物的整体健康需求，我们必须学会控制干扰身体自然功能的冲动。抑制打喷嚏、咳嗽和排出粘

液等活动会剥夺身体的自然愈合机制，并可能通过阻止病原微生物和其他异物的排出而实际上导致潜在的

疾病。

Instead of suppressing disease symptoms, the holistic healer’s efforts are centered on assisting the body to cleanse

and heal itself. In the respiratory tract, this entails supporting and encouraging the productivity of coughing,

sneezing, and expulsion of mucus. Most animals do not produce mucus as readily as humans do. Therefore, herbs

and other remedies that serve as cough suppressants or discourage expectoration (such as wild cherry bark) should

be reserved for special circumstances, such as when a continuous, unproductive cough has deprived an animal of

sleep for several days. Even then, such remedies should be used in moderation as adjuncts to herbs that support

productive coughing.

整体治疗师的工作重点不是抑制疾病症状，而是帮助身体自我净化和治愈。在呼吸道中，这需要支持和

鼓励咳嗽、打喷嚏和排出粘液的生产力。大多数动物不像人类那样容易产生粘液。因此，草药和其他止咳

药或止咳药（如野樱桃树皮）应保留在特殊情况下使用，例如当连续、无效的咳嗽导致动物数日无法睡眠

时。即便如此，此类疗法也应适量使用，作为有助于有效咳嗽的草药的辅助药物。

Many respiratory ailments can be treated at home with some simple herbal preparations. But if your companion’s

coughing or sneezing continues or worsens, or if you have any doubt whatsoever about its cause, you should have

your friend examined by a holistic vet. A persistent cough can mean minor throat irritation caused by chewing on a

stick, or it can be a symptom of a life-threatening situation such as heartworm, pneumonia, cardiopulmonary

disease, or a serious viral infection.

许多呼吸系统疾病可以在家中通过一些简单的草药制剂进行治疗。但如果你的同伴咳嗽或打喷嚏持续或

恶化，或者如果你对其原因有任何疑问，你应该让你的朋友接受全面的兽医检查。持续咳嗽可能意味着咀

嚼棍子引起轻微的喉咙刺激，也可能是危及生命的情况的症状，如心丝虫、肺炎、心肺疾病或严重的病毒

感染。

=== PAGE 513 ===
ASTHMA

哮喘

Asthma is characterized by a sudden onset of bronchial inflammation and respiratory distress. Animals with severe

asthma may begin an attack by wheezing, sneezing, and coughing, which may quickly progress to obstructed

airways, labored breathing, and a life-threatening crisis. According to most veterinarians, dogs do not suffer from

asthma, but this disease is known to occur frequently in cats and many other animals.

哮喘的特点是突然出现支气管炎症和呼吸窘迫。患有严重哮喘的动物可能会通过喘息、打喷嚏和咳嗽开始

发作，这可能会迅速发展为气道阻塞、呼吸困难和危及生命的危机。大多数兽医认为，狗不会患哮喘，但

这种疾病在猫和许多其他动物中经常发生。

Many people regard asthma as a cause of respiratory distress, but in most cases it’s really only a symptom of a

deeper immune-mediated disorder. Asthma usually occurs as part of a severe allergic reaction. Therefore, holistic

treatment does not focus solely on suppression of asthma attacks but also on proactive correction of the

dysfunctional mechanisms that trigger the attacks. (For more information on long-term holistic treatment, see

“Allergies” in the “Immune System Care” sections of this chapter.)

许多人认为哮喘是呼吸窘迫的原因，但在大多数情况下，它实际上只是更深层次的免疫介导疾病的症

状。哮喘通常是严重过敏反应的一部分。因此，整体治疗不仅仅关注抑制哮喘发作，还关注主动纠正引发

哮喘发作的功能失调机制。 （有关长期整体治疗的更多信息，请参阅本章“免疫系统护理”部分中的“过

敏”。）

Symptomatic herbal treatments for non-life-threatening cases of asthma are essentially the same as those used for

kennel cough and other forms of bronchitis (see below). Lobelia may be useful for suppressing asthma attacks in

cats, especially if a tincture is administered at the first signs of onset. Lobeline, the active constituent of lobelia, is

potentially toxic (it has central nervous system effects similar to those of nicotine), so it should be administered only

under the direction of a holistic veterinarian.

对于非危及生命的哮喘病例的对症草药治疗与用于犬窝咳和其他形式支气管炎的治疗基本相同（见下

文）。半边莲可能有助于抑制猫的哮喘发作，特别是在发病最初迹象时使用酊剂。半边莲的活性成分半边

莲具有潜在毒性（它具有与尼古丁类似的中枢神经系统作用），因此只能在整体兽医的指导下使用。

=== PAGE 514 ===
BRONCHITIS AND KENNEL COUGH

支气管炎和犬窝咳

The term bronchitis refers to inflammation of one or more of the large air passages of the lungs. Causes are variable,

ranging from inhalation of dust and other airborne irritants to viral, bacterial, or fungal infection; tumors; or cancer.

An accumulation of mucus in the bronchi and a deep, rumbling cough are usually associated with bronchitis.

支气管炎一词是指肺部一个或多个大气道的炎症。原因多种多样，从吸入灰尘和其他空气中的刺激物到病

毒、细菌或真菌感染；肿瘤；或癌症。支气管内粘液积聚和深沉的隆隆声咳嗽通常与支气管炎有关。

Bronchitis that is secondary to bacterial, fungal, or viral infection is often accompanied by elevated body

temperature and mucus discharge. If your companion is coughing up fluid, take an unpleasant moment to examine it.

If it’s pink, frothy, blood streaked, or bright yellow, get your companion and a specimen of the discharge to a

veterinarian immediately. Respiratory infections or bleeding progress rapidly and need to be treated aggressively.

继发于细菌、真菌或病毒感染的支气管炎通常伴有体温升高和粘液排出。如果你的同伴咳出液体，请花

点不愉快的时间检查一下。如果分泌物呈粉红色、泡沫状、血丝或亮黄色，请立即带你的同伴和分泌物样

本去看兽医。呼吸道感染或出血进展迅速，需要积极治疗。

Kennel cough is a generic term for a dry, hacking cough that occurs in dogs and sometimes cats. It is caused by

viral (such as canine adenovirus II, parainfluenza) or bacterial infection (such as Bordetella bronchiseptica) and is

generally self-limiting in that it rarely progresses beyond minor inflammation of the trachea. No discharge, fever,

respiratory edema, or other symptoms are associated with kennel cough—just coughing. This is an important point

to remember because if your animal is exhibiting symptoms in addition to a hacking cough, you may be facing a

condition more serious than kennel cough.

犬窝咳是发生在狗（有时是猫）身上的干咳的通用术语。它是由病毒（例如犬腺病毒 II、副流感）或细

菌感染（例如支气管败血博德特氏菌）引起的，并且通常具有自限性，因为它很少会发展到气管的轻微炎

症之外。没有分泌物、发烧、呼吸道水肿或其他与犬窝咳相关的症状——只是咳嗽。这是需要记住的重要

一点，因为如果您的动物除了干咳之外还表现出其他症状，那么您可能面临比犬窝咳更严重的病症。

Elecampane can decrease the symptoms and shorten the duration of bronchitis and kennel cough.

=== PAGE 515 ===
土木香可以减轻支气管炎和犬窝咳的症状并缩短持续时间。

Once diagnosed, kennel cough and most other types of bronchitis can be treated safely at home. If other animals

in the home are susceptible to infection, take preventive measures to keep them healthy. We administer immune-

supportive herbs to our animals before, during, and after suspected exposure to infectious bronchitis. Dietary

supplementation of fresh chopped garlic is a good preventive measure because garlic has excellent immunotonic

qualities and antibacterial and antiviral principles that are exhaled through the lungs. Astragalus or organically

grown echinacea are also well suited for boosting your companion’s immune system against kennel cough before or

during an infection. Eucalyptus essential oil can be placed into a vaporizer with some water and left within a few

feet of your companion’s resting quarters. (Don’t use this method in conjunction with a homeopathic prescription, as

it may antidote the remedy.) The vapor helps open the animal’s respiratory passages and provides a continuous

measure of antimicrobial intervention.

一旦确诊，犬窝咳和大多数其他类型的支气管炎都可以在家中安全治疗。如果家中其他动物容易受到感

染，请采取预防措施以保持它们的健康。在怀疑接触传染性支气管炎之前、期间和之后，我们给动物服用

免疫支持草药。膳食补充新鲜切碎的大蒜是一种很好的预防措施，因为大蒜具有优良的免疫功能以及通过

肺部呼出的抗菌和抗病毒原理。黄芪或有机种植的紫锥菊也非常适合在感染前或感染期间增强您同伴的免

疫系统，抵抗犬舍咳嗽。可以将桉树精油与一些水一起放入蒸发器中，并放在距离同伴休息处几英尺的地

方。 （不要将这种方法与顺势疗法处方结合使用，因为它可能会解毒。）蒸汽有助于打开动物的呼吸道，

并提供持续的抗菌干预措施。

款冬、银杏、毛蕊花和土木香具有抗病毒、抗菌、祛痰和抗痉挛的功效，有助于缩短伴侣的疾病持续时

PNEUMONIA AND PULMONARY EDEMA

肺炎和肺水肿

Pneumonia is a condition in which lung volume and pulmonary efficiency is reduced by the presence of fluid

(edema) or a solid mass (tumor). Pneumonia can originate from bacterial, viral, fungal, or protozoan infection;

allergy; cancer; injury, or systemic dysfunction. Pneumonia is a life-threatening situation that can be progressive.

Treatment varies according to the cause and symptoms.

肺炎是一种因液体（水肿）或固体肿块（肿瘤）的存在而导致肺容量和肺效率降低的疾病。肺炎可由细

菌、病毒、真菌或原虫感染引起；过敏;癌症;损伤或全身功能障碍。肺炎是一种危及生命的疾病，并且可能

呈进展性。治疗方法根据病因和症状而有所不同。

The term pulmonary edema refers to the presence of fluid in the lungs. With few exceptions (such as drowning),

pulmonary edema is secondary to other disorders, such as congestive heart failure, inhalation of toxic chemicals, or

damage of lung tissues.

术语“肺水肿”是指肺部存在液体。除了少数例外（例如溺水），肺水肿继发于其他疾病，例如充血性心

力衰竭、吸入有毒化学物质或肺组织损伤。

A TONIC FORMULA FOR ANIMALS WITH PNEUMONIA

肺炎动物的滋补配方

Combine the following glycerin-based herb tinctures:

结合以下基于甘油的草药酊剂：

2 parts echinacea

2 份 紫锥菊

1 part astragalus

1份黄芪

1 part coltsfoot

1 份款冬

1 part yarrow

1 份 西洋蓍草

This formula can be added to dandelion leaf tea and fed two or three times daily until the disease has run its

course. The dose for dogs, cats, and other small animals is 0.25–0.5 milliliters for each 20 pounds of the

animal’s body weight. Horses and other large herbivores can receive 20–30 milliliters.

此方可加蒲公英叶茶中，每日服二至三次，直至病愈。狗、猫和其他小动物的剂量为每 20 磅动物体

重 0.25-0.5 毫升。马和其他大型食草动物可以吸收 20-30 毫升。

In cases of pneumonia or pulmonary edema, pulmonary (lung) efficiency is reduced so the blood does not receive

the oxygen it needs to supply tissues throughout the body. In other words, the body progressively suffocates as the

condition worsens. Symptoms at onset include reduced physical stamina; coughing, panting, or gasping for air; and

diminished mental capacity. As the situation worsens, the tongue and mucous membranes of the eyes begin to turn

blue from lack of oxygen, the animal becomes weak and lethargic, and the brain and other vital organs begin to die.

Even if you have only a hunch that your animal may have pneumonia or a condition involving pulmonary edema,

the first course of action is to consult a veterinarian immediately to rule out the possibility of a life-threatening

=== PAGE 518 ===
situation. Don’t hesitate. Pneumonia can be aggressive in animals, especially those who are aging or weakened by

chronic illness.

在肺炎或肺水肿的情况下，肺的效率会降低，因此血液无法获得供应全身组织所需的氧气。换句话说，

随着病情恶化，身体逐渐窒息。发病时的症状包括体力下降；咳嗽、气喘或喘气；以及智力下降。随着情

况恶化，舌头和眼睛粘膜开始因缺氧而变蓝，动物变得虚弱、昏昏欲睡，大脑和其他重要器官开始死亡。

即使您只是预感您的动物可能患有肺炎或涉及肺水肿的疾病，首要行动也是立即咨询兽医，以排除危及生

命情况的可能性。不要犹豫。肺炎对动物具有侵袭性，尤其是那些因慢性疾病而衰老或虚弱的动物。

Conventional approaches usually involve the use of furosemide or other strong diuretics to help move fluid out of

the lungs, as well as antibiotic therapies directed toward any bacteria or fungi that might be involved.

传统方法通常涉及使用呋塞米或其他强利尿剂来帮助将液体排出肺部，以及针对可能涉及的任何细菌或

真菌进行抗生素治疗。

Once the nature of the problem has been identified and the animal’s condition has stabilized, herbs can be used to

strengthen the immune system and support the body in its efforts to regain well-being. Large doses of a strong, dark

dandelion leaf tea (as much as you can get the animal to drink) serves as a strong diuretic to help with the

elimination of fluid from the lungs. If the animal won’t drink the tea, use a salt-free meat or vegetable broth instead

of hot water or sweeten the tea with honey. Unlike the aforementioned furosemide, dandelion helps replace

potassium and other nutrients that are usually lost through increased urination.

一旦确定了问题的本质并且动物的状况稳定下来，就可以使用草药来增强免疫系统并支持身体努力恢复

健康。大剂量的浓浓深色蒲公英叶茶（尽可能多地让动物喝下）可以作为强效利尿剂，帮助排出肺部的液

体。如果动物不喝茶，请使用无盐肉汤或蔬菜汤代替热水，或用蜂蜜使茶变甜。与前面提到的速尿不同，

蒲公英有助于补充钾和其他通常因排尿增加而流失的营养物质。

Dandelion leaf tea should be fed continuously. Provide as much as the animal will take throughout the therapy.

Echinacea and garlic can be used to boost your companion’s immune system, and astragalus or Siberian ginseng

may increase his body’s ability to function under the added stress. Coltsfoot and elecampane are both good choices

for stimulating respiratory function, inhibiting bacterial reproduction, and helping with the elimination of mucus

from the bronchi. Inhalation therapy using a vaporizer and eucalyptus oil (as mentioned for bronchitis) can also

bring relief. Yarrow and cayenne can both increase pulmonary circulation and increase oxygen delivery to the blood.

Used in combination with the diuretic qualities of dandelion leaf, these two herbs may be especially useful for

racehorses who suffer acute respiratory bleeding and pulmonary edema as a result of strenuous exercise. Cayenne

can also be used as part of this program as a respiratory stimulant and to assist the activities of the other herbs—one

small gel cap daily for dogs and cats and five to ten large gel caps daily for horses.

蒲公英叶茶应连续喂食。在整个治疗过程中提供动物所需的量。紫锥菊和大蒜可以用来增强你同伴的免

疫系统，黄芪或西伯利亚人参可以增强他的身体在额外压力下的运作能力。款冬和土木香都是刺激呼吸功

能、抑制细菌繁殖和帮助清除支气管粘液的不错选择。使用汽化器和桉树油的吸入疗法（如针对支气管炎

所述）也可以缓解症状。西洋蓍草和辣椒都可以增加肺循环并增加血液中的氧气输送。与蒲公英叶的利尿

特性结合使用，这两种草药可能对因剧烈运动而遭受急性呼吸道出血和肺水肿的赛马特别有用。辣椒还可

以作为该计划的一部分，作为呼吸兴奋剂，并辅助其他草药的活动——狗和猫每天服用一个小凝胶帽，马

每天服用五到十个大凝胶帽。

In animals who are suffering pulmonary edema secondary to congestive heart failure or other cardiopulmonary

problems, hawthorn, ginkgo, or bugleweed may be indicated. Other herbs worth considering in a wide variety of

respiratory problems include horehound (excellent, but hard to administer because of its bitterness), thyme,

rosemary, and lovage.

对于因充血性心力衰竭或其他心肺问题继发肺水肿的动物，可能需要使用山楂、银杏或牛草。其他值得

考虑用于治疗各种呼吸系统疾病的草药包括苦海草（效果很好，但由于其苦味而难以服用）、百里香、迷

迭香和独活草。

SKIN PROBLEMS

皮肤问题

Skin is something we tend to take for granted. After all, we see it all the time. It covers our dogs, cats, horses, birds,

and our own bodies. And unlike treatments for a diseased organ that is hidden deep and mysteriously within the

body, our approaches to skin disorders are often as shallow as we perceive the skin itself to be.

皮肤是我们往往认为理所当然的东西。毕竟，我们一直都看到它。它涵盖了我们的狗、猫、马、鸟和我们

自己的身体。与对隐藏在身体深处而神秘的患病器官的治疗不同，我们对皮肤疾病的治疗方法往往与我们

对皮肤本身的感知一样肤浅。

The skin regulates body temperature as well as peripheral blood and lymph circulation and provides frontline

protection from harmful influences that exist outside the body. The skin also helps with the elimination of systemic

wastes that are not effectively eliminated through the urinary and digestive tracts. Therefore, what might appear to

be nothing more than a superficial annoyance such as a skin disorder might indicate a serious underlying disease.

Animals don’t complain as much as people do and are unable to express the discomforts of a deep-seated disease.

That means the causes of a chronic skin problem may go unnoticed until they progress to a point where an animal is

noticeably suffering from a condition such as arthritis, liver disease, kidney failure, or even cancer. Compounding

the problem is the difficulty of accurately identifying the underlying causes of many skin-related disorders—the list

of possible causes is almost unlimited. As a result, many conventional therapies amount to nothing more than relief

of surface symptoms.

皮肤调节体温以及外周血液和淋巴循环，并提供一线保护，免受体外存在的有害影响。皮肤还有助于消

除无法通过泌尿道和消化道有效消除的全身废物。因此，看似表面上的烦恼（例如皮肤病）可能表明存在

严重的潜在疾病。动物不像人类那样抱怨，也无法表达深层次疾病的不适。这意味着慢性皮肤问题的原因

可能会被忽视，直到它们发展到动物明显患有关节炎、肝病、肾衰竭甚至癌症等疾病的程度。使问题更加

复杂的是，准确识别许多皮肤相关疾病的根本原因非常困难——可能的原因几乎是无限的。因此，许多传

统疗法只不过是缓解表面症状。

In conventional veterinary medicine, skin problems are most often treated as conditions occurring on the outside

of the body, and a common course of therapy typically involves topical creams, salves, rinses, or shampoos. When

these external measures fail, corticosteroids, antihistamines, or other drugs are usually prescribed to depress the

immune system and thereby squelch the uncomfortable symptoms. While this approach to skin disease can ease an

animal’s discomfort quickly or even make the disease appear to go away, the underlying causes of the disease may

never be considered, much less acted upon. As a result, they may progress to other, more serious problems. In

human dermatology, eczema or psoriasis present excellent examples. Both are viewed by Western medicine as

symptomatic manifestations of various systemic or external causes such as hormonal imbalances; systemic

dysfunction; or viral, fungal, or bacterial infection; but the reasons the body allows such problems to occur remain

largely unknown. In the absence of curative answers, only the symptoms are addressed.

在传统兽医学中，皮肤问题通常被视为发生在身体外部的病症，常见的治疗过程通常包括外用乳膏、药

膏、冲洗液或洗发水。当这些外部措施失败时，通常会开出皮质类固醇、抗组胺药或其他药物来抑制免疫

系统，从而抑制不适症状。虽然这种治疗皮肤病的方法可以快速缓解动物的不适，甚至使疾病看起来消

失，但人们可能永远不会考虑疾病的根本原因，更不用说采取行动了。结果，他们可能会发展到其他更严

重的问题。在人类皮肤病学中，湿疹或牛皮癣就是很好的例子。西医认为两者都是各种全身或外部原因

（例如荷尔蒙失衡）的症状表现。全身功能障碍；或病毒、真菌或细菌感染；但身体允许此类问题发生的

原因仍然很大程度上未知。在没有治愈答案的情况下，只能解决症状。

The principles of holistic herbal medicine do not allow healers to employ solutions that address only the surface

manifestations of disease. While it’s true that finding a cure for chronic skin disorders is as difficult for holistic

healers as it is for conventional research scientists, we are gifted with a special weapon: a holistic perspective that

enables us to help the body find a cure for itself. The holistic herbal approach to skin disease reaches beyond

symptoms to accept the fact that the body has mysterious but powerful abilities to heal itself. Fully understanding

=== PAGE 520 ===
these abilities is not absolutely necessary. The function of the herbalist is not to substitute the body’s natural

methods of treating disease with new methods but to assist the body in healing itself naturally. This applies to all

forms of skin disease. Whether the problem is a contact dermatitis that can be quickly relieved with an application of

herbal salve or a more complex condition that emanates from within the body to create chronic seborrhea, the

approach is to assist the body’s efforts to heal while trying to identify and address the underlying causes.

整体草药的原则不允许治疗者采用仅解决疾病表面表现的解决方案。虽然寻找慢性皮肤病的治疗方法对

于整体治疗师来说确实和传统研究科学家一样困难，但我们拥有一种特殊的武器：整体视角，使我们能够

帮助身体找到自身的治疗方法。治疗皮肤病的整体草药方法超越了症状，接受了这样一个事实：身体具有

神秘而强大的自愈能力。完全理解这些能力并不是绝对必要的。草药师的作用不是用新方法取代身体治疗

疾病的自然方法，而是帮助身体自然愈合。这适用于所有形式的皮肤病。无论问题是可以通过使用草药膏

快速缓解的接触性皮炎，还是来自体内产生慢性皮脂溢的更复杂的病症，方法都是协助身体治愈，同时尝

试识别和解决根本原因。

Writing comprehensively on herbal approaches to animal skin problems would entail writing an entire book—

perhaps even multiple volumes. So instead we present some generalized herbal treatments with strong emphases on

the holistic principles by which they are most effectively applied, for a few of the most common skin problems in

companion animals.

全面撰写有关动物皮肤问题的草药方法的文章需要写一整本书，甚至可能是多卷。因此，我们提出了一

些通用的草药疗法，重点强调最有效地应用它们的整体原则，以解决伴侣动物中一些最常见的皮肤问题。

=== PAGE 521 ===
SKIN PROBLEMS OF INTERNAL ORIGIN

内部根源的皮肤问题

Chronic, or recurring, skin conditions that cannot be attributed to elements outside the body usually indicate

systemic disease. Generally speaking, if an animal’s body system cannot effectively eliminate waste or if foreign

bodies or toxins cannot be effectively dealt with by a strong immune system, the body tries to push the problem

outward, away from the vital organs. When the body resorts to such measures, it is usually because one or more of

the organs or body systems that monitor and respond to foreign bodies and systemic waste have somehow become

dysfunctional. The liver, kidneys, and immune and lymph systems become overburdened, the skin is asked to take

actions it cannot take, and a “skin problem” erupts in the form of an oily, flaky coat; irritated, itchy skin;

subcutaneous cysts; excessive hair loss; pus-filled eruptions, and so forth.

不能归因于体外因素的慢性或复发性皮肤病通常表明存在全身性疾病。一般来说，如果动物的身体系统不

能有效地排除废物，或者如果强大的免疫系统不能有效地处理异物或毒素，身体就会试图将问题向外推，

远离重要器官。当身体采取此类措施时，通常是因为监测和响应异物和全身废物的一个或多个器官或身体

系统以某种方式变得功能失调。肝脏、肾脏、免疫和淋巴系统负担过重，皮肤被要求采取它无法采取的行

动，“皮肤问题”就会以油性、片状皮毛的形式出现；皮肤发炎、发痒；皮下囊肿；脱发过多；充满脓液的

皮疹等。

Treating skin conditions that are secondary to systemic disorders is difficult. Persistent skin conditions such as

seborrhea (dry or greasy, flaky or scaly skin) or pyoderma (pus-filled eruptions) may be attributable to any number

of deep-seated factors, including dietary deficiencies, food or environmental allergies, immune system disease, or a

microbial infection that may or may not be evident upon analysis of the skin itself. In such cases, the entire system

must be evaluated, systemic deficiencies must be identified and corrected, and the search for direct causes must

continue throughout the therapy, even if the symptoms are under control. The golden rule to remember is this: The

outward symptoms of many types of chronic skin disease represent only a small part of the holistic picture. We

cannot expect to find curative solutions unless we focus our efforts beyond the symptoms to identify and address the

underlying causes. This rule applies to all forms of skin disease, from an allergic response to fleabites to chronic hair

loss.

治疗继发于全身性疾病的皮肤病很困难。持续性皮肤病，如皮脂溢（干燥或油腻、片状或鳞状皮肤）或

脓皮病（充满脓液的皮疹）可能归因于多种深层次因素，包括饮食不足、食物或环境过敏、免疫系统疾病

或通过对皮肤本身的分析可能会或可能不会明显的微生物感染。在这种情况下，必须评估整个系统，必须

识别和纠正系统性缺陷，并且即使症状得到控制，也必须在整个治疗过程中继续寻找直接原因。要记住的

黄金法则是：许多类型的慢性皮肤病的外在症状仅代表整体情况的一小部分。除非我们将精力集中在症状

之外，找出并解决根本原因，否则我们不能指望找到治愈的解决方案。这条规则适用于所有形式的皮肤

病，从对跳蚤的过敏反应到慢性脱发。

=== PAGE 522 ===
SKIN PROBLEMS OF EXTERNAL ORIGIN

外源性皮肤问题

Skin problems that are triggered from outside the body are often, but not always, easier to identify and quicker to

correct than those that emanate from within. For example, the cause of recurrent urticaria (an inflammation of the

skin surface characterized by small, itching welts) may be quickly identified and eliminated when it is discovered

that Rover has been sleeping in a patch of stinging nettles growing along the backyard fence. In this case, the

holistic approach might be to neutralize the stinging acids with a dandelion flower or nettle tea rinse. A problem

such as dermatophytosis, or ringworm, a parasitic fungal infection of the skin in dogs, cats, horses, and many other

animals (including humans), presents the holistic caregiver with a more complex scenario. Ringworm is passed

directly from an infected environment to the animal host. And like most parasites, including fleas and various skin-

burrowing mites (sarcoptic mange, barn itch, demodectic mange, to name a few), ringworm is more likely to infect

diseased or immuno-compromised animals than those with healthy disease resistance. Therefore, to holistically treat

an animal suffering from ringworm, we must take the animal’s environment and his general state of health into

consideration. Ringworm can be largely prevented by keeping the living environment clean, but infection must also

be discouraged by maintaining the health of the potential host.

由体外引发的皮肤问题通常（但并非总是）比由体内引发的皮肤问题更容易识别且更快速地纠正。例如，

当发现罗弗睡在沿着后院栅栏生长的荨麻丛中时，可以快速识别和消除复发性荨麻疹（一种以小而发痒的

伤痕为特征的皮肤表面炎症）的原因。在这种情况下，整体方法可能是用蒲公英花或荨麻茶冲洗液来中和

刺痛的酸。皮肤癣菌病或癣（一种狗、猫、马和许多其他动物（包括人类）皮肤的寄生真菌感染）等问题

给整体护理人员带来了更复杂的情况。癣从受感染的环境直接传播给动物宿主。与大多数寄生虫一样，包

括跳蚤和各种皮肤穴居螨（疥癣、谷仓痒、蠕形螨等），癣更有可能感染患病或免疫功能低下的动物，而

不是那些具有健康抗病能力的动物。因此，要对患有癣的动物进行整体治疗，我们必须考虑动物的环境和

总体健康状况。保持生活环境清洁可以在很大程度上预防癣，但也必须通过保持潜在宿主的健康来阻止感

染。

This brings us right back to our main point: Before other causative factors can be addressed, the overall health of

the individual must be fully evaluated and supported.

这让我们回到了要点：在解决其他致病因素之前，必须充分评估和支持个人的整体健康状况。

HOLISTIC APPROACHES

整体方法

It’s important to keep in mind that herbs alone are seldom curative solutions to chronic forms of disease. In holistic

medicine, most skin problems are viewed as indicators of systemic dysfunction within the body. Rather than

working in ways that exclude natural body functions (as many drugs do) to suppress the symptoms of disease, herbs

serve best as functional adjuncts to a variety of other corrective measures. Nutrition; the animal’s age; his physical,

psychological, and neurological conditions; genetic predispositions characteristic to his breed; and the quality of his

living environment must be taken into account as equal parts of a holistic health picture.

重要的是要记住，仅用草药很少能治愈慢性疾病。在整体医学中，大多数皮肤问题被视为体内系统功能障

碍的指标。草药不像许多药物那样通过排除自然身体功能来抑制疾病症状，而是最好作为各种其他纠正措

施的功能性辅助剂。营养;动物的年龄；他的身体、心理和神经状况；其品种特有的遗传倾向；他的生活环

境质量必须作为整体健康状况的同等组成部分予以考虑。

Feeding the Skin

滋养皮肤

Your effectiveness at treating conditions such as flaky skin and a dull coat is gauged by how deeply you are willing

to look into your animal’s whole body, lifestyle, and environment. To begin the healing process, some careful

measures must be taken to assure that the skin is properly fed. Start with a critical assessment of your companion’s

diet, looking not just at the diversity and types of food ingredients but at the quality of each ingredient as well. The

skin is an organ that must continually regenerate itself to survive the constant effects of aging and bombardment

from environmental elements. To do so it must receive a unique array of special nutrients and nutritional adjuncts,

many of which will not be found in a typical commercial diet. At the top of this special-requirement list are

antioxidant vitamins (A, C, and E), minerals, proteins, and especially EFAs, which can be administered to an animal

through supplementing his diet.

您治疗皮肤剥落和皮毛暗淡等状况的有效性取决于您愿意深入了解动物的整个身体、生活方式和环境。为

了开始愈合过程，必须采取一些仔细的措施以确保皮肤得到适当的滋养。首先对您同伴的饮食进行严格评

估，不仅关注食物成分的多样性和类型，还要关注每种成分的质量。皮肤是一个必须不断自我再生的器

官，才能承受衰老和环境因素的持续轰击。为此，它必须获得一系列独特的特殊营养素和营养辅助剂，其

中许多在典型的商业饮食中是找不到的。这份特殊需求清单中的首要内容是抗氧化维生素（A、C 和 E）、

矿物质、蛋白质，尤其是必需脂肪酸（EFA），这些物质可以通过补充动物的饮食来补充。

Essential fatty acid supplements might include flaxseed powder or oil, fish oil, or wheat germ oil. Vitamins A, C,

and E are needed for their regenerative and antioxidant effects, and digestive enzymes are also required. In terms of

herbs, horsetail and gotu kola may help regenerate and strengthen skin structure; and nutritive herbs such as

spirulina, nettle, alfalfa, and red clover can provide trace minerals and antioxidant vitamins. Fresh burdock root is

available at many health food stores and can be grated (raw) directly into your animal’s food. Burdock is considered

a specific alterative for chronic skin problems. It is safe and nutritious and gently supports an animal’s liver and

gallbladder. Feed your animal as much as he likes.

必需脂肪酸补充剂可能包括亚麻籽粉或油、鱼油或小麦胚芽油。维生素 A、C 和 E 是其再生和抗氧化作

用所必需的，还需要消化酶。在草药方面，木贼和雷公根可能有助于再生和强化皮肤结构；螺旋藻、荨

麻、苜蓿和红三叶草等营养草本植物可以提供微量矿物质和抗氧化维生素。新鲜的牛蒡根在许多保健食品

商店都有售，并且可以直接磨碎（生）到动物的食物中。牛蒡被认为是治疗慢性皮肤问题的特定替代品。

它安全且营养丰富，温和地支持动物的肝脏和胆囊。尽可能多地喂养你的动物。

The quality of protein you are feeding also plays a vital role here—low-grade proteins (such as soy-based fillers

and most meat by-products) are difficult for animals to metabolize, and instead of being received as nutritive

protein, they are treated as hard-to-eliminate wastes. By feeding your animal a diversity of high-quality, fresh foods

=== PAGE 524 ===
and the proper nutritional supplements, you are equipping him with the components he needs to maintain healthy

skin. Without the proper nutritional components, the skin becomes weak and vulnerable to the effects of the

environment, its related body functions become compromised, and the entire system falls out of holistic balance.

您所饲喂的蛋白质的质量在这里也起着至关重要的作用 - 低级蛋白质（例如大豆填料和大多数肉类副产

品）对于动物来说很难代谢，并且它们不是作为营养蛋白质被接受，而是被视为难以消除的废物。通过给

您的动物喂食各种优质、新鲜的食物和适当的营养补充剂，您可以为它提供保持皮肤健康所需的成分。如

果没有适当的营养成分，皮肤就会变得脆弱，容易受到环境的影响，其相关的身体功能会受到损害，整个

系统会失去整体平衡。

Piecing Together a Puzzle

拼凑拼图

Once you are sure that your companion is getting the nutritional components needed for healthy skin and coat,

consider the potential sources of any chronic problem. Does your animal have a food allergy? This can often be

determined by removing food ingredients from the diet one at a time. For a dog or cat, start by changing the type of

meat your animal is eating—especially if he is eating beef or a food that is made from mostly one type of meat.

Next, try weeding out grains and yeast one at a time. Start by eliminating soy, then try wheat, then yeast.

一旦您确定您的伴侣获得了健康皮肤和皮毛所需的营养成分，请考虑任何慢性问题的潜在根源。您的动物

有食物过敏吗？这通常可以通过一次从饮食中去除一种食物成分来确定。对于狗或猫，首先要改变动物吃

的肉的类型，尤其是当他吃牛肉或主要由一种肉制成的食物时。接下来，尝试一次清除一种谷物和酵母。

首先消除大豆，然后尝试小麦，然后是酵母。

While you are ruling out food allergies, also consider anything else that may be compromising your companion’s

immune system. It is the immune system’s job to react to invading microbes or harmful substances. If the system is

compromised and cannot react correctly or effectively, it may overreact, causing an allergic response.

在排除食物过敏的同时，还要考虑任何可能损害伴侣免疫系统的其他因素。免疫系统的工作是对入侵的

微生物或有害物质做出反应。如果系统受到损害并且无法正确或有效地做出反应，则可能会反应过度，导

致过敏反应。

Is your companion hypersensitive to fleabites? Is the animal subjected to frequent vaccinations (a major cause of

many skin and immune system problems, in our opinion), protracted antibiotic therapies, or any environmental

toxins that may be depressing or stimulating immune functions? Find out the answers. Any of these factors may

contribute to a chronic skin problem.

您的同伴对跳蚤过敏吗？动物是否经常接种疫苗（我们认为这是许多皮肤和免疫系统问题的主要原

因）、长期抗生素治疗或任何可能抑制或刺激免疫功能的环境毒素？找出答案。这些因素中的任何一个都

可能导致慢性皮肤问题。

After you have an idea of what might be entering your companion’s body to trigger the problem, then start

looking for telltale signs of which organs or body systems might be affected. Is your animal friend suffering from

constipation or diarrhea, and does his skin, coat, or breath smell bad? If so, the digestive system and liver probably

need herbal support. Is the urine concentrated and strong smelling, or does it have blood in it? Are urinary infections

or stones a problem? In these cases, you need to optimize urinary efficiency and perhaps relieve inflammation in the

urinary tract and kidneys.

当您了解什么可能进入伴侣的身体并引发问题后，请开始寻找哪些器官或身体系统可能受到影响的迹

象。你的动物朋友是否患有便秘或腹泻，他的皮肤、皮毛或呼吸有异味吗？如果是这样，消化系统和肝脏

可能需要草药支持。尿液是否浓稠且气味浓烈，或者是否有血液？尿路感染或结石是问题吗？在这些情况

下，您需要优化排尿效率，或许还需要缓解泌尿道和肾脏的炎症。

It’s impossible to ask yourself too many questions when looking for clues to the causes of a chronic skin problem.

Just remember to conduct your investigation throughout the body, focusing on the organs and systems responsible

for elimination of waste: the liver, kidneys, gallbladder, stomach and intestines, immune system, and lymph system.

If you’re having problems doing this yourself, ask your holistic vet for help.

=== PAGE 525 ===
在寻找慢性皮肤问题原因的线索时，不可能问自己太多问题。请记住对整个身体进行检查，重点关注负

责消除废物的器官和系统：肝脏、肾脏、胆囊、胃和肠、免疫系统和淋巴系统。如果您自己执行此操作时

遇到问题，请向您的整体兽医寻求帮助。

HERBAL THERAPIES

草药疗法

Since most forms of skin disease are related to poor elimination of systemic waste or immune system deficiency, a

great deal can be accomplished by supporting the liver, kidneys, lymphatic system, immune system, and digestive

functions with herbs. You should begin tonic herbal therapy while you are trying to pinpoint the actual causes of

disease. Using tonic herbs to gently support the body’s cleansing systems helps the body to heal itself. Oftentimes,

tonic alterative herbs change the course of systemic dysfunction, and the body regains its ability to deal with

whatever was triggering the skin problem. In these cases, the animal’s body finds its own cure, even though you

never identify a cause.

由于大多数形式的皮肤病都与全身废物清除不良或免疫系统缺陷有关，因此通过草药支持肝脏、肾脏、淋

巴系统、免疫系统和消化功能可以起到很大作用。当您试图查明疾病的真正原因时，您应该开始滋补草药

疗法。使用滋补草药温和地支持身体的清洁系统，有助于身体自我治愈。通常，补品替代草药可以改变全

身功能障碍的进程，使身体恢复处理引发皮肤问题的能力。在这些情况下，即使你从未找出原因，动物的

身体也会找到自己的治疗方法。

The herbs of choice for treating skin problems are stimulatory tonics and alternatives that can be used safely over

a long period as daily dietary supplements. Burdock has long been regarded as a specific alterative for treating

chronic forms of dermatitis. Cleavers improves lymph circulation, thus helping to remove waste and toxins from

body tissues. It is also a diuretic and is mildly astringent, so it reduces inflammation that may exist in the urinary

tract while encouraging elimination. Dandelion (root and leaf) is diuretic and nutritive and serves as a safe and

reliable liver stimulant. It increases bile production and gently stimulates the gallbladder and the kidneys to help

improve digestion and aid in the elimination of both solid and urine-carried wastes. Red clover helps burdock work

and adds antioxidant and immune supportive qualities to a broad spectrum of vitamins and minerals. It is generally

considered to be a blood purifier because it helps improve blood structure, which in turn allows for better transport

of waste products and toxins from the body. Garlic offers immune system support, liver support, antimicrobial

activities, and antioxidant properties. All these herbs are ingredients in the following formula for skin problems.

治疗皮肤问题所选择的草药是刺激性滋补品和替代品，可以作为日常膳食补充剂长期安全使用。牛蒡长

期以来一直被认为是治疗慢性皮炎的特殊替代品。切肉刀可以改善淋巴循环，从而有助于清除身体组织中

的废物和毒素。它也是一种利尿剂，具有轻微的收敛作用，因此它可以减少泌尿道中可能存在的炎症，同

时促进消除。蒲公英（根和叶）利尿且营养丰富，是一种安全可靠的肝脏兴奋剂。它增加胆汁的产生并温

和地刺激胆囊和肾脏，以帮助改善消化并帮助消除固体和尿液携带的废物。红三叶草有助于牛蒡发挥功

效，并为多种维生素和矿物质添加抗氧化和免疫支持特性。它通常被认为是血液净化器，因为它有助于改

善血液结构，从而更好地运输体内的废物和毒素。大蒜提供免疫系统支持、肝脏支持、抗菌活性和抗氧化

特性。所有这些草药都是以下皮肤问题配方中的成分。

As the symptoms and mechanisms of a chronic skin problem become more defined, herbs can be used to provide

added support to specific body systems in need. Herbs can also be used to relieve uncomfortable symptoms. The

ingredients of the Basic Support Formula (see box on page 287) can then be adjusted to suit special needs. For

instance, for a dog suffering from seborrhea attributed to food-borne heavy metals (a condition your holistic vet

must diagnose), a short-term regimen of yellow dock can be added to the formula to help to quickly eliminate toxic

buildups of metals or chemicals in the body. For an animal with a skin disorder associated with chronic constipation,

Oregon grape may be useful to quickly increase bile production from the liver and improve digestion and

elimination of waste, while marshmallow may also benefit the animal by lubricating the colon.

随着慢性皮肤问题的症状和机制变得更加明确，草药可以用来为有需要的特定身体系统提供额外的支

持。草药也可用于缓解不适症状。然后可以调整基本支持配方（参见第 287 页上的方框）的成分以满足特

殊需要。例如，对于因食源性重金属而患有皮脂溢的狗（您的整体兽医必须诊断出这种情况），可以在配

方中添加黄坞的短期治疗方案，以帮助快速消除金属或金属的有毒积累。体内的化学物质。对于患有与慢

性便秘相关的皮肤病的动物，俄勒冈葡萄可能有助于快速增加肝脏的胆汁分泌，改善消化和废物的排除，

而棉花糖也可能通过润滑结肠而使动物受益。

When using herbs to relieve the symptoms of disease, it’s important to keep your perspective holistic. Remember,

=== PAGE 527 ===
symptoms are valuable evidence of what’s going on within an animal’s body—don’t suppress them unless you are

finished using them to determine corrective measures for the underlying problem. For instance, if you use licorice to

relieve your companion’s inflamed skin without improving his diet, the goal of finding a curative solution will never

be reached. Dermatitis—a symptom—may be temporarily relieved with licorice, but the underlying causes cannot

be addressed unless we look at the entire problem holistically.

当使用草药缓解疾病症状时，保持整体观点很重要。请记住，症状是动物体内发生情况的宝贵证据，除

亚麻籽油、月见草油、琉璃苣籽油、鱼油或准备好的多 EFA 补充剂应按此配方喂给动物。

This formula can be used in several forms. A combination of the dried ingredients (except cleavers) can be

fed directly to an animal or sprinkled onto his food daily at a rate of 1 tablespoon per 40 pounds of the

animal’s body weight. The cleavers has to be added in the form of a liquid preparation because it oxidizes

quickly and loses its potency when dried. Therefore, 1/4 teaspoon (1 milliliter) of a glycerin-based cleavers

tincture or 2 tablespoons (30 milliliters) of strong cleavers tea should be fed in place of the dry herb for each

40 pounds of an animal’s body weight. For cats, ferrets, rabbits, birds, and other small animals, the dosage is

prorated according to the animal’s estimated weight. A parrot, for example, needs only a few drops of the

tincture each day.

该公式可以多种形式使用。干燥成分（切肉刀除外）的组合可以直接喂给动物或每天以每 40 磅动

物体重 1 汤匙的比例撒在其食物上。切肉刀必须以液体制剂的形式添加，因为它会很快氧化并在干

燥后失去效力。因此，每 40 磅体重的动物应饲喂 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升）甘油基刀酊剂或 2 汤匙（30 毫

升）浓刀刀茶来代替干药草。对于猫、雪貂、兔子、鸟类和其他小动物，剂量根据动物的估计体重

按比例分配。例如，鹦鹉每天只需要几滴酊剂。

Another option that is particularly good for horses, goats, llamas, and other herbivores is to administer the

Basic Support Formula as fresh herbs. For these large animals, a few heaping handfuls of the herb mix

=== PAGE 528 ===
should suffice each day. For rabbits and other small vegetarians, ½ cup of the mixture can be fed. If the

animal eats a portion of the serving and then stops, it might mean that he has received all he needs. Take the

remainder away. Cats, dogs, and other carnivores can be fed a raw mixture too, but keep in mind that they

may have problems swallowing the cleavers—especially if it is Galium aparine, the species most commonly

used for herbal medicine. Galium aparine has a clinging nature that causes it to stick in the throats of

animals who are not accustomed to eating live weeds. While this situation is not life threatening, it can cause

some gagging and coughing. You may choose to feed your animal a species of Galium that does not share

this characteristic, such as Northern bedstraw (Galium boreale—a common weed), or a garden variety such

as sweet woodruff, (Galium odoratum) which does not have a sticky nature.

另一种对马、山羊、美洲驼和其他食草动物特别有利的选择是将基本支持配方作为新鲜草药服

用。对于这些大型动物来说，每天抓一把草药混合物就足够了。对于兔子和其他小型素食动物，可

以喂 ½ 杯混合物。如果动物吃了一部分然后停下来，这可能意味着它已经得到了它所需要的一切。

把剩下的拿走。猫、狗和其他食肉动物也可以喂食生混合物，但请记住，它们可能在吞咽切肉刀时

遇到问题，尤其是如果它是最常用于草药的品种Galium aparine。肝素镓具有粘附性，会导致其粘在

不习惯吃活草的动物的喉咙里。虽然这种情况不会危及生命，但可能会导致一些呕吐和咳嗽。您可

以选择给您的动物喂食不具有此特性的镓品种，例如北方床草（Galium booleale - 一种常见杂草），

或花园品种，例如甜车草（Galium odoratum），它不具有粘性自然。

It’s important to remember that the intent of this formula is to assist organ functions and to optimize the

body’s absorption of needed nutrients. Providing a high-quality, natural diet is therefore paramount. It’s also

important to keep in mind that tonic herbs, being noninvasive, work only at the body’s natural pace.

Therefore, a tonic herbal therapy may take several days or even weeks to show results. Be patient, and allow

your companion’s body an opportunity to heal itself.

重要的是要记住，该配方的目的是帮助器官功能并优化身体对所需营养物质的吸收。因此，提供

高质量、天然的饮食至关重要。同样重要的是要记住，滋补草药是非侵入性的，只能按照身体的自

SEBORRHEA

皮脂溢

Seborrhea is a term that is widely used for any form of skin-related disease characterized by dry or greasy, inflamed

or itchy skin. Seborrhea may stem from any number of possibilities. At the top of the list are poor food quality and

nutritional deficiency, followed by flea- or foodrelated allergies, vaccinosis, and excessive antibiotic use. Bacterial,

fungal, viral, or parasitic (mite) infection and immune system dysfunction are also possible causes.

皮脂溢这个术语广泛用于任何形式的皮肤相关疾病，其特征是皮肤干燥或油腻、发炎或发痒。皮脂溢可能

源于多种可能性。排在首位的是食物质量差和营养缺乏，其次是跳蚤或食物相关过敏、疫苗接种和抗生素

过度使用。细菌、真菌、病毒或寄生虫（螨）感染和免疫系统功能障碍也是可能的原因。

Conventional treatment of seborrhea typically begins with the use of medicated shampoos and topical steroid and

antibiotic preparations. In cases in which clinical diagnosis identifies skin infections, these measures can bring quick

relief, but they usually do not address the reasons the skin became infected in the first place. Antibiotic and

corticosteroid therapies are often used in cases of seborrhea that do not respond to topical treatment. From a holistic

standpoint however, such measures compound the situation by inducing their own levels of systemic imbalance.

Antibiotic and steroid therapies may make the symptoms disappear, but the underlying cause continues to go

unchecked; the disease may be pushed deeper into the body and result in a much more serious disorder.

皮脂溢的传统治疗通常从使用药用洗发水和外用类固醇和抗生素制剂开始。在临床诊断发现皮肤感染的

情况下，这些措施可以快速缓解症状，但它们通常不能首先解决皮肤感染的原因。对于局部治疗无效的皮

脂溢病例，通常使用抗生素和皮质类固醇疗法。然而，从整体角度来看，这些措施会引发自身的系统性失

衡，从而使情况变得更加复杂。抗生素和类固醇疗法可能会使症状消失，但根本原因仍然得不到控制；这

种疾病可能会深入身体并导致更严重的疾病。

The holistic approach begins when we realize that seborrhea is not really a disease itself but a term used for a

variety of skin-related disorders. There is no standard herbal treatment to use for every kind of seborrhea. All forms

of chronic skin disease, however, have two things in common: all are connected to diet and all are less likely to

occur or progress in animals who have healthy waste elimination and strong immune systems.

当我们意识到皮脂溢本身并不是一种真正的疾病，而是用于描述各种皮肤相关疾病的术语时，我们就开

始采用整体方法。对于每种类型的皮脂溢，没有标准的草药治疗方法。然而，所有形式的慢性皮肤病都有

两个共同点：所有这些都与饮食有关，并且在具有健康废物消除和强大免疫系统的动物中，所有慢性皮肤

病都不太可能发生或进展。
