（基于酒精）

Thoroughly combine the three ingredients, adding just enough distilled water to make a thick paste. Then

apply the poultice to the affected areas and leave it on to dry, if possible. If licking, rolling, scratching, or

other attempts at removal are a problem, wrap the area with a cloth or a piece of gauze. Leftover poultice can

be put into an airtight container and stored in the refrigerator almost indefinitely. If it dries out, just add more

water or tincture to soften it.

将三种成分彻底混合，加入足够的蒸馏水，制成浓稠的糊状物。然后将药膏涂抹在受影响的区域，

如果可能的话，将其晾干。如果舔、滚动、刮擦或其他尝试去除有问题，请用布或纱布包裹该区

域。剩余的药膏可以放入密封容器中并几乎无限期地存放在冰箱中。如果它变干，只需添加更多的

水或酊剂来软化它。

To relieve itching and inflammation on the surface of the body, herbs with astringent and wound-healing

properties are indicated. In dogs or cats with itchy skin that exhibits little or no change of appearance, a liberal

application of oatmeal may be applied to affected areas—cook the oatmeal into a loose, wet consistency and allow it

to cool before putting it on your animal. A peppermint or lavender skin rinse is another option to help relieve

itching. If the itching is associated with minor redness, a daily skin rinse of cooled chamomile, plantain, or calendula

tea may bring relief. Completely soak the animal with the tea and allow him to drip dry. If open scratches, scabs, or

sores are visible, try combining calendula and comfrey, with sage, bee balm, thyme, or yarrow tea in equal

proportions. When cooled and used in a rinse, this mixture accelerates the healing process and helps inhibit bacterial

infection.

为了缓解身体表面的瘙痒和炎症，需要使用具有收敛和愈合伤口特性的草药。对于皮肤发痒且外观变化

很小或没有变化的狗或猫，可以在受影响的区域涂抹大量燕麦片——将燕麦片煮成松散、潮湿的稠度，待

其冷却后再涂在动物身上。薄荷或薰衣草皮肤冲洗液是另一种有助于缓解瘙痒的选择。如果瘙痒伴有轻微

发红，每天用冷却的洋甘菊、车前草或金盏花茶冲洗皮肤可能会缓解症状。将动物用茶完全浸泡并让其滴

干。如果可见开放性划痕、结痂或疮口，请尝试将金盏花和紫草与等比例的鼠尾草、蜂油、百里香或西洋

蓍草茶混合。当冷却并用于冲洗时，这种混合物可加速愈合过程并有助于抑制细菌感染。

If your companion’s condition is severe—the skin is flaky and red and scratching or chewing is continuous—

stronger astringents may be needed. A decoction of uva ursi, juniper leaf, or rose bark are strong astringents that

should serve well here. When using strong astringents on animals, proceed with caution. Dogs, cats, rabbits, ferrets,

and other small creatures have skin that is often quite sensitive. Before soaking your animal with a fluid that is

intended to tighten the skin, test it first—put a small amount on a portion of the animal’s body to make sure that

there will not be any adverse reaction. One example of a basic astringent skin rinse can be found in the box on page

288.

如果你同伴的情况很严重——皮肤呈片状、发红，并且持续抓挠或咀嚼——可能需要更强的收敛剂。熊

果、杜松叶或玫瑰皮的汤剂是强效收敛剂，在这里应该很有效。对动物使用强力收敛剂时，请务必小心。

狗、猫、兔子、雪貂和其他小动物的皮肤通常非常敏感。在用收紧皮肤的液体浸泡动物之前，请先进行测

试 - 将少量液体涂在动物身体的一部分上，以确保不会出现任何不良反应。第 288 页的包装盒中提供了一

种基本收敛性皮肤冲洗剂的示例。

Birds have especially tender skin, and rinses consisting of strong astringents should be avoided in most cases.

Sage, bee balm, or peppermint tea often work well in a birdbath. (Sage may help eliminate mites as well as relieve

itching.) Add a dilute concentration of the tea to a bowl of clean, chlorine-free water (just enough to tint the water)

and place it in the cage. Most birds enjoy taking an occasional bath, especially if they’re itchy!

鸟类的皮肤特别娇嫩，在大多数情况下应避免使用强收敛剂的冲洗液。鼠尾草、蜂香膏或薄荷茶通常在

水盆中效果很好。 （鼠尾草可能有助于消除螨虫并缓解瘙痒。）将稀释浓度的茶加入一碗干净的无氯水中

（足以使水着色），然后将其放入笼子中。大多数鸟儿喜欢偶尔洗澡，尤其是当它们发痒的时候！

If an established bacterial infection is evident (an area is swollen and red, and sores are discharging pus), internal

doses of echinacea tincture can be coupled with external applications of echinacea and Oregon grape (or organically

farmed goldenseal) powder, tincture, salve, or ointment at the sites of infection. This boosts immune system

=== PAGE 534 ===
response to the infection while adding direct antibacterial intervention. Another effective option for treating isolated

infections of the skin is an echinacea and Oregon grape clay poultice, which is discussed in detail below.

如果明显存在细菌感染（局部肿胀、发红，疮口流脓），可内服紫锥菊酊剂，并外用紫锥菊和俄勒冈葡

萄（或有机种植的毛茛）粉末、酊剂、药膏、或在感染部位涂药膏。这增强了免疫系统对感染的反应，同

时增加了直接的抗菌干预。治疗皮肤孤立感染的另一种有效选择是紫锥菊和俄勒冈葡萄粘土膏剂，下文将

详细讨论。

In cases in which itching and inflammation are severe, internal doses of licorice may bring relief by boosting

production of corticosteroids in the body and lending direct anti-inflammatory activities to the effort. But licorice

may not be a good choice in chronic, perhaps inherited skin disorders that require continuous long-term treatment

because of its possible side effects. In these cases, herbal treatment is limited to nutritional support and topical relief

measures.

在瘙痒和炎症严重的情况下，内服甘草可以通过促进体内皮质类固醇的产生并提供直接的抗炎活性来缓

解症状。但对于慢性遗传性皮肤病来说，甘草可能不是一个好的选择，因为它可能有副作用，需要持续长

期治疗。在这些情况下，草药治疗仅限于营养支持和局部缓解措施。

If the animal has a fever, a good possibility exists that the infection has moved into the body, meaning it’s time to

call your veterinarian immediately.

如果动物发烧，很可能感染已转移到体内，这意味着需要立即致电兽医。

=== PAGE 535 ===
PYODERMA

脓皮病

The term pyoderma refers to infections of the skin that are characterized by the presence of subsurface pus. Most

often, pyoderma is caused by foreign bodies such as splinters, insect bites or stings, fleas, or mites that have entered

the skin and caused infection. In these cases, basic first aid or antiparasitic measures usually solve the problem. But

in cases where pyoderma is secondary to systemic disease or dysfunction, its presence may indicate a serious, even

life-threatening, condition. The possible causes range from a minor nutritional deficiency or allergy to inherited or

acquired metabolic dysfunctions, autoimmune disease or deficiency (including lupus, pemphigus, vasculitis), viral

infection (including FeLV and FIV), hormonal imbalances, parasitic infections, long-term steroid therapies, and

even cancer. The potential seriousness of pyoderma-related illnesses is testament to the value and importance of

requiring a full holistic examination of your companion, his diet, and his environment.

术语脓皮病是指以存在皮下脓液为特征的皮肤感染。最常见的是，脓皮病是由异物引起的，例如碎片、昆

虫叮咬或叮咬、跳蚤或螨虫进入皮肤并引起感染。在这些情况下，基本的急救或抗寄生虫措施通常可以解

决问题。但如果脓皮病继发于全身性疾病或功能障碍，则其存在可能表明病情严重，甚至危及生命。可能

的原因包括轻微的营养缺乏或过敏、遗传性或后天性代谢功能障碍、自身免疫性疾病或缺陷（包括狼疮、

天疱疮、血管炎）、病毒感染（包括 FeLV 和 FIV）、荷尔蒙失衡、寄生虫感染、长期类固醇疗法，甚至癌

症。脓皮病相关疾病的潜在严重性证明了对您的伴侣、他的饮食和环境进行全面全面检查的价值和重要

性。

Diet and nutrition, as you may have guessed, are the first factors to consider in treating any pyoderma-related

disorder of internal origin. Herbal therapies should start with tonic support. The Basic Support Formula (see page

287) offers a good start. In severe cases, perhaps where acnelike pustules erupt on the chin of a cat and begin to

spread to other parts of the body, a safe but aggressive systemic detoxification therapy might be indicated. This

might include diuretic herbs such as dandelion leaf; liver stimulants such as yellow dock, Oregon grape, and

turmeric; and blood-cleansing alternatives such as red clover and alfalfa. Liver-regenerating herbs such as milk

thistle and licorice may be useful as well, especially in cases in which chemical-induced liver damage is a suspected

cause. Marshmallow root may help to ease the movement of waste through the colon. Psyllium husks added to the

animal’s food as per the supplement manufacturer’s directions may also assist with the passing of waste.

正如您可能已经猜到的那样，饮食和营养是治疗任何与脓皮病相关的内源性疾病时首先要考虑的因素。

草药疗法应从滋补支持开始。基本支持公式（参见第 287 页）提供了一个良好的开端。在严重的情况下，

也许猫的下巴上出现痤疮样脓疱并开始扩散到身体的其他部位，可能需要采取安全但积极的全身排毒疗

法。这可能包括利尿草药，例如蒲公英叶；肝脏兴奋剂，如黄坞、俄勒冈葡萄和姜黄；以及红三叶草和苜

蓿等净化血液的替代品。水飞蓟和甘草等肝脏再生草药也可能有用，特别是在怀疑化学物质引起的肝损伤

的情况下。药蜀葵根可能有助于缓解废物通过结肠的移动。按照补充剂制造商的说明添加到动物食物中的

车前子壳也可能有助于排出废物。

In addition to supporting the liver, kidneys, and digestive system, it’s important to thoroughly evaluate and

support the animal’s immune system. Clinical blood and urine tests may be useful here, as will the experience of a

holistic veterinarian. If a determination is made that the immune system needs stimulation, echinacea or astragalus

may prove beneficial. If immune deficiency is compounded by viral infection, liver damage, or inflammation,

licorice may serve as a useful adjunct. It’s important to note, however, that immune system stimulation may not

always be a good idea in the treatment of autoimmune disease in which the body’s immune system is working

against itself, such as with lupus erythematosus. Again, you are advised to consult your veterinarian before

proceeding.

除了支持肝脏、肾脏和消化系统之外，彻底评估和支持动物的免疫系统也很重要。临床血液和尿液测试

以及整体兽医的经验在这里可能有用。如果确定免疫系统需要刺激，紫锥菊或黄芪可能是有益的。如果病

毒感染、肝损伤或炎症导致免疫缺陷，那么甘草可能是一种有用的辅助药物。然而，值得注意的是，在治

疗自身免疫性疾病时，刺激免疫系统可能并不总是一个好主意，在这种疾病中，身体的免疫系统会对抗自

身，例如红斑狼疮。再次强调，建议您在继续之前咨询您的兽医。

External discomforts can be relieved with the same astringent and anti-inflammatory herbs that are used for

=== PAGE 536 ===
seborrhea. Aloe gel or a plantain or chickweed poultice may bring soothing relief as well. For cases in which

pyoderma is limited to just a few isolated areas of the body, an herb-clay poultice can be especially effective at

relieving itching, inhibiting bacteria and fungi, and pulling infection toward the surface of the body. When applied

to the skin, the green or bentonite clay used for the poultice (or paste) naturally pulls fluid and waste products

toward itself, while lending its own itch-relieving astringent activities and a diversity of mineral nutrients to the skin.

As pathogenic microbes are drawn toward the clay, they are confronted with antimicrobial herb constituents that

inhibit their reproduction.

使用与治疗皮脂溢相同的收敛和抗炎草药可以缓解外部不适。芦荟凝胶、大蕉或繁缕膏也可以带来舒缓

效果。对于脓皮病仅限于身体少数孤立区域的情况，草药粘土膏剂在缓解瘙痒、抑制细菌和真菌以及将感

染拉向身体表面方面特别有效。当涂抹到皮肤上时，用于膏剂（或糊剂）的绿色粘土或膨润土会自然地将

液体和废物拉向自身，同时为皮肤提供其自身的止痒收敛活性和多种矿物质营养。当病原微生物被吸引向

粘土时，它们会遇到抑制其繁殖的抗菌药草成分。

This clay poultice is an excellent first aid remedy for venomous and nonvenomous bites and stings as well. Be

aware that the bentonite clay sold at hardware and feed stores often contains harmful bacteria and other impurities.

Alcohol tinctures are preferable to glycerin because they add astringency to the formula and serve as preservatives in

a poultice that is saved for future use.

这种粘土膏剂对于有毒和无毒的咬伤和蜇伤也是一种极好的急救药物。请注意，五金店和饲料店出售的

膨润土通常含有有害细菌和其他杂质。酒精酊剂比甘油更可取，因为它们会增加配方的涩味，并在保存以

备将来使用的膏剂中充当防腐剂。

CONTACT DERMATITIS

接触性皮炎

Contact dermatitis is caused when an irritating substance, organism, or allergen contacts or damages the outer

surface of the skin. The onset of symptoms can be immediate or delayed for hours or even days.

当刺激性物质、生物体或过敏原接触或损伤皮肤外表面时会引起接触性皮炎。症状可能立即出现，也可能

延迟数小时甚至数天。

Contact dermatitis can appear in many forms—from what appears to be a hot, pink-flushed spot of skin to raised

wheals, blisters, and ulcers that cover the animal’s body.

接触性皮炎可以以多种形式出现——从皮肤上出现粉红色的发热斑点到覆盖动物身体的凸起的风团、水

泡和溃疡。

In dogs and cats, the most common form of contact dermatitis occurs as the result of fleabites. Treatment in these

cases begins with examining why the animal is so hypersensitive to the bites and then continues by working to make

the environments of these pesky critters less hospitable.

在狗和猫中，最常见的接触性皮炎是由跳蚤引起的。对这些病例的治疗首先要检查为什么动物对叮咬如

此敏感，然后继续努力使这些讨厌的动物的环境变得不那么适宜。

Symptomatic relief can be provided by applying astringent skin rinses (see “Seborrhea”). A skin rinse of grindelia

is considered a specific remedy for dermatitis caused by contact with poison ivy or poison oak. Jewelweed

(Impatiens capensis ), a plant native to eastern and central North America, has also been long regarded as a remedy

for poison ivy. The tea of this herb is taken internally by humans, but its safety and effectiveness in animals are

unknown. Alterative and diuretic herbs such as burdock root and dandelion leaf may be fed in tea or whole form to

help the body eliminate antigenic compounds that may be contributing to the itch and inflammation.

使用收敛性皮肤冲洗液可以缓解症状（参见“皮脂溢”）。银杏叶冲洗液被认为是治疗因接触毒葛或毒橡

树而引起的皮炎的特效疗法。宝石草（Impatiens capensis）是一种原产于北美东部和中部的植物，长期以来

也被认为是治疗毒葛的药物。这种草药的茶可供人类内服，但其对动物的安全性和有效性尚不清楚。牛蒡

根和蒲公英叶等替代和利尿草药可以以茶或整体形式喂食，以帮助身体消除可能导致瘙痒和炎症的抗原化

合物。

=== PAGE 538 ===
SEBACEOUS CYSTS

皮脂囊肿

Sebaceous cysts are lesions involving the ducts leading from sebaceous glands to their associated hair follicles. They

are generally caused by obstruction of the ducts and appear as semisolid, freely moving lumps beneath the skin.

皮脂囊肿是涉及从皮脂腺通向相关毛囊的导管的病变。它们通常是由导管阻塞引起的，表现为皮下半固

体、自由移动的肿块。

A natural raw food diet is the best prevention. If an animal does get a sebaceous cyst, administering some herbs

that help the body eliminate more easily might be in order. Herbs that assist lymphatic drainage, such as cleavers,

red clover, calendula, and burdock may help.

天然生食饮食是最好的预防措施。如果动物确实患有皮脂腺囊肿，可能需要服用一些有助于身体更容易

排泄的草药。有助于淋巴引流的草药，如菜刀、红三叶草、金盏花和牛蒡可能会有帮助。

A SYSTEMIC DETOXIFYING FORMULA FOR DOGS, CATS,

HORSES, AND GOATS

适用于狗、猫、马和山羊的全身排毒配方

Combine the following:

结合以下内容：

2 parts dandelion leaf

2 份 蒲公英叶

2 parts yellow dock root

2 份 黄色坞根

2 parts red clover

2份红三叶草

1 part licorice root

1 份 甘草根

2 parts marshmallow

2 份 棉花糖

For dogs and cats, a glycerin-based tincture is the best form of application for this detoxifying formula.

Yellow dock is bitter, and the sweet flavor of vegetable glycerin aids in administration. Feeding about 1/4

teaspoon (1 milliliter) of the combined tincture twice daily for each 20 pounds of an animal’s body weight is

usually sufficient to stimulate elimination. For best results, feed the tincture directly into the animal’s mouth.

If this isn’t possible, try diluting the tincture with water. As a last resort, add it to the animal’s food. This

formula should not be used continuously for more than seven days.

对于狗和猫来说，甘油酊剂是这种排毒配方的最佳应用形式。黄坞味苦，植物甘油的甜味有助于给

药。每 20 磅体重的动物每天喂食两次约 1/4 茶匙（1 毫升）的混合酊剂通常足以刺激排泄。为了获

得最佳效果，请将酊剂直接喂入动物的嘴里。如果不可能，请尝试用水稀释酊剂。作为最后的手

段，将其添加到动物的食物中。本方连续使用不宜超过7天。

=== PAGE 539 ===
Horses, goats, sheep, llamas, and other large herbivores can be fed this formula in fresh or dried, whole-

herb form—if they’ll eat it. Horses will probably need 3–6 cups of the herbs each day, whereas goats, sheep,

and llamas may need only 1½–3 cups. If direct feeding is not possible, try feeding everything but the yellow

dock, then administer this bitter herb later in the form of tincture (prorate the tincture’s dosage to the amount

the animal would receive in the formula).

马、山羊、绵羊、美洲驼和其他大型食草动物可以用新鲜或干燥的全药草形式喂养这种配方——

如果它们愿意吃的话。马每天可能需要 3-6 杯草药，而山羊、绵羊和美洲驼可能只需要 1.5-3 杯。如

果无法直接喂养，请尝试喂养除黄码头以外的所有东西，然后以酊剂的形式施用这种苦味药草（将

酊剂的剂量按动物在配方中接受的量按比例分配）。

The idea behind this detoxifying formula is to stimulate gentle elimination of waste from the liver and

digestive organs, not to drain your animal. If vomiting occurs, discontinue use immediately. Stools should be

soft but not watery and gushing on passage. Likewise, the animal should not show any signs of gastric

discomfort such as griping, distention, or odd sounds coming from the stomach. If this occurs, reduce the

dose by one-half or discontinue use—the digestive system is stimulated enough and a different approach is

warranted. On the other hand, if your animal has been constipated and is not finding relief from this formula,

then the dosage can be increased in increments of 10 percent per feeding until stools appear soft or until the

equivalent of one and one-half times the original dose is reached. After that, if results are not seen within two

days, discontinue use—this formula is probably not going to work for your animal.

这种排毒配方背后的想法是刺激肝脏和消化器官中废物的温和消除，而不是排干你的动物。如果

发生呕吐，请立即停止使用。大便应该是软的，但不应该是水样的并且在排便时不流淌。同样，动

物不应表现出任何胃部不适的迹象，例如胃部绞痛、腹胀或发出奇怪的声音。如果发生这种情况，

请将剂量减少一半或停止使用——消化系统受到足够的刺激，需要采取不同的方法。另一方面，如

果您的动物患有便秘并且该配方没有缓解症状，则每次喂食的剂量可以以 10% 的增量增加，直到大

便变软或直到相当于原来的一倍半剂量已达到。之后，如果两天内没有看到结果，请停止使用 - 该

配方可能对您的动物不起作用。

This detoxifying formula should not be given continuously for more than ten days without the supervision

of a qualified practitioner. It should not be used in pregnant animals or in those with a history of urinary

stones or preexisting kidney disease. All of this is because of the oxalic acid contained in yellow dock. When

used over a long period of time, oxalic acid can be irritating to the urinary system, and it may contribute to

the formation of kidney or bladder stones.

在没有合格执业医师的监督下，这种排毒配方不应连续服用超过十天。它不应用于怀孕动物或有

尿路结石或既往有肾脏疾病病史的动物。这一切都是因为黄坞中含有草酸。长期使用时，草酸会刺

激泌尿系统，并可能导致肾结石或膀胱结石的形成。

URINARY PROBLEMS

泌尿问题

You may notice that your companion is drinking more and urinating less, urinating in unusual places, or straining

while urinating. Blood or other discharge may be visible in the urine, redness and inflammation may be evident at or

around the animal’s urethra, or urine may be dark or especially odorous. If discomfort is evident when the lower

abdomen or the area immediately behind the rib cage is gently palpated with fingertips, your companion may have

an infection or inflammation of the bladder or kidneys. While these are all physical signs of a urinary tract disorder,

holistic care of an animal’s urinary system requires a level of attentiveness beyond mere recognition of such

symptoms.

您可能会注意到您的同伴喝得更多，排尿更少，在不寻常的地方排尿，或者排尿时用力。尿液中可能会出

现血液或其他分泌物，动物尿道处或周围可能会出现明显的发红和炎症，或者尿液可能呈深色或特别有气

味。如果用指尖轻轻触诊下腹部或紧邻胸廓后方的区域时感到明显不适，则您的伴侣可能患有膀胱或肾脏

感染或炎症。虽然这些都是泌尿道疾病的体征，但对动物泌尿系统的整体护理需要一定程度的关注，而不

仅仅是识别这些症状。

The urinary system is a delicately balanced arrangement of organs and body chemistries that serve a critical

purpose of eliminating potentially toxic compounds from the body. The elimination process begins with the kidneys,

which are responsible for separating waste material from the blood and delivering it via the ureters to the bladder.

The bladder then holds the urine until it is released from the body via the urethra. This system sounds simple but is

actually complex when we consider the special nutritive, chemical, and structural requirements of the individual

organs. The kidneys are fragile, oxygen-dependent organs with a low tolerance to stress. They work in concert with

the digestive tract, liver, and circulatory system, and they are easily damaged if the relationships between these

systems become compromised. For instance, if the liver is deficient in its job of removing dietary and systemic

waste via the digestive tract, the kidneys and urinary tract suffer from the stress of handling waste products that they

are not designed to handle. The result can be kidney failure, stones, inflammation, or infection. Adding to the

holistic complexity of this system is the fact that it is largely made up of smooth-muscle structures, unique vascular

arrangements, and mucous membranes that require a special diversity of nutrients and precise chemical balances to

remain healthy and functional.

泌尿系统是器官和身体化学物质的微妙平衡排列，其关键目的是消除体内潜在的有毒化合物。消除过程

从肾脏开始，肾脏负责从血液中分离废物，并通过输尿管将其输送到膀胱。然后膀胱储存尿液，直到尿液

通过尿道排出体外。当我们考虑到各个器官的特殊营养、化学和结构要求时，这个系统听起来很简单，但

实际上很复杂。肾脏是脆弱的、依赖氧气的器官，对压力的耐受性较低。它们与消化道、肝脏和循环系统

协同工作，如果这些系统之间的关系受到损害，它们很容易受损。例如，如果肝脏无法通过消化道清除饮

食和全身废物，那么肾脏和泌尿道就会承受处理废物的压力，而这些废物本来就不适合处理。结果可能是

肾衰竭、结石、炎症或感染。增加该系统整体复杂性的事实是，它主要由平滑肌结构、独特的血管排列和

粘膜组成，需要特殊的营养多样性和精确的化学平衡才能保持健康和功能。

The most effective way to treat or prevent urinary system illness is to recognize your animal’s needs before

physical symptoms of disease are obvious. Sometimes our companions have strange ways of telling us that they

don’t feel well. They may start spraying the wall or our favorite clothes. Such behavior may be related to an

emotional problem, but it may also mean that our friends are trying to tell us that something is seriously wrong

physically. Don’t ignore or write off sudden bad behavior as neurosis—the situation could be quite serious.

治疗或预防泌尿系统疾病的最有效方法是在疾病的身体症状明显之前认识到动物的需求。有时，我们的

同伴会用奇怪的方式告诉我们他们感觉不舒服。他们可能会开始喷洒墙壁或我们最喜欢的衣服。这种行为

可能与情绪问题有关，但也可能意味着我们的朋友试图告诉我们身体出现了严重的问题。不要忽视或将突

然出现的不良行为视为神经症——情况可能会非常严重。

Effective holistic treatment of urinary disease starts with a critical assessment of the animal’s diet. Usually

infection, stones, or kidney failure is the progressive result of a nutritional excess, deficiency, or metabolic

=== PAGE 541 ===
imbalance. It’s well known among clinicians and researchers that animals who receive a balanced natural diet

seldom suffer from urinary system ailments.

泌尿系统疾病的有效整体治疗始于对动物饮食的严格评估。通常，感染、结石或肾衰竭是营养过剩、缺

乏或代谢失衡的渐进结果。临床医生和研究人员众所周知，接受均衡天然饮食的动物很少患有泌尿系统疾

病。

When using herbs to treat urinary problems, teas and tinctures are the best forms of preparation. The goal is to get

the active constituents of a plant into the urine, and the best way to do this is to bypass as much of the digestive

system as possible with a liquid solution fed on an empty stomach. Following are some of the more common

treatments for urinary ailments we face as animal caregivers.

当使用草药治疗泌尿系统问题时，茶和酊剂是最好的制剂形式。目标是让植物的活性成分进入尿液，而

做到这一点的最佳方法是空腹喂食液体溶液，尽可能绕过消化系统。以下是我们作为动物护理人员面临的

一些更常见的泌尿系统疾病的治疗方法。

=== PAGE 542 ===
BLADDER AND KIDNEY STONES (UROLITHIASIS)

膀胱结石和肾结石（尿石症）

Like most forms of urinary disease, stones (sometimes called gravel or crystals) are the by-products of metabolic

dysfunction or poor diet. They are associated with the body’s inability to effectively metabolize calcium,

magnesium, ammonium, or other minerals. Many of the minerals that form stones are essential nutrients in a

balanced diet, but they must be received by a healthy balanced body in a readily usable form. It’s important to know

that excess minerals that the body cannot use must be eliminated through the digestive and urinary tracts.

与大多数形式的泌尿系统疾病一样，结石（有时称为砾石或晶体）是代谢功能障碍或不良饮食的副产品。

它们与身体无法有效代谢钙、镁、铵或其他矿物质有关。许多形成结石的矿物质是均衡饮食中的必需营养

素，但它们必须以易于使用的形式被健康均衡的身体吸收。重要的是要知道身体无法利用的多余矿物质必

须通过消化道和泌尿道排出。

Stones are formed when urine pH levels or other chemical factors cause the minerals to bind and form crystals,

which in turn build upon each other to create solid structures known as uroliths. Uroliths are most likely to occur in

the bladder, but they sometimes form in the kidneys. Exposure to cadmium is also known to increase the formation

of stones. The most common source of cadmium exposure for animals is cigarette smoke.

当尿液 pH 值或其他化学因素导致矿物质结合并形成晶体时，结石就会形成，晶体又相互堆积形成称为尿

石的固体结构。尿石最有可能发生在膀胱中，但有时也会在肾脏中形成。众所周知，接触镉也会增加结石

的形成。动物最常见的镉暴露来源是香烟烟雾。

To remain clean and free of harmful bacteria, the urinary tract must continually flush itself. If an animal’s urethra

is blocked by one or more uroliths, uremia, a potentially life-threatening condition, can result. If a ureter is blocked,

kidney damage may occur and progress quickly after the onset of symptoms. Even if the animal’s condition appears

stable and nonprogressive, urolithiasis creates an environment in the urinary system in which impeded waste

elimination may lead to infectious growth of harmful bacteria and fungi. Urolithiasis is especially common in cats,

but dogs and other animals may suffer from stones as well.

为了保持清洁且没有有害细菌，尿道必须不断自我冲洗。如果动物的尿道被一个或多个尿石堵塞，可能

会导致尿毒症，这是一种可能危及生命的疾病。如果输尿管阻塞，可能会发生肾脏损害，并在症状出现后

迅速进展。即使动物的病情看起来稳定且非进展，尿石症也会在泌尿系统中产生一种环境，在这种环境

中，废物排除受阻可能会导致有害细菌和真菌的感染性生长。尿石症在猫中尤其常见，但狗和其他动物也

可能患有结石。

=== PAGE 543 ===
Marshmallow has many qualities that make it a first-choice herb for treating kidney and bladder stones.

棉花糖具有许多品质，使其成为治疗肾结石和膀胱结石的首选草药。

Balanced nutrition is paramount in the effective treatment and prevention of urinary stones. A positive change in

diet often equates to a long-term cure. Many types of urinary stones dissolve when urine chemistry is corrected

through a change of diet. However, some types of stones such as calcium oxalate uroliths must either be eliminated

through the urethra via urination (an often long and painful process) or be surgically removed (depending on the size

and number of the stones).

均衡营养对于有效治疗和预防尿路结石至关重要。饮食的积极改变通常等同于长期治愈。当通过改变饮

食来纠正尿液化学成分时，许多类型的尿路结石就会溶解。然而，某些类型的结石，例如草酸钙尿石，必

须通过排尿通过尿道排出（通常是一个漫长而痛苦的过程），或者通过手术切除（取决于结石的大小和数

量）。

The holistic herbal approach toward urinary system infection or stones must always start with a thorough dietary

evaluation. After that, the primary objectives are to assist the body in eliminating the stones, to help moderate urine

pH (which is normally slightly acidic) with diuretic and demulcent herbs, and to inhibit infection and reduce the

painful inflammation that makes urination difficult by treating with with antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory herbs.

针对泌尿系统感染或结石的整体草药方法必须始终从彻底的饮食评估开始。之后，主要目标是帮助身体

消除结石，用利尿剂和缓和药草帮助调节尿液 pH 值（通常呈微酸性），并通过治疗抑制感染和减少导致排

尿困难的疼痛性炎症。含有抗菌和抗炎草药。

In all cases (whether the stones are in the kidneys or the bladder), our approach begins with a thick, alcohol-free

liquid preparation of marshmallow. The slippery oily mucilage of a cooled marshmallow tea or glycerite provides a

protective lubricating barrier on swollen mucous membranes, thus assisting with the passage of stones.

Marshmallow also has mild astringent qualities and antimicrobial properties that join to reduce inflammation and

help inhibit bacterial growth in the healing process. Plantain serves similar purposes but is less mucilaginous than

marshmallow and has a slightly higher astringency. This makes it appropriate in cases in which the urethral

inflammation from the passage of gravel is causing pain and strain during urination. Gravel root is another

traditional option worth considering.

在所有情况下（无论结石是在肾脏还是膀胱），我们的方法都是从浓稠的、不含酒精的棉花糖液体制剂

开始。冷却的棉花糖茶或甘油的滑滑油性粘液为肿胀的粘膜提供保护性润滑屏障，从而有助于结石通过。

棉花糖还具有温和的收敛特性和抗菌特性，可以减少炎症并有助于抑制愈合过程中的细菌生长。车前草具

=== PAGE 544 ===
有类似的用途，但粘液性低于棉花糖，并且涩味稍高。这使得它适用于砾石通道引起的尿道炎症导致排尿

时疼痛和紧张的情况。砾石根是另一个值得考虑的传统选择。

In cases in which minor urinary bleeding is present and bladder or kidney inflammation persists, couch grass and

corn silk serve as good anti-inflammatories. If significant bleeding is occurring in the bladder but clinical evaluation

has determined that kidney function remains strong and kidney inflammation is not evident, stronger hemostatic and

astringent herbs such as horsetail, uva ursi, and yarrow can be added to marshmallow to help stop the hemorrhage. If

the kidneys are inflamed, however, these herbs may be contraindicated, and couch grass or shepherd’s purse make

better options.

如果存在轻微尿出血且膀胱或肾脏炎症持续存在，沙发草和玉米须可以起到良好的抗炎作用。如果膀胱

出现大量出血，但临床评估确定肾功能仍然强大且肾脏炎症不明显，则可以在棉花糖中添加更强的止血和

收敛草药，例如木贼，熊果和西洋蓍草，以帮助止血。然而，如果肾脏发炎，这些草药可能是禁忌的，而

茅草或荠菜是更好的选择。

Diuretic herbs such as dandelion leaf and cleavers are indicated in cases in which urination has not been severely

obstructed because they help to dilute the urine and assist the body in its efforts to flush stones and bacteria out of

the urinary tract. Keep in mind that if urination is obstructed, strong diuretics may compound the situation because

the increased urine volume may cause added pressure upon the kidneys. If urine backs up into the kidneys, a life-

threatening infection can result. See your veterinarian immediately.

蒲公英叶和菜刀等利尿草药适用于排尿未严重受阻的情况，因为它们有助于稀释尿液并协助身体将结石

和细菌冲出尿道。请记住，如果排尿受阻，强效利尿剂可能会使情况变得更加复杂，因为尿量增加可能会

导致肾脏压力增加。如果尿液回流到肾脏，可能会导致危及生命的感染。立即去看兽医。

Antimicrobial herbs should be used as a preventive measure against infection, especially in circumstances in

which urination is inhibited. Echinacea serves this purpose well. Oregon grape or certified organic goldenseal is

useful for fighting bacteria and serve as effective anti-inflammatory agents in the bladder as well. If overly acidic

urine is part of the problem, mullein leaf tea may help bring pH levels back toward normal. Mullein leaf also has

diuretic and antimicrobial properties.

应使用抗菌草药作为感染的预防措施，尤其是在排尿受到抑制的情况下。紫锥菊很好地满足了这个目

的。俄勒冈葡萄或经过认证的有机金印草可有效对抗细菌，并可作为膀胱中有效的抗炎剂。如果尿液过酸

是问题的一部分，毛蕊花茶可能有助于使 pH 值恢复正常。毛蕊花叶还具有利尿和抗菌特性。

=== PAGE 545 ===
URINARY SYSTEM INFECTIONS (CYSTITIS)

泌尿系统感染（膀胱炎）

Bacterial infection of the urinary tract is the most common infectious disease of dogs. At least 10 percent of all dogs

seen by veterinarians for any reason have a urinary tract infection. Symptoms may include fever, lethargy, backache,

painful urination (dysuria), frequent urination, and blood in the urine (hematuria). Causes are varied, but from a

holistic perspective the underlying question is always the same: Why was the animal’s body unable to effectively

ward off the infection in the first place?

泌尿道细菌感染是犬最常见的传染病。无论出于何种原因，兽医见过的所有狗中至少有 10% 患有尿路感

染。症状可能包括发烧、嗜睡、背痛、排尿疼痛（排尿困难）、尿频和尿中带血（血尿）。原因多种多

样，但从整体角度来看，根本问题始终是相同的：为什么动物的身体首先无法有效抵御感染？

In many cases, this question leads us back to diet, but other causes include immunological deficiency or bacterial,

fungal, or protozoan infection from bad water or food. Bladder stones, injury, or tumors may also be contributing

factors. In all cases, the focus of symptomatic herbal treatment is fundamentally the same—to assist the body at

repelling the infection-causing entities, relieve inflammation and discomfort, dilute urine, and encourage urination.

在许多情况下，这个问题会让我们回到饮食上，但其他原因包括免疫缺陷或由坏水或食物引起的细菌、

真菌或原生动物感染。膀胱结石、损伤或肿瘤也可能是促成因素。在所有情况下，对症草药治疗的重点基

本上都是相同的——帮助身体排斥引起感染的实体，缓解炎症和不适，稀释尿液并促进排尿。

Urinary tract infections may be caused by various forms of bacteria, fungi, or parasites that have entered the body

through the mouth or urethra. Feline lower urinary tract disease, or FLUTD (formerly known as feline urinary

syndrome, or FUS), is a nonspecific inflammatory problem that occurs in the bladder and urethra of cats. It is a

chronic form of cystitis characterized by high pH (excessively alkaline) urine. Tiny, sharpedged, struvite crystals

form in the lower urinary tract and adhere to the walls of the bladder and urethra, causing inflammation and

blockage. If left unchecked, they can develop into larger stones and cause severe and obstructive inflammatory

disease of the entire urinary system. A cat with FLUTD has an urge to urinate frequently, but because urine output is

greatly diminished by inflammation and accumulated crystals, he may be able to force out only a few drops at a

time. This is a very dangerous situation—if urine backs up in the ureters and into the kidneys, irreversible kidney

damage can result quickly.

尿路感染可能是由通过口腔或尿道进入体内的各种细菌、真菌或寄生虫引起的。猫下尿路疾病

（FLUTD）（以前称为猫尿路综合征（FUS））是一种发生在猫的膀胱和尿道中的非特异性炎症问题。它

是一种慢性膀胱炎，其特征是尿液 pH 值过高（过碱性）。微小的、锋利的鸟粪石晶体在下尿道中形成，并

粘附在膀胱和尿道壁上，引起炎症和阻塞。如果不加以控制，它们可能会发展成更大的结石，并导致整个

泌尿系统严重的阻塞性炎症性疾病。患有 FLUTD 的猫有频繁排尿的冲动，但由于炎症和积累的晶体大大减

少了尿量，因此他一次只能排出几滴。这是一种非常危险的情况——如果尿液回流到输尿管并进入肾脏，

很快就会造成不可逆转的肾脏损伤。

Diet must be closely scrutinized as a primary cause of FLUTD. Because cats are carnivores, they should receive a

large part of their daily water intake in the form of juicy raw meat. The process of metabolizing raw meat is essential

to the maintenance of healthy feline urine pH levels. When cats must subsist on a dry-food diet, their systems must

perform metabolic tasks that are beyond their natural design. Urine pH levels may become severely imbalanced,

setting the stage for stone formation and bacterial reproduction. In fact, studies conducted at Cornell University

strongly suggest that free-feeding dry foods may predispose cats to FUS. We along with a large percentage of

veterinarians agree. Also, setting mealtimes is better than free-feeding. A cat or dog who is able to snack and nibble

all day long is more likely to get a urinary infection, especially if the food is out of a bag or can.

饮食必须作为 FLUTD 的主要原因进行严格审查。因为猫是肉食动物，所以它们每天摄入的水的很大一部

分应该以多汁的生肉的形式摄入。生肉的代谢过程对于维持健康的猫尿液 pH 值至关重要。当猫必须靠干粮

生存时，它们的系统必须执行超出其自然设计的代谢任务。尿液 pH 值可能会严重失衡，为结石形成和细菌

繁殖创造条件。事实上，康奈尔大学进行的研究强烈表明，自由喂养干粮可能会使猫容易患 FUS。我们和

很大一部分兽医都同意这一点。此外，设定进餐时间比自由喂养更好。整天吃零食的猫或狗更有可能患上

泌尿道感染，尤其是当食物是从袋子或罐头里拿出来的时候。

=== PAGE 546 ===
The best advice for preventing FLUTD is this: If for whatever reason you cannot feed a raw food diet to your cat,

avoid dry kibble and feed a premium-quality, all-natural canned food to prevent your cat from developing urinary

problems. If your feline friend is already suffering from FLUTD, adjust or change his diet and take him to a vet to

determine whether his kidneys have been compromised. If they haven’t, the problem can be symptomatically

approached as a case of cystitis with astringent anti-inflammatory herbs such as uva ursi or pipsissewa combined

with the soothing mucilaginous properties of marshmallow and the disinfectant qualities of echinacea, garlic,

Oregon grape, or yarrow. If kidney involvement is evident, herbs with high concentrations of tannins or strong

volatile oils should be avoided. In such cases, corn silk, couch grass, plantain, nettle, shepherd’s purse, or raspberry

leaf serves as a safer astringent.

预防 FLUTD 的最佳建议是：如果出于某种原因您无法给您的猫喂食生食，请避免干粗粮并喂食优质的全

天然罐头食品，以防止您的猫出现泌尿系统问题。如果你的猫朋友已经患有 FLUTD，请调整或改变他的饮

食，并带他去看兽医，以确定他的肾脏是否受到损害。如果没有，可以将问题视为膀胱炎，使用收敛性抗

炎草药（如熊果或pipsissewa）结合棉花糖的舒缓粘液特性以及紫锥花、大蒜、俄勒冈葡萄或葡萄的消毒特

性来解决问题。西洋蓍草。如果肾脏受累明显，应避免使用含有高浓度单宁或强挥发油的草药。在这种情

况下，玉米须、茅草、车前草、荨麻、荠菜或覆盆子叶是更安全的收敛剂。

Some people and animals find relief from cystitis with cranberry juice or cranberry powder (emptied from

capsules) mixed in their food. Cranberry helps keep bacteria from adhering to the walls of the urethra and bladder.

But research has found that cranberry juice is effective only at preventing bladder infections, not curing them. In one

study, drinking 4–6 ounces of a commercial cranberry juice daily significantly prevented infections in a nursing

home population. Another study used doses ranging from 5 to 20 ounces a day (in humans), so for dogs or cats, an

ounce or so of cranberry juice or 1/4 teaspoon of the powder should serve as a nutritious, vitamin C–rich preventive

measure against infection.

有些人和动物通过将蔓越莓汁或蔓越莓粉（从胶囊中倒空）混入食物中来缓解膀胱炎。蔓越莓有助于防

止细菌粘附在尿道和膀胱壁上。但研究发现蔓越莓汁只能有效预防膀胱感染，而不能治愈膀胱感染。在一

项研究中，每天饮用 4-6 盎司市售蔓越莓汁可以显着预防疗养院人群的感染。另一项研究使用的剂量范围

为每天 5 至 20 盎司（人类），因此对于狗或猫来说，一盎司左右的蔓越莓汁或 1/4 茶匙的蔓越莓粉应该作

为一种营养丰富、富含维生素 C 的预防措施防止感染。

The symptomatic herbal approach to any form of urinary system infection centers on the use of herbs that directly

inhibit reproduction of the invading microbes. In most cases, Oregon grape, uva ursi, garlic, raspberry leaf, or

echinacea serves this purpose well. But always look at the whole health picture and never stop asking yourself why

the infection occurred in the first place. For example, animals with chronic gingivitis sometimes develop serious

kidney infections as a progressive result of a bacterial imbalance that originated from poor dental health or immune

system deficiency. Again we are brought back to diet. In carnivores, raw bones serve to keep the teeth clean and the

gums healthy; in herbivores, it’s raw, fiber-rich vegetables. The point is this: if your companion is suffering from a

urinary infection, don’t expect to find a long-term solution exclusively through the use of herbs. A holistic caregiver

must look deeper than the symptoms to find and eliminate the root causes of disease.

针对任何形式的泌尿系统感染的对症草药治疗方法都集中在使用直接抑制入侵微生物繁殖的草药。在大

多数情况下，俄勒冈葡萄、熊果、大蒜、覆盆子叶或紫锥菊都能很好地达到这一目的。但始终要审视整个

健康状况，永远不要停止问自己为什么会发生感染。例如，患有慢性牙龈炎的动物有时会出现严重的肾脏

感染，这是由于牙齿健康状况不佳或免疫系统缺陷而导致细菌失衡的渐进结果。我们再次恢复节食。对于

食肉动物来说，生骨头可以保持牙齿清洁和牙龈健康。对于食草动物来说，它是富含纤维的生蔬菜。重点

是：如果您的伴侣患有泌尿道感染，不要指望仅通过使用草药就能找到长期解决方案。全面的护理人员必

须比症状更深入地寻找并消除疾病的根本原因。

KIDNEY FAILURE

肾功能衰竭

Given the fragility of the kidneys and the extraordinary amount of hard work they do, it’s easy to understand why

they are often the first body structures to wear out in the later years of an animal’s life. However, an alarming

percentage of young and middle-aged animals succumb to kidney failure as well.

考虑到肾脏的脆弱性和它们所做的大量艰苦工作，很容易理解为什么它们往往是动物生命后期最先磨损的

身体结构。然而，年轻和中年动物也死于肾衰竭的比例惊人。

Kidney failure is often caused and is always compounded by a poor-quality or unbalanced diet. One contributing

factor is the overabundance of phosphorus in many commercial brands of dog and cat food. Some brands contain

five to nine times the required amount. While excess phosphorus is seldom an issue for animals with strong, healthy

kidneys, it can be problematic to animals with preexisting kidney damage, especially if they are receiving a diet that

does not contain a necessary balance of readily usable calcium. In these cases, the kidneys may not be able to

effectively eliminate the phosphorus, which then accumulates in the kidneys and results in the eventual formation of

stones or degeneration of kidney tissues. A variety of other problems, such as diabetes, immune system dysfunction,

long-term drug therapies, vaccinosis, chronic liver disease, and digestive problems, often develop as the kidney

damage progresses. The worst part of this grim picture is that the entire degenerative process can remain undetected

until the damage has progressed into an irreversible state of disease.

肾衰竭通常是由不良或不均衡的饮食引起的，并且总是由不良饮食引起的。影响因素之一是许多商业品

牌的狗粮和猫粮中磷含量过高。有些品牌的含量是所需量的五到九倍。虽然对于肾脏强壮、健康的动物来

说，过量的磷很少会成为问题，但对于已有肾脏损伤的动物来说，这可能会带来问题，特别是当它们的饮

食中不含有必要的可用钙平衡时。在这些情况下，肾脏可能无法有效清除磷，磷会积聚在肾脏中，最终导

致结石形成或肾组织退化。随着肾脏损伤的进展，还会出现各种其他问题，例如糖尿病、免疫系统功能障

碍、长期药物治疗、疫苗接种、慢性肝病和消化问题。这幅严峻图景中最糟糕的部分是，整个退化过程可

能一直未被发现，直到损伤发展成不可逆转的疾病状态。

Pinpointing the exact causes of kidney failure can be difficult. The kidneys are fragile and slow to heal, and in

cases of progressive kidney degeneration, time is of the essence. Therefore, holistic treatment of kidney failure must

begin with preventive dietary measures. If it’s too late for preventive measures, the problem is best approached as

early as possible.

查明肾衰竭的确切原因可能很困难。肾脏脆弱且愈合缓慢，在进行性肾脏退化的情况下，时间至关重

要。因此，肾衰竭的整体治疗必须从预防性饮食措施开始。如果采取预防措施为时已晚，最好尽早解决问

题。

If your companion is urinating excessively, drinking a lot of water, or has suffered from one or more urinary tract

infections or a bout with stones, take him to a holistic veterinarian for a thorough examination. If kidney damage is

found, chances are your companion will be placed on a reduced-protein, natural-food diet that is designed to

moderate urine pH levels. This helps alleviate some of the kidney’s workload, allowing the body to direct more

energy toward the healing process. Herbal therapy can then commence with tonic herbs that improve renal blood

circulation (ginkgo, hawthorn), reduce inflammation of nephritic (kidney) and other urinary tract tissues (couch

grass, marshmallow, corn silk), and gently increase urine output (nettle, dandelion, alfalfa, goldenrod). If infection is

part of the problem, nonirritating antimicrobials (Oregon grape, goldenseal) can be added as well. But extra care

must be taken to assure that the herbal therapy does not further irritate the animal’s condition. Avoid herbs that

contain large amounts of aromatic volatile oils (juniper, yarrow, members of the mint family) and those with

considerable amounts of tannins (uva ursi, white oak bark, black walnut hulls), especially if the kidneys are

inflamed.

如果您的同伴排尿过多、喝大量水、或者患有一种或多种尿路感染或结石发作，请带他去看全面兽医进

行彻底检查。如果发现肾脏受损，您的伴侣很可能会接受低蛋白质、天然食品的饮食，旨在调节尿液 pH

值。这有助于减轻肾脏的一些工作负荷，使身体能够将更多的能量用于治疗过程。然后，草药治疗可以从

改善肾脏血液循环的滋补草药（银杏、山楂）开始，减少肾炎（肾脏）和其他泌尿道组织的炎症（沙发

草、棉花糖、玉米须），并逐渐增加尿量（荨麻、蒲公英） 、苜蓿、黄花）。如果感染是问题的一部分，

=== PAGE 549 ===
也可以添加无刺激性的抗菌剂（俄勒冈葡萄、白毛茛）。但必须格外小心，以确保草药疗法不会进一步刺

激动物的状况。避免使用含有大量芳香挥发油的草药（杜松子、西洋蓍草、薄荷科植物）和含有大量单宁

的草药（熊果、白橡树皮、黑胡桃壳），尤其是在肾脏发炎的情况下。

Most traditional herbal approaches to kidney failure are centered on increasing diuresis (urine output) and

decreasing inflammation. But we have found better success when equal attention is placed on improving blood

circulation in the kidneys.

大多数治疗肾衰竭的传统草药方法都集中在增加利尿（排尿量）和减少炎症。但当我们同样重视改善肾

脏的血液循环时，我们会取得更好的成功。

A Holistic Herbal Approach to Kidney Failure: The Tilford Theory

治疗肾衰竭的整体草药方法：蒂尔福德理论

=== PAGE 550 ===
The fact that the kidneys are second only to the brain in terms of circulatory dependency is often overlooked when

treating kidney failure. If the blood flow to the kidneys is blocked by damaged or inflamed tissue, the kidneys will

die from lack of oxygen.

在治疗肾衰竭时，肾脏在循环依赖性方面仅次于大脑，这一事实经常被忽视。如果流向肾脏的血液被受损

或发炎的组织阻塞，肾脏就会因缺氧而死亡。

We have received several reports from veterinarians and pet owners who have seen promising results in the

treatment of early to midstage kidney failure in dogs and cats from use of a formula that combines anti-

inflammatory, immunostimulant, and, most important, circulatory tonic herbs. The theory behind this approach is

that the kidneys are critically oxygen dependent and made up of hundreds of blood vessels. They are sensitive to

blood-pressure disorders, vascular atony, and poor circulation. Through the use of hawthorn, increased renal

circulation is achieved without elevating blood pressure. At the same time, ginkgo dilates and improves tonicity of

nephritic blood vessels, improves blood return from the extremities, and helps reduce blood pressure in congested

tissues. The mucilage content of ginkgo also serves to reduce inflammation throughout the urinary tract and provides

a protective lubricating barrier for the passage of wastes. A small amount of garlic or echinacea helps keep bacteria

and fungi in check, marshmallow helps soothe and reduce inflammation, and dandelion leaf or the fresh juice of

parsley helps to increase urine output. Other herbs worth investigating in cases of kidney failure include alfalfa,

astragalus, goldenrod, and couch grass.

我们收到了来自兽医和宠物主人的几份报告，他们发现使用结合了抗炎、免疫刺激和最重要的循环滋补

草药的配方在治疗狗和猫的早期至中期肾衰竭方面取得了可喜的结果。这种方法背后的理论是，肾脏严重

依赖氧气，并且由数百条血管组成。他们对血压紊乱、血管紧张和血液循环不良很敏感。通过使用山楂，

可以增加肾循环而不升高血压。同时，银杏还能扩张和改善肾血管的张力，改善四肢的血液回流，并有助

于降低充血组织的血压。银杏的粘液含量还可以减少整个泌尿道的炎症，并为废物的通过提供保护性润滑

屏障。少量大蒜或紫锥菊有助于抑制细菌和真菌，棉花糖有助于舒缓和减少炎症，蒲公英叶或新鲜的欧芹

汁有助于增加尿量。其他值得研究治疗肾衰竭的草药包括苜蓿、黄芪、黄花和茅草。

URINARY INCONTINENCE

尿失禁

Urinary incontinence is fairly common in aging animals, spayed females (especially dogs), and in females who have

lost bladder tone as a result of multiple pregnancies. Urinary incontinence can also be triggered by nervous system

dysfunction, emotional disorders, inflammatory disease, or nutritional deficiency.

尿失禁在老年动物、绝育雌性（尤其是狗）以及因多胎妊娠而失去膀胱张力的雌性中相当常见。神经系统

功能障碍、情绪障碍、炎症性疾病或营养缺乏也可能引发尿失禁。

Identifying the exact cause of urinary incontinence can be challenging, and successful herbal treatment usually

depends on just how well the caregiver knows and understands his or her companion. Did the problem begin

suddenly, or has there been an occasional drop or two of urine in your companion’s bed from time to time in the

past? If the latter is true, a gradual degeneration of bladder tone could have been reversed early on. Does your

animal appear to be stiff after exercise, do her hind legs wobble when she stands after exercise, or does she seem to

be holding her rump lower when walking? If any of these are even slightly evident, then your companion may be

developing arthritis, hip dysplasia, or some other cause of nerve impairment that may be affecting the tone and

function of urinary tract muscles. This illustrates just how important a pet care diary can be. By keeping detailed

notes about subtle changes in your animal’s appearance, behavior, feeding habits, and physical performance, you

can detect trends that point to early stages of disease and that greatly simplify finding curative solutions.

确定尿失禁的确切原因可能具有挑战性，成功的草药治疗通常取决于护理人员对他或她的同伴的了解和

理解程度。问题是突然出现的，还是过去您同伴的床上偶尔有一两滴尿液？如果后者属实，膀胱张力的逐

渐退化可能会在早期得到逆转。您的动物在运动后是否显得僵硬，运动后站立时后腿是否摇晃，或者行走

时是否似乎将臀部压低？如果其中任何一个症状稍微明显，那么您的同伴可能患有关节炎、髋关节发育不

良或其他一些神经损伤原因，这些神经损伤可能会影响尿路肌肉的张力和功能。这说明了宠物护理日记的

重要性。通过详细记录动物的外观、行为、饮食习惯和身体表现的细微变化，您可以发现疾病早期阶段的

趋势，并大大简化寻找治疗解决方案的过程。

A TONIC FORMULA FOR URINARY INCONTINENCE

治疗尿失禁的滋补配方

Combine the following:

结合以下内容：

1 part oatstraw

1 份 燕麦草

1 part plantain

1 份 车前草

1 part corn silk

1份玉米丝

1 part nettle root or saw palmetto

1 份荨麻根或锯棕榈

1 part horsetail

1 份马尾

=== PAGE 552 ===
We like to use this formula in the form of a glycerin tincture because it’s easy to administer, but a tea is

equally effective. A good starting dose is 12–20 drops of the glycerite or 1 teaspoon of the strong tea for each

20 pounds of the animal’s body weight, twice daily.

我们喜欢以甘油酊剂的形式使用这种配方，因为它很容易服用，但茶也同样有效。一个好的起始剂

量是每 20 磅动物体重 12-20 滴甘油或 1 茶匙浓茶，每天两次。

In spayed females, normal hormone production is interrupted when the uterus and ovaries are removed during an

ovariohysterectomy. The bladder is composed of smooth-muscle groups that are functionally interdependent with a

balance of reproductive hormones, so when hormone production is altered, the bladder loses tone and urine dribble

results. Reversing this kind of incontinence is difficult because there is no way that herbs can replace hormones that

should be naturally produced by the body. Oatstraw and wild yam (Dioscorea villosa) contain estrogenic

(phytoestrogens) compounds. Theoretically, these herbs might help stimulate whatever hormone production is left

intact, and to some extent they might mimic natural hormone production enough to serve as a partial remedy for

incontinence. Although these herbs are safe in moderate doses, this approach is unreliable and may affect only

certain animals. The better approach toward hormone-related urinary incontinence applies to all forms of urinary

incontinence: strengthen and support the structure and function of the bladder sphincters and urinary smooth-muscle

tissues with long-term use of tonic herbs. Choices include corn silk, raspberry leaf, horsetail, saw palmetto, nettle

root, couch grass, uva ursi, agrimony, marshmallow, and plantain. Oatstraw can also be included for the

aforementioned purpose and as a nutritive diuretic.

在绝育的雌性中，当子宫和卵巢在卵巢子宫切除术中被切除时，正常的激素产生就会中断。膀胱由平滑

肌群组成，这些平滑肌群在功能上与生殖激素的平衡相互依赖，因此当激素产生改变时，膀胱会失去张力

并导致尿液滴落。扭转这种失禁是很困难的，因为草药无法替代身体自然产生的激素。燕麦草和野山药

（Dioscorea villosa）含有雌激素（植物雌激素）化合物。从理论上讲，这些草药可能有助于刺激任何完好

无损的激素产生，并且在某种程度上它们可能模仿天然激素的产生，足以作为失禁的部分治疗方法。尽管

这些草药在中等剂量下是安全的，但这种方法并不可靠，可能只影响某些动物。治疗激素相关性尿失禁的

更好方法适用于所有形式的尿失禁：通过长期使用滋补草药来加强和支持膀胱括约肌和泌尿道平滑肌组织

的结构和功能。选择包括玉米须、覆盆子叶、木贼、锯棕榈、荨麻根、茅草、熊果、仙鹤草、棉花糖和车

前草。也可以出于上述目的并作为营养利尿剂包含燕麦秆。

Urinary incontinence is sometimes caused by neurological disorders, especially in older animals who suffer from

senility and general debility. Oftentimes, epileptic animals have a problem with incontinence too. In these cases, we

can look toward cerebrotonics such as ginkgo and gotu kola to help bring relief. These herbs work to improve

synaptic (nerve impulse) transmission and blood circulation in the brain. Skullcap or valerian might help moderate

brain activities that are believed to trigger epileptic episodes and may also be instrumental in treating incontinence

of neurological origin. If emotional or behavioral disorders are part of the problem, Saint-John’s-wort might be

indicated.

尿失禁有时是由神经系统疾病引起的，尤其是患有衰老和全身虚弱的老年动物。通常，癫痫动物也有失

禁的问题。在这些情况下，我们可以使用银杏和积雪草等脑补剂来缓解症状。这些草药可以改善大脑中的

突触（神经冲动）传递和血液循环。黄芩或缬草可能有助于调节大脑活动，这些活动被认为会引发癫痫发

作，也可能有助于治疗神经性失禁。如果情绪或行为障碍是问题的一部分，则可能需要使用圣约翰草。

的部位

adaptogen: a nontoxic substance that is believed to increase stamina and overall energy levels in the body,

适应原：一种无毒物质，被认为可以增加体内的耐力和整体能量水平，特别是在压力条件下

对抗疗法（参见顺势疗法）：使用药物或其他方法来解毒疾病或症状，但不一定与身体的自然功能相配

毒素和废物进入血液的方式，在大多数情况下是通过刺激肝功能。

homeopathy: a modality of healing founded by Samuel Hahnemann in the late 1700s. The science of homeopathy

involves a meticulous diagnostic investigation of an individual’s physical, behavioral, and historical state of being,

after which a remedy is tailored to the specific needs of the individual. Homeopathic remedies are composed of

organic or nonorganic compounds that are diluted from their original strength hundreds or even thousands of times.

The goal of homeopathic medicine is to effect a desired physical or psychological response by stimulating body

systems at very low, perhaps even molecular levels. Often, a “like versus like” approach is employed, such as when

the homeopathic remedy Arsenicum, an extremely dilute preparation of arsenic, is used to counter a disease that

produces symptoms similar to those of arsenic poisoning.

顺势疗法：Samuel Hahnemann 在 1700 年代末创立的一种治疗方式。顺势疗法的科学涉及对个人的身体、

行为和历史状态进行细致的诊断调查，然后根据个人的具体需求制定治疗方案。顺势疗法由有机或无机化

合物组成，这些化合物被稀释了数百甚至数千倍。顺势疗法的目标是通过在非常低的甚至分子水平上刺激

身体系统来达到所需的身体或心理反应。通常，会采用“同类对同类”的方法，例如当使用顺势疗法药物砷

（一种极其稀释的砷制剂）来对抗产生与砷中毒类似症状的疾病时。

homeostasis: a maintained state of health in which all checks and balances between interdependent elements of

mind, body, and spirit are functioning harmoniously

体内平衡：一种维持的健康状态，其中思想、身体和精神相互依存的要素之间的所有制衡都和谐地发挥作

用

hybridize: to genetically alter a plant species in such a way that inhibits or eliminates the plant’s abilities to

reproduce by natural means

杂交：以抑制或消除植物自然繁殖能力的方式对植物物种进行基因改变

hydroquinones: reduced form of quinone, containing two hydroxyl groups (sometimes used as an antioxidant)

对苯二酚：醌的还原形式，含有两个羟基（有时用作抗氧化剂）

甲状腺功能亢进症：甲状腺功能过度活跃

低血压：低血压

immune modulator: an herb that acts to help the immune system by optimizing it’s ability to adjust to stressful

circumstances. Often used synonymously with the term immunostimulant, immune modulator is becoming more

common in herbalists’ vocabulary as more is learned about how certain immune-supporting herbs work in the body.

免疫调节剂：一种草药，通过优化免疫系统适应压力环境的能力来帮助免疫系统。随着人们对某些免疫支

持草药在体内如何发挥作用的了解越来越多，免疫调节剂经常与免疫刺激剂同义使用，在草药学家的词汇

中变得越来越常见。

immunostimulant: an herb that strengthens the body’s resistance to infection by stimulating and increasing immune

system responses. In herbal medicine, this term specifically refers to the medicinal support of infection-fighting

antibodies in the bloodstream and overall tonification of the lymph system.

免疫刺激剂：一种通过刺激和增强免疫系统反应来增强人体对感染的抵抗力的草药。在草药中，这个术语

特指血液中抗感染抗体的药物支持和淋巴系统的整体强化。

immunotonic: an herb that strengthens the immune system

免疫补剂：一种增强免疫系统的草药

infusion: a preparation made by pouring boiling water over herbs and allowing them to steep; a tea

浸剂：将沸水倒在草药上并让其浸泡而制成的制剂；一杯茶

interleukin: a generic term for a group of multifunctional cytokines that are produced by a variety of lymphoid and

nonlymphoid cells and whose effects occur at least partly within the lymphopoietic system

白细胞介素：一组多功能细胞因子的通用术语，由多种淋巴和非淋巴细胞产生，其作用至少部分发生在淋

巴细胞生成系统内

isoflavone: a flavone compound (e.g., flavonoids) with molecular structures that contribute steroidal properties to a

plant

异黄酮：一种黄酮化合物（例如类黄酮），其分子结构可为植物提供类固醇特性

生酮饮食：一种高脂肪饮食，被认为对人类某些癫痫症有帮助

kinesiology: the study of body motion. In holistic medicine, kinesiology is used as a diagnostic tool involving the

observation and analysis of physical responses to touch, questioning, or other stimuli; the manner in which the body

responds to the stimuli is used to determine the existence and nature of illness.

运动机能学：对身体运动的研究。在整体医学中，运动机能学被用作一种诊断工具，涉及观察和分析对触

摸、询问或其他刺激的身体反应；身体对刺激的反应方式用于确定疾病的存在和性质。

lignan: an organic cellulose-like substance that acts as a binder for the cellulose fibers in wood and certain plants

and adds strength and stiffness to cell walls

木脂素：一种类似纤维素的物质，可作为木材和某些植物中纤维素纤维的粘合剂，并增加细胞壁的强度和

壤土：由粘土、沙子和有机质组成的肥沃土壤

浅裂叶：指的是叶子特征，浅裂叶的边缘（外边缘）有两个或多个地方深深地凹进，但不如掌状叶（例如

枫叶）深。

lymph system: the system of the body responsible for the cleansing of tissues and the production of various

淋巴系统：负责清洁组织并产生各种抗体和白细胞的身体系统

淋巴细胞：血液、淋巴液和淋巴组织中发现的任何单核、非吞噬性白细胞，是人体的免疫活性细胞及其前

形式：治疗剂的使用或使用方法或一组想法或原则

monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI): any of a variety of chemical substances that inhibit the activities of

monoamine oxidase (MAO), an enzyme that is thought to regulate the production of certain antidepressive or

antihistamine chemicals in the body. By blocking the activities of MAO with an MAOI, the body’s production of

seratonin, epinephrine, or histamine is increased to bring about antidepressive effects or other therapeutic results.

单胺氧化酶抑制剂 (MAOI)：抑制单胺氧化酶 (MAO) 活性的多种化学物质中的一种，这种酶被认为可以调

monocyte: a large, nongranular white blood cell with a single round or egg-shaped nucleus

单核细胞：具有单个圆形或蛋形核的大型非颗粒白细胞

山地的：属于山区的或与山区有关的

mucilage: a sticky, oily substance often used in herbal medicine to soothe and protect irritated tissues

粘液：一种粘性油状物质，常用于草药中以舒缓和保护受刺激的组织

mucilaginous: of, relating to, or secreting mucilage. Mucilaginous herbs are generally used as emollients or

粘液的：属于、与粘液有关或分泌粘液的。粘液草药通常用作润肤剂或缓和剂。

叶柄：植物叶子的茎状结构，将叶子连接到植物的茎、枝或真茎；有时称为叶茎

pH: a numerical measurement of acidity or alkalinity. Relating to soil, a pH level of 7.0 is regarded as neutral; lower

numbers indicate increasing acidity, higher numbers indicate increasing alkalinity.

pH：酸度或碱度的数值测量。就土壤而言，pH值7.0被视为中性；较低的数字表示酸度增加，较高的数字表

pinnate: a compound leaf pattern in which leaflets are arranged in opposing pairs along two sides of an axis

羽状：一种复合叶型，小叶沿轴两侧相对成对排列

移液管：用于插入直肠栓剂的小器具；或用于吸取液体的滴管

polysaccharide: a carbohydrate, which on hydrolysis yields a large number of monosaccharide. Polysaccharides are

present in many species of plants, often serving as medicinally active components (e.g., the polysaccharide

多糖：一种碳水化合物，水解后产生大量单糖。多糖存在于多种植物中，通常作为药用活性成分（例如，

增强：使更强大、行动更快或更有效

分层：种子必须经受长时间的寒冷（通常是冰冻）温度和水分以打破休眠状态的发芽过程

链球菌：一类革兰氏阳性、球形、呈微链状的细菌。大多数形式的链球菌通常存在于体内并且无害，而其

终止：指植物茎的绝对末端的花；也称为终端

titer: the quantity of a substance required to produce a reaction with a given volume of another substance, or the

titer analysis is sometimes used to measure an animal’s resistance to an antigen—such as rabies virus. By testing an

animal’s blood for natural resistance to viral or bacterial infection, vaccination can often be avoided.

效价：与给定体积的另一种物质发生反应所需的物质的量，或与给定量的另一种物质相对应的一种物质的

量。在兽医学中，滴度分析有时用于测量动物对抗原（例如狂犬病病毒）的抵抗力。通过测试动物血液对

病毒或细菌感染的天然抵抗力，通常可以避免接种疫苗。

tonic: a general term for a nourishing substance that invigorates and increases the tone and strength of tissues and

improves the function of one or more body systems

补品：一种滋养物质的总称，可以增强和增强组织的张力和强度，并改善一个或多个身体系统的功能

tonicity: a property of the strength and resiliency of a body tissue

张力：身体组织的强度和弹性的属性

umbel: an umbrella-shaped flower. True umbels consist of tiny florets, each extending an equal distance from a

common point to form dense clusters. In this book, the terms umbel and umbel-like are used loosely to include

伞形花序：伞形的花。真正的伞形花序由微小的小花组成，每个小花从公共点延伸相等的距离，形成密集

的簇。在本书中，伞形花序和伞形伞形这两个术语被广泛使用，包括无论“真实”标准如何，呈现伞形的花

朵。

uremia: more correctly referred to as azotemia. An excess presence of urea, creatinine, and other nitrogenous end

尿毒症：更正确地称为氮质血症。血液中尿素、肌酐和其他蛋白质和氨基酸代谢的含氮终产物过多；可能

提示慢性肾功能衰竭。

尿石症：以形成尿路结石或结石为特征的疾病
